Genesis: Bereshit bara elohim et hashshamayim veet haaretz
Bekadmin bera Adonai yat shemayya veyat ara:
Vehaaretz hayta tohu vavohu vechoshech al-pene tehom veruach elohim merachefet al-pene hammayim
Veara havat tzadya verekanya vachashocha paras al appe tehoma verucha min kodam Adonai menashsheva al appe mayya:
Vayyomer elohim yehi or vayhi-or
Vaamar Adonai yehe nehora vahava nehora:
Vayyar elohim et-haor ki-tov vayyavdel elohim ben haor uven hachoshech
Vachaza Adonai yat nehora are tav veafresh Adonai ben nehora uven chashocha:
Vayyikra elohim laor yom velachoshech kara layla vayhi-erev vayhi-voker yom echad
Ukera Adonai linhora yemama velachashocha kera lelya vahava remash vahava tzefar yoma chad:
Vayyomer elohim yehi rakia betoch hammayim vihi mavdil ben mayim lamayim
Vaamar Adonai yehi rekia bimtziut mayya vihi mafrish ben mayya lemayya:
Vayyaas elohim et-harakia vayyavdel ben hammayim asher mittachat larakia uven hammayim asher meal larakia vayhi-chen
Vaavad Adonai yat rekia veafresh ben mayya di milra lirkia uven mayya di meal lirkia vahava chen:
Vayyikra elohim larakia shamayim vayhi-erev vayhi-voker yom sheni
Ukera Adonai lirkia shemayya vahava remash vahava tzefar yom tinyan:
Vayyomer elohim yikkavu hammayim mittachat hashshamayim el-makom echad veterae hayyabbasha vayhi-chen
Vaamar Adonai yitkanshun mayya mittechot shemayya laatar chad vetitchaze yabbeshta vahava chen:
Vayyikra elohim layyabbasha eretz ulemikve hammayim kara yammim vayyar elohim ki-tov
Ukera Adonai leyabbeshta ara ulevet kenishut mayya kera yamme vachaza Adonai are tav:
Vayyomer elohim tadshe haaretz deshe esev mazria zera etz peri ose peri lemino asher zaro-vo al-haaretz vayhi-chen
Vaamar Adonai tadet ara dita isba devar zare mizdera ilan perin avad perin lizne di var zare be al ara vahava chen:
Vattotze haaretz deshe esev mazria zera leminehu veetz ose-pperi asher zaro-vo leminehu vayyar elohim ki-tov
Veappekat ara dita isba devar zare mizdera liznohi veilan aved perin devar zare be liznohi vachaza Adonai are tav:
Vayhi-erev vayhi-voker yom shelishi
Vahava remash vahava tzefar yom telitai:
Vayyomer elohim yehi meorot birkia hashshamayim lehavdil ben hayyom uven hallayla vehayu leotot ulemoadim uleyamim veshanim
Vaamar Adonai yehon nehorin birkia dishmayya leafrasha ben yemama uven lelya vihon leatin ulezimnin ulemimne vehon yomin ushenin:
Vehayu limorot birkia hashshamayim lehair al-haaretz vayhi-chen
Vihon linhorin birkia dishmayya leanhara al ara vahava chen:
Vayyaas elohim et-shene hammeorot haggedolim et-hammaor haggadol lememshelet hayyom veet-hammaor hakkaton lememshelet hallayla veet hakkochavim
Vaavad Adonai yat teren nehorayya ravrevayya yat nehora rabba lemishlat bimama veyat nehora zeera lemishlat belelya veyat kochvayya:
Vayyitten otam elohim birkia hashshamayim lehair al-haaretz
Vihav yathon Adonai birkia dishmayya leanhara al ara:
Velimshol bayyom uvallayla ulehavdil ben haor uven hachoshech vayyar elohim ki-tov
Ulemishlat bimama uvelelya uleafrasha ben nehora uven chashocha vachaza Adonai are tav:
Vayhi-erev vayhi-voker yom revii
Vahava remash vahava tzefar yom reviai:
Vayyomer elohim yishretzu hammayim sheretz nefesh chayya veof yeofef al-haaretz al-pene rekia hashshamayim
Vaamar Adonai yirchashun mayya rechesh nafsha chayta veofa yefarach al ara al appe rekia dishmayya:
Vayyivra elohim et-hattanninim haggedolim veet kol-nefesh hachayya haromeset asher shartzu hammayim leminehem veet kol-of kanaf leminehu vayyar elohim ki-tov
Uvera Adonai yat tanninayya ravrevayya veyat kol nafsha chayta dirchisha di archishu mayya liznehon veyat kol ofa defarach liznohi vachaza Adonai are tav:
Vayvarech otam elohim lemor peru urevu umilu et-hammayim bayyammim vehaof yirev baaretz
Uvarich yathon Adonai lememar pushu usegu umelu yat mayya beyammayya veofa yisge beara:
Vayhi-erev vayhi-voker yom chamishi
Vahava remash vahava tzefar yom chamishai:
Vayyomer elohim totze haaretz nefesh chayya leminah behema varemes vechayto-eretz leminah vayhi-chen
Vaamar Adonai tappek ara nafsha chayta lizna beir urechesh vechevat ara lizna vahava chen:
Vayyaas elohim et-chayyat haaretz leminah veet-habbehema leminah veet kol-remes haadama leminehu vayyar elohim ki-tov
Vaavad Adonai yat chevat ara lizna veyat beira lizna veyat kol richasha deara liznohi vachaza Adonai are tav:
Vayyomer elohim naase adam betzalmenu kidmutenu veyirdu vidgat hayyam uveof hashshamayim uvabbehema uvechol-haaretz uvechol-haremes haromes al-haaretz
Vaamar Adonai naavid enasha betzalmena kidmutana veyishletun benune yamma uveofa dishmayya uvivira uvechol ara uvechol richasha derachesh al ara:
Vayyivra elohim et-haadam betzalmo betzelem elohim bara oto zachar unekeva bara otam
Uvera Adonai yat adam betzalme betzalma daAdonai bera yate dechar venukeva bera yathon:
Vayvarech otam elohim vayyomer lahem elohim peru urevu umilu et-haaretz vechivshuha uredu bidgat hayyam uveof hashshamayim uvechol-chayya haromeset al-haaretz
Uvarich yathon Adonai vaamar lehon Adonai pushu usegu umelu yat ara utekufu ala ushelutu benune yamma uveofa dishmayya uvechol chayta derachesha al ara:
Vayyomer elohim hinne natatti lachem et-kol-esev zorea zera asher al-pene chol-haaretz veet-kol-haetz asher-bo feri-etz zorea zara lachem yihye leochla
Vaamar Adonai ha yehavit lechon yat kol isba devar zare mizdera di al appe chol ara veyat kol ilana di ve pere ilana devar zare mizdera lechon yehe lemechal:
Ulechol-chayyat haaretz ulechol-of hashshamayim ulechol romes al-haaretz asher-bo nefesh chayya et-kol-yerek esev leochla vayhi-chen
Ulechal chevat ara ulechal ofa dishmayya ulechol derachesh al ara di ve nafsha chayta yat kol yerok isba lemechal vahava chen:
Vayyar elohim et-kol-asher asa vehinne-tov meod vayhi-erev vayhi-voker yom hashshishshi
Vachaza Adonai yat kol di avad veha takkin lachada vahava remash vahava tzefar yom shetitai:
Vaychullu hashshamayim vehaaretz vechol-tzevaam
Veishtachlalu shemayya veara vechol chelehon:
Vaychal elohim bayyom hashshevii melachto asher asa vayyishbot bayyom hashshevii mikkol-melachto asher asa
Veshetze Adonai beyoma sheviaa avidte di avad venach beyoma sheviaa mikkol avidte di avad:
Vayvarech elohim et-yom hashshevii vaykaddesh oto ki vo shavat mikkol-melachto asher-bara elohim laasot
Uvarich Adonai yat yoma sheviaa vekaddish yate are ve nach mikkol avidte di vera Adonai lemebad:
Elle toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz behibbaram beyom asot Adonai elohim eretz veshamayim
Illen tuledat shemayya veara kad itberiu beyoma di avad Adonai elohim ara ushemayya:
Vechol siach hassade terem yihye vaaretz vechol-esev hassade terem yitzmach ki lo himtir Adonai elohim al-haaretz veadam ayin laavod et-haadama
Vechol ilane chakla ad la havu veara vechol isba dechakla ad la tzemach are la achit mitra Adonai elohim al ara veenash let lemiflach yat admeta:
Veed yaale min-haaretz vehishka et-kol-pene haadama
Vaanana hava salek min ara veashke yat kol appe admeta:
Vayyitzer Adonai elohim et-haadam afar min-haadama vayyippach beappav nishmat chayyim vayhi haadam lenefesh chayya
Uvera Adonai elohim yat adam afra min admeta unefach beappohi nishmeta dechayye vahavat beadam leruach memalla:
Vayyitta Adonai elohim gan-beeden mikkedem vayyasem sham et-haadam asher yatzar
Unetziv Adonai elohim ginta veeden millekadmin veashve tamman yat adam di vera:
Vayyatzmach Adonai elohim min-haadama kol-etz nechmad lemare vetov lemaachal veetz hachayyim betoch haggan veetz haddaat tov vara
Veatzmach Adonai elohim min ara kol ilan dimraggeg lemecheze vetav lemechal veilan chayya bimtziut ginta veilan deochlin perohi chakkimin ben tav levish:
Venahar yotze meeden lehashkot et-haggan umishsham yippared vehaya learbaa rashim
Venahara hava nafik meeden leashkaa yat ginta umittamman yitparish vahave learbea reshe naharin:
Shem haechad pishon hu hassovev et kol-eretz hachavila asher-sham hazzahav
Shum chad pishon hu makkif yat kol ara dachavila di tamman dahava:
Uzehav haaretz hahiv tov sham habbedolach veeven hashshoham
Vedahava deara hahi tav taman bedalcha veavne vurela:
Veshem-hannahar hashsheni gichon hu hassovev et kol-eretz kush
Veshum nahara tinyana gichon hu makkif yat kol ara dechush:
Veshem hannahar hashshelishi chiddekel hu haholech kidmat ashshur vehannahar harvii hu ferat
Veshum nahara telitaa diglat hu mehallech lemaddincha deattur venahara reviaa hu ferat:
Vayyikkach Adonai elohim et-haadam vayyannichehu vegan-eden leovdah uleshomrah
Udevar Adonai elohim yat adam veashreh beginta deeden lemiflecha ulemitra:
Vaytzav Adonai elohim al-haadam lemor mikkol etz-haggan achol tochel
Ufakkid Adonai elohim al adam lememar mikkol ilan ginta mechal techul:
Umeetz haddaat tov vara lo tochal mimmennu ki beyom acholcha mimmennu mot tamut
Umeilan deochlin perohi chakkimin ben tav levish la techul minne are beyoma detechul minne memat temut:
Vayyomer Adonai elohim lo-tov heyot haadam levaddo eese-llo ezer kenegdo
Vaamar Adonai elohim la takkin lemeheve adam bilchodohi aaved le semach lekivle:
Vayyitzer Adonai elohim min-haadama kol-chayyat hassade veet kol-of hashshamayim vayyave el-haadam lirot ma-yyikra-lo vechol asher yikra-lo haadam nefesh chayya hu shemo
Uvera Adonai elohim min ara kol chevat bera veyat kol ofa dishmayya veayte levat adam lemecheze ma yikre le vechol di hava kare le adam nafsha chayta hu sheme:
Vayyikra haadam shemot lechol-habbehema uleof hashshamayim ulechol chayyat hassade uleadam lo-matza ezer kenegdo
Ukera adam shemahan lechol beira uleofa dishmayya ulechal chevat bera uleadam la ashkach samech lekivle:
Vayyappel Adonai elohim tardema al-haadam vayyishan vayyikkach achat mitztzalotav vayyisgor basar tachtenna
Urema Adonai elohim shinta al adam udemech unesiv chada meilohi umele visra techota:
Vayyiven Adonai elohim et-hatztzela asher-lakach min-haadam leishsha vayvieha el-haadam
Uvena Adonai elohim yat ila dinsiv min adam leitteta veayta levat adam:
Vayyomer haadam zot happaam etzem meatzamay uvasar mibbesari lezot yikkare ishsha ki meish lukcha-zzot
Vaamar haadam hada zimna garma miggarmay uvisra mibbisri leda yitkere itteta are mibbala nesiva da:
Al-ken yaazov-ish et-aviv veet-immo vedavak beishto vehayu levasar echad
Al ken yishbok gevar bet mishkeve avuhi veimme veyidbak beittete vihon levisra chad:
Vayyihyu shenehem arummim haadam veishto velo yitboshashu
Vahavo tarvehon artilain adam veittete vela mitkalmin:
Vehannachash haya arum mikkol chayyat hassade asher asa Adonai elohim vayyomer el-haishsha af ki-amar elohim lo tochlu mikkol etz haggan
Vechivya hava chakkim mikkol chevat bera di avad Adonai elohim vaamar leitteta bekusheta are amar Adonai la techlun mikkol ilan ginta:
Vattomer haishsha el-hannachash mipperi etz-haggan nochel
Vaamarat itteta lechivya mippere ilan ginta nechul:
Umipperi haetz asher betoch-haggan amar elohim lo tochlu mimmennu velo tiggeu bo pen-temutun
Umippere ilana di vimtziut ginta amar Adonai la techlun minne vela tekarvun be dilma temutun:
Vayyomer hannachash el-haishsha lo-mot temutun
Vaamar chivya leitteta la mut temutun:
Ki yodea elohim ki beyom acholchem mimmennu venifkechu enechem vihyitem kelohim yode tov vara
Are galle kodam Adonai are beyoma detechlun minne veyitpattechan enechon utehon keravrevin chakkimin ben tav levish:
Vattere haishsha ki tov haetz lemaachal vechi taava-hu laenayim venechmad haetz lehaskil vattikkach mippiryo vattochal vattitten gam-leishah immah vayyochal
Vachazat itteta are tav ilan lemechal vaare asse hu leaynin umeraggeg ilana leistakkala ve unesevat meibbe vaachalat vihavat af levala imma vaachal:
Vattippakachna ene shenehem vayyedu ki erummim hem vayyitperu ale teena vayyaasu lahem chagorot
Veitpattacha ene tarvehon vidau are artilain inun vechattitu lehon tarfe teenin vaavadu lehon zerazin:
Vayyishmeu et-kol Adonai elohim mithallech baggan leruach hayyom vayyitchabbe haadam veishto mippene Adonai elohim betoch etz haggan
Ushemau yat kal memra daAdonai elohim mehallech beginta limnach yoma veitammar adam veittete min kodam Adonai elohim bego ilan ginta:
Vayyikra Adonai elohim el-haadam vayyomer lo ayyekka
Ukera Adonai elohim leadam vaamar le an at:
Vayyomer et-kolcha shamati baggan vaira ki-erom anochi vaechave
Vaamar yat kal memrach shamit beginta udechelit are artilay ana veitammarit:
Vayyomer mi higgid lecha ki erom atta hamin-haetz asher tzivviticha levilti achol-mimmennu achalta
Vaamar man chave lach are artilay at hamin ilana difakkedtach bedil dela lemechal minne achalt:
Vayyomer haadam haishsha asher natatta immadi hiv natna-lli min-haetz vaochel
Vaamar haadam itteta dihavta immi hi yahavat li min ilana vaachalit:
Vayyomer Adonai elohim laishsha ma-zzot asit vattomer haishsha hannachash hishshiani vaochel
Vaamar Adonai elohim leitteta ma da avdat vaamarat itteta chivya atayani vaachalit:
Vayyomer Adonai elohim el-hannachash ki asita zot arur atta mikkol-habbehema umikkol chayyat hassade al-gechoncha telech veafar tochal kol-yeme chayyecha
Vaamar Adonai elohim lechivya are avadta da lit at mikkol beira umikkol chevat bara al meach tezil veafra techul kol yome chayyaych:
Veeva ashit bencha uven haishsha uven zaracha uven zarah hu yeshufecha rosh veatta teshufennu akev
Udevavu eshavve benach uven itteta uven benach uven benaha hu yehe dechir lach ma diavadta le millekadmin veat tehe natir le lesofa:
El-haishsha amar harba arbe itztzevonech veheronech beetzev teldi vanim veel-ishech teshukatech vehu yimshol-bach
Leitteta amar asgaa asge tzaaraychi veidduyaychi betzear teldi venin ulevat balich tehe tiuvetich vehu yishlat bich:
Uleadam amar ki-shamata lekol ishtecha vattochal min-haetz asher tzivviticha lemor lo tochal mimmennu arura haadama baavurecha beitztzavon tochlenna kol yeme chayyecha
Uleadam amar are kabbelta lememar ittetach vaachalta min ilana di fakkedtach lememar la techul minne lita ara bedilach baamal tichlina kol yome chayyaych:
Vekotz vedardar tatzmiach lach veachalta et-esev hassade
Vechuvin veatdin tatzmach lach vetechul yat isba dechakla:
Bezeat appecha tochal lechem ad shuvecha el-haadama ki mimmenna lukkachta ki-afar atta veel-afar tashuv
Beziata deappach techul lachma ad detituv leara deminna itbereta are afra at uleafra tetuv:
Vayyikra haadam shem ishto chavva ki hiv hayta em kol-chay
Ukera adam shum ittete chavva are hi havat imma dechal bene enasha:
Vayyaas Adonai elohim leadam uleishto kotnot or vayyalbishem
Vaavad Adonai elohim leadam uleittete levushin dikar al meshach bisrehon vealbishinun:
Vayyomer Adonai elohim hen haadam haya keachad mimmennu ladaat tov vara veatta pen-yishlach yado velakach gam meetz hachayyim veachal vachay leolam
Vaamar Adonai elohim ha adam hava yechiday bealma minne lemida tav uvish uchean dilma yoshit yede veyissav af meilan chayyay veyechul viche lealam:
Vayshallechehu Adonai elohim miggan-eden laavod et-haadama asher lukkach mishsham
Veshalleche Adonai elohim migginta deeden lemiflach yat admeta deitberi mittamman:
Vaygaresh et-haadam vayyashken mikkedem legan-eden et-hakkeruvim veet lahat hacherev hammithappechet lishmor et-derech etz hachayyim
Vetarich yat adam veashre millekadmin leginta deeden yat keruvayya veyat shenan charba demithappecha lemitar yat orach ilan chayyay:
Vehaadam yada et-chavva ishto vattahar vatteled et-kayin vattomer kaniti ish et-Adonai
Veadam yeda yat chavva ittete veaddiat vilidat yat kayin vaameret kaniti gavra min kodam Adonai:
Vattosef laledet et-achiv et-havel vayhi-hevel roe tzon vekayin haya oved adama
Veosifat lemelad yat achohi yat havel vahava hevel rae ana vekayin hava falach beara:
Vayhi mikketz yamim vayyave kayin mipperi haadama mincha la-Adonai
Vahava missof yomin veayti kayin meibba deara tikruveta kodam Adonai:
Vehevel hevi gam-hu mibbechorot tzono umechelvehen vayyisha Adonai el-hevel veel-minchato
Vehevel ayti af hu mibbakkire ane umishamminhon vahavat raava min kodam Adonai behevel ubekurebane:
Veel-kayin veel-minchato lo shaa vayyichar lekayin meod vayyippelu panav
Ubekayin ubekurebane la havat raava utekef lekayin lachada veitkevishu appohi:
Vayyomer Adonai el-kayin lamma chara lach velamma naflu fanecha
Vaamar Adonai lekayin lema tekif lach ulema itkevishu appaych:
Halo im-tetiv seet veim lo tetiv lappetach chattat rovetz veelecha teshukato veatta timshol-bo
Hala im totiv ovadach yishtevek lach veim la totiv ovadach leyom dina chetach netir diatid leitpara minnach im la tetuv veim tetuv yishtevek lach:
Vayyomer kayin el-hevel achiv vayhi bihyotam bassade vayyakom kayin el-hevel achiv vayyahargehu
Vaamar kayin lehevel achohi vahava bemehevehon bechakla vekam kayin al hevel achohi vekatle:
Vayyomer Adonai el-kayin e hevel achicha vayyomer lo yadati hashomer achi anochi
Vaamar Adonai lekayin an hevel achuch vaamar la yadaana hanater achi ana:
Vayyomer me asita kol deme achicha tzoakim elay min-haadama
Vaamar me avadta kal dam zarin diatidin lemefak min achuch kavlin kodamay min ara:
Veatta arur atta min-haadama asher patzta et-piha lakachat et-deme achicha miyyadecha
Uchean lit at min ara diftachat yat puma vekabbilat yat deme deachuch min yedach:
Ki taavod et-haadama lo-tosef tet-kochah lach na vanad tihye vaaretz
Are tiflach veara la tosif lemittan chela lach mitaltel vegale tehe veara:
Vayyomer kayin el-Adonai gadol avoni minneso
Vaamar kayin kodam Adonai saggi chovi millemishbak:
Hen gerashta oti hayyom meal pene haadama umippanecha essater vehayiti na vanad baaretz vehaya chol-motzi yahargeni
Ha tarichta yati yoma den meal appe ara umin kodamach let efshar leittammara vaehi metaltel vegale beara vihe chol deyishkechinani yiktelinani:
Vayyomer lo Adonai lachen kol-horeg kayin shivatayim yukkam vayyasem Adonai lekayin ot levilti hakkot-oto kol-motzo
Vaamar le Adonai bechen kol katil kayin leshava darin yitpera minne veshavvi Adonai lekayin ata bedil dela lemiktal yate kol diyishkechune:
Vayyetze kayin millifne Adonai vayyeshev beeretz-nod kidmat-eden
Unefak kayin min kodam Adonai vitev beara gale umittaltal dahava avida alohi millekadmin deginta deeden:
Vayyeda kayin et-ishto vattahar vatteled et-chanoch vayhi bone ir vayyikra shem hair keshem beno chanoch
Vida kayin yat ittete veaddiat viledat yat chanoch vahava bane karta ukera shema dekarta keshum bere chanoch:
Vayyivvaled lachanoch et-irad veirad yalad et-mechuyael umechiyyayel yalad et-metushael umetushael yalad et-lamech
Veityelid lachanoch yat irad veirad olid yat mechuyael umechiyyayel olid yat metushael umetushael olid yat lamech:
Vayyikkach-lo lemech shete nashim shem haachat ada veshem hashshenit tzilla
Unesiv le lemech tarten neshin shum chada ada veshum tinyeta tzilla:
Vatteled ada et-yaval hu haya avi yoshev ohel umikne
Viledat ada yat yaval hu hava rabbehon deyatve mashkenin umare veir:
Veshem achiv yuval hu haya avi kol-tofes kinnor veugav
Veshum achohi yuval hu hava rabbehon dechal dimnaggen al pum nivla yade zemar kinnora veabbuva:
Vetzilla gam-hiv yalda et-tuval kayin lotesh kol-choresh nechoshet uvarzel vaachot tuval-kayin naama
Vetzilla af hi yeledat yat tuval kayin rabbehon dechal deyade ividat nechasha ufarzela vaachate detuval kayin naama:
Vayyomer lemech lenashav ada vetzilla shemaan koli neshe lemech hazenna imrati ki ish haragti lefitzi veyeled lechabburati
Vaamar lemech linshohi ada vetzilla shiman kali neshe lemech atzeta lememri la gavra ketalit divdile ana savil chovin veaf la ulema chabbalit divdile yishtetze zari:
Ki shivatayim yukkam-kayin velemech shivim veshiva
Are shava darin itliu lekayin hala lelemech bere shavin veshava:
Vayyeda adam od et-ishto vatteled ben vattikra et-shemo shet ki shat-li elohim zera acher tachat hevel ki harago kayin
Vida adam od yat ittete viledat bar ukerat yat sheme shet are amarat yehav li Adonai bar ocharan chalaf hevel dikatle kayin:
Uleshet gam-hu yullad-ben vayyikra et-shemo enosh az huchal likro beshem Adonai
Uleshet af hu ityelid bar ukera yat sheme enosh bechen beyomohi chalu vene enasha milletzallaa bishma daAdonai:
Ze sefer toldot adam beyom bero elohim adam bidmut elohim asa oto
Den sefar tuledat adam beyoma divra Adonai adam bidmut elohim avad yate:
Zachar unekeva beraam vayvarech otam vayyikra et-shemam adam beyom hibbaram
Dechar venukeva beranun uvarich yathon ukera yat shemahon adam beyoma deitberiu:
Vaychi adam sheloshim umeat shana vayyoled bidmuto ketzalmo vayyikra et-shemo shet
Vachaya adam mea utelatin shenin veolid bidmute dedame le ukera yat sheme shet:
Vayyihyu yeme-adam achare holido et-shet shemone meot shana vayyoled banim uvanot
Vahavo yome adam batar deolid yat shet tamne mea shenin veolid benin uvenan:
Vayyihyu kol-yeme adam asher-chay tesha meot shana usheloshim shana vayyamot
Vahavo kol yome adam dachaya tesha mea utelatin shenin umit:
Vaychi-shet chamesh shanim umeat shana vayyoled et-enosh
Vachaya shet mea vachamesh shenin veolid yat enosh:
Vaychi-shet achare holido et-enosh sheva shanim ushemone meot shana vayyoled banim uvanot
Vachaya shet batar deolid yat enosh tamne mea usheva shenin veolid benin uvenan:
Vayyihyu kol-yeme-shet shetem esre shana utesha meot shana vayyamot
Vahavo kol yome shet tesha mea vetarte asre shenin umit:
Vaychi enosh tishim shana vayyoled et-kenan
Vachaya enosh tishin shenin veolid yat kenan:
Vaychi enosh achare holido et-kenan chamesh esre shana ushemone meot shana vayyoled banim uvanot
Vachaya enosh batar deolid yat kenan tamne mea vachamesh asre shenin veolid benin uvenan:
Vayyihyu kol-yeme enosh chamesh shanim utesha meot shana vayyamot
Vahavo kol yome enosh tesha mea vachamesh shenin umit:
Vaychi kenan shivim shana vayyoled et-mahalalel
Vachaya kenan shavin shenin veolid yat mahalalel:
Vaychi kenan achare holido et-mahalalel arbaim shana ushemone meot shana vayyoled banim uvanot
Vachaya kenan batar deolid yat mahalalel tamne mea vearbein shenin veolid benin uvenan:
Vayyihyu kol-yeme kenan eser shanim utesha meot shana vayyamot
Vahavo kol yome kenan tesha mea vaasar shenin umit:
Vaychi mahalalel chamesh shanim veshishshim shana vayyoled et-yared
Vachaya mahalalel shittin vachamesh shenin veolid yat yared:
Vaychi mahalalel achare holido et-yered sheloshim shana ushemone meot shana vayyoled banim uvanot
Vachaya mahalalel batar deolid yat yered tamne mea utelatin shenin veolid benin uvenan:
Vayyihyu kol-yeme mahalalel chamesh vetishim shana ushemone meot shana vayyamot
Vahavo kol yome mahalalel tamne mea vetishin vachamesh shenin umit:
Vaychi-yered shetayim veshishshim shana umeat shana vayyoled et-chanoch
Vachaya yered mea veshittin vetarten shenin veolid yat chanoch:
Vaychi-yered achare holido et-chanoch shemone meot shana vayyoled banim uvanot
Vachaya yered batar deolid yat chanoch tamne mea shenin veolid benin uvenan:
Vayyihyu kol-yeme-yered shetayim veshishshim shana utesha meot shana vayyamot
Vahavo kol yome yered tesha mea veshittin vetarten shenin umit:
Vaychi chanoch chamesh veshishshim shana vayyoled et-metushalach
Vachaya chanoch shittin vachamesh shenin veolid yat metushalach:
Vayyithallech chanoch et-haelohim achare holido et-metushelach shelosh meot shana vayyoled banim uvanot
Vehallich chanoch bedachalta daAdonai batar deolid yat metushelach telat mea shenin veolid benin uvenan:
Vayhi kol-yeme chanoch chamesh veshishshim shana ushelosh meot shana
Vahava kol yome chanoch telat mea veshittin vachamesh shenin:
Vayyithallech chanoch et-haelohim veenennu ki-lakach oto elohim
Vehallich chanoch bedachalta daAdonai velaytohi are la amet yate Adonai:
Vaychi metushelach sheva ushemonim shana umeat shana vayyoled et-lamech
Vachaya metushelach mea vetamnin usheva shenin veolid yat lamech:
Vaychi metushelach achare holido et-lemech shetayim ushemonim shana usheva meot shana vayyoled banim uvanot
Vachaya metushelach batar deolid yat lemech sheva mea vetamnin vetarten shenin veolid benin uvenan:
Vayyihyu kol-yeme metushelach tesha veshishshim shana utesha meot shana vayyamot
Vahavo kol yome metushelach tesha mea veshittin utesha shenin umit:
Vaychi-lemech shetayim ushemonim shana umeat shana vayyoled ben
Vachaya lemech mea vetamnin vetarten shenin veolid bar:
Vayyikra et-shemo noach lemor ze yenachamenu mimmaasenu umeitztzevon yadenu min-haadama asher ererah Adonai
Ukera yat sheme noach lememar den yenachaminnana meovadana umilleut yedana min ara di latta Adonai:
Vaychi-lemech achare holido et-noach chamesh vetishim shana vachamesh meot shana vayyoled banim uvanot
Vachaya lemech batar deolid yat noach chamesh mea vetishin vachamesh shenin veolid benin uvenan:
Vayhi kol-yeme-lemech sheva veshivim shana usheva meot shana vayyamot
Vahavo kol yome lemech sheva mea veshavin usheva shenin umit:
Vayhi-noach ben-chamesh meot shana vayyoled noach et-shem et-cham veet-yafet
Vahava noach bar chamesh mea shenin veolid noach yat shem yat cham veyat yafet:
Vayhi ki-hechel haadam larov al-pene haadama uvanot yulledu lahem
Vahava kad sheriu vene enasha lemisge al appe ara uvenata ityelidu lehon:
Vayyiru vene-haelohim et-benot haadam ki tovot henna vayyikchu lahem nashim mikkol asher bacharu
Vachazo vene ravrevayya yat benat enasha are shappiran inun unesivu lehon neshin mikkol di itreiu:
Vayyomer Adonai lo-yadon ruchi vaadam leolam beshaggam hu vasar vehayu yamav mea veesrim shana
Vaamar Adonai la yitkayam dara visha haden kodamay lealam bedil deinun bisra veovadehon bishaya archa yehivat lehon mea veasrin shenin im yetuvun:
Hannefilim hayu vaaretz bayyamim hahem vegam achare-chen asher yavou bene haelohim el-benot haadam veyaldu lahem hemma haggibborim asher meolam anshe hashshem
Gibbarayya havo veara beyomayya hainnun veaf batar ken di yaalun bene ravrevayya levat benat enasha vilidan lehon inun gibbarayya dimealma enashin dishma:
Vayyar Adonai ki rabba raat haadam baaretz vechol-yetzer machshevot libbo rak ra kol-hayyom
Vachaza Adonai are segiat bishat enasha beara vechol yitzra machshevat libbe lechod bish kol yoma:
Vayyinnachem Adonai ki-asa et-haadam baaretz vayyitatztzev el-libbo
Vetav Adonai bememre are avad yat enasha beara vaamar bememre lemittevar takpehon kirute:
Vayyomer Adonai emche et-haadam asher-barati meal pene haadama meadam ad-behema ad-remes vead-of hashshamayim ki nichamti ki asitim
Vaamar Adonai emche yat anasha di vereti meal appe ara meenasha ad beira ad richasha vead ofa dishmayya are tavit bememri are avadtinun:
Venoach matza chen beene Adonai
Venoach ashkach rachamin kodam Adonai:
Elle toldot noach noach ish tzaddik tamim haya bedorotav et-haelohim hithallech-noach
Illen tuledat noach noach gevar zakkay shelim hava bedarohi bedachalta daAdonai hallich noach:
Vayyoled noach shelosha vanim et-shem et-cham veet-yafet
Veolid noach telata venin yat shem yat cham veyat yafet:
Vattishshachet haaretz lifne haelohim vattimmale haaretz chamas
Veitchabbalat ara kodam Adonai veitmeliat ara chatofin:
Vayyar elohim et-haaretz vehinne nishchata ki-hishchit kol-basar et-darko al-haaretz
Vachaza Adonai yat ara veha itchabbalat are chabbilu kol bisra enash yat orche al ara:
Vayyomer elohim lenoach ketz kol-basar ba lefanay ki-mala haaretz chamas mippenehem vehinni mashchitam et-haaretz
Vaamar Adonai lenoach kitztza dechal bisra allat likodamay are itmeliat ara chatofin min kodam ovadehon bishayya veha ana mechabbelhon im ara:
Ase lecha tevat atze-gofer kinnim taase et-hatteva vechafarta otah mibbayit umichutz bakkofer
Ived lach tevota deain dekadrom medorin tabed yat tevota vetechpe yata miggav umibbara bechafra:
Veze asher taase otah shelosh meot amma orech hatteva chamishshim amma rochbah usheloshim amma komatah
Veden ditaabbed yata telat mea ammin ureka detevota chamshin ammin petaya utelatin ammin ruma:
Tzohar taase latteva veel-amma techallenna milmala ufetach hatteva betziddah tasim tachtiyyim sheniyyim ushelishim taaseha
Nehor tabed letevota uleamta teshachlelinna milleella vetara detevota besitra teshavvi medorin arain tinyanin utelitain tabedinna:
Vaani hinni mevi et-hammabbul mayim al-haaretz leshachet kol-basar asher-bo ruach chayyim mittachat hashshamayim kol asher-baaretz yigva
Vaana ha ana mayte yat tofana mayya al ara lechabbala kol bisra di veh rucha dechayye mittechot shemayya kol di veara yemut:
Vahakimoti et-beriti ittach uvata el-hatteva atta uvanecha veishtecha uneshe-vanecha ittach
Veakem yat keyami immach veteol letevota at uvenach veittetach uneshe venach immach:
Umikkol-hachay mikkol-basar shenayim mikkol tavi el-hatteva lehachayot ittach zachar unekeva yihyu
Umikkal dechay mikkol bisra teren mikkola tael letevota lekayyama immach dechar venakba yehon:
Mehaof leminehu umin-habbehema leminah mikkol remes haadama leminehu shenayim mikkol yavou elecha lehachayot
Meofa liznohi umin beira lizna umikkol richasha deara liznohi teren mikkolla yaalun levatach lekayyama:
Veatta kach-lecha mikkol-maachal asher yeachel veasafta elecha vehaya lecha velahem leochla
Veat sav lach mikkol mechal dimitachel vetichnosh levatach vihe lach ulehon lemechal:
Vayyaas noach kechol asher tzivva oto elohim ken asa
Vaavad noch kechol di fakked yateh Adonai ken avad:
Vayyomer Adonai lenoach bo-atta vechol-betcha el-hatteva ki-otcha raiti tzaddik lefanay baddor hazze
Vaamar Adonai lenoach ul at vechol enash betach letevota are yatach chazeti zakkay kodamay bedara haden:
Mikkol habbehema hattehora tikkach-lecha shiva shiva ish veishto umin-habbehema asher lo tehora hiv shenayim ish veishto
Mikkol beira dachya tissav lach shava shava dechar venakba umin beira dila itaha dachya hi teren dechar venakba:
Gam meof hashshamayim shiva shiva zachar unekeva lechayyot zera al-pene chol-haaretz
Af meofa dishmayya shava shava dechar venakba lekayyama zara al appe chol ara:
Ki leyamim od shiva anochi mamtir al-haaretz arbaim yom vearbaim layla umachiti et-kol-hayekum asher asiti meal pene haadama
Are lizman yomin od shava ana machet mitra al ara arbein yemamin vearbein lelavan veemche yat kol yekuma di avdat meal appe ara:
Vayyaas noach kechol asher-tzivvahu Adonai
Vaavad noach kechol di fakkedeh Adonai:
Venoach ben-shesh meot shana vehammabbul haya mayim al-haaretz
Venoach bar shit mea shenin vetofana hava mayya al ara:
Vayyavo noach uvanav veishto uneshe-vanav itto el-hatteva mippene me hammabbul
Veal noach uvenohi veitteteh uneshe venohi immeh letevota min kodam me tofana:
Min-habbehema hattehora umin-habbehema asher enenna tehora umin-haof vechol asher-romes al-haadama
Min beira dachya umin beira di letaha dachya umin ofa vechol di rachesh al ara:
Shenayim shenayim bau el-noach el-hatteva zachar unekeva kaasher tzivva elohim et-noach
Teren teren allu levat noach letevota dechar venakba kema di fakked Adonai yat noach:
Vayhi leshivat hayyamim ume hammabbul hayu al-haaretz
Vahava lizman shivat yomin ume tofana havo al ara:
Bishnat shesh-meot shana lechayye-noach bachodesh hashsheni beshiva-asar yom lachodesh bayyom hazze nivkeu kol-mayenot tehom rabba vaarubbot hashshamayim niftachu
Bishnat shit mea shenin lechayye noach beyarcha tinyana beshivat asra yoma leyarcha beyoma haden itbezau kol mabbue tehoma rabba vechavve shemayya itpattachu:
Vayhi haggeshem al-haaretz arbaim yom vearbaim layla
Vahava mitra nachat al ara arbein yemamin vearbein lelavan:
Beetzem hayyom hazze ba noach veshem-vecham vayefet bene-noach veeshet noach usheloshet neshe-vanav ittam el-hatteva
Bichran yoma haden al noach veshem vecham vayefet bene noach veittat noach utelata neshe venohi immehon letevota:
Hemma vechol-hachayya leminah vechol-habbehema leminah vechol-haremes haromes al-haaretz leminehu vechol-haof leminehu kol tzippor kol-kanaf
Innun vechol chayta lizna vechol beira lizna vechol richasha derachesh al ara liznohi vechol ofa liznohi kol tzippar kol defarach:
Vayyavou el-noach el-hatteva shenayim shenayim mikkol-habbasar asher-bo ruach chayyim
Veallu im noach letevota teren teren mikkol bisra di veh rucha dechaye:
Vehabbaim zachar unekeva mikkol-basar bau kaasher tzivva oto elohim vayyisgor Adonai baado
Vealayya dechar venakba mikkol bisra allu kema di fakked yateh Adonai vaagen Adonai bememreh alohi:
Vayhi hammabbul arbaim yom al-haaretz vayyirbu hammayim vayyisu et-hatteva vattarom meal haaretz
Vahava tofana arbein yomin al ara usegiu mayya unetalu yat tevota veittaramat meal ara:
Vayyigberu hammayim vayyirbu meod al-haaretz vattelech hatteva al-pene hammayim
Utekifu mayya usegiu lachada al ara umehallecha tevota al appe mayya:
Vehammayim gavru meod meod al-haaretz vaychussu kol-heharim haggevohim asher-tachat kol-hashshamayim
Umayya tekifu lachada lachada al ara veitchafiu kol turayya ramayya di techot kol shemayya:
Chamesh esre amma milmala gavru hammayim vaychussu heharim
Chamesh asre ammin milella tekifu mayya veitchafiu turaya:
Vayyigva kol-basar haromes al-haaretz baof uvabbehema uvachayya uvechol-hashsheretz hashshoretz al-haaretz vechol haadam
Umit kol bisra derachesh al ara beofa uvivira uvechayta uvechol richasha derachesh al ara vechol enasha:
Kol asher nishmat-ruach chayyim beappav mikkol asher becharava metu
Kol di nishmeta rucha dechayyin beanfohi mikkol di beyabbeshta mitu:
Vayyimach et-kol-hayekum asher al-pene haadama meadam ad-behema ad-remes vead-of hashshamayim vayyimmachu min-haaretz vayyishshaer ach-noach vaasher itto batteva
Umecha yat kol yekuma di al appe ara meenasha ad beira ad richasha vead ofa dishmayya veitmechiu min ara veishtaar beram noach vedi immeh betevota:
Vayyigberu hammayim al-haaretz chamishshim umeat yom
Utekifu mayya al ara mea vechamshin yomin:
Vayyizkor elohim et-noach veet kol-hachayya veet-kol-habbehema asher itto batteva vayyaaver elohim ruach al-haaretz vayyashokku hammayim
Udechir Adonai yat noach veyat kol chayta veyat kol beira di immeh betevota veabar Adonai rucha al ara venachu mayya:
Vayyissachru mayenot tehom vaarubbot hashshamayim vayyikkale haggeshem min-hashshamayim
Veistecharu mabbue tehoma vechavve shemayya veitkeli mitra min shemayya:
Vayyashuvu hammayim meal haaretz haloch vashov vayyachseru hammayim miktze chamishshim umeat yom
Vetavu mayya meal ara azlin vetayvin vachasaru mayya missof mea vechamshin yomin:
Vattanach hatteva bachodesh hashshevii beshiva-asar yom lachodesh al hare ararat
Venachat tevota beyarcha sheviaa beshivat asar yoma leyarcha al ture kardu:
Vehammayim hayu haloch vechasor ad hachodesh haasiri baasiri beechad lachodesh niru rashe heharim
Umayya havo azlin vechasrin ad yarcha asiraa baasiraa bechad leyarcha itchaziu reshe turayya:
Vayhi mikketz arbaim yom vayyiftach noach et-challon hatteva asher asa
Vahava missof arbein yomin ufetach noach yat kavvat tevota di avad:
Vayshallach et-haorev vayyetze yatzo vashov ad-yevoshet hammayim meal haaretz
Veshallach yat arba unefak mippak vetayiv ad deyabbishu mayya meal ara:
Vayshallach et-hayyona meitto lirot hakallu hammayim meal pene haadama
Veshallach yat yona millevateh lemecheze hakalliu mayya meal appe ara:
Velo-matza hayyona manoach lechaf-raglah vattashov elav el-hatteva ki-mayim al-pene chol-haaretz vayyishlach yado vayyikkacheha vayyave otah elav el-hatteva
Vela ashkachat yona menach lefarsat ragla vetavat levateh letevota are mayya al appe chol ara veoshit yedeh venasva veael yata levateh letevota:
Vayyachel od shivat yamim acherim vayyosef shallach et-hayyona min-hatteva
Veorich od shava yomin ochoranin veosef shallach yat yona min tevota:
Vattavo elav hayyona leet erev vehinne ale-zayit taraf befiha vayyeda noach ki-kallu hammayim meal haaretz
Vaatat levateh yona leiddan ramsha veha teraf zeta tevir nachit befuma vida noach are kalliu maya meal ara:
Vayyiyyachel od shivat yamim acherim vayshallach et-hayyona velo-yasfa shuv-elav od
Veorich od shava yomin ochoranin veshallach yat yona vela osefat lemittuv levateh od:
Vayhi beachat veshesh-meot shana barishon beechad lachodesh charvu hammayim meal haaretz vayyasar noach et-michse hatteva vayyar vehinne charvu pene haadama
Vahava beshit mea vechad shenin bekadmaa bechad leyarcha neguvu mayya meal ara veadi noach yat chofaa detevota vachaza veha neguvu appe ara:
Uvachodesh hashsheni beshiva veesrim yom lachodesh yavsha haaretz
Uveyarcha tinyana beasrin veshava yoma leyarcha yabbishat ara:
Vaydabber elohim el-noach lemor
Umallel Adonai im noach lememar:
Tze min-hatteva atta veishtecha uvanecha uneshe-vanecha ittach
Puk min tevota at veittetach uvenach uneshe venach immach:
Kol-hachayya asher-ittecha mikkol-basar baof uvabbehema uvechol-haremes haromes al-haaretz hayetze ittach veshartzu vaaretz ufaru veravu al-haaretz
Kol chayta diimmach mikkol bisra beofa uvivira uvechol richasha derachesh al ara appek immach veyityalledun beara veyippeshun veyisgun al ara:
Vayyetze-noach uvanav veishto uneshe-vanav itto
Unefak noach uvenohi veitteteh uneshe venohi immeh:
Kol-hachayya kol-haremes vechol-haof kol romes al-haaretz lemishpechotehem yatzu min-hatteva
Kol chayta kol richasha vechol ofa kol derachesh al ara lezarayathon nefaku min tevota:
Vayyiven noach mizbeach la-Adonai vayyikkach mikkol habbehema hattehora umikkol haof hattahor vayyaal olot bammizbeach
Uvena noach madbecha kodam Adonai unesiv mikkol beira dachya umikkol ofa deche veassek alavan bemidbecha:
Vayyarach Adonai et-reach hannichoach vayyomer Adonai el-libbo lo-osif lekallel od et-haadama baavur haadam ki yetzer lev haadam ra minneurav velo-osif od lehakkot et-kol-chay kaasher asiti
Vekabbil Adonai beraava yat kurebaneh vaamar Adonai bememreh la osef lemelat od yat ara bedil chove enasha are yitzra libba deenasha bish mizzeireh vela osef od lemimche yat kol dechay kema deavdit:
Od kol-yeme haaretz zera vekatzir vekor vachom vekayitz vachoref veyom valayla lo yishbotu
Od kol yome ara zeroa vachatzada vekora vechoma vekayta vesitva vimam velelya la yivtelun:
Vayvarech elohim et-noach veet-banav vayyomer lahem peru urevu umilu et-haaretz
Uvarich Adonai yat noch veyat benohi vaamar lehon pushu usegu umelu yat ara:
Umoraachem vechittechem yihye al kol-chayyat haaretz veal kol-of hashshamayim bechol asher tirmos haadama uvechol-dege hayyam beyedchem nittanu
Vedachalatchon veematchon tehe al kol chevat ara veal kol ofa dishmayya bechol di tarchesh ara uvechol nune yamma beyedchon yehon mesirin:
Kol-remes asher hu-chay lachem yihye leochla keyerek esev natatti lachem et-kol
Kol richasha dehu chay lechon yehe lemechal kirok isba yehavit lechon yat kolla:
Ach-basar benafsho damo lo tochelu
Beram bisra benafsheh demeh la techlun:
Veach et-dimchem lenafshotechem edrosh miyyad kol-chayya edreshennu umiyyad haadam miyyad ish achiv edrosh et-nefesh haadam
Uveram yat dimchon lenafshatechon etba miyyad kol chayta etbeinneh umiyyad enasha miyyad gevar deyeshod yat dema daachohi etba yat nafsha deenasha:
Shofech dam haadam baadam damo yishshafech ki betzelem elohim asa et-haadam
Deyeshod dema deenasha besahadin al memar dayyanayya demeh yitteshad are betzalma daAdonai avad yat enasha:
Veattem peru urevu shirtzu vaaretz urevu-vah

Vaashavve yat benach saggiin keafra deara kema di la efshar ligvar lemimne yat afra deara af benach la yittimnun:
Kum hithallech baaretz leorkah ulerochbah ki lecha ettenenna
Kum hallich beara leorka veliftaya are lach etteninna:
Vayyeehal avram vayyavo vayyeshev beelone mamre asher bechevron vayyiven-sham mizbeach la-Adonai
Uferas avram vaata vitev bemeshre mamre di vechevron uvena tamman midbecha kodam Adonai:
Vayhi bime amrafel melech-shinar aryoch melech ellasar kedorlaomer melech elam vetidal melech goyim
Vahava beyome amrafel malka devavel aryoch malka deellasar kedarlaomer malka deelam vetidal malka deamme:
Asu milchama et-bera melech sedom veet-birsha melech amora shinav melech adma veshemever melech tzevoyim umelech bela hi-tzoar
Sedaru ny" avadu kerava im bera malka disdom veim birsha malka daamora shinav malka deadma veshemever malka ditzvoyim umalka devela hi tzoar:
Kol-elle chavru el-emek hassiddim hu yam hammelach
Kol illen itkenashu lemeshar chaklayya hu atar yamma demilcha:
Shetem esre shana avdu et-kedorlaomer ushelosh-esre shana maradu
Tarte asre shenin pelachu yat kedarlaomer utelat asre shenin meradu:
Uvearba esre shana ba chedorlaomer vehammelachim asher itto vayyakku et-refaim beashterot karnayim veet-hazzuzim beham veet haemim beshave kiryatayim
Uvearba asre shenin ata chedarlaomer umalchayya deimmeh umecho yat gibbarayya di veashterot karnayim veyat takkifayya divhemta veyat emtane divshave kiryatayim:
Veet-hachori beharram seir ad el paran asher al-hammidbar
Veyat chorae di veturehon deseir ad meshar paran dismich al madbera:
Vayyashuvu vayyavou el-en mishpat hiv kadesh vayyakku et-kol-sede haamaleki vegam et-haemori hayyoshev bechatztzon tamar
Vetavu vaatu lemeshar pillug dina hi rekam umecho yat kol chakal amalkaa veaf yat emoraa deyatev been gedi:
Vayyetze melech-sedom umelech amora umelech adma umelech tzevoyim umelech bela hiv-tzoar vayyaarchu ittam milchama beemek hassiddim
Unefak malka disdom umalka daamora umalka deadma umalka ditzvoyim umalka devela hi tzoar vesaddaru immehon kerava bemeshar chaklayya:
Et kedorlaomer melech elam vetidal melech goyim veamrafel melech shinar vearyoch melech ellasar arbaa melachim et-hachamishsha
Im kedarlaomer malka deelam vetidal malka deammin veamrafel malka devavel vearyoch malka deellasar arbea malchin lokovel chamsha:
Veemek hassiddim beerot beerot chemar vayyanusu melech-sedom vaamora vayyippelu-shamma vehannisharim hera nasu
Umeshar chaklayya berin berin maskan chemara vaaraku malka disdom vaamora unefalu tamman udeishtaaru letura araku:
Vayyikchu et-kol-rechush sedom vaamora veet-kol-ochlam vayyelechu
Ushevo yat kol kinyana disdom vaamora veyat kol mechalhon vaazalu:
Vayyikchu et-lot veet-rechusho ben-achi avram vayyelechu vehu yoshev bisdom
Ushevo yat lot veyat kinyaneh bar achuhi deavram vaazalu vehu yatev bisdom:
Vayyavo happalit vayyagged leavram haivri vehu shochen beelone mamre haemori achi eshkol vaachi aner vehem baale verit-avram
Vaata meshezava vechavvi leavram ivraa vehu share bemeshre mamre emoraa achuhi deeshkol vaachuhi deaner veinnun enashe keyameh deavram:
Vayyishma avram ki nishba achiv vayyarek et-chanichav yelide veto shemona asar ushelosh meot vayyirdof ad-dan
Ushema avram are ishtevi achuhi vezarez yat ulemohi yelide veteh telat mea vetamne asar uredaf ad dan:
Vayyechalek alehem layla hu vaavadav vayyakkem vayyirdefem ad-chova asher missemol ledammasek
Veitpeleg alehon lelya hu veavdohi umechonun uredafinnun ad chova di mitztzippuna ledammasek:
Vayyashev et kol-harchush vegam et-lot achiv urechusho heshiv vegam et-hannashim veet-haam
Vaatev yat kol kinyana veaf yat lot bar achuhi vekinyaneh atev veaf yat neshayya veyat amma:
Vayyetze melech-sedom likrato achare shuvo mehakkot et-kedorlaomer veet-hammelachim asher itto el-emek shave hu emek hammelech
Unefak malka disdom lekaddamuteh batar detav millemimche yat kedarlaomer veyat malchayya di immeh lemeshar mafna hu atar bet resa demalka:
Umalki-tzedek melech shalem hotzi lechem vayayin vehu chohen leel elyon
Umalki tzedek malka dirushelem appek lechem vachamar vehu meshammesh kodam el illaa:
Vayvarchehu vayyomar baruch avram leel elyon kone shamayim vaaretz
Uvarcheh vaamar berich avram leel illaa dikinyaneh shemayya veara:
Uvaruch el elyon asher-miggen tzarecha beyadecha vayyitten-lo maaser mikkol
Uverich el illaa dimsar sanach bidach vihav leh chad min asra mikkolla:
Vayyomer melech-sedom el-avram ten-li hannefesh veharchush kach-lach
Vaamar malka disdom leavram hav li nafshata vekinyana devar lach:
Vayyomer avram el-melech sedom harimoti yadi el-Adonai el elyon kone shamayim vaaretz
Vaamar avram lemalka disdom aremit yeday bitzlo kodam Adonai kodam el illaa dikinyaneh shemayya veara:
Im-michut vead seroch-naal veim-ekkach mikkol-asher-lach velo tomar ani heesharti et-avram
Im michuta vead arkat mesana veim essav mikkol di lach vela temar ana atarit yat avram:
Biladay rak asher achlu hannearim vechelek haanashim asher halchu itti aner eshkol umamre hem yikchu chelkam
Lechod middiachalu ulemayya vechulak guvrayya di azalu immi aner eshkol umamre innun yekabbelun chalakhon:
Achar haddevarim haelle haya devar-Adonai el-avram bammachaze lemor al-tira avram anochi magen lach secharcha harbe meod
Batar pitgamayya haillen hava pitgama daAdonai im avram binvua lememar la tidchal avram memri tekof lach agrach saggi lachada:
Vayyomer avram adonay Elohim ma-ttitten-li veanochi holech ariri uven-meshek beti hu dammesek eliezer
Vaamar avram Adonai ellohim ma titten li vaana azel bela velad uvar parnasa haden divveti hu dammaskaa eliezer:
Vayyomer avram hen li lo natatta zara vehinne ven-beti yoresh oti
Vaamar avram ha li la yehavt velad veha var beti yarit yati:
Vehinne devar-Adonai elav lemor lo yirashcha ze ki-im asher yetze mimmeecha hu yirashecha
Veha pitgama daAdonai immeh lememar la yirtinnach den elahen bar detolid hu yirtinnach:
Vayyotze oto hachutza vayyomer habbet-na hashshamayma usefor hakkochavim im-tuchal lispor otam vayyomer lo ko yihye zarecha
Veappek yateh levara vaamar istechi kean lishmayya umene kochvayya im tikkol lemimne yathon vaamar leh keden yehon benach:
Veheemin ba-Adonai vayyachsheveha lo tzedaka
Vehemin bememra daAdonai vechashva leh lezachu:
Vayyomer elav ani Adonai asher hotzeticha meur kasdim latet lecha et-haaretz hazzot lerishtah
Vaamar leh ana Adonai diappektach meura dechasdae lemittan lach yat ara hada lemerta:
Vayyomar adonay Elohim bamma eda ki irashenna
Vaamar Adonai ellohim bema idda are ertina:
Vayyomer elav kecha li egla meshulleshet veez meshulleshet veayil meshullash vetor vegozal
Vaamar leh karev kodamay eglin telata veizzin telata vedichrin telat veshafnina uvar yona:
Vayyikkach-lo et-kol-elle vayvatter otam battavech vayyitten ish-bitro likrat reehu veet-hatztzippor lo vatar
Vekarev kodamohi yat kol illen ufallig yathon beshave vihav palgayya pillug lokovel chavreh veyat ofa la fallig:
Vayyered haayit al-happegarim vayyashshev otam avram
Unechat ofa al paglayya veafrach yathon avram:
Vayhi hashshemesh lavo vetardema nafla al-avram vehinne ema chashecha gedola nofelet alav
Vahava shimsha lemeal veshinta nefalat al avram veha ema keval saggi nefalat alohi:
Vayyomer leavram yadoa teda ki-ger yihye zaracha beeretz lo lahem vaavadum veinnu otam arba meot shana
Vaamar leavram midda tidda are dayyarin yehon benach beara dela dilhon veyiflechun behon viannun yathon arba mea shenin:
Vegam et-haggoy asher yaavodu dan anochi veachare-chen yetzu birchush gadol
Veaf yat amma diyiflechun behon dayin ana uvatar ken yifkun bekinyana saggi:
Veatta tavo el-avotecha beshalom tikkaver beseva tova
Veat teol levat avahatach bishlam titkevar besevu tava:
Vedor revii yashuvu henna ki lo-shalem avon haemori ad-henna
Vedara reviaa yetuvun hacha are la shelim chova deemoraa ad kean:
Vayhi hashshemesh baa vaalata haya vehinne tannur ashan velappid esh asher avar ben haggezarim haelle
Vahava shimsha allat vekavla hava veha tannur ditnan uveur deeshshata di ada ben palgayya haillen:
Bayyom hahu karat Adonai et-avram berit lemor lezaracha natatti et-haaretz hazzot minnehar mitzrayim ad-hannahar haggadol nehar-perat
Beyoma hahu gezar Adonai im avram keyam lememar livnach yehavit yat ara hada min nahara demitzrayim vead nahara rabba nahara ferat:
Et-hakkeni veet-hakkenizzi veet hakkadmoni
Yat shalmae veyat kenizzae veyat kadmonae:
Veet-hachitti veet-happerizzi veet-harfaim
Veyat chittae veyat perizzae veyat gibbarae:
Veet-haemori veet-hakkenaani veet-haggirgashi veet-hayevusi
Veyat emorae veyat kenaanae veyat girgashae veyat yevusae:
Vesaray eshet avram lo yalda lo velah shifcha mitzrit ushemah hagar
Vesaray ittat avram la yelidat leh vela amta mitzreta ushema hagar:
Vattomer saray el-avram hinne-na atzarani Adonai milledet bo-na el-shifchati ulay ibbane mimmenna vayyishma avram lekol saray
Vaamarat saray leavram ha kean manani Adonai millemelad ul kean levat amti maim itbene minna vekabbil avram lememar saray:
Vattikkach saray eshet-avram et-hagar hammitzrit shifchatah mikketz eser shanim leshevet avram beeretz kenaan vattitten otah leavram ishah lo leishsha
Udevarat saray ittat avram yat hagar mitzreta amta missof asar shenin lemittav avram beara dichnaan vihavat yata leavram bala leh leintu:
Vayyavo el-hagar vattahar vattere ki harata vattekal gevirtah beeneha
Veal levat hagar veaddiat vachazat are addiat ukelat ribbanta beenaha:
Vattomer saray el-avram chamasi alecha anochi natatti shifchati bechekecha vattere ki harata vaekal beeneha yishpot Adonai beni uvenecha
Vaamarat saray leavram din li alach ana yehavit amti lach vachazat are addiat ukelet beenaha yedin Adonai beni uvenach:
Vayyomer avram el-saray hinne shifchatech beyadech asi-lah hattov beenayich vatteanneha saray vattivrach mippaneha
Vaamar avram lesaray ha amtich bidich ividi la kidtakkin beenaychi veanita saray vearkat mikkodamaha:
Vayyimtzaah malach Adonai al-en hammayim bammidbar al-haayin bederech shur
Veashkecha malacha daAdonai al ena demayya bemadbera al ena beorcha dechagra:
Vayyomar hagar shifchat saray e-mizze vat veana telechi vattomer mippene saray gevirti anochi borachat
Vaamar hagar amta desaray menan at atya ulean at azla vaamarat min kodam saray ribbanti ana arka ny" arakat:
Vayyomer lah malach Adonai shuvi el-gevirtech vehitanni tachat yadeha
Vaamar la malacha daAdonai tuvi levat ribbontich veishtabedi techot yedaha:
Vayyomer lah malach Adonai harba arbe et-zarech velo yissafer merov
Vaamar la malacha daAdonai asgaa asge yat benaychi vela yittimnun missege:
Vayyomer lah malach Adonai hinnach hara veyoladt ben vekarat shemo yishmael ki-shama Adonai el-onyech
Vaamar la malacha daAdonai ha at meadya veteldin bar vetikrin shemeh yishmael are kabbil Adonai tzelotich:
Vehu yihye pere adam yado vakkol veyad kol bo veal-pene chol-echav yishkon
Vehu yehe marod beenasha hu yehe tzerich lecholla vida divne anasha yehon tzerichin leh veal appe chol achohi yishre:
Vattikra shem-Adonai haddover eleha atta el roi ki amra hagam halom raiti achare roi
Vetzalliat bishma daAdonai demitmallel imma amarat at hu elaha dechaze cholla are amarat havram hacha ny" haaf ana shareti chazya batar deitgeli li:
Al-ken kara labbeer beer lachay roi hinne ven-kadesh uven bared
Al ken kera livera beera demalach kayyama ittachazi ala ha hi ben rekam uven chagra:
Vatteled hagar leavram ben vayyikra avram shem-beno asher-yalda hagar yishmael
Vilidat hagar leavram bar ukera avram shum bereh dilidat hagar yishmael:
Veavram ben-shemonim shana veshesh shanim beledet-hagar et-yishmael leavram
Veavram bar temanan veshit shenin kad yelidat hagar yat yishmael leavram:
Vayhi avram ben-tishim shana vetesha shanim vayyera Adonai el-avram vayyomer elav ani-el shadday hithallech lefanay veye tamim
Vahava avram bar tishin utesha shenin veitgeli Adonai leavram vaamar leh ana el shadday pelach kodamay veheve shelim:
Veettena veriti beni uvenecha vearbe otcha bimod meod
Veetten keyami ben memri uvenach veasge yatach lachada lachada:
Vayyippol avram al-panav vaydabber itto elohim lemor
Unefal avram al appohi umallel immeh Adonai lememar:
Ani hinne veriti ittach vehayita leav hamon goyim
Ana ha gezar vny" ynnv keyami immach utehe leav saggi ammin:
Velo-yikkare od et-shimcha avram vehaya shimcha avraham ki av-hamon goyim netatticha
Vela yitkere od yat shemach avram vihe shemach avraham are av saggi ammin yehavittach:
Vehifreti otcha bimod meod unetatticha legoyim umelachim mimmecha yetzeu
Veappesh yatach lachada lachada veetteninnach lechinshin umalchin deshallitin beammayya minnach yifkun:
Vahakimoti et-beriti beni uvenecha uven zaracha acharecha ledorotam livrit olam lihyot lecha lelohim ulezaracha acharecha
Vaakem yat keyami ben memri uvenach uven benach batrach ledarehon likyam alam lemehave lach lelaha velivnach batrach:
Venatatti lecha ulezaracha acharecha et eretz megurecha et kol-eretz kenaan laachuzzat olam vehayiti lahem lelohim
Veetten lach velivnach batrach yat ara totavutach yat kol ara dichnaan leachasanat alam veeheve lehon lelaha:
Vayyomer elohim el-avraham veatta et-beriti tishmor atta vezaracha acharecha ledorotam
Vaamar Adonai leavraham veat yat keyami tittar at uvenach batrach ledarehon:
Zot beriti asher tishmeru beni uvenechem uven zaracha acharecha himmol lachem kol-zachar
Da keyami di titterun ben memri uvenechon uven benach batrach migzar lechon kol dechura:
Unemaltem et besar orlatchem vehaya leot berit beni uvenechem
Vetigzerun yat bisra deorlatchon utehe ny" utehe leat keyam ben memri uvenechon:
Uven-shemonat yamim yimmol lachem kol-zachar ledorotechem yelid bayit umiknat-kesef mikkol ben-nechar asher lo mizzaracha hu
Uvar temanya yomin yitgezar ny" yigzar lechon kol dechura ledaratechon yelide veta uzevine chaspa mikkol bar ammin dela mibbenach hu:
Himmol yimmol yelid betcha umiknat kaspecha vehayta veriti bivsarchem livrit olam
Itgazzara yitgazzerun ny" migzar yigzar yelid betach uzevin kaspach utehe keyami bevisrechon likyam alam:
Vearel zachar asher lo-yimmol et-besar orlato venichreta hannefesh hahiv meammeha et-beriti hefar
Vearel dechura di la yigzar yat besar orlateh veyishtetze enasha hahi meammeh yat keyami ashni:
Vayyomer elohim el-avraham saray ishtecha lo-tikra et-shemah saray ki sara shemah
Vaamar Adonai leavraham saray ittetach la tikre yat shema saray are sara shema:
Uverachti otah vegam natatti mimmenna lecha ben uverachtiha vehayta legoyim malche ammim mimmenna yihyu
Veevarech yata veaf etten minna lach bar veevarachinna utehe lechinshin malchin deshallitin beammayya minna yehon:
Vayyippol avraham al-panav vayyitzchak vayyomer belibbo halleven mea-shana yivvaled veim-sara havat-tishim shana teled
Unefal avraham al appohi vachadi vaamar belibbeh halevar mea shenin yehe velad veim sara havat tishin shenin telid:
Vayyomer avraham el-haelohim lu yishmael yichye lefanecha
Vaamar avraham kodam Adonai levay yishmael yitkayyam kodamach:
Vayyomer elohim aval sara ishtecha yoledet lecha ben vekarata et-shemo yitzchak vahakimoti et-beriti itto livrit olam lezaro acharav
Vaamar Adonai bekusheta sara ittetach telid lach bar vetikre yat shemeh yitzchak vaakem yat keyami immeh likyam alam livnohi vatrohi:
Uleyishmael shematicha hinne berachti oto vehifreti oto vehirbeti oto bimod meod shenem-asar nesiim yolid unetattiv legoy gadol
Veal yishmael kabbelit tzelotach ha barechit yateh veappesh yateh veasge yateh lachada lachada teren asar ravrevayya yelid veetteninneh leam saggi:
Veet-beriti akim et-yitzchak asher teled lecha sara lammoed hazze bashshana haacheret
Veyat keyami akim im yitzchak di telid lach sara lezimna haden beshatta ochoranta:
Vaychal ledabber itto vayyaal elohim meal avraham
Veshetze lemallala immeh veistallak yekara daAdonai meillavohi deavraham:
Vayyikkach avraham et-yishmael beno veet kol-yelide veto veet kol-miknat kaspo kol-zachar beanshe bet avraham vayyamol et-besar orlatam beetzem hayyom hazze kaasher dibber itto elohim
Udevar avraham yat yishmael bereh veyat kol yelide veteh veyat kol zevine chaspeh kol dechura baanashe bet avraham ugezar yat bisra deorlathon bichran yoma haden kema di mallil immeh Adonai:
Veavraham ben-tishim vatesha shana behimmolo besar orlato
Veavraham bar tishin utesha shenin kad gezar bisra deorleteh:
Veyishmael beno ben-shelosh esre shana behimmolo et besar orlato
Veyishmael bereh bar telat asre shenin kad gezar yat bisra deorleteh:
Beetzem hayyom hazze nimmol avraham veyishmael beno
Bichran yoma haden itgezar ny" gezar avraham veyishmael bereh:
Vechol-anshe veto yelid bayit umiknat-kesef meet ben-nechar nimmolu itto
Vechol enashe veteh yelide veta uzevine chaspa min bar ammin itgezaru ny" gezaru immeh:
Vayyera elav Adonai beelone mamre vehu yoshev petach-haohel kechom hayyom
Veitgeli leh Adonai bemeshre mamre vehu yatev bitra mashkena kemecham yoma:
Vayyissa enav vayyar vehinne shelosha anashim nitztzavim alav vayyar vayyarotz likratam mippetach haohel vayyishtachu artza
Uzekaf enohi vachaza veha telata guvrin ny" gavrin kaymin illavohi vachaza urehat lekaddamutehon mittera mashkena usegid al ara:
Vayyomar adonay im-na matzati chen beenecha al-na taavor meal avdecha
Vaamar Adonai im kean ashkachit rachamin kodamach ny" beenaych la chean teibbar meal avdach:
Yukkach-na meat-mayim verachatzu raglechem vehishshaanu tachat haetz
Yissevun kean zeer mayya veaschu raglechon veistemichu techot ilana:
Veekcha fat-lechem vesaadu libbechem achar taavoru ki-al-ken avartem al-avdechem vayyomru ken taase kaasher dibbarta
Veessav pitta delachma useidu libbechon batar ken taavarun are al ken avartun al avdechon vaamaru ken tabed kema di mallelta:
Vaymaher avraham haohela el-sara vayyomer mahari shelosh seim kemach solet lushi vaasi ugot
Veochi avraham lemashkena levat sara vaamar ocha telat sein kimcha desolta lushi veividi geritzan:
Veel-habbakar ratz avraham vayyikkach ben-bakar rach vatov vayyitten el-hannaar vaymaher laasot oto
Ulevat tore rehat avraham udevar bar tore rakkich vetav vihav leulema veochi lemebad yateh:
Vayyikkach chema vechalav uven-habbakar asher asa vayyitten lifnehem vehu-omed alehem tachat haetz vayyochelu
Unesiv sheman vachalav uvar tore di avad vihav kodamehon vehu meshammesh illavehon techot ilana vaachalu:
Vayyomru elav ayye sara ishtecha vayyomer hinne vaohel
Vaamaru leh an sara ittetach vaamar ha vemashkena:
Vayyomer shov ashuv elecha kaet chayya vehinne-ven lesara ishtecha vesara shomaat petach haohel vehu acharav
Vaamar mittav ittuv levatach keiddan deattun kayyamin veha var lesara ittetach vesara shemaat bitra mashkena vehu achorohi:
Veavraham vesara zekenim baim bayyamim chadal lihyot lesara orach kannashim
Veavraham vesara sivu allu beyomin pesak millemeheve lesara orach kinshayya:
Vattitzchak sara bekirbah lemor achare veloti hayta-lli edna vadoni zaken
Vechaychat sara bimaha lememar batar desevit havat li ulemu veribboni siv:
Vayyomer Adonai el-avraham lamma ze tzachaka sara lemor haaf umnam eled vaani zakanti
Vaamar Adonai leavraham lema denan chaychat sara lememar havram bekusheta olid vaana sevit:
Hayippale mey-Adonai davar lammoed ashuv elecha kaet chayya ulesara ven
Hayitkasse min kodam Adonai pitgama lizman ittuv levatach keiddan deattun kayyamin ulesara var:
Vattechachesh sara lemor lo tzachakti ki yarea vayyomer lo ki tzachakt
Vechaddivat sara lememar la chayyechit are dechelat vaamar la beram chayyacht:
Vayyakumu mishsham haanashim vayyashkifu al-pene sedom veavraham holech immam leshallecham

Vehochiach avraham et-avimelech al-odot beer hammayim asher gazlu avde avimelech
Veochach avraham yat avimelech al esak bera demayya di annisu avde avimelech:
Vayyomer avimelech lo yadati mi asa et-haddavar hazze vegam-atta lo-higgadta li vegam anochi lo shamati bilti hayyom
Vaamar avimelech la yedait man avad yat pitgama haden veaf at la chavveta li veaf ana la shemait ellahen yoma den:
Vayyikkach avraham tzon uvakar vayyitten laavimelech vayyichretu shenehem berit
Udevar avraham an vetorin vihav laavimelech ugezaru tarvehon keyam:
Vayyatztzev avraham et-sheva kivsot hatztzon levaddehen
Vaakim avraham yat sheva churefan dean bilchodehen:
Vayyomer avimelech el-avraham ma henna sheva kevasot haelle asher hitztzavta levaddana
Vaamar avimelech leavraham ma innun sheva churefan illen daakemta bilchodehen:
Vayyomer ki et-sheva kevasot tikkach miyyadi baavur tihye-lli leeda ki chafarti et-habbeer hazzot
Vaamar are yat sheva churefan tekabbel min yedi bedil dithe li lesahadu are chafarit yat bera haden ny" hada:
Al-ken kara lammakom hahu beer shava ki sham nishbeu shenehem
Al ken kera leatra hahu beer shava are tamman kayyamu tarvehon:
Vayyichretu verit biver shava vayyakom avimelech ufichol sar-tzevao vayyashuvu el-eretz pelishtim
Ugezaru keyam biver shava vekam avimelech ufichol rav cheleh vetavu leara pelishtae:
Vayyitta eshel biver shava vayyikra-sham beshem Adonai el olam
Unetzev nitzba ny" ilana biver shava vetzalli tamman bishma daAdonai elaha dealma:
Vayyagor avraham beeretz pelishtim yamim rabbim
Veittotav avraham beara pelishtae yomin saggiin:
Vayhi achar haddevarim haelle vehaelohim nissa et-avraham vayyomer elav avraham vayyomer hinneni
Vahava batar pitgamayya haillen vayya nassi yat avraham vaamar leh avraham vaamar ha ana:
Vayyomer kach-na et-bincha et-yechidcha asher-ahavta et-yitzchak velech-lecha el-eretz hammoriyya vehaalehu sham leola al achad heharim asher omar elecha
Vaamar devar kean yat berach yat yechidach di rechamta yat yitzchak veizel lach leara pulechana veaskeh kodamay tamman laalata al chad min turayya di emar lach:
Vayyashkem avraham babboker vayyachavosh et-chamoro vayyikkach et-shene nearav itto veet yitzchak beno vayvakka atze ola vayyakom vayyelech el-hammakom asher-amar-lo haelohim
Veakdem avraham betzafra vezarez yat chamareh udevar yat teren ulemohi immeh veyat yitzchak bereh vetzallach ae laalata vekam veazal leatra di amar leh Adonai:
Bayyom hashshelishi vayyissa avraham et-enav vayyar et-hammakom merachok
Beyoma telitaa uzekaf avraham yat enohi vachaza yat atra merachik:
Vayyomer avraham el-nearav shevu-lachem po im-hachamor vaani vehannaar nelcha ad-ko venishtachave venashuva alechem
Vaamar avraham leulemohi orichu lechon hacha im chamara vaana veulema nitmete ad ka venisgud unetuv levatchon:
Vayyikkach avraham et-atze haola vayyasem al-yitzchak beno vayyikkach beyado et-haesh veet-hammaachelet vayyelchu shenehem yachdav
Unesev avraham yat ae daalata veshavvi al yitzchak bereh unesev bideh yat eshshata veyat sakkina vaazalu tarvehon batra kachada:
Vayyomer yitzchak el-avraham aviv vayyomer avi vayyomer hinnenni veni vayyomer hinne haesh vehaetzim veayye hasse leola
Vaamar yitzchak leavraham avuhi vaamar abba vaamar ha ana veri vaamar ha eshshata veaayya vean imra laalata:
Vayyomer avraham elohim yire-llo hasse leola beni vayyelchu shenehem yachdav
Vaamar avraham kodam Adonai gele leh imra laalata beri vaazalu tarvehon kachada:
Vayyavou el-hammakom asher amar-lo haelohim vayyiven sham avraham et-hammizbeach vayyaaroch et-haetzim vayyaakod et-yitzchak beno vayyasem oto al-hammizbeach mimmaal laetzim
Veatu leatra di amar leh Adonai uvena tamman avraham yat madbecha vesaddar yat aayya vaakad yat yitzchak bereh veshavvi yateh al madbecha el min aayya:
Vayyishlach avraham et-yado vayyikkach et-hammaachelet lishchot et-beno
Veoshet avraham yat yedeh unesev yat sakkina lemechas yat bereh:
Vayyikra elav malach Adonai min-hashshamayim vayyomer avraham avraham vayyomer hinneni
Ukera leh malacha daAdonai min shemayya vaamar avraham avraham vaamar ha ana:
Vayyomer al-tishlach yadcha el-hannaar veal-taas lo meuma ki atta yadati ki-yere elohim atta velo chasachta et-bincha et-yechidcha mimmenni
Vaamar la toshet yedach leulema vela tabed leh middaam are kean yedana ny" yedait are dachala daAdonai at vela menata yat berach yat yechidach minni:
Vayyissa avraham et-enav vayyar vehinne-ayil achar neechaz bassevach bekarnav vayyelech avraham vayyikkach et-haayil vayyaalehu leola tachat beno
Uzekaf avraham yat enohi batar illen vachaza veha dichra batar achid beilana bekarnohi vaazal avraham unesev yat dichra veaskeh laalata chalaf bereh:
Vayyikra avraham shem-hammakom hahu Adonai yire asher yeamer hayyom behar Adonai yerae
Ufelach vetzalli avraham tamman beatra hahu vaamar kodam Adonai hacha yehon palchan darayya bechen yitammar beyoma haden betura haden avraham kodam Adonai pelach:
Vayyikra malach Adonai el-avraham shenit min-hashshamayim
Ukera malacha daAdonai leavraham tinyanut min shemayya:
Vayyomer bi nishbati neum-Adonai ki yaan asher asita et-haddavar hazze velo chasachta et-bincha et-yechidecha
Vaamar bememre kayyemit amar Adonai are chalaf di avadta yat pitgama haden vela menata yat berach yat yechidach:
Ki-varech avarechcha veharba arbe et-zaracha kechochve hashshamayim vechachol asher al-sefat hayyam veyirash zaracha et shaar oyvav
Are varacha avarchinnach veasgaa asge yat benach kechochve shemayya uchechala di al kef yamma veyirtun benach yat kirve sanehon:
Vehitbarchu vezaracha kol goye haaretz ekev asher shamata bekoli
Veyitbarchun bedil benach kol ammayya deara chalaf di kabbelta lememri:
Vayyashov avraham el-nearav vayyakumu vayyelchu yachdav el-beer shava vayyeshev avraham biver shava
Vetav avraham levat ulemohi vekamu vaazalu kachada liver shava vitev avraham biver shava:
Vayhi achare haddevarim haelle vayyuggad leavraham lemor hinne yalda milka gam-hiv banim lenachor achicha
Vahava batar pitgamayya haillen veitchava leavraham lememar ha yeledat milka af hi benin lenachor achuch:
Et-utz bechoro veet-buz achiv veet-kemuel avi aram
Yat utz buchereh veyat buz achuhi veyat kemuel avuhi daaram:
Veet-kesed veet-chazo veet-pildash veet-yidlaf veet betuel
Veyat kesed veyat chazo veyat pildash veyat yidlaf veyat betuel:
Uvetuel yalad et-rivka shemona elle yalda milka lenachor achi avraham
Uvetuel olid yat rivka temanya illen yeledat milka lenachor achuhi deavraham:
Ufilagsho ushemah reuma vatteled gam-hiv et-tevach veet-gacham veet-tachash veet-maacha
Ulechenateh ushema reuma viledat af hi yat tevach veyat gacham veyat tachash veyat maacha:
Vayyihyu chayye sara mea shana veesrim shana vesheva shanim shene chayye sara
Vahavo chayye sara mea veesrin usheva shenin shene chayye sara:
Vattamot sara bekiryat arba hiv chevron beeretz kenaan vayyavo avraham lispod lesara velivkotah
Umitat sara bekiryat arba hi chevron beara dichnaan vaata avraham lemispeda lesara ulemivka:
Vayyakom avraham meal pene meto vaydabber el-bene-chet lemor
Vekam avraham meal appe miteh umallel im bene chittaa lememar:
Ger-vetoshav anochi immachem tenu li achuzzat-kever immachem veekbera meti millefanay
Dayyar vetotav ana immechon havu li achsanat kevura immechon veikbar miti min kodamay:
Vayyaanu vene-chet et-avraham lemor lo
Veativu vene chittaa yat avraham lememar leh:
Shemaenu adoni nesi elohim atta betochenu bemivchar kevarenu kevor et-metecha ish mimmennu et-kivro lo-yichle mimmecha mikkevor metecha
Kabbel minnana ribbonana rav kodam Adonai at benana bishfar kivrana kevar yat mitach ennash minnana yat kivreh la yimna minnach millemikbar mitach:
Vayyakom avraham vayyishtachu leam-haaretz livne-chet
Vekam avraham usegid leamma deara livne chittaa:
Vaydabber ittam lemor im-yesh et-nafshechem likbor et-meti millefanay shemauni ufigu-li beefron ben-tzochar
Umallel immehon lememar im it raava venafshechon lemikbar yat miti min kodamay kabbilu minni uveu li min efron bar tzochar:
Veyitten-li et-mearat hammachpela asher-lo asher biktze sadehu bechesef male yittenenna li betochechem laachuzzat-kaver
Veyitten li yat mearat kafelta di leh di bistar chakleh bechaspa shelim yittenina li benechon leachasanat kevura:
Veefron yoshev betoch bene-chet vayyaan efron hachitti et-avraham beozne vene-chet lechol bae shaar-iro lemor
Veefron yatev bego bene chittaa veatev efron chittaa yat avraham kodam bene chittaa lechol ale tera karteh lememar:
Lo-adoni shemaeni hassade natatti lach vehammeara asher-bo lecha netattiha leene vene-ammi netattiha lach kevor metecha
La ribboni kabbel minni chakla yehavit lach umearta di veh lach yehavita leene vene ammi yehavita lach kevar mitach:
Vayyishtachu avraham lifne am haaretz
Usegid avraham kodam amma deara:
Vaydabber el-efron beozne am-haaretz lemor ach im-atta lu shemaeni natatti kesef hassade kach mimmenni veekbera et-meti shamma
Umallel im efron kodam amma deara lememar beram im at aved li tivu kabbel minni etten kaspa deme chakla sav minni veekbar yat miti tamman:
Vayyaan efron et-avraham lemor lo
Veatev efron yat avraham lememar leh:
Adoni shemaeni eretz arba meot shekel-kesef beni uvencha ma-hiv veet-metcha kevor
Ribboni kabbel minni ara shavya arba mea silin dichsaf bena uvenach ma hi veyat mitach kevar:
Vayyishma avraham el-efron vayyishkol avraham leefron et-hakkesef asher dibber beozne vene-chet arba meot shekel kesef over lassocher
Vekabbel avraham min efron utekal avraham leefron yat kaspa demallel kodam bene chittaa arba mea silin dichsaf mitkabbel sechora ny" demitkabbel sechorata bechol medinta:
Vayyakom sede efron asher bammachpela asher lifne mamre hassade vehammeara asher-bo vechol-haetz asher bassade asher bechol-gevulo saviv
Vekam chakal efron di bechafelta di kodam mamre chakla umearta di veh vechol ilane di vechakla di vechal techumeh sechor sechor:
Leavraham lemikna leene vene-chet bechol bae shaar-iro
Leavraham lizvinohi leene bene chittaa bechol ale tera karteh:
Veachare-chen kavar avraham et-sara ishto el-mearat sede hammachpela al-pene mamre hiv chevron beeretz kenaan
Uvatar ken kevar avraham yat sara itteteh bimarat chakal kafelta al appe mamre hi chevron beara dichnaan:
Vayyakom hassade vehammeara asher-bo leavraham laachuzzat-kaver meet bene-chet
Vekam chakla umearta di veh leavraham leachasanat kevura min bene chittaa:
Veavraham zaken ba bayyamim va-Adonai berach et-avraham bakkol
Veavraham siv al beyomin vayya berich yat avraham becholla:
Vayyomer avraham el-avdo zekan beto hammoshel bechol-asher-lo sim-na yadcha tachat yerechi
Vaamar avraham leavdeh sava deveteh deshallit bechol di leh shavi chean yedach techot yarki:
Veashbiacha ba-Adonai elohe hashshamayim velohe haaretz asher lo-tikkach ishsha livni mibbenot hakkenaani asher anochi yoshev bekirbo
Vaakayyem alach bememra daAdonai elaha dishmayya velaha deara dela tissav itteta livri mibbenat kenaanae di ana yatev benehon:
Ki el-artzi veel-moladti telech velakachta ishsha livni leyitzchak
Elahen leari uleyalladuti tezil vetissav itteta livri leyitzchak:
Vayyomer elav haeved ulay lo-tove haishsha lalechet acharay el-haaretz hazzot hehashev ashiv et-bincha el-haaretz asher-yatzata mishsham
Vaamar leh avda maim la teve itteta lemete vatray leara hada haatava atev yat berach leara di nefakta mittamman:
Vayyomer elav avraham hishshamer lecha pen-tashiv et-beni shamma
Vaamar leh avraham istammar lach dilma tatev yat beri letamman:

Adonai elohe hashshamayim asher lekachani mibbet avi umeeretz moladti vaasher dibber-li vaasher nishba-li lemor lezaracha etten et-haaretz hazzot hu yishlach malacho lefanecha velakachta ishsha livni mishsham
Adonai elaha dishmayya di dabberani mibbet abba umeara yalduti vedi mallel li vedi kayyem li lememar livrach etten yat ara hada hu yishlach malacheh kodamach vetissav itteta livri mittamman:
Veim-lo tove haishsha lalechet acharecha venikkita mishshevuati zot rak et-beni lo tashev shamma
Veim la teve itteta lemete vatrach utehe zakkaa mimmomati da lechod yat beri la tatev letamman:
Vayyasem haeved et-yado tachat yerech avraham adonav vayyishshava lo al-haddavar hazze
Veshavvi avda yat yedeh techot yarcha deavraham ribboneh vekayyem leh al pitgama haden:
Vayyikkach haeved asara gemallim miggemalle adonav vayyelech vechol-tuv adonav beyado vayyakom vayyelech el-aram naharayim el-ir nachor
Udevar avda asra gamlin miggamle ribbone vaazal vechol shefar ribboneh bideh vekam vaazal laaram di al perat lekarta denachor:
Vayyavrech haggemallim michutz lair el-beer hammayim leet erev leet tzet hashshoavot
Veashre gamlayya mibbara lekarta livera demayya leiddan ramsha leiddan denafkan malyata:
Vayyomar Adonai elohe adoni avraham hakre-na lefanay hayyom vaase-chesed im adoni avraham
Vaamar Adonai elahe deribboni avraham zammin kean kodamay yoma den veivad tivu im ribboni avraham:
Hinne anochi nitztzav al-en hammayim uvenot anshe hair yotzot lishov mayim
Ha ana kaem al ena demayya uvenat enashe karta nafkan lemimle maya:
Vehaya hannaara asher omar eleha hatti-na chaddech veeshte veamra shete vegam-gemallecha ashke otah hochachta leavdecha leyitzchak uvah eda ki-asita chesed im-adoni
Utehe ulemta deemar la archini chean kuletich veeshti vetemar esht veaf gamlach ashke yata zamminta leavdach leyitzchak uva ida are avadta tivu im ribboni:
Vayhi-hu terem killa ledabber vehinne rivka yotzet asher yulleda livtuel ben-milka eshet nachor achi avraham vechaddah al-shichmah
Vahava hu ad la shetze lemallala veha rivka nefakat deityelidat livtuel bar milka ittat nachor achuhi deavraham vekuleta al katpa:
Vehannaara tovat mare meod betula veish lo yedaah vattered haayna vattemalle chaddah vattaal
Veulemta shappirat chezu ny" shappira lemecheze lachada betulta ugevar la yadah unechatat leena umelat kuleta uselekat:
Vayyarotz haeved likratah vayyomer hagmiini na meat-mayim mikkaddech
Urehat avda likdamuta vaamar ashkini s" atemni chean zeer mayya mikkuletich:
Vattomer shete adoni vattemaher vattored kaddah al-yadah vattashkehu
Vaameret esht ribboni veochiat vaachetat kuleta al yeda veashketeh:
Vattechal lehashkoto vattomer gam ligmallecha eshav ad im-killu lishtot
Veshetziat leashkayuteh vaameret af legamlach amle ad di safkun lemishte:
Vattemaher vattear kaddah el-hashshoket vattarotz od el-habbeer lishov vattishav lechol-gemallav
Veochiat unefatzat kuleta levet shakya urehatat od levera lemimle umelat lechol gamlohi:
Vehaish mishtae lah macharish ladaat hahitzliach Adonai darko im-lo
Vegavra shahe va mistakkel shatik lemeda haatzlach Adonai orcheh im la:
Vayhi kaasher killu haggemallim lishtot vayyikkach haish nezem zahav beka mishkalo ushene tzemidim al-yadeha asara zahav mishkalam
Vahava kad sappiku gamlayya lemishte unesev gavra kadasha dedahava tikla matkeleh uteren sherin al yedaha matkal asar silin dedahava matkalhon:
Vayyomer bat-mi at haggidi na li hayesh bet-avich makom lanu lalin
Vaamar bat man at chavvi chean li hait bet avuch atar kashar lana limvat:
Vattomer elav bat-betuel anochi ben-milka asher yalda lenachor
Vaameret leh bat betuel ana bar milka diledat lenachor:
Vattomer elav gam-teven gam-mispo rav immanu gam-makom lalun
Vaameret leh af tivna af kissata saggi immana af atar kashar limvat:
Vayyikkod haish vayyishtachu la-Adonai
Uchera gavra usegid kodam Adonai:
Vayyomer baruch Adonai elohe adoni avraham asher lo-azav chasdo vaamitto meim adoni anochi badderech nachani Adonai bet ache adoni
Vaamar berich Adonai elaha deribboni avraham di la mena tivuteh vekusheteh min ribboni ana beorach takna dabberani Adonai bet achohi deribboni:
Vattarotz hannaara vattagged levet immah kaddevarim haelle
Urehatat ulemta vechavviat levet imma kefitgamayya haillen:
Ulerivka ach ushemo lavan vayyarotz lavan el-haish hachutza el-haayin
Ulerivka acha ushemeh lavan urehat lavan levat gavra levara levat ena:
Vayhi kirot et-hannezem veet-hatztzemidim al-yede achoto ucheshomo et-divre rivka achoto lemor ko-dibber elay haish vayyavo el-haish vehinne omed al-haggemallim al-haayin
Vahava kad chaza yat kadasha veyat sherayya al yede achateh vechad shema yat pitgame rivka achateh lememar keden mallel immi gavra vaata levat gavra veha kaem illavve gamlayya al ena:
Vayyomer bo beruch Adonai lamma taamod bachutz veanochi pinniti habbayit umakom laggemallim
Vaamar ul bericha daAdonai lema at kaem bevara vaana panneti veta vaatar kashar legamlayya:
Vayyavo haish habbayta vayfattach haggemallim vayyitten teven umispo laggemallim umayim lirchotz raglav veragle haanashim asher itto
Veal gavra leveta ushera gamlayya vihav tivna vechissata legamlayya umayya leaschaa raglohi veragle guvrayya deimmeh:
Vayyusam lefanav leechol vayyomer lo ochal ad im-dibbarti devaray vayyomer dabber
Veshavviu kodamohi lemechal vaamar la echul ad daamallel pitgamay vaamar mallel:
Vayyomar eved avraham anochi
Vaamar avda deavraham ana:
Va-Adonai berach et-adoni meod vayyigdal vayyitten-lo tzon uvakar vechesef vezahav vaavadim ushefachot ugemallim vachamorim
Vayya barich yat ribboni lachada ureva vihav leh an vetorin uchesaf udehav veavdin veamhan vegamlin vachamarin:
Vatteled sara eshet adoni ven ladoni achare ziknatah vayyitten-lo et-kol-asher-lo
Viledat sara ittat ribboni var leribboni batar desevat vihav leh yat kol dileh:
Vayyashbieni adoni lemor lo-tikkach ishsha livni mibbenot hakkenaani asher anochi yoshev beartzo
Vekayyem alay ribboni lememar la tissav itteta livri mibbenat kenaanae di ana yatev beareh:
Im-lo el-bet-avi telech veel-mishpachti velakachta ishsha livni
Elahen levet abba tezel ulezariti vetissav itteta livri:
Vaomar el-adoni ulay lo-telech haishsha acharay
Vaamarit leribboni maim la tete itteta batray:
Vayyomer elay Adonai asher-hithallachti lefanav yishlach malacho ittach vehitzliach darkecha velakachta ishsha livni mimmishpachti umibbet avi
Vaamar li Adonai di felachit kodamohi yishlach malacheh immach veyatzlach orchach vetissav itteta livri mizzariti umibbet abba:
Az tinnake mealati ki tavo el-mishpachti veim-lo yittenu lach vehayita naki mealati
Bechen tehe zakkay ny" zakka mimmumati are tehach lezariti veim la yittenun lach utehe zakkay mimmumati:
Vaavo hayyom el-haayin vaomar Adonai elohe adoni avraham im-yeshcha-nna matzliach darki asher anochi holech aleha
Veatit ny" vaateti yoma den leena vaamarit Adonai elaha deribboni avraham im it kean raava kodamach leatzlacha orchi di ana azel ala:
Hinne anochi nitztzav al-en hammayim vehaya haalma hayyotzet lishov veamarti eleha hashkini-na meat-mayim mikkaddech
Ha ana kaem al ena demayya vihe ulemta detippok lemimle veemar la ashkini chean zeer mayya mikkuletich:
Veamra elay gam-atta shete vegam ligmallecha eshav hiv haishsha asher-hochiach Adonai leven-adoni
Vetemar li af at esht veaf legamlach amli hi itteta dezammin Adonai levar ribboni:
Ani terem achalle ledabber el-libbi vehinne rivka yotzet vechaddah al-shichmah vattered haayna vattishav vaomar eleha hashkini na
Ana ad la shetziti lemallala velibbi veha rivka nefakat vekuleta al katpa unechatat leena umelat vaamarit la ashkini chean:
Vattemaher vattored kaddah mealeha vattomer shete vegam-gemallecha ashke vaesht vegam haggemallim hishkata
Veochiat vaachitat kuleta minna vaamarat esht veaf gamlach ashki usheteti veaf gamlayya ashkiat:
Vaeshal otah vaomar bat-mi at vattomer bat-betuel ben-nachor asher yalda-llo milka vaasim hannezem al-appah vehatztzemidim al-yadeha
Usheelit yata vaamarit bat man at vaameret bat betuel bar nachor diledat leh milka veshavveti kadasha al appa vesherayya al yedaha:
Vaekkod vaeshtachave la-Adonai vaavarech et-Adonai elohe adoni avraham asher hinchani bederech emet lakachat et-bat-achi adoni livno
Ucherait usegadit kodam Adonai uvarechit yat Adonai elahe deribboni avraham dedabberani beorach keshot lemisav yat bat achuhi deribboni livreh:
Veatta im-yeshchem osim chesed veemet et-adoni haggidu li veim-lo haggidu li veefne al-yamin o al-semol
