Vayyomer yitzchak el-yaakov gesha-nna vaamushcha beni haatta ze beni esav im-lo
Vaamar yitzchak leyaakov kerev kean veemushshinnach beri haat den beri esav im la:
Vayyiggash yaakov el-yitzchak aviv vaymushshehu vayyomer hakkol kol yaakov vehayyadayim yede esav
Ukerev yaakov levat yitzchak avuhi umashye vaamar kala kala deyaakov vidayya yedohi deesav:
Velo hikkiro ki-hayu yadav kide esav achiv seirot vayvarchehu
Vela ishtemodeh are havaa yedohi kide esav achuhi seiran uvaracheh:
Vayyomer atta ze beni esav vayyomer ani
Vaamar at den beri esav vaamar ha ana:
Vayyomer haggisha li veochla mitztzed beni lemaan tevarechcha nafshi vayyaggesh-lo vayyochal vayyave lo yayin vayyesht
Vaamar karev kodamay veechul mitztzeda divri bedil di tevarchinnach nafshi vekarev leh vaachal veayti leh chamra usheti:
Vayyomer elav yitzchak aviv gesha-nna usheka-lli beni
Vaamar leh yitzchak avuhi kerev kean uneshak li beri:
Vayyiggash vayyishshak-lo vayyarach et-reach begadav vayvarchehu vayyomer ree reach beni kereach sade asher bercho Adonai
Ukerev uneshak leh vaarach yat recha dilvushohi uvarcheh vaamar havo recha divri kerecha dechakla di varacheh Adonai:
Veyitten-lecha haelohim mittal hashshamayim umishmanne haaretz verov dagan vetirosh
Veyitten lach Adonai mittalla dishmayya umittuva deara usegiut ivur vachamar:
Yaavducha ammim veyishtachavu lecha leummim heve gevir leachecha veyishtachavu lecha bene immecha orerecha arur umevarchecha baruch
Yiflechunnach ammin veyishtabedun lach malkevan heve rav leachaych veyisgedun lach bene immach melattaych yehon litin umevarachaych yehon berichin:
Vayhi kaasher killa yitzchak levarech et-yaakov vayhi ach yatzo yatza yaakov meet pene yitzchak aviv veesav achiv ba mitztzedo
Vahava kad shetzi yitzchak levaracha yat yaakov vahava beram mippak nefak yaakov millevat appe yitzchak avuhi veesav achuhi ata mitztzedeh:
Vayyaas gam-hu matammim vayyave leaviv vayyomer leaviv yakum avi veyochal mitztzed beno baavur tevarchanni nafshecha
Vaavad af hu tavshilin veael levat avuhi vaamar laavuhi yakum abba veyechul mitztzeda divreh bedil di tevarchinnani nafshach:
Vayyomer lo yitzchak aviv mi-atta vayyomer ani bincha vechorcha esav
Vaamar leh yitzchak avuhi man at vaamar ana berach bucherach esav:
Vayyecherad yitzchak charada gedola ad-meod vayyomer mi-efo hu hatztzad-tzayid vayyave li vaochal mikkol beterem tavo vaavarchehu gam-baruch yihye
Uteva yitzchak tivha rabba ad lachada vaamar man hu dechi detzad tzeda veael li vaachalit mikkolla ad la teol uvarechitteh af berich yehe:
Kishmoa esav et-divre aviv vayyitzak tzeaka gedola umara ad-meod vayyomer leaviv barcheni gam-ani avi
Kad shema esav yat pitgame avuhi utzevach tzivcha rabba umerira ad lachada vaamar laavuhi barechni af ana abba:
Vayyomer ba achicha bemirma vayyikkach birchatecha
Vaamar al achuch bechochmeta vekabbil birketach:
Vayyomer hachi kara shemo yaakov vayyakeveni ze faamayim et-bechorati lakach vehinne atta lakach birchati vayyomar halo-atzalta li beracha
Vaamar yaut kera shemeh yaakov vechakkemani denan tarten zimnin yat becheruti nesiv veha kean kabbil birketi vaamar hala shevakta li birketa:
Vayyaan yitzchak vayyomer leesav hen gevir samtiv lach veet-kol-echav natatti lo laavadim vedagan vetirosh semachtiv ulecha efo ma eese beni
Vaatev yitzchak vaamar leesav ha rav shavvitteh lach veyat kol achohi yehavit leh leavdin veivur vachamar seidteh velach hacha ma ebed beri:
Vayyomer esav el-aviv havracha achat hiv-lecha avi barcheni gam-ani avi vayyissa esav kolo vayyevk
Vaamar esav laavuhi havirketa chada hi lach abba barech li af ana abba vaarem esav kaleh uvecha:
Vayyaan yitzchak aviv vayyomer elav hinne mishmanne haaretz yihye moshavecha umittal hashshamayim meal
Vaatev yitzchak avuhi vaamar leh ha mittuva deara yehe motvach umittalla dishmayya milleella:
Veal-charbecha tichye veet-achicha taavod vehaya kaasher tarid ufarakta ullo meal tzavvarecha
Veal charbach teche veyat achuch tiflach vihe kad yaberun benohi al pitgame orayta vetade nireh meal tzavrach:
Vayyistom esav et-yaakov al-habberacha asher bercho aviv vayyomer esav belibbo yikrevu yeme evel avi veaharga et-yaakov achi
Unetar esav devavu leyaakov al birketa di varcheh avuhi vaamar esav belibbeh yikrevun yome evle deabba veektol yat yaakov achi:
Vayyuggad lerivka et-divre esav benah haggadol vattishlach vattikra leyaakov benah hakkatan vattomer elav hinne esav achicha mitnachem lecha lehorgecha
Veitchavva lerivka yat pitgame esav bera rabba ushelachat ukerat leyaakov bera zeera vaameret leh ha esav achuch kemin lach lemiktelach:
Veatta veni shema bekoli vekum berach-lecha el-lavan achi charana
Uchean beri kabbel minni vekum izel lach levat lavan achi lecharan:
Veyashavta immo yamim achadim ad asher-tashuv chamat achicha
Vetetev immeh yomin zeerin ad dituv rugeza deachuch:
Ad-shuv af-achicha mimmecha veshachach et asher-asita lo veshalachti ulekachticha mishsham lama eshkal gam-shenechem yom echad
Ad dituv rugeza deachuch minnach veyitneshe yat di avadta leh veeshlach veedberinnach mittamman lema etkal af tarvechon yoma chad:
Vattomer rivka el-yitzchak katzti vechayyay mippene benot chet im-lokeach yaakov ishsha mibbenot-chet kaelle mibbenot haaretz lamma li chayyim
Vaameret rivka leyitzchak akit bechayyay min kodam benat chittaa im nesiv yaakov itteta mibbenat chittaa cheillen mibbenat ara lema li chayyim:
Vayyikra yitzchak el-yaakov vayvarech oto vaytzavvehu vayyomer lo lo-tikkach ishsha mibbenot kenaan
Ukera yitzchak leyaakov uvarich yateh ufakkedeh vaamar leh la tissav itteta mibbenat kenaan:
Kum lech paddena aram beta vetuel avi immecha vekach-lecha mishsham ishsha mibbenot lavan achi immecha
Kum izzel lefaddan aram levet betuel avuha deimmach vesav lach mittamman itteta mibbenat lavan achuha deimmach:
Veel shadday yevarech otcha veyafrecha veyarbecha vehayita likhal ammim
Veel shadday yevarech yatach veyappeshach veyasginnach utehe lechinshat shivtin:
Veyitten-lecha et-birkat avraham lecha ulezaracha ittach lerishtecha et-eretz megurecha asher-natan elohim leavraham
Veyitten lach yat birketa deavraham lach velivnach immach lemertach yat ara totavutach di yehav Adonai leavraham:
Vayyishlach yitzchak et-yaakov vayyelech paddena aram el-lavan ben-betuel haarammi achi rivka em yaakov veesav
Ushelach yitzchak yat yaakov vaazal lefaddan aram levat lavan bar betuel arammaa achuha derivka immeh deyaakov veesav:
Vayyar esav ki-verach yitzchak et-yaakov veshillach oto paddena aram lakachat-lo mishsham ishsha bevarcho oto vaytzav alav lemor lo-tikkach ishsha mibbenot kenaan
Vachaza esav are varich yitzchak yat yaakov veshallach yateh lefaddan aram lemissav leh mittamman itteta kad barich yateh ufakkid alohi lememar la tissav itteta mibbenat kenaan:
Vayyishma yaakov el-aviv veel-immo vayyelech paddena aram
Vekabbil yaakov min avuhi umin immeh vaazal lefaddan aram:
Vayyar esav ki raot benot kenaan beene yitzchak aviv
Vachaza esav are visha benat kenaan beene yitzchak avuhi:
Vayyelech esav el-yishmael vayyikkach et-machalat bat-yishmael ben-avraham achot nevayot al-nashav lo leishsha
Vaazal esav levat yishmael unesiv yat machalat bat yishmael bar avraham achateh dinvayot al neshohi leh leintu:
Vayyetze yaakov mibbeer shava vayyelech charana
Unefak yaakov mibbeera deshava vaazal lecharan:
Vayyifga bammakom vayyalen sham ki-va hashshemesh vayyikkach meavne hammakom vayyasem meraashotav vayyishkav bammakom hahu
Vaara beatra uvat tamman are al shimsha unesiv meavne atra veshavvi issadohi ushechiv beatra hahu:
Vayyachalom vehinne sullam mutztzav artza verosho maggia hashshamayma vehinne malache elohim olim veyordim bo
Vachalam veha sulma naitz beara veresheh mate ad tzet shemayya veha malachayya daAdonai salkin venachatin be:
Vehinne Adonai nitztzav alav vayyomar ani Adonai elohe avraham avicha velohe yitzchak haaretz asher atta shochev aleha lecha ettenenna ulezarecha
Veha yekara daAdonai meattad illavohi vaamar ana Adonai elahe deavraham avuch veelahe deyitzchak ara di at share ala lach etteninna velivnach:
Vehaya zaracha kaafar haaretz ufaratzta yamma vakedma vetzafona vanegba venivrechu vecha kol-mishpechot haadama uvezarecha
Vihon benach saggiin keafra deara vetitkef lemaarva ulemadincha uletzippuna uledaroma veyitbarchun bedilach kol zarayat ara uvedil benach:
Vehinne anochi immach ushemarticha bechol asher-telech vahashivoticha el-haadama hazzot ki lo eezovcha ad asher im-asiti et asher-dibbarti lach
Veha memri besadach veetterinnach bechol atar di tehach vaatevinnach leara hada are la eshbekinnach ad di ebed yat demallelit lach:
Vayyikatz yaakov mishshenato vayyomer achen yesh Adonai bammakom hazze veanochi lo yadati
Veittear yaakov mishshinteh vaamar bekusheta it yekara daAdonai share beatra haden vaana la haveti yeda:
Vayyira vayyomar ma-nnora hammakom hazze en ze ki im-bet elohim veze shaar hashshamayim
Udechil vaamar ma dechilu atra haden let den atar hedyot ellahen atar deraava veh min kodam Adonai veden tera kovel shemayya:
Vayyashkem yaakov babboker vayyikkach et-haeven asher-sam meraashotav vayyasem otah matztzeva vayyitzok shemen al-roshah
Veakdem yaakov betzafra unesiv yat avna di shavvi issadohi veshavvi yata kama vaarik mishcha al resha:
Vayyikra et-shem-hammakom hahu bet-el veulam luz shem-hair larishona
Ukera yat shema deatra hahu bet el uveram luz shema dekarta bekadmeta:
Vayyiddar yaakov neder lemor im-yihye elohim immadi ushemarani badderech hazze asher anochi holech venatan-li lechem leechol uveged lilbosh
Vekayyim yaakov keyam lememar im yehe memra daAdonai besadi veyitterinnani beorcha haden di ana azel veyitten li lachama lemechal uchesu lemilbash:
Veshavti veshalom el-bet avi vehaya Adonai li lelohim
Veetuv bishlam levet abba vihe memra daAdonai li lelaha:
Vehaeven hazzot asher-samti matztzeva yihye bet elohim vechol asher titten-li asser aasserennu lach
Veavna hada di shavveti kama tehe di ehe falach ala min kodam Adonai vechol di titten li chad min asra afreshinneh kodamach:
Vayyissa yaakov raglav vayyelech artza vene-kedem
Unetal yaakov raglohi vaazal laara bene madincha:
Vayyar vehinne veer bassade vehinne-sham shelosha edre-tzon rovtzim aleha ki min-habbeer hahiv yashku haadarim vehaeven gedola al-pi habbeer
Vachaza veha vera vechakla veha tamman telata edrin dean reviin ala are min bera hahi mashkan adarayya veavna rabbeta al puma devera:
Veneesfu-shamma chol-haadarim vegalelu et-haeven meal pi habbeer vehishku et-hatztzon veheshivu et-haeven al-pi habbeer limkomah
Umitkanneshin letamman kol adarayya umeganderin yat avna meal puma devera umashkan yat ana umetivin yat avna al puma devera leatra:
Vayyomer lahem yaakov achay meayin attem vayyomru mecharan anachnu
Vaamar lehon yaakov achay menan attun vaamaru mecharan anachna:
Vayyomer lahem hayedatem et-lavan ben-nachor vayyomru yadanu
Vaamar lehon hayedatun yat lavan bar nachor vaamaru yedanan:
Vayyomer lahem hashalom lo vayyomru shalom vehinne rachel bitto baa im-hatztzon
Vaamar lehon hashlam leh vaamaru shelam veha rachel beratteh atya im ana:
Vayyomer hen od hayyom gadol lo-et heasef hammikne hashku hatztzon ulechu reu
Vaamar ha od yoma saggi la iddan lemichnash beir ashku ana veizzilu reu:
Vayyomru lo nuchal ad asher yeasfu kol-haadarim vegalelu et-haeven meal pi habbeer vehishkinu hatztzon
Vaamaru la nikkul ad di mitkanneshin kol adarayya viganderun yat avna meal puma devera venashke ana:
Odennu medabber immam verachel baa im-hatztzon asher leaviha ki roa hiv
Ad dehu memallel immehon verachel atat im ana di laavuha are raita hi:
Vayhi kaasher raa yaakov et-rachel bat-lavan achi immo veet-tzon lavan achi immo vayyiggash yaakov vayyagel et-haeven meal pi habbeer vayyashk et-tzon lavan achi immo
Vahava kad chaza yaakov yat rachel bat lavan achuha deimmeh veyat ana delavan achuha deimmeh ukerev yaakov vegandar yat avna meal puma devera veashke yat ana delavan achuha deimmeh:
Vayyishshak yaakov lerachel vayyissa et-kolo vayyevk
Uneshak yaakov lerachel vaarem yat kaleh uvecha:
Vayyagged yaakov lerachel ki achi aviha hu vechi ven-rivka hu vattarotz vattagged leaviha
Vechavvi yaakov lerachel are var acha deavuha hu vaare var rivka hu urehatat vechavviat leavuha:
Vayhi chishmoa lavan et-shema yaakov ben-achoto vayyarotz likrato vaychabbek-lo vaynashshek-lo vayviehu el-beto vaysapper lelavan et kol-haddevarim haelle
Vahava kad shema lavan yat shema yaakov bar achateh urehat lekaddamuteh vegappef leh venashshik leh veaaleh leveteh veishtai lelavan yat kol pitgamayya haillen:
Vayyomer lo lavan ach atzmi uvesari atta vayyeshev immo chodesh yamim
Vaamar leh lavan beram karivi uvisri at vitev immeh yerach yomin:
Vayyomer lavan leyaakov hachi-achi atta vaavadtani chinnam haggida li ma-mmaskurtecha
Vaamar lavan leyaakov hamiddeachi at vetiflechinnani maggan chavvi li ma agrach:
Ulelavan shete vanot shem haggedola lea veshem hakketanna rachel
Ulelavan tarten benan shum rabbeta lea veshum zeerta rachel:
Veene lea rakkot verachel hayta yefat-toar vifat mare
Veene lea yaayan verachel havat shappira vereva veyaaya vechezva:
Vayyeehav yaakov et-rachel vayyomer eevodcha sheva shanim berachel bittecha hakketanna
Urechem yaakov yat rachel vaamar eflechinnach sheva shenin berachel berattach zeerta:
Vayyomer lavan tov titti otah lach mittitti otah leish acher sheva immadi
Vaamar lavan tav deetten yata lach middeetten yata ligvar ochoran tiv immi:
Vayyaavod yaakov berachel sheva shanim vayyihyu veenav keyamim achadim beahavato otah
Ufelach yaakov berachel sheva shenin vahavo veenohi keyomin zeirin kad rechem yata:
Vayyomer yaakov el-lavan hava et-ishti ki malu yamay veavoa eleha
Vaamar yaakov lelavan hav yat itteti are ashlemit yome falchani veeol levata:
Vayyeesof lavan et-kol-anshe hammakom vayyaas mishte
Uchenash lavan yat kol anashe atra vaavad mishteya:
Vayhi vaerev vayyikkach et-lea vitto vayyave otah elav vayyavo eleha
Vahava veramsha udevar yat lea veratteh veael yata levateh veal levata:
Vayyitten lavan lah et-zilpa shifchato lelea vitto shifcha
Vihav lavan la yat zilpa amteh lelea veratteh leamhu:
Vayhi vabboker vehinne-hiv lea vayyomer el-lavan ma-zzot asita li halo verachel avadti immach velamma rimmitani
Vahava vetzafra veha hi lea vaamar lelavan ma da avadta li hala verachel pelachit immach ulema shakkarta bi:
Vayyomer lavan lo-yease chen bimkomenu latet hatztzeira lifne habbechira
Vaamar lavan la itaved keden beatrana lemittan zeerta kodam rabbeta:
Malle shevua zot venittena lecha gam-et-zot baavoda asher taavod immadi od sheva-shanim acherot
Ashlim shevuata deda venitten lach af yat da befalchana di tiflach immi od sheva shenin ochoranin:
Vayyaas yaakov ken vaymalle shevua zot vayyitten-lo et-rachel bitto lo leishsha
Vaavad yaakov ken veashlem shevuata deda vihav leh yat rachel beratteh leh leintu:
Vayyitten lavan lerachel bitto et-bilha shifchato lah leshifcha
Vihav lavan lerachel beratteh yat bilha amteh la leamhu:
Vayyavo gam el-rachel vayyeehav gam-et-rachel millea vayyaavod immo od sheva-shanim acherot
Veal af levat rachel urechem af yat rachel millea ufelach immeh od sheva shenin ochoranin:
Vayyar Adonai ki-senua lea vayyiftach et-rachmah verachel akara
Vachaza Adonai are seniata lea vihav la idduy verachel akra:
Vattahar lea vatteled ben vattikra shemo reuven ki amra ki-raa Adonai beonyi ki atta yeehavani ishi
Veaddiat lea vilidat bar ukerat shemeh reuven are ameret are geli kodam Adonai ulboni are chean yirchaminnani vali:
Vattahar od vatteled ben vattomer ki-shama Adonai ki-senua anochi vayyitten-li gam-et-ze vattikra shemo shimon
Veaddiat od vilidat bar vaameret are shemia kodam Adonai are seniata ana vihav li af yat den ukerat shemeh shimon:
Vattahar od vatteled ben vattomer atta happaam yillave ishi elay ki-yaladti lo shelosha vanim al-ken kara-shemo levi
Veaddiat od vilidat bar vaameret hada zimna yitchabbar li vali are yeledit leh telata venin al ken kera shemeh levi:
Vattahar od vatteled ben vattomer happaam ode et-Adonai al-ken kara shemo yehuda vattaamod milledet
Veaddiat od vilidat bar vaameret hada zimna ode kodam Adonai al ken kerat shemeh yehuda vekamat millemelad:
Vattere rachel ki lo yalda leyaakov vattekanne rachel baachotah vattomer el-yaakov hava-lli vanim veim-ayin meta anochi
Vachazat rachel are la yelidat leyaakov vekanniat rachel baachata vaameret leyaakov hav li venin veim la meta ana:
Vayyichar-af yaakov berachel vayyomer hatachat elohim anochi asher-mana mimmech peri-vaten
Utekef rugeza deyaakov berachel vaamar ha minni at baya hala min kodam Adonai tivin di mena minnich valda dimin:
Vattomer hinne amati vilha bo eleha veteled al-birkay veibbane gam-anochi mimmenna
Vaameret ha amti vilha ul levata utelid vaana erabbe veetbene af ana minna:
Vattitten-lo et-bilha shifchatah leishsha vayyavo eleha yaakov
Vihavat leh yat bilha amta leintu veal levata yaakov:
Vattahar bilha vatteled leyaakov ben
Veaddiat bilha vilidat leyaakov bar:
Vattomer rachel dananni elohim vegam shama bekoli vayyitten-li ben al-ken kara shemo dan
Vaameret rachel denanni Adonai veaf kabbil tzeloti vihav li bar al ken kerat shemeh dan:
Vattahar od vatteled bilha shifchat rachel ben sheni leyaakov
Veaddiat od vilidat bilha amta derachel bar tinyan leyaakov:
Vattomer rachel naftule elohim niftalti im-achoti gam-yacholti vattikra shemo naftali
Vaameret rachel kabbil Adonai bauti beitchannanuti bitzloti chamedat dihe li velad kaachati af ityehiv li ukerat shemeh naftali:
Vattere lea ki amda milledet vattikkach et-zilpa shifchatah vattitten otah leyaakov leishsha
Vachazat lea are kamat millemelad udevarat yat zilpa amta vihavat yata leyaakov leintu:
Vatteled zilpa shifchat lea leyaakov ben
Vilidat zilpa amta delea leyaakov bar:
Vattomer lea ba gad vattikra et-shemo gad
Vaameret lea ata gad ukerat yat shemeh gad:
Vatteled zilpa shifchat lea ben sheni leyaakov
Vilidat zilpa amta delea bar tinyan leyaakov:
Vattomer lea beoshri ki ishsheruni banot vattikra et-shemo asher
Vaameret lea tushbachta havat li are vechen yeshabbechunnani neshayya ukerat yat shemeh asher:
Vayyelech reuven bime ketzir-chittim vayyimtza dudaim bassade vayyave otam el-lea immo vattomer rachel el-lea teni-na li middudae benech
Vaazal reuven beyome chatzad chittin veashkach yavruchin bechakla veayti yathon lelea immeh vaameret rachel lelea havi chean li miyyavruche divrich:
Vattomer lah hameat kachtech et-ishi velakachat gam et-dudae beni vattomer rachel lachen yishkav immach hallayla tachat dudae venech
Vaameret la hazer didvart yat bali vetissevin af yat yavruche divri vaameret rachel bechen yishkuv imach belelya cholaf yavruche divrich:
Vayyavo yaakov min-hassade baerev vattetze lea likrato vattomer elay tavo ki sachor secharticha bedudae beni vayyishkav immah ballayla hu
Vaata yaakov min chakla beramsha unefakat lea lekaddamuteh vaameret levati teol are megar agartich beyavruche divri ushechiv imma belelya hu:
Vayyishma elohim el-lea vattahar vatteled leyaakov ben chamishi
Vekabbil Adonai tzelota delea veaddiat vilidat leyaakov bar chamishai:
Vattomer lea natan elohim sechari asher-natatti shifchati leishi vattikra shemo yissashchar
Vaameret lea yehav Adonai agri dihavit amti levali ukerat shemeh yissaschar:
Vattahar od lea vatteled ben-shishshi leyaakov
Veaddiat od lea vilidat bar shititai leyaakov:
Vattomer lea zevadani elohim oti zeved tov happaam yizbeleni ishi ki-yaladti lo shishsha vanim vattikra et-shemo zevulun
Vaameret lea yehav Adonai yateh li cholak tav hada zimna yehe medoreh devali levati are yeledit leh shitta venin ukerat yat shemeh zevulun:
Veachar yalda bat vattikra et-shemah dina
Uvatar ken yelidat beratta ukerat yat shema dina:
Vayyizkor elohim et-rachel vayyishma eleha elohim vayyiftach et-rachmah
Veal ducherana derachel kodam Adonai vekabbil tzelota Adonai vihav la idduy:
Vattahar vatteled ben vattomer asaf elohim et-cherpati
Veaddiat vilidat bar vaameret kenash Adonai yat chissudi:
Vattikra et-shemo yosef lemor yosef Adonai li ben acher
Ukerat yat shemeh yosef lememar yosef Adonai li bar ochoran:
Vayhi kaasher yalda rachel et-yosef vayyomer yaakov el-lavan shallecheni veelcha el-mekomi uleartzi
Vahava kad yelidat rachel yat yosef vaamar yaakov lelavan shallechani veehach leatri uleari:
Tena et-nashay veet-yeladay asher avadti otcha bahen veelecha ki atta yadata et-avodati asher avadticha
Hav yat neshay veyat benay di felachit yatach behen veezel are at yedata yat palchani diflachittach:
Vayyomer elav lavan im-na matzati chen beenecha nichashti vayvarcheni Adonai biglalecha
Vaamar leh lavan im kean ashkachit rachamin kodamach nasseti uvarchani Adonai bedilach:
Vayyomar nokva secharcha alay veettena
Vaamar paresh agrach alay veetten:
Vayyomer elav atta yadata et asher avadticha veet asher-haya miknecha itti
Vaamar leh at yedata yat diflachittach veyat dahava veirach immi:
Ki meat asher-haya lecha lefanay vayyifrotz larov vayvarech Adonai otcha leragli veatta matay eese gam-anochi leveti
Are zeer di hava lach kodamay utekef lemisge uvarich Adonai yatach bedili uchean ematay ebed af ana leveti:
Vayyomer ma etten-lach vayyomer yaakov lo-titten-li meuma im-taase-lli haddavar hazze ashuva ere tzoncha eshmor
Vaamar ma etten lach vaamar yaakov la titten li middaam im tabed li pitgama haden etuv ere anach ettar:
Eevor bechol-tzoncha hayyom haser mishsham kol-se nakod vetalu vechol-se-chum bakkesavim vetalu venakod baizzim vehaya sechari
Ebar bechol anach yoma den haade mittamman kol immar nemor urekoa vechol immar shechum beimmerayya urekoa unemor beizzayya vihe agri:
Veanta-bbi tzidkati beyom machar ki-tavo al-sechari lefanecha kol asher-enennu nakod vetalu baizzim vechum bakkesavim ganuv hu itti
Vetashed bi zachuti beyom dimchar are teol al agri kodamach kol di letohi nemor urekoa beizzayya ushechum beimmerayya genuva hu immi:
Vayyomer lavan hen lu yehi chidvarecha
Vaamar lavan beram levay yehe chefitgamach:
Vayyasar bayyom hahu et-hatteyashim haakuddim vehatteluim veet kol-haizzim hannekuddot vehatteluot kol asher-lavan bo vechol-chum bakkesavim vayyitten beyad-banav
Veadi veyoma hahu yat teyashayya regolayya urekoayya veyat kol izayya nemorta urekoata kol di chivvar beh vechol dishchum beimmerayya vihav beyad benohi:
Vayyasem derech sheloshet yamim beno uven yaakov veyaakov roe et-tzon lavan hannotarot
Veshavvi mahalach telata yomin benohi uven yaakov veyaakov rae yat ana delavan deishtooran:
Vayyikkach-lo yaakov makkal livne lach veluz vearmon vayfatztzel bahen petzalot levanot machsof hallavan asher al-hammaklot
Unesiv leh yaakov chuterin dilvan rattivin didluz vedidluf vekalif behon kilfin chivvarin kiluf chivvar di al chuterayya:
Vayyatztzeg et-hammaklot asher pitztzel barhatim beshiktot hammayim asher tavona hatztzon lishtot lenochach hatztzon vayyechamna bevoan lishtot
Vedaetz yat chuterayya di kallif birhatayya atar bet shakya demayya atar deatan ana lemishte lekivlehon deana umityachaman bemetehon lemishte:
Vayyechemu hatztzon el-hammaklot vatteladna hatztzon akuddim nekuddim uteluim
Veityachama ana bechuterayya vilida ana regolin nemorin urekoin:
Vehakkesavim hifrid yaakov vayyitten pene hatztzon el-akod vechol-chum betzon lavan vayyashet-lo adarim levaddo velo shatam al-tzon lavan
Veimmerayya afresh yaakov vihav beresh ana kol dirgol vechol dishchum beana delavan veshavvi leh edrin bilchodohi vela arevinnun im ana delavan:
Vehaya bechol-yachem hatztzon hamekushsharot vesam yaakov et-hammaklot leene hatztzon barhatim leyachmenna bammaklot
Vahave bechol iddan demityachaman ana mevakkarta umeshavvi yaakov yat chuterayya leene ana birhatayya leyachamutehon bechuterayya:
Uvehaatif hatztzon lo yasim vehaya haatufim lelavan vehakkeshurim leyaakov
Uvelakkishut ana la meshavve vahavo lakkeshaya lelavan uvakkirayya leyaakov:
Vayyifrotz haish meod meod vayhi-lo tzon rabbot ushefachot vaavadim ugemallim vachamorim
Utekef gavra lachada lachada vahavo leh an saggian vaamhan veavdin vegamlin vachamarin:
Vayyishma et-divre vene-lavan lemor lakach yaakov et kol-asher leavinu umeasher leavinu asa et kol-hakkavod hazze
Ushema yat pitgame vene lavan deamrin nesiv yaakov yat kol di leavuna umiddi leavuna kena yat kol nichsayya haden:
Vayyar yaakov et-pene lavan vehinne enennu immo kitmol shilshom
Vachaza yaakov yat sevar appe lavan veha letohi immeh kemeitmalle umiddekammohi:
Vayyomer Adonai el-yaakov shuv el-eretz avotecha ulemoladtecha veeye immach
Vaamar Adonai leyaakov tuv leara daavahatach uleyalladtach vihe memri besadach:
Vayyishlach yaakov vayyikra lerachel ulelea hassade el-tzono
Ushelach yaakov ukera lerachel ulelea lechakla levat aneh:
Vayyomer lahen roe anochi et-pene avichen ki-enennu elay kitmol shilshom velohe avi haya immadi
Vaamar lehen chaze ana yat sevar appe avuchen are letohi immi kemeitmalli umiddekammohi velahe deabba hava besadi:
Veattena yedaten ki bechol-kochi avadti et-avichen
Veattin yedatin are bechol cheli pelachit yat avuchen:
Vaavichen hetel bi vehechelif et-maskurti aseret monim velo-netano elohim lehara immadi
Vaavuchen shekar bi veashni yat agri asar zimnin vela shavkeh Adonai leavasha immi:
Im-ko yomar nekuddim yihye secharecha veyaldu chol-hatztzon nekuddim veim-ko yomar akuddim yihye secharecha veyaldu chol-hatztzon akuddim
Im keden hava amar nemorin yehe agrach vilidan kol ana nemorin veim keden hava amar regolin yehe agrach vilidan kol ana regolin:
Vayyatztzel elohim et-mikne avichem vayyitten-li
Veafresh Adonai yat gete daavuchon vihav li:
Vayhi beet yachem hatztzon vaessa enay vaere bachalom vehinne haattudim haolim al-hatztzon akuddim nekuddim uveruddim
Vahava beiddan deityachama ana uzekafit aynay vachazet bechelma veha teyashayya desalkin al ana regolin nemorin ufatztzichin:
Vayyomer elay malach haelohim bachalom yaakov vaomar hinneni
Vaamar li malacha daAdonai bechelma yaakov vaamarit ha ana:
Vayyomer sa-na enecha uree kol-haattudim haolim al-hatztzon akuddim nekuddim uveruddim ki raiti et kol-asher lavan ose lach
Vaamar zekof kean aynach vachaze kol teyashayya desalkin al ana regolin nemorin ufatztzichin are gele kodamay yat kol di lavan aved lach:
Anochi hael bet-el asher mashachta sham matztzeva asher nadarta li sham neder atta kum tze min-haaretz hazzot veshuv el-eretz moladtecha
Ana elaha deitgeleti alach bevet el di meshachta tamman kama di kayyimta kodamay tamman keyam kean kum puk min ara hada vetuv leara yalladutach:
Vattaan rachel velea vattomarna lo haod lanu chelek venachala bevet avinu
Vaativat rachel velea vaamaran leh haod kean lana cholak veachasana bevet avuna:
Halo nochriyyot nechshavnu lo ki mecharanu vayyochal gam-achol et-kaspenu
Hala nucheraan itchashavna leh are zabbenana vaachal af mechal yat kaspana:
Ki chol-haosher asher hitztzil elohim meavinu lanu hu ulevanenu veatta kol asher amar elohim elecha ase
Are chol utera di afresh Adonai meavuna dilana hu ulevanana uchean kol di amar Adonai lach aved:
Vayyakom yaakov vayyissa et-banav veet-nashav al-haggemallim
Vekam yaakov unetal yat benohi veyat neshohi al gamlayya:
Vayyinhag et-kol-miknehu veet-kol-rechusho asher rachash mikne kinyano asher rachash befaddan aram lavo el-yitzchak aviv artza kenaan
Udevar yat kol getohi veyat kol kinyaneh dikna gete kinyaneh di kena befaddan aram lemete levat yitzchak avuhi leara chenaan:
Velavan halach ligzoz et-tzono vattignov rachel et-hatterafim asher leaviha
Velavan azal lemiggaz yat aneh vechassiat rachel yat tzalmanayya di laavuha:
Vayyignov yaakov et-lev lavan haarammi al-beli higgid lo ki voreach hu
Vechassi yaakov min libba delavan arammaa al dela chavvi leh are azel hu:
Vayyivrach hu vechol-asher-lo vayyakom vayyaavor et-hannahar vayyasem et-panav har haggilad
Vaazal hu vechol di leh vekam vaavar yat perat veshavvi yat appohi letura degilad:
Vayyuggad lelavan bayyom hashshelishi ki varach yaakov
Veitchava lelavan beyoma telitaa are azel yaakov:
Vayyikkach et-echav immo vayyirdof acharav derech shivat yamim vayyadbek oto behar haggilad
Udevar yat achuhi immeh uredaf batrohi mahalach shivat yomin veadbek yateh betura degilad:
Vayyavo elohim el-lavan haarammi bachalom hallayla vayyomer lo hishshamer lecha pen-tedabber im-yaakov mittov ad-ra
Vaata memar min kodam Adonai levat lavan arammaa bechelma delelya vaamar leh istammar lach dilma temallel im yaakov mittav ad bish:
Vayyasseg lavan et-yaakov veyaakov taka et-oholo bahar velavan taka et-echav behar haggilad
Veadbek lavan yat yaakov veyaakov peras yat mashkeneh betura velavan ashre yat achohi betura degilad:
Vayyomer lavan leyaakov me asita vattignov et-levavi vattenaheg et-benotay kishvuyot charev
Vaamar lavan leyaakov ma avadta vechasseta minni udevarta yat benatay keshavyot charba:
Lamma nachbeta livroach vattignov oti velo-higgadta li vaashallechacha besimcha uveshirim betof uvechinnor
Lema itmarta lemezal vechasseta minni vela chavveta li veshallachittach pon bechedva uvetushebechan betufin uvechinnarin:
Velo netashtani lenashshek levanay velivnotay atta hiskalta aso
Vela shevaktani lenashshaka livnay velivnatay kean askelta lemebad:
Yesh-leel yadi laasot immachem ra velohe avichem emesh amar elay lemor hishshamer lecha middabber im-yaakov mittov ad-ra
It chela vidi lemebad immechon bish velaha daavuchon beramsha amar li lememar istammar lach millemallala im yaakov mittav ad bish:
Veatta haloch halachta ki-nichsof nichsafta levet avicha lamma ganavta et-elohay
Uchean mezal azalta are chammada chammedta levet avuch lema nesivta yat dachalti:
Vayyaan yaakov vayyomer lelavan ki yareti ki amarti pen-tigzol et-benotecha meimmi
Vaatev yaakov vaamar lelavan are dechelit are amarit dilma tanes yat benatach minni:
Im asher timtza et-elohecha lo yichye neged achenu hakker-lecha ma immadi vekach-lach velo-yada yaakov ki rachel genavatam
Im di tashkach yat dachaltach la yitkayyam kodam achana ishtemoda lach ma deimmi vesav lach vela yeda yaakov are rachel nesivathon:
Vayyavo lavan beohel yaakov uveohel lea uveohel shete haamahot velo matza vayyetze meohel lea vayyavo beohel rachel
Veal lavan bemashkena deyaakov uvemashkena delea uvemashkena detarten lechenata vela ashkach unefak mimmashkena delea veal bemashkena derachel:
Verachel lakcha et-hatterafim vattesimem bechar haggamal vatteshev alehem vaymashshesh lavan et-kol-haohel velo matza
Verachel nesivat yat tzalmanayya veshavvittinnun baavita degamla vitivat alehon umashshish lavan yat kol mashkena vela ashkach:
Vattomer el-aviha al-yichar beene adoni ki lo uchal lakum mippanecha ki-derech nashim li vaychappes velo matza et-hatterafim
Vaameret laavuha la yitkef beene ribboni are la ikkul lemekam min kodamach are orach neshin li uvelash vela ashkach yat tzalmanayya:
Vayyichar leyaakov vayyarev belavan vayyaan yaakov vayyomer lelavan ma-ppishi ma chattati ki dalakta acharay
Utekef leyaakov unetza im lavan vaatev yaakov vaamar lelavan ma chovi ma surechani are redafta batray:
Ki-mishshashta et-kol-kelay ma-mmatzata mikkol kele-vetecha sim ko neged achay veachecha veyochichu ben shenenu
Are mashshishta yat kol manay ma ashkachta mikkol mane vetach shavvi hacha kodam achay veachaych veyochichun ben tarvana:
Ze esrim shana anochi immach rechelecha veizzecha lo shikkelu veele tzoncha lo achalti
Denan esrin shenin ana immach rechelach veizzach la atkilu vedichre anach la achalit:
Terefa lo-heveti elecha anochi achattenna miyyadi tevakshenna genuvti yom ugenuvti layla
Ditvira la ayteti levatach dahava shagya mimminyana minni at bae la netarit bimama unetarit belelya:
Hayiti vayyom achalani chorev vekerach ballayla vattiddad shenati meenay
Haveti vimama achalni sharva ugelida hava nachet alay belelya unedad shinti meenay:
Ze-lli esrim shana bevetecha avadticha arba-esre shana bishte venotecha veshesh shanim betzonecha vattachalef et-maskurti aseret monim
Denan li esrin shenin bevetach pelachittach arba esre shenin betarten benataych veshit shenin beanach veashneta yat agri asar zimnin:
Lule elohe avi elohe avraham ufachad yitzchak haya li ki atta rekam shillachtani et-onyi veet-yegia kappay raa elohim vayyochach amesh
Ilula fon elahe deabba elahe deavraham udedachil leh yitzchak hava besadi are chean rekan shillachtani yat amli veyat leut yeday gele kodam Adonai veochach beramsha:
Vayyaan lavan vayyomer el-yaakov habbanot benotay vehabbanim banay vehatztzon tzoni vechol asher-atta roe li-hu velivnotay ma-eese laelle hayyom o livnehen asher yaladu
Vaatev lavan vaamar leyaakov benata benatay uvenayya venay veana ani vechol di at chaze dili hu velivnatay ma ebed leillen yoma den o livnehen dilidan:
Veatta lecha nichreta verit ani vaatta vehaya leed beni uvenecha
Uchean eta nigzar keyam ana veat vihe lesahid beni uvenach:
Vayyikkach yaakov aven vayrimeha matztzeva
Unesiv yaakov avna uzekafa kama:
Vayyomer yaakov leechav liktu avanim vayyikchu avanim vayyaasu-gal vayyochlu sham al-haggal
Vaamar yaakov laachohi lekutu avnin unesivu avnin vaavadu degora vaachalu tamman al degora:
Vayyikra-lo lavan yegar sahaduta veyaakov kara lo galed
Ukera leh lavan yegar sahaduta veyaakov kera leh galed:
Vayyomer lavan haggal hazze ed beni uvencha hayyom al-ken kara-shemo galed
Vaamar lavan degora haden sahid beni uvenach yoma den al ken kera shemeh galed:
Vehammitzpa asher amar yitzef Adonai beni uvenecha ki nissater ish mereehu
Vesachuta di amar yisech memra daAdonai beni uvenach are nitkassi gevar mechavreh:
Im-teanne et-benotay veim-tikkach nashim al-benotay en ish immanu ree elohim ed beni uvenecha
Im teanne yat benatay veim tissav neshin al benatay let enash immana chaze memra daAdonai sahid beni uvenach:
Vayyomer lavan leyaakov hinne haggal hazze vehinne hammatztzeva asher yariti beni uvenecha
Vaamar lavan leyaakov ha degora haden veha kamta di akemit beni uvenach:
Ed haggal hazze veeda hammatztzeva im-ani lo-eevor elecha et-haggal hazze veim-atta lo-taavor elay et-haggal hazze veet-hammatztzeva hazzot leraa
Sahid degora haden vesahada kama im ana la ebar levatach yat degora haden veim at la teibbar levati yat degora haden veyat kamta hada levishu:
Elohe avraham velohe nachor yishpetu venenu elohe avihem vayyishshava yaakov befachad aviv yitzchak
Elahe deavraham veelahe denachor yedunun benana elahe daavuhon vekayyem yaakov biddachil leh avuhi yitzchak:
Vayyizbach yaakov zevach bahar vayyikra leechav leechol-lachem vayyochlu lechem vayyalinu bahar
Uneches yaakov nichsata betura ukera laachohi lemechal lachama vaachalu lachama uvitu betura:
Vayyashkem lavan babboker vaynashshek levanav velivnotav vayvarech ethem vayyelech vayyashov lavan limkomo
Veakdem lavan betzafra uneshak livnohi velivnateh uvarich yathen vaazal vetav lavan leatreh:
Veyaakov halach ledarko vayyifgeu-vo malache elohim
Veyaakov azal leorcheh vaarau veh malachayya daAdonai:
Vayyomer yaakov kaasher raam machane elohim ze vayyikra shem-hammakom hahu machanayim
Vaamar yaakov kad chazanun mashrita min kodam Adonai den ukera shema deatra hahu machanayim:
Vayyishlach yaakov malachim lefanav el-esav achiv artza seir sede edom
Ushelach yaakov izgaddin kodamohi levat esav achuhi leara deseir lachakal edom:
Vaytzav otam lemor ko tomrun ladoni leesav ko amar avdecha yaakov im-lavan garti vaechar ad-atta
Ufakkid yathon lememar keden temrun leribboni leesav kidnan amar avdach yaakov im lavan darit veocharit ad kean:
Vayhi-li shor vachamor tzon veeved veshifcha vaeshlecha lehaggid ladoni limtzo-chen beenecha
Vahava li torin vachamarin an veavdin veamhan ushelachit lechavvaa leribboni leashkacha rachamin beenach:
Vayyashuvu hammalachim el-yaakov lemor banu el-achicha el-esav vegam holech likratcha vearba-meot ish immo
Vetavu izgaddayya levat yaakov lememar atena levat achuch levat esav veaf ate lekaddamutach vearba mea gavra immeh:
Vayyira yaakov meod vayyetzer lo vayyachatz et-haam asher-itto veet-hatztzon veet-habbakar vehaggemallim lishne machanot
Udechil yaakov lachada vaakat leh ufalleg yat amma di immeh veyat ana veyat tore vegamlayya litren mashshiryan:
Vayyomer im-yavo esav el-hammachane haachat vehikkahu vehaya hammachane hannishar lifleta
Vaamar im yete esav lemashrita chada veyimchinneh vihe mashrita detishtaar leshezava:
Vayyomer yaakov elohe avi avraham velohe avi yitzchak Adonai haomer elay shuv leartzecha ulemoladtecha veetiva immach
Vaamar yaakov elahe deabba avraham velahe deabba yitzchak Adonai di amar li tuv learach uleyalladutach veotev immach:
Katonti mikkol hachasadim umikkol-haemet asher asita et-avdecha ki vemakli avarti et-hayyarden hazze veatta hayiti lishne machanot
Zeiran zachutay mikkol chisdin umikkal tavvan di avadta im avdach are yechidi avarit yat yardena haden uchean haveti litren mashshiryan:
Hatztzileni na miyyad achi miyyad esav ki-yare anochi oto pen-yavo vehikkani em al-banim
Shezavni chean mida deachi mida deesav are dachel ana minneh dilma yete veyimchinnani imma al benayya:
Veatta amarta hetev etiv immach vesamti et-zaracha kechol hayyam asher lo-yissafer merov
Veat amarta otava otev immach veeshavvi yat benach saggiin kechalla deyamma di la yittimnun missaggi:
Vayyalen sham ballayla hahu vayyikkach min-habba veyado mincha leesav achiv
Uvat tamman belelya hahu unesiv min deayti videh tikruvta leesav achuhi:
Izzim matayim uteyashim esrim rechelim matayim veelim esrim
Izze matan uteyashayya esrin rechelin matan vedichrin esrin:
Gemallim menikot uvenehem sheloshim parot arbaim ufarim asara atonot esrim vayarim asara
Gamle menkata uvenehon telatin torta arbein vetore asra atnan esrin veire asra:
Vayyitten beyad-avadav eder eder levaddo vayyomer el-avadav ivru lefanay verevach tasimu ben eder uven eder
Vihav beyad avdohi edra edra bilchodohi vaamar leavdohi ibbaru kodamay urevacha teshavvun ben edra uven edra:
Vaytzav et-harishon lemor ki yifgoshcha esav achi usheelcha lemor lemi-atta veana telech ulemi elle lefanecha
Ufakked yat kadmaa lememar are yearinnach esav achi usheelinnach lememar leman at ulean at azel uleman illen dikodamach:
Veamarta leavdecha leyaakov mincha hiv shelucha ladoni leesav vehinne gam-hu acharenu
Vetemar leavdach leyaakov tikruvta hi dimshallecha leribboni leesav veha af hu ate vatrana:
Vaytzav gam et-hashsheni gam et-hashshelishi gam et-kol-haholchim achare haadarim lemor kaddavar hazze tedabberun el-esav bemotzaachem oto
Ufakkid af yat tinyana af yat telitaa af yat kol deazlin batar adarayya lememar kefitgama haden temallelun im esav kad tashkechun yateh:
Vaamartem gam hinne avdecha yaakov acharenu ki-amar achappera fanav bammincha haholechet lefanay veachare-chen ere fanav ulay yissa fanay
Vetemrun af ha avdach yaakov ate vatrana are amar anchinneh lerugezeh betikruvta deazlat lokodamay uvatar ken echeze appohi maim yissav appay:
Vattaavor hammincha al-panav vehu lan ballayla-hahu bammachane
Vaavarat tikruvta al appohi vehu vat belelya hahu bemashrita:
Vayyakom ballayla hu vayyikkach et-shete nashav veet-shete shifchotav veet-achad asar yeladav vayyaavor et maavar yabbok
Vekam belelya hu udevar yat tarten neshohi veyat tarten lechenateh veyat chad asar benohi vaavar yat maavar yuveka:
Vayyikkachem vayyaavirem et-hannachal vayyaaver et-asher-lo
Udevarinnun veabbarinnun yat nachla veabar yat dileh:
Vayyivvater yaakov levaddo vayyeavek ish immo ad alot hashshachar
Veishtaar yaakov bilchodohi veishtaddel gavra immeh ad dislek tzafra:
Vayyar ki lo yachol lo vayyigga bechaf-yerecho vatteka kaf-yerech yaakov beheavko immo
Vachaza are la yachil leh ukerev bifte yarkeh veza pete yarka deyaakov beishtaddaluteh immeh:
Vayyomer shallecheni ki ala hashshachar vayyomer lo ashallechacha ki im-berachtani
Vaamar shallechani are selik tzafra vaamar la ashallechinnach ellahen berachtani:
Vayyomer elav ma-shshemecha vayyomer yaakov
Vaamar leh ma shemach vaamar yaakov:
Vayyomer lo yaakov yeamer od shimcha ki im-yisrael ki-sarita im-elohim veim-anashim vattuchal
Vaamar la yaakov yitamar od shemach ellahen yisrael are ravrevat kodam Adonai veim guverayya vichalta:
Vayyishal yaakov vayyomer haggida-nna shemecha vayyomer lamma ze tishal lishmi vayvarech oto sham
Usheel yaakov vaamar chavvi chean shemach vaamar lema denan at shael lishmi uvarich yateh tamman:
Vayyikra yaakov shem hammakom peniel ki-raiti elohim panim el-panim vattinnatzel nafshi
Ukera yaakov shema deatra peniel are chazeti malachayya daAdonai appin beappin veishtezavat nafshi:
Vayyizrach-lo hashshemesh kaasher avar et-penuel vehu tzolea al-yerecho
Udenach leh shimsha kema di avar yat penuel vehu matla al yarkeh:
Al-ken lo-yochlu vene-yisrael et-gid hannashe asher al-kaf hayyarech ad hayyom hazze ki naga bechaf-yerech yaakov begid hannashe
Al ken la yechlun bene yisrael yat gida denashya di al pete yarka ad yoma haden are kerev bifte yarka deyaakov begida denashya:
Vayyissa yaakov enav vayyar vehinne esav ba veimmo arba meot ish vayyachatz et-hayeladim al-lea veal-rachel veal shete hashshefachot
Uzekaf yaakov enohi vachaza veha esav ata veimmeh arba mea guvrin ufallig yat benayya al lea veal rachel veal tarten lechenata:
Vayyasem et-hashshefachot veet-yaldehen rishona veet-lea viladeha acharonim veet-rachel veet-yosef acharonim
Veshavvi yat lechenata veyat benehen kadmain veyat lea uvenaha batrain veyat rachel veyat yosef batrain:
Vehu avar lifnehem vayyishtachu artza sheva peamim ad-gishto ad-achiv
Vehu avar kodamehon usegid al ara sheva zimnin ad mikreveh ad achuhi:
Vayyarotz esav likrato vaychabbekehu vayyippol al-tzavvarav vayyishshakehu vayyivku
Urehat esav lekaddamuteh vegappefeh unefal al tzavreh venashshekeh uvecho:
Vayyissa et-enav vayyar et-hannashim veet-hayeladim vayyomer mi-elle lach vayyomar hayeladim asher-chanan elohim et-avdecha
Uzekaf yat enohi vachaza yat neshayya veyat benayya vaamar man illen lach vaamar benayya di chas Adonai yat avdach:
Vattiggashna hashshefachot henna veyaldehen vattishtachavena
Ukerivat lechenata innin uvenehen usegida:
Vattiggash gam-lea viladeha vayyishtachavu veachar niggash yosef verachel vayyishtachavu
Ukeriva af lea uvenaha usegidu uvatar ken kerev yosef verachel usegidu:
Vayyomer mi lecha kol-hammachane hazze asher pagashti vayyomer limtzo-chen beene adoni
Vaamar man lach kol mashrita haden di arait vaamar leashkacha rachamin beene ribboni:
Vayyomer esav yesh-li rav achi yehi lecha asher-lach
Vaamar esav it li saggi achi atzlach bedilach:
Vayyomer yaakov al-na im-na matzati chen beenecha velakachta minchati miyyadi ki al-ken raiti fanecha kirot pene elohim vattirtzeni
Vaamar yaakov bevau im kean ashkachit rachamin beenaych utekabbel tikruvti min yedi are al ken chazittinnun leappaych kechezu appe ravrevayya veitreet li:
Kach-na et-birchati asher huvat lach ki-channani elohim vechi yesh-li-chol vayyiftzar-bo vayyikkach
Kabbel kean yat tikruvti deittotiat lach are rachim alay kodam Adonai vaare it li cholla veatkef beh vekabbil:
Vayyomer nisa venelecha veelcha lenegdecha
Vaamar nittal venehach veehach lekavlach:
Vayyomer elav adoni yodea ki-hayeladim rakkim vehatztzon vehabbakar alot alay udefakum yom echad vametu kol-hatztzon
Vaamar leh ribboni yeda are yankayya rakkichin veana vetore menikta alay udechokinnun yoma chad vimutun kol ana:
Yaavor-na adoni lifne avdo vaani etnahala leitti leregel hammelacha asher-lefanay uleregel hayeladim ad asher-avo el-adoni seira
Yeibbar kean ribboni kodam avdeh vaana edabber beniach leregel ovadta di kodamay uleregel yankayya ad di eol levat ribboni leseir:
Vayyomer esav atztziga-nna immecha min-haam asher itti vayyomer lamma ze emtza-chen beene adoni
Vaamar esav eshbok kean immach min amma diimmi vaamar lema denan ashkach rachamin beene ribboni:
Vayyashov bayyom hahu esav ledarko seira
Vetav beyoma hahu esav leorcheh leseir:
Veyaakov nasa sukkota vayyiven lo bayit ulemiknehu asa sukkot al-ken kara shem-hammakom sukkot
Veyaakov netal lesukkot uvena leh beta velivireh avad metallan al ken kera shema deatra sukkot:
Vayyavo yaakov shalem ir shechem asher beeretz kenaan bevoo mippaddan aram vayyichan et-pene hair
Vaata yaakov shelim karta dishchem di beara dichnaan bemeteh mippaddan daaram ushera lokovel appe karta:
Vayyiken et-chelkat hassade asher nata-sham oholo miyyad bene-chamor avi shechem bemea kesita
Uzevan yat achasanat chakla di feras tamman mashkeneh mida divne chamor avuhi dishchem bemea churefan:
Vayyatztzev-sham mizbeach vayyikra-lo el elohe yisrael
Vaakem tamman madbecha ufelach alohi kodam el elaha deyisrael:
Vattetze dina bat-lea asher yalda leyaakov lirot bivnot haaretz
Unefakat dina bat lea di yelidat leyaakov lemecheze bivnat ara:
Vayyar otah shechem ben-chamor hachivvi nesi haaretz vayyikkach otah vayyishkav otah vayanneha
Vachaza yata shechem bar chamor chivaa rabba deara udevar yata ushechiv yata veanya:
Vattidbak nafsho bedina bat-yaakov vayyeehav et-hannaara vaydabber al-lev hannaara
Veitreiat nafsheh bedina bat yaakov urechem yat ulemta umalil al libba deulemta:
Vayyomer shechem el-chamor aviv lemor kach-li et-hayyalda hazzot leishsha
Vaamar shechem lachamor avuhi lememar sav li yat ulemta hada leintu:
Veyaakov shama ki timme et-dina vitto uvanav hayu et-miknehu bassade vehecherish yaakov ad-boam
Veyaakov shema are saev yat dina veratteh uvenohi havo im getohi bechakla veshatik yaakov ad metehon:
Vayyetze chamor avi-shechem el-yaakov ledabber itto
Unefak chamor avuhi dishchem levat yaakov lemallala immeh:
Uvene yaakov bau min-hassade keshomam vayyitatztzevu haanashim vayyichar lahem meod ki-nevala asa veyisrael lishkav et-bat-yaakov vechen lo yease
Uvene yaakov allu min chakla kad shemau veitnesisu guvrayya utekef lehon lachada are kelana avad beyisrael lemishkav im bat yaakov vechen la chashar leitavada:
Vaydabber chamor ittam lemor shechem beni chashka nafsho bevittechem tenu na otah lo leishsha
Umallil chamor immehon lememar shechem beri itreiat nafsheh bivrattechon havu chean yata leh leintu:
Vehitchattenu otanu benotechem tittenu-lanu veet-benotenu tikchu lachem
Vetitchattenun bana benatechon tittenun lana veyat benatana tissevun lechon:
Veittanu teshevu vehaaretz tihye lifnechem shevu usecharuha veheachazu bah
Veimmana tetvun veara tehe kodamechon tivu veividu va sechorta veachasinu ba:
Vayyomer shechem el-aviha veel-acheha emtza-chen beenechem vaasher tomru elay etten
Vaamar shechem laavuha uleachaha ashkach rachamin beenechon vedi temrun li etten:
Harbu alay meod mohar umattan veettena kaasher tomru elay utenu-li et-hannaara leishsha
Asgo alay lachada moharin umattenan veetten kema di temrun li vehavu li yat ulemta leintu:
Vayyaanu vene-yaakov et-shechem veet-chamor aviv bemirma vaydabberu asher timme et dina achotam
Vaativu vene yaakov yat shechem veyat chamor avuhi bechochmata umallilu di saev yat dina achathon:
Vayyomru alehem lo nuchal laasot haddavar hazze latet et-achotenu leish asher-lo orla ki-cherpa hiv lanu
Vaamaru lehon la nikkul lemebad pitgama haden lemittan yat achatana ligvar di leh orleta are chissuda hi lana:
Ach-bezot neot lachem im tihyu chamonu lehimmol lachem kol-zachar
Beram beda nitpes lechon im tehevon kevatana lemigzar lechon kol dechura:
Venatannu et-benotenu lachem veet-benotechem nikkach-lanu veyashavnu ittechem vehayinu leam echad
Venitten yat benatana lechon veyat benatechon nissav lana venittuv immechon venehe leamma chad:
Veim-lo tishmeu elenu lehimmol velakachnu et-bittenu vehalachnu
Veim la tekabbelun minnana lemigzar unedabber yat berattana venezel:
Vayyitvu divrehem beene chamor uveene shechem ben-chamor
Ushefaru fitgamehon beene chamor uveene shechem bar chamor:
Velo-echar hannaar laasot haddavar ki chafetz bevat-yaakov vehu nichbad mikkol bet aviv
Vela ochar ulema lemebad pitgama are itrei bevat yaakov vehu yakkir mikkol bet avuhi:
Vayyavo chamor ushechem beno el-shaar iram vaydabberu el-anshe iram lemor
Vaata chamor ushechem bereh litra kartehon umallilu im anashe kartehon lememar:
Haanashim haelle shelemim hem ittanu veyeshvu vaaretz veyischaru otah vehaaretz hinne rachavat-yadayim lifnehem et-benotam nikkach-lanu lenashim veet-benotenu nitten lahem
Guvrayya haillen shalmin innun immana vitivun beara veyabedun ba sechorta veara ha fetayut yedin kodamehon yat benatehon nissav lana linshin veyat benatana nitten lehon:
Ach-bezot yeotu lanu haanashim lashevet ittanu lihyot leam echad behimmol lanu kol-zachar kaasher hem nimmolim
Beram beda yittafsun lana guverayya lemittav immana lemehave leamma chad lemigzar lana kol dechura kema di innun gezirin:
Miknehem vekinyanam vechol-behemtam halo lanu hem ach neota lahem veyeshvu ittanu
Getehon vekinyanhon vechol beirhon hala dilana innun beram nitpes lehon vitivun immana:
Vayyishmeu el-chamor veel-shechem beno kol-yotze shaar iro vayyimmolu kol-zachar kol-yotze shaar iro
Vekabbilu min chamor umin shechem bereh kol nafke tera karteh ugezaru kol dechura kol nafke tera karteh:
Vayhi vayyom hashshelishi bihyotam koavim vayyikchu shene-vene-yaakov shimon velevi ache dina ish charbo vayyavou al-hair betach vayyahargu kol-zachar
Vahava veyoma telitaa kad tekifu alehon kevehon unesivu teren bene yaakov shimon velevi ache dina gevar charbeh veallu al karta deyatvun lerachatzan uketalu kol dechura:
Veet-chamor veet-shechem beno hargu lefi-charev vayyikchu et-dina mibbet shechem vayyetzeu
Veyat chamor veyat shechem bereh ketalu lefitgam decharev udevaru yat dina mibbet shechem unefaku:
Bene yaakov bau al-hachalalim vayyavozzu hair asher timmeu achotam
Bene yaakov alu lechallatza katilayya uvezo karta di saivu achathon:
Et-tzonam veet-bekaram veet-chamorehem veet asher-bair veet-asher bassade lakachu
Yat anhon veyat torhon veyat chamarehon veyat di vekarta veyat di vechakla bezo s" devaru:
Veet-kol-chelam veet-kol-tappam veet-neshehem shavu vayyavozzu veet kol-asher babbayit
Veyat kol nichsehon veyat kol taflehon veyat neshehon shevo uvezo veyat kol di veveta:
Vayyomer yaakov el-shimon veel-levi achartem oti lehavisheni beyoshev haaretz bakkenaani uvapperizzi vaani mete mispar veneesfu alay vehikkuni venishmadti ani uveti
Vaamar yaakov leshimon ulelevi achartun yati lemittan devavu benana uven yatve ara bichnaanaa uvapperizzaa vaana am deminyan veyitkanneshun alay veyimchinnuni veeshtetze ana veenash beti:
Vayyomru hachzona yaase et-achotenu
Vaamaru hachnafkat bara yitaved laachatana:
Vayyomer elohim el-yaakov kum ale vet-el veshev-sham vaase-sham mizbeach lael hannire elecha bevorchacha mippene esav achicha
Vaamar Adonai leyaakov kum sak levet el vetiv tamman veived tamman madbecha lelaha deitgeli lach bemeirkach min kodam esav achuch:
Vayyomer yaakov el-beto veel kol-asher immo hasiru et-elohe hannechar asher betochechem vehittaharu vehachalifu simlotechem
Vaamar yaakov leenash beteh ulechol di immeh adu yat taavat ammayya di venechon veiddakku veshannu kesutechon:
Venakuma venaale bet-el veeese-shsham mizbeach lael haone oti beyom tzarati vayhi immadi badderech asher halachti
Venekom venissak levet el veebed tamman madbecha lelaha dekabbel tzeloti beyoma deakti vahava memreh besadi beorcha di azalit:
Vayyittenu el-yaakov et kol-elohe hannechar asher beyadam veet-hannezamim asher beoznehem vayyitmon otam yaakov tachat haela asher im-shechem
Vihavu leyaakov yat kol taavat ammayya di videhon veyat kadashayya di veudenehon vetammar yathon yaakov techot batma di im shechem:
Vayyissau vayhi chittat elohim al-hearim asher sevivotehem velo radfu achare bene yaakov
Unetalu vahavat dachala daAdonai al ammayya di bekirve sacharanehon vela redafu batar bene yaakov:
Vayyavo yaakov luza asher beeretz kenaan hiv bet-el hu vechol-haam asher-immo
Vaata yaakov leluz di beara dichnaan hi bet el hu vechol amma di immeh:
Vayyiven sham mizbeach vayyikra lammakom el bet-el ki sham niglu elav haelohim bevorcho mippene achiv
Uvena tamman madbecha ukera leatra el bet el are tamman itgeli leh Adonai bemeirkeh min kodam achuhi:
Vattamot devora meneket rivka vattikkaver mittachat levet-el tachat haallon vayyikra shemo allon bachut
Umitat devora menikta derivka veitkevarat millera levet el beshippole meshra ukera shemeh meshar bachita:
Vayyera elohim el-yaakov od bevoo mippaddan aram vayvarech oto
Veitgeli Adonai leyaakov od bemetohi mippaddan aram uvarich yateh:
Vayyomer-lo elohim shimcha yaakov lo-yikkare shimcha od yaakov ki im-yisrael yihye shemecha vayyikra et-shemo yisrael
Vaamar leh Adonai shemach yaakov la yitkere shemach od yaakov ellahen yisrael yehe shemach ukera yat shemeh yisrael:
Vayyomer lo elohim ani el shadday pere ureve goy ukehal goyim yihye mimmekka umelachim mechalatzecha yetzeu
Vaamar leh Adonai ana el shadday push usege am vechinshat shivtin yehe minnach umalchin deshallitin beammayya minnach yippekun:
Veet-haaretz asher natatti leavraham uleyitzchak lecha ettenenna ulezaracha acharecha etten et-haaretz
Veyat ara di yehavit leavraham uleyitzchak lach ettenina velivnach batrach etten yat ara:
Vayyaal mealav elohim bammakom asher-dibber itto
Veistallak meillavohi yekara daAdonai beatra di mallil immeh:
Vayyatztzev yaakov matztzeva bammakom asher-dibber itto matztzevet aven vayyassech aleha nesech vayyitzok aleha shamen
Vaakem yaakov kamta beatra di mallil immeh kamat avna veassich ala nissuchin vaarik ala mishcha:
Vayyikra yaakov et-shem hammakom asher dibber itto sham elohim bet-el
Ukera yaakov yat shema deatra di mallil immeh tamman Adonai bet el:
Vayyisu mibbet el vayhi-od kivrat-haaretz lavo efrata vatteled rachel vattekash belidtah
Unetalu mibbet el vahava od keruvat ara lemeal leefrat vilidat rachel vekashshiat bemelda:
Vayhi vehakshotah belidtah vattomer lah hameyalledet al-tiri ki-gam-ze lach ben
Vahava bekashyuta bemelda vaameret la chayta la tidchali are af den lich bar:
Vayhi betzet nafshah ki meta vattikra shemo ben-oni veaviv kara-lo vinyamin
Vahava bemippak nafsha are mitat ukerat shemeh bar devay vaavuhi kera leh binyamin:
Vattamot rachel vattikkaver bederech efrata hiv bet lachem
Umitat rachel veitkevarat beorach efrat hi bet lachem:
Vayyatztzev yaakov matztzeva al-kevuratah hiv matztzevet kevurat-rachel ad-hayyom
Vaakem yaakov kamta al kevurta hi kamat kevurta derachel ad yoma den:
Vayyissa yisrael vayyet oholo mehala lemigdal-eder
Unetal yisrael uferas mashkeneh millehalla lemigdela deeder:
Vayhi bishkon yisrael baaretz hahiv vayyelech reuven vayyishkav et-bilha pilegesh aviv vayyishma yisrael vayyihyu vene-yaakov shenem asar
Vahava kad shera yisrael beara hahi vaazal reuven ushechiv im bilha lechenata daavuhi ushema yisrael vahavo vene yaakov tere asar:
Bene lea bechor yaakov reuven veshimon velevi vihuda veyissashchar uzevulun
Bene lea buchera deyaakov reuven veshimon velevi vihuda veyisashchar uzevulun:

Bene rachel yosef uvinyamin:

Uvene vilha amta derachel dan venaftali:
Uvene zilpa shifchat lea gad veasher elle bene yaakov asher yullad-lo befaddan aram
Uvene zilpa amta delea gad veasher illen bene yaakov di ityelidan leh befaddan aram:
Vayyavo yaakov el-yitzchak aviv mamre kiryat haarba hiv chevron asher-gar-sham avraham veyitzchak
Vaata yaakov levat yitzchak avuhi mamre kiryat arba hi chevron di dar tamman avraham veyitzchak:
Vayyihyu yeme yitzchak meat shana ushemonim shana
Vahavo yome yitzchak mea utemanan shenin:
Vayyigva yitzchak vayyamot vayyeasef el-ammav zaken useva yamim vayyikberu oto esav veyaakov banav
Veitnegid yitzchak umit veitkenish leammeh siv useva yomin ukevaru yateh esav veyaakov benohi:

Veillen tuledat esav hu edom:

Veyat basmat bat yishmael achateh dinvayot:

Vilidat ada leesav yat elifaz uvasmat yelidat yat reuel:

Veoholivama yelidat yat yeush veyat yalam veyat korach illen bene esav di ityelidu leh beara dichnaan:

Vahavo bene elifaz teman omar tzefo vegatam ukenaz:

Veillen bene tzivon veayya vaana hu ana di ashkach yat gibbarayya bemadbera kad hava rae yat chamarayya letzivon avuhi:

Veillen bene ana dishon veoholivama bat ana:
Veelle bene dishan chemdan veeshban veyitran ucheran
Veillen bene dishan chemdan veeshban veyitran ucheran:

Illen bene etzer bilhan vezaavan vaakan:
Elle vene-dishan utz vaaran
Illen bene dishan utz vaaran:
Elle allufe hachori alluf lotan alluf shoval alluf tzivon alluf ana
Illen ravreve choraa rabba lotan rabba shoval rabba tzivon rabba ana:
Alluf dishon alluf etzer alluf dishan elle allufe hachori leallufehem beeretz seir
Rabba dishon rabba etzer rabba dishan illen ravreve choraa leravrevanehon beara deseir:
Veelle hammelachim asher malchu beeretz edom lifne meloch-melech livne yisrael
Veillen malchayya di melichu beara deedom kodam di melach malka livne yisrael:
Vayyimloch beedom bela ben-beor veshem iro dinhava
Umelach beedom bela bar beor veshum karteh dinhava:
Vayyamot bala vayyimloch tachtav yovav ben-zerach mibbotzra
Umit bala umelach techotohi yovav bar zerach mibbatzra:
Vayyamot yovav vayyimloch tachtav chusham meeretz hattemani
Umit yovav umelach techotohi chusham meara daroma:
Vayyamot chusham vayyimloch tachtav hadad ben-bedad hammakke et-midyan bisde moav veshem iro avit
Umit chusham umelach techotohi hadad bar bedad diktil yat midyanae bechakla demoav veshum karteh avit:
Vayyamot hadad vayyimloch tachtav samla mimmasreka
Umit hadad umelach techotohi samla mimmasreka:
Vayyamot samla vayyimloch tachtav shaul merchovot hannahar
Umit samla umelach techotohi shaul merchove deal perat:
Vayyamot shaul vayyimloch tachtav baal chanan ben-achbor
Umit shaul umelach techotohi baal chanan bar achbor:
Vayyamot baal chanan ben-achbor vayyimloch tachtav hadar veshem iro pau veshem ishto mehetavel bat-matred bat me zahav
Umit baal chanan bar achbor umelach techotohi hadar veshum karteh pau veshum itteteh mehetavel bat matred bat metzaref dahava:
Veelle shemot allufe esav lemishpechotam limkomotam bishmotam alluf timna alluf alva alluf yetet
Veillen shemahat ravreve esav lezarayathon leatrehon bishmahathon rabba timna rabba alva rabba yetet:
