Rabba oholivama rabba ela rabba finon:
Alluf kenaz alluf teman alluf mivtzar
Rabba kenaz rabba teman rabba mivtzar:
Alluf magdiel alluf iram elle allufe edom lemoshvotam beeretz achuzzatam hu esav avi edom
Rabba magdiel rabba iram illen ravreve edom lemotvanhon beara achasantehon hu esav avuhon deedomae:
Vayyeshev yaakov beeretz megure aviv beeretz kenaan
Vitev yaakov beara totavut avuhi beara dichnaan:
Elle toldot yaakov yosef ben-sheva-esre shana haya roe et-echav batztzon vehu naar et-bene vilha veet-bene zilpa neshe aviv vayyave yosef et-dibbatam raa el-avihem
Illen tuledat yaakov yosef bar sheva asre shenin kad hava rae im achohi baana vehu merabbe im bene vilha veim bene zilpa neshe avuhi veayti yosef yat dibbehon bisha levat avuhon:
Veyisrael ahav et-yosef mikkol-banav ki-ven-zekunim hu lo veasa lo ketonet passim
Veyisrael rechem yat yosef mikkol benohi are var chakkim hu leh vaavad leh kittuna defasse:
Vayyiru echav ki-oto ahav avihem mikkol-echav vayyisneu oto velo yachlu dabbero leshalom
Vachazo achohi are yateh rechem avuhon mikkol achohi useno yateh vela tzavan lemallala immeh lishlam:
Vayyachalom yosef chalom vayyagged leechav vayyosifu od seno oto
Vachalam yosef chelma vechavvi laachohi veosifu od seno yateh:
Vayyomer alehem shimu-na hachalom hazze asher chalamti
Vaamar lehon shemau chean chelma haden di chalemit:
Vehinne anachnu meallemim alummim betoch hassade vehinne kama alummati vegam-nitztzava vehinne tesubbena alummotechem vattishtachavena laalummati
Veha anachna measserin esaran bego chakla veha kamat esarti veaf izdekafat veha mistacharan esaratchon vesagdan leesarti:
Vayyomru lo echav hamaloch timloch alenu im-mashol timshol banu vayyosifu od seno oto al-chalomotav veal-devarav
Vaamaru leh achohi hamalchu at medamme lemimlach alana o shuletan at sevir lemishlat bana veosifu od seno yateh al chelmohi veal pitgamohi:
Vayyachalom od chalom acher vaysapper oto leechav vayyomer hinne chalamti chalom od vehinne hashshemesh vehayyareach veachad asar kochavim mishtachavim li
Vachalam od chelma acharana veishtae yateh laachohi vaamar ha chalemit chelma od veha shimsha vesihara vechad asar kochvayya sagdan li:
Vaysapper el-aviv veel-echav vayyigar-bo aviv vayyomer lo ma hachalom hazze asher chalamta havo navo ani veimmecha veachecha lehishtachavot lecha artza
Veishtae laavuhi velaachohi unezaf beh avuhi vaamar leh ma chelma haden di chalemta hameta nete ana veimmach veachaych lemisgud lach al ara:
Vaykanu-vo echav veaviv shamar et-haddavar
Vekanniu veh achohi vaavuhi netar yat pitgama:
Vayyelchu echav lirot et-tzon avihem bishchem
Vaazalu achohi lemire yat ana daavuhon bishchem:
Vayyomer yisrael el-yosef halo achecha roim bishchem lecha veeshlachacha alehem vayyomer lo hinneni
Vaamar yisrael leyosef hala achaych raan bishchem eta veeshlechinnach levathon vaamar leh ha ana:
Vayyomer lo lech-na ree et-shelom achecha veet-shelom hatztzon vahashiveni davar vayyishlachehu meemek chevron vayyavo shechema
Vaamar leh izel kean chaze yat shelama deachuch veyat shelama deana vaatevni pitgama veshalcheh mimmeshar chevron vaata lishchem:
Vayyimtzaehu ish vehinne toe bassade vayyishalehu haish lemor ma-ttevakkesh
Veashkecheh gavra veha tae bechakla ushealinneh gavra lememar ma at bae:
Vayyomer et-achay anochi mevakkesh haggida-nna li efo hem roim
Vaamar yat achay ana vae chavvi chean li hecha innun raan:
Vayyomer haish nasu mizze ki shamati omrim nelcha dotayna vayyelech yosef achar echav vayyimtzaem bedotan
Vaamar gavra netalu mikka are shemait deamrin nezel ledotan vaazal yosef batar achohi veashkechinnun bedotan:
Vayyiru oto merachok uveterem yikrav alehem vayyitnakkelu oto lahamito
Vachazo yateh merachik ad la kerev levathon vechashshivu alohi lemikteleh:
Vayyomru ish el-achiv hinne baal hachalomot hallaze ba
Vaamaru gevar laachuhi ha mare chelmayya dechi ata:
Veatta lechu venahargehu venashlichehu beachad habborot veamarnu chayya raa achalathu venire ma-yyihyu chalomotav
Uchean eto veniktelinneh venirminneh bachada min gubbayya venemar chayta vishta achalteh venecheze ma yehon besof chelmohi:
Vayyishma reuven vayyatztzilehu miyyadam vayyomer lo nakkennu nafesh
Ushema reuven veshezveh midehon vaamar la niktelinneh nefash:
Vayyomer alehem reuven al-tishpechu-dam hashlichu oto el-habbor hazze asher bammidbar veyad al-tishlechu-vo lemaan hatztzil oto miyyadam lahashivo el-aviv
Vaamar lehon reuven la toshdun dema remo yateh legubba haden di bemadbera vida la toshtun beh bedil leshezava yateh midehon laatavuteh levat avuhi:
Vayhi kaasher-ba yosef el-echav vayyafshitu et-yosef et-kuttonto et-ketonet happassim asher alav
Vahava kad al yosef levat achuhi veashlachu yat yosef yat kittuneh yat kittuna defasse di alohi:
Vayyikkachuhu vayyashlichu oto habbora vehabbor rek en bo mayim
Venasvuhi uremo yateh legubba vegubba reka let beh mayya:
Vayyeshvu leechol-lechem vayyisu enehem vayyiru vehinne orchat yishmeelim baa miggilad ugemallehem nosim nechot utzeri valot holchim lehorid mitzrayma
Veascharu lemechal lachma uzekafu enehon vachazo veha sheyarat aravae atya miggilad vegamlehon teinin sheaf uketaf uletom azlin laachata lemitzrayim:
Vayyomer yehuda el-echav ma-bbetza ki naharog et-achinu vechissinu et-damo
Vaamar yehuda laachohi ma mamon nithane lana are niktol yat achuna unechasse al demeh:
Lechu venimkerennu layyishmeelim veyadenu al-tehi-vo ki-achinu vesarenu hu vayyishmeu echav
Etu unezabbeninneh laaravae vidana la tehe veh are achuna visrana hu vekabbilu minneh achohi:
Vayyaavru anashim midyanim socharim vayyimshechu vayyaalu et-yosef min-habbor vayyimkeru et-yosef layyishmeelim beesrim kasef vayyaviu et-yosef mitzrayma
Vaavaru gavre midyanae taggare unegidu veassiku yat yosef min gubba vezabbinu yat yosef laaravae beesrin kesaf veaytiyu yat yosef lemitzrayim:
Vayyashov reuven el-habbor vehinne en-yosef babbor vayyikra et-begadav
Vetav reuven legubba veha let yosef begubba uveza yat levushohi:
Vayyashov el-echav vayyomar hayyeled enennu vaani ana ani-va
Vetav levat achohi vaamar ulema letohi vaana lean ana ate:
Vayyikchu et-ketonet yosef vayyishchatu seir izzim vayyitbelu et-hakkuttonet baddam
Unesivu yat kittuna deyosef unechisu tzefir bar izze utevalu yat kittuna bidma:
Vayshallechu et-ketonet happassim vayyaviu el-avihem vayyomru zot matzanu hakker-na hakketonet bincha hiv im-lo
Veshallachu yat kittuna defasse veaytiyu levat avuhon vaamaru da ashkachna ishtemoda kean hachittuna divrach hi im la:
Vayyakkirah vayyomer ketonet beni chayya raa achalathu tarof toraf yosef
Veishtemoda vaamar kittuna divri chayta vishta achalatteh miktal ketil yosef:
Vayyikra yaakov simlotav vayyasem sak bemotnav vayyitabbel al-beno yamim rabbim
Uveza yaakov levushohi vaasar sakka bechartzeh veitabbal al bereh yomin saggiin:
Vayyakumu chol-banav vechol-benotav lenachamo vaymaen lehitnachem vayyomer ki-ered el-beni avel sheola vayyevk oto aviv
Vekamu chol benohi vechol benateh lenachamuteh vesarev lekabbala tanchumin vaamar are echot levat al beri kad avela lishol uvecha yateh avuhi:
Vehammedanim machru oto el-mitzrayim lefotifar seris paro sar hattabbachim
Umidyanae zabbinu yateh lemitzrayim lefotifar rabba defaro rav katolayya:
Vayhi baet hahiv vayyered yehuda meet echav vayyet ad-ish adullami ushemo chira
Vahava beiddana hahi unechat yehuda millevat achohi useta ad gavra adullamaa ushemeh chira:
Vayyar-sham yehuda bat-ish kenaani ushemo shua vayyikkacheha vayyavo eleha
Vachaza tamman yehuda bat gevar taggara ushemeh shua venasva veal levata:
Vattahar vatteled ben vayyikra et-shemo er
Veaddiat vilidat bar ukera yat shemeh er:
Vattahar od vatteled ben vattikra et-shemo onan
Veaddiat od vilidat bar ukerat yat shemeh onan:
Vattosef od vatteled ben vattikra et-shemo shela vehaya vichziv belidtah oto
Veosifat od vilidat bar ukerat yat shemeh shela vahava vichziv kad yelidat yateh:
Vayyikkach yehuda ishsha leer bechoro ushemah tamar
Unesiv yehuda itteta leer buchereh ushema tamar:
Vayhi er bechor yehuda ra beene Adonai vaymitehu Adonai
Vahava er buchera dihuda bish kodam Adonai vaamiteh Adonai:
Vayyomer yehuda leonan bo el-eshet achicha veyabbem otah vehakem zera leachicha
Vaamar yehuda leonan ul levat ittat achuch veyabbem yata vaakem zara leachuch:
Vayyeda onan ki lo lo yihye hazzara vehaya im-ba el-eshet achiv veshichet artza levilti neton-zera leachiv
Vida onan are la al shemeh mitkere zara vahava kad alil levat ittat achuhi umechabbel orcheh al ara bedil dela lekayyama zara laachuhi:
Vayyera beene Adonai asher asa vayyamet gam-oto
Uveesh kodam Adonai di avad vaamit af yateh:
Vayyomer yehuda letamar kallato shevi almana vet-avich ad-yigdal shela veni ki amar pen-yamut gam-hu keechav vattelech tamar vatteshev bet aviha
Vaamar yehuda letamar kalleteh tivi armela vet avich ad dirva shela veri are amar dilma yemut af hu keachohi vaazalat tamar vitivat bet avuha:
Vayyirbu hayyamim vattamot bat-shua eshet-yehuda vayyinnachem yehuda vayyaal al-gozeze tzono hu vechira reehu haadullami timnata
Usegiu yomayya umitat bat shua ittat yehuda veitnachem yehuda uselik al gozeze aneh hu vechira rachameh adullamaa letimnat:
Vayyuggad letamar lemor hinne chamich ole timnata lagoz tzono
Veitchavva letamar lememar ha chamuyich salek letimnat lemegaz aneh:
Vattasar bigde almenutah mealeha vattechas batztzaif vattitallaf vatteshev befetach enayim asher al-derech timnata ki raata ki-gadal shela vehiv lo-nittena lo leishsha
Veadiat levushe armeluta minna veitkassiat beefa veittakkanat vitivat befarashut aynin di al orach timnat are chazat are reva shela vehi la ityehivat leh leintu:
Vayyireha yehuda vayyachsheveha lezona ki chisseta paneha
Vachazaa yehuda vechashsheva kenafkat bara are chassiat appaha:
Vayyet eleha el-hadderech vayyomer hava-nna avo elayich ki lo yada ki challato hiv vattomer ma-ttitten-li ki tavo elay
Useta levata leorcha vaamar havi chean eol levatich are la yeda are challeteh hi vaameret ma titten li are teol levati:
Vayyomer anochi ashallach gedi-izzim min-hatztzon vattomer im-titten eravon ad sholchecha
Vaamar ana ashallach gadya var izze min ana vaameret im titten mashkona ad detishlach:
Vayyomer ma haeravon asher etten-lach vattomer chotamcha ufetilecha umattecha asher beyadecha vayyitten-lah vayyavo eleha vattahar lo
Vaamar ma mashkona di etten lach vaameret izketach veshoshippach vechuterach di vidach vihav la veal levata veaddiat leh:
Vattakom vattelech vattasar tzeifah mealeha vattilbash bigde almenutah
Vekamat vaazalat veadiat efa minna uleveshat levushe armeluta:
Vayyishlach yehuda et-gedi haizzim beyad reehu haadullami lakachat haeravon miyyad haishsha velo metzaah
Veshaddar yehuda yat gadya var izze bida rachameh adullamaa lemissav mashkona mida deitteta vela ashkecha:
Vayyishal et-anshe mekomah lemor ayye hakkedesha hiv vaenayim al-haddarech vayyomru lo-hayta vaze kedesha
Usheil yat anashe atra lememar an mekaddishta hi veaynin al orcha vaamaru let hacha mekaddishta:
Vayyashov el-yehuda vayyomer lo metzatiha vegam anshe hammakom amru lo-hayta vaze kedesha
Vetav levat yehuda vaamar la ashkechita veaf anashe atra amaru let hacha mekaddishta:
Vayyomer yehuda tikkach-lah pen nihye lavuz hinne shalachti haggedi hazze veatta lo metzatah
Vaamar yehuda tissav la dilma nehe lechoch ha shaddarit gadya haden veat la ashkechitta:
Vayhi kemishlosh chodashim vayyuggad lihuda lemor zanta tamar kallatecha vegam hinne hara liznunim vayyomer yehuda hotziuha vetissaref
Vahava kitlatut yarchayya veitchavva lihuda lememar zanniat tamar kalletach veaf ha madeya liznuta vaamar yehuda appekuha vetittokad:
Hiv mutzet vehi shalcha el-chamiha lemor leish asher-elle lo anochi hara vattomer hakker-na lemi hachotemet vehappetilim vehammatte haelle
Hi mittappeka vehi shelachat lachamuha lememar ligvar di illen dileh minneh ana madeya vaameret ishtemoda kean leman izketa veshoshippa vechutera haillen:
Vayyakker yehuda vayyomer tzadka mimmenni ki-al-ken lo-netattiha leshela veni velo-yasaf od ledatah
Veishtemoda yehuda vaamar zakkaa minni madeya are al ken la yehavitta leshela veri vela osif od lemida:
Vayhi beet lidtah vehinne teomim bevitnah
Vahava beiddan demelda veha teyomin bimaha:
Vayhi velidtah vayyitten-yad vattikkach hameyalledet vattikshor al-yado shani lemor ze yatza rishona
Vahava bemelda vihav yeda unesivat chayta uketarat al yedeh zehorita lememar den nefak kadmaa:
Vayhi kemeshiv yado vehinne yatza achiv vattomer ma-pparatzta alecha paretz vayyikra shemo paretz
Vahava kad atev yedeh veha nefak achuhi vaameret ma tekof saggi alach lemitkaf ukera shemeh paretz:
Veachar yatza achiv asher al-yado hashshani vayyikra shemo zarach
Uvatar ken nefak achuhi di al yedeh zehorita ukera shemeh zarach:
Veyosef hurad mitzrayma vayyiknehu potifar seris paro sar hattabbachim ish mitzri miyyad hayyishmeelim asher horiduhu shamma
Veyosef ittachat lemitzrayim uzevaneh potifar rabba defaro rav katolayya gevar mitzraa mida daaravae di achitohi letamman:
Vayhi Adonai et-yosef vayhi ish matzliach vayhi bevet adonav hammitzri
Vahava memra daAdonai besadeh deyosef vahava gevar matzlach vahava bevet ribboneh mitzraa:
Vayyar adonav ki Adonai itto vechol asher-hu ose Adonai matzliach beyado
Vachaza ribboneh are memra daAdonai besadeh vechol di hu aved Adonai matzlach bideh:
Vayyimtza yosef chen beenav vaysharet oto vayyafkidehu al-beto vechol-yesh-lo natan beyado
Veashkach yosef rachamin beenohi veshammesh yateh umanye al beteh vechol di it leh mesar bideh:
Vayhi meaz hifkid oto beveto veal kol-asher yesh-lo vayvarech Adonai et-bet hammitzri biglal yosef vayhi birkat Adonai bechol-asher yesh-lo babbayit uvassade
Vahava meiddan demanne yateh beveteh veal kol di it leh uvarich Adonai yat bet mitzraa bedil yosef vahava birketa daAdonai bechol di it leh beveta uvechakla:
Vayyaazov kol-asher-lo beyad-yosef velo-yada itto meuma ki im-hallechem asher-hu ochel vayhi yosef yefe-toar vife mare
Ushevak kol di leh bida deyosef vela yeda immeh middaam ellahen lachma di hu achel vahava yosef shappir bereva veyae vechezva:
Vayhi achar haddevarim haelle vattissa eshet-adonav et-eneha el-yosef vattomer shichva immi
Vahava batar pitgamayya haillen uzekafat ittat ribboneh yat enaha leyosef vaameret shechuv immi:
Vaymaen vayyomer el-eshet adonav hen adoni lo-yada itti ma-bbabbayit vechol asher-yesh-lo natan beyadi
Vesarev vaamar levat ittat ribboneh ha ribboni la yeda immi ma divveta vechol di it leh mesar bidi:
Enennu gadol babbayit hazze mimmenni velo-chasach mimmenni meuma ki im-otach baasher at-ishto veech eese haraa haggedola hazzot vechatati lelohim
Letohi rav beveta haden minni vela mena minni middaam ellahen yatich bedil at itteteh veechden ebed bishta rabbeta hada veechov kodam Adonai:
Vayhi kedabberah el-yosef yom yom velo-shama eleha lishkav etzlah lihyot immah
Vahava kad mallelat im yosef yom yom vela kabbil minna lemishkav levata lemeheve imma:
Vayhi kehayyom hazze vayyavo habbayta laasot melachto veen ish meanshe habbayit sham babbayit
Vahava beyoma haden veal leveta lemivdak bechitve chashbeneh velet enash meanashe veta tamman beveta:
Vattitpesehu bevigdo lemor shichva immi vayyaazov bigdo beyadah vayyanos vayyetze hachutza
Vaachidteh bilvusheh lememar shechuv immi veshavkeh lilvusheh bida vaarak unefak leshuka:
Vayhi kirotah ki-azav bigdo beyadah vayyanos hachutza
Vahava kad chazat are shavkeh lilvusheh bida vaarak leshuka:
Vattikra leanshe vetah vattomer lahem lemor reu hevi lanu ish ivri letzachek banu ba elay lishkav immi vaekra bekol gadol
Ukerat laanashe veta vaameret lehon lememar chazo ayti lana gavra ivraa lechayyacha vana al levati lemishkav immi ukeret bekala rabba:
Vayhi cheshomo ki-harimoti koli vaekra vayyaazov bigdo etzli vayyanos vayyetze hachutza
Vahava chad shema are aremit kali ukeret veshavkeh lilvusheh levati vaarak unefak leshuka:
Vattannach bigdo etzlah ad-bo adonav el-beto
Vaachitteteh lilvusheh levata ad deal ribboneh leveteh:
Vattedabber elav kaddevarim haelle lemor ba-elay haeved haivri asher-heveta lanu letzachek bi
Umallelat immeh kefitgamayya haillen lememar al levati avda ivraa di ayteta lana lechayyacha vi:
Vayhi kaharimi koli vaekra vayyaazov bigdo etzli vayyanos hachutza
Vahava kad aremit kali ukeret veshavkeh lilvusheh levati vaarak leshuka:
Vayhi chishmoa adonav et-divre ishto asher dibbera elav lemor kaddevarim haelle asa li avdecha vayyichar appo
Vahava chad shema ribboneh yat pitgame itteteh di mallelat immeh lememar kefitgamayya haillen avad li avdach utekef rogzeh:
Vayyikkach adone yosef oto vayyittenehu el-bet hassohar mekom asher-asire hammelech asurim vayhi-sham bevet hassohar
Unesiv ribboneh deyosef yateh umanneye levet asire atar di asire malka asirin vahava tamman bevet asire:
Vayhi Adonai et-yosef vayyet elav chased vayyitten chinno beene sar bet-hassohar
Vahava memra daAdonai besadeh deyosef unegad leh chisda vihaveh lerachamin beene rav bet asire:
Vayyitten sar bet-hassohar beyad-yosef et kol-haasirim asher bevet hassohar veet kol-asher osim sham hu haya ose
Umanne rav bet asire bida deyosef yat kol asirayya di bevet asire veyat kol di avdin tamman al memreh hava mitaved:
En sar bet-hassohar roe et-kol-meuma beyado baasher Adonai itto vaasher-hu ose Adonai matzliach
Let rav bet asire chaze yat kol sarchan bideh bedi memra daAdonai besadeh vedi hu aved Adonai matzlach:
Vayhi achar haddevarim haelle chatu mashke melech-mitzrayim vehaofe laadonehem lemelech mitzrayim
Vahava batar pitgamayya haillen serachu shakya malka demitzrayim venachtoma leribbonehon lemalka demitzrayim:
Vayyiktzof paro al shene sarisav al sar hammashkim veal sar haofim
Uregez paro al teren ravrevanohi al rav shake veal rav nachtome:
Vayyitten otam bemishmar bet sar hattabbachim el-bet hassohar mekom asher yosef asur sham
Vihav yathon bemattera bet rav katolayya levet asire atar di yosef asir tamman:
Vayyifkod sar hattabbachim et-yosef ittam vaysharet otam vayyihyu yamim bemishmar
Umanni rav katolayya yat yosef immehon veshammesh yathon vahavo yomin bemattera:
Vayyachalmu chalom shenehem ish chalomo belayla echad ish kefitron chalomo hammashke vehaofe asher lemelech mitzrayim asher asurim bevet hassohar
Vachalamu chelma tarvehon gevar chelmeh belelya chad gevar kefusheran chelmeh shakya venachtoma di lemalka demitzrayim di asirin bevet asire:
Vayyavo alehem yosef babboker vayyar otam vehinnam zoafim
Vaata levathon yosef betzafra vachaza yathon veha innun nesisin:
Vayyishal et-serise faro asher itto vemishmar bet adonav lemor maddua penechem raim hayyom
Usheel yat ravreve faro di immeh bemattera bet ribboneh lememar ma den appechon bishin yoma den:
Vayyomru elav chalom chalamnu ufoter en oto vayyomer alehem yosef halo lelohim pitronim sapperu-na li
Vaamaru leh chelma chalemna ufashar let leh vaamar lehon yosef hala min kodam Adonai pusheran chelmayya ishtau chean li:
Vaysapper sar-hammashkim et-chalomo leyosef vayyomer lo bachalomi vehinne-gefen lefanay
Veishtai rav shake yat chelmeh leyosef vaamar leh bechelmi veha gufena kodamay:
Uvaggefen shelosha sarigim vehiv cheforachat alta nitztzah hivshilu ashkeloteha anavim
Uvegufena telata shivshin vehi chad afrachat appekat lavlevin vaanitzat netz bashshilu itkelataha innevin:
Vechos paro beyadi vaekkach et-haanavim vaeschat otam el-kos paro vaetten et-hakkos al-kaf paro
Vechassa defaro bidi unesevit yat innevayya veatztzarit yathon lechassa defaro vihavit yat kassa al yeda defaro:
Vayyomer lo yosef ze pitrono sheloshet hassarigim sheloshet yamim hem
Vaamar leh yosef den pishraneh telata shivshin telata yomin innun:
Beod sheloshet yamim yissa faro et-roshecha vahashivcha al-kannecha venatatta chos-paro beyado kammishpat harishon asher hayita mashkehu
Besof telata yomin yadberinnach paro yat reshach vitevinnach al shimmushach vetitten kassa defaro bideh kehilcheta kadmaa di haveta mashke leh:
Ki im-zechartani ittecha kaasher yitav lach veasita-nna immadi chased vehizkartani el-paro vehotzetani min-habbayit hazze
Ellahen tidkerinnani immach kad yetav lach vetabed kean immi tivu vetidkar alay kodam paro vetappekinnani min bet asira haden:
Ki-gunnov gunnavti meeretz haivrim vegam-po lo-asiti meuma ki-samu oti babbor
Are mignav genevna meara deivrae veaf hacha la avadit middaam are shavviu yati bevet asire:
Vayyar sar-haofim ki tov patar vayyomer el-yosef af-ani bachalomi vehinne shelosha salle chori al-roshi
Vachaza rav nachtome are yaut pashar vaamar leyosef af ana bechelmi veha telata sallin dechiru al reshi:
Uvassal haelyon mikkol maachal paro maase ofe vehaof ochel otam min-hassal meal roshi
Uvesalla illaa mikkol mechal paro ovad nachtom veofa achel yathon min salla meillave reshi:
Vayyaan yosef vayyomer ze pitrono sheloshet hassallim sheloshet yamim hem
Vaatev yosef vaamar den pishraneh telata sallin telata yomin innun:
Beod sheloshet yamim yissa faro et-roshcha mealecha vetala otcha al-etz veachal haof et-besarcha mealecha
Besof telata yomin yadi faro yat reshach minnach veyitzlov yatach al tzeliva veyechul ofa yat bisrach minnach:
Vayhi bayyom hashshelishi yom hulledet et-paro vayyaas mishte lechol-avadav vayyissa et-rosh sar hammashkim veet-rosh sar haofim betoch avadav
Vahava beyoma telitaa yoma bet valda defaro vaavad mishteya lechol avdohi veidkar yat resh rav shake veyat resh rav nachtome bego avdohi:
Vayyashev et-sar hammashkim al-mashkehu vayyitten hakkos al-kaf paro
Vaatev yat rav shake al shakyuteh vihav yat kassa al yeda defaro:
Veet sar haofim tala kaasher patar lahem yosef
Veyat rav nachtome tzelav kema di fashar lehon yosef:
Velo-zachar sar-hammashkim et-yosef vayyishkachehu
Vela dechir rav shake yat yosef veansheye:
Vayhi mikketz shenatayim yamim ufaro cholem vehinne omed al-hayeor
Vahava missof tarten shenin ufaro chalem veha kaem al nahara:
Vehinne min-hayeor olot sheva parot yefot mare uveriot basar vattirena baachu
Veha min nahara salkan sheva toran shappiran lemecheze ufattiman besar verayan beachava:
Vehinne sheva parot acherot olot acharehen min-hayeor raot mare vedakkot basar vattaamodna etzel happarot al-sefat hayeor
Veha sheva toran ochoranyan salkan batrehon min nahara bishan lemecheze vachasiran besar vekaman lekivlehon detoran al kef nahara:
Vattochalna happarot raot hammare vedakkot habbasar et sheva happarot yefot hammare vehabberiot vayyikatz paro
Vaachalan torta bishan lemecheze vachasiran besar yat sheva torta shappiran lemecheze ufattimata veittear paro:
Vayyishan vayyachalom shenit vehinne sheva shibbolim olot bekane echad beriot vetovot
Udemuch vachalam tinyanut veha sheva shubbelayya salkan bekanya chad pattiman vetavan:
Vehinne sheva shibbolim dakkot ushedufot kadim tzomchot acharehen
Veha sheva shubbelayya lakyan ushekifan kiddum tzamchan batrehon:
Vattivlana hashshibbolim haddakkot et sheva hashshibbolim habberiot vehammeleot vayyikatz paro vehinne chalom
Uvelaa shubbelayya lakyata yat sheva shubbelayya pattimata umalyata veittear paro veha chelma:
Vayhi vabboker vattippaem rucho vayyishlach vayyikra et-kol-chartumme mitzrayim veet-kol-chachameha vaysapper paro lahem et-chalomo veen-poter otam lefaro
Vahava vetzafra umittarpa rucheh ushelach ukera yat kol charashe mitzrayim veyat kol chakkimaha veishtai faro lehon yat chelmeh velet defashar yathon lefaro:
Vaydabber sar hammashkim et-paro lemor et-chataay ani mazkir hayyom
Umallil rav shake im lefaro lememar yat sarchani ana madkar yoma den:
Paro katzaf al-avadav vayyitten oti bemishmar bet sar hattabbachim oti veet sar haofim
Paro regez al avdohi vihav yati bematterat bet rav katolayya yati veyat rav nachtome:
Vannachalma chalom belayla echad ani vahu ish kefitron chalomo chalamnu
Vachalemna chelma belelya chad ana vahu gevar kefishran chelmeh chalemna:
Vesham ittanu naar ivri eved lesar hattabbachim vannesapper-lo vayyiftor-lanu et-chalomotenu ish kachalomo patar
Vetamman immana ulem ivraa avda lerav katolayya veishtaena leh ufashar lana yat chelmana gevar kechelmeh pashar:
Vayhi kaasher patar-lanu ken haya oti heshiv al-kanni veoto tala
Vahava kema di pashar lana ken hava yati atev al shimmushi veyateh tzelav:
Vayyishlach paro vayyikra et-yosef vayritzuhu min-habbor vaygallach vaychallef simlotav vayyavo el-paro
Ushelach paro ukera yat yosef vearhitohi min bet asire vesappar veshanni chesuteh veal levat paro:
Vayyomer paro el-yosef chalom chalamti ufoter en oto vaani shamati alecha lemor tishma chalom liftor oto
Vaamar paro leyosef chelma chalemit ufashar let leh vaana shimet alach lememar deat shama chelma lemifshar yateh:
Vayyaan yosef et-paro lemor biladay elohim yaane et-shelom paro
Vaatev yosef yat paro lememar bar min chochmeti ellahen min kodam Adonai yitttav yat shelama defaro:
Vaydabber paro el-yosef bachalomi hinni omed al-sefat hayeor
Umallil paro im leyosef bechelmi ha ana kaem al kef nahara:
Vehinne min-hayeor olot sheva parot beriot basar vifot toar vattirena baachu
Veha min nahara salkan sheva torta pattiman besar veshappiran lemecheze verayan beachava:
Vehinne sheva-parot acherot olot acharehen dallot veraot toar meod verakkot basar lo-raiti chahenna bechol-eretz mitzrayim laroa
Veha sheva torta ochoranyan salkan batrehon chasichan uvishan lemecheze lachada vachasiran besar la chazeti chevathen bechol ara demitzrayim levishu:
Vattochalna happarot harakkot veharaot et sheva happarot harishonot habberiot
Vaachalan torta chasichata uvishata yat sheva torta kadmayata pattimata:
Vattavona el-kirbena velo noda ki-vau el-kirbena umarehen ra kaasher battechilla vaikatz
Vaala limehen vela ityeda are allu limehen umechezehen bish kad bekadmeta veittearit:
Vaere bachalomi vehinne sheva shibbolim olot bekane echad meleot vetovot
Vachazet bechelmi veha sheva shubbelayya salkan bekanya chad malyan vetavan:
Vehinne sheva shibbolim tzenumot dakkot shedufot kadim tzomchot acharehem
Veha sheva shubbelayya natzan lakyan shekifan kiddum tzamchan batrehon:
Vattivlana hashshibbolim haddakkot et sheva hashshibbolim hattovot vaomar el-hachartummim veen maggid li
Uvelaan shubbelayya lakyata yat sheva shubbelayya tavata vaamarit lacharashayya velet di mechavve li:
Vayyomer yosef el-paro chalom paro echad hu et asher haelohim ose higgid lefaro
Vaamar yosef lefaro chelma faro chad hu yat di Adonai atid lemebad chavvi lefaro:
Sheva parot hattovot sheva shanim henna vesheva hashshibbolim hattovot sheva shanim henna chalom echad hu
Sheva torta tavata sheva shenin innun usheva shubbelayya tavata sheva shenin innun chelma chad hu:
Vesheva happarot harakkot veharaot haolot acharehen sheva shanim henna vesheva hashshibbolim harekot shedufot hakkadim yihyu sheva shene raav
Usheva torta chasichata uvishata desalkan batrehon sheva shenin innun usheva shubbelayya lakyata dishkifan kiddum yehevyan sheva shene chafna:
Hu haddavar asher dibbarti el-paro asher haelohim ose hera et-paro
Hu fitgama di mallelit im paro di Adonai atid lemebad achaze lefaro:
Hinne sheva shanim baot sava gadol bechol-eretz mitzrayim
Ha sheva shenin atyan siva rabba bechol ara demitzrayim:
Vekamu sheva shene raav acharehen venishkach kol-hassava beeretz mitzrayim vechilla haraav et-haaretz
Vikumun sheva shene chafna batrehen veyittinshe kol siva beara demitzrayim vishetze chafna yat amma deara:
Velo-yivvada hassava baaretz mippene haraav hahu achare-chen ki-chaved hu meod
Vela yityeda sova beara min kadam kafna hahu dihe vatar ken are takif hu lachada:
Veal hishshanot hachalom el-paro paamayim ki-nachon haddavar meim haelohim umemaher haelohim laasoto
Veal deittannet chelma lefaro tarten zimnin are takken pitgama min kodam Adonai veochi Adonai lemebedeh:
Veatta yere faro ish navon vechacham vishitehu al-eretz mitzrayim
Uchean yecheze faro gevar sucheletan vechakkim umanneye al ara demitzrayim:
Yaase faro veyafked pekidim al-haaretz vechimmesh et-eretz mitzrayim besheva shene hassava
Yabed paro vimanne mehemnin al ara vizarez yat ara demitzrayim besheva shene sova :
Veyikbetzu et-kol-ochel hashshanim hattovot habbaot haelle veyitzberu-var tachat yad-paro ochel bearim veshamaru
Veyichneshun yat kol ivur shenayya tavan deatyan haillen veyitzberun ivura techot yeda defaro ivura bekirvayya veyitterun:
Vehaya haochel lefikkadon laaretz lesheva shene haraav asher tihyena beeretz mitzrayim velo-tikkaret haaretz baraav
Vihe ivura ganiz leamma d leara lishva shene chafna di tehevyan beara demitzrayim vela tishtetze amma deara bechafna:
Vayyitav haddavar beene faro uveene kol-avadav
Ushefar pitgama beene faro uveene kol avdohi:
Vayyomer paro el-avadav hanimtza chaze ish asher ruach elohim bo
Vaamar paro leavdohi hanishkach keden gevar di ruach nevua min kodam Adonai beh:
Vayyomer paro el-yosef achare hodia elohim otcha et-kol-zot en-navon vechacham kamocha
Vaamar paro leyosef batar deoda Adonai yatach yat kol da let sachletan vechakkim kevatach:
Atta tihye al-beti veal-picha yishshak kol-ammi rak hakkisse egdal mimmekka
At tehe memanna al beti veal memrach yittezan kol ammi lechod karse malchuta haden ehe yakkir minnach:
Vayyomer paro el-yosef ree natatti otcha al kol-eretz mitzrayim
Vaamar paro leyosef chaze manneti yatach al kol ara demitzrayim:
Vayyasar paro et-tabbato meal yado vayyitten otah al-yad yosef vayyalbesh oto bigde-shesh vayyasem revid hazzahav al-tzavvaro
Veadi faro yat izketeh meal yedeh vihav yata al yeda deyosef vealbish yateh levushin devutz veshavvi manicha dedahava al tzavvereh:
Vayyarkev oto bemirkevet hammishne asher-lo vayyikreu lefanav avrech venaton oto al kol-eretz mitzrayim
Vearkev yateh birtikka tinyeta di leh veachrizu kodamohi den abba lemalka umanni yateh al kol ara demitzrayim:
Vayyomer paro el-yosef ani faro uviladecha lo-yarim ish et-yado veet-raglo bechol-eretz mitzrayim
Vaamar paro leyosef ana faro uvar memrach la yerim gevar yat yedeh lemechad zen veyat ragleh lemirkav al suseya bechol ara demitzrayim:
Vayyikra faro shem-yosef tzafnat paneach vayyitten-lo et-asnat bat-poti fera kohen on leishsha vayyetze yosef al-eretz mitzrayim
Ukera faro shum yosef gavra demittamran golyan leh vihav leh yat asnat bat poti fera rabba deon leitteta unefak yosef shallit al ara demitzrayim:
Veyosef ben-sheloshim shana beomdo lifne paro melech-mitzrayim vayyetze yosef millifne faro vayyaavor bechol-eretz mitzrayim
Veyosef bar telatin shenin kad kam kodam paro malka demitzrayim unefak yosef min kodam paro vaavar shallit bechol ara demitzrayim:
Vattaas haaretz besheva shene hassava likmatzim
Uchenashu dayre ara bishva shene sova ivura leotzarin:
Vayyikbotz et-kol-ochel sheva shanim asher hayu beeretz mitzrayim vayyitten-ochel bearim ochel sede-hair asher sevivoteha natan betochah
Uchenash yat kol ivur sheva shenin di havo beara demitzrayim vihav ivur bekirvayya ivur chakal karta di vesachranaha yehav begavvah:
Vayyitzbor yosef bar kechol hayyam harbe meod ad ki-chadal lispor ki-en mispar
Uchenash yosef ivura kechalla deyamma saggi lachada ad di fesak lemimne are let minyan:
Uleyosef yullad shene vanim beterem tavo shenat haraav asher yalda-llo asnat bat-poti fera kohen on
Uleyosef ityelid tarten benin ad la allat shatta dechafna diylidat leh asnat bat poti fera rabba deon:
Vayyikra yosef et-shem habbechor menashshe ki-nashshani elohim et-kol-amali veet kol-bet avi
Ukera yosef yat shum buchera menashshe are ansheyani Adonai yat kol amli veyat kol bet abba:
Veet shem hashsheni kara efrayim ki-hifrani elohim beeretz onyi
Veyat shum tinyana kera efrayim are appeshani Adonai beara shibudi:
Vattichlena sheva shene hassava asher haya beeretz mitzrayim
Ushelimat sheva shene sova di hava beara demitzrayim:
Vattechillena sheva shene haraav lavo kaasher amar yosef vayhi raav bechol-haaratzot uvechol-eretz mitzrayim haya lachem
Usheriat sheva shene chafna lemeal kema di amar yosef vahava chafna bechol arata uvechol ara demitzrayim hava lachma:
Vattirav kol-eretz mitzrayim vayyitzak haam el-paro lallachem vayyomer paro lechol-mitzrayim lechu el-yosef asher-yomar lachem taasu
Uchefanat kol ara demitzrayim utzevach amma kodam lefaro al lelachma vaamar paro lechol mitzrae izilu levat yosef di yemar lechon tabedun:
Veharaav haya al kol-pene haaretz vayyiftach yosef et-kol-asher bahem vayyishbor lemitzrayim vayyechezak haraav beeretz mitzrayim
Vechafna hava al kol appe ara ufetach yosef yat kol otzrayya di vehon ivura vezabbin lemitzrayim utekef kafna beara demitzrayim:
Vechol-haaretz bau mitzrayma lishbor el-yosef ki-chazak haraav bechol-haaretz
Vechol dayre ara allu lemitzrayim lemizban ivura min yosef are tekef kafna bechol ara:
Vayyar yaakov ki yesh-shever bemitzrayim vayyomer yaakov levanav lamma titrau
Vachaza yaakov are it ivura mizdabban bemitzrayim vaamar yaakov livnohi lema titchazun:
Vayyomer hinne shamati ki yesh-shever bemitzrayim redu-shamma veshivru-lanu mishsham venichye velo namut
Vaamar ha shemait amrin are it ivura mizdabban bemitzrayim chutu tamman uzevunu lana mittamman veneche vela nemut:
Vayyerdu ache-yosef asara lishbor bar mimmitzrayim
Unechatu ache yosef asra lemizban ivura mimmitzrayim:
Veet-binyamin achi yosef lo-shalach yaakov et-echav ki amar pen-yikraennu ason
Veyat binyamin achuhi deyosef la shelach yaakov im achuhi are amar dilma yearinneh mota:
Vayyavou bene yisrael lishbor betoch habbaim ki-haya haraav beeretz kenaan
Vaato bene yisrael lemizban ivura bego alayya are hava chafna beara dichnaan:
Veyosef hu hashshallit al-haaretz hu hammashbir lechol-am haaretz vayyavou ache yosef vayyishtachavu-lo appayim artza
Veyosef hu deshallit al ara hu dezabbin ivura lechol amma deara vaato ache yosef usegidu leh al appayya al ara:
Vayyar yosef et-echav vayyakkirem vayyitnakker alehem vaydabber ittam kashot vayyomer alehem meayin batem vayyomru meeretz kenaan lishbor-ochel
Vachaza yosef yat achohi veishtemodinnun vechashshiv ma demallel lehon umallil immehon kashya vaamar lehon menan atetun vaamaru meara dichnaan lemizban ivura:
Vayyakker yosef et-echav vehem lo hikkiruhu
Veishtemoda yosef yat achohi veinnun la ishtemodeh:
Vayyizkor yosef et hachalomot asher chalam lahem vayyomer alehem meraggelim attem lirot et-ervat haaretz batem
Udechir yosef yat chelmayya di chalim lehon vaamar lehon meallin attun lemecheze yat bidka deara atetun:
Vayyomru elav lo adoni vaavadecha bau lishbor-ochel
Vaamaru leh la ribboni veavdaych allu lemizban ivura:
Kullanu bene ish-echad nachnu kenim anachnu lo-hayu avadecha meraggelim
Kullana bene gavra chad nachna kevane anachna la havo avdaych allile:
Vayyomer alehem lo ki-ervat haaretz batem lirot
Vaamar lehon la are vidka deara atetun lemecheze:
Vayyomru shenem asar avadecha achim anachnu bene ish-echad beeretz kenaan vehinne hakkaton et-avinu hayyom vehaechad enennu
Vaamaru teren asar avdaych achin anachna bene gavra chad beara dichnaan veha zeera im avuna yoma den vechad letohi:
Vayyomer alehem yosef hu asher dibbarti alechem lemor meraggelim attem
Vaamar lehon yosef hu di mallelit immechon lememar meallile attun:
Bezot tibbachenu che faro im-tetzu mizze ki im-bevo achichem hakkaton henna
Beda titbachanun che faro im tippekun mikka ellahen bemete achuchon zeera hacha:
Shilchu mikkem echad veyikkach et-achichem veattem heasru veyibbachanu divrechem haemet ittechem veim-lo che faro ki meraggelim attem
Shelachu minnechon chad vidabber yat achuchon veattun hitasserun veyitbachanun pitgamechon hakshot attun amrin veim la che faro are meallile attun:
Vayyeesof otam el-mishmar sheloshet yamim
Uchenash yathon levet lemattera telata yomin:
Vayyomer alehem yosef bayyom hashshelishi zot asu vichyu et-haelohim ani yare
Vaamar lehon yosef beyoma telitaa da ividu vekayyimu min kodam Adonai ana dachel:
Im-kenim attem achichem echad yeaser bevet mishmarchem veattem lechu haviu shever raavon battechem
Im kevane attun achuchon chad yitassar bevet mattartechon veattun izilu ovilu ivura dechassir bevattechon:
Veet-achichem hakkaton taviu elay veyeamnu divrechem velo tamutu vayyaasu-chen
Veyat achuchon zeera taytun levati vihemnun pitgamechon vela temutun vaavadu chen:
Vayyomru ish el-achiv aval ashemim anachnu al-achinu asher rainu tzarat nafsho behitchanno elenu velo shamanu al-ken baa elenu hatztzara hazzot
Vaamaru gevar laachuhi bekusheta chayyavin anachna al achuna di chazena akat nafsheh kad hava mitchannen lana vela kabbelna minneh al ken ata levatana akta hada:
Vayyaan reuven otam lemor halo amarti alechem lemor al-techetu vayyeled velo shematem vegam-damo hinne nidrash
Vaatev reuven yathon lememar hala amarit levatchon lememar la techovun beulema vela kabbeltun veaf demeh ha mitbee:
Vehem lo yadu ki shomea yosef ki hammelitz benotam
Veinnun la yadun are shemia yosef are meturgeman hava venehon:
Vayyissov mealehem vayyevk vayyashov alehem vaydabber alehem vayyikkach meittam et-shimon vayyeesor oto leenehem
Veistachar meillavehon uvecha vetav levathon umallel immehon udevar millevathon yat shimon vaasar yateh leenehon:
Vaytzav yosef vaymalu et-kelehem bar ulehashiv kaspehem ish el-sakko velatet lahem tzeda laddarech vayyaas lahem ken
Ufakkid yosef umelo yat manehon ivura velaatava chaspehon gevar lesakkeh ulemittan lehon zevadin leorcha vaavad lehon ken:
Vayyisu et-shivram al-chamorehem vayyelchu mishsham
Unetalu yat ivurehon al chamarehon vaazalu mittamman:
Vayyiftach haechad et-sakko latet mispo lachamoro bammalon vayyar et-kaspo vehinne-hu befi amtachto
Ufetach chad yat sakkeh lemittan kista lachamareh bevet mevata vachaza yat kaspeh veha hu befum toaneh:
Vayyomer el-echav hushav kaspi vegam hinne veamtachti vayyetze libbam vayyecherdu ish el-achiv lemor ma-zzot asa elohim lanu
Vaamar laachohi ittotav kaspi veaf ha vetoani unefak madda libbehon utevahu gevar laachuhi lememar ma da avad Adonai lana:
Vayyavou el-yaakov avihem artza kenaan vayyaggidu lo et kol-hakkorot otam lemor
Vaato levat yaakov avuhon ara dichnaan vechavviu leh yat kol diaraan yathon lememar:
Dibber haish adone haaretz ittanu kashot vayyitten otanu kimraggelim et-haaretz
Mallel gavra ribbona deara immana kashyan vihav yatana kimallile yat ara:
Vannomer elav kenim anachnu lo hayinu meraggelim
Vaamarna leh kevane anachna la havena meallile:
Shenem-asar anachnu achim bene avinu haechad enennu vehakkaton hayyom et-avinu beeretz kenaan
Teren asar anachna achin bene avuna chad letohi uzeera yoma den im avuna beara dichnaan:
Vayyomer elenu haish adone haaretz bezot eda ki chenim attem achichem haechad hannichu itti veet-raavon battechem kechu valechu
Vaamar lana gavra ribbona deara beda idda are chevane attun achuchon chad shevuku levati veyat ivura dechassir bevattechon sivu veezilu:
Vehaviu et-achichem hakkaton elay veeda ki lo meraggelim attem ki chenim attem et-achichem etten lachem veet-haaretz tischaru
Veaytiu yat achuchon zeera levati veidda are la meallile attun are chevane attun yat achuchon etten lechon veyat ara tabedun ba sechorta:
Vayhi hem merikim sakkehem vehinne-ish tzeror-kaspo besakko vayyiru et-tzerorot kaspehem hemma vaavihem vayyirau
Vahava innun merikin sakkehon veha gevar tzerir kaspeh besakkeh vachazo yat tzerare chaspehon innun vaavuhon udechilu:
Vayyomer alehem yaakov avihem oti shikkaltem yosef enennu veshimon enennu veet-binyamin tikkachu alay hayu chullana
Vaamar lehon yaakov avuhon yati atkeltun yosef letohi veshimon la hava hacha letohi veyat binyamin tidberun alay havo chalhon:
Vayyomer reuven el-aviv lemor et-shene vanay tamit im-lo aviennu elecha tena oto al-yadi vaani ashivennu elecha
Vaamar reuven levat avuhi lememar yat teren benay temit im la aytinneh levatach hav yateh al yedi vaana atevinneh lach:
Vayyomer lo-yered beni immachem ki-achiv met vehu levaddo nishar ukeraahu ason badderech asher telchu-vah vehoradtem et-sevati beyagon sheola
Vaamar la yechot beri immechon are achuhi mit vehu bilchodohi eshtaar viarinneh mota beorcha di tehachun ba vetachatun yat sivti bedavona lishol:
Veharaav kaved baaretz
Vechafna takkif beara:
Vayhi kaasher killu leechol et-hashshever asher heviu mimmitzrayim vayyomer alehem avihem shuvu shivru-lanu meat-ochel
Vahava kad sappiku shetziu y' rshy" lemechal yat ivura deaytiu mimmitzrayim vaamar lehon avuhon tuvu zevunu lana zeer ivura:
Vayyomer elav yehuda lemor haed heid banu haish lemor lo-tiru fanay bilti achichem ittechem
Vaamar leh yehuda lememar ashada ashed bana gavra lememar la techezun appay ellahen kad achuchon immechon:
Im-yeshcha meshalleach et-achinu ittanu nerda venishbera lecha ochel
Im itach meshallach yat achuna immana nechot venizben lach ivura:
Veim-encha meshalleach lo nered ki-haish amar elenu lo-tiru fanay bilti achichem ittechem
Veim letach meshallach la nechot are gavra amar lana la techezun appay ellahen kad achuchon immechon:
Vayyomer yisrael lama hareotem li lehaggid laish haod lachem ach
Vaamar yisrael lema aveshtun li lechavvaa legavra haad kean lechon acha:
Vayyomru shaol shaal-haish lanu ulemoladtenu lemor haod avichem chay hayesh lachem ach vannagged-lo al-pi haddevarim haelle hayadoa neda ki yomar horidu et-achichem
Vaamaru mishal shael gavra lana uleyalladutana lememar haad kean avuchon kayyam hait lechon acha vechavvena leh al memar pitgamayya haillen hamidda havena yadin are yemar ochitu yat achuchon:
Vayyomer yehuda el-yisrael aviv shilcha hannaar itti venakuma venelecha venichye velo namut gam-anachnu gam-atta gam-tappenu
Vaamar yehuda leyisrael avuhi shelach ulema immi venekum venezel veneche vela nemut af anachna af at af taflana:
Anochi eervennu miyyadi tevakshennu im-lo haviotiv elecha vehitztzagtiv lefanecha vechatati lecha kol-hayyamim
Ana mearavna veh min yedi tivinneh im la aytinneh lach vaakeminneh kodamach veehe chate lach kol yomayya:
Ki lule hitmamahnu ki-atta shavnu ze faamayim
Are illulafon beda itakkavna are chean tavna denan tarten zimnin:
Vayyomer alehem yisrael avihem im-ken efo zot asu kechu mizzimrat haaretz bichlechem vehoridu laish mincha meat tzori umeat devash nechot valot botnim ushekedim
Vaamar lehon yisrael avuhon im ken hacha da ividu sivu middimshabbach beara bemanechon veochitu legavra tikruvta zeer ketaf uzeer devash sheaf uletom batnin veshigdin:
Vechesef mishne kechu veyedchem veet-hakkesef hammushav befi amtechotechem tashivu veyedchem ulay mishge hu
Vechaspa al chad teren sivu veyedchon veyat kaspa deittotav befum toanechon tetivun beyedchon maim shalu hu:
Veet-achichem kachu vekumu shuvu el-haish
Veyat achuchon devaru vekumu tuvu levat gavra:
Veel shadday yitten lachem rachamim lifne haish veshillach lachem et-achichem acher veet-binyamin vaani kaasher shacholti shachalti
Veel shadday yitten lechon rachamin lokodam gavra veyiftar lechon yat achuchon ochorana veyat binyamin vaana kema deitkelit techelit:
Vayyikchu haanashim et-hammincha hazzot umishne-kkesef lakchu veyadam veet-binyamin vayyakumu vayyerdu mitzrayim vayyaamdu lifne yosef
Unesivu guvrayya yat tikruvta hada veal chad teren kaspa nesivu videhon udevaru yat binyamin vekamu unechatu lemitzrayim vekamu kodam yosef:
Vayyar yosef ittam et-binyamin vayyomer laasher al-beto have et-haanashim habbayta utevoach tevach vehachen ki itti yochlu haanashim batztzohorayim
Vachaza yosef immehon yat binyamin vaamar ledi memanna al beteh ael yat guvrayya leveta unechos nichsata veatken are immi yechlun guvrayya besheruta:
Vayyaas haish kaasher amar yosef vayyave haish et-haanashim beta yosef
Vaavad gavra kema di amar yosef veael gavra yat guvrayya levet yosef:
Vayyiru haanashim ki huveu bet yosef vayyomru al-devar hakkesef hashshav beamtechotenu battechilla anachnu muvaim lehitgolel alenu ulehitnappel alenu velakachat otanu laavadim veet-chamorenu
Udechilu guvrayya are ittaalu levet yosef vaamaru al esak kaspa deittotav betoanana bekadmeta anachna mittaalin leitravrava alana uleistakkafa alana ulemikne yatana leavdin ulemidbar yat chamarana:
Vayyiggeshu el-haish asher al-bet yosef vaydabberu elav petach habbayit
Ukerivu levat gavra di memanna al bet yosef umallilu immeh bitra beta:
Vayyomru bi adoni yarod yaradnu battechilla lishbor-ochel
Vaamaru bevau ribboni mechat nechetna bekadmeta lemizban ivura:
Vayhi ki-vanu el-hammalon vanniftecha et-amtechotenu vehinne chesef-ish befi amtachto kaspenu bemishkalo vannashev oto beyadenu
Vahava kad atena levet mevata ufetachna yat toanana veha chesaf gevar befum toaneh kaspana bematkeleh vaatevna yateh bidana:
Vechesef acher horadnu veyadenu lishbor-ochel lo yadanu mi-sam kaspenu beamtechotenu
Vechaspa ochorana ochitna vidana lemizban ivura la yedana man shavvi chaspana betoanana:
Vayyomer shalom lachem al-tirau elohechem velohe avichem natan lachem matmon beamtechotechem kaspechem ba elay vayyotze alehem et-shimon
Vaamar shelam lechon la tidchalun elahachon veelaha daavuchon yehav lechon sima betoanechon kaspechon ata levati veappek levathon yat shimon:
Vayyave haish et-haanashim beta yosef vayyitten-mayim vayyirchatzu raglehem vayyitten mispo lachamorehem
Veael gavra yat guvrayya levet yosef vihav mayya veascho riglehon vihav kisseta lachamarehon:
Vayyachinu et-hammincha ad-bo yosef batztzohorayim ki shamu ki-sham yochlu lachem
Veatkinu yat tikruvta ad deal yosef besheruta are shemau are tamman yechlun lachma:
Vayyavo yosef habbayta vayyaviu lo et-hammincha asher-beyadam habbayta vayyishtachavu-lo artza
Veal yosef leveta veaytiu leh yat tikruvta di videhon levayta usegidu leh leara:
Vayyishal lahem leshalom vayyomer hashalom avichem hazzaken asher amartem haodennu chay
Usheel lehon lishlam vaamar hashlam avuchon sava di amartun haad kean kayyam:
Vayyomru shalom leavdecha leavinu odennu chay vayyikkedu vayyishtachavu
Vaamaru shelam leavdach leavuna ad kean kayyam ucherau usegidu:
Vayyissa enav vayyar et-binyamin achiv ben-immo vayyomer haze achichem hakkaton asher amartem elay vayyomar elohim yochnecha beni
Uzekaf enohi vachaza yat binyamin achuhi bar immeh vaamar haden achuchon zeera di amartun li vaamar min kodam Adonai yitracham alach beri:
Vaymaher yosef ki-nichmeru rachamav el-achiv vayvakkesh livkot vayyavo hachadra vayyevk shamma
Veochi yosef are itgolelu rachamohi al achuhi uvea lemivke veal leidron bet mishkeva uvecha tamman:
Vayyirchatz panav vayyetze vayyitappak vayyomer simu lachem
Veasche appohi unefak veitchassin vaamar shavviu lachma:
Vayyasimu lo levaddo velahem levaddam velammitzrim haochlim itto levaddam ki lo yuchelun hammitzrim leechol et-haivrim lechem ki-toeva hiv lemitzrayim
Veshavviu leh bilchodohi ulehon bilchodehon ulemitzrae deochlin immeh bilchodehon are la yachlin mitzrae lemechal im ivrae lachma are veira demitzrae dachalin leh ivrae ochlin:
Vayyeshvu lefanav habbechor kivchorato vehatztzair kitzirato vayyitmehu haanashim ish el-reehu
Veascharu kodamohi rabba keravyuteh uzeera kizeruteh utemahu guvrayya gevar lechavreh:
Vayyissa masot meet panav alehem vatterev masat binyamin mimmasot kullam chamesh yadot vayyishtu vayyishkeru immo
Unetal cholakin min kodamohi lokodamehon usegi chalaka devinyamin mecholake dechalhon chamsha cholakin ushetiu ureviu immeh:
Vaytzav et-asher al-beto lemor malle et-amtechot haanashim ochel kaasher yuchelun seet vesim kesef-ish befi amtachto
Ufakked yat di memanna al beteh lememar mele yat toane guvrayya ivura kema di yachlin lemattele veshavvi kesaf gevar befum toaneh:
Veet-gevii gevia hakkesef tasim befi amtachat hakkaton veet kesef shivro vayyaas kidvar yosef asher dibber
Veyat kallidi kallida dechaspa teshavve befum toana dizera veyat kesaf zevinohi vaavad kefitgama deyosef di mallil:
Habboker or vehaanashim shullechu hemma vachamorehem
Tzafra nehar veguvrayya itpattaru innun vachamarehon:
Hem yatzu et-hair lo hirchiku veyosef amar laasher al-beto kum redof achare haanashim vehissagtam veamarta alehem lamma shillamtem raa tachat tova
Innun nefaku min karta la archiku veyosef amar ledi memanna al beteh kum redaf batar guvrayya vetadbekinnun vetemar lehon lema ashlemtun bisha cholaf tavta:
Halo ze asher yishte adoni bo vehu nachesh yenachesh bo hareotem asher asitem
Hala den deshate ribboni beh vehu badaka mevadek beh aveshtun di avadtun:
Vayyassigem vaydabber alehem et-haddevarim haelle
Veadbekinnun umallil immehon yat pitgamayya haillen:
Vayyomru elav lamma yedabber adoni kaddevarim haelle chalila laavadecha measot kaddavar hazze
Vaamaru leh lema yemallel ribboni kefitgamayya haillen chas leavdaych millemebad kefitgama haden:
Hen kesef asher matzanu befi amtechotenu heshivonu elecha meeretz kenaan veech nignov mibbet adonecha kesef o zahav
Ha chaspa di ashkachna befum toanana atevnohi lach meara dichnaan veechden nignuv mibbet ribbonach kaspa o dahava manin dichsaf o manin didhav:
Asher yimmatze itto meavadecha vamet vegam-anachnu nihye ladoni laavadim
Di yishtechach immeh meavdaych umit veaf anachna nehe leribboni leavdin:
Vayyomer gam-atta chedivrechem ken-hu asher yimmatze itto yihye-lli aved veattem tihyu nekiyyim
Vaamar af kean kefitgamechon ken hu di yishtechach immeh yehe li avda veattun tehon zakkain:
Vaymaharu vayyoridu ish et-amtachto artza vayyiftechu ish amtachto
Veochiu unechitu s" veachitu gevar yat toaneh leara ufetachu gevar toaneh:
Vaychappes baggadol hechel uvakkaton killa vayyimmatze haggavia beamtachat binyamin
Uvelash berabba shari uvizera shetzi veishtechach kallida betoana devinyamin:
Vayyikreu simlotam vayyaamos ish al-chamoro vayyashuvu haira
Uvezau levushehon uremo gevar al chamareh vetavu lekarta:
Vayyavo yehuda veechav beta yosef vehu odennu sham vayyippelu lefanav artza
Veal yehuda vaachohi levet yosef vehu ad kean tamman unefalu kodamohi leara:
Vayyomer lahem yosef ma-hammaase hazze asher asitem halo yedatem ki-nachesh yenachesh ish asher kamoni
Vaamar lehon yosef ma ovada haden di avadtun hala yedatun are vadaka mevadek gavra di chevati:
Vayyomer yehuda ma-nnomar ladoni ma-nnedabber uma-nnitztaddak haelohim matza et-avon avadecha hinnennu avadim ladoni gam-anachnu gam asher-nimtza haggavia beyado
Vaamar yehuda ma nemar leribboni ma nemallel uma nizke min kodam Adonai ishtechach yat chova veavdaych ha anachna avdin leribboni af anachna af deishtechach kallida bideh:
Vayyomer chalila li measot zot haish asher nimtza haggavia beyado hu yihye-lli aved veattem alu leshalom el-avichem
Vaamar chas li millemebad da gavra di yishtechach kallida bideh hu yehe li avda veattun seko lishlam levat avuchon:
Vayyiggash elav yehuda vayyomer bi adoni yedabber-na avdecha davar beozne adoni veal-yichar appecha beavdecha ki chamocha kefaro
Ukerev levateh yehuda vaamar bevau ribboni yemallel kean avdach pitgama kodam ribboni vela yitkef rugezach beavdach are chefaro ken at:
Adoni shaal et-avadav lemor hayesh-lachem av o-ach
Ribboni sheil yat avdohi lememar hait lechon abba o acha:
Vannomer el-adoni yesh-lanu av zaken veyeled zekunim katan veachiv met vayyivvater hu levaddo leimmo veaviv ahevo
Vaamarna leribboni it lana abba sava uvar sivtin zeer veachuhi mit veishtaar hu bilchodohi leimme vaavuhi rechim le:
Vattomer el-avadecha horiduhu elay veasima eni alav
Vaamarta leavdaych achitohi levati veeshavve eni alohi:
Vannomer el-adoni lo-yuchal hannaar laazov et-aviv veazav et-aviv vamet
Vaamarna leribboni la yikkul ulema lemishbak yat avuhi veim yishbok yat avuhi umit:
Vattomer el-avadecha im-lo yered achichem hakkaton ittechem lo tosifun lirot panay
Vaamarta leavdaych im la yechot achuchon zeera immechon la tosfun lemecheze appay:
Vayhi ki alinu el-avdecha avi vannagged-lo et divre adoni
Vahava kad selekna leavdach abba vechavvena leh yat pitgame ribboni:
Vayyomer avinu shuvu shivru-lanu meat-ochel
Vaamar avuna tuvu zevunu lana zeer ivura:
Vannomer lo nuchal laredet im-yesh achinu hakkaton ittanu veyaradnu ki-lo nuchal lirot pene haish veachinu hakkaton enennu ittanu
Vaamarna la nikkul lemechat im it achuna zeera immana venechot are la nikkul lemecheze appe gavra veachuna zeera letohi immana:
Vayyomer avdecha avi elenu attem yedatem ki shenayim yalda-lli ishti
Vaamar avdach abba lana attun yedatun are teren yelidat li itteti:
Vayyetze haechad meitti vaomar ach tarof toraf velo reitiv ad-henna
Unefak chad millevati vaamarit beram miktal ketil vela chazitteh ad kean:
Ulekachtem gam-et-ze meim panay vekarahu ason vehoradtem et-sevati beraa sheola
Vetadberun af yat den min kodamay viarinneh mota vetachatun yat sivti bevishta lishol:
Veatta kevoi el-avdecha avi vehannaar enennu ittanu venafsho keshura venafsho
Uchean kemeti levat avdach abba veulema letohi immana venafsheh chaviva le kenafsheh:
Vehaya kiroto ki-en hannaar vamet vehoridu avadecha et-sevat avdecha avinu beyagon sheola
Vihe kad yecheze are let ulema umit veyachatun avdaych yat sivat avdach avuna bedavona lishol:
Ki avdecha arav et-hannaar meim avi lemor im-lo aviennu elecha vechatati leavi kol-hayyamim
Are avdach mearav beulema min abba lememar im la aytinneh levatach vaehi chate leabba kol yomayya:
Veatta yeshev-na avdecha tachat hannaar eved ladoni vehannaar yaal im-echav
Uchean yetev kean avdach techot ulema avda leribboni veulema yissak im achuhi:
Ki-ech eele el-avi vehannaar enennu itti pen ere vara asher yimtza et-avi
Are echden essak levat abba veulema letohi immi dilma echeze bevishu di yishtechach yat abba:
Velo-yachol yosef lehitappek lechol hannitztzavim alav vayyikra hotziu chol-ish mealay velo-amad ish itto behitvadda yosef el-echav
Vela yechil yosef leitchassana lechol dekaymin illavohi ukera appiku chol enash meillavay vela kam enash immeh kad ityeda yosef levat achohi:
Vayyitten et-kolo bivchi vayyishmeu mitzrayim vayyishma bet paro
Vihav yat kaleh bivchita ushemau mitzrayim ushema enash bet paro:
Vayyomer yosef el-echav ani yosef haod avi chay velo-yachlu echav laanot oto ki nivhalu mippanav
Vaamar yosef laachohi ana yosef haad kean abba kayyam vela yachilu achohi laatava yateh pitgam are itbehilu min kodamohi:
Vayyomer yosef el-echav geshu-na elay vayyiggashu vayyomer ani yosef achichem asher-mechartem oti mitzrayma
Vaamar yosef laachohi kerivu chean levati ukerivu vaamar ana yosef achuchon di zabbintun yati lemitzrayim:
Veatta al-teatzvu veal-yichar beenechem ki-mechartem oti henna ki lemichya shelachani elohim lifnechem
Uchean la tittenesun vela yitkaf beenechon are zabbintun yati hacha are lekayyama shallechani Adonai kodamechon:
Ki-ze shenatayim haraav bekerev haaretz veod chamesh shanim asher en-charish vekatzir
Are denan tarten shenin kafna bego ara veod chamesh shenin di let zeroa vachatzada:
Vayyishlacheni elohim lifnechem lasum lachem sheerit baaretz ulehachayot lachem lifleta gedola
Veshallechani Adonai kodamechon leshavvaa lechon sheara beara ulekayyama lechon leshezava rabba:
Veatta lo-attem shelachtem oti henna ki haelohim vaysimeni leav lefaro uleadon lechol-beto umoshel bechol-eretz mitzrayim
Uchean la attun shelachtun yati hacha ellahen min kodam Adonai veshavveyani leabba lefaro uleribbon lechol enash beteh veshallit bechol ara demitzrayim:
Maharu vaalu el-avi vaamartem elav ko amar bincha yosef samani elohim leadon lechol-mitzrayim reda elay al-taamod
Ochu useko levat abba vetemrun leh kidnan amar berach yosef shavveyani Adonai leribbon lechol mitzrayim chut levati la titakkav:
Veyashavta veeretz-goshen vehayita karov elay atta uvanecha uvene vanecha vetzoncha uvekarcha vechol-asher-lach
Vetetev beara degshen utehe kariv li at uvenach uvene venach veanach vetorach vechol di lach:
Vechilkalti otcha sham ki-od chamesh shanim raav pen-tivvaresh atta uvetcha vechol-asher-lach
Veezun yatach tamman are od chamesh shenin kafna dilma titmaskan at veenash betach vechol di lach:
Vehinne enechem root veene achi vinyamin ki-fi hamedabber alechem
Veha enechon chazan veene achi vinyamin are velishanchon ana memallel immechon:
Vehiggadtem leavi et-kol-kevodi bemitzrayim veet kol-asher reitem umihartem vehoradtem et-avi henna
