Hammalach haggoel oti mikkol-ra yevarech et-hannearim veyikkare vahem shemi veshem avotay avraham veyitzchak veyidgu larov bekerev haaretz
Malacha di ferak yati mikkol bisha yevarech yat ulemayya veyitkere vehon shemi veshum avahatay avraham veyitzchak uchenune yamma yisgun bego vene enasha al ara:
Vayyar yosef ki-yashit aviv yad-yemino al-rosh efrayim vayyera beenav vayyitmoch yad-aviv lehasir otah meal rosh-efrayim al-rosh menashshe
Vachaza yosef are shavvi avuhi yad yemineh al resha deefrayim uveesh beenohi useed yeda deavuhi leaadaa yata meal resha deefrayim leannachuta al resha dimnashshe:
Vayyomer yosef el-aviv lo-chen avi ki-ze habbechor sim yemincha al-rosho
Vaamar yosef leavuhi la chen abba are den buchera shav yeminach al resheh:
Vaymaen aviv vayyomer yadati veni yadati gam-hu yihye-lleam vegam-hu yigdal veulam achiv hakkaton yigdal mimmennu vezaro yihye melo-haggoyim
Vesarev avuhi vaamar yedana veri yedana af hu yehe leamma veaf hu yisge uveram achuhi zeira yisge minneh uvenohi yehon shallitin beammayya:
Vayvarchem bayyom hahu lemor becha yevarech yisrael lemor yesimcha elohim keefrayim vechimnashshe vayyasem et-efrayim lifne menashshe
Uverechinnun beyoma hahu lememar bach yevarech yisrael lememar yeshavvinach Adonai keefrayim vechimnashshe veshavve yat efrayim kodam menashshe:
Vayyomer yisrael el-yosef hinne anochi met vehaya elohim immachem veheshiv etchem el-eretz avotechem
Vaamar yisrael leyosef ha ana mait vihe memra daAdonai besadechon veyatev yatchon leara daavahatchon:
Vaani natatti lecha shechem achad al-achecha asher lakachti miyyad haemori becharbi uvekashti
Vaana yehavit lach chulak chad yattir al achaych di nesevit mida deemoraa bitzloti uvevauti:
Vayyikra yaakov el-banav vayyomer heasfu veaggida lachem et asher-yikra etchem beacharit hayyamim
Ukera yaakov livnohi vaamar itkannashu vaachavve lechon yat di yeara yatchon besof yomayya:
Hikkavtzu veshimu bene yaakov veshimu el-yisrael avichem
Itkannashu ushemau bene yaakov vekabbilu ulefan min yisrael avuchon:
Reuven bechori atta kochi vereshit oni yeter seet veyeter az
Reuven bucheri at cheli veresh takpi lach hava chaze lemissav telata chulakin becheruta kehunta umalchuta:
Pachaz kammayim al-totar ki alita mishkeve avicha az chillalta yetzui ala
Al daazalta lokovel appaych ha chemayya beram la ahaneta cholak yattir la tissav are selekta bet mishkeve avuch bechen achelta leshivvuyi beri selekta:
Shimon velevi achim kele chamas mecherotehem
Shimon velevi achin gavrin gibbarin beara totavutehon avadu gevura:
Besodam al-tavo nafshi bikhalam al-techad kevodi ki veappam hargu ish uvirtzonam ikkeru-shor
Berazhon la havat nafshi beitkanneshehon limhach la nechatit min yekari are verogzehon ketalu ketol uvirutehon tarau shur sana:
Arur appam ki az veevratam ki kashata achallekem beyaakov vaafitzem beyisrael
Lit rogzehon are takkif vechemathon are kashya afalleginnun beyaakov veevaddarinnun beyisrael:
Yehuda atta yoducha achecha yadcha beoref oyvecha yishtachavu lecha bene avicha
Yehuda at odeta vela veheteta bach yodun achaych yedach titkef al baale devavach yitbadderun sanach yehon mechazzerin kedal kodamach vihon mekaddemin lemishal bishlamach bene avuch:
Gur arye yehuda mitteref beni alita kara ravatz kearye uchelavi mi yekimennu
Shilton yehe vesheruya uvesofa yitrabba malka middevet yehuda are middin katla beri nafshach selekta yenuach yishre vitkof kearya ucheleta velet malchu ditzazeinneh:
Lo-yasur shevet mihuda umechokek mibben raglav ad ki-yavo shilo velo yikkehat ammim
La yaade aved shaltan middevet yehuda vesafra mibbene venohi ad alma ad deyete meshicha dedileh hi malchuta veleh yishtammeun ammayya:
Osri laggefen iro velassoreka beni atono kibbes bayyayin levusho uvedam-anavim suto
Yaschar yisrael lekarteh amma yivnun hechleh yehon tzaddikayya sechor sechor leh veavde orayta beulefan immeh yehe argevan tav levushohi kesuteh mela mela tzeva zehori vetzivonin:
Chachlili enayim miyyayin uleven-shinnayim mechalav
Yesammekun turohi becharmohi yetufun naavohi bachamar yechavveran bikateh beivur uveedre ana:
Zevulun lechof yammim yishkon vehu lechof oniyyot veyarchato al-tzidon
Zevulun al sefar yammayya yishre vehu yechabbesh mechozin bisfinan vetuv yamma yechul utechumeh yehe mate al tzidon:
Yissashchar chamor garem rovetz ben hammishpetayim
Yissaschar attir benichsin veachasanteh ben techumayya:
Vayyar menucha ki tov veet-haaretz ki naema vayyet shichmo lisbol vayhi lemas-oved
Vachaza chulaka are tav veyat ara are meabbeda ferin vichabbesh machoze ammayya vishetze yat dayyarehon udeishtaarun behon yehon leh palchin umasseke massin:
Dan yadin ammo keachad shivte yisrael
Middevet dan yitbechar vikum gavra beyomohi yitperek ammeh uvishnohi yenuchun kachada shivtayya deyisrael:
Yehi-dan nachash ale-derech shefifon ale-orach hannoshech ikkeve-sus vayyippol rochvo achor

Yehe gavra deyitbechar vikum middevet dan emteh titreme al ammayya umechateh titkef biflishtae kechive chureman yishre al orcha uchefitna yichmon al shevila yekattel gibbare mashshiryat pelishtae parashin im raglain yeakker susavan uretikkin vimagger rochvehon laachora:
Lishuatcha kivviti Adonai
Lefurekanach sabbarit Adonai:
Gad gedud yegudennu vehu yagud akev
Middevet gad mashshiryat mezayyenin kad yaavrun yat yardena kodam achehon likrava uvenichsin saggiin yetuvun learahon:
Measher shemena lachmo vehu yitten maadanne-melech
Deasher tava areh vehu meravya betafnuke malchin:
Naftali ayyala shelucha hannoten imre-shafer
Naftali beara tava yitreme adveh veachasanteh tehe meabbeda ferin yehon modan umevarchin alehon:
Ben porat yosef ben porat ale-ayin banot tzaada ale-shur
Beri deyisge yosef beri deyitbarach kegofen dintzev al ena demayya teren shivtin yippekun mibbenohi yekabbelun chulaka veachasanta:
Vaymareruhu varobbu vayyistemuhu baale chitztzim
Veitmarru yateh venakkemohi veaiku leh guvrin gibbarin baale falgota:
Vatteshev beetan kashto vayyafozzu zeroe yadav mide avir yaakov mishsham roe even yisrael

Vetavat behon neviuteh al dekayyam orayta besitra veshavvi vetukefa rochatzaneh bechen yitrema dehav al deraohi veachasin malchuta utekef da havat leh min kodam el takkifa deyaakov di vememreh zan avahan uvenin zara deyisrael:
Meel avicha veyazerekka veet shadday vivarchekka birchot shamayim meal birchot tehom rovetzet tachat birchot shadayim varacham
Memar elaha deavuch yehe vesadach veyat shadday vivarchinnach birchan denachatan mittalla dishmayya milleella birchan denagdan mimmaamakke ara millera birketa deavuch udeimmach:
Birchot avicha gavru al-birchot horay ad-taavat givot olam tihyena lerosh yosef ulekodkod nezir echav
Birketa deavuch yittosfan al birketa dili barichu avahatay dachamidu lehen ravrevayya demin alma yehevyan kol illen leresha deyosef ulegavra parisha daachohi:
Binyamin zeev yitraf babboker yochal ad velaerev yechallek shalal
Binyamin beareh tishre shechinta uveachasanteh yitbene makdesha betzafra uvefanya yehon mekarvin kahanayya korbana uveiddan ramsha yehon mefallegin motar chulekehon mishshear kodshayya:
Kol-elle shivte yisrael shenem asar vezot asher-dibber lahem avihem vayvarech otam ish asher kevirchato berach otam
Kol illen shivtayya deyisrael teren asar veda demallel lehon avuhon uvarich yathon gevar di chevirketeh barech yathon:
Vaytzav otam vayyomer alehem ani neesaf el-ammi kivru oti el-avotay el-hammeara asher bisde efron hachitti
Ufakked yathon vaamar lehon ana mitkenesh leammi kevaru yati levat avahatay bimarta di vachakal efron chittaa:
Bammeara asher bisde hammachpela asher al-pene-mamre beeretz kenaan asher kana avraham et-hassade meet efron hachitti laachuzzat-kaver
Bimarta di vachakal kafelta di al appe mamre beara dichnaan di zevan avraham yat chakla min efron chittaa leachasanat kevura:
Shamma kavru et-avraham veet sara ishto shamma kavru et-yitzchak veet rivka ishto veshamma kavarti et-lea
Tamman kevaru yat avraham veyat sara itteteh tamman kevaru yat yitzchak veyat rivka itteteh vetamman kevarit yat lea:
Mikne hassade vehammeara asher-bo meet bene-chet
Zevine chakla umearta di veh min bene chittaa:
Vaychal yaakov letzavvot et-banav vayyeesof raglav el-hammitta vayyigva vayyeasef el-ammav
Veshetze yaakov lefakkada yat benohi uchenash raglohi learsa veitnegid veitkenish leammeh:
Vayyippol yosef al-pene aviv vayyevk alav vayyishshak-lo
Unefal yosef al appe avuhi uvecha allohi uneshak leh:
Vaytzav yosef et-avadav et-harofim lachanot et-aviv vayyachantu harofim et-yisrael
Ufakkid yosef yat avdohi yat asvata lemechnat yat avuhi vechantu asvata yat yisrael:
Vayyimleu-lo arbaim yom ki ken yimleu yeme hachanutim vayyivku oto mitzrayim shivim yom
Ushelimu leh arbein yomin are ken shelimu yome chanittayya uvecho yateh mitzrae shavin yomin:
Vayyaavru yeme vechito vaydabber yosef el-bet paro lemor im-na matzati chen beenechem dabberu-na beozne faro lemor
Vaavaru yome vechiteh umallel yosef im bet paro lememar im kean ashkachit rachamin beenechon mallilu chean kodam paro lememar:
Avi hishbiani lemor hinne anochi met bekivri asher kariti li beeretz kenaan shamma tikbereni veatta eele-nna veekbera et-avi veashuva
Abba kayyim alay lememar ha ana mait bekivri deatkenit li beara dichnaan tamman tikberinnani uchean essak kean veekbar yat abba veetuv:
Vayyomer paro ale ukevor et-avicha kaasher hishbiecha
Vaamar paro sak ukevor yat avuch kema dekayyim alach:
Vayyaal yosef likbor et-aviv vayyaalu itto kol-avde faro zikne veto vechol zikne eretz-mitzrayim
Uselek yosef lemikbar yat avuhi useliku immeh kol avde faro save veteh vechol save ara demitzrayim:
Vechol bet yosef veechav uvet aviv rak tappam vetzonam uvekaram azvu beeretz goshen
Vechol bet yosef vaachohi uvet avuhi lechod taflehon veanhon vetorehon shevaku beara degshen:
Vayyaal immo gam-rechev gam-parashim vayhi hammachane kaved meod
Useliku immeh af retikkin af parashin vahava mashrita saggia lachada:
Vayyavou ad-goren haatad asher beever hayyarden vayyispedu-sham misped gadol vechaved meod vayyaas leaviv evel shivat yamim
Vaato ad bet idre deatad di beivra deyardena usefadu tamman misped rav vetakkif lachada veavad laavuhi evla shava yomin:
Vayyar yoshev haaretz hakkenaani et-haevel begoren haatad vayyomru evel-kaved ze lemitzrayim al-ken kara shemah avel mitzrayim asher beever hayyarden
Vachaza yatev ara chenaanaa yat evla bevet idre deatad vaamaru avel takkif den lemitzrae al ken kera shema avel mitzrayim di beivra deyardena:
Vayyaasu vanav lo ken kaasher tzivvam
Vaavadu venohi leh ken kema di fakkedinnun:
Vayyisu oto vanav artza kenaan vayyikberu oto bimarat sede hammachpela asher kana avraham et-hassade laachuzzat-kever meet efron hachitti al-pene mamre
Unetalu yateh benohi leara dichnaan ukevaru yateh bimarat chakal kafelta di zevan avraham yat chakla leachasanat kevura min efron chittaa al appe mamre:
Vayyashov yosef mitzrayma hu veechav vechol-haolim itto likbor et-aviv achare kovro et-aviv
Vetav yosef lemitzrayim hu vaachohi vechol disliku immeh lemikbar yat avuhi batar dikvar yat avuhi:
Vayyiru ache-yosef ki-met avihem vayyomru lu yistemenu yosef vehashev yashiv lanu et kol-haraa asher gamalnu oto
Vachazo ache yosef are mit avuhon vaamaru dilma yittar lana devavu yosef vaatava yatev lana yat kol bishta di gemalna yateh:
Vaytzavvu el-yosef lemor avicha tzivva lifne moto lemor
Ufakkidu levat yosef lememar avuch pakked kodam moteh lememar:
Ko-tomru leyosef anna sa na pesha achecha vechattatam ki-raa gemalucha veatta sa na lefesha avde elohe avicha vayyevk yosef bedabberam elav
Keden temrun leyosef bevau shevok kean lechova achaych velachataehon are vishta gemaluch uchean shevok kean lechova avde elaha deavuch uvecha yosef bemallalutehon immeh:
Vayyelchu gam-echav vayyippelu lefanav vayyomru hinnennu lecha laavadim
Vaazalu af achohi unefalu kodamohi vaamaru ha anachna lach leavdin:
Vayyomer alehem yosef al-tirau ki hatachat elohim ani
Vaamar lehon yosef la tiddachalun are dachala daAdonai ana:
Veattem chashavtem alay raa elohim chashavah letova lemaan aso kayyom hazze lehachayot am-rav
Veattun chashavtun alay bisha min kodam Adonai itchashshevat letava bedil lemebad keyoma haden lekayyama am saggi:
Veatta al-tirau anochi achalkel etchem veet-tappechem vaynachem otam vaydabber al-libbam
Uchean la tiddachalun ana ezun yatchon veyat taflechon venachem yathon umallel tanchumin al libbehon:
Vayyeshev yosef bemitzrayim hu uvet aviv vaychi yosef mea vaeser shanim
Vitev yosef bemitzrayim hu uvet avuhi vachaya yosef mea vaasar shenin:
Vayyar yosef leefrayim bene shilleshim gam bene machir ben-menashshe yulledu al-birke yosef
Vachaza yosef leefrayim benin telitain af bene machir bar menashshe ityelidu verabbi yosef:
Vayyomer yosef el-echav anochi met velohim pakod yifkod etchem veheela etchem min-haaretz hazzot el-haaretz asher nishba leavraham leyitzchak uleyaakov
Vaamar yosef laachohi ana mait vayya midkar dechir yatchon veyissak yatchon min ara hada leara di kayyim leavraham leyitzchak uleyaakov:
Vayyashba yosef et-bene yisrael lemor pakod yifkod elohim etchem vehaalitem et-atzmotay mizze
Veome yosef yat bene yisrael lememar midkar dechir Adonai yatchon vetassekun yat garmay mikka:
Vayyamot yosef ben-mea vaeser shanim vayyachantu oto vayyisem baaron bemitzrayim
Umit yosef bar mea vaasar shenin vachanatu yateh vesamuhi vearona bemitzrayim:
Exodus: Veelle shemot bene yisrael habbaim mitzrayma et yaakov ish uveto bau
Veilen shemahat bene yisrael dealu lemitzrayim im yaakov gevar veenash bete alu:
Reuven shimon levi vihuda
Reuven shimon levi vihuda:
Yissashchar zevulun uvinyamin
Yissaschar zevulun uvinyamin:
Dan venaftali gad veasher
Dan venaftali gad veasher:
Vayhi kol-nefesh yotze yerech-yaakov shivim nafesh veyosef haya vemitzrayim
Vahava kol nafshata nafke yarka deyaakov shavin nafshan veyosef dahava bemitzrayim:
Vayyamot yosef vechol-echav vechol haddor hahu
Umit yosef vechol achohi vechol dara hahu:
Uvene yisrael paru vayyishretzu vayyirbu vayyaatzmu bimod meod vattimmale haaretz otam
Uvene yisrael nefishu veityaladu usegiu utekifu lachada lachada veitmeliat ara minhon:
Vayyakom melech-chadash al-mitzrayim asher lo-yada et-yosef
Vekam malka chadta al mitzrayim dela mekayem gezerat yosef:
Vayyomer el-ammo hinne am bene yisrael rav veatzum mimmennu
Vaamar leame ha ama bene yisrael sagan vetakifin minana:
Hava nitchakkema lo pen-yirbe vehaya ki-tikrena milchama venosaf gam-hu al-sonenu venilcham-banu veala min-haaretz
Havu nitchakkam lehon dilma yisgun vihe are yearinana kerav veyittosfun af inun al sanana vigichun bana kerav veyiskun min ara:
Vayyasimu alav sare missim lemaan annoto besivlotam vayyiven are miskenot lefaro et-pitom veet-raamses
Umaniu alehon shiltonin mavishin bedil leanoehon befalchanhon uveno kirve vet otzara lefaro yat pitom veyat raamses:
Vechaasher yeannu oto ken yirbe vechen yifrotz vayyakutzu mippene bene yisrael
Uchema dimanan lehon ken sagan vechen takfin vaakat lemitzrae min kodam bene yisrael:
Vayyaavidu mitzrayim et-bene yisrael befarech
Veaflachu mitzrae yat bene yisrael bekashyu:
Vaymareru et-chayyehem baavoda kasha bechomer uvilvenim uvechol-avoda bassade et kol-avodatam asher-avdu vahem befarech
Veamraru yat chayehon befalchana kashya betina uvelivnin uvechol palchana bechakla yat kol palchanhon deaflachu vehon bekashyu:
Vayyomer melech mitzrayim lamyalledot haivriyyot asher shem haachat shifra veshem hashshenit pua
Vaamar malka demitzrayim lechayata yehudayata deshum chada shifra veshum tinyeta pua:
Vayyomer beyalledchen et-haivriyyot ureiten al-haovnayim im-ben hu vahamitten oto veim-bat hiv vachaya
Vaamar kad tehevyan moldan yat yehudayata vetechzeyan al matbera im bar hu tiktelan yate veim beratta hi vtekaymina:
Vattirena hameyalledot et-haelohim velo asu kaasher dibber alehen melech mitzrayim vattechayyena et-hayeladim
Udechila chayata min kodam Adonai vela avada kema demalil imhen malka demitzrayim vekayama yat benaya:
Vayyikra melech-mitzrayim lamyalledot vayyomer lahen maddua asiten haddavar hazze vattechayyena et-hayeladim
Ukera malka demitzrayim lechayata vaamar lehen ma den avadtun yat pitgama haden vekayemtun yat benaya:
Vattomarna hameyalledot el-paro ki lo channashim hammitzriyyot haivriyyot ki-chayot henna beterem tavo alehen hameyalledet veyaladu
Vaamara chayata lefaro are la chinshaya mitzreyata yehudayata are chakkiman inun ad la alat levathen chayata vilidan:
Vayyetev elohim lamyalledot vayyirev haam vayyaatzmu meod
Veotev Adonai lechayata usegi ama utekifu lachada:
Vayhi ki-yaru hameyalledot et-haelohim vayyaas lahem battim
Vahava kad dechila chayata min kodam Adonai vaavad lehon battin:
Vaytzav paro lechol-ammo lemor kol-habben hayyillod hayeora tashlichuhu vechol-habbat techayyun
Ufakid paro lechol ame lememar kol bera deyityelid lihudae benahara tirmune vechol beratta tekaymun:
Vayyelech ish mibbet levi vayyikkach et-bat-levi
Vaazal gavra midvet levi unesiv yat bat levi:
Vattahar haishsha vatteled ben vattere oto ki-tov hu vattitzpenehu shelosha yerachim
Veadiat itteta vilidat bar vachazat yate are tav hu veatmarte telata yarchin:
Velo-yachla od hatztzefino vattikkach-lo tevat gome vattachmera vachemar uvazzafet vattasem bah et-hayyeled vattasem bassuf al-sefat hayeor
Vela yechelat od leatmarute unesevat le tevuta degome vechappata bechemara uvezifta veshaviat ba yat ravya veshavita beyaara al kef nahara:
Vattetatztzav achoto merachok ledea ma-yyease lo
Veitattadat achate merachik lemida ma yitaved le:
Vattered bat-paro lirchotz al-hayeor venaaroteha holchot al-yad hayeor vattere et-hatteva betoch hassuf vattishlach et-amatah vattikkacheha
Unechatat bat paro lemische al nahara veulemataha mehalechan al kef nahara vachazat yat tevuta bego yaara veoshetat yat amta unesevta:
Vattiftach vattirehu et-hayyeled vehinne-naar boche vattachmol alav vattomer miyyalde haivrim ze
Ufetachat vachazat yat ravya veha ulema bache vechasat alohi vaameret mibbene yehudae hu den:
Vattomer achoto el-bat-paro haelech vekarati lach ishsha meneket min haivriyyot vetenik lach et-hayyaled
Vaameret achate levat faro haezil veikre lich itteta menikta min yehudayata vetonik lich yat ravya:
Vattomer-lah bat-paro lechi vattelech haalma vattikra et-em hayyaled
Vaameret la bat paro ezili vaazalat ulemta ukerat yat ime deravya:
Vattomer lah bat-paro helichi et-hayyeled hazze vehenikihu li vaani etten et-secharech vattikkach haishsha hayyeled vattenikehu
Vaameret la bat paro ovili yat ravya haden veonkihi li vaana etten yat agrach unesevat itteta yat ravya veonikte:
Vayyigdal hayyeled vatteviehu levat-paro vayhi-lah leven vattikra shemo moshe vattomer ki min-hammayim meshitihu
Ureva ravya veaytite levat paro vahava lah levar ukerat sheme mshe vaameret are min maya shechalte:
Vayhi bayyamim hahem vayyigdal moshe vayyetze el-echav vayyar besivlotam vayyar ish mitzri makke ish-ivri meechav
Vahava beyomaya hainun ureva mshe unefak levat achohi vachaza befalchanhon vachaza gevar mitzri mache ligvar yehudi meachohi:
Vayyifen ko vacho vayyar ki en ish vayyach et-hammitzri vayyitmenehu bachol
Veitpene lecha ulecha vachaza are let gavra umecha yat mitzraa vetamre bechala:
Vayyetze bayyom hashsheni vehinne shene-anashim ivrim nitztzim vayyomer larasha lamma takke reecha
Unefak beyoma tinyana veha teren guvrin yehudain natzan vaamar lechayava lema at mache lechavrach:
Vayyomer mi samcha leish sar veshofet alenu halehorgeni atta omer kaasher haragta et-hammitzri vayyira moshe vayyomar achen noda haddavar
Vaamar man shavyach ligvar rav vedayan alana halemikteli at amar kema diktalta yat mitzraa udechil mshe vaamar bekusheta ityeda pitgama:
Vayyishma paro et-haddavar hazze vayvakkesh laharog et-moshe vayyivrach moshe mippene faro vayyeshev beeretz-midyan vayyeshev al-habbeer
Ushema paro yat pitgama haden uvea lemiktal yat mshe vaarak mshe min kodam paro vitev beara demidyan vitev al bera:
Ulechohen midyan sheva banot vattavona vattidlena vattemallena et-harhatim lehashkot tzon avihen
Ulerabba demidyan sheva benan veataa udelaa umelaa yat rehataya leashkaa ana daavuhen:
Vayyavou haroim vaygarshum vayyakom moshe vayyoshian vayyashk et-tzonam
Vaato raaya uteradunun vekam mshe uferakinun veashke yat anhen:
Vattavona el-reuel avihen vayyomer maddua miharten bo hayyom
Vaataa levat reuel avuhen vaamar ma den ochitun lemete yoma den:
Vattomarna ish mitzri hitztzilanu miyyad haroim vegam-dalo dala lanu vayyashk et-hatztzon
Vaamara gavra mitzraa shezvana miyad raaya veaf midla dela lana veashke yat ana:
Vayyomer el-benotav veayyo lamma ze azavten et-haish kiren lo veyochal lachem
Vaamar livnateh vean hu lema denan shevaktin yat gavra keran le veyechul lachma:
Vayyoel moshe lashevet et-haish vayyitten et-tzippora vitto lemoshe
Utzevi mshe lemitav im gavra vihav yat tzippora veratte lemshe:
Vatteled ben vayyikra et-shemo gershom ki amar ger hayiti beeretz nochriyya
Vilidat bar ukera yat sheme gershom are amar dayar haveti beara nucheraa:
Vayhi vayyamim harabbim hahem vayyamot melech mitzrayim vayyeanchu vene-yisrael min-haavoda vayyizaku vattaal shavatam el-haelohim min-haavoda
Vahava beyomaya sagiaya hainun umit malka demitzrayim veitnachu vene yisrael min palchana dahava keshe alehon uzeiku uselekat keveltehon lokodam Adonai min palchana:
Vayyishma elohim et-naakatam vayyizkor elohim et-berito et-avraham et-yitzchak veet-yaakov
Ushemia kodam Adonai yat keveltehon udechir Adonai yat kayame deim avraham deim yitzchak udeim yaakov:
Vayyar elohim et-bene yisrael vayyeda elohim
Ugeli kedam Adonai shibuda divne yisrael vaamar bememre lemifrakhon Adonai:
Umoshe haya roe et-tzon yitro chotno kohen midyan vayyinhag et-hatztzon achar hammidbar vayyavo el-har haelohim choreva
Umshe hava rae yat ana deyitro chamohi rabba demidyan udevar yat ana levatar shefar raaya lemadbera veata letura deitgeli alohi yekara daAdonai lechorev:
Vayyera malach Adonai elav belabbat-esh mittoch hassene vayyar vehinne hassene boer baesh vehassene enennu ukkal
Veitgeli malacha daAdonai le beshalhovit eshata migo asana vachaza veha asana baer beeshata vaasana letohi mitachil:
Vayyomer moshe asura-nna veere et-hammare haggadol hazze maddua lo-yivar hassene
Vaamar mshe itpene chean veecheze yat chazvana rabba haden ma den la mittokad asana:
Vayyar Adonai ki sar lirot vayyikra elav elohim mittoch hassene vayyomer moshe moshe vayyomer hinneni
Vachaza Adonai are itpene lemecheze ukera le Adonai migo asana vaamar mshe mshe vaamar ha ana:
Vayyomer al-tikrav halom shal-nealecha meal raglecha ki hammakom asher atta omed alav admat-kodesh hu
Vaamar la tikrav halecha sheri senach meal riglach are atra deat kaim alohi atar kadish hu:
Vayyomer anochi elohe avicha elohe avraham elohe yitzchak velohe yaakov vayyaster moshe panav ki yare mehabbit el-haelohim
Vaamar ana elaha deavuch elaha deavraham elaha deyitzchak velaha deyaakov ucheveshinnun mshe leappohi are dachil milistakkala betzet yekara daAdonai:
Vayyomer Adonai rao raiti et-oni ammi asher bemitzrayim veet-tzaakatam shamati mippene nogsav ki yadati et-machovav
Vaamar Adonai migla geli kodamay yat shibud ami di vemitzrayim veyat keveltehon shemia kodamay min kodam maflechehon are gele kadamay yat kevehon:
Vaered lehatztzilo miyyad mitzrayim ulehaaloto min-haaretz hahiv el-eretz tova urechava el-eretz zavat chalav udevash el-mekom hakkenaani vehachitti vehaemori vehapperizzi vehachivvi vehayevusi
Veitgeleti leshezavutehon mida demitzrae uleasakutehon min ara hahi leara tava ufatya leara avda chalav udevash laatar kenaanae vechittae veemorae uferizae vechivae vivusae:
Veatta hinne tzaakat bene-yisrael baa elay vegam-raiti et-hallachatz asher mitzrayim lochatzim otam
Uchean ha kevelat bene yisrael alat kodamay veaf gele kodamay yat dochaka di mitzrae dachakin lehon:
Veatta lecha veeshlachacha el-paro vehotze et-ammi vene-yisrael mimmitzrayim
Uchean ita vaashalchinnach levat paro veappek yat ami vene yisrael mimitzrayim:
Vayyomer moshe el-haelohim mi anochi ki elech el-paro vechi otzi et-bene yisrael mimmitzrayim
Vaamar mshe kodam Adonai man ana are ezil levat paro vaare appek yat bene yisrael mimitzrayim:
Vayyomer ki-eye immach veze-llecha haot ki anochi shelachticha behotziacha et-haam mimmitzrayim taavdun et-haelohim al hahar hazze
Vaamar are yehe memri vesadach veden lach ata are ana shelachtach beappakutach yat ama mimitzrayim tiflechun kodam Adonai al tura haden:
Vayyomer moshe el-haelohim hinne anochi va el-bene yisrael veamarti lahem elohe avotechem shelachani alechem veamru-li ma-shshemo ma omar alehem
Vaamar mshe kodam Adonai ha ana ate levat bene yisrael veemar lehon elaha deavhatchon shalchani levatchon veyemrun li ma sheme ma emar lehon:
Vayyomer elohim el-moshe eye asher eye vayyomer ko tomar livne yisrael eye shelachani alechem
Vaamar Adonai lemshe eye asher eye vaamar kidnan temar livne yisrael eye shalchani levatchon:
Vayyomer od elohim el-moshe ko-tomar el-bene yisrael Adonai elohe avotechem elohe avraham elohe yitzchak velohe yaakov shelachani alechem ze-shshemi leolam veze zichri ledor dor
Vaamar od Adonai lemshe kidnan temar livne yisrael Adonai elaha deavhatchon elahe deavraham elahe deyitzchak velahe deyaakov shalchani levatchon den shemi lealam veden dachrani lechol dar vedar:
Lech veasafta et-zikne yisrael veamarta alehem Adonai elohe avotechem nira elay elohe avraham yitzchak veyaakov lemor pakod pakadti etchem veet-heasuy lachem bemitzrayim
Izel vetichnosh yat save yisrael vetemar lehon Adonai elaha deavhatchon itgele li elahe deavraham yitzchak veyaakov lememar midkar dechirna yatchon veyat deitavad lechon bemitzrayim:
Vaomar aale etchem meoni mitzrayim el-eretz hakkenaani vehachitti vehaemori vehapperizzi vehachivvi vehayevusi el-eretz zavat chalav udevash
Vaamarit asek yatchon mishibud mitzrae laara kenaanae vechittae veemorae uferizae vechivae vivusae leara avda chalav udevash:
Veshamu lekolecha uvata atta vezikne yisrael el-melech mitzrayim vaamartem elav Adonai elohe haivriyyim nikra alenu veatta nelcha-nna derech sheloshet yamim bammidbar venizbecha la-Adonai elohenu
Vikabbelun lememrach vetete at vesave yisrael levat malka demitzrayim vetemrun le Adonai elaha dihudae itkere alana uchean nezel kean mahalach telata yomin bemadbera unedabbach kodam Adonai elahana:
Vaani yadati ki lo-yitten etchem melech mitzrayim lahaloch velo beyad chazaka
Ukedamay gele are la yishbok yatchon malka demitzrayim lemezal vela min kodam dechele takif:
Veshalachti et-yadi vehikketi et-mitzrayim bechol nifleotay asher eese bekirbo veachare-chen yeshallach etchem
Vaashalach pon yat mechat gevurti veemche yat mitzrae bechol perishvati di abed benehon uvatar ken yeshalach yatchon:
Venatatti et-chen haam-hazze beene mitzrayim vehaya ki telechun lo telchu rekam
Veetten yat ama haden lerachamin beene mitzrae vihe are tehachun la tehachun rekanin:
Veshaala ishsha mishshechentah umiggarat betah kele-chesef uchele zahav usemalot vesamtem al-benechem veal-benotechem venitztzaltem et-mitzrayim
Vetishal itteta mishvavta umikrivat beta manin dichsaf umanin didhav ulevushin uteshavun al benechon veal benatechon uterokinun yat mitzrayim:
Vayyaan moshe vayyomer vehen lo-yaaminu li velo yishmeu bekoli ki yomru lo-nira elecha Adonai
Vaatev mshe vaamar veha la yehemnun li vela yekabbelun mini are yemrun la itgele lach Adonai:
Vayyomer elav Adonai ma-zze veyadecha vayyomer matte
Vaamar le Adonai ma den bidach vaamar chutera:
Vayyomer hashlichehu artza vayyashlichehu artza vayhi lenachash vayyanos moshe mippanav
Vaamar remihi leara uremahi leara vahava lechive vaarak mshe min kodamohi:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe shelach yadcha veechoz biznavo vayyishlach yado vayyachazek bo vayhi lematte bechappo
Vaamar Adonai lemshe oshit yedach veechod bezanve veoshet yede veatkef be vahava lechutera bide:
Lemaan yaaminu ki-nira elecha Adonai elohe avotam elohe avraham elohe yitzchak velohe yaakov
Bedil dihemnun are itgeli lach Adonai elaha deavhathon elahe deavraham elahe deyitzchak veelahe deyaakov:
Vayyomer Adonai lo od have-na yadcha bechekecha vayyave yado becheko vayyotziah vehinne yado metzoraat kashshaleg
Vaamar Adonai le od ael kean yedach beitfach veael yede beitfe veafka veha yede chavra chetalga:
Vayyomer hashev yadcha el-chekecha vayyashev yado el-cheko vayyotziah mecheko vehinne-shava kivsaro
Vaamar atev yedach leitfach vaatev yede leitfe veafka meitfe veha tavat havat kevisre:
Vehaya im-lo yaaminu lach velo yishmeu lekol haot harishon veheeminu lekol haot haacharon
Vihe im la yehemnun lach vela yekabbelun lekal ata kadmaa vihemnun lekal ata vatraa:
Vehaya im-lo yaaminu gam lishne haotot haelle velo yishmeun lekolecha velakachta mimmeme hayeor veshafachta hayyabbasha vehayu hammayim asher tikkach min-hayeor vehayu ledam bayyabbashet
Vihe im la yehemnun af litren ataya haillen vela yekabbelun minach vetisav mimaya divnahara veteshod leyabbeshta vihon maya di tisav min nahara vihon lidma beyabbeshta:
Vayyomer moshe el-Adonai bi adonay lo ish devarim anochi gam mittemol gam mishshilshom gam meaz dabbercha el-avdecha ki chevad-pe uchevad lashon anochi
Vaamar mshe kodam Adonai bevau Adonai la gevar demilul ana af mittemali af midkamohi af meidan demalelta im avdach are yakir mamlal veamik lishan ana:
Vayyomer Adonai elav mi sam pe laadam o mi-yasum illem o cheresh o fikkeach o ivver halo anochi Adonai
Vaamar Adonai le man shavi puma laanasha o man shavi ilma o chersha o fikcha o avira hala ana Adonai:
Veatta lech veanochi eye im-picha vehoreticha asher tedabber
Uchean ezel umemri yehe im pumach vealefinach di temalel:
Vayyomer bi adonay shelach-na beyad-tishlach
Vaamar bevau Adonai shelach kean beyad man dechashar detishlach:
Vayyichar-af Adonai bemoshe vayyomer halo aharon achicha hallevi yadati ki-dabber yedabber hu vegam hinne-hu yotze likratecha veraacha vesamach belibbo
Utekef rugeza daAdonai bemshe vaamar hala aharon achuch levae gele kodamay are malala yemalel hu veaf ha hu nafek lekadamutach veyechezinach veyechde velibbe:
Vedibbarta elav vesamta et-haddevarim befiv veanochi eye im-picha veim-pihu vehoreti etchem et asher taasun
Utemalel ime uteshavi yat pitgamaya befume umemri yehe im pumach veim pume vealef yatchon yat di tabedun:
Vedibber-hu lecha el-haam vehaya hu yihye-llecha lefe veatta tihye-llo lelohim
Vimalel hu lach leama vihe hu yehe lach limturgeman veat tehe le lerav:
Veet-hammatte hazze tikkach beyadecha asher taase-bbo et-haotot
Veyat chutra haden tisav bidach detabed be yat ataya:
Vayyelech moshe vayyashov el-yeter chotno vayyomer lo elcha na veashuva el-achay asher-bemitzrayim veere haodam chayyim vayyomer yitro lemoshe lech leshalom
Vaazal mshe vetav levat yeter chamohi vaamar le ezil kean veetuv levat achay di vemitzrayim veecheze haad kean kayamin vaamar yitro lemshe ezel lishlam:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe bemidyan lech shuv mitzrayim ki-metu kol-haanashim hamevakshim et-nafshecha
Vaamar Adonai lemshe bemidyan ezel tuv lemitzrayim are mitu kol guvraya divo lemiktelach:
Vayyikkach moshe et-ishto veet-banav vayyarkivem al-hachamor vayyashov artza mitzrayim vayyikkach moshe et-matte haelohim beyado
Udevar mshe yat ittete veyat benohi vearkevinun al chamara vetav leara demitzrayim unesiv mshe yat chutera deitavidu be nisin min kodam Adonai bide:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe belechtecha lashuv mitzrayma ree kol-hammoftim asher-samti veyadecha vaasitam lifne faro vaani achazzek et-libbo velo yeshallach et-haam
Vaamar Adonai lemshe bimhachach lemittuv lemitzrayim chaze kol moftaya di shaveti vidach vetabedinun kodam paro vaana atkef yat libbe vela yeshalach yat ama:
Veamarta el-paro ko amar Adonai beni vechori yisrael
Vetemar levat paro kidnan amar Adonai beri vucheri yisrael:
Vaomar elecha shallach et-beni veyaavdeni vattemaen leshallecho hinne anochi horeg et-bincha bechorecha
Vaamarit lach shalach yat beri veyiflach kodamay veim sariv at leshalachute ha ana katil yat berach bucherach:
Vayhi vadderech bammalon vayyifgeshehu Adonai vayvakkesh hamito
Vahava veorcha bevet mevata vaara be malacha daAdonai uvea lemiktele:
Vattikkach tzippora tzor vattichrot et-orlat benah vattagga leraglav vattomer ki chatan-damim atta li
Unesevat tzippora tinara ugezarat yat orlat bera ukerivat lokodamohi vaameret are vidma dimhulta haden ityehev chatna lana:
Vayyiref mimmennu az amra chatan damim lammulot
Venach mine bechen ameret ilule dema dimhulta haden itchayav chatna ketol:
Vayyomer Adonai el-aharon lech likrat moshe hammidbara vayyelech vayyifgeshehu behar haelohim vayyishshak-lo
Vaamar Adonai leaharon ezel lekadamut mshe lemadbera vaazal veare betura deitgele alohi yekara daAdonai uneshak le:
Vayyagged moshe leaharon et kol-divre Adonai asher shelacho veet kol-haotot asher tzivvahu
Vechavi mshe leaharon yat kol pitgamaya daAdonai di shalche veyat kol ataya di fakde:
Vayyelech moshe veaharon vayyaasfu et-kol-zikne bene yisrael
Vaazal mshe veaharon uchenashu yat kol save bene yisrael:
Vaydabber aharon et kol-haddevarim asher-dibber Adonai el-moshe vayyaas haotot leene haam
Umalil aharon yat kol pitgamaya di malil Adonai im mshe vaavad ataya leene ama:
Vayyaamen haam vayyishmeu ki-fakad Adonai et-bene yisrael vechi raa et-onyam vayyikkedu vayyishtachavu
Vehemin ama ushemau are dechir Adonai yat bene yisrael vaare gele kodamohi yat shibudehon ucherau usegidu:
Veachar bau moshe veaharon vayyomru el-paro ko-amar Adonai elohe yisrael shallach et-ammi veyachoggu li bammidbar
Uvatar ken alu mshe veaharon vaamaru lefaro kidnan amar Adonai elaha deyisrael shalach yat ami vichagun kodamay bemadbera:
Vayyomer paro mi Adonai asher eshma bekolo leshallach et-yisrael lo yadati et-Adonai vegam et-yisrael lo ashalleach
Vaamar paro shema daAdonai la itgeli li di akabbel lememre leshalacha yat yisrael la itgeli li shema daAdonai veaf yat yisrael la ashalach:
Vayyomru elohe haivrim nikra alenu nelcha na derech sheloshet yamim bammidbar venizbecha la-Adonai elohenu pen-yifgaenu baddever o vecharev
Vaamaru elaha dihudae itgeli alana nezel kean mahalach telata yomin bemadbera unedabbach kodam Adonai elahana dilma yearinana bemota o viktol:
Vayyomer alehem melech mitzrayim lamma moshe veaharon tafriu et-haam mimmaasav lechu lesivlotechem
Vaamar lehon malka demitzrayim lema mshe veaharon tevatlun yat ama meovadehon ezilu lefalchanchon:
Vayyomer paro hen-rabbim atta am haaretz vehishbattem otam missivlotam
Vaamar paro ha sagiin kean ama deara utevatlun yathon mippalchanhon:
Vaytzav paro bayyom hahu et-hannogsim baam veet-shotrav lemor
Ufakid paro beyoma hahu yat shiltonin deama veyat sarchohi lememar:
Lo tosifun latet teven laam lilbon hallevenim kitmol shilshom hem yelchu vekosheshu lahem teven
La tosfun lemittan tivna leama lemirme livnin kemittemale umidkamohi inun yehachun vigabbevun lehon tivna:
Veet-matkonet hallevenim asher hem osim temol shilshom tasimu alehem lo tigreu mimmennu ki-nirpim hem al-ken hem tzoakim lemor nelcha nizbecha lelohenu
Veyat sechom levenaya di inun avdin mittemale umidkamohi temanun alehon la timneun mine are vatlanin inun al ken inun tzavchin lememar nezel nedabbach kodam elahana:
Tichbad haavoda al-haanashim veyaasu-vah veal-yishu bedivre-shaker
Tittakaf palchana al guvraya veyitaskun ba vela yitaskun befitgamin betelin:
Vayyetzu nogse haam veshotrav vayyomru el-haam lemor ko amar paro enenni noten lachem teven
Unefaku shiltone ama vesarchohi vaamaru leama lememar kidnan amar paro let ana yahev lechon tivna:
Attem lechu kechu lachem teven measher timtzau ki en nigra meavodatchem davar
Attun ezilu sivu lechon tivna meatar detashkechun are la yittimna mippalchanchon midaam:
Vayyafetz haam bechol-eretz mitzrayim lekoshesh kash latteven
Veitbadar ama bechol ara demitzrayim legabbava gile letivna:
Vehannogsim atzim lemor kallu maasechem devar-yom beyomo kaasher bihyot hatteven
Veshiltonaya dachakin lememar ashlimu ovadechon pitgam yom beyome kema dahavetun avdin kad ityehev lechon tivna:
Vayyukku shotre bene yisrael asher-samu alehem nogse faro lemor maddua lo chillitem chokchem lilbon kitmol shilshom gam-temol gam-hayyom
Uleko sarche bene yisrael di maniu alehon shiltone faro lememar ma den la ashlemtun gezeratchon lemirme livnin kemeitmale umidkamohi af temale af yoma den:
Vayyavou shotre bene yisrael vayyitzaku el-paro lemor lamma taase cho laavadecha
Vaato sarche bene yisrael utzevachu kodam lefaro lememar lema tabed keden leavdaych:
Teven en nittan laavadecha ulevenim omrim lanu asu vehinne avadecha mukkim vechatat ammecha
Tivna la mityehev leavdaych ulevenaya amrin lana ividu veha avdaych lakan vechatan alehon amach:
Vayyomer nirpim attem nirpim al-ken attem omrim nelcha nizbecha la-Adonai
Vaamar batlanin attun batlanin al ken attun amrin nezel nedabbach kodam Adonai:
Veatta lechu ivdu veteven lo-yinnaten lachem vetochen levenim tittenu
Uchean ezilu felachu vetivna la yityehev lechon usechom levenaya tittenun:
Vayyiru shotre vene-yisrael otam bera lemor lo-tigreu millivnechem devar-yom beyomo
Vachazo sarche vene yisrael yathon bevish lememar la timneun milivnechon pitgam yom beyome:
Vayyifgeu et-moshe veet-aharon nitztzavim likratam betzetam meet paro
Vaarau yat mshe veyat aharon kaymin lekadamutehon bemippakhon mikodam paro:
Vayyomru alehem yere Adonai alechem veyishpot asher hivashtem et-rechenu beene faro uveene avadav latet-cherev beyadam lehorgenu
Vaamaru lehon yitgele Adonai alechon veyitpera di aveshtun yat rechana beene faro uveene avdohi lemittan charba bidehon lekatalutana:
Vayyashov moshe el-Adonai vayyomar adonay lama hareota laam hazze lamma ze shelachtani
Vetav mshe kodam Adonai vaamar Adonai lema aveshta leama haden ulema denan shelachtani:
Umeaz bati el-paro ledabber bishmecha hera laam hazze vehatztzel lo-hitztzalta et-ammecha
Umeidan alit levat paro lemalala vishmach avesh leamma haden veshezava la shezavta yat amach:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe atta tire asher eese lefaro ki veyad chazaka yeshallechem uveyad chazaka yegarshem meartzo
Vaamar Adonai lemshe kean techeze deebed lefaro are vida takifa yeshalchinun uvida takifa yetarechinun meare:
Vaydabber elohim el-moshe vayyomer elav ani Adonai
Umallil Adonai im mshe vaamar leh ana Adonai:
Vaera el-avraham el-yitzchak veel-yaakov beel shadday ushemi Adonai lo nodati lahem
Veitgeleti leavraham leyitzchak uleyaakov beel shadday ushemi Adonai la hodait lehon:
Vegam hakimoti et-beriti ittam latet lahem et-eretz kenaan et eretz megurehem asher-garu vah
Veaf akemit yat keyami immehon lemittan lehon yat ara dichnaan yat ara totavutehon deittotavu va:
Vegam ani shamati et-naakat bene yisrael asher mitzrayim maavidim otam vaezkor et-beriti
Veaf kodamay shemia yat kevelat bene yisrael di mitzrae maflechin behon vedachirna yat keyami:
Lachen emor livne-yisrael ani Adonai vehotzeti etchem mittachat sivlot mitzrayim vehitztzalti etchem meavodatam vegaalti etchem bizroa netuya uvishfatim gedolim
Bechen emar livne yisrael ana Adonai veappek yatchon miggo dechok palchan mitzrae veeshezev yatchon mippalchanhon veefrok yatchon bidraa merama uvedinin ravrevin:
Velakachti etchem li leam vehayiti lachem lelohim vidatem ki ani Adonai elohechem hammotzi etchem mittachat sivlot mitzrayim
Veekarev yatchon kodamay leamma veeheve lechon leelah vetiddeun are ana Adonai elahachon deappek yatchon miggo dechok palchan mitzrayim:
Veheveti etchem el-haaretz asher nasati et-yadi latet otah leavraham leyitzchak uleyaakov venatatti otah lachem morasha ani Adonai
Veael yatchon leara di kayyemit bememri lemittan yata leavraham leyitzchak uleyaakov veetten yata lechon yerutta ana Adonai:

Umallel mshe ken livne yisrael vela kabbilu min mshe mimmayak rucha umippalchana dahava kashya alehon:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Bo dabber el-paro melech mitzrayim vishallach et-bene-yisrael meartzo
Ul mallel levat paro malka demitzrayim vishallach yat bene yisrael meareh:
Vaydabber moshe lifne Adonai lemor hen bene-yisrael lo-shamu elay veech yishmaeni faro vaani aral sefatayim
Umallil mshe kodam Adonai lememar ha vene yisrael la kabbilu minni veechden yekabbel minni faro vaana yakkir mamlal:

Umallil Adonai im mshe veim aharon ufakkedinnun levat bene yisrael ulevat paro malka demitzrayim leappaka yat bene yisrael meara demitzrayim:

Illen reshe vet avahathon bene reuven buchera deyisrael chanoch ufallu chetzron vecharmi illen zarayat reuven:

Uvene merari machli umushi illen zarayat levi letuledathon:

Uvene yitzhar korach vanefeg vezichri:

Uvene uzziel mishael veeltzafan vesitri:

Unesiv aharon yat elisheva bat amminadav achateh denachshon leh leintu vilidat leh yat nadav veyat avihu yat elazar veyat itamar:

Uvene korach assir veelkana vaaviasaf illen zarayat korach:

Veelazar bar aharon nesiv leh mibbenat putiel leh leintu vilidat leh yat pinchas illen reshe avahat levae lezarayathon:
Hu aharon umoshe asher amar Adonai lahem hotziu et-bene yisrael meeretz mitzrayim al-tzivotam
Hu aharon umshe di amar Adonai lehon appiku yat bene yisrael meara demitzrayim al chelehon:
Hem hamedabberim el-paro melech-mitzrayim lehotzi et-bene-yisrael mimmitzrayim hu moshe veaharon
Innun demallelin im paro malka demitzrayim leappaka yat bene yisrael mimmitzrayim hu mshe veaharon:
Vayhi beyom dibber Adonai el-moshe beeretz mitzrayim
Vahava beyoma demallil Adonai im mshe beara demitzrayim:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor ani Adonai dabber el-paro melech mitzrayim et kol-asher ani dover elecha
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar ana Adonai mallel im paro malka demitzrayim yat kol di ana memallel immach:
Vayyomer moshe lifne Adonai hen ani aral sefatayim veech yishma elay paro
Vaamar mshe kodam Adonai ha ana yakkir mamlal veechden yekabbel minni paro:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe ree netatticha elohim lefaro veaharon achicha yihye neviecha
Vaamar Adonai lemshe chaze mannetach rav lefaro veaharon achuch yehe meturgemanach:
Atta tedabber et kol-asher atzavvekka veaharon achicha yedabber el-paro veshillach et-bene-yisrael meartzo
At temallel yat kol di afakkedinnach veaharon achuch yemallel im paro vishallach yat bene yisrael meareh:
Vaani akshe et-lev paro vehirbeti et-ototay veet-moftay beeretz mitzrayim
Vaana akshe yat libba defaro veasgeti yat atvatay veyat moftay beara demitzrayim:
Velo-yishma alechem paro venatatti et-yadi bemitzrayim vehotzeti et-tzivotay et-ammi vene-yisrael meeretz mitzrayim bishfatim gedolim
Vela yekabbel minnechon paro veetten yat machat gevurti bemitzrayim veappek yat cheli yat ammi vene yisrael meara demitzrayim bedinin ravrevin:
Veyadu mitzrayim ki-ani Adonai bintoti et-yadi al-mitzrayim vehotzeti et-bene-yisrael mittocham
Veyiddeun mitzrayim are ana Adonai kad arem yat machat gevurti al mitzrayim veappek yat bene yisrael mibbenehon:
Vayyaas moshe veaharon kaasher tzivva Adonai otam ken asu
Vaavad mshe veaharon kema difakkid Adonai yathon ken avadu:
Umoshe ben-shemonim shana veaharon ben-shalosh ushemonim shana bedabberam el-paro
Umshe bar temanan shenin veaharon bar temanan utelat shenin bemallalutehon im paro:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe veel-aharon lemor
Vaamar Adonai lemshe uleaharon lememar:
Ki yedabber alechem paro lemor tenu lachem mofet veamarta el-aharon kach et-mattecha vehashlech lifne-faro yehi letannin
Are yemallel levatchon paro lememar havu lechon ata vetemar leaharon sav yat chuterach ureme kodam paro yehi letannina:
Vayyavo moshe veaharon el-paro vayyaasu chen kaasher tzivva Adonai vayyashlech aharon et-mattehu lifne faro velifne avadav vayhi letannin
Veal mshe veaharon levat paro vaavadu chen kema defakked Adonai urema aharon yat chutereh kodam paro vekadam avdohi vahava letannina:
Vayyikra gam-paro lachachamim velamchashshefim vayyaasu gam-hem chartumme mitzrayim belahatehem ken
Ukera af paro lechakkimayya ulecharashayya vaavadu af innun charashe mitzrayim belachashehon ken:
Vayyashlichu ish mattehu vayyihyu letanninim vayyivla matte-aharon et-mattotam
Uremo gevar chutereh vahavo letanninayya uvela chutra deaharon yat chutrehon:
Vayyechezak lev paro velo shama alehem kaasher dibber Adonai
Veittakkaf libba defaro vela kabbil minnehon kema dimallil Adonai:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe kaved lev paro meen leshallach haam
Vaamar Adonai lemshe ityakkar lfrshy" yakkir libba defaro sariv leshallacha amma:
Lech el-paro babboker hinne yotze hammayma venitztzavta likrato al-sefat hayeor vehammatte asher-nepach lenachash tikkach beyadecha
Izzel levat paro betzafra ha nafek lemayya vetitattad lekaddamuteh al kef nahara vechutra deithafich lechivya tissav bidach:
Veamarta elav Adonai elohe haivrim shelachani elecha lemor shallach et-ammi veyaavduni bammidbar vehinne lo-shamata ad-ko
Vetemar leh Adonai elaha dihudae shallechani levatach lememar shallach yat ammi veyiflechun kodamay bemadbera veha la kabbelta ad kean:
Ko amar Adonai bezot teda ki ani Adonai hinne anochi makke bammatte asher-beyadi al-hammayim asher bayor venehefchu ledam
Kidnan amar Adonai beda tidda are ana Adonai ha ana mache bechutra di vidi al mayya di venahara veyithappechun lidma:
Vehaddaga asher-bayor tamut uvaash hayeor venilu mitzrayim lishtot mayim min-hayeor
Venune di venahara temut useri nahara veyilun mitzrae lemishte mayya min nahara:

Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe emor el-aharon kach mattecha unete-yadcha al-meme mitzrayim al-naharotam al-yeorehem veal-agmehem veal kol-mikve memehem veyihyu-dam vehaya dam bechol-eretz mitzrayim uvaetzim uvaavanim

Vaamar Adonai lemshe emar leaharon tol chutrach vaarem yedach al mayya demitzrayim al naharehon al arittehon veal agmehon veal kol bet kenishut memehon vihon dema vihe dema bechol ara demitzrayim uvemane aa uvemane avna:
Vayyaasu-chen moshe veaharon kaasher tzivva Adonai vayyarem bammatte vayyach et-hammayim asher bayor leene faro uleene avadav vayyehafchu kol-hammayim asher-bayor ledam
Vaavadu chen mshe veaharon kema defakkid Adonai vaarem bechutra umecha yat mayya di venahara leene faro uleene avdohi veithafichu kol mayya di venahara lidma:
Vehaddaga asher-bayor meta vayyivash hayeor velo-yachlu mitzrayim lishtot mayim min-hayeor vayhi haddam bechol-eretz mitzrayim
Venune di venahara mitu useri nahara vela yechilu mitzrae lemishte mayya min nahara vahava dema bechol ara demitzrayim:
Vayyaasu-chen chartumme mitzrayim belatehem vayyechezak lev-paro velo-shama alehem kaasher dibber Adonai
Vaavadu chen charashe mitzrayim belachashehon veittakkaf libba defaro vela kabbel minnehon kema dimallil Adonai:
Vayyifen paro vayyavo el-beto velo-shat libbo gam-lazot
Veitpeni faro veal leveteh vela shavvi libbeh af leda:

Vachafaru chol mitzrae sacharanut nahara mayya lemishte are la yechilu lemishte mimmayya denahara:
Vayyimmale shivat yamim achare hakkot-Adonai et-hayeor
Veashlem shivat yomin batar dimcha Adonai yat nahara:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe bo el-paro veamarta elav ko amar Adonai shallach et-ammi veyaavduni
Vaamar Adonai lemshe ul levat paro vetemar leh kidnan amar Adonai shallach yat ammi veyiflechun kodamay:
Veim-maen atta leshalleach hinne anochi nogef et-kol-gevulecha batzfardeim
Veim sariv at leshallacha ha ana mache yat kol techumach beurdeanayya:
Vesharatz hayeor tzefardeim vealu uvau bevetecha uvachadar mishkavcha veal-mittatecha uvevet avadecha uveammecha uvetannurecha uvemisharotecha
Virabbe nahara urdeanayya veyissekun veyeelun bevetach uveidderon bet mishkevach veal arsach uvevet avdaych uveammach uvetannurach uveatzvatach:
Uvecha uveammecha uvechol-avadecha yaalu hatzfardeim
Uvach uveammach uvechol avdaych yissekun urdeanayya:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe emor el-aharon nete et-yadcha bemattecha al-hanneharot al-hayeorim veal-haagammim vehaal et-hatzfardeim al-eretz mitzrayim
Vaamar Adonai lemshe emar leaharon arem yat yedach bechutrach al naharayya al arittayya veal agmayya veassek yat urdeanayya al ara demitzrayim:
Vayyet aharon et-yado al meme mitzrayim vattaal hatztzefardea vattechas et-eretz mitzrayim
Vaarem aharon yat yedeh al mayya demitzrae uselekat urdeanayya vachafat yat ara demitzrayim:
Vayyaasu-chen hachartummim belatehem vayyaalu et-hatzfardeim al-eretz mitzrayim
Vaavadu chen charashayya belachashehon veassiku yat urdeanayya al ara demitzrayim:
Vayyikra faro lemoshe uleaharon vayyomer hatiru el-Adonai veyaser hatzfardeim mimmenni umeammi vaashallecha et-haam veyizbechu la-Adonai
Ukera faro lemshe uleaharon vaamar tzallo kodam Adonai veyade urdeanayya minni umeammi veeshlach yat amma veyidbechun kodam Adonai:
Vayyomer moshe lefaro hitpaer alay lematay atir lecha velaavadecha uleammecha lehachrit hatzfardeim mimmecha umibbattecha rak bayor tishshaarna
Vaamar mshe lefaro sheal lach gevura hav li zeman leimmatay etzalle alach veal avdaych veal ammach leshetzaa urdeanayya minnach umibbattaych lechod benahara tishtaaran:
Vayyomer lemachar vayyomer kidvarcha lemaan teda ki-en ka-Adonai elohenu
Vaamar limchar vaamar kefitgamach bedil detidda are let kayya elahana:
Vesaru hatzfardeim mimmecha umibbattecha umeavadecha umeammecha rak bayor tishshaarna
Veyedun urdeanayya minnach umibbattaych umeavdaych umeammach lechod benahara yishtaaran:
Vayyetze moshe veaharon meim paro vayyitzak moshe el-Adonai al-devar hatzfardeim asher-sam lefaro
Unefak mshe veaharon millevat paro vetzalli mshe kodam Adonai al esak urdeanayya di shavvi lefaro:
Vayyaas Adonai kidvar moshe vayyamutu hatzfardeim min-habbattim min-hachatzerot umin-hassadot
Vaavad Adonai kefitgama demshe umitu urdeanayya min battayya min darata umin chaklata:
Vayyitzberu otam chomarim chomarim vattivash haaretz
Uchenashu yathon degorin degorin useriu al ara:
Vayyar paro ki hayta harvacha vehachbed et-libbo velo shama alehem kaasher dibber Adonai
Vachaza faro are havat revachta veyityakkar yat libbeh vela kabbil minnehon kema dimallil Adonai:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe emor el-aharon nete et-mattecha vehach et-afar haaretz vehaya lechinnim bechol-eretz mitzrayim
Vaamar Adonai lemshe emar leaharon arem yat chutrach umecha yat afra deara vihe lekalmeta bechol ara demitzrayim:
Vayyaasu-chen vayyet aharon et-yado vemattehu vayyach et-afar haaretz vattehi hakkinnam baadam uvabbehema kol-afar haaretz haya chinnim bechol-eretz mitzrayim
Vaavadu chen vaarem aharon yat yedeh bechutreh umecha yat afra deara vahavat kalmeta baanasha uvivira kol afra deara havat kalmeta bechol ara demitzrayim:
Vayyaasu-chen hachartummim belatehem lehotzi et-hakkinnim velo yacholu vattehi hakkinnam baadam uvabbehema
Vaavadu chen charashayya belachashehon leappaka yat kalmeta vela yachilu vahavat kalmeta baanasha uvivira:
Vayyomru hachartummim el-paro etzba elohim hiv vayyechezak lev-paro velo-shama alehem kaasher dibber Adonai
Vaamaru charashayya lefaro ha macha min kodam Adonai hi veittakkaf libba defaro vela kabbil minnehon kema dimallil Adonai:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe hashkem babboker vehityatztzev lifne faro hinne yotze hammayma veamarta elav ko amar Adonai shallach ammi veyaavduni
Vaamar Adonai lemshe akdem betzafra veitattad kodam paro ha nafek lemayya vetemar leh kidnan amar Adonai shallach ammi veyiflechun kodamay:
Ki im-encha meshalleach et-ammi hinni mashliach becha uvaavadecha uveammecha uvevattecha et-hearov umalu batte mitzrayim et-hearov vegam haadama asher-hem aleha
Are im letach meshallach yat ammi ha ana mashlach bach uveavdaych uveammach uvevattaych yat arova veyimlun batte mitzrayim yat arova veaf ara diinnun ala:
Vehifleti vayyom hahu et-eretz goshen asher ammi omed aleha levilti heyot-sham arov lemaan teda ki ani Adonai bekerev haaretz
Veafresh beyoma hahu yat ara degshen diammi kaim ala bedil dela lemeheve tamman arova bedil detidda are ana Adonai shallit bego ara:
Vesamti fedut ben ammi uven ammecha lemachar yihye haot hazze
Veeshavve furekan leammi veal ammach ayti macha limchar yehe ata haden:
Vayyaas Adonai ken vayyavo arov kaved beta faro uvet avadav uvechol-eretz mitzrayim tishshachet haaretz mippene hearov
Vaavad Adonai ken vaata arova takkif levet paro ulevet avdohi uvechol ara demitzrayim itchabbalat ara min kodam arova:
Vayyikra faro el-moshe uleaharon vayyomer lechu zivchu lelohechem baaretz
Ukera faro lemshe uleaharon vaamar ezilu dabbachu kodam elahachon beara:
Vayyomer moshe lo nachon laasot ken ki toavat mitzrayim nizbach la-Adonai elohenu hen nizbach et-toavat mitzrayim leenehem velo yiskelunu

Vaamar mshe la takken lemebad ken are veira demitzrae dachalin leh minneh anachna nasvin ledabbacha kodam Adonai elahana ha nedabbach yat beira demitzrae dachalin leh veinnun yehon chazan hala yemrun lemirgemana:
Derech sheloshet yamim nelech bammidbar vezavachnu la-Adonai elohenu kaasher yomar elenu
Mahalach telata yomin nezil bemadbera unedabbach kodam Adonai elahana kema diyemar lana:
Vayyomer paro anochi ashallach etchem uzevachtem la-Adonai elohechem bammidbar rak harchek lo-tarchiku lalechet hatiru baadi
Vaamar paro ana ashallach yatchon vetidbechun kodam Adonai elahachon bemadbera lechod archaka la terachakun lemezal tzallo af alay:
Vayyomer moshe hinne anochi yotze meimmach vehatarti el-Adonai vesar hearov mipparo meavadav umeammo machar rak al-yosef paro hatel levilti shallach et-haam lizboach la-Adonai
Vaamar mshe ha ana nafek meimmach veetzalle kodam Adonai veyade arova mipparo meavdohi umeammeh mechar lechod la yosef paro leshakkara bedil dela leshallacha yat amma ledabbacha kodam Adonai:
Vayyetze moshe meim paro vayyetar el-Adonai
Unefak mshe min kodam paro vetzalli kodam Adonai:
Vayyaas Adonai kidvar moshe vayyasar hearov mipparo meavadav umeammo lo nishar echad
Vaavad Adonai kefitgama demshe veadi arova mipparo meavdohi umeammeh la ishtaar chad:
Vayyachbed paro et-libbo gam bappaam hazzot velo shillach et-haam
Veyakkar paro yat libbeh af bezimna hada vela shallach yat amma:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe bo el-paro vedibbarta elav ko-amar Adonai elohe haivrim shallach et-ammi veyaavduni
Vaamar Adonai lemshe ul levat paro utemallel immeh kidnan amar Adonai elaha dihudae shallach yat ammi veyiflechun kodamay:
Ki im-maen atta leshalleach veodcha machazik bam
Are im sariv at leshallacha vead kean at matkef behon:
Hinne yad-Adonai hoya bemiknecha asher bassade bassusim bachamorim baggemallim babbakar uvatztzon dever kaved meod
Ha macha min kodam Adonai havya bivirach divchakla besusavata bachamare begamle betore uveana mota takkif lachada:
Vehifla Adonai ben mikne yisrael uven mikne mitzrayim velo yamut mikkol-livne yisrael davar
Veafresh Adonai ben beira deyisrael uven beira demitzrayim vela yemut mikkol livne yisrael middaam:
Vayyasem Adonai moed lemor machar yaase Adonai haddavar hazze baaretz
Veshavvi Adonai zimna lememar mechar yabed Adonai pitgama haden beara:
Vayyaas Adonai et-haddavar hazze mimmochorat vayyamot kol mikne mitzrayim umimmikne vene-yisrael lo-met echad
Vaavad Adonai yat pitgama haden beyoma devatrohi umit kol beira demitzrayim umibbeira divne yisrael la mit chad:
Vayyishlach paro vehinne lo-met mimmikne yisrael ad-echad vayyichbad lev paro velo shillach et-haam
Ushelach paro veha la mit mibbeira deyisrael ad chad veityakkar libba defaro vela shallach yat amma:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe veel-aharon kechu lachem melo chofnechem piach kivshan uzerako moshe hashshamayma leene faro
Vaamar Adonai lemshe uleaharon sivu lechon mele chofnechon picha deattuna veyizrekinneh mshe letzet shemayya leene faro
Vehaya leavak al kol-eretz mitzrayim vehaya al-haadam veal-habbehema lishchin poreach avabuot bechol-eretz mitzrayim
Vihe leavka al kol ara demitzrayim vihe al anasha veal beira leshichana saggi avabuin bechol ara demitzrayim:
Vayyikchu et-piach hakkivshan vayyaamdu lifne faro vayyizrok oto moshe hashshamayma vayhi shechin avabuot poreach baadam uvabbehema
Unesivu yat picha deattuna vekamu kodam paro uzerak yateh mshe letzet shemayya vahava shichana avabuin sage baanasha uvivira:
Velo-yachlu hachartummim laamod lifne moshe mippene hashshechin ki-haya hashshechin bachartummim uvechol-mitzrayim
Vela yachilu charashayya lemekam kodam mshe min kodam shichana are hava shichana becharashayya uvechol mitzrae:
Vaychazzek Adonai et-lev paro velo shama alehem kaasher dibber Adonai el-moshe
Vetakkif Adonai yat libba defaro vela kabbil minnehon kema demallel Adonai im mshe:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe hashkem babboker vehityatztzev lifne faro veamarta elav ko-amar Adonai elohe haivrim shallach et-ammi veyaavduni
Vaamar Adonai lemshe akdem betzafra veitattad kodam paro vetemar leh kidnan amar Adonai elaha dihudae shallach yat ammi veyiflechun kodamay:
Ki bappaam hazzot ani sholeach et-kol-maggefotay el-libbecha uvaavadecha uveammecha baavur teda ki en kamoni bechol-haaretz
Are bezimna hada ana shalach yat kol mechatay lelibbach uveavdaych uveammach bedil detidda are let dichvati shallit bechol ara:
Ki atta shalachti et-yadi vaach otcha veet-ammecha baddaver vattikkached min-haaretz
Are chean kerev kodamay deeshlach pon yat machat gevurti veemche yatach veyat ammach bemota veshetziat min ara:
Veulam baavur zot heemadticha baavur harotcha et-kochi ulemaan sapper shemi bechol-haaretz
Uveram bedil da kayyemittach bedil leachazayutach yat cheli uvedil dihon mishtaan gevurat shemi bechol ara:
Odcha mistolel beammi levilti shallecham
Ad kean at keveshat beh beammi bedil dela leshallachutehon:
Hinni mamtir kaet machar barad kaved meod asher lo-haya chamohu bemitzrayim lemin-hayyom hivvasda vead-atta
Ha ana machet mitra beiddana haden mechar barda takkif lachada di la hava dichvateh bemitzrayim lemin yoma deishtachlalat vead kean:
Veatta shelach haez et-miknecha veet kol-asher lecha bassade kol-haadam vehabbehema asher-yimmatze vassade velo yeasef habbayta veyarad alehem habbarad vametu
Uchean shelach kenosh yat beirach veyat kol di lach bechakla kol anasha uveira deishtechach bechakla vela yitkenesh leveta veyechot alehon barda vimutun:
Hayyare et-devar Adonai meavde paro henis et-avadav veet-miknehu el-habbattim
Dedachil mippitgama daAdonai meavde paro kenash yat avdohi veyat getohi levattayya:
Vaasher lo-sam libbo el-devar Adonai vayyaazov et-avadav veet-miknehu bassade
Vedi la shavvi libbeh lefitgama daAdonai shevak yat avdohi veyat getohi bechakla:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe nete et-yadcha al-hashshamayim vihi varad bechol-eretz mitzrayim al-haadam veal-habbehema veal kol-esev hassade beeretz mitzrayim
Vaamar Adonai lemshe arem yat yedach al tzet shemayya vihe varda bechol ara demitzrae al anasha veal beira veal kol esba dechakla beara demitzrayim:
Vayyet moshe et-mattehu al-hashshamayim va-Adonai natan kolot uvarad vattihalach esh artza vayyamter Adonai barad al-eretz mitzrayim
Vaarem mshe yat chutreh al tzet shemayya vayya yehav kalin uvarda umehallecha eshshata al ara veamtar Adonai barda al ara demitzrayim:
Vayhi varad veesh mitlakkachat betoch habbarad kaved meod asher lo-haya chamohu bechol-eretz mitzrayim meaz hayta legoy
Vahava varda veeshshata mishtalhavat bego varda takkif lachada di la hava dichvateh bechol ara demitzrayim meiddan dahavat leam:
Vayyach habbarad bechol-eretz mitzrayim et kol-asher bassade meadam vead-behema veet kol-esev hassade hikka habbarad veet-kol-etz hassade shibber
Umecha varda bechol ara demitzrayim yat kol di vechakla meanasha vead beira veyat kol esba dechakla mecha varda veyat kol ilan divchakla tevar:
Rak beeretz goshen asher-sham bene yisrael lo haya barad
Lechod beara degshen di tamman bene yisrael la hava barda:
Vayyishlach paro vayyikra lemoshe uleaharon vayyomer alehem chatati happaam Adonai hatztzaddik vaani veammi harshaim
Ushelach paro ukera lemshe uleaharon vaamar lehon chavit zimna hada Adonai zakkaa vaana veammi chayyavin:
Hatiru el-Adonai verav mihyot kolot elohim uvarad vaashallecha etchem velo tosifun laamod
Tzallo kodam Adonai vesaggi kodamohi revach dela yehon alana kalin dilvat keillen min kodam Adonai uvarda veeshlach yatchon vela tosfun leitakkava:
Vayyomer elav moshe ketzeti et-hair efros et-kappay el-Adonai hakkolot yechdalun vehabbarad lo yihye-od lemaan teda ki la-Adonai haaretz
Vaamar leh mshe kemippeki min karta efros yeday bitzlo kodam Adonai kalayya yitmanneun uvarda la yehe od bedil detidda are daAdonai ara:
Veatta vaavadecha yadati ki terem tirun mippene Adonai elohim
Veat veavdaych yedana are ad kean la itkenatun min kodam Adonai ellohim:
Vehappishta vehasseora nukkata ki hasseora aviv vehappishta givol
Vechittana vesaare leko are saranya abbivin vechittana gavolin:
Vehachitta vehakkussemet lo nukku ki afilot henna
Vechittaa vechuntayya la leko are afilata innun:
Vayyetze moshe meim paro et-hair vayyifros kappav el-Adonai vayyachdelu hakkolot vehabbarad umatar lo-nittach artza
Unefak mshe millevat paro yat karta uferas yedohi bitzlo kodam Adonai veyitmanneun kalayya uvarda umitra dahava nachit la meta al ara:
Vayyar paro ki-chadal hammatar vehabbarad vehakkolot vayyosef lachato vayyachbed libbo hu vaavadav
Vachaza faro are itmena mitra uvarda vekalayya veosef lemechete veyakkereh lelibbeh hu veavdohi:
Vayyechezak lev paro velo shillach et-bene yisrael kaasher dibber Adonai beyad-moshe
Veittakkaf libba defaro vela shallach yat bene yisrael kema di mallel Adonai bida demshe:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe bo el-paro ki-ani hichbadti et-libbo veet-lev avadav lemaan shiti ototay elle bekirbo
Vaamar Adonai lemshe ul levat paro are ana yakarit yat libbe veyat libba deavdohi bedil leshavaa atay ilen benehon:
Ulemaan tesapper beozne vincha uven-bincha et asher hitallalti bemitzrayim veet-ototay asher-samti vam vidatem ki-ani Adonai
Uvedil detishtae kodam berach uvar berach yat nisin di avadit bemitzrayim veyat atvatay di shaveti vehon vetidun are ana Adonai:
Vayyavo moshe veaharon el-paro vayyomru elav ko-amar Adonai elohe haivrim ad-matay meanta leanot mippanay shallach ammi veyaavduni
Vaata mshe veaharon levat paro vaamaru le kidnan amar Adonai elaha dihudae ad imatay mesarev at leitkenaa min kodamay shalach ami veyiflechun kodamay:
Ki im-maen atta leshalleach et-ammi hinni mevi machar arbe bigvulecha
Are im sarev at leshalacha yat ami ha ana mayyti mechar gova bitchumach:
Vechissa et-en haaretz velo yuchal lirot et-haaretz veachal et-yeter happeleta hannisheret lachem min-habbarad veachal et-kol-haetz hatztzomeach lachem min-hassade
Vachafa yat en shimsha deara vela yikkul lemecheze yat ara veyechul yat shear shezavta deishtaar lechon min barda veyechul yat kol ilana deatzmach lechon min chakla:
Umalu vattecha uvatte chol-avadecha uvatte chol-mitzrayim asher lo-rau avotecha vaavot avotecha miyyom heyotam al-haadama ad hayyom hazze vayyifen vayyetze meim paro
Veyimlun battaych uvatte chol avdaych uvatte chol mitzrayim di la chazo avahatach vaavahat avahatach miyoma demehevehon al ara ad yoma haden veitpeni unefak min kodam paro:
Vayyomru avde faro elav ad-matay yihye ze lanu lemokesh shallach et-haanashim veyaavdu et-Adonai elohehem haterem teda ki avda mitzrayim
Vaamaru avde faro le ad imatay yehe den lana letakla shalach yat guvraya veyiflechun kodam Adonai elahahon haad kean la yedata are avedat mitzrayim:
Vayyushav et-moshe veet-aharon el-paro vayyomer alehem lechu ivdu et-Adonai elohechem mi vami haholchim
Veittotav yat mshe veyat aharon levat paro vaamar lehon ezilu felachu kodam Adonai elahachon man uman deazlin:
Vayyomer moshe binarenu uvizkenenu nelech bevanenu uvivnotenu betzonenu uvivkarenu nelech ki chag-Adonai lanu
Vaamar mshe beulemanna uvesavanna nezel bevanana uvivnatana beanana uvetorana nezel are chaga kodam Adonai lana:
Vayyomer alehem yehi chen Adonai immachem kaasher ashallach etchem veet-tappechem reu ki raa neged penechem
Vaamar lehon yehe chen memra daAdonai besadechon kad ashshalach yatchon veyat taflechon chazo are visha deattun sevirin lemebad lokovel appechon leistachara:
Lo chen lechu-na haggevarim veivdu et-Adonai ki otah attem mevakshim vaygaresh otam meet pene faro
La chen ezilu chean guvraya ufelachu kodam Adonai are yata attun baan vetarich yathon min kodam paro:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe nete yadcha al-eretz mitzrayim baarbe veyaal al-eretz mitzrayim veyochal et-kol-esev haaretz et kol-asher hishir habbarad
Vaamar Adonai lemshe arem yedach al ara demitzrayim veyete gova veyisak al ara demitzrayim veyechul yat kol isba deara yat kol di ashar barda:
Vayyet moshe et-mattehu al-eretz mitzrayim va-Adonai nihag ruach-kadim baaretz kol-hayyom hahu vechol-hallayla habboker haya veruach hakkadim nasa et-haarbe
Vaarem mshe yat chutre al ara demitzrayim vaAdonai dabbar ruach kiduma beara kol yoma hahu vechol lelya tzafra hava veruach kiduma netal yat gova:
Vayyaal haarbe al kol-eretz mitzrayim vayyanach bechol gevul mitzrayim kaved meod lefanav lo-haya chen arbe kamohu veacharav lo yihye-kken
Uselek gova al kol ara demitzrayim ushera bechol techum mitzrayim takif lachada kodamohi la hava chen gova dichvate uvatrohi la yehe chen:
Vaychas et-en kol-haaretz vattechshach haaretz vayyochal et-kol-esev haaretz veet kol-peri haetz asher hotir habbarad velo-notar kol-yerek baetz uveesev hassade bechol-eretz mitzrayim
Vachafa yat en shimsha dechal ara vachashochat ara vaachal yat kol esba deara veyat kol pere ilana di ashar barda vela ishtaar kol yaroka beilana uveesba dechakla bechol ara demitzrayim:
Vaymaher paro likro lemoshe uleaharon vayyomer chatati la-Adonai elohechem velachem
Veochi faro lemikre lemshe uleaharon vaamar chavit kodam Adonai elahachon ulechon:
Veatta sa na chattati ach happaam vehatiru la-Adonai elohechem veyaser mealay rak et-hammavet hazze
Uchean shevok kean lechovi beram zimna hada vetzalo kadam Adonai elahachon veyade mini lechod yat mota haden:
Vayyetze meim paro vayyetar el-Adonai
Unefak milvat paro vetzali kodam Adonai:
Vayyahafoch Adonai ruach-yam chazak meod vayyissa et-haarbe vayyitkaehu yamma suf lo nishar arbe echad bechol gevul mitzrayim
Vahafach Adonai rucha maarva takif lachada unetal yat gova uremahi leyama desuf la ishtaar gova chad bechol techum mitzrayim:
Vaychazzek Adonai et-lev paro velo shillach et-bene yisrael
Veatkef Adonai yat libba defaro vela shalach yat bene yisrael:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe nete yadcha al-hashshamayim vihi choshech al-eretz mitzrayim veyamesh choshech
Vaamar Adonai lemshe arem yedach al tzet shemaya vihe chashocha al ara demitzrayim batar deyade kevel lelya:
Vayyet moshe et-yado al-hashshamayim vayhi choshech-afela bechol-eretz mitzrayim sheloshet yamim
Vaarem mshe yat yede al tzet shemaya vahava chashoch kevel bechol ara demitzrayim telata yomin:
Lo-rau ish et-achiv velo-kamu ish mittachtav sheloshet yamim ulechol-bene yisrael haya or bemoshvotam
La chazo enash yat achohi vela kamu enash mittechotohi telata yomin ulechal bene yisrael hava nehora bemotvanhon:
Vayyikra faro el-moshe vayyomer lechu ivdu et-Adonai rak tzonchem uvekarchem yutztzag gam-tappechem yelech immachem
Ukera faro lemshe vaamar ezilu pelachu kodam Adonai lechod anchon vetorchon shevuku af taflechon yezel imchon:
Vayyomer moshe gam-atta titten beyadenu zevachim veolot veasinu la-Adonai elohenu
Vaamar mshe af at timsar bidana nichsat kudshin vaalavan venabed kodam Adonai elahana:
Vegam-miknenu yelech immanu lo tishshaer parsa ki mimmennu nikkach laavod et-Adonai elohenu vaanachnu lo-neda ma-nnaavod et-Adonai ad-boenu shamma
Veaf beirana yezel imana la tishtaar midaam are mine anachna nasvin lemiflach kodam Adonai elahana vaanachna let anachna yadin ma niflach kodam Adonai ad metana taman:
Vaychazzek Adonai et-lev paro velo ava leshallecham
Veatkef Adonai yat libba defaro vela ava leshalachutehon:
Vayyomer-lo faro lech mealay hishshamer lecha al-tosef reot panay ki beyom reotcha fanay tamut
Vaamar le paro izel meilavay istamar lach la tosif lemecheze appay are beyoma detecheze appay temut:
Vayyomer moshe ken dibbarta lo-osif od reot panecha
Vaamar mshe yaut malelta la osif od lemecheze appaych:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe od nega echad avi al-paro veal-mitzrayim achare-chen yeshallach etchem mizze keshallecho kala garesh yegaresh etchem mizze
Vaamar Adonai lemshe od machtash chad ayti al paro veal mitzrayim batar ken yeshalach yatchon mikka keshalachute gemera taracha yetarech yatchon mikka:
Dabber-na beozne haam veyishalu ish meet reehu veishsha meet reutah kele-chesef uchele zahav
Malel kean kodam ama veyishalun gevar min chavre veitteta min chaverta manin dichsaf umanin didhav:
Vayyitten Adonai et-chen haam beene mitzrayim gam haish moshe gadol meod beeretz mitzrayim beene avde-faro uveene haam
Vihav Adonai yat ama lerachamin beene mitzrayim af gavra mshe rav lachada beara demitzrayim beene avde faro uveene ama:
Vayyomer moshe ko amar Adonai kachatzot hallayla ani yotze betoch mitzrayim
Vaamar mshe kidnan amar Adonai kefalgut lelya ana mitgeli bego mitzrayim:
Umet kol-bechor beeretz mitzrayim mibbechor paro hayyoshev al-kiso ad bechor hashshifcha asher achar harechayim vechol bechor behema
Vimut kol buchera beara demitzrayim mibbuchera defaro deatid lemittav al karse malchute ad buchera deamta di batar rechya vechol buchera divira:
Vehayta tzeaka gedola bechol-eretz mitzrayim asher kamohu lo nihyata vechamohu lo tosif
Utehe tzevachta rabba bechol ara demitzrayim dichvate la havat vedichvate la tosef:
Ulechol bene yisrael lo yecheratz-kelev leshono lemeish vead-behema lemaan tedun asher yafle Adonai ben mitzrayim uven yisrael
Ulechol bene yisrael la yanzek kalba belishne leminbach lemeanasha vead beira bedil detidun deyafresh Adonai ben mitzrayim uven yisrael:
Veyardu chol-avadecha elle elay vehishtachavu-li lemor tze atta vechol-haam asher-beraglecha veachare-chen etze vayyetze meim-paro bochori-af
Veyechetun kol avdaych ilen levati veyivon mini lememar puk at vechol ama di imach uvatar ken eppok unefak milvat paro bitkof regaz:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe lo-yishma alechem paro lemaan revot moftay beeretz mitzrayim
Vaamar Adonai lemshe la yekabbel minchon paro bedil leasgaa moftay beara demitzrayim:
Umoshe veaharon asu et-kol-hammoftim haelle lifne faro vaychazzek Adonai et-lev paro velo-shillach et-bene-yisrael meartzo
Umshe veaharon avadu yat kol moftaya hailen kodam paro veatkef Adonai yat libba defaro vela shalach yat bene yisrael meare:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe veel-aharon beeretz mitzrayim lemor
Vaamar Adonai lemshe uleaharon beara demitzrayim lememar:
Hachodesh hazze lachem rosh chodashim rishon hu lachem lechodshe hashshana
Yarcha haden lechon resh yarchin kadmay hu lechon leyarche shatta:
Dabberu el-kol-adat yisrael lemor beasor lachodesh hazze veyikchu lahem ish se levet-avot se labbayit
Malilu im kol kenishta deyisrael lememar beasra leyarcha haden veyisvun lehon gevar imar levet abba imar leveta:
Veim-yimat habbayit mihyot misse velakach hu ushecheno hakkarov el-beto bemichsat nefashot ish lefi ochlo tachossu al-hasse
Veim yizer beta militmenaa al imra veyisav hu veshevave dekariv levete beminyan nafshata gevar lefum mechle titmenun al imra:
Se tamim zachar ben-shana yihye lachem min-hakkevasim umin-haizzim tikkachu
Imar shelim dechar bar shatte yehe lechon min imraya umin izaya tisvun:
Vehaya lachem lemishmeret ad arbaa asar yom lachodesh hazze veshachatu oto kol kehal adat-yisrael ben haarbayim
Vihe lechon lematra ad arbea asra yoma leyarcha haden veyikkesun yate kol kehala chenishta deyisrael ben shimshaya:
Velakchu min-haddam venatnu al-shete hammezuzot veal-hammashkof al habbattim asher-yochlu oto bahem
Veyisvun min dema veyittenun al teren sippaya veal shakfa al battaya deyechlun yate behon:
Veochlu et-habbasar ballayla hazze tzeli-esh umatztzot al-merorim yochluhu
Veyechlun yat bisra belela hahu teve nur ufatir al merarin yechlune:
Al-tochlu mimmennu na uvashel mevushshal bammayim ki im-tzeli-esh rosho al-keraav veal-kirbo
La techlun mine kad chay veaf la vashala mevashel bemaya elahen teve nur resheh al keraohi veal gave:
Velo-totiru mimmennu ad-boker vehannotar mimmennu ad-boker baesh tisrofu
Vela tasharun mine ad tzafra udeyishtaar mine ad tzafra benura tokdun:
Vechacha tochlu oto motnechem chagurim naalechem beraglechem umakkelchem beyedchem vaachaltem oto bechippazon pesach hu la-Adonai
Ucheden techlun yate chartzechon yehon asirin mesanechon beriglechon vechuterechon bidechon vetechlun yate bivhilu pischa hu kodam Adonai:
Veavarti veeretz-mitzrayim ballayla hazze vehikketi chol-bechor beeretz mitzrayim meadam vead-behema uvechol-elohe mitzrayim eese shefatim ani Adonai
Veitgeleti veara demitzrayim belelya haden veektol kol buchera beara demitzrayim meanasha vead beira uvechol taavat mitzrayim abed dinin ana Adonai:
Vehaya haddam lachem leot al habbattim asher attem sham veraiti et-haddam ufasachti alechem velo-yihye vachem negef lemashchit behakkoti beeretz mitzrayim
Vihe dema lechon leat al battaya di attun taman veecheze yat dema veechos alechon vela yehe vechon mota lechabbala bemikteli beara demitzrayim:
Vehaya hayyom hazze lachem lezikkaron vechaggotem oto chag la-Adonai ledorotechem chukkat olam techogguhu
Vihe yoma haden lechon leducherana utechagun yate chaga kodam Adonai ledarechon keyam alam techagune:
Shivat yamim matztzot tochelu ach bayyom harishon tashbitu seor mibbattechem ki kol-ochel chametz venichreta hannefesh hahiv miyyisrael miyyom harishon ad-yom hashshevii
Shivat yomin patir techlun beram beyoma kadmaa tevatlun chamira mibbattechon are kol deyechul chamia veyishtetze enasha hahu miyisrael miyoma kadmaa ad yoma sheviaa:
Uvayyom harishon mikra-kodesh uvayyom hashshevii mikra-kodesh yihye lachem kol-melacha lo-yease vahem ach asher yeachel lechol-nefesh hu levaddo yease lachem
Uveyoma kadmaa meara kadish uveyoma sheviaa meara kadish yehe lechon kol ivida la yitaved behon beram di mitachel lechol nefash hu vilchodohi yitaved lechon:
Ushemartem et-hammatztzot ki beetzem hayyom hazze hotzeti et-tzivotechem meeretz mitzrayim ushemartem et-hayyom hazze ledorotechem chukkat olam
Vetitrun yat patira are bichran yoma haden appekit yat chelechon meara demitzrayim vetitrun yat yoma haden ledarechon keyam alam:
Barishon bearbaa asar yom lachodesh baerev tochlu matztzot ad yom haechad veesrim lachodesh baarev
Benisan bearbea asra yoma leyarcha beramsha techlun patira ad yoma esrin vechad leyarcha beramsha:
Shivat yamim seor lo yimmatze bevattechem ki kol-ochel machmetzet venichreta hannefesh hahiv meadat yisrael bagger uveezrach haaretz
Shivat yomin chamir la yishtechach bevattechon are kol deyechul machmea veyishtetze enasha hahu mikkenishta deyisrael begiyora uveyatziva deara:
Kol-machmetzet lo tochelu bechol moshvotechem tochlu matztzot
Kol machmea la techlun bechol motvanechon techlun patira:
Vayyikra moshe lechol-zikne yisrael vayyomer alehem mishchu ukechu lachem tzon lemishpechotechem veshachatu happasach
Ukera mshe lechol save yisrael vaamar lehon negidu vesivu lechon min bene ana lezarayatchon vechusu fischa:
Ulekachtem aguddat ezov utevaltem baddam asher-bassaf vehiggatem el-hammashkof veel-shete hammezuzot min-haddam asher bassaf veattem lo tetzu ish mippetach-beto ad-boker
Vetisvun esarat ezova vetitbelun bidma divmana vetadun leshakfa velitren sippaya min dema divmana veattun la tippekun enash mittera bete ad tzafra:
Veavar Adonai lingof et-mitzrayim veraa et-haddam al-hammashkof veal shete hammezuzot ufasach Adonai al-happetach velo yitten hammashchit lavo el-battechem lingof
Veyitgele Adonai lemimche yat mitzrayim veyecheze yat dema al shakfa veal teren sippaya veyechos Adonai al tara vela yishbok lechabbala lemeal levattechon lemimche:
Ushemartem et-haddavar hazze lechok-lecha ulevanecha ad-olam
Vetitrun yat pitgama haden likyam lach velivnaych ad alam:
Vehaya ki-tavou el-haaretz asher yitten Adonai lachem kaasher dibber ushemartem et-haavoda hazzot
Vihe are tealun leara deyitten Adonai lechon kema di malil vetitrun yat palchana haden:
Vehaya ki-yomru alechem benechem ma haavoda hazzot lachem
Vihe are yemrun lechon benechon ma palchana haden lechon:
Vaamartem zevach-pesach hu la-Adonai asher pasach al-batte vene-yisrael bemitzrayim benogpo et-mitzrayim veet-battenu hitztzil vayyikkod haam vayyishtachavu
Vetemrun dabbach chayas hu kodam Adonai di chas al batte vene yisrael bemitzrayim kad hava mache yat mitzrae veyat battana sheziv uchera ama usegidu:
Vayyelchu vayyaasu bene yisrael kaasher tzivva Adonai et-moshe veaharon ken asu
Vaazalu vaavadu bene yisrael kema defakid Adonai yat mshe veaharon ken avadu:
Vayhi bachatzi hallayla va-Adonai hikka chol-bechor beeretz mitzrayim mibbechor paro hayyoshev al-kiso ad bechor hashshevi asher bevet habbor vechol bechor behema
Vahava befalgut lelya vaAdonai ketal kol buchera beara demitzrayim mibbuchera defaro deatid lemittav al karse malchute ad buchera deshivya di bevet asire vechol buchera divira:
Vayyakom paro layla hu vechol-avadav vechol-mitzrayim vattehi tzeaka gedola bemitzrayim ki-en bayit asher en-sham met
Vekam paro lelya hu vechol avdohi vechol mitzrayim vahavat tzevachta rabbeta bemitzrayim are let beta dela hava ve taman meta:
Vayyikra lemoshe uleaharon layla vayyomer kumu tzeu mittoch ammi gam-attem gam-bene yisrael ulechu ivdu et-Adonai kedabberchem
Ukera lemshe uleaharon lelya vaamar kumu puku migo ami af attun af bene yisrael veezilu felachu kodam Adonai kema dihavetun amrin:
Gam-tzonchem gam-bekarchem kechu kaasher dibbartem valechu uverachtem gam-oti
Af anchon af torchon devaru kema di maleltun veezilu vetzalo af alay:
Vattechezak mitzrayim al-haam lemaher leshallecham min-haaretz ki amru kullanu metim
Utekefat mitzrayim al ama leochaa leshalachutehon min ara are amaru kulana maytin:
Vayyissa haam et-betzeko terem yechmatz misharotam tzerurot besimlotam al-shichmam
Unetal ama yat layshehon ad la chama motar atzvathon tzerir bilvashehon al katpehon:
Uvene-yisrael asu kidvar moshe vayyishalu mimmitzrayim kele-chesef uchele zahav usemalot
Uvene yisrael avadu kefitgama demshe usheilu mimitzrayim manin dichsaf umanin didhav ulevushin:
Va-Adonai natan et-chen haam beene mitzrayim vayyashilum vaynatztzelu et-mitzrayim
Vayya yehav yat ama lerachamin beene mitzrayim veashelinun verokinu yat mitzrayim:
Vayyisu vene-yisrael merameses sukkota keshesh-meot elef ragli haggevarim levad mittaf
Unetalu vene yisrael merameses lesukkot keshit mea alfin riglain guvraya bar mitafla:
Vegam-erev rav ala ittam vetzon uvakar mikne kaved meod
Veaf nucherain sagiin seliku imhon veana vetorin beira sagi lachada:
Vayyofu et-habbatzek asher hotziu mimmitzrayim ugot matztzot ki lo chametz ki-gorshu mimmitzrayim velo yachlu lehitmameah vegam-tzeda lo-asu lahem
Vaafo yat laysha di appiku mimitzrayim geritzan patiran are la chama are ittarachu mimitzrayim vela yachilu leitakkava veaf zevadin la avadu lehon:
Umoshav bene yisrael asher yashvu bemitzrayim sheloshim shana vearba meot shana
Umotav bene yisrael di yetivu bemitzrayim arba mea utelatin shenin:
Vayhi mikketz sheloshim shana vearba meot shana vayhi beetzem hayyom hazze yatzu kol-tzivot Adonai meeretz mitzrayim
Vahava misof arba mea utelatin shenin vahava bichran yoma haden nefaku kol chelaya daAdonai meara demitzrayim:
Lel shimmurim hu la-Adonai lehotziam meeretz mitzrayim hu-hallayla hazze la-Adonai shimmurim lechol-bene yisrael ledorotam
Lel netir hu kodam Adonai leappakutehon meara demitzrayim hu lelya haden kodam Adonai netirin lechol bene yisrael ledarehon:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe veaharon zot chukkat happasach kol-ben-nechar lo-yochal bo
Vaamar Adonai lemshe uleaharon da gezerat pischa kol bar yisrael deyishtamad la yechul be:
Vechol-eved ish miknat-kasef umalta oto az yochal bo
Vechol avad gevar zevine chaspa vetigzar yate bechen yechul be:
Toshav vesachir lo-yochal bo
Totava vaagira la yechul be:
Bevayit echad yeachel lo-totzi min-habbayit min-habbasar chutza veetzem lo tishberu-vo
Bachavura chada yitachel la tappek min beta min bisra levara vegarma la titberun be:
Kol-adat yisrael yaasu oto
Kol kenishta deyisrael yabedun yate:
Vechi-yagur ittecha ger veasa fesach la-Adonai himmol lo chol-zachar veaz yikrav laasoto vehaya keezrach haaretz vechol-arel lo-yochal bo
Vaare yitgayar imach giyora veyabed pischa kodam Adonai migzar le kol dechura uvechen yikrav lemebede vihe keyatziva deara vechol arla la yechul be:
Tora achat yihye laezrach velagger haggar betochechem
Orayta chada yehe leyatziva ulegiyora deyitgayrun benechon:
Vayyaasu kol-bene yisrael kaasher tzivva Adonai et-moshe veet-aharon ken asu
Vaavadu kol bene yisrael kema di fakid Adonai yat mshe veyat aharon ken avadu:
Vayhi beetzem hayyom hazze hotzi Adonai et-bene yisrael meeretz mitzrayim al-tzivotam
Vahava bichran yoma haden appek Adonai yat bene yisrael meara demitzrayim al chelehon:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umalel Adonai im mshe lememar:
Kaddesh-li chol-bechor peter kol-rechem bivne yisrael baadam uvabbehema li hu
Akdesh kodamay kol buchera patach kol valda bivne yisrael beenasha uvivira dili hu:
