Vayyomer moshe el-haam zachor et-hayyom hazze asher yetzatem mimmitzrayim mibbet avadim ki bechozek yad hotzi Adonai etchem mizze velo yeachel chametz
Vaamar mshe leama havo dechirin yat yoma haden di nefaktun mimitzrayim mibbet avduta are bitkof yeda appek Adonai yatchon mikka vela yitachel chamia:
Hayyom attem yotzim bechodesh haaviv
Yoma den attun nafkin beyarcha deabbiva:
Vehaya chi-yeviacha Adonai el-eretz hakkenaani vehachitti vehaemori vehachivvi vehayevusi asher nishba laavotecha latet lach eretz zavat chalav udevash veavadta et-haavoda hazzot bachodesh hazze
Vihe are yaelinach Adonai leara dichnaanae vechittae veemorae vechivae vivusae di kayim laavahatach lemittan lach ara avda chalav udevash vetiflach yat palchana hada beyarcha haden:
Shivat yamim tochal matztzot uvayyom hashshevii chag la-Adonai
Shiva yomin techul patira uveyoma sheviaa chaga kodam Adonai:
Matztzot yeachel et shivat hayyamim velo-yerae lecha chametz velo-yerae lecha seor bechol-gevulecha
Patir yitachel yat shivat yomin vela yitchaze lach chamia vela yitchaze lach chamir bechol techumach:
Vehiggadta levincha bayyom hahu lemor baavur ze asa Adonai li betzeti mimmitzrayim
Utechave livrach beyoma hahu lememar bedil den avad Adonai li bemippeki mimitzrayim:
Vehaya lecha leot al-yadcha ulezikkaron ben enecha lemaan tihye torat Adonai beficha ki beyad chazaka hotziacha Adonai mimmitzrayim
Vihe lach leat al yedach uledachrana ben enaych bedil tehe orayta daAdonai befumach are bida takifa appekach Adonai mimitzrayim:
Veshamarta et-hachukka hazzot lemoadah miyyamim yamima
Vetitar yat keyama hada lezimne mizman lizman:
Vehaya ki-yeviacha Adonai el-eretz hakkenaani kaasher nishba lecha velaavotecha unetanah lach
Vihe are yaelinach Adonai leara dichnaanae kema di kayim lach velaavahatach veyittenina lach:
Vehaavarta chol-peter-rechem la-Adonai vechol-peter sheger behema asher yihye lecha hazzecharim la-Adonai
Vetabar kol patach valda kodam Adonai vechol patach velad beira di yehe lach dichrin takdesh kodam Adonai:
Vechol-peter chamor tifde vese veim-lo tifde vaarafto vechol bechor adam bevanecha tifde
Vechol patach buchera dachamara tifrok beimra veim la tifrok vetinkefe vechol buchera daanasha bivnaych tifrok:
Vehaya ki-yishalcha vincha machar lemor ma-zzot veamarta elav bechozek yad hotzianu Adonai mimmitzrayim mibbet avadim
Vihe are yishalinach berach mechar lememar ma da vetemar le bitkof yeda appekana Adonai mimitzrayim mibbet avduta:
Vayhi ki-hiksha faro leshallechenu vayyaharog Adonai kol-bechor beeretz mitzrayim mibbechor adam vead-bechor behema al-ken ani zoveach la-Adonai kol-peter rechem hazzecharim vechol-bechor banay efde

Vahava are akshe faro leshalachutana uketal Adonai kol buchera beara demitzrayim mibbuchera daanasha vead buchera divira al ken ana davach kodam Adonai kol patach valda dichrin vechol buchera divnay efrok:
Vehaya leot al-yadcha uletotafot ben enecha ki bechozek yad hotzianu Adonai mimmitzrayim
Vihe leat al yedach velitfilin ben enaych are bitkof yeda appekana Adonai mimitzrayim:
Vayhi beshallach paro et-haam velo-nacham elohim derech eretz pelishtim ki karov hu ki amar elohim pen-yinnachem haam birotam milchama veshavu mitzrayma
Vahava kad shalach paro yat ama vela dabbarinun Adonai orach ara felishtae are kariva hu are amar Adonai dilma yezuun ama bemechezehon kerava vituvun lemitzrayim:
Vayyassev elohim et-haam derech hammidbar yam-suf vachamushim alu vene-yisrael meeretz mitzrayim
Veaschar Adonai yat ama orach madbera yama desuf umezarzin seliku bene yisrael meara demitzrayim:
Vayyikkach moshe et-atzmot yosef immo ki hashbea hishbia et-bene yisrael lemor pakod yifkod elohim etchem vehaalitem et-atzmotay mizze ittechem
Veasik mshe yat garme yosef ime are omaa omi yat bene yisrael lememar midkar dechir Adonai yatchon vetaskun yat garmay mikka imchon:
Vayyisu missukkot vayyachanu veetam biktze hammidbar
Unetalu misukkot ushero veetam bistar madbera:
Va-Adonai holech lifnehem yomam beammud anan lanchotam hadderech velayla beammud esh lehair lahem lalechet yomam valayla
VaAdonai medabbar kadamehon bimama beamuda daanana ledabbarutehon beorcha velelya beamuda deeshata leanhara lehon lemezal bimama uvelelya:
Lo-yamish ammud heanan yomam veammud haesh layla lifne haam
La yaade amuda daanana bimama veaf la amuda deeshata belelya kodam ama:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umalel Adonai im mshe lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael veyashuvu veyachanu lifne pi hachirot ben migdol uven hayyam lifne baal tzefon nichcho tachanu al-hayyam
Malel im bene yisrael vituvun veyishrun kodam pum chirata ben migdol uven yama kodam beel tzefon lekivle tishrun al yama:
Veamar paro livne yisrael nevuchim hem baaretz sagar alehem hammidbar
Veyemar paro al bene yisrael mearbelin inun beara achad alehon madbera:
Vechizzakti et-lev-paro veradaf acharehem veikkavda befaro uvechol-chelo veyadu mitzrayim ki-ani Adonai vayyaasu-chen
Veatkef yat libba defaro veyirdaf batrehon veetyakar befaro uvechol mashiryate veyidun mitzrae are ana Adonai vaavadu chen:
Vayyuggad lemelech mitzrayim ki varach haam vayyehafech levav paro vaavadav el-haam vayyomru ma-zzot asinu ki-shillachnu et-yisrael meovdenu
Veitchava lemalka demitzrayim are azal ama veithafich libba defaro veavdohi leama vaamaru ma da avadna are shalachna yat yisrael mippalchanana:
Vayyesor et-richbo veet-ammo lakach immo
Vetakis yat retikke veyat ame dabbar ime:
Vayyikkach shesh-meot rechev bachur vechol rechev mitzrayim veshalishim al-kullo
Udevar shit mea retikkin bechiran vechol retikke mitzrae vegibbarin memanan al kulhon:
Vaychazzek Adonai et-lev paro melech mitzrayim vayyirdof achare bene yisrael uvene yisrael yotzim beyad rama
Veatkef Adonai yat libba defaro malka demitzrayim uredaf batar bene yisrael uvene yisrael nefaku beresh geli:
Vayyirdefu mitzrayim acharehem vayyassigu otam chonim al-hayyam kol-sus rechev paro ufarashav vechelo al-pi hachirot lifne baal tzefon
Uredafu mitzrae batrehon veadbiku yathon kad sharan al yama kol susavat retikke faro ufarashohi umashiryate al pum chirata kodam beel tzefon:
Ufaro hikriv vayyisu vene-yisrael et-enehem vehinne mitzrayim nosea acharehem vayyiru meod vayyitzaku vene-yisrael el-Adonai
Ufaro kerev uzekafu vene yisrael yat enehon veha mitzrae natlin batrehon udechilu lachada uzeiku bene yisrael kodam Adonai:
Vayyomru el-moshe hamibbeli en-kevarim bemitzrayim lekachtanu lamut bammidbar ma-zzot asita lanu lehotzianu mimmitzrayim
Vaamaru lemshe hamidlet kivrin bemitzrayim devartana limmat bemadbera ma da avadta lana leappakutana mimitzrayim:
Halo-ze haddavar asher dibbarnu elecha vemitzrayim lemor chadal mimmennu venaavda et-mitzrayim ki tov lanu avod et-mitzrayim mimmutenu bammidbar
Hala den pitgama di malelna imach vemitzrayim lememar shevok minana veniflach yat mitzrae are tav lana deniflach yat mitzrae midinmut bemadbera:
Vayyomer moshe el-haam al-tirau hityatztzevu ureu et-yeshuat Adonai asher-yaase lachem hayyom ki asher reitem et-mitzrayim hayyom lo tosifu lirotam od ad-olam
Vaamar mshe leama la tidchalun itattadu vachazo yat purekana daAdonai deyabed lechon yoma den are kema dichazetun yat mitzrae yoma den la tosfun lemechezehon od ad alma:
Adonai yillachem lachem veattem tacharishun
Adonai yegiach lechon kerav veattun tishtekun:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe ma-ttitzak elay dabber el-bene-yisrael veyissau
Vaamar Adonai lemshe kabbelit tzelotach malel im bene yisrael veyitlun:
Veatta harem et-mattecha unete et-yadcha al-hayyam uvekaehu veyavou vene-yisrael betoch hayyam bayyabbasha
Veat tol yat chutrach vaarem yat yedach al yama uvezaohi veyealun bene yisrael bego yama beyabbeshta:
Vaani hinni mechazzek et-lev mitzrayim veyavou acharehem veikkavda befaro uvechol-chelo berichbo uvefarashav
Vaana ha ana metakef yat libba demitzrae veyealun batrehon veetyakar befaro uvechol mashiryate birtikkohi uvefarashohi:
Veyadu mitzrayim ki-ani Adonai behikkavdi befaro berichbo uvefarashav
Veyiddeun mitzrae are ana Adonai beityakaruti befaro birtikkohi uvefarashohi:
Vayyissa malach haelohim haholech lifne machane yisrael vayyelech meacharehem vayyissa ammud heanan mippenehem vayyaamod meacharehem
Unetal malacha daAdonai dimdabbar kodam mashrita deyisrael vaata mibbatrehon unetal ammuda daanana min kodamehon ushera mibbatrehon:
Vayyavo ben machane mitzrayim uven machane yisrael vayhi heanan vehachoshech vayyaer et-hallayla velo-karav ze el-ze kol-hallayla
Veal ben mashrita demitzrae uven mashrita deyisrael vahava anana vekavla lemitzrae uleyisrael nehar kol lelya vela itkerivu den levat den kol lelya:
Vayyet moshe et-yado al-hayyam vayyolech Adonai et-hayyam beruach kadim azza kol-hallayla vayyasem et-hayyam lecharava vayyibbaku hammayim
Vaarem mshe yat yede al yamma vedabbar Adonai yat yamma beruach kiduma takif kol lelya veshavi yat yamma leyabbeshta veitbezau mayya:
Vayyavou vene-yisrael betoch hayyam bayyabbasha vehammayim lahem choma miminam umissemolam
Vealu vene yisrael bego yama beyabbeshta umayya lehon shurin miyyaminehon umismalehon:
Vayyirdefu mitzrayim vayyavou acharehem kol sus paro richbo ufarashav el-toch hayyam
Uredafu mitzrae vealu vatrehon kol susavat paro retikkohi ufarashohi lego yama:
Vayhi beashmoret habboker vayyashkef Adonai el-machane mitzrayim beammud esh veanan vayyahom et machane mitzrayim
Vahava bematrat tzafra veisteche Adonai lemashrita demitzrae beamuda deeshata vaanana veshagish yat mashrita demitzrae:
Vayyasar et ofan markevotav vaynahagehu bichvedut vayyomer mitzrayim anusa mippene yisrael ki Adonai nilcham lahem bemitzrayim
Veadi yat galgale retikkohi umedabberin lehon bitkof vaamar mitzrae neirok min kodam yisrael are da hi gevurta daAdonai daaved lehon keravin bemitzrayim:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe nete et-yadcha al-hayyam veyashuvu hammayim al-mitzrayim al-richbo veal-parashav
Vaamar Adonai lemshe arem yat yedach al yama vituvun maya al mitzrae al retikkehon veal parashehon:
Vayyet moshe et-yado al-hayyam vayyashov hayyam lifnot boker leetano umitzrayim nasim likrato vaynaer Adonai et-mitzrayim betoch hayyam
Vaarem mshe yat yede al yama vetav yama leidan tzafra letakpe umitzrae arkin lekadamute veshanik Adonai yat mitzrae bego yama:
Vayyashuvu hammayim vaychassu et-harechev veet-happarashim lechol chel paro habbaim acharehem bayyam lo-nishar bahem ad-echad
Vetavu maya vachafo yat retikkaya veyat parashaya lechol mashiryat paro dealu vatrehon beyama la ishtaar behon ad chad:
Uvene yisrael halchu vayyabbasha betoch hayyam vehammayim lahem choma miminam umissemolam
Uvene yisrael halichu veyabbeshta bego yama umaya lehon shurin miyaminehon umismalehon:
Vayyosha Adonai bayyom hahu et-yisrael miyyad mitzrayim vayyar yisrael et-mitzrayim met al-sefat hayyam
Uferak Adonai beyoma hahu yat yisrael mida demitzrae vachazo yisrael yat mitzrae maytin al kef yama:
Vayyar yisrael et-hayyad haggedola asher asa Adonai bemitzrayim vayyiru haam et-Adonai vayyaaminu ba-Adonai uvemoshe avdo
Vachaza yisrael yat gevureta yeda rabbeta di avad Adonai bemitzrayim udechilu ama min kodam Adonai veheminu bememra daAdonai uvinviut mshe avde:
Az yashir-moshe uvene yisrael et-hashshira hazzot la-Adonai vayyomru lemor ashira la-Adonai ki-gao gaa sus verochvo rama vayyam
Bechen shabbach mshe uvene yisrael yat tishbachta hada kodam Adonai vaamaru lememar neshabbach venode kadam Adonai are itgae al gevtanaya vegeuta dile hi suseya verachve rema veyama:
Ozzi vezimrat yah vayhi-li lishua ze eli veanvehu elohe avi vaaromemenhu
Takpi vetushbachti dechila Adonai vaamar bememre vahava li lefarak den elahay veevne le makdesha elaha daavahatay veeflach kodamohi:
Adonai ish milchama Adonai shemo
Adonai mare nitzchan keravaya Adonai sheme:
Markevot paro vechelo yara vayyam umivchar shalishav tubbeu veyam-suf
Retikke paro umashiryate shedi veyama ushefar gibbarohi itbau beyama desuf:
Tehomot yechasyumu yardu vimtzolot kemo-aven
Tehomaya chafo alehon nechatu leumekaya keavna:
Yemincha Adonai nedari bakkoach yemincha Adonai tiratz oyev
Yaminach Adonai adira bechela yaminach Adonai tevarat sana:
Uverov geoncha taharos kamecha teshallach charoncha yochlemo kakkash
Uvisge takpach tevartanun lidkamu al amach shalachta rugezach shetzitinun kenura lekasha:
Uveruach appecha neermu mayim nitztzevu chemo-ned nozlim kafu tehomot belev-yam
Uvememar pumach chakkimu maya kamu cheshur azalaya kafu tehomin belibba deyama:
Amar oyev erdof assig achallek shalal timlaemo nafshi arik charbi torishemo yadi
Dahava amar sana erdof adbek afaleg bizta tisba minhon nafshi eshlof charbi teshetzinun yedi:
Nashafta veruchacha kissamo yam tzalelu kaoferet bemayim addirim
Amarta bememrach chafa alehon yama ishtekau kaavara bemayin takifin:
Mi-chamocha baelim Adonai mi kamocha nedar bakkodesh nora tehillot ose fele
Let bar minach deat hu elaha Adonai let bar minach elaha at adir bekudesha dechel tushbechan aved parishan:
Natita yemincha tivlaemo aretz
Aremta yaminach belaatnun ara:
Nachita vechasdecha am-zu gaalta nehaleta veozzecha el-neve kodshecha
Dabbarhi vetavvatach ama denan difrakta sovarhi vetakpach ledira dekudshach:
Shamu ammim yirgazun chil achaz yoshve pelashet
Shemau ammaya vezau dachala achadatnun ledahavo yatvin biflashet:
Az nivhalu allufe edom ele moav yochazemo raad namogu kol yoshve chenaan
Bechen itbehilu ravreve edom takife moav achadatnun reteta itbaru kol dahavo yatvin bichnaan:
Tippol alehem emata vafachad bigdol zeroacha yiddemu kaaven ad-yaavor ammecha Adonai ad-yaavor am-zu kanita
Tappel alehon emta vedachalta bisge takpach yishtekun keavna ad deyeibbar amach Adonai yat arnona ad deyeibbar ama denan di ferakta yat yardena:
Teviemo vetittaemo behar nachalatcha machon leshivtecha paalta Adonai mikkedash adonay konenu yadecha
Taelinun vetashrinun betura deachsantach atar metaken levet shechintach atkenta Adonai makdesha Adonai atkenohi yedaych:
Adonai yimloch leolam vaed
Adonai malchute kaem lealam ulealme almaya:
Ki va sus paro berichbo uvefarashav bayyam vayyashev Adonai alehem et-me hayyam uvene yisrael halchu vayyabbasha betoch hayyam
Are al susavat paro birtikkohi uvefarashohi beyama vaatev Adonai alehon yat me yama uvene yisrael halichu veyabbeshta bego yama:
Vattikkach miryam hannevia achot aharon et-hattof beyadah vattetzena chol-hannashim achareha betuppim uvimcholot
Unesevat miryam neviata achate deaharon yat tuppa bida unefaku chol neshaya batraha betuppin uvechingin:
Vattaan lahem miryam shiru la-Adonai ki-gao gaa sus verochvo rama vayyam
Umeanya lahen miryam shabbachu veodu kodam Adonai are itgae al gevtanaya vegeuta dile hi suseya verachve rema veyama:
Vayyassa moshe et-yisrael miyyam-suf vayyetzu el-midbar-shur vayyelchu sheloshet-yamim bammidbar velo-matzu mayim
Veatel mshe yat yisrael miyama desuf unefaku lemadbera dechagra vaazalu telata yomin bemadbera vela ashkachu maya:
Vayyavou marata velo yachlu lishtot mayim mimmara ki marim hem al-ken kara-shemah mara
Vaato lemara vela yechilu lemishte maya mimara are meririn inun al ken kera shema mara:
Vayyillonu haam al-moshe lemor ma-nnishte
Veitraamu ama al mshe lememar ma nishte:
Vayyitzak el-Adonai vayyorehu Adonai etz vayyashlech el-hammayim vayyimteku hammayim sham sam lo chok umishpat vesham nissahu
Vetzali kodam Adonai vealfe Adonai aa urema lemaya uvasimu maya taman gezar le keyam vedin vetaman nasye:
Vayyomer im-shamoa tishma lekol Adonai elohecha vehayyashar beenav taase vehaazanta lemitzvotav veshamarta kol-chukkav kol-hammachala asher-samti vemitzrayim lo-asim alecha ki ani Adonai rofecha
Vaamar im kabbala tekabbel lememra daAdonai elahach udechashar kodamohi tabed vetatzet lifikudohi vetitar kol keyamohi kol marin di shaveti vemitzrayim la ashave alach are ana Adonai asach:
Vayyavou elima vesham shetem esre enot mayim veshivim temarim vayyachanu-sham al-hammayim
Vaato leelim vetaman tere asar mabbuin demayin veshivin diklin ushero taman al maya:
Vayyisu meelim vayyavou kol-adat bene-yisrael el-midbar-sin asher ben-elim uven sinay bachamishsha asar yom lachodesh hashsheni letzetam meeretz mitzrayim
Unetalu meelim vaato kol kenishta divne yisrael lemadbera desin di ven elim uven sinay bechamsha asra yoma leyarcha tinyana lemippakhon meara demitzrayim:
Vayyillonu kol-adat bene-yisrael al-moshe veal-aharon bammidbar
Veitraamu kol kenishta divne yisrael al mshe veal aharon bemadbera:

Vayyomru alehem bene yisrael mi-yitten mutenu veyad-Adonai beeretz mitzrayim beshivtenu al-sir habbasar beochlenu lechem lasova ki-hotzetem otanu el-hammidbar hazze lehamit et-kol-hakkahal hazze baraav

Vaamaru lehon bene yisrael levay demitna kodam Adonai beara demitzrayim kad havena yatvin al dude visra kad havena ochlin lachma vesavin are appektun yatana lemadbera haden lekatala yat kol kehala haden bechafna:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe hinni mamtir lachem lechem min-hashshamayim veyatza haam velaktu devar-yom beyomo lemaan anassennu hayelech betorati im-lo
Vaamar Adonai lemshe ha ana machet lechon lachma min shemaya veyifkun ama veyilketun pitgam yom beyome bedil daanasinun hayehachun beorayti im la:
Vehaya bayyom hashshishshi vehechinu et asher-yaviu vehaya mishne al asher-yilketu yom yom
Vihe beyoma shetitaa vitaknun yat deyaytun vihe al chad teren al deyilketun yom yom:
Vayyomer moshe veaharon el-kol-bene yisrael erev vidatem ki Adonai hotzi etchem meeretz mitzrayim
Vaamar mshe veaharon lechol bene yisrael beramsha vetidun are Adonai appek yatchon meara demitzrayim:
Uvoker ureitem et-kevod Adonai beshomo et-telunnotechem al-Adonai venachnu ma ki tallinu alenu
Uvetzafra vetechezun yat yekara daAdonai kad shemia kodamohi yat turamutechon al memra daAdonai venachna ma are atraamtun alana:
Vayyomer moshe betet Adonai lachem baerev basar leechol velechem babboker lisboa bishmoa Adonai et-telunnotechem asher-attem mallinim alav venachnu ma lo-alenu telunnotechem ki al-Adonai

Vaamar mshe bidyitten Adonai lechon beramsha bisra lemechal velachma betzafra lemisba bedishmia kodam Adonai yat turamutechon di attun mitraamin alohi venachna ma la alana turamutechon elahen al memra daAdonai:
Vayyomer moshe el-aharon emor el-kol-adat bene yisrael kirvu lifne Adonai ki shama et telunnotechem
Vaamar mshe leaharon emar lechol kenishta divne yisrael kerivu kodam Adonai are shemian kodamohi yat turamutechon:
Vayhi kedabber aharon el-kol-adat bene-yisrael vayyifnu el-hammidbar vehinne kevod Adonai nira beanan
Vahava kad malil aharon im kol kenishta divne yisrael veitpeniyu lemadbera veha yekara daAdonai itgeli baanana:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umalel Adonai im mshe lememar:
Shamati et-telunnot bene yisrael dabber alehem lemor ben haarbayim tochlu vasar uvabboker tisbeu-lachem vidatem ki ani Adonai elohechem
Shemia kodamay yat turamat bene yisrael malel imhon lememar ben shimshaya techlun bisra uvetzafra tisbeun lachma vetidun are ana Adonai elahachon:
Vayhi vaerev vattaal hasselav vattechas et-hammachane uvabboker hayta shichvat hattal saviv lammachane
Vahava veramsha uselekat selav vachafat yat mashrita uvetzafra havat nechatat tala sechor sechor lemashrita:
Vattaal shichvat hattal vehinne al-pene hammidbar dak mechuspas dak kakkefor al-haaretz
Uselekat nechatat tala veha al appe madbera dadak mekalaf dadak kegir kiglida al ara:
Vayyiru vene-yisrael vayyomru ish el-achiv man hu ki lo yadu ma-hu vayyomer moshe alehem hu hallechem asher natan Adonai lachem leochla
Vachazo vene yisrael vaamaru gevar laachuhi mana hu are la yedau ma hu vaamar mshe lehon hu lachma di yehav Adonai lechon lemechal:
Ze haddavar asher tzivva Adonai liktu mimmennu ish lefi ochlo omer laggulgolet mispar nafshotechem ish laasher beoholo tikkachu
Den pitgama di faked Adonai lekutu mine gevar lefum mechle umra legulgalta minyan nafshatechon gevar ledi vemashkene tisvun:
Vayyaasu-chen bene yisrael vayyilketu hammarbe vehammamit
Vaavadu chen bene yisrael ulekatu deasge udeazer:
Vayyamoddu vaomer velo hedif hammarbe vehammamit lo hechsir ish lefi-ochlo lakatu
Uchelo veumera vela otar deasge udeazer la chasir gevar lefum mechle lekatu:
Vayyomer moshe alehem ish al-yoter mimmennu ad-boker
Vaamar mshe lehon enash la yashar mine ad tzafra:
Velo-shamu el-moshe vayyotiru anashim mimmennu ad-boker vayyarum tolaim vayyivash vayyiktzof alehem moshe
Vela kabbilu min mshe veasharu guvraya mine ad tzafra urechesh richasha useri uregaz alehon mshe:
Vayyilketu oto babboker babboker ish kefi ochlo vecham hashshemesh venamas
Ulekatu yate bitzfar bitzfar gevar lefum mechle uma demishtaar mine al appe chakla kad chama alohi shimsha pashar:
Vayhi bayyom hashshishshi laktu lechem mishne shene haomer laechad vayyavou kol-nesie haeda vayyaggidu lemoshe
Vahava beyoma shetitaa lekatu lachma al chad teren teren umrin lechad vaato kol ravreve chenishta vechaviu lemshe:
Vayyomer alehem hu asher dibber Adonai shabbaton shabbat-kodesh la-Adonai machar et asher-tofu efu veet asher-tevashshelu bashshelu veet kol-haodef hannichu lachem lemishmeret ad-habboker
Vaamar lehon hu di malil Adonai shevata shevat kudesha kodam Adonai mechar yat di attun atidin lemefa afo veyat di attun atidin levashala bashilu veyat kol motara atznau lechon lematara ad tzafra:
Vayyannichu oto ad-habboker kaasher tzivva moshe velo hivish verimma lo-hayta bo
Veatznau yate ad tzafra kema defakid mshe vela seri verichasha la hava ve:
Vayyomer moshe ichluhu hayyom ki-shabbat hayyom la-Adonai hayyom lo timtzauhu bassade
Vaamar mshe ichluhi yoma den are shabbeta yoma den kodam Adonai yoma den la tashkechune bechakla:
Sheshet yamim tilketuhu uvayyom hashshevii shabbat lo yihye-bbo
Shitta yomin tilketune uveyoma sheviaa shabbeta la yehe ve:
Vayhi bayyom hashshevii yatzu min-haam lilkot velo matzau
Vahava beyoma sheviaa nefaku min ama lemilkat vela ashkachu:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe ad-ana meantem lishmor mitzvotay vetorotay
Vaamar Adonai lemshe ad ematay attun mesarvin lemitar pikuday veorayatay:
Reu ki-Adonai natan lachem hashshabbat al-ken hu noten lachem bayyom hashshishshi lechem yomayim shevu ish tachtav al-yetze ish mimmekomo bayyom hashshevii
Chazo are Adonai yehav lechon shabbeta al ken hu yahev lechon beyoma shetitaa lechem teren yomin tivu anash techotohi la yippok anash meatre beyoma sheviaa
Vayyishbetu haam bayyom hashshevii
Venachu ama beyoma sheviaa:
Vayyikreu vet-yisrael et-shemo man vehu kezera gad lavan vetamo ketzappichit bidvash
Ukero vet yisrael yat sheme man vehu kevar zera gida chivar vetame keiskeretavan bidvash:
Vayyomer moshe ze haddavar asher tzivva Adonai melo haomer mimmennu lemishmeret ledorotechem lemaan yiru et-hallechem asher heechalti etchem bammidbar behotzii etchem meeretz mitzrayim
Vaamar mshe den pitgama di fakid Adonai mile umra mine lematra ledarechon bedil deyechzun yat lachma di ochalit yatchon bemadbera beappakuti yatchon meara demitzrayim:
Vayyomer moshe el-aharon kach tzintzenet achat veten-shamma melo-haomer man vehannach oto lifne Adonai lemishmeret ledorotechem
Vaamar mshe leaharon sav tzelochit chada vehav taman mele umra man veatzna yate kodam Adonai lematra ledarechon:
Kaasher tzivva Adonai el-moshe vayyannichehu aharon lifne haedut lemishmaret
Kema di fakid Adonai lemshe veatznee aharon kodam sahaduta lematra:
Uvene yisrael achlu et-hamman arbaim shana ad-boam el-eretz noshavet et-hamman achlu ad-boam el-ketze eretz kenaan
Uvene yisrael achalu yat mana arbein shenin ad demetehon leara yatvata yat mana achalu ad deato lisyafe ara dichnaan:
Vehaomer asirit haefa hu
Veumra chad min asra bitlat sein hu:
Vayyisu kol-adat bene-yisrael mimmidbar-sin lemasehem al-pi Adonai vayyachanu birfidim veen mayim lishtot haam
Unetalu kol kenishta divne yisrael mimadbera desin lematlanehon al memra daAdonai ushero birfidim velet maya lemishte ama:
Vayyarev haam im-moshe vayyomru tenu-lanu mayim venishte vayyomer lahem moshe ma-tterivun immadi ma-ttenassun et-Adonai
Unetza ama im mshe vaamaru havu lana maya venishte vaamar lehon mshe ma attun natzan imi ma menasun attun kodam Adonai:
Vayyitzma sham haam lammayim vayyalen haam al-moshe vayyomer lamma ze heelitanu mimmitzrayim lehamit oti veet-banay veet-miknay batztzama
Utzechi taman ama lemaya veitraam ama al mshe vaamar lema denan asektana mimitzrayim lekatala yati veyat benay veyat beiray betzachuta:
Vayyitzak moshe el-Adonai lemor ma eese laam hazze od meat usekaluni
Vetzali mshe kodam Adonai lememar ma ebed leama haden od zeer pon veyirgemunani:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe avor lifne haam vekach ittecha mizzikne yisrael umattecha asher hikkita bo et-hayeor kach beyadcha vehalachta
Vaamar Adonai lemshe ibbar kodam ama udevar imach misave yisrael vechutrach di macheta ve yat nahara sav bidach vetezil:
Hinni omed lefanecha sham al-hatztzur bechorev vehikkita vatztzur veyatzu mimmennu mayim veshata haam vayyaas ken moshe leene zikne yisrael
Ha ana kaem kodamach taman al tinara bechorev vetimche vetinara veyippekun mine maya veyishte ama vaavad ken mshe leene save yisrael:
Vayyikra shem hammakom massa umeriva al-riv bene yisrael veal nassotam et-Adonai lemor hayesh Adonai bekirbenu im-ayin
Ukera shema deatra niseta umatzuta al dintzo bene yisrael veal denasiu kodam Adonai lememar hait shechinta daAdonai benana im la:
Vayyavo amalek vayyillachem im-yisrael birfidim
Vaata amalek vaagach kerava im yisrael birfidim:
Vayyomer moshe el-yehoshua bechar-lanu anashim vetze hillachem baamalek machar anochi nitztzav al-rosh haggiva umatte haelohim beyadi
Vaamar mshe lihoshua bechar lana guvrin ufuk agach kerava baamalek mechar ana kaem al resh ramata vechutera deitavidu ve nisin min kodam Adonai bidi:
Vayyaas yehoshua kaasher amar-lo moshe lehillachem baamalek umoshe aharon vechur alu rosh haggiva
Vaavad yehoshua kema deamar le mshe leagacha kerava baamalek umshe aharon vechur seliku leresh ramata:
Vehaya kaasher yarim moshe yado vegavar yisrael vechaasher yaniach yado vegavar amalek
Vahava kad merim mshe yedohi umitgabberin devet yisrael vechad manach yedohi umitgabberin devet amalek:
Vide moshe kevedim vayyikchu-even vayyasimu tachtav vayyeshev aleha veaharon vechur tamchu veyadav mizze echad umizze echad vayhi yadav emuna ad-bo hashshamesh
Vide mshe yekaran unesivu avna veshaviu techotohi vitev ala veaharon vechur sadan bidohi mikka chad umikka chad vahava yedohi perisan bitzlo ad deal shimsha:
Vayyachalosh yehoshua et-amalek veet-ammo lefi-charev
Vetabbar yehoshua yat amalek veyat ame lefitgam decharev:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe ketov zot zikkaron bassefer vesim beozne yehoshua ki-macho emche et-zecher amalek mittachat hashshamayim
Vaamar Adonai lemshe ketav da ducherana besifra veshavi kodam yehoshua are mimcha emche yat ducherana daamalek mittechot shemaya:
Vayyiven moshe mizbeach vayyikra shemo Adonai nissi
Uvena mshe madbecha ufelach alohi kodam Adonai daavad le nisin:
Vayyomer ki-yad al-kes yah milchama la-Adonai baamalek middor dor
Vaamar bishvua amira da min kodam dechela dishchinte al karse yekare deatid deyittagach kerava kodam Adonai bidvet amalek leshetzayutehon midare alma:
Vayyishma yitro chohen midyan choten moshe et kol-asher asa elohim lemoshe uleyisrael ammo ki-hotzi Adonai et-yisrael mimmitzrayim
Ushema yitro rabba demidyan chamuhi demshe yat kol di avad Adonai lemshe uleyisrael ame are appik Adonai yat yisrael mimitzrayim:
Vayyikkach yitro choten moshe et-tzippora eshet moshe achar shillucheha
Udevar yitro chamuhi demshe yat tzippora ittat mshe batar defatra:
Veet shene vaneha asher shem haechad gershom ki amar ger hayiti beeretz nochriyya
Veyat teren benaha di shum chad gershom are amar dayar haveti beara nucheraa:
Veshem haechad eliezer ki-elohe avi beezri vayyatztzileni mecherev paro
Veshum chad eliezer are elaha deabba hava vesadi veshezvani mecharba defaro:
Vayyavo yitro choten moshe uvanav veishto el-moshe el-hammidbar asher-hu chone sham har haelohim
Vaata yitro chamuhi demshe uvenohi veittete levat mshe lemadbera di hu share taman letura deitgele alohi yekara daAdonai:
Vayyomer el-moshe ani chotencha yitro ba elecha veishtecha ushene vaneha immah
Vaamar lemshe ana chamuch yitro ate levatach veittetach uteren benaha ima:
Vayyetze moshe likrat chotno vayyishtachu vayyishshak-lo vayyishalu ish-lereehu leshalom vayyavou haohela
Unefak mshe lekadamut chamuhi usegid uneshik le usheilu gevar lechavre lishlam vealu lemashkena:
Vaysapper moshe lechotno et kol-asher asa Adonai lefaro ulemitzrayim al odot yisrael et kol-hattelaa asher metzaatam badderech vayyatztzilem Adonai
Veishtai mshe lachamuhi yat kol di avad Adonai lefaro ulemitzrae al esak yisrael yat kol akta di ashkachtinun beorcha veshezvanun Adonai:
Vayyichad yitro al kol-hattova asher-asa Adonai leyisrael asher hitztzilo miyyad mitzrayim
Vachadi yitro al kol tavta di avad Adonai leyisrael di shezveh mida demitzrae:
Vayyomer yitro baruch Adonai asher hitztzil etchem miyyad mitzrayim umiyyad paro asher hitztzil et-haam mittachat yad-mitzrayim
Vaamar yitro berich Adonai di sheziv yatchon mida demitzrae umida defaro di sheziv yat ama mittechot marvat mitzrae:
Atta yadati ki-gadol Adonai mikkol-haelohim ki vaddavar asher zadu alehem
Kean yedana are rav Adonai velet elah bar mine are befitgama di chashivu mitzrae lemidan yat yisrael be daninun:
Vayyikkach yitro choten moshe ola uzevachim lelohim vayyavo aharon vechol zikne yisrael leechol-lechem im-choten moshe lifne haelohim
Vekariv yitro chamuhi demshe alavan venichsat kudeshin kodam Adonai vaata aharon vechol save yisrael lemechal lachma im chamuhi demshe kodam Adonai:
Vayhi mimmochorat vayyeshev moshe lishpot et-haam vayyaamod haam al-moshe min-habboker ad-haarev
Vahava miyoma devatrohi vitev mshe lemidan yat ama vekam ama ilavohi demshe min tzafra ad ramsha:
Vayyar choten moshe et kol-asher-hu ose laam vayyomer ma-haddavar hazze asher atta ose laam maddua atta yoshev levaddecha vechol-haam nitztzav alecha min-boker ad-arev
Vachaza chamuhi demshe yat kol di hu aved leama vaamar ma fitgama haden di at aved leama ma den at yatev bilchodach vechol ama kaymin ilavach min tzafra ad ramsha:
Vayyomer moshe lechotno ki-yavo elay haam lidrosh elohim
Vaamar mshe lachamuhi are atan levati ama lemitba ulefan min kodam Adonai:
Ki-yihye lahem davar ba elay veshafatti ben ish uven reehu vehodati et-chukke haelohim veet-torotav
Kad have lehon dina atan levati vedaina ben gavra uven chavre umehodana lehon yat keyamaya daAdonai veyat orayate:
Vayyomer choten moshe elav lo-tov haddavar asher atta ose
Vaamar chamuhi demshe le la takin pitgama deat aved:
Navol tibbol gam-atta gam-haam hazze asher immach ki-chaved mimmecha haddavar lo-tuchal asohu levaddecha
Mila tile af at af ama haden diimach are yakir minach pitgama la tikkol lemebede bilchodach:
Atta shema bekoli iatzcha vihi elohim immach heye atta laam mul haelohim veheveta atta et-haddevarim el-haelohim
Kean kabbel mini amalchinach vihe memra daAdonai besadach heve at leama teva ulefan min kodam Adonai utehe mayti at yat pitgamaya likodam Adonai:
Vehizharta ethem et-hachukkim veet-hattorot vehodata lahem et-hadderech yelchu vah veet-hammaase asher yaasun
Vetazhar yathon yat keyamaya veyat orayta utehoda lehon yat orcha diyhachun ba veyat ovada diyabedun:
Veatta techeze mikkol-haam anshe-chayil yire elohim anshe emet sone vatza vesamta alehem sare alafim sare meot sare chamishshim vesare asarot
Veat techeze mikkol ama guvrin dechela dachalaya daAdonai guvrin dikshot desanan lekabbala mamon utemane alehon rabbane alfin rabbane mavata rabbane chamshin verabbane isoryata:
Veshaftu et-haam bechol-et vehaya kol-haddavar haggadol yaviu elecha vechol-haddavar hakkaton yishpetu-hem vehakel mealecha venasu ittach
Vidunun yat ama bechol idan vihe kol pitgam rav yaytun levatach vechol pitgam zeer yedunun inun veyiklun minach visovrun imach:
Im et-haddavar hazze taase vetzivvecha elohim veyacholta amod vegam kol-haam hazze al-mekomo yavo veshalom
Im yat pitgama haden tabed vifakdinach Adonai vetikkol lemekam veaf kol ama haden al atre yehach bishlam:
Vayyishma moshe lekol chotno vayyaas kol asher amar
Vekabbil mshe lememra dachamuhi vaavad kol di amar:
Vayyivchar moshe anshe-chayil mikkol-yisrael vayyitten otam rashim al-haam sare alafim sare meot sare chamishshim vesare asarot
Uvechar mshe guvrin dechela mikkol yisrael umani yathon reshin al ama rabbane alfin rabbane mavata rabbane chamshin verabbane isoryata:
Veshaftu et-haam bechol-et et-haddavar hakkashe yeviun el-moshe vechol-haddavar hakkaton yishputu hem
Vedaynin yat ama bechol idan yat pitgam kashe maytin levat mshe vechol pitgam zeer daynin inun:
Vayshallach moshe et-chotno vayyelech lo el-artzo
Veshalach mshe yat chamuhi vaazal le leare:
Bachodesh hashshelishi letzet bene-yisrael meeretz mitzrayim bayyom hazze bau midbar sinay
Beyarcha telitaa lemippak bene yisrael meara demitzrayim beyoma haden ato lemadbera desinay:
Vayyisu merfidim vayyavou midbar sinay vayyachanu bammidbar vayyichan-sham yisrael neged hahar
Unetalu merfidim vaato lemadbera desinay ushero bemadbera ushera taman yisrael lokovel tura:
Umoshe ala el-haelohim vayyikra elav Adonai min-hahar lemor ko tomar levet yaakov vetagged livne yisrael
Umshe selek kodam Adonai ukera le Adonai min tura lememar kidnan temar levet yaakov utechavi livne yisrael:
Attem reitem asher asiti lemitzrayim vaessa etchem al-kanfe nesharim vaavi etchem elay
Attun chazittun di avadit lemitzrayim unetalit yatchon kidal gadfe nishrin vekarevit yatchon lefalchani:
Veatta im-shamoa tishmeu bekoli ushemartem et-beriti vihyitem li segulla mikkol-haammim ki-li kol-haaretz
Uchean im kabbala tekabbelun lememri vetitrun yat keyami utehon kodamay chabbivin mikkol ammaya are di li kol ara:
Veattem tihyu-li mamlechet kohanim vegoy kadosh elle haddevarim asher tedabber el-bene yisrael
Veattun tehon kodamay malchin kahanin veam kadish ilen pitgamaya di temalel im bene yisrael:
Vayyavo moshe vayyikra lezikne haam vayyasem lifnehem et kol-haddevarim haelle asher tzivvahu Adonai
Vaata mshe ukera lesave ama vesadar kodamehon yat kol pitgamaya hailen defakdeh Adonai:
Vayyaanu chol-haam yachdav vayyomru kol asher-dibber Adonai naase vayyashev moshe et-divre haam el-Adonai
Vaativu chol ama kachada vaamaru kol di malil Adonai nabed vaatev mshe yat pitgame ama kodam Adonai:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe hinne anochi ba elecha beav heanan baavur yishma haam bedabberi immach vegam-becha yaaminu leolam vayyagged moshe et-divre haam el-Adonai
Vaamar Adonai lemshe ha ana mitgeli lach beeva daanana bedil deyishma ama bemalaluti imach veaf bach yehemnun lealam vechavi mshe yat pitgame ama kodam Adonai:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe lech el-haam vekiddashtam hayyom umachar vechibbesu simlotam
Vaamar Adonai lemshe izel levat ama utezamninun yoma den umechar vichavrun levushehon:
Vehayu nechonim layyom hashshelishi ki bayyom hashshelishi yered Adonai leene chol-haam al-har sinay
Vihon zeminin leyoma telitaa are beyoma telitaa yitgeli Adonai leene chol ama al tura desinay:
Vehigbalta et-haam saviv lemor hishshamru lachem alot bahar unegoa bekatzehu kol-hannogea bahar mot yumat
Utetachem yat ama sechor sechor lememar istamaru lechon milmisak betura ulemikrav besofe kol deyikrav betura itketala yitketel:
Lo-tigga bo yad ki-sakol yissakel o-yaro yiyyare im-behema im-ish lo yichye bimshoch hayyovel hemma yaalu vahar
La tikrav be yeda are itregama yitregem o ishtedaa yishtedi im beira im enasha la yitkayam bemegad shofara inun merashan lemisak betura:
Vayyered moshe min-hahar el-haam vaykaddesh et-haam vaychabbesu simlotam
Unechat mshe min tura levat ama vezamin yat ama vechavaru levushehon:
Vayyomer el-haam heyu nechonim lishloshet yamim al-tiggeshu el-ishsha
Vaamar leama hevo zeminin litlata yomin la tikrevun letzad itteta:
Vayhi vayyom hashshelishi bihyot habboker vayhi kolot uverakim veanan kaved al-hahar vekol shofar chazak meod vayyecherad kol-haam asher bammachane
Vahava veyoma telitaa bemeheve tzafra vahava kalin uvarkin vaanana takif al tura vekal shofara takif lachada veza kol ama di vemashrita:
Vayyotze moshe et-haam likrat haelohim min-hammachane vayyityatztzevu betachtit hahar
Veappek mshe yat ama lekadamut memra daAdonai min mashrita veitattadu beshippole tura:
Vehar sinay ashan kullo mippene asher yarad alav Adonai baesh vayyaal ashano keeshen hakkivshan vayyecherad kol-hahar meod
Vetura desinay tanan kule min kodam deitgeli alohi Adonai beeshata uselik tenane kitnana deattuna veza kol tura lachada:
Vayhi kol hashshofar holech vechazek meod moshe yedabber vehaelohim yaanennu vekol
Vahava kal shofara azel vetakef lachada mshe memalel umin kodam Adonai mitane le vekal:
Vayyered Adonai al-har sinay el-rosh hahar vayyikra Adonai lemoshe el-rosh hahar vayyaal moshe
Veitgeli Adonai al tura desinay leresh tura ukera Adonai lemshe leresh tura uselik mshe:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe red haed baam pen-yehersu el-Adonai lirot venafal mimmennu rav
Vaamar Adonai lemshe chut ashed beama dilma yefagrun kodam Adonai lemecheze veyippel minhon sagi:
Vegam hakkohanim hanniggashim el-Adonai yitkaddashu pen-yifrotz bahem Adonai
Veaf kahanaya dikrivin leshamasha kodam Adonai yitkadshun dilma yiktol behon Adonai:
Vayyomer moshe el-Adonai lo-yuchal haam laalot el-har sinay ki-atta haedota banu lemor hagbel et-hahar vekiddashto
Vaamar mshe kodam Adonai la yikkol ama lemisak letura desinay are at ashedta bana lememar tachim yat tura vekadeshhi:
Vayyomer elav Adonai lech-red vealita atta veaharon immach vehakkohanim vehaam al-yehersu laalot el-Adonai pen-yifrotz-bam
Vaamar le Adonai izel chut vetisak at veaharon imach vechahanaya veama la yefagrun lemisak likodam Adonai dilma yiktol behon:
Vayyered moshe el-haam vayyomer alehem
Unechat mshe leama vaamar lehon:
Vaydabber elohim et kol-haddevarim haelle lemor
Umalil Adonai yat kol pitgamaya hailen lememar:
Anochi Adonai elohecha asher hotzeticha meeretz mitzrayim mibbet avadim
Ana Adonai elahach di appektach meara demitzrayim mibbet avduta:
Lo-yihye-lecha elohim acherim al-panaay
La yehe lach elah ochoran bar mini:
Lo-taase-lecha fesel vechol-temuna asher bashshamayim mimmaal vaasher baaretz mittaachat vaasher bammayim mittachat laaretz
La tabed lach tzelem vechol demut di vishmaya milela vedi veara milra vedi vemaya milra leara:
Lo-tishtachave lahem velo toovdem ki anochi Adonai elohecha el kanna poked avon avot al-banim al-shilleshim veal-ribbeim lesonay
La tisgud lehon vela tiflechinun are ana Adonai elahach el kana masar chove avahan al benin maradin al dar telitay veal dar reviay lesanay kad meshalmin benaya lemechete batar avahathon:
Veose chesed laalafim leohavay uleshomre mitzvotay
Veaved tivu lealfe darin lerachamay ulenatre fikoday:
Lo tissa et-shem-Adonai elohecha lashshav ki lo yenakke Adonai et asher-yissa et-shemo lashshav
La teme bishma daAdonai elahach lemagana are la yizakke Adonai yat diyeme vishme leshikra:
Zachor et-yom hashshabbat lekaddesho
Have dechir yat yoma deshabbeta lekadashute:
Sheshet yamim taavod veasita kol-melachtecha
Shitta yomin tiflach vetabed kol ividtach:
Veyom hashshevii shabbat la-Adonai elohecha lo-taase chol-melacha atta uvincha-uvittecha avdecha vaamatcha uvehemtecha vegercha asher bisharecha
Veyoma sheviaa shabbeta kodam Adonai elahach la tabed kol ividta at uverach uverattach avdach veamtach uveirach vegiyorach di vekirvach:
Ki sheshet-yamim asa Adonai et-hashshamayim veet-haaretz et-hayyam veet-kol-asher-bam vayyanach bayyom hashshevii al-ken berach Adonai et-yom hashshabbat vaykaddeshehu
Are shitta yomin avad Adonai yat shemaya veyat ara yat yama veyat kol di vehon venach beyoma sheviaa al ken barich Adonai yat yoma deshabbeta vekadshe:
Kabbed et-avicha veet-immecha lemaan yaarichun yamecha al haadama asher-Adonai elohecha noten lach
Yakar yat avuch veyat imach bedil deyorchun yomaych al ara daAdonai elahach yahev lach:
Lo tirtzach lo tinaf lo tignov lo-taane vereacha ed shaker
La tiktol nefash la teguf la tignuv la tashed bechavrach sahaduta deshikra:
Lo tachmod bet reecha lo-tachmod eshet reecha veavdo vaamato veshoro vachamoro vechol asher lereecha
La tachmed bet chavrach la tachmed ittat chavrach veavde veamte vetore vachamare vechol di lechavrach:
Vechol-haam roim et-hakkolot veet-hallappidim veet kol hashshofar veet-hahar ashen vayyar haam vayyanuu vayyaamdu merachok
Vechol ama chazan yat kalaya veyat baoraya veyat kal shofara veyat tura tanen vachaza ama vezau vekamu merachik:
Vayyomru el-moshe dabber-atta immanu venishmaa veal-yedabber immanu elohim pen-namut
Vaamaru lemshe malel at imana unekabbel vela yitmalel imana min kodam Adonai dilma nemut:
Vayyomer moshe el-haam al-tirau ki levaavur nassot etchem ba haelohim uvaavur tihye yirato al-penechem levilti techetau
Vaamar mshe leama la tidchalun are bedil lenasaa yatchon itgeli lechon yekara daAdonai uvedil dithe dachalte al appechon bedil dela techuvun:
Vayyaamod haam merachok umoshe niggash el-haarafel asher-sham haelohim
Vekam ama merachik umshe karev letzad amitta ditaman yekara daAdonai:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe ko tomar el-bene yisrael attem reitem ki min-hashshamayim dibbarti immachem
Vaamar Adonai lemshe kidnan temar livne yisrael attun chazittun are min shemaya malelit imchon:
Lo taasun itti elohe chesef velohe zahav lo taasu lachem
La tabedun kodamay dachalan dichsaf vedachalan didhav la tabedun lechon:
Mizbach adama taase-lli vezavachta alav et-olotecha veet-shelamecha et-tzoncha veet-bekarecha bechol-hammakom asher azkir et-shemi avo elecha uverachticha
Madbach admeta tabed kodamay utehe dabbach alohi yat alavatach veyat nichsat kudeshach min anach umin torach bechol atra di ashre yat shechinti letaman eshlach birketi lach veevarechinach:
Veim-mizbach avanim taase-lli lo-tivne ethen gazit ki charbecha henafta aleha vattechalleha
Veim madbach avnin tabed kodamay la tivne yathon pesilan dilma terim charbach ala utechallina:
Velo-taale vemaalot al-mizbechi asher lo-tiggale ervatcha alav
Vela tisak bedargin al madbechi di la titgele eryetach alohi:
Veelle hammishpatim asher tasim lifnehem
Veilen dinaya di tasdar kodamehon:
Ki tikne eved ivri shesh shanim yaavod uvashsheviit yetze lachofshi chinnam
Are tizban avda var yisrael shit shenin yiflach uvashvieta yippok levar chorin magan:
Im-begappo yavo begappo yetze im-baal ishsha hu veyatza ishto immo
Im bilchodohi yeol bilchodohi yippok im beel itteta hu vetippok ittete ime:
Im-adonav yitten-lo ishsha veyalda-lo vanim o vanot haishsha viladeha tihye ladoneha vehu yetze vegappo
Im ribbone yitten le itteta utelid le benin o venan itteta uvenaha tehe leribbonaha vehu yippok bilchodohi:
Veim-amor yomar haeved ahavti et-adoni et-ishti veet-banay lo etze chofshi
Veim memar yemar avda rachemna yat ribboni yat itteti veyat benay la eppok levar chorin:
Vehiggisho adonav el-haelohim vehiggisho el-haddelet o el-hammezuza veratza adonav et-ozno bammartzea vaavado leolam
Vikarvine ribbone likodam dayanaya vikarvine levat dasha o levat mezuzta veyartza ribbone yat udene bemartzea vihe le avad palach lealam:
Vechi-yimkor ish et-bitto leama lo tetze ketzet haavadim
Vaare yezabben gevar yat beratte leamhu la tippok kemafkanut avdaya:
Im-raa beene adoneha asher-lo yeadah vehefdah leam nochri lo-yimshol lemochrah bevigdo-vah
Im bisha beene ribbona dikayma le veyifrekina ligvar ochoran let le reshu lezabbona bemishlete va:
Veim-livno yiadenna kemishpat habbanot yaase-llah
Veim livre yekaymina kehilchat benat yisrael yabed la:
Im-acheret yikkach-lo sheerah kesutah veonatah lo yigra
Im ochoranta yisav le ziyuna kesuta veonata la yimna:
Veim-shelosh-elle lo yaase lah veyatza chinnam en kasef
Veim telat ilen la yabed la vetippok magan bela chesaf:
Makke ish vamet mot yumat
Deyimche leenash veyikteline itketala yitketel:
Vaasher lo tzada vehaelohim inna leyado vesamti lecha makom asher yanus shamma
Udela cheman le umin kodam Adonai ittimsar lide veeshavi lach atar di yeirok letaman:
Vechi-yazid ish al-reehu lehorgo veorma meim mizbechi tikkachennu lamut
Vaare yarsha gevar al chavre lemiktele vinchilu min madbechi tidberine limmat:
Umakke aviv veimmo mot yumat
Udeyimche avuhi veime itketala yitketel:
Vegonev ish umecharo venimtza veyado mot yumat
Vediyignuv nafsha min bene yisrael vizabbenine veyishtechach bide itketala yitketel:
Umekallel aviv veimmo mot yumat
Vediylut avuhi veime itketala yitketel:
Vechi-yerivun anashim vehikka-ish et-reehu beeven o veegrof velo yamut venafal lemishkav
Vaare yintzun guvrin veyimche gevar yat chavre beavna o vechuremeza vela yemut veyippol levutelan:
Im-yakum vehithallech bachutz al-mishanto venikka hammakke rak shivto yitten verappo yerappe
Im yekum vihalich bevara al bureye vihe zakkaa machya lechod butelane yitten vaagar asya yeshalem:
Vechi-yakke ish et-avdo o et-amato bashshevet umet tachat yado nakom yinnakem
Vaare yimche gevar yat avde o yat amte beshaltan vimut techot yede itdana yittedan:
Ach im-yom o yomayim yaamod lo yukkam ki chaspo hu
Beram im yoma o teren yomin yitkayam la yittedan are chaspe hu:
Vechi-yinnatzu anashim venagfu ishsha hara veyatzu yeladeha velo yihye ason anosh yeanesh kaasher yashit alav baal haishsha venatan biflilim
Vaare yintzun guvrin veyimchun itteta maadya veyippekun valdaha vela yehe mota itgevaa yitgeve kema di yeshavi alohi baala deitteta veyitten al memar dayanaya:
Veim-ason yihye venatatta nefesh tachat nafesh
Veim mota yehe vetitten nafsha cholaf nafsha:
Ayin tachat ayin shen tachat shen yad tachat yad regel tachat ragel
Ena cholaf ena shina cholaf shina yeda cholaf yeda ragla cholaf ragla:
Keviyya tachat keviyya petza tachat patza chabbura tachat chabbura
Kevaa cholaf kevaa pida cholaf pida mashkofe cholaf mashkofe:
Vechi-yakke ish et-en avdo o-et-en amato veshichatah lachofshi yeshallechennu tachat eno
Vaare yimche gevar yat ena deavde o yat ena deamte vichabbelina levar chorin yifterine cholaf ene:
Veim-shen avdo o-shen amato yappil lachofshi yeshallechennu tachat shinno
Veim shina deavde o shina deamte yappel levar chorin yifterine cholaf shine:
Vechi-yiggach shor et-ish o et-ishsha vamet sakol yissakel hashshor velo yeachel et-besaro uvaal hashshor naki
Vaare yagach tora yat gavra o yat itteta vimut itregama yitregem tora vela yitachel yat bisre umare detora yehe zakkaa:
Veim shor naggach hu mittemol shilshom vehuad bivalav velo yishmerennu vehemit ish o ishsha hashshor yissakel vegam-bealav yumat
Veim tor nagach hu meittemale umidkamohi veyittashed bemare vela natre veyiktol gavra o itteta tora yitregem veaf mare yitketel:
Im-kofer yushat alav venatan pidyon nafsho kechol asher-yushat alav
Im mamon yeshavun alohi veyitten purekan nafshe kechol di yeshavun alohi:
O-ven yiggach o-vat yiggach kammishpat hazze yease lo
O levar yisrael yagach tora o levat yisrael yagach kedina haden yitaved le:
Im-eved yiggach hashshor o ama kesef sheloshim shekalim yitten ladonav vehashshor yissakel
Im leavda yagach tora o leamta kesaf telatin silin yitten leribbone vetora yitregem:
Vechi-yiftach ish bor o ki-yichre ish bor velo yechassennu venafal-shamma shor o chamor
Vaare yiftach gevar gov o are yichre gevar gov vela yechasine veyippel taman tora o chamara:
Baal habbor yeshallem kesef yashiv livalav vehammet yihye-llo
Mare degubba yeshalem kaspa yativ lemarohi umeta yehe dile:
Vechi-yiggof shor-ish et-shor reehu vamet umachru et-hashshor hachay vechatzu et-kaspo vegam et-hammet yechetzun
Vaare yigof tor digvar yat tora dechavre vimut vizabbenun yat tora chaya vifalgun yat kaspe veaf yat deme meta yefalgun:
O noda ki shor naggach hu mittemol shilshom velo yishmerennu bealav shallem yeshallem shor tachat hashshor vehammet yihye-llo
O ityeda are tor nagach hu meittemale umidkamohi vela natre mare shalama yeshalem tora chalaf tora umeta yehe dile:
Ki yignov-ish shor o-se utevacho o mecharo chamishsha vakar yeshallem tachat hashshor vearba-tzon tachat hasse
Are yignuv gevar tor o imar veyikkesine o yezabbenine chamsha torin yeshalem chalaf tora vearba ana cholaf imra:
Im-bammachteret yimmatze haggannav vehukka vamet en lo damim
Im bemachtarta yishtechach ganava veyitmeche vimut let le dam:
Im-zarcha hashshemesh alav damim lo shallem yeshallem im-en lo venimkar bignevato
Im ena desahadaya nefalat alohi dema le shalama yeshalem im let le veyizdabban bignuvte:
Im-himmatze timmatze veyado haggeneva mishshor ad-chamor ad-se chayyim shenayim yeshallem
Im ishtechacha yishtechach bide genuvta mittor ad chamar ad imar kad inun chayin al chad teren yeshalem:
Ki yaver-ish sade o-cherem veshillach et-beiro uvier bisde acher metav sadehu umetav karmo yeshallem
Are yochil gevar chakal o cheram vishalach yat beire veyechul bachakal ochoran shefar chakle ushefar karme yeshalem:
Ki-tetze esh umatza kotzim veneechal gadish o hakkama o hassade shallem yeshallem hammavir et-habbeera
Are tittappak nur veyashkach kuvin veyechul gedishin o koma o chakla shalama yeshalem deadlek yat delekta:
Ki-yitten ish el-reehu kesef o-chelim lishmor vegunnav mibbet haish im-yimmatze haggannav yeshallem shenayim
Are yitten gevar lechavre kesaf o manin lemitar veyitganvun mibbet gavra im yishtechach ganava yeshalem al chad teren:
Im-lo yimmatze haggannav venikrav baal-habbayit el-haelohim im-lo shalach yado bimlechet reehu
Im la yishtechach ganava veyitkarev mare deveta likodam dayanaya im la oshit yede bema dimsar le chavre:
Al-kol-devar-pesha al-shor al-chamor al-se al-salma al-kol-aveda asher yomar ki-hu ze ad haelohim yavo devar-shenehem asher yarshiun elohim yeshallem shenayim lereehu
Al kol pitgam dechov al tor al chamar al imar al kesu al kol avedta di yemar are hu den likodam dayanaya yeol din tarvehon di yechayvun dayanaya yeshalem al chad teren lechavre:
Ki-yitten ish el-reehu chamor o-shor o-se vechol-behema lishmor umet o-nishbar o-nishba en roe
Are yitten gevar lechavre chamar o tor o imar vechol beira lemitar umit o ittevar o ishtevi let dechaze:
Shevuat Adonai tihye ben shenehem im-lo shalach yado bimlechet reehu velakach bealav velo yeshallem
Momata daAdonai tehe ben tarvehon im la oshit yede bema dimsar le chavre vikabbel mare mine momata vela yeshalem:
Veim-ganov yigganev meimmo yeshallem livalav
Veim itgenava yitgenev meime yeshalem lemarohi:
Im-tarof yittaref yeviehu ed hatterefa lo yeshallem
Im ittevara yittevar yayti sahadin ditvira la yeshalem:
Vechi-yishal ish meim reehu venishbar o-met bealav en-immo shallem yeshallem
Vaare yishal gevar min chavre veyittevar o mit mare let ime shalama yeshalem:
Im-bealav immo lo yeshallem im-sachir hu ba bischaro
Im mare ime la yeshalem im agira hu al beagre:
Vechi-yefatte ish betula asher lo-orasa veshachav immah mahor yimharenna lo leishsha
Vaare yeshadel gevar vetulta di la mearsa veyishkuv ima kayama yekaymina le leintu:
Im-maen yemaen aviha letittah lo kesef yishkol kemohar habbetulot
Im mitzba la yitzbe avuha lemittena le kaspa yitkol kemohare betulta:
Mechashshefa lo techayye
Charasha la tache:
Kol-shochev im-behema mot yumat
Kol deyishkuv im beira itketala yitketel:
Zoveach laelohim yochoram bilti la-Adonai levaddo
Dedabbach letavat ammaya yitketel elahen lishma daAdonai bilchodohi:
Veger lo-tone velo tilchatzennu ki-gerim heyitem beeretz mitzrayim
Vegiyora la tonun vela teikun le are dayarin hevetun beara demitzrayim:
Kol-almana veyatom lo teannun
Kol armela veyittam la teanun:
Im-anne teanne oto ki im-tzaok yitzak elay shamoa eshma tzaakato
Im anaa teane yate are im mikval yikvel kodamay kabbala ekabbel kevilte:
Vechara appi veharagti etchem becharev vehayu neshechem almanot uvenechem yetomim
Veyitkef rugezi veektol yatchon becharba vihevyan neshechon armelin uvenechon yatmin:
Im-kesef talve et-ammi et-heani immach lo-tihye lo kenoshe lo-tesimun alav neshech
Im kaspa tozef beami leanya di imach la tehe le kerashya la teshavvon alohi chibbuleya:
Im-chavol tachbol salmat reecha ad-bo hashshemesh teshivennu lo
Im mashkona tisav kesuta dechavrach ad meal shimsha tetivine le:
Ki hiv chesuto levaddah hiv simlato leoro bamme yishkav vehaya ki-yitzak elay veshamati ki-channun ani
Are hi chesute bilchoda hi totve lemashkeh bema yishkuv vihe are yikvel kodamay veekabbel kevilte are chanana ana:
Elohim lo tekallel venasi veammecha lo taor
Dayana la tekil verabba veamach la telut:
Meleatcha vedimacha lo teacher bechor banecha titten-li
Bikkurach vedimach la teacher buchera divnaych tafresh kodamay:
Ken-taase leshorcha letzonecha shivat yamim yihye im-immo bayyom hashshemini titteno-li
Ken tabed letorach leanach shiva yomin yehe im ime beyoma teminaa tifreshine kodamay:
Veanshe-kodesh tihyun li uvasar bassade terefa lo tochelu lakkelev tashlichun oto
Veenashin kadishin tehon kodamay uvesar telish min cheva chayta la techlun lechalba tirmun yate:
Lo tissa shema shav al-tashet yadcha im-rasha lihyot ed chamas
La tekabbel shema dishkar la teshavi yedach im chayava lemeheve le sahid shekar:
Lo-tihye achare-rabbim leraot velo-taane al-riv lintot achare rabbim lehattot
La tehe batar sagiin leavasha vela titmena milalafa ma divenach al dina batar sagie shelam dina:
Vedal lo tedar berivo
Veal miskena la terachem bedine:
Ki tifga shor oyivcha o chamoro toe hashev teshivennu lo
Are tifga tora desanach o chamare detae atava tetivine le:
Ki-tire chamor sonaacha rovetz tachat massao vechadalta meazov lo azov taazov immo
Are techeze chamara desanach revia techot toaneh vetittimna milmishbak le mishbak tishbok ma divlibbach alohi utefarek ime:
Lo tatte mishpat evyoncha berivo
La tatzle din miskenach bedine:
Middevar-sheker tirchak venaki vetzaddik al-taharog ki lo-atzdik rasha
Mippitgama deshikra heve rachik vedizche vedi nefak deche min dina la tiktol are la ezakke chayava:
Veshochad lo tikkach ki hashshochad yeavver pikchim visallef divre tzaddikim
Veshochada la tekabbel are shochada meaver ene chakkimin umekalkel pitgamin teritzin:
Veger lo tilchatz veattem yedatem et-nefesh hagger ki-gerim heyitem beeretz mitzrayim
Vegiyora la teikun veattun yedatun yat nafsha degiyora are dayarin havetun beara demitzrayim:
Veshesh shanim tizra et-artzecha veasafta et-tevuatah
Veshit shenin tizra yat arach vetichnosh yat alalta:
Vehashsheviit tishmetenna unetashtah veachlu evyone ammecha veyitram tochal chayyat hassade ken-taase lecharmecha lezetecha
Ushevieta tashmetina vetarteshina veyechlun miskene amach ushearhon techul chevat bara ken tabed lecharmach lezetach:
Sheshet yamim taase maasecha uvayyom hashshevii tishbot lemaan yanuach shorcha vachamorecha veyinnafesh ben-amatcha vehagger
Shitta yomin tabed ovadaych uveyoma sheviaa tanuach bedil dinuach torach vechamarach veyishshekot bar amtach vegiyora:
Uvechol asher-amarti alechem tishshameru veshem elohim acherim lo tazkiru lo yishshama al-picha
Uvechol di amarit lechon tistamrun veshum taavat ammaya la tidkerun la yishtema al pumechon:
Shalosh regalim tachog li bashshana
Telat zimnin techog kodamay beshatta:
Et-chag hammatztzot tishmor shivat yamim tochal matztzot kaasher tzivviticha lemoed chodesh haaviv ki-vo yatzata mimmitzrayim velo-yerau fanay rekam
Yat chaga defatiraya titar shiva yomin techul patira kema difakedittach lizman yarcha daaviva are ve nefakta mimitzrayim vela yitchazun kodamay rekanun:
Vechag hakkatzir bikkure maasecha asher tizra bassade vechag haasif betzet hashshana beospecha et-maasecha min-hassade
Vechaga dachatzada bikkure ovadaych di tizra bechakla vechaga dichnasha bemippeka deshatta bemichneshach yat ovadaych min chakla:
Shalosh peamim bashshana yerae kol-zechurecha el-pene haadon Adonai
Telat zimnin beshatta yitchazun kol dechurach kodam ribbon alma Adonai:
Lo-tizbach al-chametz dam-zivchi velo-yalin chelev-chaggi ad-boker
La tikkos al chamia dam pischi vela yevitun bar min madbecha tarbe nichsat chaga ad tzafra:
Reshit bikkure admatcha tavi bet Adonai elohecha lo-tevashshel gedi bachalev immo
Resh bikkure arach tayti levet mikdesha daAdonai elahach la techlun besar bachalav:
Hinne anochi sholeach malach lefanecha lishmorcha baddarech velahaviacha el-hammakom asher hachinoti
Ha ana shalach malacha kodamach lemitrach beorcha uleoolutach leatra diatkenit:
Hishshamer mippanav ushema bekolo al-tammer bo ki lo yissa lefishachem ki shemi bekirbo
Istammar min kodamohi vekabbel lememre la tesarev lekivle are la yishbok lechovechon are vishmi memre:
Ki im-shamoa tishma bekolo veasita kol asher adabber veayavti et-oyvecha vetzarti et-tzorerecha
Are im kabbala tekabbel lememre vetabed kol deemalel veesne yat sanach veaik ledimikin lach:
Ki-yelech malachi lefanecha veheviacha el-haemori vehachitti vehapperizzi vehakkenaani hachivvi vehayevusi vehichchadtiv
Are yehach malachi kodamach veyaelinach levat emorae vechittae uferizae uchenaanae chivae vivusae veeshetzinun:
Lo-tishtachave lelohehem velo toovdem velo taase kemaasehem ki hares teharsem veshabber teshabber matztzevotehem
La tisgud letaavathon vela tiflechinun vela tabed keovadehon are fagara tefagrinun vetabbara tetabbar kamathon:
Vaavadtem et Adonai elohechem uverach et-lachmecha veet-memecha vahasiroti machala mikkirbecha
Vetiflechun kodam Adonai elahachon vivarech yat mechlach veyat mishteyach veadi marin bishin mibbenach:
Lo tihye meshakkela vaakara beartzecha et-mispar yamecha amalle
La tehe metakkela veakra bearach yat minyan yomaych ashlim:
Et-emati ashallach lefanecha vehammoti et-kol-haam asher tavo bahem venatatti et-kol-oyvecha elecha oref
Yat emti ashalach kodamach veitbar yat kol ama deat ate laagacha behon veemsar yat kol baale devavach kodamach mechazre kedal:
Veshalachti et-hatztzira lefanecha vegersha et-hachivvi et-hakkenaani veet-hachitti millefanecha
Veeshlach yat araita kodamach utetarech yat chivae yat kenaanae veyat chittae min kodamach:
Lo agarshennu mippanecha beshana echat pen-tihye haaretz shemama verabba alecha chayyat hassade
La etarechinun min kodamach beshatta chada dilma tehe ara tzadya vetisge alach chevat bara:
Meat meat agarshennu mippanecha ad asher tifre venachalta et-haaretz
Zeer zeer etarechinun min kodamach ad detisge vetachsen yat ara:
Veshatti et-gevulcha miyyam-suf vead-yam pelishtim umimmidbar ad-hannahar ki etten beyedchem et yoshve haaretz vegerashtamo mippanecha
Veeshave yat techumach miyama desuf vead yama diflishtae umimadbera ad perat are emsar bidechon yat yatve ara utetarechinun min kodamach:
Lo-tichrot lahem velelohehem berit
La tigzar lehon uletaavathon keyam:
Lo yeshvu beartzecha pen-yachatiu otcha li ki taavod et-elohehem ki-yihye lecha lemokesh
La yetvun bearach dilma yechayvun yatach kodamay are tiflach yat taavathon are yehon lach letakla:
Veel-moshe amar ale el-Adonai atta veaharon nadav vaavihu veshivim mizzikne yisrael vehishtachavitem merachok
Ulemshe amar sak likodam Adonai at veaharon nadav vaavihu veshivin misave yisrael vetisgedun merachik:
Veniggash moshe levaddo el-Adonai vehem lo yiggashu vehaam lo yaalu immo
Veyitkerev mshe vilchodohi likodam Adonai veinun la yitkarvun veama la yiskun ime:
Vayyavo moshe vaysapper laam et kol-divre Adonai veet kol-hammishpatim vayyaan kol-haam kol echad vayyomru kol-haddevarim asher-dibber Adonai naase
Vaata mshe veishtai leama yat kol pitgamaya daAdonai veyat kol dinaya vaatev kol ama kala chad vaamaru kol pitgamaya di malil Adonai nabed:
Vayyichtov moshe et kol-divre Adonai vayyashkem babboker vayyiven mizbeach tachat hahar ushetem esre matztzeva lishnem asar shivte yisrael
Uchetav mshe yat kol pitgamaya daAdonai veakdem betzafra uvena madbecha beshippole tura vetarta esre kaman litre asar shivtaya deyisrael:
Vayyishlach et-naare bene yisrael vayyaalu olot vayyizbechu zevachim shelamim la-Adonai parim
Ushelach yat buchere bene yisrael veasiku alavan vekarivu nichsat kudeshin kodam Adonai torin:
Vayyikkach moshe chatzi haddam vayyasem baagganot vachatzi haddam zarak al-hammizbeach
Unesiv mshe palgut dema veshavi bemizrekaya ufalgut dema zerak al madbecha:
Vayyikkach sefer habberit vayyikra beozne haam vayyomru kol asher-dibber Adonai naase venishma
Unesiv sifra dikyama ukera kodam ama vaamaru kol di malil Adonai nabed unekabbel:
Vayyikkach moshe et-haddam vayyizrok al-haam vayyomer hinne dam-habberit asher karat Adonai immachem al kol-haddevarim haelle
Unesiv mshe yat dema uzerak al madbecha lechappara al ama vaamar ha den dam keyama digzar Adonai imchon al kol pitgamaya hailen:
Vayyaal moshe veaharon nadav vaavihu veshivim mizzikne yisrael
Uselek mshe veaharon nadav vaavihu veshivin misave yisrael
Vayyiru et elohe yisrael vetachat raglav kemaase livnat hassappir ucheetzem hashshamayim latohar
Vachazo yat yekar elaha deyisrael utechot karsa yekare keovad even tava uchemecheze shemaya levariru:
Veel-atzile bene yisrael lo shalach yado vayyechezu et-haelohim vayyochlu vayyishtu
Uleravreve bene yisrael la hava nizka vachazo yat yekara daAdonai vahavo chadan bekorbanehon deitkabbalu beraava keilu ochlin veshatan:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe ale elay hahara veye-sham veettena lecha et-luchot haeven vehattora vehammitzva asher katavti lehorotam
Vaamar Adonai lemshe sak likodamay letura veheve taman veetten lach yat luche avna veorayta vetafkedta dichtavit lealufehon:
Vayyakom moshe vihoshua mesharto vayyaal moshe el-har haelohim
Vekam mshe vihoshua meshumshane uselek mshe letura deitgeli alohi yekara daAdonai:
Veel-hazzekenim amar shevu-lanu vaze ad asher-nashuv alechem vehinne aharon vechur immachem mi-vaal devarim yiggash alehem
Ulesavaya amar orichu lana hacha ad dintuv levatchon veha aharon vechur imchon man deit le dina yitkerev likodamehon:
Vayyaal moshe el-hahar vaychas heanan et-hahar
Uselek mshe letura vachafa anana yat tura:
Vayyishkon kevod-Adonai al-har sinay vaychassehu heanan sheshet yamim vayyikra el-moshe bayyom hashshevii mittoch heanan
Ushera yekara daAdonai al tura desinay vachafahi anana shitta yomin ukera lemshe beyoma sheviaa migo anana:
Umare kevod Adonai keesh ochelet berosh hahar leene bene yisrael
Vechezu yekara daAdonai kechezu esha ochla beresh tura leene bene yisrael:
Vayyavo moshe betoch heanan vayyaal el-hahar vayhi moshe bahar arbaim yom vearbaim layla
Veal mshe bego anana uselek letura vahava mshe betura arbein yemamin vearbein lelavan:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael veyikchu-li teruma meet kol-ish asher yiddevennu libbo tikchu et-terumati
Mallel im bene yisrael veyafreshun kodamay afrashuta min kol gevar deyitreeh libbeh tissevun yat afrashuti:
Vezot hatteruma asher tikchu meittam zahav vachesef unechoshet
Veda afrashuta ditissevun minnehon dahava vechaspa unechasha:
Utechelet veargaman vetolaat shani veshesh veizzim
Vetichla veargevana utzeva zehori uvutz umeazze:
Veorot elim meoddamim veorot techashim vaatze shittim
Umashche dedichre mesammeke umashche sasgona veae shittin:
Shemen lammaor besamim leshemen hammishcha veliktoret hassammim
Mishcha leanharuta busemayya lemishcha dirvuta veliktoret busemayya:
Avne-shoham veavne milluim laefod velachoshen
Avne vurela veavne ashlamuta leshakkaa veefoda uvechushena:
Veasu li mikdash veshachanti betocham
Veyabedun kodamay mikdesha veashre shechinti benehon:
Kechol asher ani mare otcha et tavnit hammishkan veet tavnit kol-kelav vechen taasu
Kechol di ana machaze yatach yat demut mashkena veyat demut kol manohi vechen tabedun:
Veasu aron atze shittim ammatayim vachetzi orko veamma vachetzi rochbo veamma vachetzi komato
Veyabedun arona deae shittin tarten ammin ufalga urkeh veammeta ufalga petaye veammeta ufalga rumeh:
Vetzippita oto zahav tahor mibbayit umichutz tetzappennu veasita alav zer zahav saviv
Vetechefe yateh dehav deche miggav umibbara tachafinneh vetabed alohi zer didhav sechor sechor:
Veyatzakta lo arba tabbeot zahav venatatta al arba paamotav ushete tabbaot al-tzalo haechat ushete tabbaot al-tzalo hashshenit
Vetattich leh arba izkan didhav vetitten al arba zivyateh vetarten izkan al sitreh chad vetarten izkan al sitreh tinyeta:
Veasita vadde atze shittim vetzippita otam zahav
Vetabed ariche deae shittin vetachafe yathon dahava:
Veheveta et-habbaddim battabbaot al tzalot haaron laset et-haaron bahem
Vetael yat arichayya beizkata al sitre arona lemittal yat arona behon:
Betabbeot haaron yihyu habbaddim lo yasuru mimmennu
Beizketa daarona yehon arichayya la yeiddun minneh:
Venatatta el-haaron et haedut asher etten elecha
Vetitten baarona yat sahaduta di etten lach:
Veasita chapporet zahav tahor ammatayim vachetzi orkah veamma vachetzi rochbah
Vetabed kappurta didhav deche tarten ammin ufalga urka veammeta ufalga petaya:
Veasita shenayim keruvim zahav miksha taase otam mishshene ketzot hakkapporet
Vetabed teren keruvin didhav negid tabed yathon mitteren sitre chappurta:
Vaase keruv echad mikkatza mizze ucheruv-echad mikkatza mizze min-hakkapporet taasu et-hakkeruvim al-shene ketzotav
Veibbed keruva chad missitra mikka ucheruva chad missitra mikka min kappurta tabedun yat keruvayya al teren sitrohi:
Vehayu hakkeruvim porse chenafayim lemala sochechim bechanfehem al-hakkapporet ufenehem ish el-achiv el-hakkapporet yihyu pene hakkeruvim
Vihon keruvayya perisan gadfehon leella metallin begadfehon al kappurta veappehon chad lokovel chad lokovel kappurta yehon appe cheruvayya:
Venatatta et-hakkapporet al-haaron milmala veel-haaron titten et-haedut asher etten elecha
Vetitten yat kappurta al arona milleella uvaarona titten yat sahaduta di etten lach:
Venoadti lecha sham vedibbarti ittecha meal hakkapporet mibben shene hakkeruvim asher al-aron haedut et kol-asher atzavve otcha el-bene yisrael
Veezammen memri lach tamman veemallel immach meillave chappurta mibben teren keruvayya di al arona desahaduta yat kol di afakked yatach levat bene yisrael:
Veasita shulchan atze shittim ammatayim orko veamma rochbo veamma vachetzi komato
Vetabed patora deae shittin tarten ammin urkeh veammeta fetaye veammeta ufalga rumeh:
Vetzippita oto zahav tahor veasita lo zer zahav saviv
Vetachafe yateh dehav deche vetabed leh zer didhav sechor sechor:
Veasita lo misgeret tofach saviv veasita zer-zahav lemisgarto saviv
Vetabed leh gedanfa rumeh pushka sechor sechor vetabed zer didhav ligdanfeh sechor sechor:
Veasita lo arba tabbeot zahav venatatta et-hattabbaot al arba happeot asher learba raglav
Vetabed leh arba izkan didhav vetitten yat izkata al arba zivyata di learba raglohi:
Leummat hammisgeret tihyena hattabbaot levattim levaddim laset et-hashshulchan
Lokovel gedanfa yehevyan izkata leatra laarichayya lemittal yat patora:
Veasita et-habbaddim atze shittim vetzippita otam zahav venissa-vam et-hashshulchan
Vetabed yat arichayya deae shittin vetachafe yathon dahava vihon natlin behon yat patora:
Veasita kearotav vechappotav ukesotav umenakkiyyotav asher yussach bahen zahav tahor taase otam
Vetabed magisohi uvazikkohi vekasvateh umechilateh diyitnassach behen dehav deche tabed yathon:
Venatatta al-hashshulchan lechem panim lefanay tamid
Vetitten al patora lechem appayya kodamay tedira:
Veasita menorat zahav tahor miksha tease hammenora yerechah vekanah gevieha kaftoreha uferacheha mimmenna yihyu
Vetabed menarta didhav deche negid titaved menarta shidda ukena kallidaha chezuraha veshoshannaha minna yehon:
Veshishsha kanim yotzim mitztziddeha shelosha kene menora mitztziddah haechad ushelosha kene menora mitztziddah hashsheni
Veshitta kenin nafkin missitraha telata kene menarta missitra chad utelata kene menarta missitra tinyana:
Shelosha geviim meshukkadim bakkane haechad kaftor vaferach ushelosha geviim meshukkadim bakkane haechad kaftor vafarach ken lesheshet hakkanim hayyotzim min-hammenora
Telata challidin metzayrin bekanya chad chezur veshoshan utelata challidin metzayrin bekanya chad chezur veshoshan ken leshitta kenin denafkin min menarta:
Uvammenora arbaa geviim meshukkadim kaftoreha uferacheha
Uvimnarta arbea challidin metzayrin chezuraha veshoshannaha:
Vechaftor tachat shene hakkanim mimmenna vechaftor tachat shene hakkanim mimmenna vechaftor tachat-shene hakkanim mimmenna lesheshet hakkanim hayyotzim min-hammenora
Vechezur techot teren kenin minna vechezur techot teren kenin minna vechezur techot teren kenin minna leshitta kenin denafkin min menarta:
Kaftorehem ukenotam mimmenna yihyu kullah miksha achat zahav tahor
Chezurehon ukenehon minna yehon kulla negida chada didhav deche:
Veasita et-neroteha shiva veheela et-neroteha veheir al-ever paneha
Vetabed yat botzinaha shiva vetadlek yat botzinaha vihon menaharin al kovel appaha:
Umalkacheha umachtoteha zahav tahor
Vetzivyataha umachteyataha didhav deche:
Kikkar zahav tahor yaase otah et kol-hakkelim haelle
Kikkera didhav deche yabed yata yat kol manayya haillen:
Uree vaase betavnitam asher-atta more bahar
Vachaze vaaved kidmutehon diat mitchazi betura:
Veet-hammishkan taase eser yeriot shesh moshzar utechelet veargaman vetolaat shani keruvim maase choshev taase otam
Veyat mashkena tabed asar yerian devutz shezir vetichla veargevana utzeva zehori tzurat keruvin ovad oman tabed yathon:
Orech hayeria haachat shemone veesrim baamma verochav arba baamma hayeria haechat midda achat lechol-hayeriot
Urka diriata chada asrin vetamne ammin ufuteya arba ammin diriata chada meshachta chada lechol yeriata:
Chamesh hayeriot tihyena chovrot ishsha el-achotah vechamesh yeriot chovrot ishsha el-achotah
Chamesh yerian yehevyan melappefan chada im chada vachamesh yerian melappefan chada im chada:
Veasita lulot techelet al sefat hayeria haechat mikkatza bachovaret vechen taase bisfat hayeria hakkitzona bammachberet hashshenit
Vetabed anuvin detichla al sifta diriata chada missitra bet lofe vechen tabed besifta diriata besitra devet lofe tinyeta:
Chamishshim lulaot taase bayria haechat vachamishshim lulaot taase biktze hayeria asher bammachberet hashshenit makbilot hallulaot ishsha el-achotah
Chamshin anuvin tabed biriata chada vechamshin anuvin tabed besitra diriata devet lofe tinyana mechavvenan anuvayya chada lokovel chada:
Veasita chamishshim karse zahav vechibbarta et-hayeriot ishsha el-achotah bakkerasim vehaya hammishkan echad
Vetabed chamshin purefin didhav utelafef yat yeriata chada im chada befurefayya vihe mashkena chad:
Veasita yeriot izzim leohel al-hammishkan ashte-esre yeriot taase otam
Vetabed yerian meazze lifrasa al mashkena chada esre yerian tabed yathon:
Orech hayeria haachat sheloshim baamma verochav arba baamma hayeria haechat midda achat leashte esre yeriot
Urka diriata chada telatin ammin ufuteya arba ammin diriata chada meshachta chada lachada esre yerian:
Vechibbarta et-chamesh hayeriot levad veet-shesh hayeriot levad vechafalta et-hayeria hashshishshit el-mul pene haohel
Utelafef yat chamesh yerian lechod veyat shit yerian lechod veteuf yat yeriata shetiteta lokovel appe mashkena:
Veasita chamishshim lulaot al sefat hayeria haechat hakkitzona bachovaret vachamishshim lulaot al sefat hayeria hachoveret hashshenit
Vetabed chamshin anuvin al sifta diriata chada besitra bet lofe vechamshin anuvin al sifta diriata devet lofe tinyeta:
Veasita karse nechoshet chamishshim veheveta et-hakkerasim ballulaot vechibbarta et-haohel vehaya echad
Vetabed purefin dinchasha chamshin vetael yat purefayya baanuvayya utelafef yat mashkena vihe chad:
Veserach haodef biriot haohel chatzi hayeria haodefet tisrach al achore hammishkan
Vesircha deyattira biriat mashkena palgut yeriata deyattira tisrach al achore mashkena:
Vehaamma mizze vehaamma mizze baodef beorech yeriot haohel yihye saruach al-tzidde hammishkan mizze umizze lechassoto
Veammeta mikka veammeta mikka bidyattira beurka yeriata demashkena yehe seriach al sitre mashkena mikka umikka lechassayuteh:
Veasita michse laohel orot elim meoddamim umichse orot techashim milmala
Vetabed chofaa lifrasa mashche dedichre mesammeke vechofaa mashche desasgona milleella:
Veasita et-hakkerashim lammishkan atze shittim omdim
Vetabed yat dappayya lemashkena deae shittin kaymin:
Eser ammot orech hakkaresh veamma vachatzi haamma rochav hakkeresh haechad
Asar ammin urka dedappa veammeta ufalgut ammeta puteya dedappa chad:
Shete yadot lakkeresh haechad meshullavot ishsha el-achotah ken taase lechol karshe hammishkan
Tarten tzirin ledappa chad meshallevin chada lokovel chada ken tabed lechol dappe mashkena:
Veasita et-hakkerashim lammishkan esrim keresh lifat negba temana
Vetabed yat dappayya lemashkena asrin dappin leruach evar daroma:
Vearbaim adne-chesef taase tachat esrim hakkaresh shene adanim tachat-hakkeresh haechad lishte yedotav ushene adanim tachat-hakkeresh haechad lishte yedotav
Vearbein samchin dichsaf tabed techot asrin dappin teren samchin techot dappa chad litren tzirohi uteren samchin techot dappa chad litren tzirohi:
Uletzela hammishkan hashshenit lifat tzafon esrim karesh
Velistar mashkena tinyeta leruach tzippuna asrin dappin:
Vearbaim adnehem kasef shene adanim tachat hakkeresh haechad ushene adanim tachat hakkeresh haechad
Vearbein samchehon dichsaf teren samchin techot dappa chad uteren samchin techot dappa chad:
Uleyarkete hammishkan yamma taase shishsha kerashim
Velisyafe mashkena maarba tabed shitta dappin:
Ushene kerashim taase limkutzot hammishkan bayyarchatayim
Uteren dappin tabed lezavyat mashkena besofehon:
Veyihyu toamim millematta veyachdav yihyu tammim al-rosho el-hattabbaat haechat ken yihye lishnehem lishne hammiktzoot yihyu
Vihon mechavvenin millera vechachada yehon mechavvenin al resheh leizketa chada ken yehe letarvehon litren zavyan yehon:
Vehayu shemona kerashim veadnehem kesef shishsha asar adanim shene adanim tachat hakkeresh haechad ushene adanim tachat hakkeresh haechad
Vihon temanya dappin vesamchehon dichsaf shitta asar samchin teren samchin techot dappa chad uteren samchin techot dappa chad:
Veasita verichim atze shittim chamishsha lekarshe tzela-hammishkan haechad
Vetabed abbere deae shittin chamsha ledappe setar mashkena chad:
Vachamishsha verichim lekarshe tzela-hammishkan hashshenit vachamishsha verichim lekarshe tzela hammishkan layyarchatayim yamma
Vechamsha abberin ledappe setar mashkena tinyeta vechamsha abberin ledappe setar mashkena lesofehon maarva:
Vehabberiach hattichon betoch hakkerashim mavriach min-hakkatze el-hakkatze
Veabbera metziaa bego dappayya mabar min seyafe lisyafe:
Veet-hakkerashim tetzappe zahav veet-tabbeotehem taase zahav battim labberichim vetzippita et-habberichim zahav
Veyat dappayya tachpe dahava veyat izkathon tabed dahava atra leavrayya vetachpe yat abberayya dahava:
Vahakemota et-hammishkan kemishpato asher horeta bahar
Utekim yat mashkena kehilketeh di itchazeta betura:
Veasita farochet techelet veargaman vetolaat shani veshesh moshzar maase choshev yaase otah keruvim
Vetabed paruchta tichla veaggevana utzeva zehori uvutz shezir ovad oman yabed yata tzurat keruvin:
Venatatta otah al-arbaa ammude shittim metzuppim zahav vavehem zahav al-arbaa adne-chasef
Vetitten yata al arbea ammude shittin mechappeyan dahava vavehon dahava al arbea samche dichsaf:
Venatatta et-happarochet tachat hakkerasim veheveta shamma mibbet lapparochet et aron haedut vehivdila happarochet lachem ben hakkodesh uven kodesh hakkodashim
Vetitten yat paruchta techot purefayya vetael tamman miggav lefaruchta yat arona desahaduta vetafresh paruchta lechon ben kudesha uven kodesh kudeshayya:
Venatatta et-hakkapporet al aron haedut bekodesh hakkodashim
Vetitten yat kappurta al arona desahaduta bekodesh kudeshayya:
Vesamta et-hashshulchan michutz lapparochet veet-hammenora nochach hashshulchan al tzela hammishkan temana vehashshulchan titten al-tzela tzafon
Uteshavvi yat patora mibbara lefaruchta veyat menarta lokovel patora al tzidda demashkena daroma ufatora titten al setar tzippuna:
Veasita masach lefetach haohel techelet veargaman vetolaat shani veshesh moshzar maase rokem
Vetabed perasa litra mashkena tichla veargevana utzeva zehori uvutz shezir ovad tzayyar:
Veasita lammasach chamishsha ammude shittim vetzippita otam zahav vavehem zahav veyatzakta lahem chamishsha adne nechoshet
Vetabed lifrasa chamsha ammude shittin vetachappe yathon dahava vavehon dahava vetattich lehon chamsha samche nechasha:
Veasita et-hammizbeach atze shittim chamesh ammot orech vechamesh ammot rochav ravua yihye hammizbeach veshalosh ammot komato
Vetabed yat madbecha deae shittin chamesh ammin urka vachamesh ammin puteya merabba yehe madbecha utelat ammin rumeh:
Veasita karnotav al arba pinnotav mimmennu tihyena karnotav vetzippita oto nechoshet
Vetabed karnohi al arba zivyateh minneh tehevyan karnohi vetachappe yateh nechasha:
Veasita sirotav ledashsheno veyaav umizrekotav umizlegotav umachtotav lechol-kelav taase nechoshet
Vetabed pesachteravateh lemisfe kitmeh umagrofyateh umizrekateh vetzinnureyateh umachteyateh lechol manohi tabed nechasha:
Veasita lo michbar maase reshet nechoshet veasita al-hareshet arba tabbeot nechoshet al arba ketzotav
Vetabed leh serada ovad metzadta dinchasha vetabed al metzadta arba izkan dinchasha al arba sitrohi:
Venatatta otah tachat karkov hammizbeach millematta vehayta hareshet ad chatzi hammizbeach
Vetitten yata techot sovave madbecha millera utehe metzadta ad palgut madbecha:
Veasita vaddim lammizbeach badde atze shittim vetzippita otam nechoshet
Vetabed arichayya lemadbecha ariche deae shittin vetachafe yathon nechasha:
Vehuva et-baddav battabbaot vehayu habbaddim al-shete tzalot hammizbeach biset oto
Veyael yat arichohi beizkata vihon arichayya al teren sitre madbecha bemittal yateh:
Nevuv luchot taase oto kaasher hera otcha bahar ken yaasu
Chalil luche tabed yateh kema di achazi yatach betura ken yabedun:
Veasita et chatzar hammishkan lifat negev-temana kelaim lechatzer shesh moshzar mea vaamma orech lappea haechat
Vetabed yat darat mashkena leruach evar daroma seradin ledarta devutz shezir mea veammin urka leevar chad:
Veammudav esrim veadnehem esrim nechoshet vave haammudim vachashukehem kasef
Veammudohi esrin vesamchehon esrin nechasha vave ammudayya vechibbushehon kesaf:
Vechen lifat tzafon baorech kelaim mea orech veammudav esrim veadnehem esrim nechoshet vave haammudim vachashukehem kasef
Vechen leruach tzippuna beurka seradin mea urka veammudohi esrin vesamchehon esrin nechasha vave ammudayya vechibbushehon dichsaf:
Verochav hechatzer lifat-yam kelaim chamishshim amma ammudehem asara veadnehem asara
Ufuteya dedarta leruach maarba seradin chamshin ammin ammudehon asra vesamchehon asra:
Verochav hechatzer lifat kedma mizracha chamishshim amma
Ufuteya dedarta leruach kidduma maddincha chamshin ammin:
Vachamesh esre amma kelaim lakkatef ammudehem shelosha veadnehem shelosha
Vachamesh esre ammin seradin leivra ammudehon telata vesamchehon telata:
Velakkatef hashshenit chamesh esre kelaim ammudehem shelosha veadnehem shelosha
Uleivra tinyana chamesh esre seradin ammudehon telata vesamchehon telata:
Uleshaar hechatzer masach esrim amma techelet veargaman vetolaat shani veshesh moshzar maase rokem ammudehem arbaa veadnehem arbaa
Velitra darta perasa esrin ammin tichla veargevana utzeva zehori uvutz shezir ovad tzayyar ammudehon arbea vesamchehon arbea:
Kol-ammude hechatzer saviv mechushshakim kesef vavehem kasef veadnehem nechoshet
Kol ammude darta sechor sechor mechabbeshin kesaf vavehon kesaf vesamchehon nechasha:
Orech hechatzer mea vaamma verochav chamishshim bachamishshim vekoma chamesh ammot shesh moshzar veadnehem nechoshet
Urka dedarta mea veammin ufuteya chamshin bechamshin veruma chamesh ammin devutz shezir vesamchehon nechasha:
Lechol kele hammishkan bechol avodato vechol-yetedotav vechol-yitdot hechatzer nechoshet
Lechol mane mashkena bechol palchaneh vechol sikkohi vechol sikke dedarta nechasha:
Veatta tetzavve et-bene yisrael veyikchu elecha shemen zayit zach katit lammaor lehaalot ner tamid
Veat tefakked yat bene yisrael veyissevun lach mishcha zeta dachya katisha leanhara leadlaka votzinayya tedira:
Beohel moed michutz lapparochet asher al-haedut yaaroch oto aharon uvanav meerev ad-boker lifne Adonai chukkat olam ledorotam meet bene yisrael
Bemashkan zimna mibbara lefaruchta dial sahaduta yesaddar yateh aharon uvenohi meramsha ad tzafra kodam Adonai keyam alam ledarehon min bene yisrael:
Veatta hakrev elecha et-aharon achicha veet-banav itto mittoch bene yisrael lechahano-li aharon nadav vaavihu elazar veitamar bene aharon
Veat karev levatach yat aharon achuch veyat benohi immeh miggo bene yisrael leshammasha kodamay aharon nadav vaavihu elazar veitamar bene aharon:
Veasita vigde-kodesh leaharon achicha lechavod uletifaret
Vetabed levushe kudesha leaharon achuch likar uletushbechan:
Veatta tedabber el-kol-chachme-lev asher milletiv ruach chochma veasu et-bigde aharon lekaddesho lechahano-li
Veat temallel im kol chakkime libba diashlemit immeh ruach chochmeta veyabedun yat levushe aharon lekaddashuteh leshammasha kodamay:
Veelle habbegadim asher yaasu choshen veefod umeil uchetonet tashbetz mitznefet veavnet veasu vigde-kodesh leaharon achicha ulevanav lechahano-li
