Veillen levushayya di yabedun chushena veefoda umeila vechittuna merammetza mitznefta vehemyana veyabedun levushe kudesha leaharon achuch velivnohi leshammasha kodamay:
Vehem yikchu et-hazzahav veet-hattechelet veet-haargaman veet-tolaat hashshani veet-hashshesh
Veinnun yissevun yat dahava veyat tichla veyat argevana veyat tzeva zehori veyat butza:
Veasu et-haefod zahav techelet veargaman tolaat shani veshesh moshzar maase choshev
Veyabedun yat efoda dahava tichla veargevana tzeva zehori uvutz shezir ovad oman:
Shete chetefot chovrot yihye-llo el-shene ketzotav vechubbar
Tarten katpin melappefan yehon leh al teren sitrohi veyitlafaf:
Vecheshev afuddato asher alav kemaasehu mimmennu yihye zahav techelet veargaman vetolaat shani veshesh moshzar
Vehemyan tikkuneh di alohi keovadohi minneh yehe dahava tichla veargevana utzeva zehori uvutz shezir:
Velakachta et-shete avne-shoham ufittachta alehem shemot bene yisrael
Vetissav yat tarten avne vurela vetiglof alehen shemahat bene yisrael:
Shishsha mishshemotam al haeven haechat veet-shemot hashshishsha hannotarim al-haeven hashshenit ketoldotam
Shitta mishshemahathon al avna chada veyat shemahat shitta deishtaaru al avna tinyeta ketuledathon:
Maase charash even pittuche chotam tefattach et-shete haavanim al-shemot bene yisrael musabbot mishbetzot zahav taase otam
Ovad oman even tava ketav mefarash kiglof deizka tiglof yat tarten avnayya al shemahat bene yisrael meshakkean merammetzan didhav tabed yathon:
Vesamta et-shete haavanim al kitfot haefod avne zikkaron livne yisrael venasa aharon et-shemotam lifne Adonai al-shete chetefav lezikkaron
Uteshavvi yat tarten avnaya al kitpe efoda avne dachrana livne yisrael veyittol aharon yat shemahathon kodam Adonai al teren kitpohi ledachrana:
Veasita mishbetzot zahav
Vetabed merammetzan didhav:
Ushete sharsherot zahav tahor migbalot taase otam maase avot venatatta et-sharsherot haavotot al-hammishbetzot
Vetarten tikkin dehav deche metachman tabed yathon ovad gedilu vetitten yat tikkayya gedilata al merammetzata:
Veasita choshen mishpat maase choshev kemaase efod taasennu zahav techelet veargaman vetolaat shani veshesh moshzar taase oto
Vetabed chshen dina ovad oman keovad efoda tabedinneh dahava tichla veargevana utzeva zehori uvutz shezir tabed yateh:
Ravua yihye kaful zeret orko vezeret rochbo
Merabba yehe ef zerta urkeh vezerta fetaye:
Umilleta vo milluat even arbaa turim aven tur odem pitda uvareket hattur haechad
Vetashlem beh ashlamut avna arbea sidrin even tava sidra kadmaa samkan yarkan uvarkan sidra chad:
Vehattur hashsheni nofech sappir veyahalom
Vesidra tinyana izmaragdin veshavziz vesivhalom:
Vehattur hashshelishi leshem shevo veachlama
Vesidra telitaa kankire tarkeya veen egla:
Vehattur harvii tarshish veshoham veyashfe meshubbatzim zahav yihyu bemilluotam
Vesidra reviaa kerum yamma uvurela ufantere merammetzan didhav yehon beashlamutehon:
Vehaavanim tihyena al-shemot bene-yisrael shetem esre al-shemotam pittuche chotam ish al-shemo tihyena lishne asar shavet
Veavnayya yehevyan al shemahat bene yisrael tarte esre al shemahathon ketav mefarash kiglof deizka gevar al shemeh tehevyan litren asar shivtin:
Veasita al-hachoshen sharshot gavlut maase avot zahav tahor
Vetabed al chushena tikkin metachman ovad gedilu dehav deche:
Veasita al-hachoshen shete tabbeot zahav venatatta et-shete hattabbaot al-shene ketzot hachoshen
Vetabed al chushena tarten izkan didhav vetitten yat tarten izkata al teren sitre chushena:
Venatatta et-shete avotot hazzahav al-shete hattabbaot el-ketzot hachoshen
Vetitten yat tarten gedilan didhav al tarten izkata lesitre chushena:
Veet shete ketzot shete haavotot titten al-shete hammishbetzot venatatta al-kitfot haefod el-mul panav
Veyat tarten gedilan deal tarten sitrohi titten al tarten merammetzata vetitten al kitpe efoda lokovel appohi:
Veasita shete tabbeot zahav vesamta otam al-shene ketzot hachoshen al-sefato asher el-ever haefod bayta
Vetabed tarten izkan didhav uteshavvi yathon al teren sitre chushena al sifteh di leivra deefoda millegav:
Veasita shete tabbeot zahav venatatta otam al-shete chitfot haefod millematta mimmul panav leummat machbarto mimmaal lecheshev haefod
Vetabed tarten izkan didhav vetitten yathon al tarten kitpe efoda millera millokovel appohi lokovel bet lofe meillave lehemyan efoda:
Veyirkesu et-hachoshen mittabbeotav el-tabbeot haefod biftil techelet lihyot al-cheshev haefod velo-yizzach hachoshen meal haefod
Veyechdun yat chushena meizketeh leizketa deefoda bechuta ditchelta lemeheve al hemyan efoda vela yitparek chushena meillave efoda:
Venasa aharon et-shemot bene-yisrael bechoshen hammishpat al-libbo bevoo el-hakkodesh lezikkaron lifne-Adonai tamid
Veyittol aharon yat shemahat bene yisrael bechshen dina al libbeh bemealeh lekudesha leducherana kodam Adonai tedira:
Venatatta el-choshen hammishpat et-haurim veet-hattummim vehayu al-lev aharon bevoo lifne Adonai venasa aharon et-mishpat bene-yisrael al-libbo lifne Adonai tamid
Vetitten bechshen dina yat urayya veyat tummayya vihon al libba deaharon bemealeh kodam Adonai veyittol aharon yat dina divne yisrael al libbeh kodam Adonai tedira:
Veasita et-meil haefod kelil techelet
Vetabed yat meila deefoda gemir tichla:
Vehaya fi-rosho betocho safa yihye lefiv saviv maase oreg kefi tachra yihye-llo lo yikkarea
Vihe fum resheh kafil legavveh tora yehe makkaf lefumeh sechor sechor ovad mache kefum shiryan yehe leh la yitbeza:
Veasita al-shulav rimmone techelet veargaman vetolaat shani al-shulav saviv ufaamone zahav betocham saviv
Vetabed al shifolohi rimmone tichla veargevana utzeva zehori al shifolohi sechor sechor vezaggin dedahava benehon sechor sechor:
Paamon zahav verimmon paamon zahav verimmon al-shule hammeil saviv
Zagga dedahava verimmona zaga dedahava verimona al shifole meila sechor sechor:
Vehaya al-aharon lesharet venishma kolo bevoo el-hakkodesh lifne Adonai uvetzeto velo yamut
Vihe al aharon leshammasha veyishtema kaleh bemealeh lekudesha kodam Adonai uvemippekeh vela yemut:
Veasita tzitz zahav tahor ufittachta alav pittuche chotam kodesh la-Adonai
Vetabed tzitza didhav deche vetiglof alohi ketav mefarash kodesh layya:
Vesamta oto al-petil techelet vehaya al-hammitznafet el-mul pene-hammitznefet yihye
Uteshavvi yateh al chuta ditchelta vihe al mitznefta lokovel appe mitznefta yehe:
Vehaya al-metzach aharon venasa aharon et-avon hakkodashim asher yakdishu bene yisrael lechol-mattenot kodshehem vehaya al-mitzcho tamid leratzon lahem lifne Adonai
Vihe al bet enohi deaharon veyittol aharon yat avayat kudeshayya di yekaddeshun bene yisrael lechol mattenat kudeshehon vihe al bet enohi tedira leraava lehon kodam Adonai:
Veshibbatzta hakketonet shesh veasita mitznefet shesh veavnet taase maase rokem
Uterammetz kittuna vutza vetabed mitznefta devutza vehemyana tabed ovad tzayyar:
Velivne aharon taase chuttonot veasita lahem avnetim umigbaot taase lahem lechavod uletifaret
Velivne aharon tabed kittunin vetabed lehon hemyanin vechovain tabed lehon likar uletushbechan:
Vehilbashta otam et-aharon achicha veet-banav itto umashachta otam umilleta et-yadam vekiddashta otam vechihanu li
Vetalbesh yathon yat aharon achuch veyat benohi immeh uterabbe yathon utekarev yat kurbanhon utekaddesh yathon vishammeshun kodamay:
Vaase lahem michnese-vad lechassot besar erva mimmotnayim vead-yerechayim yihyu
Veived lehon michnesin devutz lechassaa besar eryeta mechartzan vead yarkan yehon:
Vehayu al-aharon veal-banav bevoam el-ohel moed o vegishtam el-hammizbeach lesharet bakkodesh velo-yisu avon vametu chukkat olam lo ulezaro acharav
Vihon al aharon veal benohi bemealhon lemashkan zimna o vemikravhon lemadbecha leshammasha vekudesha vela yekabbelun chova vimutun keyam alam leh velivnohi vatrohi:
Veze haddavar asher-taase lahem lekaddesh otam lechahen li lekach par echad ben-bakar veelim shenayim temimim
Veden pitgama di tabed lehon lekaddasha yathon leshammasha kodamay sav tor chad bar tore vedichrin teren shalmin:
Velechem matztzot vechallot matztzot belulot bashshemen urekike matztzot meshuchim bashshamen solet chittim taase otam
Ulechem pattir ugeritzin pattirin defilan bimshach veespogin pattirin dimshichin bimshach sulta chittin tabed yathon:
Venatatta otam al-sal echad vehikravta otam bassal veet-happar veet shene haelim
Vetitten yathon al salla chad utekarev yathon besalla veyat tora veyat teren dichrin:
Veet-aharon veet-banav takriv el-petach ohel moed verachatzta otam bammayim
Veyat aharon veyat benohi tekarev litra mashkan zimna vetasche yathon bemayya:
Velakachta et-habbegadim vehilbashta et-aharon et-hakkuttonet veet meil haefod veet-haefod veet-hachoshen veafadta lo becheshev haefod
Vetissav yat levushayya vetalbesh yat aharon yat kittuna veyat meil efoda veyat efoda veyat chushena vetatken leh behemyan efoda:
Vesamta hammitznefet al-rosho venatatta et-nezer hakkodesh al-hammitznafet
Uteshavvi mitznefta al resheh vetitten yat kelila dekudesha al mitznefta:
Velakachta et-shemen hammishcha veyatzakta al-rosho umashachta oto
Vetissav yat mishcha dirvuta uterik al resheh uterabbi yateh:
Veet-banav takriv vehilbashtam kuttonot
Veyat benohi tekarev vetalbeshinnun kittunin:
Vechagarta otam avnet aharon uvanav vechavashta lahem migbaot vehayta lahem kehunna lechukkat olam umilleta yad-aharon veyad-banav
Utezarez yathon hemyanin aharon uvenohi vetatkan lehon kovain utehe lehon kehunta likyam alam utekarev kurbana deaharon vekurbana divnohi:
Vehikravta et-happar lifne ohel moed vesamach aharon uvanav et-yedehem al-rosh happar
Utekarev yat tora likodam mashkan zimna veyismoch aharon uvenohi yat yedehon al resh tora:
Veshachatta et-happar lifne Adonai petach ohel moed
Vetikkos yat tora kodam Adonai bitra mashkan zimna:
Velakachta middam happar venatatta al-karnot hammizbeach beetzbaecha veet-kol-haddam tishpoch el-yesod hammizbeach
Vetissav middema detora vetitten al karnat madbecha beetzbaach veyat kol dema teshod lisoda demadbecha:
Velakachta et-kol-hachelev hamechasse et-hakkerev veet hayyoteret al-hakkaved veet shete hakkelayot veet-hachelev asher alehen vehiktarta hammizbecha
Vetissav yat kol tarba dechafe yat gavva veyat chitzra dial kavda veyat tarten kalyan veyat tarba di alehen vetassek lemadbecha:
Veet-besar happar veet-oro veet-pirsho tisrof baesh michutz lammachane chattat hu
Veyat bisra detora veyat mashkeh veyat ucheleh tokid benura mibbara lemashrita chattata hu:
Veet-haayil haechad tikkach vesamchu aharon uvanav et-yedehem al-rosh haayil
Veyat dichra chad tissav veyismechun aharon uvenohi yat yedehon al resh dichra:
Veshachatta et-haayil velakachta et-damo vezarakta al-hammizbeach saviv
Vetikkos yat dichra vetissav yat demeh vetizrok al madbecha sechor sechor:
Veet-haayil tenatteach lintachav verachatzta kirbo ucheraav venatatta al-netachav veal-rosho
Veyat dichra tefalleg leevarohi utechallil gavveh ucheraohi vetitten al evarohi veal resheh:
Vehiktarta et-kol-haayil hammizbecha ola hu la-Adonai reach nichoach ishshe la-Adonai hu
Vetassek yat kol dichra lemadbecha alata hu kodam Adonai leitkabbala veraava kurbana kodam Adonai hu:
Velakachta et haayil hashsheni vesamach aharon uvanav et-yedehem al-rosh haayil
Vetissav yat dichra tinyana veyismoch aharon uvenohi yat yedehon al resh dichra:

Veshachatta et-haayil velakachta middamo venatatta al-tenuch ozen aharon veal-tenuch ozen banav hayemanit veal-bohen yadam hayemanit veal-bohen raglam hayemanit vezarakta et-haddam al-hammizbeach saviv

Vetikkos yat dichra vetissav midmeh vetitten al rum udena deaharon veal rum udena divnohi deyammina veal ilyon yedehon deyammina veal ilyon raglehon deyammina vetizrok yat dema al madbecha sechor sechor:
Velakachta min-haddam asher al-hammizbeach umishshemen hammishcha vehizzeta al-aharon veal-begadav veal-banav veal-bigde vanav itto vekadash hu uvegadav uvanav uvigde vanav itto
Vetissav min dema di al madbecha umimmishcha dirvuta vetadde al aharon veal levushohi veal benohi veal levushe venohi immeh veyitkaddash hu ulevushohi uvenohi ulevushe venohi immeh:
Velakachta min-haayil hachelev vehaalya veet-hachelev hamechasse et-hakkerev veet yoteret hakkaved veet shete hakkelayot veet-hachelev asher alehen veet shok hayyamin ki el milluim hu
Vetissav min dichra tarba veallita veyat tarba dechafe yat gavva veyat chatzar kavda veyat tarten kalyan veyat tarba di alehen veyat shoka deyammina are dechar kurbana hu:
Vechikkar lechem achat vechallat lechem shemen achat verakik echad missal hammatztzot asher lifne Adonai
Ufitta dilchem chad ugeritzta dilchem meshach chada veespog chad missalla defattirayya di kodam Adonai:
Vesamta hakkol al kappe aharon veal kappe vanav vehenafta otam tenufa lifne Adonai
Uteshavvi cholla al yeda deaharon veal yeda divnohi uterim yathon aramuta kodam Adonai:
Velakachta otam miyyadam vehiktarta hammizbecha al-haola lereach nichoach lifne Adonai ishshe hu la-Adonai
Vetissav yathon midehon vetassek lemadbecha al alata leitkabbala veraava kodam Adonai kurbana hu kodam Adonai:
Velakachta et-hechaze meel hammilluim asher leaharon vehenafta oto tenufa lifne Adonai vehaya lecha lemana
Vetissav yat chedya middechar kurbanayya di leaharon uterim yateh aramuta kodam Adonai vihe lach locholak:
Vekiddashta et chaze hattenufa veet shok hatteruma asher hunaf vaasher huram meel hammilluim measher leaharon umeasher levanav
Utekaddesh yat chedya daaramuta veyat shoka deafrashuta di ittaram vedi ittafrash middechar kurbanayya middi leaharon umiddi livnohi:
Vehaya leaharon ulevanav lechok-olam meet bene yisrael ki teruma hu uteruma yihye meet bene-yisrael mizzivche shalmehem terumatam la-Adonai
Vihe leaharon velivnohi likyam alam min bene yisrael are afrashuta hu veafrashuta yehe min bene yisrael minnichsat kudeshehon afrashutehon kodam Adonai:
Uvigde hakkodesh asher leaharon yihyu levanav acharav lemoshcha vahem ulemalle-vam et-yadam
Ulevushe kudesha di leaharon yehon livnohi batrohi ledakkaa vehon ulekarava vehon yat kurbanhon:
Shivat yamim yilbasham hakkohen tachtav mibbanav asher yavo el-ohel moed lesharet bakkodesh
Shivat yomin yalbeshinnun kahana techotohi mibbenohi di yeol lemashkan zimna leshammasha vekudesha:
Veet el hammilluim tikkach uvishshalta et-besaro bemakom kadosh
Veyat dechar kurbanayya tissav utevashshel yat bisreh baatar kaddish:
Veachal aharon uvanav et-besar haayil veet-hallechem asher bassal petach ohel moed
Veyechul aharon uvenohi yat besar dichra veyat lachma di vesalla litra mashkan zimna:
Veochlu otam asher kuppar bahem lemalle et-yadam lekaddesh otam vezar lo-yochal ki-kodesh hem
Veyechlun yathon di yitkappar behon lekarava yat kurbanhon lekaddasha yathon vechillonay la yechul are kudesha innun:
Veim-yivvater mibbesar hammilluim umin-hallechem ad-habboker vesarafta et-hannotar baesh lo yeachel ki-kodesh hu
Veim yishtaar mibbesar kurbanayya umin lachma ad tzafra vetokid yat deishtaar benura la yitachel are kudesha hu:
Veasita leaharon ulevanav kacha kechol asher-tzivviti otacha shivat yamim temalle yadam
Vetabed leaharon velivnohi keden kechol di fakkedit yatach shivat yomin tekarev kurbanhon:
Ufar chattat taase layyom al-hakkippurim vechitteta al-hammizbeach bechappercha alav umashachta oto lekaddesho
Vetora dechattata tabed leyoma al kippurayya utedakke al madbecha bechapparutach alohi uterabbe yateh lekaddashuteh:
Shivat yamim techapper al-hammizbeach vekiddashta oto vehaya hammizbeach kodesh kodashim kol-hannogea bammizbeach yikdash
Shivat yomin techapper al madbecha utekaddesh yateh vihe madbecha kodesh kudeshayya kol deyikrav bemadbecha yitkaddash:
Veze asher taase al-hammizbeach kevasim bene-shana shenayim layyom tamid
Veden di tabed al madbecha immerin bene shena teren leyoma tedira:
Et-hakkeves haechad taase vabboker veet hakkeves hashsheni taase ben haarbayim
Yat immera chad tabed betzafra veyat imra tinyana tabed ben shimshayya:
Veissaron solet balul beshemen katit reva hahin venesech reviit hahin yayin lakkeves haechad
Veisrona sulta defila vimshach katisha ravut hina veniska ravut hina chamra leimra chad:
Veet hakkeves hashsheni taase ben haarbayim keminchat habboker ucheniskah taase-llah lereach nichoach ishshe la-Adonai
Veyat imra tinyana tabed ben shimshayya keminchat tzafra ucheniska tabed la leitkabbala veraava kurbana kodam Adonai:
Olat tamid ledorotechem petach ohel-moed lifne Adonai asher ivvaed lachem shamma ledabber elecha sham
Alata tedira ledarechon bitra mashkan zimna kodam Adonai diezammen memri lechon tamman lemallala immach tamman:
Venoadti shamma livne yisrael venikdash bichvodi
Veezammen memri tamman livne yisrael veyitkaddash bikari:
Vekiddashti et-ohel moed veet-hammizbeach veet-aharon veet-banav akaddesh lechahen li
Veekaddesh yat mashkan zimna veyat madbecha veyat aharon veyat benohi ekaddesh leshammasha kodamay:
Veshachanti betoch bene yisrael vehayiti lahem lelohim
Veashre shechinti bego bene yisrael veeheve lehon leelah:
Veyadu ki ani Adonai elohehem asher hotzeti otam meeretz mitzrayim leshochni vetocham ani Adonai elohehem
Veyiddeun are ana Adonai elahahon di appekit yathon meara demitzrayim leashraa shechinti benehon ana Adonai elahahon:
Veasita mizbeach miktar ketoret atze shittim taase oto
Vetabed madbecha leaktara alohi ketoret busemayya deae shittin tabed yateh:
Amma orko veamma rochbo ravua yihye veammatayim komato mimmennu karnotav
Ammeta urkeh veammeta fetaye merabba yehe vetarten ammin rumeh minneh karnohi:
Vetzippita oto zahav tahor et-gaggo veet-kirotav saviv veet-karnotav veasita lo zer zahav saviv
Vetachafe yateh dehav deche yat iggareh veyat katlohi sechor sechor veyat karnohi vetabed leh der didhav sechor sechor:
Ushete tabbeot zahav taase-llo mittachat lezero al shete tzalotav taase al-shene tziddav vehaya levattim levaddim laset oto bahemma
Vetarten izkan didhav tabed leh millera ledereh al tarten zivyateh tabed al teren sitrohi vihe leatra laarichayya lemittal yateh behon:
Veasita et-habbaddim atze shittim vetzippita otam zahav
Vetabed yat arichayya deae shittin vetachafe yathon dahava:
Venatatta oto lifne happarochet asher al-aron haedut lifne hakkapporet asher al-haedut asher ivvaed lecha shamma
Vetitten yateh kodam paruchta di al arona desahaduta likodam kappurta di al sahaduta di azammen memri lach tamman:
Vehiktir alav aharon ketoret sammim babboker babboker behetivo et-hannerot yaktirenna
Veyaktar alohi aharon ketoret busemin bitzfar bitzfar beatkanuteh yat botzinayya yassekinna:
Uvehaalot aharon et-hannerot ben haarbayim yaktirenna ketoret tamid lifne Adonai ledorotechem
Uveadlakut aharon yat botzinayya ben shimshayya yassekinna ketoret busemayya tedira kodam Adonai ledarechon:
Lo-taalu alav ketoret zara veola umincha venesech lo tissechu alav
La tassekun alohi ketoret busemin nucherain vaalata uminchata veniska la tenassechun alohi:
Vechipper aharon al-karnotav achat bashshana middam chattat hakkippurim achat bashshana yechapper alav ledorotechem kodesh-kodashim hu la-Adonai
Vichapper aharon al karnohi chada beshatta middema chattat kippurayya chada veshatta yechapper alohi ledarechon kodesh kudeshin hu kodam Adonai:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Ki tissa et-rosh bene-yisrael lifkudehem venatnu ish kofer nafsho la-Adonai bifkod otam velo-yihye vahem negef bifkod otam
Are tekabbel yat chushban bene yisrael leminyanehon veyittenun gevar purkan nafsheh kodam Adonai kad timne yathon vela yehe vehon mota kad timne yathon:
Ze yittenu kol-haover al-happekudim machatzit hashshekel beshekel hakkodesh esrim gera hashshekel machatzit hashshekel teruma la-Adonai
Den yittenun kol deavar al minyanayya palgut sila besile kudesha esrin main sila palgut sila afrashuta kodam Adonai:
Kol haover al-happekudim mibben esrim shana vamala yitten terumat Adonai
Kol deavar al minyanayya mibbar esrin shenin uleella yitten afrashuta kodam Adonai:
Heashir lo-yarbe vehaddal lo yamit mimmachatzit hashshakel latet et-terumat Adonai lechapper al-nafshotechem
Deattir la yasge udemisken la yazer mippalgut sila lemittan yat afrashuta kodam Adonai lechappara al nafshatechon:
Velakachta et-kesef hakkippurim meet bene yisrael venatatta oto al-avodat ohel moed vehaya livne yisrael lezikkaron lifne Adonai lechapper al-nafshotechem
Vetissav yat kesaf kippurayya min bene yisrael vetitten yateh al palchan mashkan zimna vihe livne yisrael ledachrana kodam Adonai lechappara al nafshatechon:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Veasita kiyyor nechoshet vechanno nechoshet lerochtza venatatta oto ben-ohel moed uven hammizbeach venatatta shamma mayim
Vetabed kiyyora dinchasha uvesiseh nechasha lekiddush vetitten yateh ben mashkan zimna uven madbecha vetitten tamman mayya:
Verachatzu aharon uvanav mimmennu et-yedehem veet-raglehem
Vikaddeshun aharon uvenohi minneh yat yedehon veyat raglehon:
Bevoam el-ohel moed yirchatzu-mayim velo yamutu o vegishtam el-hammizbeach lesharet lehaktir ishshe la-Adonai
Bemealhon lemashkan zimna yekaddeshun mayya vela yemutun o vemikravhon lemadbecha leshammasha leassaka kurbana kodam Adonai:
Verachatzu yedehem veraglehem velo yamutu vehayta lahem chok-olam lo ulezaro ledorotam
Vikaddeshun yedehon veraglehon vela yemutun utehe lehon keyam alam leh velivnohi ledarehon:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Veatta kach-lecha besamim rosh mor-deror chamesh meot vekinnemon-besem machatzito chamishshim umatayim ukene-vosem chamishshim umatayim
Veat sav lach busemin resha mera dachya matkal chamesh mea vekinneman besem palguteh matkal matan vechamshin ukene vusema matkal matan vechamshin:
Vekidda chamesh meot beshekel hakkodesh veshemen zayit hin
Uketziata matkal chamesh mea besile kudesha umeshach zeta mele hina:
Veasita oto shemen mishchat-kodesh rokach mirkachat maase rokeach shemen mishchat-kodesh yihye
Vetabed yateh meshach revut kudesha bosem mevassam ovad busemanu meshach revut kudesha yehe:
Umashachta vo et-ohel moed veet aron haedut
Uterabbi veh yat mashkan zimna veyat arona desahaduta:
Veet-hashshulchan veet-kol-kelav veet-hammenora veet-keleha veet mizbach hakketoret
Veyat patora veyat kol manohi veyat menarta veyat manaha veyat madbecha diktoret busemayya:
Veet-mizbach haola veet-kol-kelav veet-hakkiyyor veet-kanno
Veyat madbach daalata veyat kol manohi veyat kiyyora veyat besiseh:
Vekiddashta otam vehayu kodesh kodashim kol-hannogea bahem yikdash
Utekaddesh yathon vihon kodesh kudeshayya kol deyikrav behon yitkaddash:
Veet-aharon veet-banav timshach vekiddashta otam lechahen li
Veyat aharon veyat benohi terabbi utekaddesh yathon leshammasha kodamay:
Veel-bene yisrael tedabber lemor shemen mishchat-kodesh yihye ze li ledorotechem
Veim bene yisrael temallel lememar meshach revut kudesha yehe den kodamay ledarechon:
Al-besar adam lo yisach uvematkunto lo taasu kamohu kodesh hu kodesh yihye lachem
Al bisra daanasha la yitnassach uvidmuteh la tabedun kevateh kudesha hu kudesha yehe lechon:
Ish asher yirkach kamohu vaasher yitten mimmennu al-zar venichrat meammav
Gevar di yevassam dichvateh vedi yitten minneh al chillonay veyishtetze meammeh:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe kach-lecha sammim nataf ushechelet vechelbena sammim ulevona zakka bad bevad yihye
Vaamar Adonai lemshe sav lach busemin netofa vetufera vechelbeneta busemin ulevuneta dachita matkal bematkal yehe:
Veasita otah ketoret rokach maase rokeach memullach tahor kodesh
Vetabed yata ketoret busemin bosem ovad busemanu mearav deche kudesha:
Veshachakta mimmenna hadek venatatta mimmenna lifne haedut beohel moed asher ivvaed lecha shamma kodesh kodashim tihye lachem
Vetishchok minna vetaddik vetitten minna kodam sahaduta bemashkan zimna di ezammen memri lach tamman kodesh kudeshin tehe lechon:
Vehakketoret asher taase bematkuntah lo taasu lachem kodesh tihye lecha la-Adonai
Uketoret busemin di tabed bidmutah la tabedun lechon kudesha tehe lach kodam Adonai:
Ish asher-yaase chamoha lehariach bah venichrat meammav
Gevar deyabed dichvata laaracha va veyishtetze meammeh:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Ree karati veshem betzalel ben-uri ven-chur lematte yehuda
Chaze derabbeti veshum betzalel bar uri var chur leshivta dihuda:
Vaamalle oto ruach elohim bechochma uvitvuna uvedaat uvechol-melacha
Veashlemit immeh ruach min kodam Adonai bechochmeta uvesucheletanu uvemadda uvechol ivida:
Lachshov machashavot laasot bazzahav uvakkesef uvannechoshet
Leallafa umanvan lemebad bedahava uvechaspa uvinchasha:
Uvacharoshet even lemallot uvacharoshet etz laasot bechol-melacha
Uveamanut even tava leashlama uvenaggarut aa lemebad bechol ivida:
Vaani hinne natatti itto et oholiav ben-achisamach lematte-dan uvelev kol-chacham-lev natatti chochma veasu et kol-asher tzivviticha
Vaana ha yehavit immeh yat oholiav bar achisamach leshivta dedan uvelibba chol chakkime libba yehavit chochmeta veyabedun yat chol di fakedittach:
Et ohel moed veet-haaron laedut veet-hakkapporet asher alav veet kol-kele haohel
Yat mashkan zimna veyat arona lesahaduta veyat kappurta di alohi veyat kol mane mashkena:
Veet-hashshulchan veet-kelav veet-hammenora hattehora veet-kol-keleha veet mizbach hakketoret
Veyat patora veyat manohi veyat menarta dachita veyat kol manaha veyat madbecha diktoret busemaya:
Veet-mizbach haola veet-kol-kelav veet-hakkiyyor veet-kanno
Veyat madbecha daalata veyat kol manohi veyat kiyora veyat besiseh:
Veet bigde hasserad veet-bigde hakkodesh leaharon hakkohen veet-bigde vanav lechahen
Veyat levushe shimusha veyat levushe kudesha leaharon kahana veyat levushe venohi leshammasha:
Veet shemen hammishcha veet-ketoret hassammim lakkodesh kechol asher-tzivviticha yaasu
Veyat mishcha dirvuta veyat ketoret busemayya lekudesha kechol di fakkedtach yabedun:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe lemor
Vaamar Adonai lemshe lememar:
Veatta dabber el-bene yisrael lemor ach et-shabbetotay tishmoru ki ot hiv beni uvenechem ledorotechem ladaat ki ani Adonai mekaddishchem
Veat mallel im bene yisrael lememar beram yat yome shabbayya di li titterun are at hi ben memri uvenechon ledarechon lemidda are ana Adonai mekaddishchon:
Ushemartem et-hashshabbat ki kodesh hiv lachem mechalleha mot yumat ki kol-haose vah melacha venichreta hannefesh hahiv mikkerev ammeha
Vetitterun yat shabbeta are kudesha hi lechon mechallelinna itketala yitketel are kol deyabed ba ivida veyishtetze anasha hahu miggo ammeh:
Sheshet yamim yease melacha uvayyom hashshevii shabbat shabbaton kodesh la-Adonai kol-haose melacha beyom hashshabbat mot yumat
Shitta yomin yitaved ivida uveyoma sheviaa shevat shabbeta kudesha kodam Adonai kol deyabed ividta beyoma deshabbeta itketala yitketel:
Veshamru vene-yisrael et-hashshabbat laasot et-hashshabbat ledorotam berit olam
Veyitterun bene yisrael yat shabbeta lemebad yat shabbeta ledarehon keyam alam:
Beni uven bene yisrael ot hiv leolam ki-sheshet yamim asa Adonai et-hashshamayim veet-haaretz uvayyom hashshevii shavat vayyinnafash
Ben memri uven bene yisrael at hi lealam are shitta yomin avad Adonai yat shemayya veyat ara uveyoma sheviaa shevat venach:
Vayyitten el-moshe kechalloto ledabber itto behar sinay shene luchot haedut luchot even ketuvim beetzba elohim
Vihav lemshe kad shetze lemallala immeh betura desinay teren luche sahaduta luche avna ketivin beetzbea daAdonai:

Vayyar haam ki-voshesh moshe laredet min-hahar vayyikkahel haam al-aharon vayyomru elav kum ase-lanu elohim asher yelchu lefanenu ki-ze moshe haish asher heelanu meeretz mitzrayim lo yadanu me-haya lo
Vachaza amma are ochar mshe lemechat min tura veitkenesh amma al aharon vaamaru leh kum aved lana dachalan diyhachun kodamana are den mshe gavra di assekana meara demitzrayim la yedana ma hava leh:
Vayyomer alehem aharon parku nizme hazzahav asher beozne neshechem benechem uvenotechem vehaviu elay
Vaamar lehon aharon periku kadashe dedahava di beudene neshechon benechon uvenatechon veaytiyyu levati:
Vayyitparku kol-haam et-nizme hazzahav asher beoznehem vayyaviu el-aharon
Veitperiku kol amma yat kadashe dedahava di veudenehon veaytiyyu leaharon:
Vayyikkach miyyadam vayyatzar oto bacheret vayyaasehu egel massecha vayyomru elle elohecha yisrael asher heelucha meeretz mitzrayim
Unesiv midehon vetzar yateh bezifa veavdeh egel mattecha vaamaru illen dachaltach yisrael di assekuch meara demitzrayim:
Vayyar aharon vayyiven mizbeach lefanav vayyikra aharon vayyomar chag la-Adonai machar
Vachaza aharon uvena madbecha kodamohi ukera aharon vaamar chagga kodam Adonai mechar:
Vayyashkimu mimmochorat vayyaalu olot vayyaggishu shelamim vayyeshev haam leechol veshato vayyakumu letzachek
Veakdimu beyoma devatrohi veassiku alavan vekarivu nichsin veaschar amma lemechal ulemishte vekamu lechayyacha:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lech-red ki shichet ammecha asher heeleta meeretz mitzrayim
Umallil Adonai im mshe izel chut are chabbil ammach di assekta meara demitzrayim:
Saru maher min-hadderech asher tzivvitim asu lahem egel massecha vayyishtachavu-lo vayyizbechu-lo vayyomru elle elohecha yisrael asher heelucha meeretz mitzrayim
Satu bifria min orcha di fakkedtinnun avadu lehon egal mattecha usegidu leh vedabbachu leh vaamaru illen dachaltach yisrael di assekuch meara demitzrayim:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe raiti et-haam hazze vehinne am-keshe-oref hu
Vaamar Adonai lemshe gele kodamay amma haden veha amma keshe kedal hu:
Veatta hannicha li veyichar-appi vahem vaachallem veeese otcha legoy gadol
Uchean hannach bautach min kodamay veyitkef rugezi vehon veeshetzinnun veebed yatach leam saggi:
Vaychal moshe et-pene Adonai elohav vayyomer lama Adonai yechere appecha beammecha asher hotzeta meeretz mitzrayim bechoach gadol uveyad chazaka
Vetzalli mshe kodam Adonai elaheh vaamar lema Adonai yitkef rugezach beammach di appekta meara demitzrayim bechel rav uvida takkifa:
Lamma yomru mitzrayim lemor beraa hotziam laharog otam beharim ulechallotam meal pene haadama shuv mecharon appecha vehinnachem al-haraa leammecha
Lema yemrun mitzrae lememar bevishta appektinnun lekattala yathon bene turayya uleshetzayutehon meal appe ara tuv mittekof rugezach veatev min bishta demellelta lemebad leammach:

Zechor leavraham leyitzchak uleyisrael avadecha asher nishbata lahem bach vattedabber alehem arbe et-zarachem kechochve hashshamayim vechol-haaretz hazzot asher amarti etten lezarachem venachalu leolam
Idkar leavraham leyitzchak uleyisrael avdaych di kayyemta lehon bememrach umallelta immehon asge yat benechon kechochve shemayya vechol ara hada di amarit etten livnechon veyachsenun laalam:
Vayyinnachem Adonai al-haraa asher dibber laasot leammo
Vetav Adonai min bishta di mallel lemebad leammeh:
Vayyifen vayyered moshe min-hahar ushene luchot haedut beyado luchot ketuvim mishshene evrehem mizze umizze hem ketuvim
Veitpene unechat mshe min tura uteren luche sahaduta bideh luche ketivin mitteren ivrehon mikka umikka innun ketivin:
Vehalluchot maase elohim hemma vehammichtav michtav elohim hu charut al-halluchot
Veluchayya ovada daAdonai innun uchetava ketava daAdonai hu mefarash al luchayya:
Vayyishma yehoshua et-kol haam bereo vayyomer el-moshe kol milchama bammachane
Ushema yehoshua yat kal amma kad meyabbevin vaamar lemshe kal kerava bemashrita:
Vayyomer en kol anot gevura veen kol anot chalusha kol annot anochi shomea
Vaamar la kal gibbarin denatzchin bikrava veaf la kal challashin demittabberin kal dimchayyechin ana shema:
Vayhi kaasher karav el-hammachane vayyar et-haegel umecholot vayyichar-af moshe vayyashlech miyyadav et-halluchot vayshabber otam tachat hahar
Vahava kad kariv lemashrita vachaza yat egla vechingin utekef rugeza demshe urema midohi yat luchayya vetabbar yathon beshippole tura:
Vayyikkach et-haegel asher asu vayyisrof baesh vayyitchan ad asher-dak vayyizer al-pene hammayim vayyashk et-bene yisrael
Unesev yat egla di avadu veoked benura veshaf ad dahava dakkik uzera al appe mayya veashke yat bene yisrael:
Vayyomer moshe el-aharon me-asa lecha haam hazze ki-heveta alav chataa gedola
Vaamar mshe leaharon ma avad lach amma haden are ayteta alohi chova rabba:
Vayyomer aharon al-yichar af adoni atta yadata et-haam ki vera hu
Vaamar aharon la yitkef rugeza deribboni at yedaat yat amma are bevish hu:
Vayyomru li ase-lanu elohim asher yelchu lefanenu ki-ze moshe haish asher heelanu meeretz mitzrayim lo yadanu me-haya lo
Vaamaru li ived lana dachalan di yehachan kodamana are den mshe gavra di assekana meara demitzrayim la yedana ma hava leh:
Vaomar lahem lemi zahav hitparaku vayyittenu-li vaashlichehu vaesh vayyetze haegel hazze
Vaamarit lehon leman dahava pariku vihavu li uremiteh benura unefak egla haden:
Vayyar moshe et-haam ki farua hu ki-ferao aharon leshimtza bekamehem
Vachaza mshe yat amma are vetil hu are vatelinnun aharon laasavutehon shum bish ledarehon:
Vayyaamod moshe beshaar hammachane vayyomer mi la-Adonai elay vayyeasfu elav kol-bene levi
Vekam mshe bitra mashrita vaamar man dachalayya daAdonai yetun levati veitkannashu levateh kol bene levi:
Vayyomer lahem ko-amar Adonai elohe yisrael simu ish-charbo al-yerecho ivru vashuvu mishshaar lashaar bammachane vehirgu ish-et-achiv veish et-reehu veish et-kerovo
Vaamar lehon kidnan amar Adonai elaha deyisrael shavvu gevar charbeh al yarkeh ivaru vetuvu mittera litra bemashrita uketulu gevar yat achuhi ugevar yat chavreh veenash yat kariveh:
Vayyaasu vene-levi kidvar moshe vayyippol min-haam bayyom hahu kishloshet alfe ish
Vaavadu vene levi kefitgama demshe unefal min amma beyoma hahu kitlata alfin gavra:
Vayyomer moshe milu yedchem hayyom la-Adonai ki ish bivno uveachiv velatet alechem hayyom beracha
Vaamar mshe karivu yedchon kurbana yoma den kodam Adonai are gevar bivreh uveachuhi uleaytaa alechon yoma den birchan:
Vayhi mimmochorat vayyomer moshe el-haam attem chatatem chataa gedola veatta eele el-Adonai ulay achappera bead chattatchem
Vahava beyoma devatrohi vaamar mshe leamma attun chavtun chova rabba uchean essak kodam Adonai maim achapper al chovechon:
Vayyashov moshe el-Adonai vayyomar anna chata haam hazze chataa gedola vayyaasu lahem elohe zahav
Vetav mshe likodam Adonai vaamar bevau chav amma haden chova rabba vaavadu lehon dachalan didhav:
Veatta im-tissa chattatam veim-ayin mecheni na missifrecha asher katavta
Uchean im shavkat lechovehon veim la mecheni chean missifrach di chetavta:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe mi asher chata-li emchennu missifri
Vaamar Adonai lemshe man di chav kodamay emchinneh misifri:
Veatta lech neche et-haam el asher-dibbarti lach hinne malachi yelech lefanecha uveyom pokdi ufakadti alehem chattatam
Uchean izzel dabbar yat amma laatar di mallelit lach ha malachi yehach kodamach uveyom asaruti veasar alehon chovehon:
Vayyiggof Adonai et-haam al asher asu et-haegel asher asa aharon
Umecha Adonai yat amma al di ishtabadu leegla di avad aharon:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lech ale mizze atta vehaam asher heelita meeretz mitzrayim el-haaretz asher nishbati leavraham leyitzchak uleyaakov lemor lezaracha ettenenna
Umallil Adonai im mshe izzel sak mikka at veamma deassekta meara demitzrayim leara di kayyemit leavraham leyitzchak uleyaakov lememar livnaych etteninna:
Veshalachti lefanecha malach vegerashti et-hakkenaani haemori vehachitti vehapperizzi hachivvi vehayevusi
Veeshlach kodamach malacha veetarech yat kenaanae emorae vechittae uferizzae chivvae vivusae:
El-eretz zavat chalav udevash ki lo eele bekirbecha ki am-keshe-oref atta pen-achelcha baddarech
Leara avda chalav udevash are la asallek shechinti mibbenach are am keshe kedal at dilma ashetzinnach beorcha:
Vayyishma haam et-haddavar hara hazze vayyitabbalu velo-shatu ish edyo alav
Ushema amma yat pitgama visha haden veitabbalu vela shavviyu gevar tikkun zeneh alohi:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe emor el-bene-yisrael attem am-keshe-oref rega echad eele vekirbecha vechilliticha veatta hored edyecha mealecha veeda ma eese-llach
Vaamar Adonai lemshe emar livne yisrael attun am keshe kedal shaa chada asallek shechinti mibbenach veeshetzinnach uchean adi tikkun zenach minnach ugele kodamay ma abed lach:
Vayyitnatztzelu vene-yisrael et-edyam mehar chorev
Veadiu vene yisrael yat tikkun zenehon mittura dechorev:
Umoshe yikkach et-haohel venata-lo michutz lammachane harchek min-hammachane vekara lo ohel moed vehaya kol-mevakkesh Adonai yetze el-ohel moed asher michutz lammachane
Umshe nesiv yat mashkena ufarseh leh mibbara lemashrita archek min mashrita vekare leh mashkan bet ulefana vihe kol detava ulefan min kodam Adonai nefak lemashkan bet ulefana mibbara lemashrita:
Vehaya ketzet moshe el-haohel yakumu kol-haam venitztzevu ish petach oholo vehibbitu achare moshe ad-boo haohela
Vahava kad nefak mshe lemashkena kayyemin kol amma umitattedin gevar bitra mashkena umistakkelin achore mshe ad dealel lemashkena:
Vehaya kevo moshe haohela yered ammud heanan veamad petach haohel vedibber im-moshe
Vahava kad alel mshe lemashkena nachit ammuda daanana vekaem bitra mashkena umitmallel im mshe:
Veraa chol-haam et-ammud heanan omed petach haohel vekam kol-haam vehishtachavu ish petach oholo
Vachazan kol amma yat ammuda daanana kaem bitra mashkena vekayyemin kol amma vesagdin gevar bitra mashkeneh:
Vedibber Adonai el-moshe panim el-panim kaasher yedabber ish el-reehu veshav el-hammachane umesharto yehoshua bin-nun naar lo yamish mittoch haohel
Umitmallel Adonai im mshe mamlal im mamlal kema dimmallel gevar im chavreh vetav lemashrita umeshumeshaneh yehoshua bar nun ulema la ade miggo mashkena:
Vayyomer moshe el-Adonai ree atta omer elay haal et-haam hazze veatta lo hodatani et asher-tishlach immi veatta amarta yedaticha veshem vegam-matzata chen beenay
Vaamar mshe kodam Adonai chaze deat amar li assek yat amma haden veat la hodatani yat di tishlach immi veat amart rabbitach beshum veaf ashkachta rachamin kodamay:
Veatta im-na matzati chen beenecha hodieni na et-derachecha veedaacha lemaan emtza-chen beenecha uree ki ammecha haggoy hazze
Uchean im kean ashkachit rachamin kodamach hodani chean yat orach tuvach veidda rachamach bedil deashkach rachamin kodamach ugele kadamach are ammach amma haden:
Vayyomar panay yelechu vahanichoti lach
Vaamar shechinti tehach veaniach lach:
Vayyomer elav im-en panecha holchim al-taalenu mizze
Vaamar kodamohi im let shechintach mehallecha venana la taskinana mikka:
Uvamme yivvada efo ki-matzati chen beenecha ani veammecha halo belechtecha immanu veniflinu ani veammecha mikkol-haam asher al-pene haadama
Uvamme yityadda hacha are ashkachit rachamin kodamach ana veammach hala bemehach shechintach immana veyitabbedan lana ferishan li uleammach meshanne mikkol amma di al appe ara:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe gam et-haddavar hazze asher dibbarta eese ki-matzata chen beenay vaedaacha beshem
Vaamar Adonai lemshe af yat pitgama haden di mallelta ebed are ashkachta rachamin kodamay verabbitach beshum:
Vayyomar hareni na et-kevodecha
Vaamar achazeni chean yat yekarach:
Vayyomer ani aavir kol-tuvi al-panecha vekarati veshem Adonai lefanecha vechannoti et-asher achon verichamti et-asher arachem
Vaamar ana abar kol tuvi al appaych veekre vishma daAdonai kodamach veechon leman deechon veerachem al man deerachem:
Vayyomer lo tuchal lirot et-panay ki lo-yirani haadam vachay
Vaamar la tichul lemecheze yat appe shechinti are la yechezinani enasha veyitkayyam:
Vayyomer Adonai hinne makom itti venitztzavta al-hatztzur
Vaamar Adonai ha atar matkan kodamay vetitattad al tinnara:
Vehaya baavor kevodi vesamticha benikrat hatztzur vesakkoti chappi alecha ad-ovri
Vihe bemeavar yekari veeshavvinach bimarat tinnara veagen bememri alach ad deeevar:
Vahasiroti et-kappi veraita et-achoray ufanay lo yerau
Veade yat divrat yekari vetecheze yat devatray vedikodamay la yitchazun:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe pesol-lecha shene-luchot avanim karishonim vechatavti al-halluchot et-haddevarim asher hayu al-halluchot harishonim asher shibbarta
Vaamar Adonai lemshe pesal lach teren luche avnayya kekadmae veechtov al luchayya yat pitgamayya di havo al luchayya kadmae di tevarta:
Veye nachon labboker vealita vabboker el-har sinay venitztzavta li sham al-rosh hahar
Veheve zammin letzafra vetissak betzafra letura desinay vetitattad kodamay tamman al resh tura:
Veish lo-yaale immach vegam-ish al-yera bechol-hahar gam-hatztzon vehabbakar al-yiru el-mul hahar hahu
Veenash la yissak immach veaf enash la yitchaze bechol tura af ana vetore la yirun lokovel tura hahu:
Vayyifsol shene-luchot avanim karishonim vayyashkem moshe vabboker vayyaal el-har sinay kaasher tzivva Adonai oto vayyikkach beyado shene luchot avanim
Ufesal teren luche avnayya kekadmae veakdem mshe vetzafra uselek letura desinay kema defakked Adonai yateh unesev bideh teren luche avnayya:
Vayyered Adonai beanan vayyityatztzev immo sham vayyikra veshem Adonai
Veitgeli Adonai baanana veitattad immeh tamman ukera vishma daAdonai:
Vayyaavor Adonai al-panav vayyikra Adonai Adonai el rachum vechannun erech appayim verav-chesed veemet
Veabar Adonai shechinteh al appohi ukera Adonai Adonai elaha rachamana vechannana marchik regaz umasge lemebad tavvan ukeshot:
Notzer chesed laalafim nose avon vafesha vechattaa venakke lo yenakke poked avon avot al-banim veal-bene vanim al-shilleshim veal-ribbeim
Natar tivu lealfe darin shavek laavayan velimrod ulechovin salach lidtayvin leorayteh velidla tayvin la mezakke masar chove avahan al benin veal bene venin maradin al dar telitay veal dar reviay:
Vaymaher moshe vayyikkod artza vayyishtachu
Veochi mshe uchera al ara usegid:
Vayyomer im-na matzati chen beenecha adonay yelech-na adonay bekirbenu ki am-keshe-oref hu vesalachta laavonenu ulechattatenu unechaltanu
Vaamar im kean ashkachit rachamin kodamach Adonai tehach kean shechinta daAdonai benana are am keshe kedal hu vetishbok lechovana velachataana vetachsenana:
Vayyomer hinne anochi koret berit neged kol-ammecha eese niflaot asher lo-nivreu vechol-haaretz uvechol-haggoyim veraa chol-haam asher-atta vekirbo et-maase Adonai ki-nora hu asher ani ose immach
Vaamar ha ana gezar keyam kodam kol ammach aabbed perishan di la itberiu bechol ara uvechol ammayya veyecheze chol amma di at benehon yat ovada daAdonai are dachel hu di ana aved immach:
Shemor-lecha et asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom hinni goresh mippanecha et-haemori vehakkenaani vehachitti vehapperizzi vehachivvi vehayevusi
Tar lach yat di ana mefakdach yoma den ha ana metarech min kodamach yat emorae uchenaanae vechittae uferizzae vechivvae vivusae:
Hishshamer lecha pen-tichrot berit leyoshev haaretz asher atta ba aleha pen-yihye lemokesh bekirbecha
Istammar lach dilma tigzar keyam leyatev ara di at alel ala dilma yehe letakla benach:
Ki et-mizbechotam tittotzun veet-matztzevotam teshabberun veet-asherav tichrotun
Are yat agorehon tetarun veyat kamathon tetabberun veyat asherehon tekatztzetzun:
Ki lo tishtachave leel acher ki Adonai kanna shemo el kanna hu
Are la tisgod letaavat ammayya are Adonai kanna shemeh el kanna hu:
Pen-tichrot berit leyoshev haaretz vezanu achare elohehem vezavchu lelohehem vekara lecha veachalta mizzivcho
Dilma tigzar keyam leyatev ara veyitun batar taavathon veyidbechun letaavathon veyikrun lach vetechul middivchehon:
Velakachta mibbenotav levanecha vezanu venotav achare elohehen vehiznu et-banecha achare elohehen
Vetissav mibbenathon livnaych veyitayyan benathon batar taavathon veyitayyan yat benaych batar taavathon:
Elohe massecha lo taase-llach
Dachalan dematcha la tabed lach:
Et-chag hammatztzot tishmor shivat yamim tochal matztzot asher tzivviticha lemoed chodesh haaviv ki bechodesh haaviv yatzata mimmitzrayim
Yat chagga defattirayya tittar shiva yomin techul pattira kema di fakkedtach lizman yarcha deabbiva are beyarcha deabbiva nefakta mimmitzrayim:
Kol-peter rechem li vechol-miknecha tizzachar peter shor vase
Kol patach valda dili vechol beirach dichrin takdesh bechor tor veimar:
Ufeter chamor tifde vese veim-lo tifde vaarafto kol bechor banecha tifde velo-yerau fanay rekam
Uvuchera dachamara tifrok beimra veim la tifrok vetankefeh kol buchera divnaych tifrok vela yitchazun kodamay rekanin:
Sheshet yamim taavod uvayyom hashshevii tishbot becharish uvakkatzir tishbot
Shitta yomin tiflach uveyoma sheviaa tenuach bizroa uvachatzada tenuach:
Vechag shavuot taase lecha bikkure ketzir chittim vechag haasif tekufat hashshana
Vechagga deshavuayya tabed lach bikkure chatzad chittin vechagga dichnasha bemifka deshatta:
Shalosh peamim bashshana yerae kol-zechurecha et-pene haadon Adonai elohe yisrael
Telat zimnin beshatta yitchazun kol dechuraych kodam ribbon alma Adonai elaha deyisrael:
Ki-orish goyim mippanecha vehirchavti et-gevulecha velo-yachmod ish et-artzecha baalotcha leraot et-pene Adonai elohecha shalosh peamim bashshana
Are atarech ammin min kodamach veafte yat techumach vela yachmed enash yat arach bemiskach leitchazzaa kodam Adonai elahach telat zimnin beshatta:
Lo-tishchat al-chametz dam-zivchi velo-yalin labboker zevach chag happasach
La tikkos al chamia dam pischi vela yevitun letzafra bar mimmadbecha tarbe nichsat chagga defischa:
Reshit bikkure admatcha tavi bet Adonai elohecha lo-tevashshel gedi bachalev immo
Resh bikkure arach tayte levet makdesha daAdonai elahach la techlun besar bachalav:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe ketov-lecha et-haddevarim haelle ki al-pi haddevarim haelle karatti ittecha berit veet-yisrael
Vaamar Adonai lemshe ketav lach yat pitgamayya haillen are al memar pitgamayya haillen gezarit immach keyam veim yisrael:
Vayhi-sham im-Adonai arbaim yom vearbaim layla lechem lo achal umayim lo shata vayyichtov al-halluchot et divre habberit aseret haddevarim
Vahava tamman kodam Adonai arbein yemamin vearbein lelavan lachma la achal umayya la shete uchetav al luchayya yat pitgame keyama asra pitgamin:
Vayhi beredet moshe mehar sinay ushene luchot haedut beyad-moshe beridto min-hahar umoshe lo-yada ki karan or panav bedabbero itto
Vahava kad nechat mshe mittura desinay uteren luche sahaduta bida demshe bemechateh min tura umshe la yeda are sege ziv yekara deappohi bemallaluteh immeh:
Vayyar aharon vechol-bene yisrael et-moshe vehinne karan or panav vayyiru miggeshet elav
Vachaza aharon vechol bene yisrael yat mshe veha sege ziv yekara deappohi udechilu milleitkerava levateh:
Vayyikra alehem moshe vayyashuvu elav aharon vechol-hannesiim baeda vaydabber moshe alehem
Ukera lehon mshe vetavu levateh aharon vechol ravrevayya bichnishta umallel mshe immehon:
Veachare-chen niggeshu kol-bene yisrael vaytzavvem et kol-asher dibber Adonai itto behar sinay
Uvatar ken itkerivu kol bene yisrael ufakkedinnun yat kol di mallel Adonai immeh betura desinay:
Vaychal moshe middabber ittam vayyitten al-panav masve
Veshetze mshe milmallala immehon vihav al appohi bet appe:
Uvevo moshe lifne Adonai ledabber itto yasir et-hammasve ad-tzeto veyatza vedibber el-bene yisrael et asher yetzuvve
Vechad alel mshe lokodam Adonai lemallala immeh adi yat bet appohi ad mippekeh venafek umemallel im bene yisrael yat di mitpakkad:
Verau vene-yisrael et-pene moshe ki karan or pene moshe veheshiv moshe et-hammasve al-panav ad-boo ledabber itto
Vachazan bene yisrael yat appe mshe are sege ziv yekara deappe mshe vaatev mshe yat bet appe al appohi ad dealel lemallala immeh:
Vayyakhel moshe et-kol-adat bene yisrael vayyomer alehem elle haddevarim asher-tzivva Adonai laasot otam
Veachnesh mshe yat kol kenishta divne yisrael vaamar lehon illen pitgamayya di fakked Adonai lemebad yathon:
Sheshet yamim tease melacha uvayyom hashshevii yihye lachem kodesh shabbat shabbaton la-Adonai kol-haose vo melacha yumat
Shitta yomin titaved ividta uveyoma sheviaa yehe lechon kudesha shabba shabbeta kodam Adonai kol deyabed beh ividta yitketel:
Lo-tevaaru esh bechol moshvotechem beyom hashshabbat
La tevaarun eshshata bechol motvanechon beyoma deshabbeta:
Vayyomer moshe el-kol-adat bene-yisrael lemor ze haddavar asher-tzivva Adonai lemor
Vaamar mshe lechol kenishta divne yisrael lememar den pitgama di fakked Adonai lememar:
Kechu meittechem teruma la-Adonai kol nediv libbo yevieha et terumat Adonai zahav vachesef unechoshet
Savu minnechon afrashuta kodam Adonai kol deyitree libbeh yayte yat afrashuta kodam Adonai dahava vechaspa unechasha:
Utechelet veargaman vetolaat shani veshesh veizzim
Vetichla veargevana utzeva zehori uvutz umeazze:
Veorot elim meoddamim veorot techashim vaatze shittim
Umashche dedichre mesammeke umashche desasgona veae shittin:
Veshemen lammaor uvesamim leshemen hammishcha veliktoret hassammim
Umishcha leanharuta uvusemayya limshach revuta veliktoret busemayya:
Veavne-shoham veavne milluim laefod velachoshen
Veavne vurela veavne ashlamuta leshakkaa veefoda uvechushena:
Vechol-chacham-lev bachem yavou veyaasu et kol-asher tzivva Adonai
Vechol chakkime libba bechon yetun veyaavdun yat kol di fakked Adonai:
Et-hammishkan et-oholo veet-michsehu et-kerasav veet-kerashav et-berichav et-ammudav veet-adanav
Yat mashkena yat peraseh veyat chofaeh yat purefohi veyat dappohi yat avrohi yat ammudohi veyat samchohi:
Et-haaron veet-baddav et-hakkapporet veet parochet hammasach
Yat arona veyat arichohi yat kappurta veyat paruchta difrasa:
Et-hashshulchan veet-baddav veet-kol-kelav veet lechem happanim
Yat patora veyat arichohi veyat kol manohi veyat lechem appayya:
Veet-menorat hammaor veet-keleha veet-neroteha veet shemen hammaor
Veyat menarta deanhore veyat manaha veyat botzinaha veyat mishcha deanharuta:
Veet-mizbach hakketoret veet-baddav veet shemen hammishcha veet ketoret hassammim veet-masach happetach lefetach hammishkan
Veyat madbecha diktoret busemayya veyat arichohi veyat mishcha dirvuta veyat ketoret busemayya veyat perasa detara litra mashkena:
Et mizbach haola veet-michbar hannechoshet asher-lo et-baddav veet-kol-kelav et-hakkiyyor veet-kanno
Yat madbecha daalata veyat serada dinchasha dileh yat arichohi veyat kol manohi yat kiyora veyat besiseh:
Et kale hechatzer et-ammudav veet-adaneha veet masach shaar hechatzer
Yat serade darta yat ammudohi veyat samchaha veyat perasa ditra darta:
Et-yitdot hammishkan veet-yitdot hechatzer veet-metrehem
Yat sikke mashkena veyat sikke dedarta veyat attunehon:
Et-bigde hasserad lesharet bakkodesh et-bigde hakkodesh leaharon hakkohen veet-bigde vanav lechahen
Yat levushe shimmusha leshammasha vekudesha yat levushe kudesha leaharon kahana veyat levushe venohi leshammasha:
Vayyetzu kol-adat bene-yisrael millifne moshe
Unefaku kol kenishta divne yisrael min kodam mshe:
Vayyavou kol-ish asher-nesao libbo vechol asher nadva rucho oto heviu et-terumat Adonai limlechet ohel moed ulechol-avodato ulevigde hakkodesh
Vaato kol gevar deitree libbeh vechol di ashlemat rucheh yateh aytiu yat afrashuta kodam Adonai laavidat mashkan zimna ulechal pulchaneh velilvushe kudesha:
Vayyavou haanashim al-hannashim kol nediv lev heviu chach vanezem vetabbaat vechumaz kol-keli zahav vechol-ish asher henif tenufat zahav la-Adonai
Umaytan guvrayya al neshayya kol deitree libbeh aytiu sherin veshivchin veizkan umachuch kol man didhav vechol gevar di arem aramut dahava kodam Adonai:
Vechol-ish asher-nimtza itto techelet veargaman vetolaat shani veshesh veizzim veorot elim meoddamim veorot techashim heviu
Vechol gevar deishtechach immeh tichla veargevana utzeva zehori uvutz umeazze umashche dedichre mesammeke umashche sasgona aytiu:
Kol-merim terumat kesef unechoshet heviu et terumat Adonai vechol asher nimtza itto atze shittim lechol-melechet haavoda heviu
Kol daarem aramut kesaf unechash aytiu yat afrashuta kodam Adonai vechol di ishtechach immeh ae shittin lechol ividat pulchana aytiu:
Vechol-ishsha chachmat-lev beyadeha tavu vayyaviu matve et-hattechelet veet-haargaman et-tolaat hashshani veet-hashshesh
Vechol itteta chakkimat libba bidaha meazzela umaytan kad azel yat tichla veyat argevana yat tzeva zehori veyat butza:
Vechol-hannashim asher nasa libban otana bechochma tavu et-haizzim
Vechol neshayya deitree libbehen immehen bechochma azzelan yat meazya:
Vehannesiim heviu et avne hashshoham veet avne hammilluim laefod velachoshen
Veravrevayya aytiu yat avne vurela veyat avne ashlamuta leshakkaa beefoda uvechushena:
Veet-habbosem veet-hashshamen lemaor uleshemen hammishcha veliktoret hassammim
Veyat busema veyat mishcha leanharuta ulemishcha dirvuta veliktoret busemayya:
Kol-ish veishsha asher nadav libbam otam lehavi lechol-hammelacha asher tzivva Adonai laasot beyad-moshe heviu vene-yisrael nedava la-Adonai
Kol gevar veitteta deitree libbehon immehon leaytaa lechol ividta di fakked Adonai lemebad bida demshe aytiu vene yisrael nedavta kodam Adonai:
Vayyomer moshe el-bene yisrael reu kara Adonai beshem betzalel ben-uri ven-chur lematte yehuda
Vaamar mshe livne yisrael chazo derabbi Adonai beshum betzalel bar uri var chur leshivta dihuda:
Vaymalle oto ruach elohim bechochma bitvuna uvedaat uvechol-melacha
Veashlem immeh ruach nevua min kodam Adonai bechochmeta besucheletanu uvemadda uvechol ivida:
Velachshov machashavot laasot bazzahav uvakkesef uvannechoshet
Uleallafa umanvan lemebad bedahava uvechaspa uvinchasha:
Uvacharoshet even lemallot uvacharoshet etz laasot bechol-melechet machashavet
Uveumanut even tava leashlama uvenaggarut aa lemebad bechol ividat umanvan:
Ulehorot natan belibbo hu veoholiav ben-achisamach lematte-dan
Uleallafa yehav belibbeh hu veoholiav bar achisamach leshivta dedan:
Mille otam chochmat-lev laasot kol-melechet charash vechoshev verokem battechelet uvaargaman betolaat hashshani uvashshesh veoreg ose kol-melacha vechoshve machashavot
Ashlem immehon chakkimut libba lemebad kol ividat naggar veamman vetzayyar betichla uveargevana bitzva zehori uvevutza umache avde kol ivida umalfe umanvan:
Veasa vetzalel veoholiav vechol ish chacham-lev asher natan Adonai chochma utevuna bahemma ladaat laasot et-kol-melechet avodat hakkodesh lechol asher-tzivva Adonai
Vaavad betzalel veoholiav vechol gevar chakkim libba dihav Adonai chochma vesucheletanuta behon lemidda lemebad yat kol ividat palchan kudesha lechol di pakked Adonai:
Vayyikra moshe el-betzalel veel-oholiav veel kol-ish chacham-lev asher natan Adonai chochma belibbo kol asher nesao libbo lekorva el-hammelacha laasot otah
Ukera mshe livtzalel uleoholiav ulechal gevar chakkim libba dihav Adonai chochmeta belibbeh kol deitree libbeh lemikrav leividta lemebad yateh:
Vayyikchu millifne moshe et kol-hatteruma asher heviu bene yisrael limlechet avodat hakkodesh laasot otah vehem heviu elav od nedava babboker babboker
Unesivu min kodam mshe yat kol afrashuta di aytiu bene yisrael leividat palchan kudesha lemebad yata veinnun maytan leh od nedavta bitzfar bitzfar:
Vayyavou kol-hachachamim haosim et kol-melechet hakkodesh ish-ish mimmelachto asher-hemma osim
Vaato kol chakkimayya deavdin yat kol ividat kudesha gevar gevar meividteh deinnun avdin:
Vayyomru el-moshe lemor marbim haam lehavi midde haavoda lammelacha asher-tzivva Adonai laasot otah
Vaamaru lemshe lememar masgan amma leaytaa missat palchana leividta defakked Adonai lemebad yata:
Vaytzav moshe vayyaaviru kol bammachane lemor ish veishsha al-yaasu-od melacha litrumat hakkodesh vayyikkale haam mehavi
Ufakked mshe veaavaru charoza vemashrita lememar gevar veitteta la yaavdun od ividta leafrashut kudesha ufesak amma milleaytaa:
Vehammelacha hayta dayyam lechol-hammelacha laasot otah vehoter
Veividta havat missat lechol ividta lemebad yata vitarat:
Vayyaasu chol-chacham-lev beose hammelacha et-hammishkan eser yeriot shesh moshzar utechelet veargaman vetolaat shani keruvim maase choshev asa otam
Vaavadu chol chakkime libba beavde ividta yat mashkena asar yerian devutz shezir vetichla veargevana utzeva zehori tzurat keruvin ovad amman avad yathon:
Orech hayeria haachat shemone veesrim baamma verochav arba baamma hayeria haechat midda achat lechol-hayeriot
Urka diriata chada asrin utemanya ammin ufuteya arba ammin diriata chada meshachta chada lechol yeriata:
Vaychabber et-chamesh hayeriot achat el-echat vechamesh yeriot chibbar achat el-echat
Velafef yat chamesh yerian chada im chada vechamesh yerian lafef chada im chada:
Vayyaas lulot techelet al sefat hayeria haechat mikkatza bammachbaret ken asa bisfat hayeria hakkitzona bammachberet hashshenit
Vaavad anuvin detichla al sifta diriata chada missitra bet lofe ken avad besifta diriata besitra bet lofe tinyeta:
Chamishshim lulaot asa bayria haechat vachamishshim lulaot asa biktze hayeria asher bammachberet hashshenit makbilot hallulaot achat el-echat
Chamshin anuvin avad biriata chada vechamshin anuvin avad besitra diriata devet lofe tinyeta mechavvenan anuvayya chada lokovel chada:
Vayyaas chamishshim karse zahav vaychabber et-hayeriot achat el-achat bakkerasim vayhi hammishkan echad
Vaavad chamshin purefin didhav velafef yat yeriata chada im chada befurefayya vahava mashkena chad:
Vayyaas yeriot izzim leohel al-hammishkan ashte-esre yeriot asa otam
Vaavad yerian dimazze lifrasa al mashkena chad asar yerian avad yathen:
Orech hayeria haachat sheloshim baamma vearba ammot rochav hayeria haechat midda achat leashte esre yeriot
Urka diriata chada telatin beammin vearba ammin puteya diriata chada meshachta chada lechad asar yerian:
Vaychabber et-chamesh hayeriot levad veet-shesh hayeriot levad
Velafef yat chamesh yerian lechod veyat shet yerian lechod:
Vayyaas lulaot chamishshim al sefat hayeria hakkitzona bammachbaret vachamishshim lulaot asa al-sefat hayeria hachoveret hashshenit
Vaavad anuvin chamshin al sifta diriata besitra bet lofe vechamshin anuvin avad al sifta diriata devet lofe tinyeta:
Vayyaas karse nechoshet chamishshim lechabber et-haohel lihyot echad
Vaavad purefin dinchasha chamshin lelappafa yat mashkena lemeheve chad:
Vayyaas michse laohel orot elim meoddamim umichse orot techashim milmala
Vaavad chofaa lemashkena mashche dedichre mesammeke vechofaa mashche desasgona milleella:
Vayyaas et-hakkerashim lammishkan atze shittim omdim
Vaavad yat dappayya lemashkena deae shittin kaymin:
Eser ammot orech hakkaresh veamma vachatzi haamma rochav hakkeresh haechad
Asar ammin urka dedappa veammeta ufalgut ammeta puteya dedappa chad:
Shete yadot lakkeresh haechad meshullavot achat el-echat ken asa lechol karshe hammishkan
Tarten tzirin ledappa chad meshallevin chada lokovel chada ken avad lechol dappe mashkena:
Vayyaas et-hakkerashim lammishkan esrim kerashim lifat negev temana
Vaavad yat dappayya lemashkena esrin dappin leruach evar daroma:
Vearbaim adne-chesef asa tachat esrim hakkerashim shene adanim tachat-hakkeresh haechad lishte yedotav ushene adanim tachat-hakkeresh haechad lishte yedotav
Vearbein samchin dichsaf avad techot esrin dappin teren samchin techot dappa chad litren tzirohi uteren samchin techot dappa chad litren tzirohi:
Uletzela hammishkan hashshenit lifat tzafon asa esrim kerashim
Velistar mashkena tinyeta leruach tzippuna avad esrin dappin:
Vearbaim adnehem kasef shene adanim tachat hakkeresh haechad ushene adanim tachat hakkeresh haechad
Vearbein samchehon dichsaf teren samchin techot dappa chad uteren samchin techot dappa chad:
Uleyarkete hammishkan yamma asa shishsha kerashim
Velisyafe mashkena maarva avad shitta dappin:
Ushene kerashim asa limkutzot hammishkan bayyarchatayim
Uteren dappin avad lezavyat mashkena besofehon:
Vehayu toamim millematta veyachdav yihyu tammim el-rosho el-hattabbaat haechat ken asa lishnehem lishne hammiktzoot
Vahavo mechavvenin millera vechachada havo mechavvenin al resheh leizkata chada ken avad letarvehon litren zavyan:
Vehayu shemona kerashim veadnehem kesef shishsha asar adanim shene adanim shene adanim tachat hakkeresh haechad
Vahavo temanya dappin vesamchehon dichsaf shitta asar samchin teren samchin teren samchin techot dappa chad:
Vayyaas beriche atze shittim chamishsha lekarshe tzela-hammishkan haechat
Vaavad abbere deae shittin chamsha ledappe setar mashkena chad:
Vachamishsha verichim lekarshe tzela-hammishkan hashshenit vachamishsha verichim lekarshe hammishkan layyarchatayim yamma
Vechamsha abberin ledappe setar mashkena tinyeta vechamsha abberin ledappe mashkena lesofehon maarva:
Vayyaas et-habberiach hattichon livroach betoch hakkerashim min-hakkatze el-hakkatze
Vaavad yat abbera metziaa leabara bego dappayya min seyafe lisyafe:
Veet-hakkerashim tzippa zahav veet-tabbeotam asa zahav battim labberichim vaytzaf et-habberichim zahav
Veyat dappayya chafa dahava veyat izkathon avad dahava atra leabberayya vachafa yat abberayya dahava:
Vayyaas et-happarochet techelet veargaman vetolaat shani veshesh moshzar maase choshev asa otah keruvim
Vaavad yat paruchta tichla veargevana utzeva zehori uvutz shezir ovad amman avad yata tzurat keruvin:
Vayyaas lah arbaa ammude shittim vaytzappem zahav vavehem zahav vayyitzok lahem arbaa adne-chasef
Vaavad leh arbea ammude shittin vachafanun dahava vavehon dahava veattich lehon arbea samchin dichsaf:
Vayyaas masach lefetach haohel techelet veargaman vetolaat shani veshesh moshzar maase rokem
Vaavad perasa litra mashkena tichla veargevana utzeva zehori uvutz shezir ovad tzayyar:
Veet-ammudav chamishsha veet-vavehem vetzippa rashehem vachashukehem zahav veadnehem chamishsha nechoshet
Veyat ammudohi chamsha veyat vavehon vachafa reshehon vechibbushehon dahava vesamchehon chamsha nechasha:
Vayyaas betzalel et-haaron atze shittim ammatayim vachetzi orko veamma vachetzi rochbo veamma vachetzi komato
Vaavad betzalel yat arona deae shittin tarten ammin ufalga urkeh veammeta ufalga fetaye veamta ufalga rumeh:
Vaytzappehu zahav tahor mibbayit umichutz vayyaas lo zer zahav saviv
Vachafahi dehav deche miggav umibbara vaavad leh der didhav sechor sechor:
Vayyitzok lo arba tabbeot zahav al arba paamotav ushete tabbaot al-tzalo haechat ushete tabbaot al-tzalo hashshenit
Veattich leh arba izkan didhav al arba zivyateh vetarten izkan al sitreh chad vetarten izkan al sitreh tinyeta:
Vayyaas badde atze shittim vaytzaf otam zahav
Vaavad ariche deae shittin vachafa yathon dahava:
Vayyave et-habbaddim battabbaot al tzalot haaron laset et-haaron
Veael yat arichayya beizkata al sitre arona lemittal yat arona:
Vayyaas kapporet zahav tahor ammatayim vachetzi orkah veamma vachetzi rochbah
Vaavad kappurta dehav deche tarten ammin ufalga urka veammeta ufalga petaya:
Vayyaas shene cheruvim zahav miksha asa otam mishshene ketzot hakkapporet
Vaavad teren keruvin didhav negid avad yathon mitteren sitre chappurta:
Keruv-echad mikkatza mizze ucheruv-echad mikkatza mizze min-hakkapporet asa et-hakkeruvim mishshene ketzotav
Keruva chad missitra mikka ucheruva chad missitra mikka min kappurta avad yat keruvayya mitteren sitrohi:
Vayyihyu hakkeruvim porse chenafayim lemala sochechim bechanfehem al-hakkapporet ufenehem ish el-achiv el-hakkapporet hayu pene hakkeruvim
Vahavo cheruvayya perisan gadfehon leella natlin begadfehon al kappurta veappehon chad lokovel chad lokovel kappurta havo appe cheruvayya:
Vayyaas et-hashshulchan atze shittim ammatayim orko veamma rochbo veamma vachetzi komato
Vaavad yat patora deae shittin tarten ammin urkeh veammeta fetaye veammeta ufalga rumeh:
Vaytzaf oto zahav tahor vayyaas lo zer zahav saviv
Vachafa yateh dehav deche vaavad leh der didhav sechor sechor:
Vayyaas lo misgeret tofach saviv vayyaas zer-zahav lemisgarto saviv
Vaavad leh gedanfa rumeh pushecha sechor sechor vaavad der didhav ligdanfeh sechor sechor:
Vayyitzok lo arba tabbeot zahav vayyitten et-hattabbaot al arba happeot asher learba raglav
Veattich leh arba izkan didhav vihav yat izkata al arba zivyata di learba raglohi:
Leummat hammisgeret hayu hattabbaot battim labbaddim laset et-hashshulchan
Lokovel gedanfa havo izkata atra laarichayya lemittal yat patora:
Vayyaas et-habbaddim atze shittim vaytzaf otam zahav laset et-hashshulchan
Vaavad yat arichayya deae shittin vachafa yathon dahava lemittal yat patora:
Vayyaas et-hakkelim asher al-hashshulchan et-kearotav veet-kappotav veet menakkiyyotav veet-hakkesavot asher yussach bahen zahav tahor
Vaavad yat manayya di al patora yat magisohi veyat bazichohi veyat mechilateh veyat kasvata di yitnassach behon dehav deche:
Vayyaas et-hammenora zahav tahor miksha asa et-hammenora yerechah vekanah gevieha kaftoreha uferacheha mimmenna hayu
Vaavad yat menarta dehav deche negid avad yat menarta shida ukena kalidaha chezuraha veshoshannaha minna havo:
Veshishsha kanim yotzim mitztziddeha shelosha kene menora mitztziddah haechad ushelosha kene menora mitztziddah hashsheni
Veshitta kenin nafkin missitraha telata kene menarta missitra chad utelata kene menarta missitra tinyana:
Shelosha geviim meshukkadim bakkane haechad kaftor vaferach ushelosha geviim meshukkadim bekane echad kaftor vafarach ken lesheshet hakkanim hayyotzim min-hammenora
Telata challidin metzayyerin bekanya chad chezur veshoshan utelata challidin metzayyerin bekanya chad chezur veshoshan ken leshitta kenin denafkin min menarta:
Uvammenora arbaa geviim meshukkadim kaftoreha uferacheha
Uvimnarta arbea challidin metzayyerin chezzuraha veshoshannaha:
Vechaftor tachat shene hakkanim mimmenna vechaftor tachat shene hakkanim mimmenna vechaftor tachat-shene hakkanim mimmenna lesheshet hakkanim hayyotzim mimmenna
Vechezur techot teren kenin minna vechezur techot teren kenin minna vechezur techot teren kenin minna leshitta kenin denafkin minna:
Kaftorehem ukenotam mimmenna hayu kullah miksha achat zahav tahor
Chezurehon ukenehon minna havo kula negida chada dehav deche:
Vayyaas et-neroteha shiva umalkacheha umachtoteha zahav tahor
Vaavad yat botzinaha shiva vetzivyetaha umachitteyetaha dehav deche:
Kikkar zahav tahor asa otah veet kol-keleha
Kikkera dehav deche avad yata veyat kol manaha:
Vayyaas et-mizbach hakketoret atze shittim amma orko veamma rochbo ravua veammatayim komato mimmennu hayu karnotav
Vaavad yat madbecha diktoret busemayya deae shittin ammeta urkeh veammeta fetaye merabba vetarten ammin rumeh minneh havo karnohi:
Vaytzaf oto zahav tahor et-gaggo veet-kirotav saviv veet-karnotav vayyaas lo zer zahav saviv
Vachafa yateh dehav deche yat iggareh veyat katlohi sechor sechor veyat karnohi vaavad leh der didhav sechor sechor:
Ushete tabbeot zahav asa-lo mittachat lezero al shete tzalotav al shene tziddav levattim levaddim laset oto bahem
Vetarten izkan didhav avad leh millera ledereh al tarten zivyateh al teren sitrohi leatra laarichayya lemittal yateh behon:
Vayyaas et-habbaddim atze shittim vaytzaf otam zahav
Vaavad yat arichayya deae shittin vachafa yathon dahava:
Vayyaas et-shemen hammishcha kodesh veet-ketoret hassammim tahor maase rokeach
Vaavad yat mishcha dirvuta kudesha veyat ketoret busemayya deche ovad busemanu:
Vayyaas et-mizbach haola atze shittim chamesh ammot orko vechamesh-ammot rochbo ravua veshalosh ammot komato
Vaavad yat madbecha daalata deae shittin chamesh ammin urkeh vachamesh ammin petaye merabba utelata ammin rumeh:
Vayyaas karnotav al arba pinnotav mimmennu hayu karnotav vaytzaf oto nechoshet
Vaavad karnohi al arba zivyateh minneh havo karnohi vachafa yateh nechasha:
Vayyaas et-kol-kele hammizbeach et-hassirot veet-hayyaim veet-hammizrakot et-hammizlagot veet-hammachtot kol-kelav asa nechoshet
Vaavad yat kol mane madbecha yat pesachteravata veyat magrofyata veyat mizrekata yat tzinnureyata veyat machteyata kol manohi avad nechasha:
Vayyaas lammizbeach michbar maase reshet nechoshet tachat karkubbo millematta ad-chetzyo
Vaavad lemadbecha serada ovad metzadta dinchasha techot sovaveh millera ad palgeh:
Vayyitzok arba tabbaot bearba hakketzavot lemichbar hannechoshet battim labbaddim
Veattich arba izkata bearba sitrata lisrada dinchasha atra laarichayya:
Vayyaas et-habbaddim atze shittim vaytzaf otam nechoshet
Vaavad yat arichayya deae shittin vachafa yathon nechasha:
Vayyave et-habbaddim battabbaot al tzalot hammizbeach laset oto bahem nevuv luchot asa oto
Veael yat arichayya beizkata al sitre madbecha lemittal yateh behon chalil luchin avad yateh:
Vayyaas et hakkiyyor nechoshet veet kanno nechoshet bemarot hatztzovot asher tzavu petach ohel moed
Vaavad yat kiyora nechasha veyat besiseh nechasha bemechzeyan neshayya deatyan letzallaa bitra mashkan zimna:
Vayyaas et-hechatzer lifat negev temana kale hechatzer shesh moshzar mea baamma
Vaavad yat darta leruach evar daroma serade darta devutz shezir mea veammin:
Ammudehem esrim veadnehem esrim nechoshet vave haammudim vachashukehem kasef
Ammudehon esrin vesamchehon esrin nechasha vave ammudayya vechibbushehon kesaf:
Velifat tzafon mea vaamma ammudehem esrim veadnehem esrim nechoshet vave haammudim vachashukehem kasef
Uleruach tzippuna mea ammin ammudehon esrin vesamchehon esrin nechasha vave ammudayya vechibbushehon dichsaf:
Velifat-yam kelaim chamishshim baamma ammudehem asara veadnehem asara vave haammudim vachashukehem kasef
Uleruach maarva seradin chamshin beammin ammudehon asra vesamchehon asra vave ammudayya vechibbushehon dichsaf:
Velifat kedma mizracha chamishshim amma
Uleruach kidduma madincha chamshin ammin:
Kelaim chamesh-esre amma el-hakkatef ammudehem shelosha veadnehem shelosha
Seradin chamesh esre ammin leivra ammudehon telata vesamchehon telata:
Velakkatef hashshenit mizze umizze leshaar hechatzer kelaim chamesh esre amma ammudehem shelosha veadnehem shelosha
Uleivra tinyeta mikka umikka litra darta seradin chamesh esre ammin ammudehon telata vesamchehon telata
Kol-kale hechatzer saviv shesh moshzar
Kol serade dedarta sechor sechor devutz shezir:
Vehaadanim laammudim nechoshet vave haammudim vachashukehem kesef vetzippuy rashehem kasef vehem mechushshakim kesef kol ammude hechatzer
Vesamchayya leammudayya nechasha vave ammudayya vechibbushehon dichsaf vechippuy reshehon dichsaf veinnun mechabbeshin dichsaf kol ammude darta:
Umasach shaar hechatzer maase rokem techelet veargaman vetolaat shani veshesh moshzar veesrim amma orech vekoma verochav chamesh ammot leummat kale hechatzer
Uferasa ditra darta ovad tzayyar tichla veargevana utzeva zehori uvutz shezir veesrin ammin urka veruma befuteya chamesh ammin lokovel serade darta:
Veammudehem arbaa veadnehem arbaa nechoshet vavehem kesef vetzippuy rashehem vachashukehem kasef
Veammudehon arbea vesamchehon arbea nechasha vavehon dichsaf vechippuy reshehon vechibbushehon dichsaf:
Vechol-hayetedot lammishkan velechatzer saviv nechoshet
Vechol sikkayya lemashkena uledarta sechor sechor dinchasha:
Elle fekude hammishkan mishkan haedut asher pukkad al-pi moshe avodat haleviyyim beyad itamar ben-aharon hakkohen
Illen minyane mashkena mashkena desahaduta di itmene al memra demshe palchan levae bida deitamar bar aharon kahana:
Uvetzalel ben-uri ven-chur lematte yehuda asa et kol-asher-tzivva Adonai et-moshe
Uvetzalel bar uri var chur leshivta dihuda avad yat kol di fakkid Adonai yat mshe:
Veitto oholiav ben-achisamach lematte-dan charash vechoshev verokem battechelet uvaargaman uvetolaat hashshani uvashshesh
Veimmeh oholiav bar achisamach leshivta dedan naggar veomman vetzayyar betichla uveargevana uvitzva zehori uvevutza:
Kol-hazzahav heasuy lammelacha bechol melechet hakkodesh vayhi zehav hattenufa tesha veesrim kikkar usheva meot usheloshim shekel beshekel hakkodesh
Kol dahava deitaved leivida bechol ividat kudesha vahava dehav aramuta esrin utesha kikkerin usheva mea utelatin silin besile kudesha:
Vechesef pekude haeda meat kikkar veelef usheva meot vachamishsha veshivim shekel beshekel hakkodesh
Uchesaf minyane chenishta mea chikkerin veelef usheva mea veshivin vechamsha silin besile kudesha:
Beka laggulgolet machatzit hashshekel beshekel hakkodesh lechol haover al-happekudim mibben esrim shana vamala leshesh-meot elef usheloshet alafim vachamesh meot vachamishshim
Tikla legulgalta palgut sila besile kudesha lechol deavar al minyanayya mibbar esrin shenin uleella leshet mea utelata alfin vachamesh mea vechamshin:
Vayhi meat kikkar hakkesef latzeket et adne hakkodesh veet adne happarochet meat adanim limat hakkikkar kikkar laaden
Vahava mea kikkerin dichsaf leattacha yat samche kudesha veyat samche defaruchta mea samchin lima chikkerin kikkera lesamcha:
Veet-haelef usheva hammeot vachamishsha veshivim asa vavim laammudim vetzippa rashehem vechishshak otam
Veyat alfa usheva mea veshivin vechamsha avad vavin leammudayya vechippa reshehon vechabbesh yathon:
Unechoshet hattenufa shivim kikkar vealpayim vearba-meot shakel
Unechasha daaramuta shivin kikkerin uteren alfin vearba mea silin:
Vayyaas bah et-adne petach ohel moed veet mizbach hannechoshet veet-michbar hannechoshet asher-lo veet kol-kele hammizbeach
Vaavad ba yat samche tera mashkan zimna veyat madbecha dinchasha veyat serada dinchasha di leh veyat kol mane madbecha:
Veet-adne hechatzer saviv veet-adne shaar hechatzer veet kol-yitdot hammishkan veet-kol-yitdot hechatzer saviv
Veyat samche dedarta sechor sechor veyat samche tera darta veyat kol sikke mashkena veyat kol sikke darta sechor sechor:
Umin-hattechelet vehaargaman vetolaat hashshani asu vigde-serad lesharet bakkodesh vayyaasu et-bigde hakkodesh asher leaharon kaasher tzivva Adonai et-moshe
Umin tichla veargevana utzeva zehori avadu levushe shimmusha leshammasha vekudesha vaavadu yat levushe kudesha di leaharon kema di pakkid Adonai yat mshe:
Vayyaas et-haefod zahav techelet veargaman vetolaat shani veshesh moshzar
Vaavad yat efoda dahava tichla veargevana utzeva zehori uvutz shezir:
Vayrakkeu et-pache hazzahav vekitztzetz petilim laasot betoch hattechelet uvetoch haargaman uvetoch tolaat hashshani uvetoch hashshesh maase choshev
Veraddidu yat tasse dahava vekatztzitzu chutin lemebad bego tichla uvego argevana uvego tzeva zehori uvego vutza ovad amman:
Ketefot asu-lo chovrot al-shene ketzotav chubbar
Katpan avadu leh melappefan al teren sitrohi yitlafef:
Vecheshev afuddato asher alav mimmennu hu kemaasehu zahav techelet veargaman vetolaat shani veshesh moshzar kaasher tzivva Adonai et-moshe
Vehemyan tikkuneh di alohi minneh hu keovadohi dahava tichla veargevana utzeva zehori uvutz shezir kema di fakkid Adonai yat mshe:
Vayyaasu et-avne hashshoham musabbot mishbetzot zahav mefuttachot pittuche chotam al-shemot bene yisrael
Vaavadu yat avne vurela meshakkean merammetzan didhav gelifan ketav mefarash al shemahat bene yisrael:
Vayyasem otam al kitfot haefod avne zikkaron livne yisrael kaasher tzivva Adonai et-moshe
Veshavvi yathon al kitpa deefoda avne ducherana livne yisrael kema di pakkid Adonai yat mshe:
Vayyaas et-hachoshen maase choshev kemaase efod zahav techelet veargaman vetolaat shani veshesh moshzar
Vaavad yat chushena ovad amman keovade efoda dahava tichla veargevana utzeva zehori uvutz shezir:
Ravua haya kaful asu et-hachoshen zeret orko vezeret rochbo kaful
Merabba hava ef avadu yat chushena zerta urkeh vezerta fetaye ef:
Vaymalu-vo arbaa ture aven tur odem pitda uvareket hattur haechad
Veashlimu veh arbea sidre even tava sidra kadmaa samkan yarkan uvarkan sidra chad:
Vehattur hashsheni nofech sappir veyahalom
Vesidra tinyana izmaragdin shavzez vesavhalom:
Vehattur hashshelishi leshem shevo veachlama
Vesidra telitaa kankere tarkeya veen egla:
Vehattur harvii tarshish shoham veyashfe musabbot mishbetzot zahav bemilluotam
Vesidra reviaa kerum yamma uvurela ufantere meshakkean merammetzan didhav beashlamutehon:
Vehaavanim al-shemot bene-yisrael henna shetem esre al-shemotam pittuche chotam ish al-shemo lishnem asar shavet
Veavnayya al shemahat bene yisrael innin tarte esre al shemahathon ketav mefarash kiglof deizka gevar al shemeh litren asar shivtin:
Vayyaasu al-hachoshen sharsherot gavlut maase avot zahav tahor
Vaavadu al chushena tikkin metachman ovad gedilu dehav deche:
Vayyaasu shete mishbetzot zahav ushete tabbeot zahav vayyittenu et-shete hattabbaot al-shene ketzot hachoshen
Vaavadu tarten merammetzan didhav vetarten izkan didhav vihavu yat tarten izkata al teren sitre chushena:
Vayyittenu shete haavotot hazzahav al-shete hattabbaot al-ketzot hachoshen
Vihavu tarten gedilata didhav al tarten izkata al sitre chushena:
Veet shete ketzot shete haavotot natnu al-shete hammishbetzot vayyittenum al-kitfot haefod el-mul panav
Veyat tarten gedilan dial tarten sitrohi yehavu al tarten merammetzata vihavunnun al katfe efoda lokovel appohi:
Vayyaasu shete tabbeot zahav vayyasimu al-shene ketzot hachoshen al-sefato asher el-ever haefod bayta
Vaavadu tarten izkan didhav veshavviu al teren sitre chushena al sifteh di leivra deefoda millegav:
Vayyaasu shete tabbeot zahav vayyittenum al-shete chitfot haefod millematta mimmul panav leummat machbarto mimmaal lecheshev haefod
Vaavadu tarten izkan didhav vihavunnun al tarten kitfe efoda millera millokovel appohi lokovel bet lofe meillave lehemyan efoda:
Vayyirkesu et-hachoshen mittabbeotav el-tabbeot haefod biftil techelet lihyot al-cheshev haefod velo-yizzach hachoshen meal haefod kaasher tzivva Adonai et-moshe
Veyachadun yat chushena meizkateh leizketa deefoda bechuta ditchelta lemeheve al hemyan efoda vela yitparek chushena meillave efoda kema di pakkid Adonai yat mshe:
Vayyaas et-meil haefod maase oreg kelil techelet
Vaavad yat meila deefoda ovad mache gemir tichla:
Ufi-hammeil betocho kefi tachra safa lefiv saviv lo yikkarea
Ufum meila kafil legavve kefum shiryan tora makkaf lefumeh sechor sechor la yitbeza:
Vayyaasu al-shule hammeil rimmone techelet veargaman vetolaat shani moshzar
Vaavadu al shippole meila rimmone tichla veargevana utzeva zehori shezir:
Vayyaasu faamone zahav tahor vayyittenu et-happaamonim betoch harimmonim al-shule hammeil saviv betoch harimmonim
Vaavadu zaggayya dehav deche vihavu yat zaggayya bego rimmonayya al shippole meila sechor sechor bego rimmonayya:
Paamon verimmon paamon verimmon al-shule hammeil saviv lesharet kaasher tzivva Adonai et-moshe
Zagga verimmona zagga verimmona al shippole meila sechor sechor leshammasha kema di pakkid Adonai yat mshe:
Vayyaasu et-hakkotnot shesh maase oreg leaharon ulevanav
Vaavadu yat kittunin devutza ovad mache leaharon velivnohi:
Veet hammitznefet shesh veet-paare hammigbaot shesh veet-michnese habbad shesh moshzar
Veyat mitznefta devutza veyat shevach kovaayya devutza veyat michnese vutza devutz shezir:
Veet-haavnet shesh moshzar utechelet veargaman vetolaat shani maase rokem kaasher tzivva Adonai et-moshe
Veyat hemyana devutz shezir vetichla veargevana utzeva zehori ovad tzayyar kema di pakkid Adonai yat mshe:
Vayyaasu et-tzitz nezer-hakkodesh zahav tahor vayyichtevu alav michtav pittuche chotam kodesh la-Adonai
Vaavadu yat tzitza chelila dekudesha dehav deche uchetavu alohi gelifan ketav mefarash kodesh layya:
Vayyittenu alav petil techelet latet al-hammitznefet milmala kaasher tzivva Adonai et-moshe
Vihavu alohi chuta techelta lemittan al mitznefta milleella kema di pakkid Adonai yat mshe:
Vattechel kol-avodat mishkan ohel moed vayyaasu bene yisrael kechol asher tzivva Adonai et-moshe ken asu
Ushelim kol palchan mashkena mashkan zimna vaavadu bene yisrael kechol di pakkid Adonai yat mshe ken avadu:
Vayyaviu et-hammishkan el-moshe et-haohel veet-kol-kelav kerasav kerashav berichav veammudav vaadanav
Veaytiu yat mashkena lemshe yat mashkena veyat kol manohi purefohi dappohi abberohi veammudohi vesammechohi:
Veet-michse orot haelim hameoddamim veet-michse orot hattechashim veet parochet hammasach
Veyat chofaa mashche dedichre mesammeke veyat chofaa mashche desasgona veyat paruchta difrasa:
Et-aron haedut veet-baddav veet hakkapporet
Yat arona desahaduta veyat arichohi veyat kafurta:
Et-hashshulchan et-kol-kelav veet lechem happanim
Yat patora yat kol manohi veyat lechem appayya:
Et-hammenora hattehora et-neroteha nerot hammaaracha veet-kol-keleha veet shemen hammaor
Yat menarta dachita yat botzinaha botzine sidra veyat kol manaha veyat mishcha deanharuta:
Veet mizbach hazzahav veet shemen hammishcha veet ketoret hassammim veet masach petach haohel
Veyat madbecha dedahava veyat mishcha dirvuta veyat ketoret busemayya veyat perasa ditra mashkena:
Et mizbach hannechoshet veet-michbar hannechoshet asher-lo et-baddav veet-kol-kelav et-hakkiyyor veet-kanno
Yat madbecha dinchasha veyat serada dinchasha dileh yat arichohi veyat kol manohi yat kiyyora veyat besiseh:
Et kale hechatzer et-ammudeha veet-adaneha veet-hammasach leshaar hechatzer et-metarav vitedoteha veet kol-kele avodat hammishkan leohel moed
Yat serade dedarta yat ammudaha veyat sammechaha veyat perasa litra darta yat atunohi vesikkaha veyat kol mane palchan mashkena lemashkan zimna:
Et-bigde hasserad lesharet bakkodesh et-bigde hakkodesh leaharon hakkohen veet-bigde vanav lechahen
Yat levushe shimmusha leshammasha vekudesha yat levushe kudesha leaharon kahana veyat levushe venohi leshammasha:
Kechol asher-tzivva Adonai et-moshe ken asu bene yisrael et kol-haavoda
Kechol di pakkid Adonai yat mshe ken avadu bene yisrael yat kol palchana:
