Vayyar moshe et-kol-hammelacha vehinne asu otah kaasher tzivva Adonai ken asu vayvarech otam moshe
Vachaza mshe yat kol ividta veha avadu yata kema di pakkid Adonai ken avadu uvarich yathon mshe:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Beyom-hachodesh harishon beechad lachodesh takim et-mishkan ohel moed
Beyoma yarcha kadmaa bechad leyarcha tekim yat mashkena mashkan zimna:
Vesamta sham et aron haedut vesakkota al-haaron et-happarochet
Uteshavvi tamman yat arona desahaduta vetattel al arona yat paruchta:
Veheveta et-hashshulchan vearachta et-erko veheveta et-hammenora vehaaleta et-neroteha
Vetael yat patora vetasdar yat sidreh vetael yat menarta vetadlek yat botzinaha:
Venatatta et-mizbach hazzahav liktoret lifne aron haedut vesamta et-masach happetach lammishkan
Vetitten yat madbecha dedahava liktoret busemayya kodam arona desahaduta uteshavvi yat perasa detara lemashkena:
Venatatta et mizbach haola lifne petach mishkan ohel-moed
Vetitten yat madbecha daalata kodam tera mashkena mashkan zimna:
Venatatta et-hakkiyyor ben-ohel moed uven hammizbeach venatatta sham mayim
Vetitten yat kiyyora ben mashkan zimna uven madbecha vetitten tamman mayya:
Vesamta et-hechatzer saviv venatatta et-masach shaar hechatzer
Uteshavve yat darta sechor sechor vetitten yat perasa ditra darta:
Velakachta et-shemen hammishcha umashachta et-hammishkan veet-kol-asher-bo vekiddashta oto veet-kol-kelav vehaya kodesh
Vetissav yat mishcha dirvuta uterabbe yat mashkena veyat kol di veh utekaddesh yateh veyat kol manohi vihe kudesha:
Umashachta et-mizbach haola veet-kol-kelav vekiddashta et-hammizbeach vehaya hammizbeach kodesh kodashim
Uterabbe yat madbecha daalata veyat kol manohi utekaddesh yat madbecha vihe madbecha kodesh kudeshin:
Umashachta et-hakkiyyor veet-kanno vekiddashta oto
Uterabbe yat kiyyora veyat besiseh utekaddesh yateh:
Vehikravta et-aharon veet-banav el-petach ohel moed verachatzta otam bammayim
Utekarev yat aharon veyat benohi litra mashkan zimna vetasche yathon bemayya:
Vehilbashta et-aharon et bigde hakkodesh umashachta oto vekiddashta oto vechihen li
Vetalbesh yat aharon yat levushe kudesha uterabbe yateh utekaddesh yateh vishammesh kodamay:
Veet-banav takriv vehilbashta otam kuttonot
Veyat benohi tekarev vetalbesh yathon kittunin:
Umashachta otam kaasher mashachta et-avihem vechihanu li vehayta lihyot lahem moshchatam lichhunnat olam ledorotam
Uterabbe yathon kema di rabbeta yat avuhon vishammeshun kodamay utehe lemeheve lehon revutehon lechahanut alam ledarehon:
Vayyaas moshe kechol asher tzivva Adonai oto ken asa
Vaavad mshe kechol di pakkid Adonai yateh ken avad:
Vayhi bachodesh harishon bashshana hashshenit beechad lachodesh hukam hammishkan
Vahava beyarcha kadmaa beshatta tinyeta bechad leyarcha ittakam mashkena:
Vayyakem moshe et-hammishkan vayyitten et-adanav vayyasem et-kerashav vayyitten et-berichav vayyakem et-ammudav
Vaakem mshe yat mashkena vihav yat sammechohi veshavvi yat dappohi vihav yat avrohi vaakem yat ammudohi:
Vayyifros et-haohel al-hammishkan vayyasem et-michse haohel alav milmala kaasher tzivva Adonai et-moshe
Uferas yat perasa al mashkena veshavvi yat chofaa demashkena alohi milleella kema di pakkid Adonai yat mshe:
Vayyikkach vayyitten et-haedut el-haaron vayyasem et-habbaddim al-haaron vayyitten et-hakkapporet al-haaron milmala
Unesiv vihav yat sahaduta laarona veshavvi yat arichayya al arona vihav yat kappurta al arona milella:
Vayyave et-haaron el-hammishkan vayyasem et parochet hammasach vayyasech al aron haedut kaasher tzivva Adonai et-moshe
Veael yat arona lemashkena veshavvi yat paruchta difrasa veattel al arona desahaduta kema di pakkid Adonai yat mshe:
Vayyitten et-hashshulchan beohel moed al yerech hammishkan tzafona michutz lapparochet
Vihav yat patora bemashkan zimna al tzidda demashkena tzippuna mibbara lefaruchta:
Vayyaaroch alav erech lechem lifne Adonai kaasher tzivva Adonai et-moshe
Vesaddar alohi siddur dilchem kodam Adonai kema di pakkid Adonai yat mshe:
Vayyasem et-hammenora beohel moed nochach hashshulchan al yerech hammishkan negba
Veshavvi yat menarta bemashkan zimna lokovel patora al tzidda demashkena ledaroma:
Vayyaal hannerot lifne Adonai kaasher tzivva Adonai et-moshe
Veadlek botzinaha kodam Adonai kema di pakkid Adonai yat mshe:
Vayyasem et-mizbach hazzahav beohel moed lifne happarochet
Veshavvi yat madbecha dedahava bemashkan zimna kodam paruchta:
Vayyakter alav ketoret sammim kaasher tzivva Adonai et-moshe
Veaktar alohi ketoret busemin kema di pakkid Adonai yat mshe:
Vayyasem et-masach happetach lammishkan
Veshavvi yat perasa detara lemashkena:
Veet mizbach haola sam petach mishkan ohel-moed vayyaal alav et-haola veet-hammincha kaasher tzivva Adonai et-moshe
Veyat madbecha daalata shavvi bitra mashkena mashkan zimna veassek alohi yat alata veyat minchata kema di pakkid Adonai yat mshe:
Vayyasem et-hakkiyyor ben-ohel moed uven hammizbeach vayyitten shamma mayim lerochtza
Veshavvi yat kiyora ben mashkan zimna uven madbecha vihav tamman mayya lekiddush:
Verachatzu mimmennu moshe veaharon uvanav et-yedehem veet-raglehem
Vikaddeshun minneh mshe veaharon uvenohi yat yedehon veyat raglehon:
Bevoam el-ohel moed uvekorvatam el-hammizbeach yirchatzu kaasher tzivva Adonai et-moshe
Bemealhon lemashkan zimna uvemikravhon lemadbecha yekaddeshun kema di pakkid Adonai yat mshe:
Vayyakem et-hechatzer saviv lammishkan velammizbeach vayyitten et-masach shaar hechatzer vaychal moshe et-hammelacha
Vaakem yat darta sechor sechor lemashkena ulemadbecha vihav yat perasa ditra darta veshetze mshe yat ivida:
Vaychas heanan et-ohel moed uchevod Adonai male et-hammishkan
Vachafa anana yat mashkan zimna vikara daAdonai itmeli yat mashkena:
Velo-yachol moshe lavo el-ohel moed ki-shachan alav heanan uchevod Adonai male et-hammishkan
Vela yachil mshe lemeal lemashkan zimna are shera alohi anana vikara daAdonai itmeli yat mashkena:
Uvehealot heanan meal hammishkan yisu bene yisrael bechol masehem
Uveistallakut anana meillave mashkena natlin bene yisrael bechol mattelanehon:
Veim-lo yeale heanan velo yisu ad-yom healoto
Veim la yistallak anana vela natlin ad yoma deistallakuteh:
Ki anan Adonai al-hammishkan yomam veesh tihye layla bo leene chol-bet-yisrael bechol-masehem
Are anana yekara daAdonai al mashkena bimama vechezu eshshata have velelya beh leene chol bet yisrael bechol mattelanehon:
Leviticus: Vayyikra el-moshe vaydabber Adonai elav meohel moed lemor
Ukera lemshe umallel Adonai immeh mimmashkan zimna lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael veamarta alehem adam ki-yakriv mikkem korban la-Adonai min-habbehema min-habbakar umin-hatztzon takrivu et-korbanchem
Mallel im bene yisrael vetemar lehon enash are yekarev minnechon kurbana kodam Adonai min beira min tore umin ana tekarvun yat kurbanchon:
Im-ola korbano min-habbakar zachar tamim yakrivennu el-petach ohel moed yakriv oto lirtzono lifne Adonai
Im alata kurbaneh min tore dechar shelim yekarvinneh litra mashkan zimna yekarev yateh leraava leh kodam Adonai:
Vesamach yado al rosh haola venirtza lo lechapper alav
Veyismoch yedeh al resh alata veyitree leh lechappara alohi:
Veshachat et-ben habbakar lifne Adonai vehikrivu bene aharon hakkohanim et-haddam vezarku et-haddam al-hammizbeach saviv asher-petach ohel moed
Veyikkos yat bar tore kodam Adonai vikarvun bene aharon kahanayya yat dema veyizrekun yat dema al madbecha sechor sechor di vitra mashkan zimna:
Vehifshit et-haola venittach otah lintacheha
Veyashlach yat alata vifalleg yata leevraha:
Venatnu bene aharon hakkohen esh al-hammizbeach vearchu etzim al-haesh
Veyittenun bene aharon kahana eshshata al madbecha visadderun aayya al eshshata:
Vearchu bene aharon hakkohanim et hannetachim et-harosh veet-happader al-haetzim asher al-haesh asher al-hammizbeach
Visadderun bene aharon kahanayya yat evrayya yat resha veyat tarba al aayya di al eshata di al madbecha:
Vekirbo ucheraav yirchatz bammayim vehiktir hakkohen et-hakkol hammizbecha ola ishshe reach-nichoach la-Adonai
Vegaveh ucheraohi yechallel bemayya veyassek kahana yat kola lemadbecha alata kurban demitkabbel beraava kodam Adonai:
Veim-min-hatztzon korbano min-hakkesavim o min-haizzim leola zachar tamim yakrivennu
Veim min ana kurbaneh min immerayya o min bene izayya laalata dechar shelim yekarvineh:
Veshachat oto al yerech hammizbeach tzafona lifne Adonai vezarku bene aharon hakkohanim et-damo al-hammizbeach saviv
Veyikkos yateh al tzidda demadbecha tzippuna kodam Adonai veyizrekun bene aharon kahanayya yat demeh al madbecha sechor sechor:
Venittach oto lintachav veet-rosho veet-pidro vearach hakkohen otam al-haetzim asher al-haesh asher al-hammizbeach
Vifalleg yateh leevarohi veyat resheh veyat tarbeh veyasdar kahana yathon al aayya di al eshshata di al madbecha:
Vehakkerev vehakkeraayim yirchatz bammayim vehikriv hakkohen et-hakkol vehiktir hammizbecha ola hu ishshe reach nichoach la-Adonai
Vegavva ucheraayya yechallel bemayya vikarev kahana yat kola veyassek lemadbecha alata hu kurban demitkabbel beraava kodam Adonai:
Veim min-haof ola korbano la-Adonai vehikriv min-hattorim o min-bene hayyona et-korbano
Veim min ofa alata kurbaneh kodam Adonai vikarev min shafninayya o min bene yona yat kurbaneh:
Vehikrivo hakkohen el-hammizbeach umalak et-rosho vehiktir hammizbecha venimtza damo al kir hammizbeach
Vikarvineh kahana lemadbecha veyimlok yat resheh veyassek lemadbecha veyittimtze demeh al kotel madbecha:
Vehesir et-murato benotzatah vehishlich otah etzel hammizbeach kedma el-mekom haddashen
Veyaadde yat zefakeh beucheleh veyirme yata listar madbecha kiduma laatar demoshdin kitma:
Veshissa oto vichnafav lo yavdil vehiktir oto hakkohen hammizbecha al-haetzim asher al-haesh ola hu ishshe reach nichoach la-Adonai
Vifarek yateh begadfohi la yafresh veyassek yateh kahana lemadbecha al aayya di al eshshata alata hu kurban demitkabbel beraava kodam Adonai:
Venefesh ki-takriv korban mincha la-Adonai solet yihye korbano veyatzak aleha shemen venatan aleha levona
Veenash are yekarev kurban minchata kodam Adonai suleta yehe kurbaneh virik alah mishcha veyitten alah levonta:
Veheviah el-bene aharon hakkohanim vekamatz mishsham melo kumtzo missoltah umishshamnah al kol-levonatah vehiktir hakkohen et-azkaratah hammizbecha ishshe reach nichoach la-Adonai
Veyaytinnah levat bene aharon kahanayya veyikmotz mittamman mele kumtzeh missulta umimmishcha al kol levontah veyassek kahana yat adkartah lemadbecha kurban demitkabbel beraava kodam Adonai:
Vehannoteret min-hammincha leaharon ulevanav kodesh kodashim meishshe Adonai
Udeishtaar min minchata leaharon velivnohi kodesh kudeshin mikkurbanayya daAdonai:
Vechi takriv korban mincha maafe tannur solet challot matztzot belulot bashshemen urekike matztzot meshuchim bashshamen
Vaare tekarev kurban minchata maafe tannura suleta geritzan pattiran defilan bimshach veaspogin pattirin dimshichin bimshach:
Veim-mincha al-hammachavat korbanecha solet belula vashshemen matztza tihye
Veim minchata al masreta kurbanach suleta defila vimshach pattir tehe:
Patot otah pittim veyatzakta aleha shamen mincha hiv
Betza yatah bitzuin uterik alah mishcha minchata hi:
Veim-minchat marcheshet korbanecha solet bashshemen tease
Veim minchata deradta kurbanach suleta vimshach titaved:
Veheveta et-hammincha asher yease meelle la-Adonai vehikrivah el-hakkohen vehiggishah el-hammizbeach
Vetayte yat minchata di yitaved meillen kodam Adonai vikarvina levat kahana vikarvinna lemadbecha:
Veherim hakkohen min-hammincha et-azkaratah vehiktir hammizbecha ishshe reach nichoach la-Adonai
Veyafresh kahana min minchata yat adkarta veyassek lemadbecha kurban demitkabbel beraava kodam Adonai:
Vehannoteret min-hammincha leaharon ulevanav kodesh kodashim meishshe Adonai
Udeishtaar min minchata leaharon velivnohi kodesh kudeshin mikkurbanayya daAdonai:
Kol-hammincha asher takrivu la-Adonai lo tease chametz ki chol-seor vechol-devash lo-taktiru mimmennu ishshe la-Adonai
Kol minchata di tekarvun kodam Adonai la titaved chamia are chol chamir vechol devash la tassekun minneh kurbana kodam Adonai:
Korban reshit takrivu otam la-Adonai veel-hammizbeach lo-yaalu lereach nichoach
Kurban kadmay tekarvun yathon kodam Adonai ulemadbecha la yittassekun leitkabbala veraava:
Vechol-korban minchatcha bammelach timlach velo tashbit melach berit elohecha meal minchatecha al kol-korbancha takriv melach
Vechol kurban minchatach bemilcha timlach vela tevattel melach keyam elahach meal minchatach al kol kurbanach tekarev milcha:
Veim-takriv minchat bikkurim la-Adonai aviv kaluy baesh geres karmel takriv et minchat bikkurecha
Veim tekarev minchat bikkurin kodam Adonai aviv kele venur perochan rakkichan tekarev yat minchat bikkurach:
Venatatta aleha shemen vesamta aleha levona mincha hiv
Vetitten ala mishcha uteshavve ala levonta minchata hi:
Vehiktir hakkohen et-azkaratah miggirsah umishshamnah al kol-levonatah ishshe la-Adonai
Veyassek kahana yat idkarta mipperucha umimmishcha al kol levontah kurbana kodam Adonai:
Veim-zevach shelamim korbano im min-habbakar hu makriv im-zachar im-nekeva tamim yakrivennu lifne Adonai
Veim nichsat kudeshayya kurbaneh im min tore hu mekarev im dechar im nukeva shelim yekarvineh kodam Adonai:

Veyismoch yedeh al resh kurbaneh veyikkesinneh bitra mashkan zimna veyizrekun bene aharon kahanayya yat dema al madbecha sechor sechor:

Vikarev minnichsat kudeshayya kurbana kodam Adonai yat tarba dechafe yat gavva veyat kol tarba di al gavva:

Veyaskun yateh bene aharon lemadbecha al alata di al aayya di al eshshata kurban demitkabbel beraava kodam Adonai:

Veim min ana kurbaneh lenichsat kudeshayya kodam Adonai dechar o nukba shelim yekarvinneh:
Im-kesev hu-makriv et-korbano vehikriv oto lifne Adonai
Im imar hu mekarev yat kurbaneh vikarev yateh kodam Adonai:

Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:

Mallel im bene yisrael lememar enash are yechov beshalu mikkol pikkudayya daAdonai di la chashrin leitavada veyabed min chad minnehon:

Im kahana rabba yechov lechovat amma vikarev al chovteh di chav tor bar tore shelim kodam Adonai lechattata:

Veyismechun save chenishta yat yedehon al resh tora kodam Adonai veyikkos yat tora kodam Adonai:

Veyael kahana rabba min dema detora lemashkan zimna:

Veyappek yat tora lemibbara lemashrita veokid yateh kema di okid yat tora kadmaa chattat kehala hu:

Veim-keves yavi korbano lechattat nekeva temima yevienna

Veyismoch yat yedeh al resh chattata veyikkos yata lechattata beatra di yikkos yat alata:

Veyissav kahana middema dechattata beetzbeeh veyitten al karnat madbecha daalata veyat kol dema yeshod lisoda demadbecha:

Veyat kol tarba yede kema di mittada terav immera minnichsat kudeshayya veyassek kahana yathon lemadbecha al kurbenayya daAdonai vichapper alohi kahana al chovteh di chav veyishtevek leh:
Venefesh ki-techeta veshama kol ala vehu ed o raa o yada im-lo yaggid venasa avono
Veenash are yechov veyishma kal mome vehu sahid o chaza o yeda im la yechavvi vikabbel choveh:
O nefesh asher tigga bechol-davar tame o venivlat chayya temea o benivlat behema temea o benivlat sheretz tame venelam mimmennu vehu tame veashem
O enash di yikrav bechol middaam mesaav o venivlat chayta mesaava o benivlat beira mesaava o benivlat richasha mesaav vihe mechassa minneh vehu mesaav vechav:

O are yikrav besoavat enasha lechol sovteh di yistaav ba vihe mechassa minneh vehu yada vechav:

Vehaya chi-yesham leachat meelle vehitvadda asher chata aleha
Vihe are yechov lachada meillen vivaddi di chav ala:

Nefesh ki techeta umaala maal ba-Adonai vechichesh baamito befikkadon o-vitsumet yad o vegazel o ashak et-amito
Enash are yechov vishakkar shekar kodam Adonai vichadev bechavreh bfikkedona o veshuttafut yeda o vigzela o annis yat chavreh:
O-matza aveda vechichesh bah venishba al-shaker al-achat mikkol asher-yaase haadam lachato vahenna
O ashkach avedta vichaddev ba veishteva al shikra al chada mikkol di yabed enasha lemechav behen:
Vehaya ki-yecheta veashem veheshiv et-haggezela asher gazal o et-haoshek asher ashak o et-happikkadon asher hofkad itto o et-haaveda asher matza
Vihe are yechete veyechov veyatev yat gezela di gezal o yat ushka di ashak o yat pikkedona di itpakkad levateh o yat avedta di ashkach:
O mikkol asher-yishshava alav lashsheker veshillam oto berosho vachamishitav yosef alav laasher hu lo yittenennu beyom ashmato
O mikkol di yishteva alohi leshikra vishallem yateh beresheh vechumsheh yosef alohi ledi hu dileh yitteninneh beyoma dechovteh:
Veet-ashamo yavi la-Adonai ayil tamim min-hatztzon beerkecha leasham el-hakkohen
Veyat ashma yayti lokodam Adonai dechar shelim min ana befursaneh laashama levat kahana:
Vechipper alav hakkohen lifne Adonai venislach lo al-achat mikkol asher-yaase leashma vah
Vichapper alohi chahana kodam Adonai veyishtevek leh al chada mikkol di yabed lemechav ba:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Tzav et-aharon veet-banav lemor zot torat haola hiv haola al mokda al-hammizbeach kol-hallayla ad-habboker veesh hammizbeach tukad bo
Pakked yat aharon veyat benohi lememar da orayta daalata hi alata al demittokda al madbecha chol lelya ad tzafra veeshshata demadbecha tehe yakda veh:
Velavash hakkohen middo vad umichnese-vad yilbash al-besaro veherim et-haddeshen asher tochal haesh et-haola al-hammizbeach vesamo etzel hammizbeach
Veyalbesh kahana levushin devutz umichnesin devutz yalbesh al bisreh veyafresh yat kitma di techul eshshata yat alata al madbecha vishavvinneh bistar madbecha:
Ufashat et-begadav velavash begadim acherim vehotzi et-haddeshen el-michutz lammachane el-makom tahor
Veyashlach yat levushohi veyilbash levushin ochoranin veyappek yat kitma lemibbara lemashrita laatar deche:
Vehaesh al-hammizbeach tukad-bo lo tichbe uvier aleha hakkohen etzim babboker babboker vearach aleha haola vehiktir aleha chelve hashshelamim
Veeshshata al madbecha tehe yakda veh la tittefe veyavar ala kahana aayya bitzfar bitzfar veyasdar alla alata veyassek ala tarbe nichsat kudeshayya:
Esh tamid tukad al-hammizbeach lo tichbe
Eshshata tedira tehe yakda al madbecha la tittefe:
Vezot torat hammincha hakrev otah bene-aharon lifne Adonai el-pene hammizbeach
Veda orayta deminchata dikarvun yata bene aharon kodam Adonai lokodam madbecha:
Veherim mimmennu bekumtzo missolet hammincha umishshamnah veet kol-hallevona asher al-hammincha vehiktir hammizbeach reach nichoach azkaratah la-Adonai
Veyafresh minneh bekumtzeh missulta deminchata umimmishcha veyat kol levuneta di al minchata veyassek lemadbecha leitkabbala veraava adkarta kodam Adonai:
Vehannoteret mimmenna yochlu aharon uvanav matztzot teachel bemakom kadosh bachatzar ohel-moed yochluha
Udeishtaar minna yechlun aharon uvenohi pattir titachel baatar kaddish bedarat mishkan zimna yechlunna:
Lo teafe chametz chelkam natatti otah meishshay kodesh kodashim hiv kachattat vechaasham
La titafe chamia cholakhon yehavit yata mikkurbanay kodesh kudeshin hi kechattata vechaashama:
Kol-zachar bivne aharon yochlenna chok-olam ledorotechem meishshe Adonai kol asher-yigga bahem yikdash
Kol dechura bivne aharon yechlunna keyam alam ledaratechon mikkurbanayya daAdonai kol deyikrav behon yitkaddash:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Ze korban aharon uvanav asher-yakrivu la-Adonai beyom himmashach oto asirit haefa solet mincha tamid machatzitah babboker umachatzitah baarev
Den kurban aharon uvenohi di yekarvun kodam Adonai beyoma derabbiu yateh chad min asra vitlat sein sulta minchata tedira palguta betzafra ufalguta beramsha:
Al-machavat bashshemen tease murbechet tevienna tufine minchat pittim takriv reach-nichoach la-Adonai
Al masreta bimshach titaved revicha taytinna tufine minchat bitztzuin tekarev leitkabbala veraava kodam Adonai:
Vehakkohen hammashiach tachtav mibbanav yaase otah chok-olam la-Adonai kalil toktar
Vechahana dimrabba techotohi mibbenohi yabed yata keyam alam kodam Adonai gemir tittassak:
Vechol-minchat kohen kalil tihye lo teachel
Vechol minchata dechahana gemir tehe la titachel:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Dabber el-aharon veel-banav lemor zot torat hachattat bimkom asher tishshachet haola tishshachet hachattat lifne Adonai kodesh kodashim hiv
Mallel im aharon veim benohi lememar da orayta dechattata beatar di titneches alata titneches chattata kodam Adonai kodesh kudeshin hi:
Hakkohen hamechatte otah yochlenna bemakom kadosh teachel bachatzar ohel moed
Kahana dimchapper bidma yechlinna baatar kaddish titachel bedarat mashkan zimna:
Kol asher-yigga bivsarah yikdash vaasher yizze middamah al-habbeged asher yizze aleha techabbes bemakom kadosh
Kol di yikrav bevisra yitkaddash vedi yaddi middema al levush di yaddi ala titchavvar baatar kaddish:
Ucheli-cheres asher tevushshal-bo yishshaver veim-bichli nechoshet bushshala umorak veshuttaf bammayim
Uman dachasaf di titbashshel beh yittavar veim bemana dinchasha titbashshel veyitmerek veyishtattef bemayya:
Kol-zachar bakkohanim yochal otah kodesh kodashim hiv
Kol dechura vechahanayya yechul yata kodesh kudeshin hi:
Vechol-chattat asher yuva middamah el-ohel moed lechapper bakkodesh lo teachel baesh tissaref
Vechol chattata di yittaal middema lemashkan zimna lechappara vekudesha la titachel benura tittokad:
Vezot torat haasham kodesh kodashim hu
Veda orayta daashama kodesh kudeshin hu:
Bimkom asher yishchatu et-haola yishchatu et-haasham veet-damo yizrok al-hammizbeach saviv
Veatra di yikkesun yat alata yikkesun yat ashama veyat demeh yizrak al madbecha sechor sechor:
Veet kol-chelbo yakriv mimmennu et haalya veet-hachelev hamechasse et-hakkerev
Veyat kol tarbeh yafresh minneh yat alita veyat tarba dechafe yat gavva:
Veet shete hakkelayot veet-hachelev asher alehen asher al-hakkesalim veet-hayyoteret al-hakkaved al-hakkelayot yesirenna
Veyat tarten kalyan veyat tarba di alehen di al gissayya veyat chitzra deal kavda al kalyeta yedinna:
Vehiktir otam hakkohen hammizbecha ishshe la-Adonai asham hu
Veyassek yathon kahana lemadbecha kurbana kodam Adonai ashama hu:
Kol-zachar bakkohanim yochlennu bemakom kadosh yeachel kodesh kodashim hu
Kol dechura vechahanayya yechlinneh baatar kaddish yitachal kodesh kudeshin hu:
Kachattat kaasham tora achat lahem hakkohen asher yechapper-bo lo yihye
Kechattata kaashama orayta chada lehon kahana di yechapper beh dileh yehe:
Vehakkohen hammakriv et-olat ish or haola asher hikriv lakkohen lo yihye
Vechahana dimkarev yat alat gevar meshach alata di yekarev lechahana dileh yehe:
Vechol-mincha asher teafe battannur vechol-naasa vammarcheshet veal-machavat lakkohen hammakriv otah lo tihye
Vechol minchata di titafe betannura vechol detitaved beridta veal masreta lechahana dimkarev yata dileh tehe:
Vechol-mincha velula-vashshemen vachareva lechol-bene aharon tihye ish keachiv
Vechol minchata defila vimshach udela fila lechol bene aharon tehe gevar keachohi:
Vezot torat zevach hashshelamim asher yakriv la-Adonai
Veda orayta denichsat kudeshayya di yekarev kodam Adonai:
Im al-toda yakrivennu vehikriv al-zevach hattoda challot matztzot belulot bashshemen urekike matztzot meshuchim bashshamen vesolet murbechet challot belulot bashshamen
Im al todta yekarvinneh vikarev al nichsat todta geritzan pattiran defilan bimshach veespogin pattirin dimshichin bimshach vesulta revicha geritzan defilan bimshach:
Al-challot lechem chametz yakriv korbano al-zevach todat shelamav
Al geritzan dilchem chamia yekarev kurbaneh al nichsat todat kudeshohi:
Vehikriv mimmennu echad mikkol-korban teruma la-Adonai lakkohen hazzorek et-dam hashshelamim lo yihye
Vikarev minneh chad mikkol kureban afrashuta kodam Adonai lechahana dizrak yat dam nichsat kudeshayya dileh yehe:
Uvesar zevach todat shelamav beyom korbano yeachel lo-yanniach mimmennu ad-boker
Uvesar nichsat todat kudeshohi beyom kurbaneh yitachel la yatzna minneh ad tzafra:
Veim-neder o nedava zevach korbano beyom hakrivo et-zivcho yeachel umimmochorat vehannotar mimmennu yeachel
Veim nidra o nedavta nichsat kurbeneh beyoma di yekarev yat nichseteh yitachel uveyoma devatrohi udeishtaar minneh yitachel:
Vehannotar mibbesar hazzavach bayyom hashshelishi baesh yissaref
Udeishtaar mibbesar nichseta beyoma telitaa benura yittokad:
Veim heachol yeachel mibbesar-zevach shelamav bayyom hashshelishi lo yeratze hammakriv oto lo yechashev lo piggul yihye vehannefesh haochelet mimmennu avonah tissa
Veim itachala yitachel mibbesar nichsat kudeshohi beyoma telitaa la yehe leraava dimkarev yateh la yitchashev leh merachak yehe veenash detechul minneh choveh yekabbel:
Vehabbasar asher-yigga bechol-tame lo yeachel baesh yissaref vehabbasar kol-tahor yochal basar
Uvesar kudesha di yikrav bechol mesaav la yitachel benura yittokad uvesar kudesha kol di deche lekudesha yechul besar kudesha:
Vehannefesh asher-tochal basar mizzevach hashshelamim asher la-Adonai vetumato alav venichreta hannefesh hahiv meammeha
Veenash di techul bisra minnichsat kudeshayya di kodam Adonai vesovteh alohi veyishtetze enasha hahi meamma:
Venefesh ki-tigga bechol-tame betumat adam o bivhema temea o bechol-sheketz tame veachal mibbesar-zevach hashshelamim asher la-Adonai venichreta hannefesh hahiv meammeha
Veenash are tikrav bechol mesaav besoavat enasha o bivira mesaava o bechol shiktza mesaav veyechul mibbesar nichsat kudeshayya di kodam Adonai vishtetze enasha hahi meamma:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael lemor kol-chelev shor vechesev vaez lo tochelu
Mallel im bene yisrael lememar kol terav tor veimmar veizza la techlun:
Vechelev nevela vechelev terefa yease lechol-melacha veachol lo tochluhu
Uterav nevila uterav tevira yitaved lechol ividta umechal la techlunneh:
Ki kol-ochel chelev min-habbehema asher yakriv mimmenna ishshe la-Adonai venichreta hannefesh haochelet meammeha
Are kol deyechul tarba min beira di yekarvun minna kurbana kodam Adonai veyishtetze enasha di techul meamma:
Vechol-dam lo tochlu bechol moshvotechem laof velabbehema
Vechol dema la techlun bechol motvanechon deofa vedivira:
Kol-nefesh asher-tochal kol-dam venichreta hannefesh hahiv meammeha
Kol enasha di techul kol dema veyishtetze enasha hahi meamma:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael lemor hammakriv et-zevach shelamav la-Adonai yavi et-korbano la-Adonai mizzevach shelamav
Mallel im bene yisrael lememar dimkarev yat nichsat kudeshohi kodam Adonai yayti yat kurbaneh lokodam Adonai minnichsat kudeshohi:
Yadav teviena et ishshe Adonai et-hachelev al-hechaze yeviennu et hechaze lehanif oto tenufa lifne Adonai
Yedohi taytun yat kurbanayya daAdonai yat tarba al chedya yaytinneh yat chedya laarama yateh aruma kodam Adonai:
Vehiktir hakkohen et-hachelev hammizbecha vehaya hechaze leaharon ulevanav
Veyassek kahana yat tarba lemadbecha vihe chedya leaharon velivnohi:
Veet shok hayyamin tittenu teruma lakkohen mizzivche shalmechem
Veyat shoka deyammina tittenun afrashuta lechahana minnichsat kudeshechon:
Hammakriv et-dam hashshelamim veet-hachelev mibbene aharon lo tihye shok hayyamin lemana
Dimkarev yat dam nichsat kudeshayya veyat tarba mibbene aharon dileh tehe shoka deyammina locholak:
Ki et-chaze hattenufa veet shok hatteruma lakachti meet bene-yisrael mizzivche shalmehem vaetten otam leaharon hakkohen ulevanav lechok-olam meet bene yisrael
Are yat chedya daaramuta veyat shoka deafrashuta nesevit min bene yisrael minnichsat kudeshehon vihavit yathon leaharon kahana velivnohi likyam alam min bene yisrael:
Zot mishchat aharon umishchat banav meishshe Adonai beyom hikriv otam lechahen la-Adonai
Da revut aharon urevut benohi mikkurbanayya daAdonai beyoma diykarvun yathon leshammasha kodam Adonai:
Asher tzivva Adonai latet lahem beyom moshcho otam meet bene yisrael chukkat olam ledorotam
Di pakkid Adonai lemittan lehon beyoma derabbi yathon min bene yisrael keyam alam ledarehon:
Zot hattora laola lammincha velachattat velaasham velammilluim ulezevach hashshelamim
Da orayta laalata leminchata ulechattata velaashama ulekurbanayya ulenichsat kudeshayya:
Asher tzivva Adonai et-moshe behar sinay beyom tzavvoto et-bene yisrael lehakriv et-korbenehem la-Adonai bemidbar sinay
Di fakkid Adonai yat mshe betura desinay beyoma difakkedeh yat bene yisrael lekarava yat kurbanhon kodam Adonai bemadbera desinay:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Kach et-aharon veet-banav itto veet habbegadim veet shemen hammishcha veet par hachattat veet shene haelim veet sal hammatztzot
Karev yat aharon veyat benohi immeh veyat levushayya veyat mishcha dirvuta veyat tora dechattata veyat teren dichrin veyat salla defattirayya:
Veet kol-haeda hakhel el-petach ohel moed
Veyat kol kenishta kenesh litra mashkan zimna:
Vayyaas moshe kaasher tzivva Adonai oto vattikkahel haeda el-petach ohel moed
Vaavad mshe kema di pakkid Adonai yateh veitkenishat kenishta litra mashkan zimna:
Vayyomer moshe el-haeda ze haddavar asher-tzivva Adonai laasot
Vaamar mshe lichnishta den pitgama di fakkid Adonai lemebad:
Vayyakrev moshe et-aharon veet-banav vayyirchatz otam bammayim
Vekariv mshe yat aharon veyat benohi veasche yathon bemayya:
Vayyitten alav et-hakkuttonet vayyachgor oto baavnet vayyalbesh oto et-hammeil vayyitten alav et-haefod vayyachgor oto becheshev haefod vayyepod lo bo
Vihav alohi yat kittuna vezarez yateh behemyana vealbesh yateh yat meila vihav alohi yat efoda vezarez yateh behemyan efoda veatken leh beh:
Vayyasem alav et-hachoshen vayyitten el-hachoshen et-haurim veet-hattummim
Veshavvi alohi yat chushena vihav bechushena yat urayya veyat tumayya:
Vayyasem et-hammitznefet al-rosho vayyasem al-hammitznefet el-mul panav et tzitz hazzahav nezer hakkodesh kaasher tzivva Adonai et-moshe
Veshavvi yat mitznefta al resheh veshavvi al mitznefta lokovel appohi yat tzitza dedahava kelila dekudesha kema di fakkid Adonai yat mshe:
Vayyikkach moshe et-shemen hammishcha vayyimshach et-hammishkan veet-kol-asher-bo vaykaddesh otam
Unesiv mshe yat mishcha dirvuta verabbi yat mashkena veyat kol di veh vekaddish yathon:
Vayyaz mimmennu al-hammizbeach sheva peamim vayyimshach et-hammizbeach veet-kol-kelav veet-hakkiyyor veet-kanno lekaddesham
Veaddi minneh al madbecha sheva zimnin verabbi yat madbecha veyat kol manohi veyat kiyyora veyat besiseh lekaddashutehon:
Vayyitzok mishshemen hammishcha al rosh aharon vayyimshach oto lekaddesho
Vaarik mimmishcha dirvuta al resha deaharon verabbi yateh lekaddashuteh:
Vayyakrev moshe et-bene aharon vayyalbishem kuttonot vayyachgor otam avnet vayyachavosh lahem migbaot kaasher tzivva Adonai et-moshe
Vekariv mshe yat bene aharon vealbeshinnun kittunin vezarez yathon hemyanin veatken lehon kovain kema di fakkid Adonai yat mshe:
Vayyaggesh et par hachattat vayyismoch aharon uvanav et-yedehem al-rosh par hachattat
Vekarev yat tora dechattata usemach aharon uvenohi yat yedehon al resh tora dechattata:
Vayyishchat vayyikkach moshe et-haddam vayyitten al-karnot hammizbeach saviv beetzbao vaychatte et-hammizbeach veet-haddam yatzak el-yesod hammizbeach vaykaddeshehu lechapper alav
Uneches unesiv mshe yat dema vihav al karnat madbecha sechor sechor beetzbeeh vedakki yat madbecha veyat dema arik lisoda demadbecha vekaddesheh lechappara alohi:
Vayyikkach et-kol-hachelev asher al-hakkerev veet yoteret hakkaved veet-shete hakkelayot veet-chelbehen vayyakter moshe hammizbecha
Unesiv yat kol tarba di al gavva veyat chatzar kavda veyat tarten kalyan veyat tarbehen veassek mshe lemadbecha:
Veet-happar veet-oro veet-besaro veet-pirsho saraf baesh michutz lammachane kaasher tzivva Adonai et-moshe
Veyat tora veyat mashkeh veyat bisreh veyat ochleh okid benura mibbara lemashrita kema di fakkid Adonai yat mshe:
Vayyakrev et el haola vayyismechu aharon uvanav et-yedehem al-rosh haayil
Vekariv yat dichra daalata usemachu aharon uvenohi yat yedehon al resh dichra:
Vayyishchat vayyizrok moshe et-haddam al-hammizbeach saviv
Uneches uzerak mshe yat dema al madbecha sechor sechor:
Veet-haayil nittach lintachav vayyakter moshe et-harosh veet-hannetachim veet-happader
Veyat dichra palleg leevrohi veassek mshe yat resha veyat evarayya veyat tarba:
Veet-hakkerev veet-hakkeraayim rachatz bammayim vayyakter moshe et-kol-haayil hammizbecha ola hu lereach-nichoach ishshe hu la-Adonai kaasher tzivva Adonai et-moshe
Veyat gavva veyat keraayya challil bemayya veassek mshe yat kol dichra lemadbecha alata hu leitkabbala veraava kurbana hu kodam Adonai kema di fakkid Adonai yat mshe:
Vayyakrev et-haayil hashsheni el hammilluim vayyismechu aharon uvanav et-yedehem al-rosh haayil
Vekariv yat dichra tinyana dechar kurbanayya usemachu aharon uvenohi yat yedehon al resh dichra:
Vayyishchat vayyikkach moshe middamo vayyitten al-tenuch ozen-aharon hayemanit veal-bohen yado hayemanit veal-bohen raglo hayemanit
Uneches unesiv mshe min dema vihav al rum udena deaharon deyammina veal ilyon yedeh deyammina veal ilyon ragleh deyammina:
Vayyakrev et-bene aharon vayyitten moshe min-haddam al-tenuch oznam hayemanit veal-bohen yadam hayemanit veal-bohen raglam hayemanit vayyizrok moshe et-haddam al-hammizbeach saviv
Vekariv yat bene aharon vihav mshe min dema al rum udenehon deyammina veal ilyon yedehon deyammina veal ilyon raglehon deyammina uzerak mshe yat dema al madbecha sechor sechor:
Vayyikkach et-hachelev veet-haalya veet-kol-hachelev asher al-hakkerev veet yoteret hakkaved veet-shete hakkelayot veet-chelbehen veet shok hayyamin
Unesiv yat tarba veyat alita veyat kol tarba di al gavva veyat chatzar kavda veyat tarten kalyan veyat tarbehen veyat shoka deyammina:
Umissal hammatztzot asher lifne Adonai lakach challat matztza achat vechallat lechem shemen achat verakik echad vayyasem al-hachalavim veal shok hayyamin
Umissalla defattirayya di kodam Adonai nesiv geritzta fattira chada ugeritzta dilchem meshach chada veespog chad veshavvi al tarbayya veal shoka deyammina:
Vayyitten et-hakkol al kappe aharon veal kappe vanav vayyanef otam tenufa lifne Adonai
Vihav yat kolla al yede aharon veal yede venohi vaarem yathon arama kodam Adonai:
Vayyikkach moshe otam meal kappehem vayyakter hammizbecha al-haola milluim hem lereach nichoach ishshe hu la-Adonai
Unesiv mshe yathon meal yedehon veassek lemadbecha al alata kurbanayya innun leitkabbala veraava kurbana hu kodam Adonai:
Vayyikkach moshe et-hechaze vaynifehu tenufa lifne Adonai meel hammilluim lemoshe haya lemana kaasher tzivva Adonai et-moshe
Unesiv mshe yat chedya vaarimeh arama kodam Adonai middechar kurbanayya lemshe hava locholak kema di fakkid Adonai yat mshe:
Vayyikkach moshe mishshemen hammishcha umin-haddam asher al-hammizbeach vayyaz al-aharon al-begadav veal-banav veal-bigde vanav itto vaykaddesh et-aharon et-begadav veet-banav veet-bigde vanav itto
Unesiv mshe mimmishcha dirvuta umin dema di al madbecha veaddi al aharon al levushohi veal benohi veal levushe venohi immeh vekaddish yat aharon yat levushohi veyat benohi veyat levushe venohi immeh:
Vayyomer moshe el-aharon veel-banav bashshelu et-habbasar petach ohel moed vesham tochlu oto veet-hallechem asher besal hammilluim kaasher tzivveti lemor aharon uvanav yochluhu
Vaamar mshe leaharon velivnohi bashshilu yat bisra bitra mashkan zimna vetamman techlun yateh veyat lachma di besal kurbanayya kema di fakkedit lememar aharon uvenohi yechlunneh:
Vehannotar babbasar uvallachem baesh tisrofu
Udeishtaar bevisra uvelachma benura tokdun:
Umippetach ohel moed lo tetzu shivat yamim ad yom melot yeme milluechem ki shivat yamim yemalle et-yedchem
Umittera mashkan zimna la tippekun shiva yomin ad yom mishlam yome kurbanechon are shiva yomin yekarev yat kurbanchon:
Kaasher asa bayyom hazze tzivva Adonai laasot lechapper alechem
Kema di avad beyoma haden pakkid Adonai lemebad lechappara alechon:
Ufetach ohel moed teshvu yomam valayla shivat yamim ushemartem et-mishmeret Adonai velo tamutu ki-chen tzuvveti
Uvitra mashkan zimna tetvun yemam velele shiva yomin vetitterun yat matterat memra daAdonai vela temutun are chen itpakkadit:
Vayyaas aharon uvanav et kol-haddevarim asher-tzivva Adonai beyad-moshe
Vaavad aharon uvenohi yat kol pitgamayya di fakkid Adonai bida demshe:
Vayhi bayyom hashshemini kara moshe leaharon ulevanav ulezikne yisrael
Vahava beyoma teminaa kera mshe leaharon velivnohi ulesave yisrael:
Vayyomer el-aharon kach-lecha egel ben-bakar lechattat veayil leola temimim vehakrev lifne Adonai
Vaamar leaharon sav lach egal bar tore lechattata udechar laalata shalmin vekarev kodam Adonai:
Veel-bene yisrael tedabber lemor kechu seir-izzim lechattat veegel vacheves bene-shana temimim leola
Veim bene yisrael temallel lememar sivu tzefir bar izzin lechattata veegal veimmar bene shena shalmin laalata:
Veshor vaayil lishlamim lizboach lifne Adonai umincha belula vashshamen ki hayyom Adonai nira alechem
Vetor udechar lenichsat kudeshayya ledabbacha kodam Adonai uminchata defila vimshach are yoma den yekara daAdonai mitgeli lechon:
Vayyikchu et asher tzivva moshe el-pene ohel moed vayyikrevu kol-haeda vayyaamdu lifne Adonai
Unesivu yat di fakkid mshe lokodam mashkan zimna ukerivu kol kenishta vekamu kodam Adonai:
Vayyomer moshe ze haddavar asher-tzivva Adonai taasu veyera alechem kevod Adonai
Vaamar mshe den pitgama di fakkid Adonai tabedun veyitgeli lechon yekara daAdonai:
Vayyomer moshe el-aharon kerav el-hammizbeach vaase et-chattatcha veet-olatecha vechapper baadcha uvead haam vaase et-korban haam vechapper baadam kaasher tzivva Adonai
Vaamar mshe leaharon kerav lemadbecha veived yat chattatach veyat alatach vechappar alach veal amma veived yat kurban amma vechappar alehon kema di pakkid Adonai:
Vayyikrav aharon el-hammizbeach vayyishchat et-egel hachattat asher-lo
Ukerev aharon lemadbecha uneches yat egla dechattata di leh:
Vayyakrivu bene aharon et-haddam elav vayyitbol etzbao baddam vayyitten al-karnot hammizbeach veet-haddam yatzak el-yesod hammizbeach
Vekarivu bene aharon yat dema leh uteval etzbeeh bidma vihav al karnat madbecha veyat dema arik lisoda demadbecha:
Veet-hachelev veet-hakkelayot veet-hayyoteret min-hakkaved min-hachattat hiktir hammizbecha kaasher tzivva Adonai et-moshe
Veyat tarba veyat kalyeta veyat chitzra min kavda min chattata assek lemadbecha kema di pakkid Adonai yat mshe:
Veet-habbasar veet-haor saraf baesh michutz lammachane
Veyat bisra veyat mashka okid benura mibbara lemashrita:
Vayyishchat et-haola vayyamtziu bene aharon elav et-haddam vayyizrekehu al-hammizbeach saviv
Uneches yat alata veamtiu bene aharon leh yat dema uzerakeh al madbecha sechor sechor:
Veet-haola himtziu elav lintacheha veet-harosh vayyakter al-hammizbeach
Veyat alata amtiu leh leevaraha veyat resha veassek al madbecha:
Vayyirchatz et-hakkerev veet-hakkeraayim vayyakter al-haola hammizbecha
Vechallil yat gavva veyat keraayya veassek al alata lemadbecha:
Vayyakrev et korban haam vayyikkach et-seir hachattat asher laam vayyishchatehu vaychatteehu karishon
Vekarev yat kurban amma unesiv yat tzefira dechattata di leamma venachseh vechapper bidmeh kekadmaa:
Vayyakrev et-haola vayyaaseha kammishpat
Vekarev yat alata veavda kidchaze:
Vayyakrev et-hammincha vaymalle chappo mimmenna vayyakter al-hammizbeach millevad olat habboker
Vekarev yat minchata umela yedeh minna veassek al madbecha bar mealat tzafra:
Vayyishchat et-hashshor veet-haayil zevach hashshelamim asher laam vayyamtziu bene aharon et-haddam elav vayyizrekehu al-hammizbeach saviv
Uneches yat tora veyat dichra nichsat kudeshayya di leamma veamtiu bene aharon yat dema leh uzerakeh al madbecha sechor sechor:
Veet-hachalavim min-hashshor umin-haayil haalya vehamechasse vehakkelayot veyoteret hakkaved
Veyat tarbayya min tora umin dichra alita vechafe gavva vechalyeta vachatzar kavda:
Vayyasimu et-hachalavim al-hechazot vayyakter hachalavim hammizbecha
Veshavviu yat tarbayya al chedvata veassek tarbayya lemadbecha:
Veet hechazot veet shok hayyamin henif aharon tenufa lifne Adonai kaasher tzivva moshe
Veyat chedvata veyat shoka deyammina arem aharon arama kodam Adonai kema di pakkid mshe:
Vayyissa aharon et-yadav el-haam vayvarchem vayyered measot hachattat vehaola vehashshelamim
Vaarem aharon yat yedohi al amma uvarechinnun unechat millemebad chattata vaalata venichsat kudeshayya:
Vayyavo moshe veaharon el-ohel moed vayyetzu vayvarchu et-haam vayyera chevod-Adonai el-kol-haam
Veal mshe veaharon lemashkan zimna unefaku uvarichu yat amma veitgeli yekara daAdonai lechol amma:
Vattetze esh millifne Adonai vattochal al-hammizbeach et-haola veet-hachalavim vayyar kol-haam vayyaronnu vayyippelu al-penehem
Unefakat eshshata min kodam Adonai vaachalat al madbecha yat alata veyat tarbayya vachaza kol amma veshabbachu unefalu al appehon:
Vayyikchu vene-aharon nadav vaavihu ish machtato vayyittenu vahen esh vayyasimu aleha ketoret vayyakrivu lifne Adonai esh zara asher lo tzivva otam
Unesivu vene aharon nadav vaavihu gevar machtiteh vihavu vehon eshshata veshavviu ala ketoret vekarivu kodam Adonai eshshata nuchereta di la pakkid yathon:
Vattetze esh millifne Adonai vattochal otam vayyamutu lifne Adonai
Unefakat eshshata min kodam Adonai vaachalat yathon umitu kodam Adonai:
Vayyomer moshe el-aharon hu asher-dibber Adonai lemor bikrovay ekkadesh veal-pene chol-haam ekkaved vayyiddom aharon
Vaamar mshe leaharon hu di mallil Adonai lememar bekarivay itkaddash veal appe chol amma ityakkar ushetik aharon:
Vayyikra moshe el-mishael veel eltzafan bene uzziel dod aharon vayyomer alehem kirvu seu et-achechem meet pene-hakkodesh el-michutz lammachane
Ukera mshe lemishael uleeltzafan bene uzziel ach avuhi deaharon vaamar lehon kerivu tulu yat achuchon min kodam appe kudesha lemibbara lemashrita:
Vayyikrevu vayyissaum bechuttonotam el-michutz lammachane kaasher dibber moshe
Ukerivu unetalunnun bechittunnehon lemibbara lemashrita kema di mallil mshe:
Vayyomer moshe el-aharon uleelazar uleitamar banav rashechem al-tifrau uvigdechem lo-tifromu velo tamutu veal kol-haeda yiktzof vaachechem kol-bet yisrael yivku et-hasserefa asher saraf Adonai

Vaamar mshe leaharon uleelazar uleitamar benohi reshechon la terabbun perua ulevushechon la tevazzeun vela temutun veal kol kenishta yehe rugeza vaachechon kol bet yisrael yivkun yat yekidta di okid Adonai:
Umippetach ohel moed lo tetzu pen-tamutu ki-shemen mishchat Adonai alechem vayyaasu kidvar moshe
Umittera mashkan zimna la tippekun dilma temutun are meshach revuta daAdonai alechon vaavadu kefitgama demshe:
Vaydabber Adonai el-aharon lemor
Umallil Adonai leaharon lememar:
Yayin veshechar al-tesht atta uvanecha ittach bevoachem el-ohel moed velo tamutu chukkat olam ledorotechem
Chamar umeravve la tishte at uvenaych immach bemealchon lemashkan zimna vela temutun keyam alam ledarechon:
Ulehavdil ben hakkodesh uven hachol uven hattame uven hattahor
Uleafrasha ben kudesha uven chulla uven mesaava uven dachya:
Ulehorot et-bene yisrael et kol-hachukkim asher dibber Adonai alehem beyad-moshe
Uleallafa yat bene yisrael yat kol keyamayya di mallil Adonai lehon bida demshe:
Vaydabber moshe el-aharon veel elazar veel-itamar banav hannotarim kechu et-hammincha hannoteret meishshe Adonai veichluha matztzot etzel hammizbeach ki kodesh kodashim hiv
Umallil mshe im aharon veim elazar veim itamar benohi deishtaaru sivu yat minchata deishtaarat mikkurbanayya daAdonai veichluha fattir bistar madbecha are kodesh kudeshin hi:
Vaachaltem otah bemakom kadosh ki chokcha vechok-banecha hiv meishshe Adonai ki-chen tzuvveti
Vetechlun yata baatar kaddish are cholakach vocholak benaych hi mikkurbanayya daAdonai are chen itpakkadit:
Veet chaze hattenufa veet shok hatteruma tochlu bemakom tahor atta uvanecha uvenotecha ittach ki-chokcha vechok-banecha nittenu mizzivche shalme bene yisrael
Veyat chedya daaramuta veyat shoka deafrashuta techlun baatar deche at uvenaych uvenataych immach are cholakach vocholak benaych ityehivu minnichsat kudeshayya divne yisrael:
Shok hatteruma vachaze hattenufa al ishshe hachalavim yaviu lehanif tenufa lifne Adonai vehaya lecha ulevanecha ittecha lechok-olam kaasher tzivva Adonai
Shoka deafrashuta vechedya daaramuta al kurbane tarbayya yaytun laarama arama kodam Adonai vihe lach velivnaych immach likyam alam kema di pakkid Adonai:
Veet seir hachattat darosh darash moshe vehinne soraf vayyiktzof al-elazar veal-itamar bene aharon hannotarim lemor
Veyat tzefira dechattata mitba tave mshe veha ittokad uregez al elazar veal itamar bene aharon deishtaaru lememar:
Maddua lo-achaltem et-hachattat bimkom hakkodesh ki kodesh kodashim hiv veotah natan lachem laset et-avon haeda lechapper alehem lifne Adonai
Maden la achaltun yat chattata baatar kaddish are kodesh kudeshin hi veyata yahev lechon lesallacha al chove chenishta lechappara alehon kodam Adonai:
Hen lo-huva et-damah el-hakkodesh penima achol tochlu otah bakkodesh kaasher tzivveti
Ha la ittaal yat dema levet kudsha gavvaa mechal techlun yata bekudsha kema di fakkedit:
Vaydabber aharon el-moshe hen hayyom hikrivu et-chattatam veet-olatam lifne Adonai vattikrena oti kaelle veachalti chattat hayyom hayyitav beene Adonai
Umallil aharon im mshe ha yoma den karivu yat chattathon veyat alathon kodam Adonai vaaraa yati akan keillen veillufon achalit chattata yoma den hatakken kodam Adonai:
Vayyishma moshe vayyitav beenav
Ushema mshe ushefar beenohi:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe veel-aharon lemor alehem
Umallil Adonai im mshe uleaharon lememar lehon:
Dabberu el-bene yisrael lemor zot hachayya asher tochlu mikkol-habbehema asher al-haaretz
Mallilu im bene yisrael lememar da chayta di techlun mikkol beira di al ara:
Kol mafreset parsa veshosaat shesa perasot maalat gera babbehema otah tochelu
Kol di sedikan parsata umattilfan tilfin parsata masseka fishra bivira yata techlun:
Ach et-ze lo tochlu mimmaale haggera umimmafrise happarsa et-haggamal ki-maale gera hu ufarsa enennu mafris tame hu lachem
Beram yat den la techlun mimmasseke fishra umimmasdike parsata yat gamla are massik pishra hu ufarsata la sedika mesaav hu lechon:
Veet-hashshafan ki-maale gera hu ufarsa lo yafris tame hu lachem
Veyat tafza are massik pishra hu ufarsata la sedika mesaav hu lechon:
Veet-haarnevet ki-maalat gera hiv ufarsa lo hifrisa temea hiv lachem
Veyat arneva are masseka fishra hi ufarsata la sedika mesaava hi lechon:
Veet-hachazir ki-mafris parsa hu veshosa shesa parsa vehu gera lo-yiggar tame hu lachem
Veyat chazira are sedik parsata hu umattilfan tilfin parsateh vehu pishra la fashar mesaav hu lechon:
Mibbesaram lo tochelu uvenivlatam lo tiggau temeim hem lachem
Mibbisrehon la techlun uvinviltehon la tikrevun mesaavin innun lechon:
Et-ze tochlu mikkol asher bammayim kol asher-lo senappir vekaskeset bammayim bayyammim uvannechalim otam tochelu
Yat den techlun mikkol di vemayya kol di leh tzitzin vekalfin bemayya beyamemayya uvenachalayya yathon techlun:
Vechol asher en-lo senappir vekaskeset bayyammim uvannechalim mikkol sheretz hammayim umikkol nefesh hachayya asher bammayim sheketz hem lachem
Vechol di let leh tzitzin vekalfin beyammayya uvenachalayya mikkol richasha demayya umikkal nafsha chayta di vemayya shiktza innun lechon:
Vesheketz yihyu lachem mibbesaram lo tochelu veet-nivlatam teshakketzu
Veshiktza yehon lechon mibbisrehon la techlun veyat neviltehon teshakketzun:
Kol asher en-lo senappir vekaskeset bammayim sheketz hu lachem
Kol di let leh tzitzin vekalfin bemayya shiktza hu lechon:
Veet-elle teshakketzu min-haof lo yeochlu sheketz hem et-hannesher veet-happeres veet haozniyya
Veyat illen tashakketzun min ofa la yitachlun shiktza innun nishra vear veazya:
Veet-haddaa veet-haayya leminah
Vedayta vetarafita lizna:
Et kol-orev lemino
Yat kol ureva lizneh:
Veet bat hayyaana veet-hattachmas veet-hashshachaf veet-hannetz leminehu
Veyat bat naamita vetzitza vetzippar shachpa venatza liznohi:
Veet-hakkos veet-hashshalach veet-hayyanshuf
Vekarya veshalenuna vekippofa:
Veet-hattinshemet veet-hakkaat veet-haracham
Uvavta vekata virakreka:
Veet hachasida haanafa leminah veet-hadduchifat veet-haatallef
Vechavvarita veibbu lizna venaggar tura vaatallefa:
Kol sheretz haof haholech al-arba sheketz hu lachem
Kol richasha deofa dimhallech al arba shiktza hu lechon:
Ach et-ze tochlu mikkol sheretz haof haholech al-arba asher-lo cheraayim mimmaal leraglav lenatter bahen al-haaretz
Beram yat den techlun mikkol richasha deofa dimhallech al arba di leh kartzulin meillave raglohi lekappatza vehon al ara:
Et-elle mehem tochelu et-haarbe lemino veet-hassolam leminehu veet-hachargol leminehu veet-hechagav leminehu
Yat illen minnehon techlun yat gova lizna veyat rashuna liznohi veyat chargola liznohi veyat chagava liznohi:
Vechol sheretz haof asher-lo arba raglayim sheketz hu lachem
Vechol richasha deofa di leh arba raglin shiktza hu lechon:
Uleelle tittammau kol-hannogea benivlatam yitma ad-haarev
Uleillen tistaavun kol deyikrav binviltehon yehe mesaav ad ramsha:
Vechol-hannose minnivlatam yechabbes begadav vetame ad-haarev
Vechol deyitol minneviltehon yetzabba levushohi vihe mesaav ad ramsha:
Lechol-habbehema asher hiv mafreset parsa veshesa enenna shosaat vegera enenna maala temeim hem lachem kol-hannogea bahem yitma
Lechol beira di hi sedika farsata vetilfin letaha mattilfa ufishra letaha masseka mesaavin innun lechon kol deyikrav behon yehe mesaav:
Vechol holech al-kappav bechol-hachayya haholechet al-arba temeim hem lachem kol-hannogea benivlatam yitma ad-haarev
Vechol dimhallech al yedohi bechol chayta dimhalecha al arba mesaavin innun lechon kol deyikrav binviltehon yehe mesaav ad ramsha:
Vehannose et-nivlatam yechabbes begadav vetame ad-haarev temeim hemma lachem
Udeyittol yat neviltehon yetzabba levushohi vihe mesaav ad ramsha mesaavin innun lechon:
Veze lachem hattame bashsheretz hashshoretz al-haaretz hacholed vehaachbar vehatztzav leminehu
Veden lechon mesaava berichasha derachesh al ara chulda veachbara vetzava liznohi:
Vehaanaka vehakkoach vehalletaa vehachomet vehattinshamet
Veyala vechocha vechulteta vechumta veashuta:
Elle hattemeim lachem bechol-hashsharetz kol-hannogea bahem bemotam yitma ad-haarev
Illen dimsaavin lechon bechol richasha kol deyikrav behon bemothon yehe mesaav ad ramsha:
Vechol asher-yippol-alav mehem bemotam yitma mikkol-keli-etz o veged o-or o sak kol-keli asher-yease melacha bahem bammayim yuva vetame ad-haerev vetaher
Vechol di yippel alohi minnehon bemothon yehe mesaav mikkol man deaa o levush o meshach o sak kol man di titaved ivida behon bemayya yittaal vihe mesaav ad ramsha veyidke:
Vechol-keli-cheres asher-yippol mehem el-tocho kol asher betocho yitma veoto tishboru
Vechol man dachasaf di yippel minnehon legavveh kol di vegavveh yistaav veyateh tetabberun:
Mikkol-haochel asher yeachel asher yavo alav mayim yitma vechol-mashke asher yishshate bechol-keli yitma
Mikkol mechla demitachel di yaalun alohi mayya yehe mesaav vechol mashke di yishtete bechol man yehe mesaav:
Vechol asher-yippol minnivlatam alav yitma tannur vechirayim yuttatz temeim hem utemeim yihyu lachem
Vechol di yippel minneviltehon alohi yehe mesaav tannur vechirayim yittarun mesaavin innun umesaavin yehon lechon:
Ach mayan uvor mikve-mayim yihye tahor venogea benivlatam yitma
Beram mayan vegov bet kenishut mayya yehe deche udeyikrav binviltehon yehe mesaav:
Vechi yippol minnivlatam al-kol-zera zerua asher yizzarea tahor hu
Vaare yippel minneviltehon al kol bar zera zerua di yizdera deche hu:
Vechi yuttan-mayim al-zera venafal minnivlatam alav tame hu lachem
Vaare yityahavun mayya al bar zara veyippel minneviltehon alohi mesaav hu lechon:
Vechi yamut min-habbehema asher-hi lachem leochla hannogea benivlatah yitma ad-haarev
Vaare yemut min beira di hi lechon lemechal deyikrav binvilta yehe mesaav ad ramsha:
Vehaochel minnivlatah yechabbes begadav vetame ad-haarev vehannose et-nivlatah yechabbes begadav vetame ad-haarev
Udeyechul minnevilta yetzabba levushohi vihe mesaav ad ramsha udeyittol yat nevilta yetzabba levushohi vihe mesaav ad ramsha:
Vechol-hashsheretz hashshoretz al-haaretz sheketz hu lo yeachel
Vechol richasha derachesh al ara shiktza hu la yitachel:
Kol holech al-gachon vechol holech al-arba ad kol-marbe raglayim lechol-hashsheretz hashshoretz al-haaretz lo tochlum ki-sheketz hem
Kol dimhallech al meohi vechol dimhallech al arba ad kol segiut raglain lechol richasha derachesh al ara la techlunnun are shiktza innun:
Al-teshakketzu et-nafshotechem bechol-hashsheretz hashshoretz velo tittammeu bahem venitmetem bam
La teshakketzu yat nafshatechon bechol richasha derachesh vela tistaavun behon vetistaavun pon behon:
Ki ani Adonai elohechem vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim ki kadosh ani velo tetammeu et-nafshotechem bechol-hashsheretz haromes al-haaretz
Are ana Adonai elahachon vetitkaddeshun utehon kaddishin are kaddish ana vela tesaavun yat nafshatechon bechol richasha derachesh al ara:
Ki ani Adonai hammaale etchem meeretz mitzrayim lihyot lachem lelohim vihyitem kedoshim ki kadosh ani
Are ana Adonai deassek yatchon meara demitzrayim lemeheve lechon leelah utehon kaddishin are kaddish ana:
Zot torat habbehema vehaof vechol nefesh hachayya haromeset bammayim ulechol-nefesh hashshoretzet al-haaretz
Da orayta divira udeofa udechol nafshata chayta dirchesha bemayya ulechal nafsha dirchesha al ara:
Lehavdil ben hattame uven hattahor uven hachayya hanneechelet uven hachayya asher lo teachel
Leafrasha ben mesaava uven dachya uven chayta demitachla uven chayta di la mitachla:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael lemor ishsha ki tazria veyalda zachar vetama shivat yamim kime niddat devotah titma
Mallel im bene yisrael lememar itteta are teaddi utelid dechar utehe mesaava shivat yomin keyome richuk sovta tehe mesaava:
Uvayyom hashshemini yimmol besar orlato
Uveyoma teminaa yigzar bisra deorleteh:
Usheloshim yom usheloshet yamim teshev bidme tohora bechol-kodesh lo-tigga veel-hammikdash lo tavo ad-melot yeme tohorah
Utelatin utelata yomin tetev bedam dechu bechol kudesha la tikrav ulemikdesha la teol ad mishlam yome dachuta:
Veim-nekeva teled vetama shevuayim keniddatah veshishshim yom vesheshet yamim teshev al-deme tohora
Veim nekuveta telid utehe mesaava arbea asar kerichuka veshittin veshitta yomin tetev al dam dechu:
Uvimlot yeme tohorah leven o levat tavi keves ben-shenato leola uven-yona o-tor lechattat el-petach ohel-moed el-hakkohen
Uvemishlam yome dachuta livra o livratta tayti immar bar shatteh laalata uvar yona o shafnina lechattata litra mashkan zimna levat kahana:
Vehikrivo lifne Adonai vechipper aleha vetahara mimmekor dameha zot torat hayyoledet lazzachar o lannekeva
Vikarvinneh kodam Adonai vichapper ala vetidke missoavat demaha da orayta deyalledta leduchera o linkuvta:
Veim-lo timtza yadah de se velakcha shete-torim o shene bene yona echad leola veechad lechattat vechipper aleha hakkohen vetahera
Veim la tashkach yeda kemissat immera vetissav tarten shafninin o teren bene yona chad laalata vechad lechattata vichapper ala kahana vetidke:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe veel-aharon lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe veim aharon lememar:
Adam ki-yihye veor-besaro seet o-sappachat o vaheret vehaya veor-besaro lenega tzaraat vehuva el-aharon hakkohen o el-achad mibbanav hakkohanim
Enash are yehe vimshach bisreh amka o adya o vahara vihe vimshach bisreh lemachtash segiru veyittete levat aharon kahana o levat chad mibbenohi kahanayya:
Veraa hakkohen et-hannega beor-habbasar vesear bannega hafach lavan umare hannega amok meor besaro nega tzaraat hu veraahu hakkohen vetimme oto
Veyecheze chahana yat machtasha vimshach bisra vesear bemachtasha ithafich lemechevar umecheze machtasha ammik bimshach bisreh machtash segiruta hu veyechezinneh kahana visaev yateh:
Veim-baheret levana hiv beor besaro veamok en-mareha min-haor useara lo-hafach lavan vehisgir hakkohen et-hannega shivat yamim
Veim bahara chavvera hi bimshach bisreh veammik let mechezaha min mashcha useara la ithafich lemechevar veyasgar kahana yat machtasha shiva yomin:
Veraahu hakkohen bayyom hashshevii vehinne hannega amad beenav lo-fasa hannega baor vehisgiro hakkohen shivat yamim shenit
Veyechezinneh kahana beyoma sheviaa veha machtesha kam kad hava la osef machtasha bemashka veyasgerinneh kahana shiva yomin tinyanut:
Veraa hakkohen oto bayyom hashshevii shenit vehinne keha hannega velo-fasa hannega baor vetiharo hakkohen mispachat hiv vechibbes begadav vetaher
Veyecheze chahana yateh beyoma sheviaa tinyanut veha amya machtasha vela osef machtasha bemashka vidakkinneh kahana adita hi vitzabba levushohi veyidke:
Veim-paso tifse hammispachat baor achare heraoto el-hakkohen letohorato venira shenit el-hakkohen
Veim osafa tosef adita bemashka batar diittachazi lechahana ledakkuteh veyittachazi tinyanut lechahana:
Veraa hakkohen vehinne pasta hammispachat baor vetimmeo hakkohen tzaraat hiv
Veyecheze chahana veha osefat adita bemashka visaevinneh kahana segiruta hi:
Nega tzaraat ki tihye beadam vehuva el-hakkohen
Machtash segiru are tehe beenasha veyittete levat kahana:
Veraa hakkohen vehinne seet-levana baor vehi hafcha sear lavan umichyat basar chay baset
Veyecheze chahana veha amka chavvera bemashka vehi hafachat sear lechivvar vershem bisra chayta beammikta:
Tzaraat noshenet hiv beor besaro vetimmeo hakkohen lo yasgirennu ki tame hu
Segirut attika hi bimshach bisreh visaevinneh kahana la yasgerineh are mesaav hu:
Veim-paroach tifrach hatztzaraat baor vechisseta hatztzaraat et kol-or hannega merosho vead-raglav lechol-mare ene hakkohen
Veim misga tisge segiruta bemashka vetachafe segiruta yat kol meshach machtasha meresheh vead raglohi lechol chezu ene chahana:
Veraa hakkohen vehinne chisseta hatztzaraat et-kol-besaro vetihar et-hannaga kullo hafach lavan tahor hu
Veyecheze chahana veha chafat segiruta yat kol bisreh vidakki yat machtasha kulleh ithafich lemechevar deche hu:
Uveyom heraot bo basar chay yitma
Uveyoma deittachazi veh bisra chayya yehe mesaav:
Veraa hakkohen et-habbasar hachay vetimmeo habbasar hachay tame hu tzaraat hu
Veyecheze chahana yat bisra chayya visaevinneh bisra chayya mesaav hu segirut hu:
O chi yashuv habbasar hachay venepach lelavan uva el-hakkohen
O are yetuv bisra chayya veyithafich lemechevar veyittete levat kahana:
Veraahu hakkohen vehinne nepach hannega lelavan vetihar hakkohen et-hannega tahor hu
Veyechezinneh kahana veha ithafich machtasha lemechevar vidakke chahana yat machtasha deche hu:
Uvasar ki-yihye vo-veoro shechin venirpa
Uvisra are yehe veh bemashkeh shichana veyittasse:
Vehaya bimkom hashshechin seet levana o vaheret levana adamdamet venira el-hakkohen
Vihe baatar shichana amka chavvera o vahara chavvera samka veyittachazi lechahana:
Veraa hakkohen vehinne mareha shafal min-haor usearah hafach lavan vetimmeo hakkohen nega-tzaraat hiv bashshechin paracha
Veyecheze chahana veha mechezaha makkich min mashka useara ithafich lemechevar visaevineh kahana machtash segiruta hi beshichana segiat:
Veim yirenna hakkohen vehinne en-bah sear lavan ushefala enenna min-haor vehi cheha vehisgiro hakkohen shivat yamim
Veim yechezinna kahana veha let ba sear chivvar umakkicha letaha min mashka vehi amya veyasgerinneh kahana shiva yomin:
Veim-paso tifse baor vetimme hakkohen oto nega hiv
Veim osafa tosef bemashka visaev kahana yateh machtasha hi:
Veim-tachteha taamod habbaheret lo fasata tzarevet hashshechin hiv vetiharo hakkohen
Veim beatraha kamat beharta la osefat rshem shichana hi vidakkinneh kahana:
O vasar ki-yihye veoro michvat-esh vehayta michyat hammichva baheret levana adamdemet o levana
O visra are yehe vemashkeh kevaa denur utehe rshem kevaa bahara chavvera samka o chavvera:
Veraa otah hakkohen vehinne nepach sear lavan babbaheret umareha amok min-haor tzaraat hiv bammichva paracha vetimme oto hakkohen nega tzaraat hiv
Veyecheze yata kahana veha ithafich sear chivvar bevaherta umechezaha ammik min mashka segiruta hi bichvaa segia visaev yateh kahana machtash segiruta hi:
Veim yirenna hakkohen vehinne en-babbaheret sear lavan ushefala enenna min-haor vehiv cheha vehisgiro hakkohen shivat yamim
Veim yechezinna kahana veha let bevaherta sear chivvar umakkicha letaha min mashka vehi amya veyasgrinneh kahana shiva yomin:
Veraahu hakkohen bayyom hashshevii im-paso tifse baor vetimme hakkohen oto nega tzaraat hiv
Veyechezinneh kahana beyoma sheviaa im osafa tosef bemashka visaev kahana yateh machtash segiruta hi:
Veim-tachteha taamod habbaheret lo-fasta vaor vehiv cheha seet hammichva hiv vetiharo hakkohen ki-tzarevet hammichva hiv
Veim beatraha kamat baherta la osefat bemashka vehi amya omek kevaa hi vidakkinneh kahana are rshem kevaa hi:
Veish o ishsha ki-yihye vo naga berosh o vezakan
Ugevar o itteta are yehe veh machtasha beresha o vidkan:
Veraa hakkohen et-hannega vehinne marehu amok min-haor uvo sear tzahov dak vetimme oto hakkohen netek hu tzaraat harosh o hazzakan hu
Veyecheze chahana yat machtasha veha mechezohi ammik min mashka uveh sear summak dadak visaev yateh kahana nitka hu segirut resha o dikna hu:
Vechi-yire hakkohen et-nega hannetek vehinne en-marehu amok min-haor vesear shachor en bo vehisgir hakkohen et-nega hannetek shivat yamim
Vaare yecheze chahana yat machtash nitka veha let mechezohi ammik min mashka vesear ukkam let beh veyasgar kahana yat machtash nitka shivat yomin:
Veraa hakkohen et-hannega bayyom hashshevii vehinne lo-fasa hannetek velo-haya vo sear tzahov umare hannetek en amok min-haor
Veyecheze chahana yat machtasha beyoma sheviaa veha la osef nitka vela hava veh sear summak umecheze nitka let ammik min mashka:
Vehitgallach veet-hannetek lo yegalleach vehisgir hakkohen et-hannetek shivat yamim shenit
Vigallach sochorane nitka udeim nitka la yegallach veyasgar kahana yat nitka shiva yomin tinyanut:
Veraa hakkohen et-hannetek bayyom hashshevii vehinne lo-fasa hannetek baor umarehu enennu amok min-haor vetihar oto hakkohen vechibbes begadav vetaher
Veyecheze chahana yat nitka beyoma sheviaa veha la osef nitka bemashka umechezohi letohi ammik min mashka vidakke yateh kahana vitzabba levushohi veyidke:
Veim-paso yifse hannetek baor achare tohorato
Veim osafa yosef nitka bemashka batar dachuteh:
Veraahu hakkohen vehinne pasa hannetek baor lo-yevakker hakkohen lassear hatztzahov tame hu
Veyechezinneh kahana veha osef nitka bemashka la yevakker kahana lesear summak mesaav hu:
Veim-beenav amad hannetek vesear shachor tzamach-bo nirpa hannetek tahor hu vetiharo hakkohen
Veim kad hava kam nitka vesear ukkam tzemach beh ittassi nitka deche hu vidakkinneh kahana:
Veish o-ishsha ki-yihye veor-besaram beharot beharot levanot
Ugevar o itteta are yehe vimshach bisrehon baharan baharan chavveran:
Veraa hakkohen vehinne veor-besaram beharot kehot levanot bohak hu parach baor tahor hu
Veyecheze chahana veha vimshach bisrehon baharan amyan chavveran bahaka hu sage vemashka deche hu:
Veish ki yimmaret rosho kereach hu tahor hu
Ugevar are yattar sear resheh kerach hu deche hu:
Veim mippeat panav yimmaret rosho gibbeach hu tahor hu
Veim millokovel appohi yattar sear resheh gelosh hu deche hu:
Vechi-yihye vakkarachat o vaggabbachat nega lavan adamdam tzaraat porachat hiv bekarachto o vegabbachto
Vaare yehe vekarachuteh o vigloshuteh machtash chivvar sammok segirut sagya hi bekarachuteh o vigloshuteh:
Veraa oto hakkohen vehinne seet-hannega levana adamdemet bekarachto o vegabbachto kemare tzaraat or basar
Veyecheze yateh kahana veha ammik machtasha chavvera sammeka bekarachuteh o vigloshuteh kemecheze segiruta meshach bisra:
Ish-tzarua hu tame hu tamme yetammeennu hakkohen berosho nigo
Gevar segir hu mesaav hu soova yesaevinneh kahana beresheh machtasheh:
Vehatztzarua asher-bo hannega begadav yihyu ferumim verosho yihye farua veal-safam yate vetame tame yikra
Usegira di veh machtasha levushohi yehon mevazzein veresheh yehe feria veal safam kaavela yitattaf vela tistaavun vela tistaavun yikre:
Kol-yeme asher hannega bo yitma tame hu badad yeshev michutz lammachane moshavo
Kol yome di machtasha veh yehe mesaav mesaav hu bilchodohi yetev mibbara lemashrita motveh:
Vehabbeged ki-yihye vo nega tzaraat beveged tzemer o beveged pishtim
Ulevusha are yehe veh machtash segiru bilvush amar o bilvush kittan:
O vishti o veerev lappishtim velatztzamer o veor o bechol-melechet or
O veshitya o vearva lechittana uleamra o vemashka o bechol avidat meshach:
Vehaya hannega yerakrak o adamdam babbeged o vaor o-vashsheti o-vaerev o vechol-keli-or nega tzaraat hu vehora et-hakkohen
Vihe machtasha yarok o sammok bilvusha o vemashka o veshitya o vearva o vechal man dimshach machtash segiruta hu veyittachaze lechahana:
Veraa hakkohen et-hannaga vehisgir et-hannega shivat yamim
Veyecheze chahana yat machtasha veyasgar yat machtasha shivat yomin:
Veraa et-hannega bayyom hashshevii ki-fasa hannega babbeged o-vashsheti o-vaerev o vaor lechol asher-yease haor limlacha tzaraat mameret hannega tame hu
Veyecheze yat machtasha beyoma sheviaa are osef machtasha bilvusha o veshitya o vearva o vemashka lechol di yitaved mashka leivida segirut mechasra machtasha mesaav hu:
Vesaraf et-habbeged o et-hashsheti o et-haerev batztzemer o vappishtim o et-kol-keli haor asher-yihye vo hannaga ki-tzaraat mameret hiv baesh tissaref
Veyokid yat levusha o yat shitya o yat arva beamra o vechittana o yat kol man dimshach di yehe veh machtasha are segirut mechasra hi benura tittokad:
Veim yire hakkohen vehinne lo-fasa hannega babbeged o vashsheti o vaerev o bechol-keli-or
Veim yecheze chahana veha la osef machtasha bilvusha o veshitya o vearva o bechol man dimshach:
Vetzivva hakkohen vechibbesu et asher-bo hannaga vehisgiro shivat-yamim shenit
Vifakked kahana vichavverun yat di veh machtasha veyasgerinneh shivat yomin tinyanut:
Veraa hakkohen achare hukkabbes et-hannega vehinne lo-hafach hannega et-eno vehannega lo-fasa tame hu baesh tisrefennu pechetet hiv bekarachto o vegabbachto
Veyecheze chahana batar dechavvaru yat machtasha veha la shena machtasha min kad hava umachtasha la osef mesaav hu benura tokdinneh tavra hi beshechikuteh o vechaddatuteh:
Veim raa hakkohen vehinne keha hannega achare hukkabbes oto vekara oto min-habbeged o min-haor o min-hashsheti o min-haerev
Veim chaza chahana veha amya machtasha batar dechavvaru yateh uveza yateh min levusha o min mashka o min shitya o min arva:
Veim-terae od babbeged o-vashsheti o-vaerev o vechol-keli-or porachat hiv baesh tisrefennu et asher-bo hannaga
Veim titchaze od bilvusha o veshitya o vearva o vechal man dimshach sagya hi benura tokdinneh yat di veh machtasha:
Vehabbeged o-hashsheti o-haerev o-chol-keli haor asher techabbes vesar mehem hannaga vechubbas shenit vetaher
Ulevusha o shitya o arva o chol man dimshach di yitchavvar veyede minnehon machtasha veyitztabba tinyanut veyidke:
Zot torat nega-tzaraat beged hatztzemer o happishtim o hashsheti o haerev o kol-keli-or letaharo o letammeo
Da orayta demachtash segiru bilvush amar o chittana o shitya o arva o kol man dimshach ledakkayuteh o lesaavuteh:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Zot tihye torat hammetzora beyom tohorato vehuva el-hakkohen
Da tehe orayta disgira biyoma dedachuteh veyittete levat kahana:
Veyatza hakkohen el-michutz lammachane veraa hakkohen vehinne nirpa nega-hatztzaraat min-hatztzarua
Veyippok kahana lemibbara lemashrita veyecheze chahana veha ittassi machtash segiruta min segira:
Vetzivva hakkohen velakach lammittaher shete-tzipporim chayyot tehorot veetz erez usheni tolaat veezov
Vifakked kahana veyissav lemiddakke tarten tzipperin chayyin dochyan veaa dearza utzeva zehori veezova:
Vetzivva hakkohen veshachat et-hatztzippor haechat el-keli-cheres al-mayim chayyim
Vifakked kahana veyikkos yat tzippera chada leman dachasaf al me mabbua:
Et-hatztzippor hachayya yikkach otah veet-etz haerez veet-sheni hattolaat veet-haezov vetaval otam veet hatztzippor hachayya bedam hatztzippor hashshechuta al hammayim hachayyim
Yat tzippera chayta yissav yata veyat aa dearza veyat tzeva zehori veyat ezova veyitbol yathon veyat tzippera chayta bidma detzippera dinchisa al me mabbua:
Vehizza al hammittaher min-hatztzaraat sheva peamim vetiharo veshillach et-hatztzippor hachayya al-pene hassade
Veyaddi al demiddakke min segiruta sheva zimnin vidakkinneh vishallach yat tzippera chayta al appe chakla:
Vechibbes hammittaher et-begadav vegillach et-kol-searo verachatz bammayim vetaher veachar yavo el-hammachane veyashav michutz leoholo shivat yamim
Vitzabba demiddakke yat levushohi vigallach yat kol saareh veyasche vemayya veyidke uvatar ken yeol lemashrita vitev mibbara lemashkeneh shava yomin:
Vehaya vayyom hashshevii yegallach et-kol-searo et-rosho veet-zekano veet gabbot enav veet-kol-searo yegalleach vechibbes et-begadav verachatz et-besaro bammayim vetaher
Vihe veyoma sheviaa yegallach yat kol saareh yat resheh veyat dikneh veyat gevine enohi veyat kol saareh yegallach vitzabba yat levushohi veyasche yat bisreh bemayya veyidke:
Uvayyom hashshemini yikkach shene-chevasim temimim vechavsa achat bat-shenatah temima ushelosha esronim solet mincha belula vashshemen velog echad shamen
Uveyoma teminaa yissav teren immerin shalmin veimmarta chada bat shatta shelemta utelata esronin sulta minchata defila vimshach velugga chad demishcha:
Veheemid hakkohen hametaher et haish hammittaher veotam lifne Adonai petach ohel moed
Vikim kahana dimdakke yat gavra demiddakke veyathon kodam Adonai bitra mashkan zimna:
Velakach hakkohen et-hakkeves haechad vehikriv oto leasham veet-log hashshamen vehenif otam tenufa lifne Adonai
Veyissav kahana yat immera chada vikarev yateh laashama veyat lugga demishcha virim yathon arama kodam Adonai:
Veshachat et-hakkeves bimkom asher yishchat et-hachattat veet-haola bimkom hakkodesh ki kachattat haasham hu lakkohen kodesh kodashim hu
Veyikkos yat immera baatar di yikkos yat chattata veyat alata baatar kaddish are kechattata ashama hu lechahana kodesh kudeshin hu:
Velakach hakkohen middam haasham venatan hakkohen al-tenuch ozen hammittaher hayemanit veal-bohen yado hayemanit veal-bohen raglo hayemanit
Veyissav kahana middema daashama veyitten kahana al rum udena demiddakke deyammina veal ilyon yedeh deyammina veal ilyon ragleh deyammina:
Velakach hakkohen millog hashshamen veyatzak al-kaf hakkohen hassemalit
Veyissav kahana millugga demishcha virik al yeda dechahana dismala:
Vetaval hakkohen et-etzbao hayemanit min-hashshemen asher al-kappo hassemalit vehizza min-hashshemen beetzbao sheva peamim lifne Adonai
Veyitbol kahana yat etzbeeh deyammina min mishcha di al yedeh dismala veyaddi min mishcha beetzbeeh sheva zimnin kodam Adonai:
Umiyyeter hashshemen asher al-kappo yitten hakkohen al-tenuch ozen hammittaher hayemanit veal-bohen yado hayemanit veal-bohen raglo hayemanit al dam haasham
Umishshear mishcha di al yedeh yitten kahana al rum udena demiddakke deyammina veal ilyon yedeh deyammina veal ilyon ragleh deyammina al dema daashama:
Vehannotar bashshemen asher al-kaf hakkohen yitten al-rosh hammittaher vechipper alav hakkohen lifne Adonai
Udeishtaar bemishcha di al yeda dechahana yitten al resha demiddakke vichapper alohi kahana kodam Adonai:
Veasa hakkohen et-hachattat vechipper al-hammittaher mittumato veachar yishchat et-haola
Veyabed kahana yat chattata vichapper al demiddakke mesovteh uvatar ken yikkos yat alata:
Veheela hakkohen et-haola veet-hammincha hammizbecha vechipper alav hakkohen vetaher
Veyassek kahana yat alata veyat minchata lemadbecha vichapper alohi kahana veyidke:
Veim-dal hu veen yado masseget velakach keves echad asham litnufa lechapper alav veissaron solet echad balul bashshemen lemincha velog shamen
Veim misken hu velet yedeh madbeka veyissav immar chad ashama laarama lechappara alohi veisrona sulta chad defil bimshach lemincha velugga demishcha:
Ushete torim o shene bene yona asher tassig yado vehaya echad chattat vehaechad ola
Vetarten shafninin o teren bene yona di tadbek yedeh vihe chad chattata vechad alata:
Vehevi otam bayyom hashshemini letohorato el-hakkohen el-petach ohel-moed lifne Adonai
Veyayti yathon beyoma teminaa ledakkayuteh levat kahana litra mashkan zimna kodam Adonai:
Velakach hakkohen et-keves haasham veet-log hashshamen vehenif otam hakkohen tenufa lifne Adonai
Veyissav kahana yat immera daashama veyat lugga demishcha virim yathon kahana arama kodam Adonai:
Veshachat et-keves haasham velakach hakkohen middam haasham venatan al-tenuch ozen-hammittaher hayemanit veal-bohen yado hayemanit veal-bohen raglo hayemanit
Veyikkos yat immera daashama veyissav kahana middema daashama veyitten al rum udena demiddakke deyammina veal ilyon yedeh deyammina veal ilyon ragleh deyammina:
Umin-hashshemen yitzok hakkohen al-kaf hakkohen hassemalit
Umin mishcha yerik kahana al yeda dechahana dismala:
Vehizza hakkohen beetzbao hayemanit min-hashshemen asher al-kappo hassemalit sheva peamim lifne Adonai
Veyaddi chahana beetzbeeh deyammina min mishcha di al yedeh dismala sheva zimnin kodam Adonai:
Venatan hakkohen min-hashshemen asher al-kappo al-tenuch ozen hammittaher hayemanit veal-bohen yado hayemanit veal-bohen raglo hayemanit al-mekom dam haasham
Veyitten kahana min mishcha di al yedeh al rum udena demiddakke deyammina veal ilyon yedeh deyammina veal ilyon ragleh deyammina al atar dema daashama:
Vehannotar min-hashshemen asher al-kaf hakkohen yitten al-rosh hammittaher lechapper alav lifne Adonai
Udeyishtaar min mishcha di al yeda dechahana yitten al resha demiddakke lechappara alohi kodam Adonai:
Veasa et-haechad min-hattorim o min-bene hayyona measher tassig yado
Veyabed yat chad min shafninayya o min bene yona middi tadbek yedeh:
Et asher-tassig yado et-haechad chattat veet-haechad ola al-hammincha vechipper hakkohen al hammittaher lifne Adonai
Yat di tadbek yedeh yat chad chattata veyat chad alata al minchata vichapper kahana al demiddakke kodam Adonai:
Zot torat asher-bo nega tzaraat asher lo-tassig yado betohorato
Da orayta di veh machtash segiru di la tadbek yedeh bedachuteh:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe veel-aharon lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe veim aharon lememar:
Ki tavou el-eretz kenaan asher ani noten lachem laachuzza venatatti nega tzaraat bevet eretz achuzzatchem
Are tealun leara dichnaan di ana yahev lechon leachasana veetten machtash segiru bevet ara achasnetechon:
Uva asher-lo habbayit vehiggid lakkohen lemor kenega nira li babbayit
Veyete dedileh beta vichavvi lechahana lememar kemachtasha itchazi li beveta:
Vetzivva hakkohen ufinnu et-habbayit beterem yavo hakkohen lirot et-hannega velo yitma kol-asher babbayit veachar ken yavo hakkohen lirot et-habbayit
Vifakked kahana vifannun yat beta ad la yeol kahana lemecheze yat machtasha vela yistaav kol di beveta uvatar ken yeol kahana lemecheze yat beta:
Veraa et-hannega vehinne hannega bekirot habbayit shekaarurot yerakrakkot o adamdammot umarehen shafal min-hakkir
Veyecheze yat machtasha veha machtasha bechatle veta pachatin yarkan o samkan umechezehon makkich min katla:
Veyatza hakkohen min-habbayit el-petach habbayit vehisgir et-habbayit shivat yamim
Veyippok kahana min beta litra beta veyasgar yat beta shiva yomin:
Veshav hakkohen bayyom hashshevii veraa vehinne pasa hannega bekirot habbayit
Vituv kahana beyoma sheviaa veyecheze veha osif machtasha bechatle veta:
Vetzivva hakkohen vechilletzu et-haavanim asher bahen hannaga vehishlichu ethen el-michutz lair el-makom tame
Vifakked kahana vishallefun yat avnayya di vehon machtasha veyirmun yathon lemibbara lekarta laatar mesaav:
Veet-habbayit yaktzia mibbayit saviv veshafchu et-heafar asher hiktzu el-michutz lair el-makom tame
Veyat beta yekallefun miggav sechor sechor veyirmun yat afra di kallifu lemibbara lekarta laatar mesaav:
Velakchu avanim acherot veheviu el-tachat haavanim veafar acher yikkach vetach et-habbayit
Veyissevun avnayya ochoranin veyaalun laatar avnayya vaafar ochoran yissav vishua yat beta:
Veim-yashuv hannega ufarach babbayit achar chilletz et-haavanim veachare hiktzot et-habbayit veachare hittoach
Veim yetuv machtasha veyisge beveta batar deshallifu yat avnayya uvatar dekallifu yat beta uvatar deittesha:
Uva hakkohen veraa vehinne pasa hannega babbayit tzaraat mameret hiv babbayit tame hu
Veyeol kahana veyecheze veha osef machtasha beveta segirut mechasra hi beveta mesaav hu:
Venatatz et-habbayit et-avanav veet-etzav veet kol-afar habbayit vehotzi el-michutz lair el-makom tame
Vitara yat beta yat avnohi veyat aohi veyat kol afar beta veyappek lemibbara lekarta laatar mesaav:
Vehabba el-habbayit kol-yeme hisgir oto yitma ad-haarev
Udeyeol leveta kol yomin deyasgar yateh yehe mesaav ad ramsha:
Vehashshochev babbayit yechabbes et-begadav vehaochel babbayit yechabbes et-begadav
Udeyishkuv beveta yetzabba yat levushohi udeyechul beveta yetzabba yat levushohi:
Veim-bo yavo hakkohen veraa vehinne lo-fasa hannega babbayit achare hittoach et-habbayit vetihar hakkohen et-habbayit ki nirpa hannaga
Veim meal yeol kahana veyecheze veha la osef machtasha beveta batar deittesha yat beta vidakke chahana yat beta are ittassi machtasha:
Velakach lechatte et-habbayit shete tzipporim veetz erez usheni tolaat veezov
Veyissav ledakkaa yat beta tarten tzipperin veaa dearza utzeva zehori veezova:
Veshachat et-hatztzippor haechat el-keli-cheres al-mayim chayyim
Veyikkos yat tzippara chada leman dachasaf al me mabbua:
Velakach et-etz-haerez veet-haezov veet sheni hattolaat veet hatztzippor hachayya vetaval otam bedam hatztzippor hashshechuta uvammayim hachayyim vehizza el-habbayit sheva peamim
Veyissav yat aa dearza veyat ezova veyat tzeva zehori veyat tzippara chayta veyitbol yathon bidma detzippara dinchisa uveme mabbua veyaddi leveta sheva zimnin:
Vechitte et-habbayit bedam hatztzippor uvammayim hachayyim uvatztzippor hachayya uveetz haerez uvaezov uvishni hattolaat
Vidakke yat beta bidma detzippara uveme mabbua uvetzippara chayta uveaa dearza uveezova uvitzva zehori:
Veshillach et-hatztzippor hachayya el-michutz lair el-pene hassade vechipper al-habbayit vetaher
Vishallach yat tzippara chayta lemibbara lekarta leappe chakla vichappar al beta veyidke:
Zot hattora lechol-nega hatztzaraat velannatek
Da orayta lechol machtash segiruta ulenitka:
Uletzaraat habbeged velabbayit
Velisgirut levusha uleveta:
Velaset velassappachat velabbeharet
Uleamka uleadya ulevahara:
Lehorot beyom hattame uveyom hattahor zot torat hatztzaraat
Leallafa beyoma mesaava uveyoma dachya da orayta disgiruta:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe veel-aharon lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe veim aharon lememar:
Dabberu el-bene yisrael vaamartem alehem ish ish ki yihye zav mibbesaro zovo tame hu
Mallilu im bene yisrael vetemrun lehon gevar gevar are yehe daiv mibbisreh doveh mesaav hu:
Vezot tihye tumato bezovo rar besaro et-zovo o-hechtim besaro mizzovo tumato hiv
Veda tehe sovteh bedoveh rar bisreh yat doveh o chatim bisreh middoveh sovteh hi:
Kol-hammishkav asher yishkav alav hazzav yitma vechol-hakkeli asher-yeshev alav yitma
Kol mishkeva di yishkuv alohi dovana yehe mesaav vechol mana deyetev alohi yehe mesaav:
Veish asher yigga bemishkavo yechabbes begadav verachatz bammayim vetame ad-haarev
Ugevar di yikrav bmishkeveh yetzabba levushohi veyasche vemayya vihe mesaav ad ramsha:
Vehayyoshev al-hakkeli asher-yeshev alav hazzav yechabbes begadav verachatz bammayim vetame ad-haarev
Udeyetev al mana deyetev alohi dovana yetzabba levushohi veyasche vemayya vihe mesaav ad ramsha:
Vehannogea bivsar hazzav yechabbes begadav verachatz bammayim vetame ad-haarev
Udeyikrav bivsar dovana yetzabba levushohi veyasche vemayya vihe mesaav ad ramsha:
Vechi-yarok hazzav battahor vechibbes begadav verachatz bammayim vetame ad-haarev
Vaare yerok dovana bedachya vitzabba levushohi veyasche vemayya vihe mesaav ad ramsha:
Vechol-hammerkav asher yirkav alav hazzav yitma
Vechol merkeva di yirkuv alohi dovana yehe mesaav:
Vechol-hannogea bechol asher yihye tachtav yitma ad-haarev vehannose otam yechabbes begadav verachatz bammayim vetame ad-haarev
Vechol deyikrav bechol di yehe techotohi yehe mesaav ad ramsha udeyittol yathon yetzabba levushohi veyasche vemayya vihe mesaav ad ramsha:
Vechol asher yigga-bo hazzav veyadav lo-shataf bammayim vechibbes begadav verachatz bammayim vetame ad-haarev
Vechol di yikrav beh dovana vidohi la shetaf bemayya vitzabba levushohi veyasche vemayya vihe mesaav ad ramsha:
Ucheli-cheres asher-yigga-bo hazzav yishshaver vechol-keli-etz yishshatef bammayim
Uman dachasaf di yikrav beh dovana yittavar vechol man dea yishtattaf bemayya:
Vechi-yithar hazzav mizzovo vesafar lo shivat yamim letohorato vechibbes begadav verachatz besaro bemayim chayyim vetaher
