Vaare yidke dovana middoveh veyimne leh shivat yomin ledachuteh vitzabba levushohi veyasche visreh beme mabbua veyidke:
Uvayyom hashshemini yikkach-lo shete torim o shene bene yona uva lifne Adonai el-petach ohel moed unetanam el-hakkohen
Uveyoma teminaa yissav leh tarten shafninin o teren bene yona veyete lokodam Adonai litra mashkan zimna veyitteninnun lechahana:
Veasa otam hakkohen echad chattat vehaechad ola vechipper alav hakkohen lifne Adonai mizzovo
Veyabed yathon kahana chad chattata vechad alata vichapper alohi kahana kodam Adonai middoveh:
Veish ki-tetze mimmennu shichvat-zara verachatz bammayim et-kol-besaro vetame ad-haarev
Ugevar are tippok minneh shichvat zara veyasche vemayya yat kol bisreh vihe mesaav ad ramsha:
Vechol-beged vechol-or asher-yihye alav shichvat-zara vechubbas bammayim vetame ad-haarev
Vechol levush vechol meshach di yehe alohi shichvat zara veyitztabba bemayya vihe mesaav ad ramsha:
Veishsha asher yishkav ish otah shichvat-zara verachatzu vammayim vetamu ad-haarev
Veitteta di yishkuv gevar yata shichvat zara veyaschun bemayya veyisavun ad ramsha:
Veishsha ki-tihye zava dam yihye zovah bivsarah shivat yamim tihye veniddatah vechol-hannogea bah yitma ad-haarev
Veitteta are tehe dayva dam yehe dova bevisra shiva yomin tehe verichuka vechol deyikrav ba yehe mesaav ad ramsha:
Vechol asher tishkav alav beniddatah yitma vechol asher-teshev alav yitma
Vechol di tishkuv alohi berichuka yehe mesaav vechol di tetev alohi yehe mesaav:
Vechol-hannogea bemishkavah yechabbes begadav verachatz bammayim vetame ad-haarev
Vechol deyikrav bemishkeva yetzabba levushohi veyasche vemayya vihe mesaav ad ramsha:
Vechol-hannogea bechol-keli asher-teshev alav yechabbes begadav verachatz bammayim vetame ad-haarev
Vechol deyikrav bechol mana di tetev alohi yetzabba levushohi veyasche vemayya vihe mesaav ad ramsha:
Veim al-hammishkav hu o al-hakkeli asher-hiv yoshevet-alav benogo-vo yitma ad-haarev
Veim al mishkeva hu o al mana di hi yatva alohi bemikreveh beh yehe mesaav ad ramsha:
Veim shachov yishkav ish otah utehi niddatah alav vetame shivat yamim vechol-hammishkav asher-yishkav alav yitma
Veim mishkav yishkuv gevar yata utehe richuka alohi vihe mesaav shivat yomin vechol mishkeva di yishkuv alohi yehe mesaav:
Veishsha ki-yazuv zov damah yamim rabbim belo et-niddatah o chi-tazuv al-niddatah kol-yeme zov tumatah kime niddatah tihye temea hiv
Veitteta are yeduv dov dema yomin saggiin bela iddan richuka o are teduv al richuka kol yome dov sovta keyomeh richuka tehe mesoova hi:
Kol-hammishkav asher-tishkav alav kol-yeme zovah kemishkav niddatah yihye-llah vechol-hakkeli asher teshev alav tame yihye ketumat niddatah
Kol mishkeva di tishkuv alohi kol yome dova kemishkav richuka yehe la vechol mana di tetev alohi mesaav yehe kesoavat richuka:
Vechol-hannogea bam yitma vechibbes begadav verachatz bammayim vetame ad-haarev
Vechol deyikrav behon yehe mesaav vitzabba levushohi veyasche vemayya vihe mesaav ad ramsha:
Veim-tahara mizzovah vesafra lah shivat yamim veachar tithar
Veim dechiat middova vetimne la shivat yomin uvatar ken tidke:
Uvayyom hashshemini tikkach-lah shete torim o shene bene yona vehevia otam el-hakkohen el-petach ohel moed
Uveyoma teminaa tissav la tarten shafninin o teren bene yona vetayti yathon levat kahana litra mashkan zimna:
Veasa hakkohen et-haechad chattat veet-haechad ola vechipper aleha hakkohen lifne Adonai mizzov tumatah
Veyabed kahana yat chad chattata veyat chad alata vichapper ala kahana kodam Adonai middov sovta:
Vehizzartem et-bene-yisrael mittumatam velo yamutu betumatam betammeam et-mishkani asher betocham
Vetafreshun yat bene yisrael missoavathon vela yemutun besoavathon besaavhon yat mashkeni di venehon:
Zot torat hazzav vaasher tetze mimmennu shichvat-zera letoma-vah
Da orayta dedovna vedi tippok minneh shichvat zara leistaava va:
Vehaddava beniddatah vehazzav et-zovo lazzachar velannekeva uleish asher yishkav im-temea
Velidsauveta berichuka veliddaiv yat doveh lidchar ulenukba veligvar di yishkuv im mesaava:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe achare mot shene bene aharon bekorvatam lifne-Adonai vayyamutu
Umallil Adonai im mshe batar demitu teren bene aharon bekarovehon eshshata nuchereta kodam Adonai umitu:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe dabber el-aharon achicha veal-yavo vechol-et el-hakkodesh mibbet lapparochet el-pene hakkapporet asher al-haaron velo yamut ki beanan erae al-hakkapporet
Vaamar Adonai lemshe mallel im aharon achuch vela yehe alel bechol iddan lekudesha miggav lefaruchta lokodam kappurta di al arona vela yemut are baanana ana mitgeli al bet kappurta:
Bezot yavo aharon el-hakkodesh befar ben-bakar lechattat veayil leola
Beda yehe alel aharon lekudesha betor bar tore lechattata udechar laalata:
Ketonet-bad kodesh yilbash umichnese-vad yihyu al-besaro uveavnet bad yachgor uvemitznefet bad yitznof bigde-kodesh hem verachatz bammayim et-besaro ulevesham
Kittuna devutza kudesha yilbash umichnesin devutz yehon al bisreh uvehemyana devutza yesar uvemitznefta devutza yachet beresheh levushe kudesha innun veyasche vemayya yat bisreh veyalbeshinnun:
Umeet adat bene yisrael yikkach shene-seire izzim lechattat veayil echad leola
Umin kenishta divne yisrael yissav teren tzefire izzin lechattata udechar chad laalata:
Vehikriv aharon et-par hachattat asher-lo vechipper baado uvead beto
Vikarev aharon yat tora dechattata di leh vichapper alohi veal enash beteh:
Velakach et-shene hasseirim veheemid otam lifne Adonai petach ohel moed
Veyissav yat teren tzefirin vikim yathon kodam Adonai bitra mashkan zimna:
Venatan aharon al-shene hasseirim goralot goral echad la-Adonai vegoral echad laazazel
Veyitten aharon al teren tzefirin advin adva chad lishma daAdonai veadva chad laazazel:
Vehikriv aharon et-hassair asher ala alav haggoral la-Adonai veasahu chattat
Vikarev aharon yat tzefira di selik alohi adva lishma daAdonai veyabidineh chattata:
Vehassair asher ala alav haggoral laazazel yoomad-chay lifne Adonai lechapper alav leshallach oto laazazel hammidbara
Utzefira di selik alohi adva laazazel yittakam kad chay kodam Adonai lechappara alohi leshallach yateh laazazel lemadbera:
Vehikriv aharon et-par hachattat asher-lo vechipper baado uvead beto veshachat et-par hachattat asher-lo
Vikarev aharon yat tora dechattata di leh vichapper alohi veal enash beteh veyikkos yat tora dechattata di leh:
Velakach melo-hammachta gachale-esh meal hammizbeach millifne Adonai umelo chofnav ketoret sammim dakka vehevi mibbet lapparochet
Veyissav mele machtita gumerin deeshsha meillave madbecha min kodam Adonai umele chofnohi ketoret busemin dakkikin veyael miggav lefaruchta:
Venatan et-hakketoret al-haesh lifne Adonai vechissa anan hakketoret et-hakkapporet asher al-haedut velo yamut
Veyitten yat ketoret busemayya al eshshata lokodam Adonai vechafe anana ketarta yat kappurta di al sahaduta vela yemut:
Velakach middam happar vehizza veetzbao al-pene hakkapporet kedma velifne hakkapporet yazze sheva-peamim min-haddam beetzbao
Veyissav middema detora veyaddi veetzbeeh al appe kappurta kidduma velokodam kappurta yaddi sheva zimnin min dema beetzbeeh:
Veshachat et-seir hachattat asher laam vehevi et-damo el-mibbet lapparochet veasa et-damo kaasher asa ledam happar vehizza oto al-hakkapporet velifne hakkapporet
Veyikkos yat tzefira dechattata di leamma veyael yat demeh lemiggav lefaruchta veyabed lidmeh kema di avad lidma detora veyaddi yateh al kappurta velokodam kappurta:
Vechipper al-hakkodesh mittumot bene yisrael umippishehem lechol-chattotam vechen yaase leohel moed hashshochen ittam betoch tumotam
Vichapper al kudesha missoavat bene yisrael umimmerdehon lechol chataehon vechen yabed lemashkan zimna deshare immehon bego soavathon:
Vechol-adam lo-yihye beohel moed bevoo lechapper bakkodesh ad-tzeto vechipper baado uvead beto uvead kol-kehal yisrael
Vechol enash la yehe bemashkan zimna bemealeh lechappara vekudesha ad mippekeh vichapper alohi veal enash beteh veal kol kehala deyisrael:
Veyatza el-hammizbeach asher lifne-Adonai vechipper alav velakach middam happar umiddam hassair venatan al-karnot hammizbeach saviv
Veyippok lemadbecha di kodam Adonai vichapper alohi veyissav middema detora umiddema ditzfira veyitten al karnat madbecha sechor sechor:
Vehizza alav min-haddam beetzbao sheva peamim vetiharo vekiddesho mittumot bene yisrael
Veyadde alohi min dema beetzbeeh sheva zimnin vidakkinneh vikaddeshinneh missoavat bene yisrael:
Vechilla mikkapper et-hakkodesh veet-ohel moed veet-hammizbeach vehikriv et-hassair hechay
Vishetze millechappara al kudesha veal mashkan zimna veal madbecha vikarev yat tzefira chayya:
Vesamach aharon et-shete yadav al rosh hassair hachay vehitvadda alav et-kol-avonot bene yisrael veet-kol-pishehem lechol-chattotam venatan otam al-rosh hassair veshillach beyad-ish itti hammidbara

Veyismoch aharon yat tarten yedohi al resh tzefira chayya veyivadde alohi yat kol avayat bene yisrael veyat kol merdehon lechol chataehon veyitten yathon al resh tzefira vishallach beyad gevar dizmin limhach lemadbera:
Venasa hassair alav et-kol-avonotam el-eretz gezera veshillach et-hassair bammidbar
Veyittol tzefira alohi yat kol chovehon leara dela yatva vishallach yat tzefira bemadbera:
Uva aharon el-ohel moed ufashat et-bigde habbad asher lavash bevoo el-hakkodesh vehinnicham sham
Veyeol aharon lemashkan zimna veyashlach yat levushe vutza di levash bemealeh lekudesha veyatzneinnun tamman:
Verachatz et-besaro vammayim bemakom kadosh velavash et-begadav veyatza veasa et-olato veet-olat haam vechipper baado uvead haam
Veyasche yat bisreh bemayya baatar kaddish veyilbash yat levushohi veyippok veyabed yat alateh veyat alat amma vichappar alohi veal amma:
Veet chelev hachattat yaktir hammizbecha
Veyat tarba dechattata yassek lemadbecha:
Vehameshalleach et-hassair laazazel yechabbes begadav verachatz et-besaro bammayim veachare-chen yavo el-hammachane
Udemovil yat tzefira laazazel yetzabba levushohi veyasche yat bisreh bemayya uvatar ken yeol lemashrita:
Veet par hachattat veet seir hachattat asher huva et-damam lechapper bakkodesh yotzi el-michutz lammachane vesarfu vaesh et-orotam veet-besaram veet-pirsham
Veyat tora dechattata veyat tzefira dechattata di ittaal middimhon lechappara vekudesha yittappekun lemibbara lemashrita veyokdun benura yat mashkehon veyat bisrehon veyat ochlehon:
Vehassoref otam yechabbes begadav verachatz et-besaro bammayim veachare-chen yavo el-hammachane
Udemokid yathon yetzabba levushohi veyasche yat bisreh bemayya uvatar ken yeol lemashrita:
Vehayta lachem lechukkat olam bachodesh hashshevii beasor lachodesh teannu et-nafshotechem vechol-melacha lo taasu haezrach vehagger haggar betochechem
Utehe lechon likyam alam beyarcha sheviaa beasra leyarcha teannun yat nafshatechon vechol ivida la tabedun yatztziva vegiyyora deyitgayyerun benechon:
Ki-vayyom hazze yechapper alechem letaher etchem mikkol chattotechem lifne Adonai titharu
Are veyoma haden yechapper alechon ledakkaa yatchon mikkol chovechon kodam Adonai tidkun:
Shabbat shabbaton hi lachem veinnitem et-nafshotechem chukkat olam
Shevat shevata hi lechon uteannun yat nafshatechon keyam alam:
Vechipper hakkohen asher-yimshach oto vaasher yemalle et-yado lechahen tachat aviv velavash et-bigde habbad bigde hakkodesh
Vichappar kahana di rabbi yateh vedi yekarev yat kurbaneh leshammasha techot avuhi veyilbash yat levushe vutza levushe kudesha:
Vechipper et-mikdash hakkodesh veet-ohel moed veet-hammizbeach yechapper veal hakkohanim veal-kol-am hakkahal yechapper
Vichappar al mikdash kudesha veal mashkan zimna veal madbecha yechappar veal kahanayya veal kol amma dikhala yechappar:
Vehayta-zzot lachem lechukkat olam lechapper al-bene yisrael mikkol-chattotam achat bashshana vayyaas kaasher tzivva Adonai et-moshe
Utehe da lechon likyam alam lechappara al bene yisrael mikkol chovehon chada beshatta vaavad kema di fakked Adonai yat mshe:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Dabber el-aharon veel-banav veel kol-bene yisrael veamarta alehem ze haddavar asher-tzivva Adonai lemor
Mallel im aharon veim benohi veim kol bene yisrael vetemar lehon den pitgama di fakkid Adonai lememar:
Ish ish mibbet yisrael asher yishchat shor o-chesev o-ez bammachane o asher yishchat michutz lammachane
Gevar gevar mibbet yisrael di yikkos tor o immar o izza bemashrita o di yikkos mibbara lemashrita:
Veel-petach ohel moed lo hevio lehakriv korban la-Adonai lifne mishkan Adonai dam yechashev laish hahu dam shafach venichrat haish hahu mikkerev ammo
Velitra mashkan zimna la ayteh lekarava kurbana kodam Adonai kodam mashkena daAdonai dema yitchashshav legavra hahu dema ashad veyishtetze anasha hahu miggo ammeh:
Lemaan asher yaviu bene yisrael et-zivchehem asher hem zovchim al-pene hassade vehevium la-Adonai el-petach ohel moed el-hakkohen vezavchu zivche shelamim la-Adonai otam
Bedil di yaytun bene yisrael yat divchehon di innun davchin al appe chakla veyaytunnun lokodam Adonai litra mashkan zimna levat kahana veyikkesun nichsat kudeshin kodam Adonai yathon:
Vezarak hakkohen et-haddam al-mizbach Adonai petach ohel moed vehiktir hachelev lereach nichoach la-Adonai
Veyizrok kahana yat dema al madbecha daAdonai bitra mashkan zimna veyassek tarba leitkabbala veraava kodam Adonai:
Velo-yizbechu od et-zivchehem lasseirim asher hem zonim acharehem chukkat olam tihye-zzot lahem ledorotam
Vela yidbechun od yat divchehon lashshedin di innun taan batrehon keyam alam tehe da lehon ledarehon:
Vaalehem tomar ish ish mibbet yisrael umin-hagger asher-yagur betocham asher-yaale ola o-zavach
Ulehon temar gevar gevar mibbet yisrael umin giyyora deyitgayyerun benechon di yassek alata o nichsat kudeshayya:
Veel-petach ohel moed lo yeviennu laasot oto la-Adonai venichrat haish hahu meammav
Velitra mashkan zimna la aytinneh lemebad yateh kodam Adonai veyishtetze anasha hahu meammeh:
Veish ish mibbet yisrael umin-hagger haggar betocham asher yochal kol-dam venatatti fanay bannefesh haochelet et-haddam vehichratti otah mikkerev ammah
Ugevar gevar mibbet yisrael umin giyyora deyitgayyerun benechon di yechul kol dema veetten rugezi baanasha deyechul yat dema veeshetze yateh miggo ammeh:
Ki nefesh habbasar baddam hiv vaani netattiv lachem al-hammizbeach lechapper al-nafshotechem ki-haddam hu bannefesh yechapper
Are nefash bisra bidma hi vaana yehavitteh lechon al madbecha lechappara al nafshatechon are dema hu al nafsha mechapper:
Al-ken amarti livne yisrael kol-nefesh mikkem lo-tochal dam vehagger haggar betochechem lo-yochal dam
Al ken amarit livne yisrael kol enash minnechon la yechul dema vegiyyora deyitgayyerun benechon la yechul dema:
Veish ish mibbene yisrael umin-hagger haggar betocham asher yatzud tzed chayya o-of asher yeachel veshafach et-damo vechissahu beafar
Ugevar gevar min bene yisrael umin giyyora deyitgayyerun benechon di yetzud tzeda chayta o ofa di mitachel veyeshod yat demeh vichassinneh beafra:
Ki-nefesh kol-basar damo venafsho hu vaomar livne yisrael dam kol-basar lo tochelu ki nefesh kol-basar damo hiv kol-ochlav yikkaret
Are nefash kol bisra demeh benafsheh hu vaamarit livne yisrael dam kol bisra la techlun are nefash kol bisra demeh hi kol deyechlinneh yishtetze:
Vechol-nefesh asher tochal nevela uterefa baezrach uvagger vechibbes begadav verachatz bammayim vetame ad-haerev vetaher
Vechol enash di yechul nevila utevira beyatztziva uvegiyyora vitzabba levushohi veyasche vemayya vihe mesaav ad ramsha veyidke:
Veim lo yechabbes uvesaro lo yirchatz venasa avono
Veim la yetzabba uvisreh la yasche vikabbel choveh:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael veamarta alehem ani Adonai elohechem
Mallel im bene yisrael vetemar lehon ana Adonai elahachon:
Kemaase eretz-mitzrayim asher yeshavtem-bah lo taasu uchemaase eretz-kenaan asher ani mevi etchem shamma lo taasu uvechukkotehem lo telechu
Keovade amma deara demitzrayim di yetevtun ba la tabedun ucheovade amma deara dichnaan di ana mael yatchon tamman la tabedun uvenimosehon la tehachun:
Et-mishpatay taasu veet-chukkotay tishmeru lalechet bahem ani Adonai elohechem
Yat dinay tabedun veyat keyamay titterun lehallacha behon ana Adonai elahachon:
Ushemartem et-chukkotay veet-mishpatay asher yaase otam haadam vachay bahem ani Adonai
Vetitterun yat keyamay veyat dinay di yabed yathon anasha veyeche vehon lechayye alma ana Adonai:
Ish ish el-kol-sheer besaro lo tikrevu legallot erva ani Adonai
Gevar gevar lechol kariv bisreh la tikrevun legallaa erya ana Adonai:
Ervat avicha veervat immecha lo tegalle immecha hiv lo tegalle ervatah
Eryat avuch veeryat immach la tegalle immach hi la tegalle eryeta:
Ervat eshet-avicha lo tegalle ervat avicha hiv
Eryat ittat avuch la tegalle eryat avuch hi:
Ervat achotcha vat-avicha o vat-immecha moledet bayit o moledet chutz lo tegalle ervatan
Eryat achatach bat avuch o vat immach dilida min avuch min ittat ochori o min immach ligvar ochoran la tegalle eryathen:
Ervat bat-bincha o vat-bittecha lo tegalle ervatan ki ervatcha henna
Eryat bat berach o vat berattach la tegalle eryathen are eryetach innun:
Ervat bat-eshet avicha moledet avicha achotcha hiv lo tegalle ervatah
Eryat bat ittat avuch dilida min avuch achatach hi la tegalle eryeta:
Ervat achot-avicha lo tegalle sheer avicha hiv
Eryat achat avuch la tegalle karivat avuch hi:
Ervat achot-immecha lo tegalle ki-sheer immecha hiv
Eryat achat immach la tegalle are karivat immach hi:
Ervat achi-avicha lo tegalle el-ishto lo tikrav dodatcha hiv
Eryat ach avuch la tegalle leitteteh la tikrav ittat ach avuch hi:
Ervat kallatcha lo tegalle eshet bincha hiv lo tegalle ervatah
Eryat kalletach la tegalle ittat berach hi la tegalle eryeta:
Ervat eshet-achicha lo tegalle ervat achicha hiv
Eryat ittat achuch la tegalle eryat achuch hi:
Ervat ishsha uvittah lo tegalle et-bat-benah veet-bat-bittah lo tikkach legallot ervatah shaara henna zimma hiv
Eryat itteta uveratta la tegalle yat bat bera veyat bat beratta la tissav legallaa eryeta karivan innun etzat chitin hi:
Veishsha el-achotah lo tikkach litzror legallot ervatah aleha bechayyeha
Veitteta im achata la tissav leakaa legallaa eryeta ala bechayyayha:
Veel-ishsha beniddat tumatah lo tikrav legallot ervatah
Uleitteta berichuk sovta la tikrav legallaa eryeta:
Veel-eshet amitcha lo-titten shechovtecha lezara letoma-vah
Uveittat chavrach la titten shechuvtach lezara leistaava va:
Umizzaracha lo-titten lehaavir lammolech velo techallel et-shem elohecha ani Adonai
Umibbenaych la titten leabara lemolech vela tachel yat shema deelahach ana Adonai:
Veet-zachar lo tishkav mishkeve ishsha toeva hiv
Veim dechura la tishkuv mishkeve itteta toevta hi:
Uvechol-behema lo-titten shechovtecha letoma-vah veishsha lo-taamod lifne vehema lerivah tevel hu
Uvechol beira la titten shechuvtach leistaava va veitteta la tekum kodam beira lemishlat ba tivla hu:
Al-tittammeu bechol-elle ki vechol-elle nitmeu haggoyim asher-ani meshalleach mippenechem
La tistaavun bechol illen are vechal illen istaavu ammayya di ana magle min kodamechon:
Vattitma haaretz vaefkod avonah aleha vattaki haaretz et-yoshveha
Veistaavat ara veasarit chova ala verokenat ara yat yatvaha:
Ushemartem attem et-chukkotay veet-mishpatay velo taasu mikkol hattoevot haelle haezrach vehagger haggar betochechem
Vetitterun attun yat keyamay veyat dinay vela tabedun mikkol toevta haillen yatztziva vegiyyora deyitgayyerun benechon:
Ki et-kol-hattoevot hael asu anshe-haaretz asher lifnechem vattitma haaretz
Are yat kol toevta haillen avadu enashe ara di kodamechon veistaavat ara:
Velo-taki haaretz etchem betammaachem otah kaasher kaa et-haggoy asher lifnechem
Vela teroken ara yatchon besoovechon yata kema derokenat yat ammayya di kodamechon:
Ki kol-asher yaase mikkol hattoevot haelle venichretu hannefashot haosot mikkerev ammam
Are kol di yabed mikkol toevta haillen veyishtetzun nafshata diyabedun miggo ammehon:
Ushemartem et-mishmarti levilti asot mechukkot hattoevot asher naasu lifnechem velo tittammeu bahem ani Adonai elohechem
Vetitterun yat matterat memri bedil dela lemebad minnimose toevta deitavada kodamechon vela tistaavun behon ana Adonai elahachon:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Dabber el-kol-adat bene-yisrael veamarta alehem kedoshim tihyu ki kadosh ani Adonai elohechem
Mallel im kol kenishta divne yisrael vetemar lehon kaddishin tehon are kaddish ana Adonai elahachon:
Ish immo veaviv tirau veet-shabbetotay tishmoru ani Adonai elohechem
Gevar min immeh umin avuhi tehon dachalin veyat yome shabbayya dili titrun ana Adonai elahachon:
Al-tifnu el-haelilim velohe massecha lo taasu lachem ani Adonai elohechem
La titpenun batar taavan vedachalan demattecha la tabedun lechon ana Adonai elahachon:
Vechi tizbechu zevach shelamim la-Adonai lirtzonchem tizbachuhu
Vaare tikkesun nichsat kudeshayya kodam Adonai leraava lechon tikkesunneh:
Beyom zivchachem yeachel umimmochorat vehannotar ad-yom hashshelishi baesh yissaref
Beyoma deyitneches yitachel uveyoma devatrohi udeishtaar ad yoma telitaa benura yittokad:
Veim heachol yeachel bayyom hashshelishi piggul hu lo yeratze
Veim itachala yitachel beyoma telitaa merachak hu la yehe leraava:
Veochlav avono yissa ki-et-kodesh Adonai chillel venichreta hannefesh hahiv meammeha
Udeyechlinneh choveh yekabbel are yat kudesha daAdonai achel veyishtetze anasha hahu meammeh:
Uvekutzrechem et-ketzir artzechem lo techalle peat sadcha liktzor veleket ketzircha lo telakket
Uvemechtzadchon yat chatzada dearachon la teshetze pata dechaklach lemechtzad ulekata dachatzadach la telakket:
Vecharmecha lo teolel uferet karmecha lo telakket leani velagger taazov otam ani Adonai elohechem
Vecharmach la tealel venitra decharmach la telakket leanye ulegiyyore tishbok yathon ana Adonai elahachon:
Lo tignovu velo-techachashu velo-teshakkeru ish baamito
La tignevun vela techaddevun vela teshakkerun enash bechavreh:
Velo-tishshavu vishmi lashshaker vechillalta et-shem elohecha ani Adonai
Vela tishshavun bishmi leshikra vetachel yat shema deelahach ana Adonai:
Lo-taashok et-reacha velo tigzol lo-talin peullat sachir ittecha ad-boker
La taashok yat chavrach vela teannes la tevit agra daagira levatach ad tzafra:
Lo-tekallel cheresh velifne ivver lo titten michshol veyareta meelohecha ani Adonai
La telut dela shama vekodam dela chaze la tesim takla vetidchal meelahach ana Adonai:
Lo-taasu avel bammishpat lo-tissa fene-dal velo tedar pene gadol betzedek tishpot amitecha
La tabedun shekar bedina la tissav appe maskena vela tedar appe rabba bekusheta tedineh lechavrach:
Lo-telech rachil beammecha lo taamod al-dam reecha ani Adonai
La techul kuretzin beammach la tekum al dema dechavrach ana Adonai:
Lo-tisna et-achicha bilvavecha hocheach tochiach et-amitecha velo-tissa alav chet
La tisne yat achuch belibbach ochacha tochach yat chavrach vela tekabbel al di leh chova:
Lo-tikkom velo-tittor et-bene ammecha veahavta lereacha kamocha ani Adonai
La tikkom vela tittar devavu livne ammach uterachem lechavrach kevatach ana Adonai:
Et-chukkotay tishmoru behemtecha lo-tarbia kilayim sadcha lo-tizra kilayim uveged kilayim shaatnez lo yaale alecha
Yat keyamay titterun beirach la tarkev eruvin chaklach la tizra eruvin ulevush eruvin shaatneza la yissak alach:
Veish ki-yishkav et-ishsha shichvat-zera vehiv shifcha necherefet leish vehofde lo nifdata o chufsha lo nittan-lah bikkoret tihye lo yumetu ki-lo chuppasha
Ugevar are yishkuv im itteta shichvat zara vehi amta achida ligvar veitperaka la itperikat bechaspa o cheruta la ityehivat la bishtar bikkurta tehe la yumetun are la itchararat:
Vehevi et-ashamo la-Adonai el-petach ohel moed el asham
Veyayti yat ashmeh kodam Adonai litra mashkan zimna dechar laashama:
Vechipper alav hakkohen beel haasham lifne Adonai al-chattato asher chata venislach lo mechattato asher chata
Vichapper alohi chahana bedichra daashama kodam Adonai al chovteh di chav veyishtevek leh mechovteh di chav:
Vechi-tavou el-haaretz unetatem kol-etz maachal vaaraltem orlato et-piryo shalosh shanim yihye lachem arelim lo yeachel
Vaare tealun leara vetitztzevun kol illan demechal uterachakun rachaka yat ibbeh telat shenin yehe lechon merachak laavada la yitachel:
Uvashshana harviit yihye kol-piryo kodesh hillulim la-Adonai
Uveshatta revieta yehe kol ibbeh kodesh tushbechan kodam Adonai:
Uvashshana hachamishit tochlu et-piryo lehosif lachem tevuato ani Adonai elohechem
Uveshatta chamishsheta techlun yat ibbeh leosafa lechon alalteh ana Adonai elahachon:
Lo tochlu al-haddam lo tenachashu velo teonenu
La techlun al dema la tenachashun vela teonun:
Lo takkifu peat roshchem velo tashchit et peat zekanecha
La takkefun pata dereshchon vela techabbel yat pata dediknach:
Veseret lanefesh lo tittenu bivsarchem uchetovet kaaka lo tittenu bachem ani Adonai
Vechibbul al mit la tittenun bevisreychon verushemin charitin la tittenun bechon ana Adonai:
Al-techallel et-bittecha lehaznotah velo-tizne haaretz umala haaretz zimma
La tachel yat berattach leatayuta vela tite ara vetitmele ara etzat chitin:
Et-shabbetotay tishmoru umikdashi tirau ani Adonai
Yat yome shabbayya dili titrun ulevet makdeshi tehon dachalin ana Adonai:
Al-tifnu el-haovot veel-hayyiddeonim al-tevakshu letoma vahem ani Adonai elohechem
La titpenun batar biddin udechuru la titbeun leistaava behon ana Adonai elahachon:
Mippene seva takum vehadarta pene zaken veyareta meelohecha ani Adonai
Min kodam desabbar beorayta tekum utehaddar appe sava vetidchal meelahach ana Adonai:
Vechi-yagur ittecha ger beartzechem lo tonu oto
Vaare yitgayyar immach giyyora bearachon la tonun yateh:
Keezrach mikkem yihye lachem hagger haggar ittechem veahavta lo kamocha ki-gerim heyitem beeretz mitzrayim ani Adonai elohechem
Keyatztziva minnechon yehe lechon giyyora deyitgayyar benechon uterachem leh kevatach are dayyarin havetun beara demitzrayim ana Adonai elahachon:
Lo-taasu avel bammishpat bammidda bammishkal uvammesura
La tabedun shekar bedin bimshachta bematkela uvimchilta:
Mozne tzedek avne-tzedek efat tzedek vehin tzedek yihye lachem ani Adonai elohechem asher-hotzeti etchem meeretz mitzrayim
Moznavan dikshot matkelan dikshot mechilan dikshot vehinin dikshot yehon lechon ana Adonai elahachon di appekit yatchon meara demitzrayim:
Ushemartem et-kol-chukkotay veet-kol-mishpatay vaasitem otam ani Adonai
Vetitterun yat kol keyamay veyat kol dinay vetabedun yathon ana Adonai:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Veel-bene yisrael tomar ish ish mibbene yisrael umin-hagger haggar beyisrael asher yitten mizzaro lammolech mot yumat am haaretz yirgemuhu vaaven
Veim bene yisrael temar gevar gevar mibbene yisrael umin giyyora deyitgayrun beyisrael di yitten mizzareh lemolech itketala yitketel amma vet yisrael yirgemunneh beavna:
Vaani etten et-panay baish hahu vehichratti oto mikkerev ammo ki mizzaro natan lammolech lemaan tamme et-mikdashi ulechallel et-shem kodshi
Vaana etten yat rugezi begavra hahu veeshetze yateh miggo ammeh are mizzareh yehav lemolech bedil lesaava yat makdeshi uleachalla yat shema dekudeshi:
Veim halem yalimu am haaretz et-enehem min-haish hahu betitto mizzaro lammolech levilti hamit oto
Veim michbash yichbeshun amma vet yisrael yat enehon min gavra hahu bidyahev mizzareh lemolech bedil dela lekattala yateh:
Vesamti ani et-panay baish hahu uvemishpachto vehichratti oto veet kol-hazzonim acharav liznot achare hammolech mikkerev ammam
Veeshavve ana yat rugezi begavra hahu uvisadohi veeshetze yateh veyat kol detaan batrohi lemite batar molech miggo ammehon:
Vehannefesh asher tifne el-haovot veel-hayyiddeonim liznot acharehem venatatti et-panay bannefesh hahiv vehichratti oto mikkerev ammo
Veenash di yitpene batar biddin udechuru lemite vatrehon veetten yat rugezi baanasha hahi veeshetze yateh miggo ammeh:
Vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim ki ani Adonai elohechem
Vetitkaddeshun utehon kaddishin are ana Adonai elahachon:
Ushemartem et-chukkotay vaasitem otam ani Adonai mekaddishchem
Vetitterun yat keyamay vetabedun yathon ana Adonai mekaddishchon:
Ki-ish ish asher yekallel et-aviv veet-immo mot yumat aviv veimmo killel damav bo
Are gevar gevar di yelut yat avuhi veyat immeh itketala yitketel avuhi veimmeh lat ketala chayyav:
Veish asher yinaf et-eshet ish asher yinaf et-eshet reehu mot-yumat hannoef vehannoafet
Ugevar di yeguf yat ittat gevar di yeguf yat ittat chavreh itketala yitketel gayyafa vegayyafta:
Veish asher yishkav et-eshet aviv ervat aviv gilla mot-yumetu shenehem demehem bam
Ugevar di yishkuv im ittat avuhi eryeta daavuhi galli itketala yitkattelun tarvehon ketala chayyavin:
Veish asher yishkav et-kallato mot yumetu shenehem tevel asu demehem bam
Ugevar di yishkuv yat kalleteh itketala yitkattelun tarvehon tivla avadu ketala chayyavin:
Veish asher yishkav et-zachar mishkeve ishsha toeva asu shenehem mot yumatu demehem bam
Ugevar di yishkuv yat dechura mishkeve itteta toevta avadu tarvehon itketala yitkattelun ketala chayyavin:
Veish asher yikkach et-ishsha veet-immah zimma hiv baesh yisrefu oto veethen velo-tihye zimma betochechem
Ugevar di yissav yat itteta veyat imma etzat chitin hi benura yokdun yateh veyathen vela tehe etzat chitin benechon:
Veish asher yitten shechovto bivhema mot yumat veet-habbehema taharogu
Ugevar di yitten shechavteh bivira itketala yitketel veyat beira tiktelun:
Veishsha asher tikrav el-kol-behema leriva otah veharagta et-haishsha veet-habbehema mot yumatu demehem bam
Veitteta di tikrav lechol beira lemishlat ba vetiktol yat itteta veyat beira itketala yitkattelun ketala chayyavin:
Veish asher-yikkach et-achoto bat-aviv o vat-immo veraa et-ervatah vehi-tire et-ervato chesed hu venichretu leene bene ammam ervat achoto gilla avono yissa
Ugevar di yissav yat achateh bat avuhi o vat immeh veyecheze yat eryeta vehi techeze yat eryeteh kelana hu veyishtetzun leene bene ammehon eryat achateh galli choveh yekabbel:
Veish asher-yishkav et-ishsha dava vegilla et-ervatah et-mekorah heera vehiv gilleta et-mekor dameha venichretu shenehem mikkerev ammam
Ugevar di yishkuv yat itteta soavata vigalli yat eryeta yat kelana galli vehi tegalle yat soavat demaha veyishtetzun tarvehon miggo ammehon:
Veervat achot immecha vaachot avicha lo tegalle ki et-sheero heera avonam yissau
Veeryat achat immach vaachat avuch la tegalle are yat kariveh galli chovhen yekabbelun:
Veish asher yishkav et-dodato ervat dodo gilla chetam yissau aririm yamutu
Ugevar di yishkuv yat ittat ach avuhi eryat ach avuhi galli chovhen yekabbelun bela velad yemutun:
Veish asher yikkach et-eshet achiv nidda hiv ervat achiv gilla aririm yihyu
Ugevar di yissav yat ittat achuhi merachaka hi eryeta daachuhi galli bela velad yehon:
Ushemartem et-kol-chukkotay veet-kol-mishpatay vaasitem otam velo-taki etchem haaretz asher ani mevi etchem shamma lashevet bah
Vetitterun yat kol keyamay veyat kol dinay vetabedun yathon vela teroken yatchon ara di ana mael yatchon tamman lemittav ba:
Velo telchu bechukkot haggoy asher-ani meshalleach mippenechem ki et-kol-elle asu vaakutz bam
Vela tehachun benimose ammayya di ana magle min kodamechon are yat kol illen avadu verachik memri yathon:
Vaomar lachem attem tirshu et-admatam vaani ettenenna lachem lareshet otah eretz zavat chalav udevash ani Adonai elohechem asher-hivdalti etchem min-haammim
Vaamarit lechon attun tirtun yat arahon vaana etteninna lechon lemerat yata ara avda chalav udevash ana Adonai elahachon di afreshit yatchon min ammayya:
Vehivdaltem ben-habbehema hattehora lattemea uven-haof hattame lattahor velo-teshakketzu et-nafshotechem babbehema uvaof uvechol asher tirmos haadama asher-hivdalti lachem letamme
Vetafreshun ben beira dachya limsaava uven ofa mesaava lidche vela teshakketzun yat nafshatechon bivira uveofa uvechol di tarchesh ara di afreshit lechon lesaava:
Vihyitem li kedoshim ki kadosh ani Adonai vaavdil etchem min-haammim lihyot li
Utehon kodamay kaddishin are kaddish ana Adonai veafreshit yatchon min ammayya lemeheve falchin kodamay:
Veish o-ishsha ki-yihye vahem ov o yiddeoni mot yumatu baeven yirgemu otam demehem bam
Ugevar o itteta are yehe vehon biddin o dechur itketala yitkattelun beavna yirgemun yathon ketala chayyavin:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe emor el-hakkohanim bene aharon veamarta alehem lenefesh lo-yittamma beammav
Vaamar Adonai lemshe emar lechahanayya bene aharon vetemar lehon al mit la yistaav beammeh:
Ki im-lishero hakkarov elav leimmo uleaviv velivno ulevitto uleachiv
Ellahen lekariveh dekariv leh leimmeh velaavuhi velivreh velivratteh velaachuhi:
Velaachoto habbetula hakkerova elav asher lo-hayta leish lah yittamma
Velaachateh betulta dekariva leh di la havat ligvar la yistaav:
Lo yittamma baal beammav lehechallo
La yistaav rabba veammeh leachaluteh:
Lo-yikrechu korcha berosham ufeat zekanam lo yegallechu uvivsaram lo yisretu saratet
La yimretun merat bereshhon ufata dediknehon la yegallechun uvevisrehon la yechabbelun chibbul:
Kedoshim yihyu lelohehem velo yechallelu shem elohehem ki et-ishshe Adonai lechem elohehem hem makrivim vehayu kodesh
Kaddishin yehon kodam elahahon vela yechallun shema deelahahon are yat kurbenayya daAdonai kurban elahahon innun makrivin vihon kaddishin:
Ishsha zona vachalala lo yikkachu veishsha gerusha meishah lo yikkachu ki-kadosh hu lelohav
Itteta mataya umechallela la yissevun veitteta dimtarcha mibbala la yissevun are kaddish hu kodam elaheh:
Vekiddashto ki-et-lechem elohecha hu makriv kadosh yihye-llach ki kadosh ani Adonai mekaddishchem
Utekaddeshinneh are yat kurban elahach hu mekarev kaddish yehe lach are kaddish ana Adonai mekaddishchon:
Uvat ish kohen ki techel liznot et-aviha hi mechallelet baesh tissaref
Uvat gevar kahen are titchal lemite mikkedushshat avuha hi mittachala benura tittokad:
Vehakkohen haggadol meechav asher-yutzak al-rosho shemen hammishcha umille et-yado lilbosh et-habbegadim et-rosho lo yifra uvegadav lo yifrom
Vechahana deitrabba meachohi d yittarik al resheh mishcha dirvuta vedi kariv yat kurbaneh lemilbash yat levushayya yat resheh la yerabbe ferua ulevushohi la yivza:
Veal kol-nafshot met lo yavo leaviv uleimmo lo yittamma
Veal kol nafshat meta la yeol laavuhi uleimmeh la yistaav:
Umin-hammikdash lo yetze velo yechallel et mikdash elohav ki nezer shemen mishchat elohav alav ani Adonai
Umin makdesha la yippok vela yachel yat makdesha deelaheh are kelil meshach revuta deelaheh alohi ana Adonai:
Vehu ishsha vivtuleha yikkach
Vehu itteta bivtultaha yissav:
Almana ugerusha vachalala zona et-elle lo yikkach ki im-betula meammav yikkach ishsha
Armela umetarcha vechallila mataya yat illen la yissav elahen betulta meammeh yissav itteta:
Velo-yechallel zaro beammav ki ani Adonai mekaddesho
Vela yachel zareh beammeh are ana Adonai mekaddesheh:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Dabber el-aharon lemor ish mizzaracha ledorotam asher yihye vo mum lo yikrav lehakriv lechem elohav
Mallel im aharon lememar gevar mibbenaych ledarehon di yehe veh muma la yikrav lekarava kurbana kodam elaheh:
Ki chol-ish asher-bo mum lo yikrav ish ivver o fisseach o charum o sarua
Are chol gevar di veh muma la yikrav gevar avvir o chagir o charim o seria:
O ish asher-yihye vo shever ragel o shever yad
O gevar di yehe veh tevar ragla o tevar yeda:
O-gibben o-dak o tevallul beeno o garav o yallefet o meroach ashech
O gevin o dukka o chilliz beeneh o garvan o chazazan o meras pachadin:
Kol-ish asher-bo mum mizzera aharon hakkohen lo yiggash lehakriv et-ishshe Adonai mum bo et lechem elohav lo yiggash lehakriv
Kol gevar di veh muma mizzara deaharon kahana la yikrav lekarava yat kurbanayya daAdonai muma veh yat kurban elaheh la yikrav lekarava:
Lechem elohav mikkodshe hakkodashim umin-hakkodashim yochel
Kurban elaheh mikkodesh kudeshayya umin kudeshayya yechul:
Ach el-happarochet lo yavo veel-hammizbeach lo yiggash ki-mum bo velo yechallel et-mikdashay ki ani Adonai mekaddesham
Beram lefaruchta la yeol ulemadbecha la yikrav are muma veh vela yachel yat makdeshay are ana Adonai mekaddishhon:
Vaydabber moshe el-aharon veel-banav veel-kol-bene yisrael
Umallil mshe im aharon veim benohi veim kol bene yisrael:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Dabber el-aharon veel-banav veyinnazru mikkodshe vene-yisrael velo yechallelu et-shem kodshi asher hem makdishim li ani Adonai
Mallel im aharon veim benohi veyipparshun mikkudeshayya divne yisrael vela yechallun yat shema dekudeshi di innun mekaddeshin kodamay ana Adonai:
Emor alehem ledorotechem kol-ish asher-yikrav mikkol-zarachem el-hakkodashim asher yakdishu vene-yisrael la-Adonai vetumato alav venichreta hannefesh hahiv millefanay ani Adonai
Emar lehon ledarechon kol gevar di yikrav mikkol benechon lekudeshayya di yekaddeshun bene yisrael kodam Adonai vesovteh alohi veyishtetze anasha hahi min kodamay ana Adonai:
Ish ish mizzera aharon vehu tzarua o zav bakkodashim lo yochal ad asher yithar vehannogea bechol-teme-nefesh o ish asher-tetze mimmennu shichvat-zara
Gevar gevar mizzara deaharon vehu segir o daiv bekudeshayya la yechul ad di yidke udeyikrav bechol teme nafsha o gevar di tippok minneh shichvat zara:
O-ish asher yigga bechol-sheretz asher yitma-lo o veadam asher yitma-lo lechol tumato
O gevar di yikrav bechol richasha di yistaav leh o vaanasha di yistaav leh lechol sovteh:
Nefesh asher tigga-bo vetama ad-haarev velo yochal min-hakkodashim ki im-rachatz besaro bammayim
Enash di yikrav beh vihe mesaav ad ramsha vela yechul min kudeshayya elahen asche visreh bemayya:
Uva hashshemesh vetaher veachar yochal min-hakkodashim ki lachmo hu
Uvemeal shimsha veyidke uvatar ken yechul min kudeshayya are lachmeh hu:
Nevela uterefa lo yochal letoma-vah ani Adonai
Nevila utevira la yechul leistaava va ana Adonai:
Veshamru et-mishmarti velo-yisu alav chet umetu vo ki yechalleluhu ani Adonai mekaddesham
Veyitterun yat matterat memri vela yekabbelun alohi chova vimutun beh are yechallunneh ana Adonai mekaddishhon:
Vechol-zar lo-yochal kodesh toshav kohen vesachir lo-yochal kodesh
Vechol chillonay la yechul kudesha totava dechahana vaagira la yechul kudesha:
Vechohen ki-yikne nefesh kinyan kaspo hu yochal bo vilid beto hem yochlu velachmo
Vechahen are yikne nefash kinyan kaspeh hu yechul beh vilid beteh innun yechlun belachmeh:
Uvat-kohen ki tihye leish zar hiv bitrumat hakkodashim lo tochel
Uvat kahen are tehe ligvar chillonay hi beafrashut kudeshayya la techul:
Uvat-kohen ki tihye almana ugerusha vezera en lah veshava el-bet aviha kinureha millechem aviha tochel vechol-zar lo-yochal bo
Uvat kahen are tehe armela umetarcha uvar let la utetuv levet avuha keravyutaha millachma daavuha techul vechol chillonay la yechul beh:
Veish ki-yochal kodesh bishgaga veyasaf chamishito alav venatan lakkohen et-hakkodesh
Ugevar are yechul kudesha beshalu veyosef chumesheh alohi vitten lechahana yat kudesha:
Velo yechallelu et-kodshe bene yisrael et asher-yarimu la-Adonai
Vela yechallun yat kudeshayya divne yisrael yat di yafreshun kodam Adonai:
Vehissiu otam avon ashma beochlam et-kodshehem ki ani Adonai mekaddesham
Vikabbelun alehon avayan vechovin bemechalhon besoava yat kudeshehon are ana Adonai mekaddishhon:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Dabber el-aharon veel-banav veel kol-bene yisrael veamarta alehem ish ish mibbet yisrael umin-hagger beyisrael asher yakriv korbano lechol-nidrehem ulechol-nidvotam asher-yakrivu la-Adonai leola

Mallel im aharon veim benohi veim kol bene yisrael vetemar lehon gevar gevar mibbet yisarael umin giyyora beyisrael di yekarev kurbaneh lechol nidrehon ulechal nidvathon di yekarvun kodam Adonai laalata:
Lirtzonchem tamim zachar babbakar bakkesavim uvaizzim
Leraava lechon shelim dechura betore beimrayya uveizzayya:
Kol asher-bo mum lo takrivu ki-lo leratzon yihye lachem
Kol di veh muma la tekarvun are la leraava yehe lechon:
Veish ki-yakriv zevach-shelamim la-Adonai lefalle-neder o lindava babbakar o vatztzon tamim yihye leratzon kol-mum lo yihye-bbo
Ugevar are yekarev nichsat kudeshayya kodam Adonai lefarasha nidra o lindavta betore o veana shelim yehe leraava kol muma la yehe veh:
Avveret o shavur o-charutz o-yabbelet o garav o yallefet lo-takrivu elle la-Adonai veishshe lo-tittenu mehem al-hammizbeach la-Adonai
Avvir o tevir o fesik o yabbelan o garvan o chazazan la tekarvun illen kodam Adonai vekurbana la tittenun minnehon al madbecha kodam Adonai:
Veshor vase sarua vekalut nedava taase oto uleneder lo yeratze
Vetor veimmar yattir vechassir nedavta tabed yateh ulenidra la yehe leraava:
Umauch vechatut venatuk vecharut lo takrivu la-Adonai uveartzechem lo taasu
Vedi meris vedi resis vedi shelif vedi gezir la tekarvun kodam Adonai uvearachon la tabedun:
Umiyyad ben-nechar lo takrivu et-lechem elohechem mikkol-elle ki moshchatam bahem mum bam lo yeratzu lachem
Umin bar ammin la tekarvun yat kurban elahachon mikkol illen are chibbulehon behon muma vehon la leraava yehon lechon:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Shor o-chesev o-ez ki yivvaled vehaya shivat yamim tachat immo umiyyom hashshemini vahala yeratze lekorban ishshe la-Adonai
Tor o immar o izza are yityelid vihe shiva yomin batar immeh umiyyoma teminaa ulehalla yittire lekarava kurbana kodam Adonai:
Veshor o-se oto veet-beno lo tishchatu beyom echad
Vetorta o seta la velivra la tikkesun beyoma chad:
Vechi-tizbechu zevach-toda la-Adonai lirtzonchem tizbachu
Vaare tikkesun nichsat todta kodam Adonai leraava lechon tikkesunneh:
Bayyom hahu yeachel lo-totiru mimmennu ad-boker ani Adonai
Beyoma hahu yitachel la tasharun minneh ad tzafra ana Adonai:
Ushemartem mitzvotay vaasitem otam ani Adonai
Vetitterun pikkoday vetabedun yathon ana Adonai:
Velo techallelu et-shem kodshi venikdashti betoch bene yisrael ani Adonai mekaddishchem
Vela techallelun yat shema dekudeshay veitkaddash bego bene yisrael ana Adonai mekaddishchon:
Hammotzi etchem meeretz mitzrayim lihyot lachem lelohim ani Adonai
Deappik yatchon meara demitzrayim lemeheve lechon lelaha ana Adonai:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael veamarta alehem moade Adonai asher-tikreu otam mikrae kodesh elle hem moaday
Mallel im bene yishrael vetemar lehon moadayya daAdonai di tearun yathon meare kaddish illen innun moaday:
Sheshet yamim tease melacha uvayyom hashshevii shabbat shabbaton mikra-kodesh kol-melacha lo taasu shabbat hiv la-Adonai bechol moshvotechem
Shitta yomin titaved ivida uveyoma sheviaa shevat shevata meara kaddish kol ivida la tabedun shabbeta hi kodam Adonai bechol motvanechon:
Elle moade Adonai mikrae kodesh asher-tikreu otam bemoadam
Illen moadayya daAdonai meare kaddish di tearun yathon bezimnehon:
Bachodesh harishon bearbaa asar lachodesh ben haarbayim pesach la-Adonai
Beyarcha kadmaa bearbeat asra leyarcha ben shimshayya pischa kodam Adonai:
Uvachamishsha asar yom lachodesh hazze chag hammatztzot la-Adonai shivat yamim matztzot tochelu
Uvechamshat asra yoma leyarcha haden chagga defattirayya kodam Adonai shiva yomin pattir techlun:
Bayyom harishon mikra-kodesh yihye lachem kol-melechet avoda lo taasu
Beyoma kadmaa meara kaddish yihe lechon kol ividat palchan la tabedun:
Vehikravtem ishshe la-Adonai shivat yamim bayyom hashshevii mikra-kodesh kol-melechet avoda lo taasu
Utekarvun kurbana kodam Adonai shiva yomin beyoma sheviaa meara kaddish kol ividat palchan la tabedun:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael veamarta alehem ki-tavou el-haaretz asher ani noten lachem uketzartem et-ketzirah vahavetem et-omer reshit ketzirchem el-hakkohen
Mallel im bene yisrael vetemar lehon are tealun leara di ana yahev lechon vetachtzedun yat chatzada vetaytun yat umera resh chatzadchon levat kahana:
Vehenif et-haomer lifne Adonai lirtzonchem mimmochorat hashshabbat yenifennu hakkohen
Virim yat umera kodam Adonai leraava lechon mibbatar yoma tava yeriminneh kahana:
Vaasitem beyom hanifchem et-haomer keves tamim ben-shenato leola la-Adonai
Vetabedun beyoma daaramutechon yat umera immar shelim bar shatteh laalata kodam Adonai:
Uminchato shene esronim solet belula vashshemen ishshe la-Adonai reach nichoach venisko yayin reviit hahin
Uminchateh teren eshronin sulta defila vimshach kurbana kodam Adonai leitkabbala veraava veniskeh chamra ravut hina:
Velechem vekali vecharmel lo tochlu ad-etzem hayyom hazze ad haviachem et-korban elohechem chukkat olam ledorotechem bechol moshvotechem
Ulechem ukeli uferuchan la techlun ad keran yoma haden ad aytoechon yat kurban elahachon keyam alam ledarechon bechol motvanechon:
Usefartem lachem mimmochorat hashshabbat miyyom haviachem et-omer hattenufa sheva shabbatot temimot tihyena
Vetimnun lechon mibbatar yoma tava miyyom aytoechon yat umera daaramuta shiva shavuin shalmin yehevyan:
Ad mimmochorat hashshabbat hashsheviit tisperu chamishshim yom vehikravtem mincha chadasha la-Adonai
Ad mibbatar shevuata shevieta timnun chamshin yomin utekarvun minchata chadatta kodam Adonai:
Mimmoshvotechem taviu lechem tenufa shetayim shene esronim solet tihyena chametz teafena bikkurim la-Adonai
Mimmotvanechon taytun lechem aramuta tarten geritzan teren eshronin sulta yehevyan chamia yitafyan bikkurin kodam Adonai:
Vehikravtem al-hallechem shivat kevasim temimim bene shana ufar ben-bakar echad veelim shenayim yihyu ola la-Adonai uminchatam veniskehem ishshe reach-nichoach la-Adonai
Utekarvun al lachma shiva immerin shalmin bene shena vetor bar tore chad vedichrin teren yehon alata kodam Adonai uminchathon veniskehon kurban demitkabbel beraava kodam Adonai:
Vaasitem seir-izzim echad lechattat ushene chevasim bene shana lezevach shelamim
Vetabedun tzefir bar izze chad lechattata uteren immerin bene shena lenichsat kudeshayya:
Vehenif hakkohen otam al lechem habbikkurim tenufa lifne Adonai al-shene kevasim kodesh yihyu la-Adonai lakkohen
Virim kahana yathon al lechem bikkurayya aramuta kodam Adonai al teren immerin kudesha yehon kodam Adonai lechahana:
Ukeratem beetzem hayyom hazze mikra-kodesh yihye lachem kol-melechet avoda lo taasu chukkat olam bechol-moshvotechem ledorotechem
Utearun bichran yoma haden meara kaddish yehe lechon kol ividat palchan la tabedun keyam alam bechol motvanechon ledarechon:
Uvekutzrechem et-ketzir artzechem lo-techalle peat sadcha bekutzrecha veleket ketzircha lo telakket leani velagger taazov otam ani Adonai elohechem
Uvemechetzadchon yat chatzada dearachon la teshetze pata dechaklach bemechetzadach ulekata dachatzadach la telakket leanye ulegiyyore tishbok yathon ana Adonai elahachon:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael lemor bachodesh hashshevii beechad lachodesh yihye lachem shabbaton zichron terua mikra-kodesh
Mallel im bene yisrael lememar beyarcha sheviaa bechad leyarcha yehe lechon neyacha ducheran yabbava meara kaddish:
Kol-melechet avoda lo taasu vehikravtem ishshe la-Adonai
Kol ividat palchana la tabedun utekarvun kurbana kodam Adonai:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Ach beasor lachodesh hashshevii hazze yom hakkippurim hu mikra-kodesh yihye lachem veinnitem et-nafshotechem vehikravtem ishshe la-Adonai
Beram beasra leyarcha sheviaa haden yoma dechippurayya hu meara kaddish yehe lechon uteannun yat nafshatechon utekarvun kurbana kodam Adonai:
Vechol-melacha lo taasu beetzem hayyom hazze ki yom kippurim hu lechapper alechem lifne Adonai elohechem
Vechol ivida la tabedun bichran yoma haden are yoma dechippurayya hu lechappara alechon kodam Adonai elahachon:
Ki chol-hannefesh asher lo-teunne beetzem hayyom hazze venichreta meammeha
Are chol anasha di la mitanne bichran yoma haden veyishtetze meammaha:
Vechol-hannefesh asher taase kol-melacha beetzem hayyom hazze vehaavadti et-hannefesh hahiv mikkerev ammah
Vechol enash di tabed kol ivida bichran yoma haden veoved yat anasha hahi miggo amma:
Kol-melacha lo taasu chukkat olam ledorotechem bechol moshvotechem
Kol ivida la tabedun keyam alam ledarechon bechol motvanechon:
Shabbat shabbaton hu lachem veinnitem et-nafshotechem betisha lachodesh baerev meerev ad-erev tishbetu shabbattechem
Shevat shevata hu lechon uteannun yat nafshatechon betisha leyarcha beramsha meramsha ad ramsha tenuchun neyachachon:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael lemor bachamishsha asar yom lachodesh hashshevii hazze chag hassukkot shivat yamim la-Adonai
Mallel im bene yisrael lememar bechamsha ashra yoma leyarcha sheviaa haden chagga dimtallayya shivat yomin kodam Adonai:
Bayyom harishon mikra-kodesh kol-melechet avoda lo taasu
Beyoma kadmaa meara kaddish kol ividat palchan la tabedun:
Shivat yamim takrivu ishshe la-Adonai bayyom hashshemini mikra-kodesh yihye lachem vehikravtem ishshe la-Adonai atzeret hiv kol-melechet avoda lo taasu
Shiva yomin tekarvun kurbana kodam Adonai beyoma teminaa meara kaddish yehe lechon utekarvun kurbana kodam Adonai kenesh tehon kol ividat palchan la tabedun:
Elle moade Adonai asher-tikreu otam mikrae kodesh lehakriv ishshe la-Adonai ola umincha zevach unesachim devar-yom beyomo
Illen moadayya daAdonai di tearun yathon meare kaddish lekarava kurbana kodam Adonai alata uminchata nichsat kudeshin venissuchin pitgam yom beyomeh:
Millevad shabbetot Adonai umillevad mattenotechem umillevad kol-nidrechem umillevad kol-nidvotechem asher tittenu la-Adonai
Bar shabbayya daAdonai uvar mattenatechon uvar kol nidrechon uvar kol nidvatechon di tittenun kodam Adonai:
Ach bachamishsha asar yom lachodesh hashshevii beospechem et-tevuat haaretz tachoggu et-chag-Adonai shivat yamim bayyom harishon shabbaton uvayyom hashshemini shabbaton
Beram bechamsha ashar yoma leyarcha sheviaa bemichneshechon yat alalat ara techaggun yat chagga kodam Adonai shiva yomin beyoma kadmaa neyacha uveyoma teminaa neyacha:
Ulekachtem lachem bayyom harishon peri etz hadar kappot temarim vaanaf etz-avot vearve-nachal usemachtem lifne Adonai elohechem shivat yamim
Vetissevun lechon beyoma kadmaa pere ilana etrogin velullabbin vahadassin vearvin dinchal vetechedun kodam Adonai elahachon shavat yomin:
Vechaggotem oto chag la-Adonai shivat yamim bashshana chukkat olam ledorotechem bachodesh hashshevii tachoggu oto
Utechaggun yateh chagga kodam Adonai shavat yomin beshatta keyam alam ledarechon beyarcha sheviaa techaggun yateh:
Bassukkot teshvu shivat yamim kol-haezrach beyisrael yeshvu bassukkot
Bimtallayya tetvun shavat yomin kol yatztziva beyisrael yetvun bimtallayya:
Lemaan yedu dorotechem ki vassukkot hoshavti et-bene yisrael behotzii otam meeretz mitzrayim ani Adonai elohechem
Bedil diyiddeun darechon are vimtallayut anane otevit yat bene yisrael beappakuti yathon meara demitzrayim ana Adonai elahachon:
Vaydabber moshe et-moade Adonai el-bene yisrael
Umallil mshe yat sedar moadayya daAdonai veallefinnun livne yisrael:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Tzav et-bene yisrael veyikchu elecha shemen zayit zach katit lammaor lehaalot ner tamid
Pakked yat bene yisrael veyissevun lach meshach zeta dachya katisha leanhara leadlaka votzinayya tedira:
Michutz lefarochet haedut beohel moed yaaroch oto aharon meerev ad-boker lifne Adonai tamid chukkat olam ledorotechem
Mibbara lefaruchta desahaduta bemashkan zimna yasdar yateh aharon meramsha ad tzafra kodam Adonai tedira keyam alam ledarechon:
Al hammenora hattehora yaaroch et-hannerot lifne Adonai tamid
Al menarta dachita yasdar yat botzinayya kodam Adonai tedira:
Velakachta solet veafita otah shetem esre challot shene esronim yihye hachalla haechat
Vetissav sulta vetefe yata tarta asre geritzan teren esronin tehe geritzta chada:
Vesamta otam shetayim maarachot shesh hammaarachet al hashshulchan hattahor lifne Adonai
Uteshavvi yathon tarten sidrin shit sidra al patora dachya kodam Adonai:
Venatatta al-hammaarechet levona zakka vehayta lallechem leazkara ishshe la-Adonai
Vetitten al sidra levunta dachita utehe lilchem leidkarta kurbana kodam Adonai:
Beyom hashshabbat beyom hashshabbat yaarchennu lifne Adonai tamid meet bene-yisrael berit olam
Beyoma deshabbeta beyoma deshabbeta yasderinneh kodam Adonai tedira min kodam bene yisrael keyam alam:
Vehayta leaharon ulevanav vaachaluhu bemakom kadosh ki kodesh kodashim hu lo meishshe Adonai chok-olam
Utehe leaharon velivnohi veyechlunneh baatar kaddish are kodesh kudeshin hu leh mikkurbanayya daAdonai keyam alam:
Vayyetze ben-ishsha yisreelit vehu ben-ish mitzri betoch bene yisrael vayyinnatzu bammachane ben hayyisreelit veish hayyisreeli
Unefak bar itteta vat yisrael vehu bar gevar mitzraa bego bene yisrael unetzo bemashrita bar itteta vat yisrael vegavra bar yisrael:
Vayyikkov ben-haishsha hayyisreelit et-hashshem vaykallel vayyaviu oto el-moshe veshem immo shelomit bat-divri lematte-dan
Ufaresh bar itteta vat yisrael yat shema veargez veaytiu yateh levat mshe veshum immeh shelomit bat divri leshivta dedan:
Vayyannichuhu bammishmar lifrosh lahem al-pi Adonai
Veasserohi bevet mattera ad deyitparash lehon al gezerat memra daAdonai:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Hotze et-hamekallel el-michutz lammachane vesamchu chol-hashshomim et-yedehem al-rosho veragmu oto kol-haeda
Appek yat deargez lemibbara lemashrita veyismechun kol di shemau yat yedehon al resheh veyirgemun yateh kol kenishta:
Veel-bene yisrael tedabber lemor ish ish ki-yekallel elohav venasa cheto
Veim bene yisrael temallel lememar gevar gevar di yargez kodam elaheh vikabbel choveh:
Venokev shem-Adonai mot yumat ragom yirgemu-vo kol-haeda kagger kaezrach benokvo-shem yumat
Vedi faresh shema daAdonai itketala yitketel mirgam yirgemun beh kol kenishta kegiyyora keyatztziva befarashuteh shema yitketel:
Veish ki yakke kol-nefesh adam mot yumat
Ugevar are yiktol kol nafsha daanasha itketala yitketel:
Umakke nefesh-behema yeshallemenna nefesh tachat nafesh
Udeyiktol nefash beira yeshalleminna nafsha chalaf nafsha:
Veish ki-yitten mum baamito kaasher asa ken yease lo
Ugevar are yitten muma bechavreh kema di avad ken yitaved leh:
Shever tachat shever ayin tachat ayin shen tachat shen kaasher yitten mum baadam ken yinnaten bo
Tavra cholaf tavra ena cholaf ena shinna cholaf shinna kema di yitten muma baanasha ken yityehev beh:
Umakke vehema yeshallemenna umakke adam yumat
Udeyiktol beira yeshalleminna udeyiktol anasha yitketel:
Mishpat echad yihye lachem kagger kaezrach yihye ki ani Adonai elohechem
Dina chada yehe lechon kegiyyora cheyatztziva yehe are ana Adonai elahachon:
Vaydabber moshe el-bene yisrael vayyotziu et-hamekallel el-michutz lammachane vayyirgemu oto aven uvene-yisrael asu kaasher tzivva Adonai et-moshe
Umallil mshe im bene yisrael veappiku yat deargez lemibbara lemashrita uregamu yateh avna uvene yisrael avadu kema di fakked Adonai yat mshe:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe behar sinay lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe betura desinay lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael veamarta alehem ki tavou el-haaretz asher ani noten lachem veshavta haaretz shabbat la-Adonai
Mallel im bene yisrael vetemar lehon are tealun leara di ana yahev lechon vetashmet ara shemitteta kodam Adonai:
Shesh shanim tizra sadecha veshesh shanim tizmor karmecha veasafta et-tevuatah
Shit shenin tizra chaklach veshit shenin tichsach karmach vetichnosh yat alalta:
Uvashshana hashsheviit shabbat shabbaton yihye laaretz shabbat la-Adonai sadcha lo tizra vecharmecha lo tizmor
Uveshatta sheviata neyach shemitteta yehe leara detashmet kodam Adonai chaklach la tizra vecharmach la tichsach:
Et sefiach ketzircha lo tiktzor veet-inneve nezirecha lo tivtzor shenat shabbaton yihye laaretz
Yat katte dachatzadach la techetzad veyat inneve shivkach la tiktof shenat shemitteta yehe leara:
Vehayta shabbat haaretz lachem leochla lecha uleavdecha velaamatecha velischircha uletoshavcha haggarim immach
Utehe shemittat ara lechon lemechal lach uleavdach uleamtach velaagirach uletotavach dedayrin immach:
Velivhemtecha velachayya asher beartzecha tihye chol-tevuatah leechol
Velivirach ulechayta di vearach tehe chol alalta lemechal:
Vesafarta lecha sheva shabbetot shanim sheva shanim sheva peamim vehayu lecha yeme sheva shabbetot hashshanim tesha vearbaim shana
Vetimne lach sheva shemittin dishnin sheva shenin sheva zimnin vihon lach yome sheva shemittin dishnin arbein vetesha shenin:
Vehaavarta shofar terua bachodesh hashshevii beasor lachodesh beyom hakkippurim taaviru shofar bechol-artzechem
Vetaavar shofar yabbava beyarcha sheviaa beasra leyarcha beyoma dechippurayya taabberun shofara bechol arachon:
Vekiddashtem et shenat hachamishshim shana ukeratem deror baaretz lechol-yoshveha yovel hiv tihye lachem veshavtem ish el-achuzzato veish el-mishpachto tashuvu
Utekaddeshun yat shenat chamshin shenin vetakrun cheruta beara lechol yatvaha yovela hi tehe lechon utetuvun gevar leachasanteh ugevar lezariteh tetuvun:
Yovel hiv shenat hachamishshim shana tihye lachem lo tizrau velo tiktzeru et-seficheha velo tivtzeru et-nezireha
Yovela hi shenat chamshin shenin tehe lechon la tizreun vela tachtzedun yat kattaha vela tiktefun yat shivkaha:
Ki yovel hiv kodesh tihye lachem min-hassade tochlu et-tevuatah
Are yovela hi kudesha tehe lechon min chakla techlun yat alalta:
Bishnat hayyovel hazzot tashuvu ish el-achuzzato
Beshatta deyovela hada tetuvun gevar leachasanteh:
Vechi-timkeru mimkar laamitecha o kano miyyad amitecha al-tonu ish et-achiv
Vaare tezabben zevinin lechavrach o tizben mida dechavrach la tonun gevar yat achohi:
Bemispar shanim achar hayyovel tikne meet amitecha bemispar shene-tevuot yimkor-lach
Beminyan shenayya batar yovela tizben min chavrach beminyan shene alalta yezabben lach:
Lefi rov hashshanim tarbe miknato ulefi meot hashshanim tamit miknato ki mispar tevuot hu mocher lach
Lefum segiut shenayya tasge zevinohi ulefum zeerut shenayya tazer zevinohi are minyan alalta hu mezabben lach:
Velo tonu ish et-amito veyareta meelohecha ki ani Adonai elohechem
Vela tonun gevar yat chavreh vetidchal meelahach are ana Adonai elahachon:
Vaasitem et-chukkotay veet-mishpatay tishmeru vaasitem otam vishavtem al-haaretz lavetach
Vetabedun yat keyamay veyat dinay titterun vetabedun yathon vetetvun al ara lerachtzan:
Venatna haaretz piryah vaachaltem lasova vishavtem lavetach aleha
Vetitten ara ibba vetechlun lemisba vetetvun lerachatzan ala:
Vechi tomru ma-nnochal bashshana hashsheviit hen lo nizra velo neesof et-tevuatenu
Vaare temrun ma nechul beshatta shevieta ha la nizra vela nichnosh yat alaltana:
Vetzivviti et-birchati lachem bashshana hashshishshit veasat et-hattevua lishlosh hashshanim
Veefakked yat birchati lechon beshatta shetiteta vetabed yat alalta litlat shenin:
Uzeratem et hashshana hashsheminit vaachaltem min-hattevua yashan ad hashshana hatteshiit ad-bo tevuatah tochlu yashan
Vetizreun yat shatta temineta vetechlun min alalta attika ad shatta teshieta ad meal alalta techlun attika:
Vehaaretz lo timmacher litzmitut ki-li haaretz ki-gerim vetoshavim attem immadi
Veara la tizdabban lachalutin are dili ara are dayyarin vetotavin attun kodamay:
Uvechol eretz achuzzatchem geulla tittenu laaretz
Uvechol ara achasantechon purkana tittenun leara:
Ki-yamuch achicha umachar meachuzzato uva goalo hakkarov elav vegaal et mimkar achiv
Are yetemaskan achuch vizabben meachasante veyete farikeh dekariv leh veyifrok yat zevine achuhi:
Veish ki lo yihye-llo goel vehissiga yado umatza kede geullato
Ugevar are la yehe le parik vetadbek yede veyashkach kemissat purkane:
Vechishshav et-shene mimkaro veheshiv et-haodef laish asher machar-lo veshav laachuzzato
Vichashshev yat shene zevinohi veyatev yat motara ligvar di zabben leh vituv leachasante:
Veim lo-matza yado de hashiv lo vehaya mimkaro beyad hakkone oto ad shenat hayyovel veyatza bayyovel veshav laachuzzato
Veim la tashkach yede kemissat atev leh vihe zevinohi bida dizvan yateh ad shatta deyovela veyippok beyovela vituv leachasanteh:
Veish ki-yimkor bet-moshav ir choma vehayta geullato ad-tom shenat mimkaro yamim tihye geullato
Ugevar are yezabben bet motav karta makkefa shur utehe furkaneh ad mishlam shatta dizvinohi iddan beiddan tehe furkaneh:
Veim lo-yiggael ad-melot lo shana temima vekam habbayit asher-bair asher-lo choma latztzemitut lakkone oto ledorotav lo yetze bayyovel
Veim la yitparak ad mishlam leh shatta shelemta vikum beta di vekarta di leh shura lachalutin ledi zevan yateh ledarohi la yippok beyovela:
Uvatte hachatzerim asher en-lahem choma saviv al-sede haaretz yechashev geulla tihye-llo uvayyovel yetze
Uvatte fatzchayya di let lehon shur makkaf sechor sechor al chakal ara yitchashshav purkana tehe leh uveyovela yippok:
Veare haleviyyim batte are achuzzatam geullat olam tihye lalviyyim
Vekirve levae batte kirve achasantehon purkan alam tehe lelevae:
Vaasher yigal min-haleviyyim veyatza mimkar-bayit veir achuzzato bayyovel ki vatte are haleviyyim hiv achuzzatam betoch bene yisrael
Vedi yifrok min levae veyippok zevin beta vekarta achasanteh beyovela are vatte kirve levae hi achasantehon bego bene yisrael:
Usede migrash arehem lo yimmacher ki-achuzzat olam hu lahem
Vachakal revach kirvehon la yizdabban are achasanat alam hu lehon:
Vechi-yamuch achicha umata yado immach vehechezakta bo ger vetoshav vachay immach
Vaare yitmaskan achuch utemut yedeh immach vetatkef beh dayyar vetotav viche immach:
Al-tikkach meitto neshech vetarbit veyareta meelohecha veche achicha immach
La tissav minneh chibbuleya veribbita vetidchal meelahach viche achuch immach:
Et-kaspecha lo-titten lo beneshech uvemarbit lo-titten ochlecha
Yat kaspach la titten leh bechibbuleya uveribbita la titten mechlach:
Ani Adonai elohechem asher-hotzeti etchem meeretz mitzrayim latet lachem et-eretz kenaan lihyot lachem lelohim
Ana Adonai elahachon di appekit yatchon meara demitzrayim lemittan lechon yat ara dichnaan lemeheve lechon leelah:
Vechi-yamuch achicha immach venimkar-lach lo-taavod bo avodat aved
Vaare yitmaskan achuch immach veyizdabban lach la tiflach beh palchan avdin:
Kesachir ketoshav yihye immach ad-shenat hayyovel yaavod immach
Kaagira chetotava yehe immach ad shatta deyovela yiflach immach:
Veyatza meimmach hu uvanav immo veshav el-mishpachto veel-achuzzat avotav yashuv
Veyippok meimmach hu uvenohi immeh vituv lezariteh uleachasanat avahatohi yetuv:
Ki-avaday hem asher-hotzeti otam meeretz mitzrayim lo yimmachru mimkeret aved
Are avday innun di appekit yathon meara demitzrayim la yizdabbenun zevun avdin:
Lo-tirde vo befarech veyareta meelohecha
La tiflach beh bekashyu vetidchal meelahach:
Veavdecha vaamatcha asher yihyu-lach meet haggoyim asher sevivotechem mehem tiknu eved veama
Veavdach veamtach di yehon lach min ammayya di vesacharanechon minnehon tiknun avdin veamhan:
Vegam mibbene hattoshavim haggarim immachem mehem tiknu umimmishpachtam asher immachem asher holidu beartzechem vehayu lachem laachuzza
Veaf mibbene totavayya orlayya dedayrin immechon minnehon tiknun umizzarithon deimmechon di ityelidu bearachon vihon lechon leachasana:
Vehitnachaltem otam livnechem acharechem lareshet achuzza leolam bahem taavodu uveachechem bene-yisrael ish beachiv lo-tirde vo befarech
Vetachsenun yathon livnechon batrechon lirutat achasana lealam behon tiflechun uveachechon bene yisrael gevar baachuhi la tiflach beh bekashyu:
Vechi tassig yad ger vetoshav immach umach achicha immo venimkar leger toshav immach o leeker mishpachat ger
Vaare tadbek yad arel vetotav immach veyitmaskan achuch immeh veyizdabban learel totav immach o learmay zarit giyyora:
Achare nimkar geulla tihye-llo echad meechav yigalennu
Batar deyizdabban purkana tehe leh chad meachohi yifrekinneh:
O-dodo o ven-dodo yigalennu o-mishsheer besaro mimmishpachto yigalennu o-hissiga yado venigal
O ach avuhi o var ach avuhi yifrekinneh o mikkariv bisreh mizzariteh yifrekinneh o detadbek yedeh veyitparak:
Vechishshav im-konehu mishshenat himmachro lo ad shenat hayyovel vehaya kesef mimkaro bemispar shanim kime sachir yihye immo
Vichashshev im zavneh mishshatta deizdabban leh ad shatta deyovela vihe kesaf zevinohi beminyan shenaya keyome agira yehe immeh:
Im-od rabbot bashshanim lefihen yashiv geullato mikkesef miknato
Im od segiyyut bishnayya lefumehen yatev purkaneh mikkesaf zevinohi:
Veim-meat nishar bashshanim ad-shenat hayyovel vechishshav-lo kefi shanav yashiv et-geullato
Veim zeer yishtaar bishnayya ad shatta deyovela vichashshev leh kefum shenohi yatev yat purkaneh:
Kischir shana beshana yihye immo lo-yirdennu beferech leenecha
Kaagir shena bishna yehe immeh la yiflach beh bekashyu leenaych:
Veim-lo yiggael beelle veyatza bishnat hayyovel hu uvanav immo
Veim la yitparak beillen veyippok beshatta deyovela hu uvenohi immeh:
Ki-li vene-yisrael avadim avaday hem asher-hotzeti otam meeretz mitzrayim ani Adonai elohechem
Are dili vene yisrael avdin avday innun di appekit yathon meara demitzrayim ana Adonai elahachon:
Lo-taasu lachem elilim ufesel umatztzeva lo-takimu lachem veeven maskit lo tittenu beartzechem lehishtachavot aleha ki ani Adonai elohechem
La tabedun lechon taavan vetzelem vekama la tekimun lechon veeven sagda la tittenun bearachon lemisgud ala are ana Adonai elahachon:
Et-shabbetotay tishmoru umikdashi tirau ani Adonai
Yat yome shabbayya dili titterun ulevet makdeshi tehon dachalin ana Adonai:
Im-bechukkotay telechu veet-mitzvotay tishmeru vaasitem otam
Im bikyamay tehachun veyat pikkoday titterun vetabedun yathon:
Venatatti gishmechem beittam venatna haaretz yevulah veetz hassade yitten piryo
Veetten matrechon beiddanhon vetitten ara alalta veilan chakla yitten ibbeh:
Vehissig lachem dayish et-batzir uvatzir yassig et-zara vaachaltem lachmechem lasova vishavtem lavetach beartzechem
Viara lechon deyasha yat ketafa uketafa yeara leappoke var zara vetechlun lachmechon lemisba vetetvun lerachtzan bearachon:
Venatatti shalom baaretz ushechavtem veen macharid vehishbatti chayya raa min-haaretz vecherev lo-taavor beartzechem
Veetten shelama beara vetishrun velet demanid veevattel chayta vishta min ara udekatlin becharba la yeiddun bearachon:
Uredaftem et-oyvechem venaflu lifnechem lecharev
Vetirdefun yat baale devavechon veyippelun kodamechon lecharba:
Veradfu mikkem chamishsha mea umea mikkem revava yirdofu venaflu oyvechem lifnechem lecharev
Veyirdefun minnechon chamsha mea umea minnechon leribbota yeirkun veyippelun baale devavechon kodamechon lecharba:
Ufaniti alechem vehifreti etchem vehirbeti etchem vahakimoti et-beriti ittechem
Veetpeni vememri leotava lechon veappesh yatchon veasge yatchon vaakem yat keyami immechon:
Vaachaltem yashan noshan veyashan mippene chadash totziu
Vetechlun attika deattik veattika min kodam chadatta tefannun:
Venatatti mishkani betochechem velo-tigal nafshi etchem
Veetten mashkeni benechon vela yerachek memri yatchon:
Vehithallachti betochechem vehayiti lachem lelohim veattem tihyu-li leam
Veashre shechinti benechon veeheve lechon leelah veattun tehon kodamay leam:
Ani Adonai elohechem asher hotzeti etchem meeretz mitzrayim mihyot lahem avadim vaeshbor motot ullechem vaolech etchem komemiyyut
Ana Adonai elahachon di appekit yatchon meara demitzrayim millemeheve lehon avdin vetabbarit nir ammayya minnechon vedabbarit yatchon lecheruta:
Veim-lo tishmeu li velo taasu et kol-hammitzvot haelle
Veim la tekabbelun lememri vela tabedun yat kol pikkudayya haillen:
Veim-bechukkotay timasu veim et-mishpatay tigal nafshechem levilti asot et-kol-mitzvotay lehafrechem et-beriti
Veim bikyamay tekotzun veim yat dinay terachek nafshechon bedil dela lemebad yat kol pikkoday leashnayutechon yat keyami:
Af-ani eese-zzot lachem vehifkadti alechem behala et-hashshachefet veet-hakkaddachat mechallot enayim umedivot nafesh uzeratem larik zarachem vaachaluhu oyvechem
Af ana ebad da lechon veasar alechon bahelta yat shachefta veyat kaddachta mechashshechan aynin umappechan nefash vetizreun lerekanun zarachon veyechlunneh baale devavechon:
Venatatti fanay bachem veniggaftem lifne oyvechem veradu vachem sonechem venastem veen-rodef etchem
Veetten rugezi bechon vetittabberun kodam baale devavechon veyirdun bechon sanechon veteirkun velet deradif yatchon:
Veim-ad-elle lo tishmeu li veyasafti leyassera etchem sheva al-chattotechem
Veim ad illen la tekabbelun lememri veosef lemirde yatchon sheva al chovechon:
Veshavarti et-geon uzzechem venatatti et-shemechem kabbarzel veet-artzechem kannechusha
Veetbar yat yekar takpechon veetten yat shemayya di illavechon takkifin kefarzela millaachata mitra veara ditchotechon chasina chinchasha millemebad perin:
Vetam larik kochachem velo-titten artzechem et-yevulah veetz haaretz lo yitten piryo
Visufun lerekanu chelechon vela titten arachon yat alalta veilan ara la yitten ibbeh:
Veim-telchu immi keri velo tovu lishmoa li veyasafti alechem makka sheva kechattotechem
Veim tehachun kodamay bekashyu vela tevun lekabbala lememri veosef leetaa alechon macha sheva kechovechon:
Vehishlachti vachem et-chayyat hassade veshikkela etchem vehichrita et-behemtechem vehimita etchem venashammu darchechem
Veegare vechon yat chevat bara utetakkel yatchon uteshetze yat beirchon vetazer yatchon vitzadyan orchatchon:
Veim-beelle lo tivvasru li vahalachtem immi keri
Veim beillen la titredun lememri utehachun kodamay bekashyu:
Vehalachti af-ani immachem bekeri vehikketi etchem gam-ani sheva al-chattotechem
Veehach af ana immechon bekashyu vealke yatchon af ana sheva al chovechon:
Veheveti alechem cherev nokemet nekam-berit veneesaftem el-arechem veshillachti dever betochechem venittattem beyad-oyev
Veayti alechon dekatlin becharba veyitparun minnechon puranuta al daavartun al pitgame orayta vetitkanneshun lekirvechon veegare motana benechon vetitmasserun bida desana:
Beshivri lachem matte-lechem veafu eser nashim lachmechem betannur echad veheshivu lachmechem bammishkal vaachaltem velo tisbau
Bidittevar lechon said mechla veyofyan asar neshin lachmechon betannura chad vitivun lachmechon bematkela vetochlun vela tisbeun:
Veim-bezot lo tishmeu li vahalachtem immi bekeri
Veim beda la tekabbelun lememri utehachun kodamay bekashyu:
Vehalachti immachem bachamat-keri veyissarti etchem af-ani sheva al-chattotechem
Veehach immechon bitkof regaz veirde yatchon af ana sheva al chovechon:
Vaachaltem besar benechem uvesar benotechem tochelu
Vetechlun besar benechon uveshar benatechon techlun:
Vehishmadti et-bamotechem vehichratti et-chammanechem venatatti et-pigrechem al-pigre gillulechem vegaala nafshi etchem
Veeshetze yat bamatechon veekatztzetz yat chanisnesechon veetten yat pigrechon al piggur taavatchon virachek memri yatchon:
Venatatti et-arechem chorba vahashimmoti et-mikdeshechem velo ariach bereach nichochachem
Veetten yat kirvechon tzada veetzde yat makdeshechon vela akabbel beraava kurban kenishshatchon:
Vahashimmoti ani et-haaretz veshamemu aleha oyvechem hayyoshvim bah
Veetzde ana yat ara vitzaryun ala baale devavechon deyatvun ba:
Veetchem ezare vaggoyim vaharikoti acharechem charev vehayta artzechem shemama vearechem yihyu chorba
Veyatchon avaddar bene ammayya veegare vatrechon dekatlin becharba utehe arachon tzadya vekirvechon yehon chorba:
Az tirtze haaretz et-shabbetoteha kol yeme hoshshamma veattem beeretz oyvechem az tishbat haaretz vehirtzat et-shabbetoteha
Bechen tare ara yat shemittaha kol yomin di tzediat veattun beara baale devavechon bechen tashmet ara vetare yat shemittaha:
Kol-yeme hoshshamma tishbot et asher lo-shavta beshabbetotechem beshivtechem aleha
Kol yomin di tzediat tashmet yat di la shemetat bishmittechon kad havetun yatvin ala:
Vehannisharim bachem veheveti morech bilvavam beartzot oyvehem veradaf otam kol ale niddaf venasu menusat-cherev venaflu veen rodef
Udeyishtaarun bechon veael tavra belibbehon bearata desanehon veyirdof yathon kal tarpa deshakkif veyearkun kemeirok min kodam dekatlin becharba veyippelun velet deradif:
Vechashlu ish-beachiv kemippene-cherev verodef ayin velo-tihye lachem tekuma lifne oyvechem
Veyittaklun gevar beachuhi kemikkadam dekatlin becharba veradif layit vela tehe lechon tekuma kodam baale devavechon:
Vaavadtem baggoyim veochla etchem eretz oyvechem
Vetevdun bene ammayya utegammar yatchon ara baale devavechon:
Vehannisharim bachem yimmakku baavonam beartzot oyvechem veaf baavonot avotam ittam yimmakku
Udeyishtaarun bechon yittimsun bechovehon bearata baale devavechon veaf bechove avahathon bishayya daachidin bidehon yittimsun:
Vehitvaddu et-avonam veet-avon avotam bemaalam asher maalu-vi veaf asher-halchu immi bekeri
Vivaddun yat chovehon veyat chove avahathon beshikrehon deshakkaru kodamay veaf di hallichu kodamay bekashyu:
Af-ani elech immam bekeri veheveti otam beeretz oyvehem o-az yikkana levavam hearel veaz yirtzu et-avonam
Af ana ehach immehon bekashyu veael yathon beara baale devavehon o vechen yittavar libbehon tafsha uvechen yirun yat chovehon:
Vezacharti et-beriti yaakov veaf et-beriti yitzchak veaf et-beriti avraham ezkor vehaaretz ezkor
Vedachirna yat keyami deim yaakov veaf yat keyami deim yitzchak veaf yat keyami deim avraham ana dachir veara ana dachir:
Vehaaretz teazev mehem vetiretz et-shabbetoteha bohshamma mehem vehem yirtzu et-avonam yaan uveyaan bemishpatay maasu veet-chukkotay gaala nafsham
Veara titretesh minnehon vetare yat shemittaha beditzdiat minnehon veinnun yirun yat chovehon levatin cholaf birchan ayti alehon bedil divdinay katzu veyat keyamay rechekat nafshehon:
Veaf-gam-zot bihyotam beeretz oyvehem lo-meastim velo-gealtim lechallotam lehafer beriti ittam ki ani Adonai elohehem
Veaf beram da bemehevehon beara baale devavehon la arteshinnun vela archekinnun leshetzayutehon leashnaa keyami immehon are ana Adonai elahahon:
Vezacharti lahem berit rishonim asher hotzeti-otam meeretz mitzrayim leene haggoyim lihyot lahem lelohim ani Adonai
Vedachirna lehon keyam kadmae di appekit yathon meara demitzrayim leene ammayya lemeheve lehon lelaha ana Adonai:
Elle hachukkim vehammishpatim vehattorot asher natan Adonai beno uven bene yisrael behar sinay beyad-moshe
Illen keyamayya vedinayya veorayata di yehav Adonai ben memreh uven bene yisrael betura desinay bida demshe:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael veamarta alehem ish ki yafli neder beerkecha nefashot la-Adonai
Mallel im bene yisrael vetemar lehon gevar are yafresh nedar befursan nafshata kodam Adonai:
Vehaya erkecha hazzachar mibben esrim shana vead ben-shishshim shana vehaya erkecha chamishshim shekel kesef beshekel hakkodesh
Vihe fursaneh dechura mibbar esrin shenin vead bar shittin shenin vihe fursaneh chamshin silin dichsaf besile kudesha:
Veim-nekeva hiv vehaya erkecha sheloshim shakel
Veim nekuveta hi vihe fursaneh telatin silin:
Veim mibben-chamesh shanim vead ben-esrim shana vehaya erkecha hazzachar esrim shekalim velannekeva aseret shekalim
Veim mibbar chamesh shenin vead bar esrin shenin vihe fursaneh dechura esrin silin velinkuveta asar silin:
Veim mibben-chodesh vead ben-chamesh shanim vehaya erkecha hazzachar chamishsha shekalim kasef velannekeva erkecha sheloshet shekalim kasef
Veim mibbar yarcha vead bar chamesh shenin vihe fursaneh dechura chamesh silin dichsaf velinkuveta fursana telat silin dichsaf:
Veim mibben-shishshim shana vamala im-zachar vehaya erkecha chamishsha asar shakel velannekeva asara shekalim
Veim mibbar shittin shenin uleella im dechura vihe fursaneh chamesh esre silin velinkuveta asar silin:
Veim-mach hu meerkecha veheemido lifne hakkohen veheerich oto hakkohen al-pi asher tassig yad hannoder yaarichennu hakkohen
Veim misken hu mippursanneh vikiminneh kodam kahana veyifros yateh kahana al memar di tadbek yeda denodera yifresinneh kahana:
Veim-behema asher yakrivu mimmenna korban la-Adonai kol asher yitten mimmennu la-Adonai yihye-kkodesh
Veim beira di yekarvun minna kurbana kodam Adonai kol di yitten minneh kodam Adonai yehe kudesha:
Lo yachalifennu velo-yamir oto tov bera o-ra betov veim-hamer yamir behema bivhema vehaya-hu utemurato yihye-kkodesh
La yechallefinneh vela yeibbar yateh tav bevish o vish betav veim challafa yechallef beira bivira vihe hu vechillufeh yehe kaddish:
Veim kol-behema temea asher lo-yakrivu mimmenna korban la-Adonai veheemid et-habbehema lifne hakkohen
Veim kol beira mesaava di la yekarvun minna kurbana kodam Adonai vikim yat beira kodam kahana:
Veheerich hakkohen otah ben tov uven ra keerkecha hakkohen ken yihye
Veyifros kahana yata ben tav uven bish kefursana dechahana ken yehe:
Veim-gaol yigalenna veyasaf chamishito al-erkecha
Veim mifrak yifrekunna veyosef chumsheh al pursaneh:
Veish ki-yakdish et-beto kodesh la-Adonai veheericho hakkohen ben tov uven ra kaasher yaarich oto hakkohen ken yakum
Ugevar are yakdesh yat beteh kudesha kodam Adonai veyifresinneh kahana ben tav uven bish kema di yifros yateh kahana ken yekum:
Veim-hammakdish yigal et-beto veyasaf chamishit kesef-erkecha alav vehaya lo
Veim deakdesh yifrok yat beteh veyosef chomesh kesaf pursaneh alohi vihe leh:
Veim missede achuzzato yakdish ish la-Adonai vehaya erkecha lefi zaro zera chomer seorim bachamishshim shekel kasef
Veim mechakal achasanteh yakdish gevar kadam Adonai vihe fursaneh lefum zareh bar zera kur seorin bechamshin silin dichsaf:
Im-mishshenat hayyovel yakdish sadehu keerkecha yakum
Im mishshatta deyovela yakdesh chakleh kefursaneh yekum:
Veim-achar hayyovel yakdish sadehu vechishshav-lo hakkohen et-hakkesef al-pi hashshanim hannotarot ad shenat hayyovel venigra meerkecha
Veim batar yovela yakdesh chakleh vichashshev leh kahana yat kaspa al memar shenayya deishtaaran ad shatta deyovela veyittimna mippursaneh:
Veim-gaol yigal et-hassade hammakdish oto veyasaf chamishit kesef-erkecha alav vekam lo
Veim mifrak yifrok yat chakla deakdesh yateh veyosef chomesh kesaf pursaneh alohi vikum leh:
Veim-lo yigal et-hassade veim-machar et-hassade leish acher lo yiggael od
Veim la yifrok yat chakla veim zabbin yat chakla ligvar ochoran la yitparak od
Vehaya hassade betzeto vayyovel kodesh la-Adonai kisde hacherem lakkohen tihye achuzzato
Vihe chakla bemippekeh beyovela kudesha kodam Adonai kachakal cherma lechahana tehe achasanteh:
Veim et-sede miknato asher lo missede achuzzato yakdish la-Adonai
Veim yat chakal zevinohi di la mechakal achasanteh yakdesh kodam Adonai:
Vechishshav-lo hakkohen et michsat haerkecha ad shenat hayyovel venatan et-haerkecha bayyom hahu kodesh la-Adonai
Vichashshev leh kahana yat minyan pursanneh ad shatta deyovela veyitten yat pursaneh beyoma hahu kudesha kodam Adonai:
Bishnat hayyovel yashuv hassade laasher kanahu meitto laasher-lo achuzzat haaretz
Beshatta deyovela yetuv chakla ledizbaneh minneh lededileh achasanat ara:
Vechol-erkecha yihye beshekel hakkodesh esrim gera yihye hashshakel
Vechol pursaneh yehe besile kudesha esrin main yehe sila:
Ach-bechor asher-yevukkar la-Adonai bivhema lo-yakdish ish oto im-shor im-se la-Adonai hu
Beram buchera di yitbakkar kodam Adonai bivira la yakdesh gevar yateh im tor im immar daAdonai hu:
Veim babbehema hattemea ufada veerkecha veyasaf chamishito alav veim-lo yiggael venimkar beerkecha
Veim bivira mesaava veyifrok befursaneh veyosef chumsheh alohi veim la yitparak veyizdabban befursaneh:
Ach-kol-cherem asher yacharim ish la-Adonai mikkol-asher-lo meadam uvehema umissede achuzzato lo yimmacher velo yiggael kol-cherem kodesh-kodashim hu la-Adonai
Beram kol cherma di yacharem gevar kodam Adonai mikkol di leh meanasha uveira umechakal achasanteh la yizdabban vela yitparak kol cherma kodesh kudeshin hu kodam Adonai:
Kol-cherem asher yochoram min-haadam lo yippade mot yumat
Kol cherma di yittachram min enasha la yitparak itketala yitketel:
Vechol-masar haaretz mizzera haaretz mipperi haetz la-Adonai hu kodesh la-Adonai
Vechol masera deara mizzara deara mippere ilana daAdonai hu kudesha kodam Adonai:
Veim-gaol yigal ish mimmaasro chamishito yosef alav
Veim mifrak yifrok gevar mimmaasreh chumsheh yosef alohi:
Vechol-masar bakar vatzon kol asher-yaavor tachat hashshavet haasiri yihye-kkodesh la-Adonai
Vechol maasar torin vean kol deyeibbar techot chutra asiraa yehe kaddish kodam Adonai:
Lo yevakker ben-tov lara velo yemirennu veim-hamer yemirennu vehaya-hu utemurato yihye-kkodesh lo yiggael
La yevakkar ben tav levish vela yechallefinneh veim challafa yechallefinneh vihe hu vechillufeh yehe kudesha la yitparak:
Elle hammitzvot asher tzivva Adonai et-moshe el-bene yisrael behar sinay
Illen pikkodayya di fakkid Adonai yat mshe levat bene yisrael betura desinay:
