Numbers: Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe bemidbar sinay beohel moed beechad lachodesh hashsheni bashshana hashshenit letzetam meeretz mitzrayim lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe bemadbera desinay bemashkan zimna bechad leyarcha tinyana beshatta tinyeta lemippakhon meara demitzrayim lememar:
Seu et-rosh kol-adat bene-yisrael lemishpechotam levet avotam bemispar shemot kol-zachar legulgelotam
Kabbilu yat chushban kol kenishta divne yisrael lezarayathon levet avahathon beminyan shemahan kol dechura legulgelathon:
Mibben esrim shana vamala kol-yotze tzava beyisrael tifkedu otam letzivotam atta veaharon
Mibbar asrin shenin uleella kol nafek chela beyisrael timnun yathon lechelehon at veaharon:
Veittechem yihyu ish ish lammatte ish rosh levet-avotav hu
Veimmechon yehon gavra gavra leshivta gevar resh levet avahatohi hu:
Veelle shemot haanashim asher yaamdu ittechem liruven elitzur ben-shedeur
Veillen shemahat guvrayya di yekumun immechon liruven elitzur bar shedeur:
Leshimon shelumiel ben-tzurishadday
Leshimon shelumiel bar tzurishadday:
Lihuda nachshon ben-amminadav
Lihuda nachshon bar amminadav:
Leyissashchar netanel ben-tzuar
Leyissashchar netanel bar tzuar:
Lizvulun eliav ben-chelon
Lizvulun eliav bar chellon:
Livne yosef leefrayim elishama ben-ammihud limnashshe gamliel ben-pedatzur
Livne yosef leefrayim elishama bar ammihud limnashshe gamliel bar pedatzur:
Levinyamin avidan ben-gidoni
Levinyamin avidan bar gidoni:
Ledan achiezer ben-ammishadday
Ledan achiezer bar ammishadday:
Leasher pagiel ben-ochran
Leasher pagiel bar achran:
Legad elyasaf ben-deuel
Legad elyasaf bar deuel:
Lenaftali achira ben-enan
Lenaftali achira bar enan:
Elle kerue haeda nesie mattot avotam rashe alfe yisrael hem
Illen meare chenishta ravreve shivte avahathon reshe alfayya deyisrael innun:
Vayyikkach moshe veaharon et haanashim haelle asher nikkevu beshemot
Unesev mshe veaharon yat guvrayya haillen di itparashu bishmahan:
Veet kol-haeda hikhilu beechad lachodesh hashsheni vayyityaldu al-mishpechotam levet avotam bemispar shemot mibben esrim shana vamala legulgelotam
Veyat kol kenishta achnashu bechad leyarcha tinyana veityachasu al zarayathon levet avahathon beminyan shemahan mibbar asrin shenin uleella legulgelathon:
Kaasher tzivva Adonai et-moshe vayyifkedem bemidbar sinay
Kema di fakked Adonai yat mshe umeninnun bemadbera desinay:
Vayyihyu vene-reuven bechor yisrael toldotam lemishpechotam levet avotam bemispar shemot legulgelotam kol-zachar mibben esrim shana vamala kol yotze tzava
Vahavo vene reuven buchera deyisrael tuledathon lezarayathon levet avahathon beminyan shemahan legulgelathon kol dechura mibbar asrin shenin uleella kol nafek chela:
Pekudehem lematte reuven shishsha vearbaim elef vachamesh meot
Minyanehon leshivta diruven arbein veshitta alfin vachamesh mea:
Livne shimon toldotam lemishpechotam levet avotam pekudav bemispar shemot legulgelotam kol-zachar mibben esrim shana vamala kol yotze tzava
Livne shimon tuledathon lezarayathon levet avahathon minyanohi beminyan shemahan legulgelathon kol dechura mibbar asrin shenin uleella kol nafek chela:
Pekudehem lematte shimon tisha vachamishshim elef ushelosh meot
Minyanehon leshivta deshimon chamshin vetisha alfin utelat mea:
Livne gad toldotam lemishpechotam levet avotam bemispar shemot mibben esrim shana vamala kol yotze tzava
Livne gad tuledathon lezarayathon levet avahathon beminyan shemahan mibbar asrin shenin uleella kol nafek chela:
Pekudehem lematte gad chamishsha vearbaim elef veshesh meot vachamishshim
Minyanehon leshivta degad arbein vechamsha alfin veshit mea vechamshin
Livne yehuda toldotam lemishpechotam levet avotam bemispar shemot mibben esrim shana vamala kol yotze tzava
Livne yehuda tuledathon lezarayathon levet avahathon beminyan shemahan mibbar asrin shenin uleella kol nafek chela:
Pekudehem lematte yehuda arbaa veshivim elef veshesh meot
Minyanehon leshivta dihuda shavin vearbea alfin veshit mea:
Livne yissashchar toldotam lemishpechotam levet avotam bemispar shemot mibben esrim shana vamala kol yotze tzava
Livne yissashchar tuledathon lezarayathon levet avahathon beminyan shemahan mibbar asrin shenin uleella kol nafek chela:
Pekudehem lematte yissashchar arbaa vachamishshim elef vearba meot
Minyanehon leshivta deyissashchar chamshin vearbea alfin vearba mea:
Livne zevulun toldotam lemishpechotam levet avotam bemispar shemot mibben esrim shana vamala kol yotze tzava
Livne zevulun tuledathon lezarayathon levet avahathon beminyan shemahan mibbar asrin shenin uleella kol nafek chela:
Pekudehem lematte zevulun shiva vachamishshim elef vearba meot
Minyanehon leshivta dizvulun chamshin usheva alfin vearba mea:
Livne yosef livne efrayim toldotam lemishpechotam levet avotam bemispar shemot mibben esrim shana vamala kol yotze tzava
Livne yosef livne efrayim tuledathon lezarayathon levet avahathon beminyan shemahan mibbar asrin shenin uleella kol nafek chela:
Pekudehem lematte efrayim arbaim elef vachamesh meot
Minyanehon leshivta deefrayim arbein alfin vachamesh mea:
Livne menashshe toldotam lemishpechotam levet avotam bemispar shemot mibben esrim shana vamala kol yotze tzava
Livne menashshe tuledathon lezarayathon levet avahathon beminyan shemahan mibbar asrin shenin uleella kol nafek chela:
Pekudehem lematte menashshe shenayim usheloshim elef umatayim
Minyanehon leshivta dimnashshe telatin uteren alfin umatan:
Livne vinyamin toldotam lemishpechotam levet avotam bemispar shemot mibben esrim shana vamala kol yotze tzava
Livne vinyamin tuledathon lezarayathon levet avahathon beminyan shemahan mibbar asrin shenin uleella kol nafek chela:
Pekudehem lematte vinyamin chamishsha usheloshim elef vearba meot
Minyanehon leshivta devinyamin telatin vechamsha alfin vearba mea:
Livne dan toldotam lemishpechotam levet avotam bemispar shemot mibben esrim shana vamala kol yotze tzava
Livne dan tuledathon lezarayathon levet avahathon beminyan shemahan mibbar asrin shenin uleella kol nafek chela:
Pekudehem lematte dan shenayim veshishshim elef usheva meot
Minyanehon leshivta dedan shittin uteren alfin usheva mea:
Livne asher toldotam lemishpechotam levet avotam bemispar shemot mibben esrim shana vamala kol yotze tzava
Livne asher tuledathon lezarayathon levet avahathon beminyan shemahan mibbar asrin shenin uleella kol nafek chela:
Pekudehem lematte asher echad vearbaim elef vachamesh meot
Minyanehon leshivta deasher arbein vechad alfin vachamesh mea:
Bene naftali toldotam lemishpechotam levet avotam bemispar shemot mibben esrim shana vamala kol yotze tzava
Bene naftali tuledathon lezarayathon levet avahathon beminyan shemahan mibbar asrin shenin uleella kol nafek chela:
Pekudehem lematte naftali shelosha vachamishshim elef vearba meot
Minyanehon leshivta denaftali chamshin utelat alfin vearba mea:
Elle happekudim asher pakad moshe veaharon unesie yisrael shenem asar ish ish-echad levet-avotav hayu
Illen minyanayya di mena mshe veaharon veravreve yisrael teren asar guvrin gavra chad levet avahatohi havo:
Vayyihyu kol-pekude vene-yisrael levet avotam mibben esrim shana vamala kol-yotze tzava beyisrael
Vahavo kol minyane vene yisrael levet avahathon mibbar asrin shenin uleella kol nafek chela beyisrael:
Vayyihyu kol-happekudim shesh-meot elef usheloshet alafim vachamesh meot vachamishshim
Vahavo kol minyanayya shit mea utelata alfin vachamesh mea vechamshin:
Vehaleviyyim lematte avotam lo hotpakdu betocham
Velevae leshivta daavahathon la itmeniu benehon:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Ach et-matte levi lo tifkod veet-rosham lo tissa betoch bene yisrael
Beram yat shivta delevi la timne veyat chushbanhon la tekabbel bego bene yisrel:
Veatta hafked et-haleviyyim al-mishkan haedut veal kol-kelav veal kol-asher-lo hemma yisu et-hammishkan veet-kol-kelav vehem yeshartuhu vesaviv lammishkan yachanu
Veat manni yat levae al mashkena desahaduta veal kol manohi veal kol di leh innun yittelun yat mashkena veyat kol manohi veinnun yeshammeshunneh usechor sechor lemashkena yishrun:
Uvinsoa hammishkan yoridu oto haleviyyim uvachanot hammishkan yakimu oto haleviyyim vehazzar hakkarev yumat
Uvemittal mashkena yefarkun yateh levae uvemishre mashkena yekimun yateh levae vechillonay deyikrav yitketal:
Vechanu bene yisrael ish al-machanehu veish al-diglo letzivotam
Veyishrun bene yisrael gevar al mashrohi ugevar al tikseh lechelehon:
Vehaleviyyim yachanu saviv lemishkan haedut velo-yihye ketzef al-adat bene yisrael veshamru haleviyyim et-mishmeret mishkan haedut
Velevae yishrun sechor sechor lemashkena desahaduta vela yehe rugeza al kenishta divne yisrael veyitterun levae yat matterat mashkena desahaduta:
Vayyaasu bene yisrael kechol asher tzivva Adonai et-moshe ken asu
Vaavadu bene yisrael kechol di fakkid Adonai yat mshe ken avadu:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe veel-aharon lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe veim aharon lememar:
Ish al-diglo veotot levet avotam yachanu bene yisrael minneged saviv leohel-moed yachanu
Gevar al tikseh beatvan levet avahathon yishrun bene yisrael millokovel sechor sechor lemashkan zimna yishrun:
Vehachonim kedma mizracha degel machane yehuda letzivotam venasi livne yehuda nachshon ben-amminadav
Vedi sheran kidduma maddincha tekas mashrit yehuda lechelehon verabba livne yehuda nachshon bar amminadav:
Utzevao ufekudehem arbaa veshivim elef veshesh meot
Vecheleh uminyanehon shavin vearbea alfin veshit mea:
Vehachonim alav matte yissashchar venasi livne yissashchar netanel ben-tzuar
Vedi sheran semichin alohi shivta deyissashchar verabba livne yissashchar netanel bar tzuar:
Utzevao ufekudav arbaa vachamishshim elef vearba meot
Vecheleh uminyanohi chamshin vearbea alfin vearba mea:
Matte zevulun venasi livne zevulun eliav ben-chelon
Shivta dizvulun verabba livne zevulun eliav bar chelon:
Utzevao ufekudav shiva vachamishshim elef vearba meot
Vecheleh uminyanohi chamshin veshiva alfin vearba mea:
Kol-happekudim lemachane yehuda meat elef ushemonim elef vesheshet-alafim vearba-meot letzivotam rishona yissau
Kol minyanayya lemashrit yehuda mea utemanan veshitta alfin vearba mea lechelehon bekadmeta natlin:
Degel machane reuven temana letzivotam venasi livne reuven elitzur ben-shedeur
Tekas mashrit reuven daroma lechelehon verabba livne reuven elitzur bar shedeur:
Utzevao ufekudav shishsha vearbaim elef vachamesh meot
Vecheleh uminyanohi arbein veshitta alfin vachamesh mea:
Vehachonim alav matte shimon venasi livne shimon shelumiel ben-tzurishadday
Vedi sheran semichin alohi shivta deshimon verabba livne shimon shelumiel bar tzurishadday:
Utzevao ufekudehem tisha vachamishshim elef ushelosh meot
Vecheleh uminyanehon chamshin utesha alfin utelat mea:
Umatte gad venasi livne gad elyasaf ben-reuel
Veshivta degad verabba livne gad elyasaf bar reuel:
Utzevao ufekudehem chamishsha vearbaim elef veshesh meot vachamishshim
Vecheleh uminyanehon arbein vechamsha alfin veshit mea vechamshin:
Kol-happekudim lemachane reuven meat elef veechad vachamishshim elef vearba-meot vachamishshim letzivotam usheniyyim yissau
Kol minyanayya lemashrit reuven mea vechamshin vechad alfin vearba mea vechamshin lechelehon betinyeta natlin:
Venasa ohel-moed machane haleviyyim betoch hammachanot kaasher yachanu ken yissau ish al-yado lediglehem
Venatel mashkan zimna mashrit levae bego mashreyata kema desharan ken natlin gevar al atreh letiksehon:
Degel machane efrayim letzivotam yamma venasi livne efrayim elishama ben-ammihud
Tekas mashrit efrayim lechelehon maarva verabba livne efrayim elishama bar ammihud:
Utzevao ufekudehem arbaim elef vachamesh meot
Vecheleh uminyanehon arbein alfin vachamesh mea:
Vealav matte menashshe venasi livne menashshe gamliel ben-pedatzur
Vedismichin alohi shivta dimnashshe verabba livne menashshe gamliel bar pedatzur:
Utzevao ufekudehem shenayim usheloshim elef umatayim
Vecheleh uminyanehon telatin uteren alfin umatan:
Umatte binyamin venasi livne vinyamin avidan ben-gidoni
Veshivta devinyamin verabba livne vinyamin avidan bar gidoni:
Utzevao ufekudehem chamishsha usheloshim elef vearba meot
Vecheleh uminyanehon telatin vechamsha alfin vearba mea:
Kol-happekudim lemachane efrayim meat elef ushemonat-alafim umea letzivotam ushelishim yissau
Kol minyanayya lemashrit efrayim mea vetamne alfin umea lechelehon bitliteta natlin:
Degel machane dan tzafona letzivotam venasi livne dan achiezer ben-ammishadday
Tekas mashrit dan tzippuna lechelehon verabba livne dan achiezer bar ammishadday:
Utzevao ufekudehem shenayim veshishshim elef usheva meot
Vecheleh uminyanehon shittin uteren alfin usheva mea:
Vehachonim alav matte asher venasi livne asher pagiel ben-ochran
Vedi sheran semichin alohi shivta deasher verabba livne asher pagiel bar achran:
Utzevao ufekudehem echad vearbaim elef vachamesh meot
Vecheleh uminyanehon arbein vechad alfin vachamesh mea:
Umatte naftali venasi livne naftali achira ben-enan
Veshivta denaftali verabba livne naftali achira bar enan:
Utzevao ufekudehem shelosha vachamishshim elef vearba meot
Vecheleh uminyanehon chamshin utelata alfin vearba mea:
Kol-happekudim lemachane dan meat elef veshiva vachamishshim elef veshesh meot laacharona yisu lediglehem
Kol minyanayya lemashrit dan mea vechamshin veshiva alfin veshit mea bevatreta natlin letiksehon:
Elle pekude vene-yisrael levet avotam kol-pekude hammachanot letzivotam shesh-meot elef usheloshet alafim vachamesh meot vachamishshim
Illen minyane vene yisrael levet avahathon kol minyane mashreyata lechelehon shit mea utelata alfin vachamesh mea vechamshin:
Vehaleviyyim lo hotpakdu betoch bene yisrael kaasher tzivva Adonai et-moshe
Velevae la itmeniu bego bene yisrael kema di fakkid Adonai yat mshe:
Vayyaasu bene yisrael kechol asher-tzivva Adonai et-moshe ken-chanu lediglehem vechen nasau ish lemishpechotav al-bet avotav
Vaavadu bene yisrael kechol di fakkid Adonai yat mshe ken sharan letiksehon vechen natlin gevar lezarayathon al bet avahatohi:
Veelle toldot aharon umoshe beyom dibber Adonai et-moshe behar sinay
Veillen tuledat aharon umshe beyoma demallil Adonai im mshe betura desinay:
Veelle shemot bene-aharon habbechor nadav vaavihu elazar veitamar
Veillen shemahat bene aharon buchera nadav vaavihu elazar veitamar:
Elle shemot bene aharon hakkohanim hammeshuchim asher-mille yadam lechahen
Illen shemahat bene aharon kahanayya deitrabbiu di itkarav kurbanhon leshammasha:
Vayyamot nadav vaavihu lifne Adonai behakrivam esh zara lifne Adonai bemidbar sinay uvanim lo-hayu lahem vaychahen elazar veitamar al-pene aharon avihem
Umit nadav vaavihu kodam Adonai bekarovehon eshshata nuchereta kodam Adonai bemadbera desinay uvenin la havo lehon veshammesh elazar veitamar al appe aharon avuhon:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Hakrev et-matte levi vehaamadta oto lifne aharon hakkohen veshertu oto
Karev yat shivta delevi utekem yateh kodam aharon kahana vishammeshun yateh:
Veshamru et-mishmarto veet-mishmeret kol-haeda lifne ohel moed laavod et-avodat hammishkan
Veyitterun yat mattarteh veyat matterat kol kenishta kodam mashkan zimna lemiflach yat palchan mashkena:
Veshamru et-kol-kele ohel moed veet-mishmeret bene yisrael laavod et-avodat hammishkan
Veyitterun yat kol mane mashkan zimna veyat matterat bene yisrael lemiflach yat palchan mashkena:
Venatatta et-haleviyyim leaharon ulevanav netunim netunim hemma lo meet bene yisrael
Vetitten yat levae leaharon velivnohi mesirin yehivin innun leh min bene yisrael:
Veet-aharon veet-banav tifkod veshamru et-kehunnatam vehazzar hakkarev yumat
Veyat aharon veyat benohi temanne veyitterun yat kehunnathon vechillonay deyikrav yitketal:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Vaani hinne lakachti et-haleviyyim mittoch bene yisrael tachat kol-bechor peter rechem mibbene yisrael vehayu li haleviyyim
Vaana ha karevit yat levae miggo bene yisrael chalaf kol buchera patach valda mibbene yisrael vihon meshammeshin kodamay levae:
Ki li kol-bechor beyom hakkoti chol-bechor beeretz mitzrayim hikdashti li chol-bechor beyisrael meadam ad-behema li yihyu ani Adonai
Are dili kol buchera beyoma diktalit kol buchera beara demitzrayim akdeshit kodamay kol buchera beyisrael meenasha ad beira dili yehon ana Adonai:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe bemidbar sinay lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe bemadbera desinay lememar:
Pekod et-bene levi levet avotam lemishpechotam kol-zachar mibben-chodesh vamala tifkedem
Mene yat bene levi levet avahathon lezarayathon kol dechura mibbar yarcha uleella timninnun:
Vayyifkod otam moshe al-pi Adonai kaasher tzuvva
Umena yathon mshe al memra daAdonai kema deitpakkad:
Vayyihyu-elle vene-levi bishmotam gershon ukehat umerari
Vahavo illen bene levi bishmahathon gershon ukehat umerari:
Veelle shemot bene-gershon lemishpechotam livni veshimi
Veillen shemahat bene gershon lezarayathon livni veshimi:
Uvene kehat lemishpechotam amram veyitzhar chevron veuzziel
Uvene kehat lezarayathon amram veyitzhar chevron veuzziel:
Uvene merari lemishpechotam machli umushi elle hem mishpechot hallevi levet avotam
Uvene merari lezarayathon machli umushi illen innun zarayat levae levet avahathon:
Legershon mishpachat hallivni umishpachat hashshimi elle hem mishpechot haggershunni
Legershon zarit livni vezarit shimi illen innun zarayat gershon:
Pekudehem bemispar kol-zachar mibben-chodesh vamala pekudehem shivat alafim vachamesh meot
Minyanehon beminyan kol dechura mibbar yarcha uleella minyanehon shava alfin vachamesh mea:
Mishpechot haggershunni achare hammishkan yachanu yamma
Zarayat gershon achore mashkena yishrun maarva:
Unesi vet-av laggershunni elyasaf ben-lael
Verav bet abba levet gershon elyasaf bar lael:
Umishmeret bene-gershon beohel moed hammishkan vehaohel michsehu umasach petach ohel moed
Umatterat bene gershon bemashkan zimna mashkena uferasa chofaeh uferasa ditra mashkan zimna:
Vekale hechatzer veet-masach petach hechatzer asher al-hammishkan veal-hammizbeach saviv veet metarav lechol avodato
Userade dedarta veyat perasa ditra darta di al mashkena veal madbecha sechor sechor veyat attunohi lechol pulechaneh:
Velikhat mishpachat haamrami umishpachat hayyitzhari umishpachat hachevroni umishpachat haozzieli elle hem mishpechot hakkehati
Velikhat zarit amram vezarit yitzhar vezarit chevron vezarit uzziel illen innun zarayat kehat:
Bemispar kol-zachar mibben-chodesh vamala shemonat alafim veshesh meot shomre mishmeret hakkodesh
Beminyan kol dechura mibbar yarcha uleella temanya alfin veshit mea natre mattarta dekudesha:
Mishpechot bene-kehat yachanu al yerech hammishkan temana
Zarayat bene kehat yishrun al tzidda demashkena daroma:
Unesi vet-av lemishpechot hakkehati elitzafan ben-uzziel
Verav bet abba lezarayat kehat elitzafan bar uzziel:
Umishmartam haaron vehashshulchan vehammenora vehammizbechot uchele hakkodesh asher yeshartu bahem vehammasach vechol avodato
Umattartehon arona ufatora umenarta umadbecha umane kudesha di yeshammeshun behon uferasa vechol palchaneh:
Unesi nesie hallevi elazar ben-aharon hakkohen pekuddat shomre mishmeret hakkodesh
Vaamarkela dimmanna al ravreve levae elazar bar aharon kahana demittechot yedohi memannan natre matterat kudesha:
Limrari mishpachat hammachli umishpachat hammushi elle hem mishpechot merari
Limrari zarit machli vezarit mushi illen innun zarayat merari:
Ufekudehem bemispar kol-zachar mibben-chodesh vamala sheshet alafim umatayim
Uminyanehon beminyan kol dechura mibbar yarcha uleella shitta alfin umatan:
Unesi vet-av lemishpechot merari tzuriel ben-avichayil al yerech hammishkan yachanu tzafona
Verav bet abba lezarayat merari tzuriel bar avichayil al tzidda demashkena yishrun tzippuna:
Ufekuddat mishmeret bene merari karshe hammishkan uverichav veammudav vaadanav vechol-kelav vechol avodato
Vedi mesir lematterat bene merari dappe mashkena veavrohi veammudohi vesamchohi vechol manohi vechol pulechaneh:
Veammude hechatzer saviv veadnehem vitedotam umetrehem
Veammude dedarta sechor sechor vesamchehon vesikkehon veattunehon:
Vehachonim lifne hammishkan kedma lifne ohel-moed mizracha moshe veaharon uvanav shomrim mishmeret hammikdash lemishmeret bene yisrael vehazzar hakkarev yumat
Vedi sheran kodam mashkena kidduma kodam mashkan zimna maddincha mshe veaharon uvenohi natrin matterat makdesha lematterat bene yisrael vechillonay deyikrav yitketal:
Kol-pekude haleviyyim asher pakad moshe veaharon al-pi Adonai lemishpechotam kol-zachar mibben-chodesh vamala shenayim veesrim alef
Kol minyane levae di mena mshe veaharon al memra daAdonai lezarayathon kol dechura mibbar yarcha uleella asrin uteren alfin:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe pekod kol-bechor zachar livne yisrael mibben-chodesh vamala vesa et mispar shemotam
Vaamar Adonai lemshe mene kol bucherayya dichrayya livne yisrael mibbar yarcha uleella vekabbel yat minyan shemahathon:
Velakachta et-haleviyyim li ani Adonai tachat kol-bechor bivne yisrael veet behemat haleviyyim tachat kol-bechor bevehemat bene yisrael
Utekarev yat levae kodamay ana Adonai chalaf kol buchera bivne yisrael veyat beira delevae chalaf kol buchera bivira divne yisrael:
Vayyifkod moshe kaasher tzivva Adonai oto et-kol-bechor bivne yisrael
Umena mshe kema di pakid Adonai yateh yat kol buchera bivne yisrael:
Vayhi chol-bechor zachar bemispar shemot mibben-chodesh vamala lifkudehem shenayim veesrim elef shelosha veshivim umatayim
Vahavo chol bucherayya dichrayya beminyan shemahan mibbar yarcha uleella leminyanehon asrin uteren alfin matan veshavin utelata:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Kach et-haleviyyim tachat kol-bechor bivne yisrael veet-behemat haleviyyim tachat behemtam vehayu-li haleviyyim ani Adonai
Karev yat levae chalaf kol buchera bivne yisrael veyat beira delevae chalaf beirhon vihon meshammeshin kodamay levae ana Adonai:
Veet peduye hashshelosha vehashshivim vehammatayim haodfim al-haleviyyim mibbechor bene yisrael
Veyat purkan matan veshavin utelata deyattirin al levae mibbucherayya divne yisrael:
Velakachta chameshet chameshet shekalim laggulgolet beshekel hakkodesh tikkach esrim gera hashshakel
Vetissav chamesh chamesh silin legulgalta besile kudesha tissav asrin main sila:
Venatatta hakkesef leaharon ulevanav peduye haodfim bahem
Vetitten kaspa leaharon velivnohi purkan deyattirin behon:
Vayyikkach moshe et kesef happidyom meet haodfim al peduye haleviyyim
Unesev mshe yat kesaf purkanhon min deyattirin al perike levae:
Meet bechor bene yisrael lakach et-hakkasef chamishsha veshishshim ushelosh meot vaelef beshekel hakkodesh
Min bucherayya divne yisrael nesiv yat kaspa alaf utelat mea veshittin vechamesh silin besile kudesha:
Vayyitten moshe et-kesef happeduyim leaharon ulevanav al-pi Adonai kaasher tzivva Adonai et-moshe
Vihav mshe yat kesaf perikayya leaharon velivnohi al memra daAdonai kema di fakkid Adonai yat mshe:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe veel-aharon lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe veim aharon lememar:
Naso et-rosh bene kehat mittoch bene levi lemishpechotam levet avotam
Kabbilu yat chushban bene kehat miggo bene levi lezarayathon levet avahathon:
Mibben sheloshim shana vamala vead ben-chamishshim shana kol-ba latztzava laasot melacha beohel moed
Mibbar telatin shenin uleella vead bar chamshin shenin kol deate lechela lemebad ividta bemashkan zimna:
Zot avodat bene-kehat beohel moed kodesh hakkodashim
Den pulechan bene kehat bemashkan zimna kodesh kudeshayya:
Uva aharon uvanav binsoa hammachane vehoridu et parochet hammasach vechissu-vah et aron haedut
Veyeol aharon uvenohi bemittal mashrita vifarkun yat paruchta difrasa vichassun ba yat arona desahaduta:
Venatnu alav kesuy or tachash ufarsu veged-kelil techelet milmala vesamu baddav
Veyittenun alohi chofaa dimshach sasgona veyifresun levush gemir tichla milella vishavvun arichohi:
Veal shulchan happanim yifresu beged techelet venatnu alav et-hakkearot veet-hakkappot veet-hammenakkiyyot veet kesot hannasech velechem hattamid alav yihye
Veal patora dilchem appayya yifresun levush tichla veyittenun alohi yat magisayya veyat bazichayya veyat mechilata veyat kasvot nissucha ulechem tedira alohi yehe:
Ufarsu alehem beged tolaat shani vechissu oto bemichse or tachash vesamu et-baddav
Veyifresun alehon levush tzeva zehori vichassun yateh bechofaa dimshach sasgona vishavvun yat arichohi:
Velakchu beged techelet vechissu et-menorat hammaor veet-neroteha veet-malkacheha veet-machtoteha veet kol-kele shamnah asher yeshartu-lah bahem
Veyissevun levush tichla vichassun yat menarta deanhore veyat botzinaha veyat tzivtaha veyat machteytaha veyat kol mane mishcha di yeshammeshun leh behon:
Venatnu otah veet-kol-keleha el-michse or tachash venatnu al-hammot
Veyittenun yata veyat kol manaha lechofaa dimshach sasgona veyittenun al aricha:
Veal mizbach hazzahav yifresu beged techelet vechissu oto bemichse or tachash vesamu et-baddav
Veal madbecha dedahava yifresun levush tichla vichassun yateh bechofaa dimshach sasgona vishavvun yat arichohi:
Velakchu et-kol-kele hashsharet asher yeshartu-vam bakkodesh venatnu el-beged techelet vechissu otam bemichse or tachash venatnu al-hammot
Veyissevun yat kol mane shimmusha di yeshammeshun behon bekudesha veyittenun lilvush tichla vichassun yathon bechofaa dimshach sasgona veyittenun al aricha:
Vedishshenu et-hammizbeach ufarsu alav beged argaman
Veyissefun yat kitma demadbecha veyifresun alohi levush argevan:
Venatnu alav et-kol-kelav asher yeshartu alav bahem et-hammachtot et-hammizlagot veet-hayyaim veet-hammizrakot kol kele hammizbeach ufarsu alav kesuy or tachash vesamu vaddav

Veyittenun alohi yat kol manohi di yeshammeshun alohi vehon yat machteyata veyat tzinnoryata veyat magrofyata veyat mizrekayya kol mane madbecha veyifresun alohi chofaa dimshach sasgona vishavun arichohi:
Vechilla aharon-uvanav lechassot et-hakkodesh veet-kol-kele hakkodesh binsoa hammachane veachare-chen yavou vene-kehat laset velo-yiggeu el-hakkodesh vametu elle massa vene-kehat beohel moed

Vishetze aharon uvenohi lechassaa yat kudesha veyat kol mane kudesha bemittal mashrita uvatar ken yealun bene kehat lemittal vela yikrevun lekudesha vela yemutun illen mattul bene kehat bemashkan zimna:
Ufekuddat elazar ben-aharon hakkohen shemen hammaor uketoret hassammim uminchat hattamid veshemen hammishcha pekuddat kol-hammishkan vechol-asher-bo bekodesh uvechelav
Vedi mesir leelazar bar aharon kahana mishcha deanharuta uketoret busemayya uminchata tedira umishcha dirvuta matrat kol mashkena vechol di veh bekudesha uvemanohi:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe veel-aharon lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe veim aharon lememar:
Al-tachritu et-shevet mishpechot hakkehati mittoch haleviyyim
La teshetzun yat shivta zarayat kehat miggo levae:
Vezot asu lahem vechayu velo yamutu begishtam et-kodesh hakkodashim aharon uvanav yavou vesamu otam ish ish al-avodato veel-massao
Veda ividu lehon veyechun vela yemutun bemikravhon lekodesh kudeshayya aharon uvenohi yealun vimannun yathon gevar gevar al pulechaneh ulemattuleh:
Velo-yavou lirot kevalla et-hakkodesh vametu
Vela yealun lemecheze kad mechassan yat mane kudesha vela yemutun:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Naso et-rosh bene gershon gam-hem levet avotam lemishpechotam
Kabbel yat chushban bene gershon af innun levet avahathon lezarayathon:
Mibben sheloshim shana vamala ad ben-chamishshim shana tifkod otam kol-habba litzvo tzava laavod avoda beohel moed
Mibbar telatin shenin uleella ad bar chamshin shenin timne yathon kol deate lechayyala chela lemiflach palchana bemashkan zimna:
Zot avodat mishpechot haggershunni laavod ulemassa
Den palchan zarayat gershon lemiflach ulemattol:
Venasu et-yeriot hammishkan veet-ohel moed michsehu umichse hattachash asher-alav milmala veet-masach petach ohel moed
Veyittelun yat yeriat mashkena veyat mashkan zimna chofaeh vechofaa desasgona di alohi milleella veyat perasa ditra mashkan zimna:
Veet kale hechatzer veet-masach petach shaar hechatzer asher al-hammishkan veal-hammizbeach saviv veet metrehem veet-kol-kele avodatam veet kol-asher yease lahem veavadu
Veyat serade darta veyat perasa demaalana ditra darta di al mashkena veal madbecha sechor sechor veyat attunehon veyat kol mane palchanhon veyat kol di yitmesar lehon veyiflechun:
Al-pi aharon uvanav tihye kol-avodat bene haggershunni lechol-massaam ulechol avodatam ufekadtem alehem bemishmeret et kol-massaam
Al memar aharon uvenohi yehe kol palchan bene gershon lechol mattulehon ulechol palchanhon utemannun alehon bemattera yat kol mattulehon:
Zot avodat mishpechot bene haggershunni beohel moed umishmartam beyad itamar ben-aharon hakkohen
Den palchan zarayat bene gershon bemashkan zimna umattartehon bida deitamar bar aharon kahana:
Bene merari lemishpechotam levet-avotam tifkod otam
Bene merari lezarayathon levet avahathon timne yathon:
Mibben sheloshim shana vamala vead ben-chamishshim shana tifkedem kol-habba latztzava laavod et-avodat ohel moed
Mibbar telatin shenin uleella vead bar chamshin shenin timninnun kol deate lechela lemiflach yat palchan mashkan zimna:
Vezot mishmeret massaam lechol-avodatam beohel moed karshe hammishkan uverichav veammudav vaadanav
Veda matterat mattulehon lechol palchanhon bemashkan zimna dappe mashkena veavrohi veammudohi vesamchohi:
Veammude hechatzer saviv veadnehem vitedotam umetrehem lechol-kelehem ulechol avodatam uveshemot tifkedu et-kele mishmeret massaam
Veammude dedarta sechor sechor vesamchehon vesikkehon veattunehon lechol manehon ulechol palchanhon uvishmahan temannun yat mane matterat mattulehon:
Zot avodat mishpechot bene merari lechol-avodatam beohel moed beyad itamar ben-aharon hakkohen
Den palchan zarayat bene merari lechol palchanhon bemashkan zimna bida deitamar bar aharon kahana:
Vayyifkod moshe veaharon unesie haeda et-bene hakkehati lemishpechotam ulevet avotam
Umena mshe veaharon veravreve chenishta yat bene kehat lezarayathon ulevet avahathon:
Mibben sheloshim shana vamala vead ben-chamishshim shana kol-habba latztzava laavoda beohel moed
Mibbar telatin shenin uleella vead bar chamshin shenin kol deate lechela lefalchana bemashkan zimna:
Vayyihyu fekudehem lemishpechotam alpayim sheva meot vachamishshim
Vahavo meneyanehon lezarayathon teren alfin sheva mea vechamshin:
Elle fekude mishpechot hakkehati kol-haoved beohel moed asher pakad moshe veaharon al-pi Adonai beyad-moshe
Illen minyane zarayat kehat kol defalach bemashkan zimna di mena mshe veaharon al memra daAdonai bida demshe:
Ufekude bene gershon lemishpechotam ulevet avotam
Uminyane bene gershon lezarayathon ulevet avahathon:
Mibben sheloshim shana vamala vead ben-chamishshim shana kol-habba latztzava laavoda beohel moed
Mibbar telatin shenin uleella vead bar chamshin shenin kol deate lechela lefalchana bemashkan zimna:
Vayyihyu pekudehem lemishpechotam levet avotam alpayim veshesh meot usheloshim
Vahavo minyanehon lezarayathon levet avahathon teren alfin veshit mea utelatin:
Elle fekude mishpechot bene gershon kol-haoved beohel moed asher pakad moshe veaharon al-pi Adonai
Illen minyane zarayat bene gershon kol defalach bemashkan zimna di mena mshe veaharon al memra daAdonai:
Ufekude mishpechot bene merari lemishpechotam levet avotam
Uminyane zarayat bene merari lezarayathon levet avahathon:
Mibben sheloshim shana vamala vead ben-chamishshim shana kol-habba latztzava laavoda beohel moed
Mibbar telatin shenin uleella vead bar chamshin shenin kol deate lechela lefalchana bemashkan zimna:
Vayyihyu fekudehem lemishpechotam sheloshet alafim umatayim
Vahavo minyanehon lezarayathon telata alfin umatan:
Elle fekude mishpechot bene merari asher pakad moshe veaharon al-pi Adonai beyad-moshe
Illen minyane zarayat bene merari di mena mshe veaharon al memra daAdonai bida demshe:
Kol-happekudim asher pakad moshe veaharon unesie yisrael et-haleviyyim lemishpechotam ulevet avotam
Kol minyanayya di mena mshe veaharon veravreve yisrael yat levae lezarayathon ulevet avahathon:
Mibben sheloshim shana vamala vead ben-chamishshim shana kol-habba laavod avodat avoda vaavodat massa beohel moed
Mibbar telatin shenin uleella vead bar chamshin shenin kol deate lemiflach palchan palchana ufalchan mattul bemashkan zimna:
Vayyihyu pekudehem shemonat alafim vachamesh meot ushemonim
Vahavo minyanehon temanya alfin vachamesh mea vetamnan:
Al-pi Adonai pakad otam beyad-moshe ish ish al-avodato veal-massao ufekudav asher-tzivva Adonai et-moshe
Al memra daAdonai mena yathon bida demshe gevar gevar al palchaneh veal mattuleh uminyanohi di fakkid Adonai yat mshe:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Tzav et-bene yisrael vishallechu min-hammachane kol-tzarua vechol-zav vechol tame lanafesh
Pakked yat bene yisrael vishallechun min mashrita kol disgir vechol dedaev vechol dimsaav litme nafsha deenasha:
Mizzachar ad-nekeva teshallechu el-michutz lammachane teshallechum velo yetammeu et-machanehem asher ani shochen betocham
Middechar ad nukeva teshallechun lemibbara lemashrita teshallechunnun vela yesaavun yat mashrithon di shechinti sharya venehon:
Vayyaasu-chen bene yisrael vayshallechu otam el-michutz lammachane kaasher dibber Adonai el-moshe ken asu bene yisrael
Vaavadu chen bene yisrael veshallechu yathon lemibbara lemashrita kema di mallil Adonai im mshe ken avadu bene yisrael:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael ish o-ishsha ki yaasu mikkol-chattot haadam limol maal ba-Adonai veashma hannefesh hahiv
Mallel im bene yisrael gevar o itteta are yabedun mikkol chove enasha leshakkara shekar kodam Adonai veyechov enasha hahu:
Vehitvaddu et-chattatam asher asu veheshiv et-ashamo berosho vachamishito yosef alav venatan laasher asham lo
Vivaddun yat chovehon di avadu veyatev yat chovteh beresheh vechumsheh yosef alohi veyitten lidchav leh:
Veim-en laish goel lehashiv haasham elav haasham hammushav la-Adonai lakkohen millevad el hakkippurim asher yechapper-bo alav
Veim let ligvar parik laatava chovta leh chovta dimtev kodam Adonai lechahana bar middechar kippurayya di yechapper beh alohi:
Vechol-teruma lechol-kodshe vene-yisrael asher-yakrivu lakkohen lo yihye
Vechol afrashuta lechol kudeshayya divne yisrael di yekarvun lechahana dilleh yehe:
Veish et-kodashav lo yihyu ish asher-yitten lakkohen lo yihye
Ugevar yat maasar kudesheh dilleh yehon gevar diyitten lechahana dilleh yehe:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael veamarta alehem ish ish ki-tiste ishto umaala vo maal
Mallel im bene yisrael vetemar lehon gevar gevar are tiste itteteh uteshakker beh shekar:
Veshachav ish otah shichvat-zera venelam meene ishah venistera vehi nitmaa veed en bah vehiv lo nitpasa
Veyishkuv gevar yata shachvat zara vihe mechassa meene valah umittammera vehi mesaava vesahid let ba vehi la ittachadat:
Veavar alav ruach-kina vekinne et-ishto vehiv nitmaa o-avar alav ruach-kina vekinne et-ishto vehi lo nitmaa
Veyebar alohi ruach kina vikanne yat itteteh vehi mesaava o avar alohi ruach kina vikanne yat itteteh vehi la mesaava:
Vehevi haish et-ishto el-hakkohen vehevi et-korbanah aleha asirit haefa kemach seorim lo-yitzok alav shemen velo-yitten alav levona ki-minchat kenaot hu minchat zikkaron mazkeret avon

Veyayti gavra yat itteteh levat kahana veyayti yat kurbana ala chad min asra bitlat sein kimcha searin la yerik alohi mishcha vela yitten alohi levunta are minchat kinata hu minchat ducherana madkarat chova:
Vehikriv otah hakkohen veheemidah lifne Adonai
Vikarev yata kahana vikiminna kodam Adonai:
Velakach hakkohen mayim kedoshim bichli-chares umin-heafar asher yihye bekarka hammishkan yikkach hakkohen venatan el-hammayim
Veyissav kahana me chiyyor beman dachasaf umin afra di yehe bisode mashkena yissav kahana veyitten lemayya:
Veheemid hakkohen et-haishsha lifne Adonai ufara et-rosh haishsha venatan al-kappeha et minchat hazzikkaron minchat kenaot hiv uveyad hakkohen yihyu me hammarim hamearerim
Vikim kahana yat itteta kodam Adonai veyifra yat resha deitteta vihev al yedaha yat minchat ducherana minchat kinata hi uvida dechahana yehon mayya merirayya melattayya:
Vehishbia otah hakkohen veamar el-haishsha im-lo shachav ish otach veim-lo satit tuma tachat ishech hinnaki mimme hammarim hamearerim haelle
Veyome yata kahana veyemar leitteta im la shechiv gevar yatich veim la setit leistaava bar mibbaalich heve zakkaa mimmayya merirayya melattayya haillen:
Veat ki satit tachat ishech vechi nitmet vayyitten ish bach et-shechovto mibbalade ishech
Veat are setit bar mibbaalich vaare istaavt vihav gevar bich yat shechuvteh bar mibbaalich:
Vehishbia hakkohen et-haishsha bishvuat haala veamar hakkohen laishsha yitten Adonai otach leala velishvua betoch ammech betet Adonai et-yerechech nofelet veet-bitnech tzava
Veyome chahana yat itteta bemomata dilvata veyemar kahana leitteta yehev Adonai yatich lilvat ulemome bego ammich bedihev Adonai yat yarkich masya veyat meaychi nefichin:
Uvau hammayim hamearerim haelle bemeayich latzbot beten velanpil yarech veamra haishsha amen amen
Veyealun mayya melattayya haillen bimaychi laafacha mein uleamsaa yarka vetemar itteta amen amen:
Vechatav et-haalot haelle hakkohen bassefer umacha el-me hammarim
Veyichtov yat levatayya haillen kahana besifra veyimchok lemayya merirayya:
Vehishka et-haishsha et-me hammarim hamearerim uvau vah hammayim hamearerim lemarim
Veyashke yat itteta yat mayya merirayya melattayya veyealun ba mayya melattayya limriru:
Velakach hakkohen miyyad haishsha et minchat hakkenaot vehenif et-hammincha lifne Adonai vehikriv otah el-hammizbeach
Veyissav kahana mida deitteta yat minchat kinata virim yat minchata kodam Adonai vikarev yata lemadbecha:
Vekamatz hakkohen min-hammincha et-azkaratah vehiktir hammizbecha veachar yashke et-haishsha et-hammayim
Veyikmotz kahana min minchata yat adkarta veyassek lemadbecha uvatar ken yashke yat itteta yat mayya:
Vehishkah et-hammayim vehayta im-nitmea vattimol maal beishah uvau vah hammayim hamearerim lemarim vetzavta vitnah venafla yerechah vehayta haishsha leala bekerev ammah
Veyashkinna yat mayya utehe im istaavat veshakkarat shekar bevaala veyealun ba mayya melattayya limriru veyippechun meaha vetitmese yarka utehe itteta lilvat bego amma:
Veim-lo nitmea haishsha utehora hiv venikketa venizrea zara
Veim la istaavat itteta vedachyaa hi vetippok zakkaa vetadi idduy:
Zot torat hakkenaot asher tiste ishsha tachat ishah venitmaa
Da orayta dekinata di tiste itteta bar mibbaala vetistaav:
O ish asher taavor alav ruach kina vekinne et-ishto veheemid et-haishsha lifne Adonai veasa lah hakkohen et kol-hattora hazzot
O gevar di tebar alohi ruach kina vikanne yat ittete vikem yat itteta kodam Adonai veyebad la kahana yat kol orayta hada:
Venikka haish meavon vehaishsha hahiv tissa et-avonah
Vihe zakkaa gavra mechova veitteta hahi tekabbel yat chovah:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael veamarta alehem ish o-ishsha ki yafli lindor neder nazir lehazzir la-Adonai
Mallel im bene yisrael vetemar lehon gevar o itteta are yefaresh lemiddar nedar neziru lemezar kodam Adonai:
Miyyayin veshechar yazzir chometz yayin vechometz shechar lo yishte vechol-mishrat anavim lo yishte vaanavim lachim viveshim lo yochel
Mechamar chadat veattik yizzar chal dachamar chadat vechal dachamar attik la yishte vechol matrut invin la yishte veinvin rattivin viveshin la yechul:
Kol yeme nizro mikkol asher yease miggefen hayyayin mechartzannim vead-zag lo yochel
Kol yome nizreh mikkol deyitaved miggufna dechamra mippuretzenin vead itztzurin la yechul:
Kol-yeme neder nizro taar lo-yaavor al-rosho ad-melot hayyamim asher-yazzir la-Adonai kadosh yihye gaddel pera sear rosho
Kol yome nedar nizreh maspar la yebar al resheh ad mishlam yomayya deyanzer kodam Adonai kaddish yehe marbe ferua sear resheh:
Kol-yeme hazziro la-Adonai al-nefesh met lo yavo
Kol yomin deyanzer kodam Adonai al nafsha demeta la yeul:
Leaviv uleimmo leachiv uleachoto lo-yittamma lahem bemotam ki nezer elohav al-rosho
Leavuhi uleimmeh leachuhi uleachateh la yistaav lehon bemothon are kelila deelaheh al resheh:
Kol yeme nizro kadosh hu la-Adonai
Kol yome nizreh kaddish hu kodam Adonai:
Vechi-yamut met alav befeta pitom vetimme rosh nizro vegillach rosho beyom tohorato bayyom hashshevii yegallechennu
Vaare yemut meta alohi bitkef shalu visaev resh nizreh vigallach resheh beyoma didchuteh beyoma sheviaa yegallechinne:
Uvayyom hashshemini yavi shete torim o shene bene yona el-hakkohen el-petach ohel moed
Uveyoma teminaa yayte tarten shafninin o teren bene yona levat kahana litra mashkan zimna:
Veasa hakkohen echad lechattat veechad leola vechipper alav measher chata al-hannafesh vekiddash et-rosho bayyom hahu
Veyabed kahana chad lechattata vechad laalata vichapper alohi middechav al meta vikaddash yat resheh beyoma hahu:
Vehizzir la-Adonai et-yeme nizro vehevi keves ben-shenato leasham vehayyamim harishonim yippelu ki tame nizro
Veyazzer kodam Adonai yat yome nizreh veyayti immar bar shatteh laashama veyomayya kadmae yivtelun are istaav nizreh:
Vezot torat hannazir beyom melot yeme nizro yavi oto el-petach ohel moed
Veda orayta dinzira beyom mishlam yome nizreh yayti yateh litra mashkan zimna:
Vehikriv et-korbano la-Adonai keves ben-shenato tamim echad leola vechavsa achat bat-shenatah temima lechattat veayil-echad tamim lishlamim
Vikarev yat kurbaneh kodam Adonai immar bar shatte shelim chad laalata veimmarta chada bat shatte shelemta lechattata udechar chad shelim lenichsat kudeshayya:
Vesal matztzot solet challot belulot bashshemen urekike matztzot meshuchim bashshamen uminchatam veniskehem
Vesal pattir sulta geritzan defilan bimshach veispogin pattirin dimshichin bimshach uminchathon veniskehon:
Vehikriv hakkohen lifne Adonai veasa et-chattato veet-olato
Vikarev kahana kodam Adonai veyabed yat chattateh veyat alateh:
Veet-haayil yaase zevach shelamim la-Adonai al sal hammatztzot veasa hakkohen et-minchato veet-nisko
Veyat dichra yabed nichsat kudeshayya kodam Adonai al salla defattirayya veyabed kahana yat minchateh veyat niskeh:
Vegillach hannazir petach ohel moed et-rosh nizro velakach et-sear rosh nizro venatan al-haesh asher-tachat zevach hashshelamim
Vigallach nezira bitra mashkan zimna yat resh nizreh veyissav yat sear resh nizreh veyitten al eshshata di techot duda denichsat kudeshayya:
Velakach hakkohen et-hazzeroa beshela min-haayil vechallat matztza achat min-hassal urekik matztza echad venatan al-kappe hannazir achar hitgallecho et-nizro
Veyissav kahana yat deraa beshela min dichra ugeritzta pattirta chada min salla veispog pattir chad veyitten al yede nezira batar degallach yat nizreh:
Vehenif otam hakkohen tenufa lifne Adonai kodesh hu lakkohen al chaze hattenufa veal shok hatteruma veachar yishte hannazir yayin
Virim yathon kahana arama kodam Adonai kudesha hu lechahana al chadya daaramuta veal shaka deafrashuta uvatar ken yishte nezira chamra:
Zot torat hannazir asher yiddor korbano la-Adonai al-nizro millevad asher-tassig yado kefi nidro asher yiddor ken yaase al torat nizro
Da orayta dinzira di yiddar kurbaneh kodam Adonai al nizreh bar middetadbek yedeh kefum nidreh di yiddar ken yabed al orayta denizreh:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Dabber el-aharon veel-banav lemor ko tevarchu et-bene yisrael amor lahem
Mallel im aharon veim benohi lememar keden tevarchun yat bene yisrael temrun lehon:
Yevarechcha Adonai veyishmerecha
Yevarchinnach Adonai veyitterinnach:
Yaer Adonai panav elecha vichunnekka
Yanhar Adonai shechinteh levatach virachem yatach:
Yissa Adonai panav elecha veyasem lecha shalom
Yissav Adonai appeh levatach vishavve lach shelam:
Vesamu et-shemi al-bene yisrael vaani avarchem
Vishavvun yat birkat shemi al bene yisrael vaana avarechinnun:
Vayhi beyom kallot moshe lehakim et-hammishkan vayyimshach oto vaykaddesh oto veet-kol-kelav veet-hammizbeach veet-kol-kelav vayyimshachem vaykaddesh otam
Vahava beyoma deshetze mshe laakama yat mashkena verabbi yateh vekaddish yateh veyat kol manohi veyat madbecha veyat kol manohi verabbinnun vekaddish yathon:
Vayyakrivu nesie yisrael rashe bet avotam hem nesie hammattot hem haomdim al-happekudim
Ukerivu ravreve yisrael reshe bet avahathon innun ravreve shivtayya innun dekaymin al minyanayya:
Vayyaviu et-korbanam lifne Adonai shesh-eglot tzav ushene asar bakar agala al-shene hannesiim veshor leechad vayyakrivu otam lifne hammishkan
Veaytiyu yat kurbanehon kodam Adonai shit eglan kad mechafyan utere asar torin egleta al teren ravrevayya vetor lechad vekarivu yathon lokodam mashkena:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe lemor
Vaamar Adonai lemshe lememar:
Kach meittam vehayu laavod et-avodat ohel moed venatatta otam el-haleviyyim ish kefi avodato
Kabbel minnehon vihon lemiflach yat palchan mashkan zimna vetitten yathon lelevae gevar kemissat palchaneh:
Vayyikkach moshe et-haagalot veet-habbakar vayyitten otam el-haleviyyim
Unesev mshe yat eglata veyat tore vihav yathon lelevae:
Et shete haagalot veet arbaat habbakar natan livne gershon kefi avodatam
Yat tarten eglata veyat arbea tore yehav livne gershon kemissat palchanhon:
Veet arba haagalot veet shemonat habbakar natan livne merari kefi avodatam beyad itamar ben-aharon hakkohen
Veyat arba eglan veyat temanya tore yehav livne merari kemissat palchanhon bida deitamar bar aharon kahana:
Velivne kehat lo natan ki-avodat hakkodesh alehem bakkatef yissau
Velivne kehat la yehav are falchan kudesha alehon bechatpa natlin:
Vayyakrivu hannesiim et chanukkat hammizbeach beyom himmashach oto vayyakrivu hannesiim et-korbanam lifne hammizbeach
Vekarivu ravrevayya yat chanukkat madbecha beyoma derabbiyyu yateh vekarivu ravrevayya yat kurbanhon lekodam madbecha:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe nasi echad layyom nasi echad layyom yakrivu et-korbanam lachanukkat hammizbeach
Vaamar Adonai lemshe rabba chad leyoma rabba chad leyoma yekarvun yat kurbanhon lachanukkat madbecha:
Vayhi hammakriv bayyom harishon et-korbano nachshon ben-amminadav lematte yehuda
Vahava dimkarav beyoma kadmaa yat kurbaneh nachshon bar amminadav leshivta dihuda:
Vekorbano kaarat-kesef achat sheloshim umea mishkalah mizrak echad kesef shivim shekel beshekel hakkodesh shenehem meleim solet belula vashshemen lemincha
Vekurbaneh megista dichsaf chada mea utelatin silin hava matkela mizreka chad dichsaf matkeleh shavin silin besile kudesha tarvehon melan sulta defila vimshach leminchata:
Kaf achat asara zahav melea ketoret
Bazicha chada matkal asar silin hi didhav malya ketoret busemayya:
Par echad ben-bakar ayil echad keves-echad ben-shenato leola
Tor chad bar tore dechar chad immar chad bar shatteh laalata:
Seir-izzim echad lechattat
Tzefir bar izzin chad lechattata:
Ulezevach hashshelamim bakar shenayim elim chamishsha attudim chamishsha kevasim bene-shana chamishsha ze korban nachshon ben-amminadav
Ulenichsat kudeshayya torin teren dichre chamsha gedaye chamsha immerin bene shena chamsha den kurbana denachshon bar amminadav:
Bayyom hashsheni hikriv netanel ben-tzuar nesi yissashchar
Beyoma tinyana kariv netanel bar tzuar rabba deyissashchar:
Hikriv et-korbano kaarat-kesef achat sheloshim umea mishkalah mizrak echad kesef shivim shekel beshekel hakkodesh shenehem meleim solet belula vashshemen lemincha
Kariv yat kurbaneh megista dichsaf chada mea utelatin silin hava matkela mizreka chad dichsaf matkeleh shavin silin besile kudesha tarvehon melan sulta defila vimshach leminchata:

Tor chad bar tore dechar chad immar chad bar shatteh laalata:

Tzefir bar izzin chad lechattata:

Karev yat levae miggo bene yisrael utedakke yathon:

Utekarev yat levae kodam mashkan zimna vetichnesh yat kol kenishta divne yisrael:
Vehikravta et-haleviyyim lifne Adonai vesamchu vene-yisrael et-yedehem al-haleviyyim
Utekarev yat levae kodam Adonai veyismechun bene yisrael yat yedehon al levae:
Vehenif aharon et-haleviyyim tenufa lifne Adonai meet bene yisrael vehayu laavod et-avodat Adonai
Virim aharon yat levae arama kodam Adonai min bene yisrael vihon lemiflach yat palchana daAdonai:
Vehaleviyyim yismechu et-yedehem al rosh happarim vaase et-haechad chattat veet-haechad ola la-Adonai lechapper al-haleviyyim
Velevae yismechun yat yedehon al resh torayya veyaabbed yat chad chattata veyat chad alata kodam Adonai lechappara al levae:
Vehaamadta et-haleviyyim lifne aharon velifne vanav vehenafta otam tenufa la-Adonai
Utekem yat levae kodam aharon vekadam benohi uterem yathon arama kodam Adonai:
Vehivdalta et-haleviyyim mittoch bene yisrael vehayu li haleviyyim
Vetafresh yat levae miggo bene yisrael vihon meshammeshin kodamay levae:
Veachare-chen yavou haleviyyim laavod et-ohel moed vetiharta otam vehenafta otam tenufa
Uvatar ken yaalun levae lemiflach yat mashkan zimna utedakke yathon uterem yathon arama:
Ki netunim netunim hemma li mittoch bene yisrael tachat pitrat kol-rechem bechor kol mibbene yisrael lakachti otam li
Are afrasha mafreshin innun li miggo bene yisrael chalaf petach kol valda buchera cholla mibbene yisrael karevit yathon kodamay:
Ki li chol-bechor bivne yisrael baadam uvabbehema beyom hakkoti chol-bechor beeretz mitzrayim hikdashti otam li
Are dili chol buchera bivne yisrael baanasha uvivira beyoma diktalit kol buchera beara demitzrayim akdeshit yathon kodamay:
Vaekkach et-haleviyyim tachat kol-bechor bivne yisrael
Vekarevit yat levae chalaf kol buchera bivne yisrael:

Vihavit yat levae mesirin leaharon velivnohi miggo bene yisrael lemiflach yat palchan bene yisrael bemashkan zimna ulechappara al bene yisrael vela yehe bivne yisrael mota bemikrav bene yisrael lekudesha:

Uvatar ken allu levae lemiflach yat palchanhon bemashkan zimna kodam aharon vekadam benohi kema di fakkid Adonai yat mshe al levae ken avadu lehon:

Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:

Umibbar chamshin shenin yetuv mechel palchana vela yiflach od:

Umallil Adonai im mshe bemadbera desinay beshatta tinyeta lemippakhon meara demitzrayim beyarcha kadmaa lememar:

Veyabedun bene yisrael yat pischa bezimneh:
Bearbaa asar-yom bachodesh hazze ben haarbayim taasu oto bemoado kechol-chukkotav uchechol-mishpatav taasu oto
Bearbeat asra yoma beyarcha haden ben shimshayya tabedun yateh bezimneh kechal gezerateh uchechal dechaze leh tabedun yateh:
Vaydabber moshe el-bene yisrael laasot happasach
Umallil mshe im bene yisrael lemebad pischa:
Vayyaasu et-happesach barishon bearbaa asar yom lachodesh ben haarbayim bemidbar sinay kechol asher tzivva Adonai et-moshe ken asu bene yisrael
Vaavadu yat pischa benisan bearbeat asra yoma leyarcha ben shimshayya bemadbera desinay kechol di fakkid Adonai yat mshe ken avadu bene yisrael:
Vayhi anashim asher hayu temeim lenefesh adam velo-yachlu laasot-happesach bayyom hahu vayyikrevu lifne moshe velifne aharon bayyom hahu
Vahavo guvrayya di havo mesaavin litme nafsha deenasha vela yechilu lemebad pischa beyoma hahu ukerivu kodam mshe vekadam aharon beyoma hahu:

Vaamar lehon mshe orichu ad deishma ma deitpakkad kodam Adonai al di lechon:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael lemor ish ish ki-yihye-tame lanefesh o vederech rechoka lachem o ledorotechem veasa fesach la-Adonai
Mallel im bene yisrael lememar gevar gevar are yehe mesaav litme nafsha deenasha o veorcha rechika lechon o ledarechon veyabed pischa kodam Adonai:
Bachodesh hashsheni bearbaa asar yom ben haarbayim yaasu oto al-matztzot umerorim yochluhu
Beyarcha tinyana bearbeat asra yoma ben shimshayya yabedun yateh al pattir umerarin yechlunneh:
Lo-yashiru mimmennu ad-boker veetzem lo yishberu-vo kechol-chukkat happesach yaasu oto
La yasharun minneh ad tzafra vegarma la yitberun beh kechal gezerat pischa yabedun yateh:
Vehaish asher-hu tahor uvederech lo-haya vechadal laasot happesach venichreta hannefesh hahiv meammeha ki korban Adonai lo hikriv bemoado cheto yissa haish hahu
Vegavra dehu deche uveorach la hava veyitmena lemebad pischa veyishtetze anasha hahi meamma are kurbana daAdonai la kariv bezimneh choveh yekabbel gavra hahu:
Vechi-yagur ittechem ger veasa fesach la-Adonai kechukkat happesach uchemishpato ken yaase chukka achat yihye lachem velagger uleezrach haaretz
Vaare yitgayyar immechon giyyora veyabed pischa kodam Adonai kigzerat pischa vechidchaze leh ken yabed keyama chad yehe lechon ulegiyyora uleyatztziva deara:
Uveyom hakim et-hammishkan kissa heanan et-hammishkan leohel haedut uvaerev yihye al-hammishkan kemare-esh ad-boker
Uveyoma deittakam yat mashkena chafa anana yat mashkena lemashkena desahaduta uveramsha hava al mashkena kechezu eshshata ad tzafra:
Ken yihye tamid heanan yechassennu umare-esh layla
Ken hava tedira anana chafe leh vechezu eshshata belelya:
Ulefi healot heanan meal haohel veachare chen yisu bene yisrael uvimkom asher yishkon-sham heanan sham yachanu bene yisrael
Ulefum istallakut anana meillave mashkena uvatar ken natlin bene yisrael uveatra deshare tamman anana tamman sharan bene yisrael:
Al-pi Adonai yisu bene yisrael veal-pi Adonai yachanu kol-yeme asher yishkon heanan al-hammishkan yachanu
Al memra daAdonai natlin bene yisrael veal memra daAdonai sharan kol yome di share anana al mashkena sharan:
Uvehaarich heanan al-hammishkan yamim rabbim veshamru vene-yisrael et-mishmeret Adonai velo yissau
Uveorachut anana al mashkena yomin saggiin veyitterun bene yisrael yat matterat memra daAdonai vela natlin:
Veyesh asher yihye heanan yamim mispar al-hammishkan al-pi Adonai yachanu veal-pi Adonai yissau
Veit di hava anana yome deminyan al mashkena al memra daAdonai sharan veal memra daAdonai natlin:
Veyesh asher-yihye heanan meerev ad-boker venaala heanan babboker venasau o yomam valayla venaala heanan venasau
Veit di hava anana meramsha ad tzafra umistallak anana betzafra venatlin o yemam velele umistallak anana venatlin:
O-yomayim o-chodesh o-yamim behaarich heanan al-hammishkan lishkon alav yachanu vene-yisrael velo yissau uvehealoto yissau
O teren yomin o yarcha o iddan beiddan beorachut anana al mashkena lemishre alohi sharan bene yisrael vela natlin uveistallakuteh natlin:
Al-pi Adonai yachanu veal-pi Adonai yissau et-mishmeret Adonai shamaru al-pi Adonai beyad-moshe
Al memra daAdonai sharan veal memra daAdonai natlin yat matterat memra daAdonai natrin al memra daAdonai bida demshe:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Ase lecha shete chatzotzrot kesef miksha taase otam vehayu lecha lemikra haeda ulemassa et-hammachanot
Ived lach tarten chatzotzran dichsaf negid tabed yathon vihevyan lach leara chenishta uleattala yat mashrita:
Vetaku bahen venoadu elecha kol-haeda el-petach ohel moed
Veyitkeun behen veyizdammenun levatach kol kenishta litra mashkan zimna:
Veim-beachat yitkau venoadu elecha hannesiim rashe alfe yisrael
Veim bachada yitkeun veyizdammenun levatach ravrevayya reshe alfayya deyisrael:
Utekatem terua venasu hammachanot hachonim kedma
Vetitkeun yabbevta veyittelun mashshiryata dishran kidduma:
Utekatem terua shenit venasu hammachanot hachonim temana terua yitkeu lemasehem
Vetitkeun yabbevta tinyanut veyittelun mashshiryata dishran daroma yabbava yitkeun lemattelanehon:
Uvehakhil et-hakkahal titkeu velo tariu
Uvemichnash yat kehala titkeun vela teyabbevun:
Uvene aharon hakkohanim yitkeu bachatzotzrot vehayu lachem lechukkat olam ledorotechem
Uvene aharon kahanayya yitkeun bachatzotzrata vihevyan lechon likyam alam ledarechon:
Vechi-tavou milchama beartzechem al-hatztzar hatztzorer etchem vahareotem bachatzotzrot venizkartem lifne Adonai elohechem venoshatem meoyvechem
Vaare tealun leaggacha kerava bearachon al meike dimikin lechon uteyabbevun bachatzotzrata veyeul ducheranechon letava kodam Adonai elahachon vetitparkun missanechon:
Uveyom simchatchem uvemoadechem uverashe chodshechem utekatem bachatzotzrot al olotechem veal zivche shalmechem vehayu lachem lezikkaron lifne elohechem ani Adonai elohechem
Uveyom chedvatchon uvemoadechon uvereshe yarchechon vetitkeun bachatzotzrata al alavatchon veal nichsat kudeshechon vihevyan lechon leducherana kodam elahachon ana Adonai elahachon:
Vayhi bashshana hashshenit bachodesh hashsheni beesrim bachodesh naala heanan meal mishkan haedut
Vahava beshatta tinyeta beyarcha tinyana beasrin leyarcha istallak anana meillave mashkena desahaduta:
Vayyisu vene-yisrael lemasehem mimmidbar sinay vayyishkon heanan bemidbar paran
Unetalu vene yisrael lemattelanehon mimmadbera desinay ushera anana bemadbera defaran:
Vayyisu barishona al-pi Adonai beyad-moshe
Unetalu bekadmeta al memra daAdonai bida demshe:
Vayyissa degel machane vene-yehuda barishona letzivotam veal-tzevao nachshon ben-amminadav
Unetal tekas mashrit bene yehuda bekadmeta lechelehon veal cheleh nachshon bar amminadav:
Veal-tzeva matte bene yissashchar netanel ben-tzuar
Veal chela deshivta divne yissashchar netanel bar tzuar:
Veal-tzeva matte bene zevulun eliav ben-chelon
Veal chela deshivta divne zevulun eliav bar chelon:
Vehurad hammishkan venasu vene-gershon uvene merari nose hammishkan
Umitparak mashkena venatlin bene gershon uvene merari natle mashkena:
Venasa degel machane reuven letzivotam veal-tzevao elitzur ben-shedeur
Unetal tekas mashrit reuven lechelehon veal cheleh elitzur bar shedeur:
Veal-tzeva matte bene shimon shelumiel ben-tzurishadday
Veal chela deshivta divne shimon shelumiel bar tzurishadday:
Veal-tzeva matte vene-gad elyasaf ben-deuel
Veal chela deshivta divne gad elyasaf bar deuel:
Venasu hakkehatim nose hammikdash vehekimu et-hammishkan ad-boam
Venatlin bene kehat natle makdesha umekimin yat mashkena ad metehon:
Venasa degel machane vene-efrayim letzivotam veal-tzevao elishama ben-ammihud
Unetal tekas mashrit bene efrayim lechelehon veal cheleh elishama bar ammihud:
Veal-tzeva matte bene menashshe gamliel ben-pedatzur
Veal chela deshivta divne menashshe gamliel bar pedatzur:
Veal-tzeva matte bene vinyamin avidan ben-gidoni
Veal chela deshivta divne vinyamin avidan bar gidoni:
Venasa degel machane vene-dan meassef lechol-hammachanot letzivotam veal-tzevao achiezer ben-ammishadday
Venatel tekas mashrit bene dan machnesh lechol mashshiryata lechelehon veal cheleh achiezer bar ammishadday:
Veal-tzeva matte bene asher pagiel ben-ochran
Veal chela deshivta divne asher pagiel bar achran:
Veal-tzeva matte bene naftali achira ben-enan
Veal chela deshivta divne naftali achira bar enan:
Elle mase vene-yisrael letzivotam vayyissau
Illen mattelane bene yisrael lechelehon unetalu:
Vayyomer moshe lechovav ben-reuel hammidyani choten moshe nosim anachnu el-hammakom asher amar Adonai oto etten lachem lecha ittanu vehetavnu lach ki-Adonai dibber-tov al-yisrael
Vaamar mshe lechovav bar reuel midyanaa chamuhi demshe natlin anachna leatra di amar Adonai yateh etten lechon ita immana venotev lach are Adonai mallil leaytaa tava al yisrael:
Vayyomer elav lo elech ki im-el-artzi veel-moladti elech
Vaamar leh la ezel ellahen leari uleyalladuti ezel:
Vayyomer al-na taazov otanu ki al-ken yadata chanotenu bammidbar vehayita lanu leenayim
Vaamar la chean tishbok yatana are al ken yedaat kad havena sharan bemadbera ugevuran deitavidan lana chazeta veenayich:
Vehaya ki-telech immanu vehaya hattov hahu asher yetiv Adonai immanu vehetavnu lach
Vihe are tezel immana vihe tava hahu di yotiv Adonai immana venotev lach:
Vayyisu mehar Adonai derech sheloshet yamim vaaron berit-Adonai nosea lifnehem derech sheloshet yamim latur lahem menucha
Unetalu mittura deitgele alohi yekara daAdonai mahalach telata yomin vaaron keyama daAdonai natel kodamehon mahalach telata yomin leatkenaa lehon atar bet meshre:
Vaanan Adonai alehem yomam benosam min-hammachane
Vaanan yekara daAdonai mattel alehon bimama bemittalhon min mashrita:
Vayhi binsoa haaron vayyomer moshe kuma Adonai veyafutzu oyvecha veyanusu mesanecha mippanecha
Vahava bemittal arona vaamar mshe itgele Adonai veyitbadderun sanaych viarkun baale devavach min kodamach:
Uvenucho yomar shuva Adonai rivvot alfe yisrael
Uvemishrohi amar tuv Adonai shere vikarach bego rivvat alfayya deyisrael:
Vayhi haam kemitonenim ra beozne Adonai vayyishma Adonai vayyichar appo vattivar-bam esh Adonai vattochal biktze hammachane
Vahava amma kad mistakfin bish kodam Adonai ushemia kodam Adonai utekef rogzeh udelekat behon eshshata min kodam Adonai veshetziat bisyafe mashrita:
Vayyitzak haam el-moshe vayyitpallel moshe el-Adonai vattishka haesh
Utzevach amma al mshe vetzalli mshe kodam Adonai veishtakkeat eshshata:
Vayyikra shem-hammakom hahu tavera ki-vaara vam esh Adonai
Ukera shema deatra hahu delekta are delekat behon eshshata min kodam Adonai:
Vehasafsuf asher bekirbo hitavvu taava vayyashuvu vayyivku gam bene yisrael vayyomru mi yaachilenu basar
Vaaravrevin di venehon sheilu sheelta vetavu uvecho af bene yisrael vaamaru man yechlinnana bisra:
Zacharnu et-haddaga asher-nochal bemitzrayim chinnam et hakkishshuim veet haavattichim veet-hechatzir veet-habbetzalim veet-hashshumim
Dechirin anachna yat nunayya dahavena ochlin bemitzrayim maggan yat botzinayya veyat avattichayya ucherate uvutzele vetume:
Veatta nafshenu yevesha en kol bilti el-hamman enenu
Uchean nafshana taiva let kol middaam ellahen lemanna enana:
Vehamman kizra-gad hu veeno keen habbedolach
Umanna kevar zera gadda hu vechezveh kechezu vedolcha:
Shatu haam velaktu vetachanu varechayim o dachu bammedocha uvishshelu bapparur veasu oto ugot vehaya tamo ketaam leshad hashshamen
Shaytin amma velaktin detzave tachin berechayya o detzave daich bammeduchta umevashshelin leh bekidra veavdin yateh geritzan vahava taameh kitem delish bemishcha:
Uveredet hattal al-hammachane layla yered hamman alav
Vechad nachet talla al mashrita lelya nachet manna alohi:
Vayyishma moshe et-haam boche lemishpechotav ish lefetach oholo vayyichar-af Adonai meod uveene moshe ra
Ushema mshe yat amma bachan lezarayathon gevar bitra mashkeneh utekef rogza daAdonai lachada uveene mshe bish:
Vayyomer moshe el-Adonai lama hareota leavdecha velamma lo-matzati chen beenecha lasum et-massa kol-haam hazze alay
Vaamar mshe kodam Adonai lema aveshta leavdach ulema la ashkachit rachamin kodamach leshavvaa yat metul kol amma haden alay:
Heanochi hariti et kol-haam hazze im-anochi yelidtihu ki-tomar elay saehu vechekecha kaasher yissa haomen et-hayyonek al haadama asher nishbata laavotav
Haav ana lechol amma haden im benay innun deamret li sovarhi betakpach kema dimsovar turbeyana yat yanka al ara di kayyemta laavahatohi:
Meayin li basar latet lechol-haam hazze ki-yivku alay lemor tena-llanu vasar venochela
Menan li bisra lemehav lechol amma haden are bachan alay lememar hav lana visra venechul:
Lo-uchal anochi levaddi laset et-kol-haam hazze ki chaved mimmenni
Let ana yachil bilchodi lesovara yat kol amma haden are yakkir minni:
Veim-kacha at-ose li horgeni na harog im-matzati chen beenecha veal-ere beraati
Veim keden at aved li ketalni chean ketol im ashkachit rachamin kodamach vela echeze bevishti:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe esfa-lli shivim ish mizzikne yisrael asher yadata ki-hem zikne haam veshotrav velakachta otam el-ohel moed vehityatztzevu sham immach
Vaamar Adonai lemshe kenosh kodamay shavin gavra missave yisrael di yedaat are innun save amma vesarchohi utedabbar yathon lemashkan zimna veyitattedun tamman immach:
Veyaradti vedibbarti immecha sham veatzalti min-haruach asher alecha vesamti alehem venasu ittecha bemassa haam velo-tissa atta levaddecha
Veetgele veemallel immach tamman vaarabbe min rucha daalach veeshavve alehon visovrun immach bemattul amma vela tesovar at bilchodach:
Veel-haam tomar hitkaddeshu lemachar vaachaltem basar ki bechitem beozne Adonai lemor mi yaachilenu basar ki-tov lanu bemitzrayim venatan Adonai lachem basar vaachaltem
Uleamma temar izdammenu limchar vetechlun bisra are bechetun kodam Adonai lememar man yechlinnana bisra are tav lana bemitzrayim veyitten Adonai lechon bisra vetechlun:
Lo yom echad tochlun velo yomayim velo chamishsha yamim velo asara yamim velo esrim yom
La yoma chad techlun vela teren yomin vela chamsha yomin vela asra yomin vela asrin yomin:
Ad chodesh yamim ad asher-yetze meappechem vehaya lachem lezara yaan ki-meastem et-Adonai asher bekirbechem vattivku lefanav lemor lamma ze yatzanu mimmitzrayim
Ad yerach yomin ad di tekotzun beh vihe lechon letakla chalaf dekatztun yat memra daAdonai dishchinteh sharyat benechon uvechetun kodamohi lememar lema denan nefakna mimmitzrayim:
Vayyomer moshe shesh-meot elef ragli haam asher anochi bekirbo veatta amarta basar etten lahem veochlu chodesh yamim
Vaamar mshe shit mea alfin gavra riglaa amma di ana venehon veat amart bisra etten lehon veyechlun yerach yomin:
Hatzon uvakar yishshachet lahem umatza lahem im et-kol-dege hayyam yeasef lahem umatza lahem
Haan vetorin yitnakkesun lehon hayesappekun lehon im yat kol nune yamma yitkanneshun lehon hayesappekun lehon:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe hayad Adonai tiktzar atta tire hayikrecha devari im-lo
Vaamar Adonai lemshe hamemra daAdonai yitakkav kean techeze hayearinnach pitgami im la:
Vayyetze moshe vaydabber el-haam et divre Adonai vayyeesof shivim ish mizzikne haam vayyaamed otam sevivot haohel
Unefak mshe umallil leamma yat pitgamayya daAdonai uchenesh shavin gavra missave amma vaakem yathon sechor sechor lemashkena:
Vayyered Adonai beanan vaydabber elav vayyatzel min-haruach asher alav vayyitten al-shivim ish hazzekenim vayhi kenoach alehem haruach vayyitnabbeu velo yasafu
Veitgeli Adonai baanana umallil immeh verabbi min rucha di alohi vihav al shavin gavra savayya vahava kad sherat alehon rucha dinvua umitnabbein vela faskin:
Vayyishshaaru shene-anashim bammachane shem haechad eldad veshem hashsheni medad vattanach alehem haruach vehemma bakketuvim velo yatzu haohela vayyitnabbeu bammachane
Veishtaaru teren guvrin bemashrita shum chad eldad veshum tinyana medad usherat alehon rucha dinvua veinnun bichtivayya vela nefaku lemashkena veitnabbiu bemashrita:
Vayyarotz hannaar vayyagged lemoshe vayyomar eldad umedad mitnabbeim bammachane
Urehat ulema vechavvi lemshe vaamar eldad umedad mitnabbein bemashrita:
Vayyaan yehoshua bin-nun mesharet moshe mibbechurav vayyomar adoni moshe kelaem
Vaatev yehoshua bar nun meshummeshaneh demshe meulemuteh vaamar ribboni mshe asarinnun:
Vayyomer lo moshe hamekanne atta li umi yitten kol-am Adonai neviim ki-yitten Adonai et-rucho alehem
Vaamar leh mshe hakinati at mekanne li reena fon dihon kol amma daAdonai neviayn are yitten Adonai yat ruach nevuateh alehon:
Vayyeasef moshe el-hammachane hu vezikne yisrael
Veitkenesh mshe lemashrita hu vesave yisrael:
Veruach nasa meet Adonai vayyagoz salvim min-hayyam vayyittosh al-hammachane kederech yom ko uchederech yom ko sevivot hammachane ucheammatayim al-pene haaretz
Verucha netal min kodam Adonai veafrach selav min yamma urema al mashrita kemahalach yoma lecha uchemahalach yoma lecha sechor sechor lemashrita ucherum tarten ammin al appe ara:
Vayyakom haam kol-hayyom hahu vechol-hallayla vechol yom hammochorat vayyaasfu et-hasselav hammamit asaf asara chomarim vayyishtechu lahem shatoach sevivot hammachane
Vekam amma kol yoma hahu vechol lelya vechol yoma devatrohi uchenashu yat selav deazar kenash asra degorin ushetachu lehon mashtichin sechor sechor lemashrita:
Habbasar odennu ben shinnehem terem yikkaret veaf Adonai chara vaam vayyach Adonai baam makka rabba meod
Bisra ad kean ben shinnehon ad la fesak verogza daAdonai tekef beamma uketal Adonai beamma ketol saggi lachada:
Vayyikra et-shem-hammakom hahu kivrot hattaava ki-sham kavru et-haam hammitavvim
Ukera yat shema deatra hahu kivre dimshaale are tamman kevaru yat amma deshailu:
Mikkivrot hattaava nasu haam chatzerot vayyihyu bachatzerot
Mikkivre dimshaale netalu amma lachatzerot vahavo bachatzerot:
Vattedabber miryam veaharon bemoshe al-odot haishsha hakkushit asher lakach ki-ishsha chushit lakach
Umallelat miryam veaharon bemshe al esak itteta shappirta di nesiv are itteta shappirta dinsiv rachik:
Vayyomru harak ach-bemoshe dibber Adonai halo gam-banu dibber vayyishma Adonai
Vaamaru halechod beram vemshe mallil Adonai hala af immana mallil ushemia kodam Adonai:
Vehaish moshe anav meod mikkol haadam asher al-pene haadama
Vegavra mshe invetan lachada mikkol enasha di al appe ara:
Vayyomer Adonai pitom el-moshe veel-aharon veel-miryam tzeu sheloshtechem el-ohel moed vayyetzu sheloshtam
Vaamar Adonai bitkef lemshe uleaharon ulemiryam puku telatechon lemashkan zimna unefaku telatehon:
Vayyered Adonai beammud anan vayyaamod petach haohel vayyikra aharon umiryam vayyetzu shenehem
Veitgeli Adonai beammuda daanana vekam bitra mashkena ukera aharon umiryam unefaku tarvehon:
Vayyomer shimu-na devaray im-yihye neviachem Adonai bammara elav etvadda bachalom adabber-bo
Vaamar shemau chean pitgamay im yehon lechon neviin ana Adonai bechezyan ana mitgeli lehon bechelmin ana memallel immehon:
Lo-chen avdi moshe bechol-beti neeman hu
La chen avdi mshe bechol beti meheman hu:
Pe el-pe adabber-bo umare velo vechidot utemunat Adonai yabbit umaddua lo yeretem ledabber beavdi vemoshe
Mamlal im mamlal mallelna immeh bechezu vela vechidvan udemut yekara daAdonai mistakkal uma den la decheltun lemallala beavdi vemshe:
Vayyichar-af Adonai bam vayyelach
Utekif rogza daAdonai behon veistallak:
Veheanan sar meal haohel vehinne miryam metzoraat kashshaleg vayyifen aharon el-miryam vehinne metzoraat
Vaanana istallak meillave mashkena veha miryam chavvera ketalga veitpeni aharon levat miryam veha segirat:
Vayyomer aharon el-moshe bi adoni al-na tashet alenu chattat asher noalnu vaasher chatanu
Vaamar aharon lemshe bevau ribboni la chean teshavvi alana chova deitpashna vedi serachna:
Al-na tehi kammet asher betzeto merechem immo vayyeachel chatzi vesaro
La chean titrachak da mibbenana are achatana hi tzalli chean al bisra mita haden di va veyittassi:
Vayyitzak moshe el-Adonai lemor el na refa na lah
Vetzalli mshe kodam Adonai lememar elaha bevau asse chean yatah:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe veaviha yarok yarak befaneha halo tikkalem shivat yamim tissager shivat yamim michutz lammachane veachar teasef
Vaamar Adonai lemshe veillu avuha minzaf nezif ba hala titkelem shava yomin tistegar shava yomin mibbara lemashrita uvatar ken titkenesh:
Vattissager miryam michutz lammachane shivat yamim vehaam lo nasa ad-heasef miryam
Veistegarat miryam mibbara lemashrita shava yomin veamma la netal ad deitkeneshat miryam:
Veachar nasu haam mechatzerot vayyachanu bemidbar paran
Uvatar ken netalu amma mechatzerot ushero bemadbera defaran:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Shelach-lecha anashim veyaturu et-eretz kenaan asher-ani noten livne yisrael ish echad ish echad lematte avotav tishlachu kol nasi vahem
Shelach lach guvrin viallelun yat ara dichnaan di ana yahev livne yisrael gavra chad gavra chad leshivta daavahatohi teshallechun kol rabba divhon:
Vayyishlach otam moshe mimmidbar paran al-pi Adonai kullam anashim rashe vene-yisrael hemma
Ushelach yathon mshe mimmadbera defaran al memra daAdonai kullehon guvrin reshe vene yisrael innun:
Veelle shemotam lematte reuven shammua ben-zakkur
Veillen shemahathon leshivta diruven shammua bar zakkur:
Lematte shimon shafat ben-chori
Leshivta deshimon shafat bar chori:
Lematte yehuda kalev ben-yefunne
Leshivta dihuda kalev bar yefunne:
Lematte yissashchar yigal ben-yosef
Leshivta deyissashchar yigal bar yosef:
Lematte efrayim hoshea bin-nun
Leshivta deefrayim hoshea bar nun:
Lematte vinyamin palti ben-rafu
Leshivta devinyamin palti bar rafu:
Lematte zevulun gaddiel ben-sodi
Leshivta dizvulun gaddiel bar sodi:
Lematte yosef lematte menashshe gaddi ben-susi
Leshivta deyosef leshivta dimnashshe gaddi bar susi:
Lematte dan ammiel ben-gemalli
Leshivta dedan ammiel bar gemalli:
Lematte asher setur ben-michael
Leshivta deasher setur bar michael:
Lematte naftali nachbi ben-vofsi
Leshivta denaftali nachbi bar vafsi:
Lematte gad geuel ben-machi
Leshivta degad geuel bar machi:
Elle shemot haanashim asher-shalach moshe latur et-haaretz vayyikra moshe lehoshea bin-nun yehoshua
Illen shemahat guvrayya di shelach mshe leallala yat ara ukera mshe lehoshea bar nun yehoshua:
Vayyishlach otam moshe latur et-eretz kenaan vayyomer alehem alu ze bannegev vaalitem et-hahar
Ushelach yathon mshe leallala yat ara dichnaan vaamar lehon saku da bidroma vetiskun letura:
Ureitem et-haaretz ma-hiv veet-haam hayyoshev aleha hechazak hu harafe hameat hu im-rav
Vetechezun yat ara ma hi veyat amma deyatev ala hatakkif hu im challash hazer hu im saggi:
Uma haaretz asher-hu yoshev bah hatova hiv im-raa uma hearim asher-hu yoshev bahenna habbemachanim im bemivtzarim
Uma ara di hu yatev ba hatava hi im bisha uma kirvayya di hu yatev behon habbefatzchin im bichrakkin:
Uma haaretz hashshemena hiv im-raza hayesh-bah etz im-ayin vehitchazzaktem ulekachtem mipperi haaretz vehayyamim yeme bikkure anavim
Uma ara haattira hi im miskena hait ba ilanin im la vetitkefun vetissevun meibba deara veyomayya yome bikkure innevin:
Vayyaalu vayyaturu et-haaretz mimmidbar-tzin ad-rechov levo chamat
Useliku veallilu yat ara mimmadbbra detzin ad rechov limte chamat:
Vayyaalu vannegev vayyavo ad-chevron vesham achiman sheshay vetalmay yelide haanak vechevron sheva shanim nivneta lifne tzoan mitzrayim
Useliku vidroma vaata ad chevron vetamman achiman sheshay vetalmay bene gibbarayya vechevron sheva shenin itbeniat kodam tanas demitzrayim:
Vayyavou ad-nachal eshkol vayyichretu mishsham zemora veeshkol anavim echad vayyissauhu vammot bishnayim umin-harimmonim umin-hatteenim
Vaato ad nachala deatkala uketzo mittamman ovarta veatkal innevin chad unetalohi vaaricha bitren umin rimmonayya umin teenayya:
Lammakom hahu kara nachal eshkol al odot haeshkol asher-kartu mishsham bene yisrael
Leatra hahu kera nachla deatkala al esak atkala diktzo mittamman bene yisrael:
Vayyashuvu mittur haaretz mikketz arbaim yom
Vetavu milleallala yat ara missof arbein yomin:
Vayyelchu vayyavou el-moshe veel-aharon veel-kol-adat bene-yisrael el-midbar paran kadesha vayyashivu otam davar veet-kol-haeda vayyarum et-peri haaretz
Vaazalu vaato levat mshe ulevat aharon ulevat kol kenishta divne yisrael lemadbera defaran lirkam vaativu yathon pitgama veyat kol kenishta veachaziunnun yat ibba deara:
Vaysapperu-lo vayyomru banu el-haaretz asher shelachtanu vegam zavat chalav udevash hiv veze-ppiryah
Veishtaiu leh vaamaru atena leara di shelachtana veaf avda chalav udevash hi veden ibba:
Efes ki-az haam hayyoshev baaretz vehearim betzurot gedolot meod vegam-yelide haanak rainu sham
Lechod are takkif amma deyatev beara vekirvayya kerichan ravrevan lachada veaf bene gibbarayya chazena tamman:
Amalek yoshev beeretz hannegev vehachitti vehayevusi vehaemori yoshev bahar vehakkenaani yoshev al-hayyam veal yad hayyarden
Amalkaa yatev baara daroma vechittaa vivusaa veemoraa yatev betura uchenaanaa yatev al yamma veal kef yardena:
Vayyahas kalev et-haam el-moshe vayyomer alo naale veyarashnu otah ki-yachol nuchal lah
Veatztzet kalev yat amma lemshe vaamar mesak nesak venirat yata are mechal nechul la:
Vehaanashim asher-alu immo amru lo nuchal laalot el-haam ki-chazak hu mimmennu
Veguvrayya di seliku immeh amaru la nechul lemesak levat amma are takkif hu minnana:
Vayyotziu dibbat haaretz asher taru otah el-bene yisrael lemor haaretz asher avarnu vah latur otah eretz ochelet yoshveha hiv vechol-haam asher-rainu vetochah anshe middot
Veappiku shum bish al ara di allilu yata levat bene yisrael lememar ara di avarna va leallala yata ara mekattelat yatvaha hi vechol amma di chazena vegavvah enashin demishchan:
Vesham rainu et-hannefilim bene anak min-hannefilim vannehi veenenu kachagavim vechen hayinu beenehem
Vetamman chazena yat gibbarayya bene anak min gibbarayya vahavena beene nafshana kekamtzin vechen havena beenehon:
Vattissa kol-haeda vayyittenu et-kolam vayyivku haam ballayla hahu
Vaarimat kol kenishta vihavu yat kalhon uvecho amma belelya hahu:
Vayyillonu al-moshe veal-aharon kol bene yisrael vayyomru alehem kol-haeda lu-matnu beeretz mitzrayim o bammidbar hazze lu-matnu
Veitraamu al mshe veal aharon kol bene yisrael vaamaru lehon kol kenishta levay demitna beara demitzrayim o bemadbera haden levay demitna:
Velama Adonai mevi otanu el-haaretz hazzot linpol bacherev nashenu vetappenu yihyu lavaz halo tov lanu shuv mitzrayma
Ulema Adonai mael yatana leara hada leminpal becharba neshana vetaflana yehon levizza hala tav lana di netuv lemitzrayim:
Vayyomru ish el-achiv nittena rosh venashuva mitzrayma
Vaamaru gevar leachohi nemanne resha unetuv lemitzrayim:
Vayyippol moshe veaharon al-penehem lifne kol-kehal adat bene yisrael
Unefal mshe veaharon al appehon kodam kol kehal kenishta divne yisrael:
Vihoshua bin-nun vechalev ben-yefunne min-hattarim et-haaretz karu bigdehem
Vihoshua bar nun vechalev bar yefunne min meallale yat ara bezau levushehon:
Vayyomru el-kol-adat bene-yisrael lemor haaretz asher avarnu vah latur otah tova haaretz meod meod
Vaamaru lechol kenishta divne yisrael lememar ara di avarna va leallala yata tava ara lachada lachada:
Im-chafetz banu Adonai vehevi otanu el-haaretz hazzot unetanah lanu eretz asher-hiv zavat chalav udevash
Im raava vana kodam Adonai veyael yatana leara hada veyittenina lana ara di hi avda chalav udevash:
Ach ba-Adonai al-timrodu veattem al-tiru et-am haaretz ki lachmenu hem sar tzillam mealehem va-Adonai ittanu al-tiraum
Beram bememra daAdonai la timredun veattun la tidchalun min amma deara are vidana mesirin innun ada takpehon minnehon umemra daAdonai besadana la tidchalun minnehon:
Vayyomru kol-haeda lirgom otam baavanim uchevod Adonai nira beohel moed el-kol-bene yisrael
Vaamaru kol kenishta lemirgam yathon beavnayya vikara daAdonai itgeli bemashkan zimna lechol bene yisrael:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe ad-ana yenaatzuni haam hazze vead-ana lo-yaaminu vi bechol haotot asher asiti bekirbo
Vaamar Adonai lemshe ad ematay yehon meraggezin kodamay amma haden vead ematay la yehemnun bememri bechol atayya di avadit benehon:
Akkennu vaddever veorishennu veeese otcha legoy-gadol veatzum mimmennu
Emchinnun bemota vaashetzinnun veebed yatach leam rav vetakkif minnehon:
Vayyomer moshe el-Adonai veshamu mitzrayim ki-heelita vechochacha et-haam hazze mikkirbo
Vaamar mshe kodam Adonai veyishmeun mitzrae are assekta vechelach yat amma haden mibbenehon:
Veamru el-yoshev haaretz hazzot shamu ki-atta Adonai bekerev haam hazze asher-ayin beayin nira atta Adonai vaanancha omed alehem uveammud anan atta holech lifnehem yomam uveammud esh layla

Veyemrun leyatev ara hada dishmau are at Adonai dishchintach sharyat bego amma haden di veenehon chazan shechinat yekara daAdonai vaananach mattel illavhon uveammuda daanana at medabbar kodamehon bimama uveammuda deeshshata belelya:
Vehematta et-haam hazze keish echad veamru haggoyim asher-shamu et-shimacha lemor
Utekattal yat amma haden kegavra chad veyemrun ammayya di shemau yat shema gevurtach lememar:
Mibbilti yecholet Adonai lehavi et-haam hazze el-haaretz asher-nishba lahem vayyishchatem bammidbar
Middelet yuchela kodam Adonai leaala yat amma haden leara di kayyem lehon vekattelinun bemadbera:
Veatta yigdal-na koach adonay kaasher dibbarta lemor
Uchean saggi chean chela min kodam Adonai kema demallelta lememar:
Adonai erech appayim verav-chesed nose avon vafasha venakke lo yenakke poked avon avot al-banim al-shilleshim veal-ribbeim

Adonai marchek regaz umasge lemebad tavvan ukeshot shavek laavayan velimrod ulechovin sallach lidtayvin leorayteh udela tayvin la mezakke masar chove avahan al benin meradin al dar telitae veal dar reviae:
Selach-na laavon haam hazze kegodel chasdecha vechaasher nasata laam hazze mimmitzrayim vead-henna
Shevok kean lechove amma haden kisgiut tavvatach uchema di shevakta leamma haden mimmitzrayim vead kean:
Vayyomer Adonai salachti kidvarecha
Vaamar Adonai shevakit kefitgamach:
Veulam chay-ani veyimmale chevod-Adonai et-kol-haaretz
Uveram kayyam ana umalya yekara daAdonai yat kol ara:
Ki chol-haanashim haroim et-kevodi veet-ototay asher-asiti vemitzrayim uvammidbar vaynassu oti ze eser peamim velo shamu bekoli
Are chol guvrayya dachazo yat yekari veyat atvatay di avadit bemitzrayim uvemadbera venassiu kodamay denan asar zimnin vela kabbilu bememri:
Im-yiru et-haaretz asher nishbati laavotam vechol-menaatzay lo yiruha
Im yechezun yat ara di kayyemit laavahathon vechol deargizu kodamay la yechezunna:
Veavdi chalev ekev hayta ruach acheret immo vaymalle acharay vahaviotiv el-haaretz asher-ba shamma vezaro yorishenna
Veavdi chalev chalaf dahava ruach ochari immeh veashlem batar dachalti vealinneh leara di al letamman uvenohi yetarchinna:
Vehaamaleki vehakkenaani yoshev baemek machar penu useu lachem hammidbar derech yam-suf
