Vaamalkaa uchenaanaa yatev bemeshra mechar itpenu vetulu lechon lemadbera orach yamma desuf:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe veel-aharon lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe veim aharon lememar:
Ad-matay laeda haraa hazzot asher hemma mallinim alay et-telunnot bene yisrael asher hemma mallinim alay shamati
Ad ematay lichnishta vishta hada di innun mitraamin alay yat turamat bene yisrael di innun mitraamin alay shemia kodamay:
Emor alehem chay-ani neum-Adonai im-lo kaasher dibbartem beoznay ken eese lachem
Emar lehon kayyam ana amar Adonai im la kema di malleltun kodamay ken ebed lechon:
Bammidbar hazze yippelu figrechem vechol-pekudechem lechol-misparchem mibben esrim shana vamala asher halinotem alay
Bemadbera haden yippelun pigrechon vechol minyanechon lechol chushbanchon mibbar asrin shenin uleella di itraamtun alay:
Im-attem tavou el-haaretz asher nasati et-yadi leshakken etchem bah ki im-kalev ben-yefunne vihoshua bin-nun
Im attun tealun leara di kayyemit bememri leashraa yatchon ba ellahen kalev bar yefunne vihoshua bar nun:
Vetappechem asher amartem lavaz yihye veheveti otam veyadu et-haaretz asher meastem bah
Vetaflechon di amartun levizza yehe veael yathon veyiddeun yat ara di katztun ba:
Ufigrechem attem yippelu bammidbar hazze
Ufigrechon di lechon yippelun bemadbera haden:
Uvenechem yihyu roim bammidbar arbaim shana venasu et-zenutechem ad-tom pigrechem bammidbar
Uvenechon yehon meacharin bemadbera arbein shenin vikabbelun yat chovechon ad disufun pigrechon bemadbera:
Bemispar hayyamim asher-tartem et-haaretz arbaim yom yom lashshana yom lashshana tisu et-avonotechem arbaim shana vidatem et-tenuati
Beminyan yomayya di alleltun yat ara arbein yomin yoma leshatta yoma leshatta tekabbelun yat chovechon arbein shenin vetiddeun yat deitraamtun alay:
Ani Adonai dibbarti im-lo zot eese lechol-haeda haraa hazzot hannoadim alay bammidbar hazze yittammu vesham yamutu
Ana Adonai gezarit bememri im la da ebed lechol kenishta vishta hada deizdammenun alay bemadbera haden yesufun vetamman yemutun:
Vehaanashim asher-shalach moshe latur et-haaretz vayyashuvu vayyallinu alav et-kol-haeda lehotzi dibba al-haaretz
Veguvrayya di shelach mshe leallala yat ara vetavu vearimu alohi yat kol kenishta leappaka shum bish al ara:
Vayyamutu haanashim motzie dibbat-haaretz raa bammaggefa lifne Adonai
Umitu guvrayya deappiku shum bish al ara bemotana kodam Adonai:
Vihoshua bin-nun vechalev ben-yefunne chayu min-haanashim hahem haholchim latur et-haaretz
Vihoshua bar nun vechalev bar yefunne itkayyemu min guvrayya hainnun daazalu leallala yat ara:
Vaydabber moshe et-haddevarim haelle el-kol-bene yisrael vayyitabbelu haam meod
Umallil mshe yat pitgamayya haillen lechol bene yisrael veitabbalu amma lachada:
Vayyashkimu vabboker vayyaalu el-rosh-hahar lemor hinnennu vealinu el-hammakom asher-amar Adonai ki chatanu
Veakdimu vetzafra useliku leresh tura lememar ha anachna salkin leatra di amar Adonai are chavna:
Vayyomer moshe lamma ze attem ovrim et-pi Adonai vehiv lo titzlach
Vaamar mshe lema denan attun avrin al gezerat memra daAdonai vehi la tatzlach:
Al-taalu ki en Adonai bekirbechem velo tinnagfu lifne oyvechem
La tissekun are let shechinta daAdonai benechon vela tittabberun kodam baale devavechon:
Ki haamaleki vehakkenaani sham lifnechem unefaltem becharev ki-al-ken shavtem meachare Adonai velo-yihye Adonai immachem
Are amalkaa uchenaanaa tamman kodamechon vetippelun becharba are al ken tavtun mibbatar palchana daAdonai vela yehe memra daAdonai besadechon:
Vayyapilu laalot el-rosh hahar vaaron berit-Adonai umoshe lo-mashu mikkerev hammachane
Vearshau lemissak leresh tura vaaron keyama daAdonai umshe la ado miggo mashrita:
Vayyered haamaleki vehakkenaani hayyoshev bahar hahu vayyakkum vayyakketum ad-hachorma
Unechat amalkaa uchenaanaa deyatev betura hahu umechunnun uteradunnun ad charma:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael veamarta alehem ki tavou el-eretz moshvotechem asher ani noten lachem
Mallel im bene yisrael vetemar lehon are tealun laara motvanechon di ana yahev lechon:
Vaasitem ishshe la-Adonai ola o-zevach lefalle-neder o vindava o bemoadechem laasot reach nichoach la-Adonai min-habbakar o min-hatztzon
Vetabedun kurbana kodam Adonai alata o nichsat kudeshayya leafrasha nidra o vindavta o bemoadechon lemebad leitkabbala veraava kodam Adonai min tore o min ana:
Vehikriv hammakriv korbano la-Adonai mincha solet issaron balul birviit hahin shamen
Vikarev dimkarev kurbaneh kodam Adonai minchata sulta asrona defila beravut hina mishcha:
Veyayin lannesech reviit hahin taase al-haola o lazzavach lakkeves haechad
Vechamra leniska ravut hina tabed al alata o lenichsat kudeshayya leimmera chad:
O laayil taase mincha solet shene esronim belula vashshemen shelishit hahin
O ledichra tabed minchata sulta teren asronin defila vimshach taltut hina:
Veyayin lannesech shelishit hahin takriv reach-nichoach la-Adonai
Vechamra leniska taltut hina tekarev leitkabbala veraava kodam Adonai:
Vechi-taase ven-bakar ola o-zavach lefalle-neder o-shelamim la-Adonai
Vaare tabed bar tore alata o nichsat kudeshayya lefarasha nidra o nichsat kudeshayya kodam Adonai:
Vehikriv al-ben-habbakar mincha solet shelosha esronim balul bashshemen chatzi hahin
Vikarev al bar tore minchata sulta telata asronin defila vimshach palgut hina:
Veyayin takriv lannesech chatzi hahin ishshe reach-nichoach la-Adonai
Vechamra tekarev leniska palgut hina kurban demitkabbel beraava kodam Adonai:
Kacha yease lashshor haechad o laayil haechad o-lasse vakkevasim o vaizzim
Keden yitaved letora chad o ledichra chad o leimmar beimmerayya o veizzayya:
Kammispar asher taasu kacha taasu laechad kemisparam
Keminyan di tabedun keden tabedun lechad keminyanhon:
Kol-haezrach yaase-kkacha et-elle lehakriv ishshe reach-nichoach la-Adonai
Kol yatztziva yabed keden yat illen lekarava kurban demitkabbel beraava kodam Adonai:
Vechi-yagur ittechem ger o asher-betochechem ledorotechem veasa ishshe reach-nichoach la-Adonai kaasher taasu ken yaase
Vaare yitgayyar immechon giyyora o di venechon ledarechon veyabed kurban demitkabbel baraava kodam Adonai kema di tabedun ken yabed:
Hakkahal chukka achat lachem velagger haggar chukkat olam ledorotechem kachem kagger yihye lifne Adonai
Kehala keyama chad lechon ulegiyyora deyitgayyar keyam alam ledarechon kevatchon kegiyyora yehe kodam Adonai:
Tora achat umishpat echad yihye lachem velagger haggar ittechem
Orayta chada vedina chad yehe lechon ulegiyyora deyitgayyar immechon:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael veamarta alehem bevoachem el-haaretz asher ani mevi etchem shamma
Mallel im bene yisrael vetemar lehon bemealchon leara di ana mael yatchon letamman:
Vehaya baacholchem millechem haaretz tarimu teruma la-Adonai
Vihe bemechalchon millachma deara tafreshun afrashuta kodam Adonai:
Reshit arisotechem challa tarimu teruma kitrumat goren ken tarimu otah
Resh atzvatchon challeta tafreshun afrashuta kema di mafreshin min idra ken tafreshun yata:
Mereshit arisotechem tittenu la-Adonai teruma ledorotechem
Meresh atzvatchon tittenun kodam Adonai afrashuta ledarechon:
Vechi tishgu velo taasu et kol-hammitzvot haelle asher-dibber Adonai el-moshe
Vaare tishtelun vela tabedun yat kol pikkodayya haillen di mallil Adonai im mshe:
Et kol-asher tzivva Adonai alechem beyad-moshe min-hayyom asher tzivva Adonai vahala ledorotechem
Yat kol di fakkid Adonai yatchon bida demshe min yoma di fakkid Adonai ulehalla ledarechon:
Vehaya im meene haeda neesta lishgaga veasu chol-haeda par ben-bakar echad leola lereach nichoach la-Adonai uminchato venisko kammishpat useir-izzim echad lechattat
Vihe im meene chenishta itavedat leshalu veyabedun kol kenishta tor bar tore chad laalata leitkabbala veraava kodam Adonai uminchateh veniskeh kidchaze utzefir bar izze chad lechattata:
Vechipper hakkohen al-kol-adat bene yisrael venislach lahem ki-shegaga hiv vehem heviu et-korbanam ishshe la-Adonai vechattatam lifne Adonai al-shiggatam
Vichappar kahana al kol kenishta divne yisrael veyishtevek lehon are shaluta hi veinnun aytiu yat kurbanhon kurbana kodam Adonai vechovathon kodam Adonai al shalutehon:
Venislach lechol-adat bene yisrael velagger haggar betocham ki lechol-haam bishgaga
Veyishtevek lechol kenishta divne yisrael ulegiyyora deyitgayyar benehon are lechol amma beshaluta:
Veim-nefesh achat techeta vishgaga vehikriva ez bat-shenatah lechattat
Veim enash chad yechov beshalu vikarev izza bat shatta lechattata:
Vechipper hakkohen al-hannefesh hashshogeget becheta vishgaga lifne Adonai lechapper alav venislach lo
Vichappar kahana al enash deishteli bemechaveh beshalu kodam Adonai lechappara alohi veyishtevek leh:
Haezrach bivne yisrael velagger haggar betocham tora achat yihye lachem laose bishgaga
Yatztziva bivne yisrael ulegiyyora deyitgayyar benehon orayta chada yehe lechon lidyabed beshalu
Vehannefesh asher-taase beyad rama min-haezrach umin-hagger et-Adonai hu megaddef venichreta hannefesh hahiv mikkerev ammah
Veenash deyabed beresh geli min yatztzivayya umin giyyorayya kodam Adonai hu margez veyishtetze anasha hahi miggo ammeh:
Ki devar-Adonai baza veet-mitzvato hefar hikkaret tikkaret hannefesh hahiv avona vah
Are al memra daAdonai besar veyat pikkodohi ashne ishtetzaa tishtetze anasha hahi chova ba:
Vayyihyu vene-yisrael bammidbar vayyimtzeu ish mekoshesh etzim beyom hashshabbat
Vahavo vene yisrael bemadbera veashkachu gavra kad megabbav ain beyoma deshabbeta:
Vayyakrivu oto hammotzim oto mekoshesh etzim el-moshe veel-aharon veel kol-haeda
Vekarivu yateh deashkachu yateh kad megabbav ain levat mshe ulevat aharon ulevat kol kenishta:
Vayyannichu oto bammishmar ki lo forash ma-yyease lo
Veasseru yateh bevet mattera are la itperash lehon ma deyabedun leh:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe mot yumat haish ragom oto vaavanim kol-haeda michutz lammachane
Vaamar Adonai lemshe itketala yitketel gavra mirgam yateh beavnayya kol kenishta mibbara lemashrita:
Vayyotziu oto kol-haeda el-michutz lammachane vayyirgemu oto baavanim vayyamot kaasher tzivva Adonai et-moshe
Veappiku yateh kol kenishta lemibbara lemashrita uregamu yateh beavnayya umit kema di fakid Adonai yat mshe:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe lemor
Vaamar Adonai lemshe lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael veamarta alehem veasu lahem tzitzit al-kanfe vigdehem ledorotam venatnu al-tzitzit hakkanaf petil techelet
Mallel im bene yisrael vetemar lehon veyabedun lehon kerusepedin al kanfe chesutehon ledarehon veyittenun al kerusepeda dechanfa chuta ditchelta:
Vehaya lachem letzitzit ureitem oto uzechartem et-kol-mitzvot Adonai vaasitem otam velo-taturu achare levavchem veachare enechem asher-attem zonim acharehem
Vihon lechon lichrusepedin vetechezun yateh vetidkerun yat kol pikkudayya daAdonai vetabedun yathon vela titteun batar hirhur libbechon uvatar chezu enechon di attun taan batrehon:
Lemaan tizkeru vaasitem et-kol-mitzvotay vihyitem kedoshim lelohechem
Bedil detidkerun vetabedun yat kol pikkoday utehon kaddishin kodam elahachon:
Ani Adonai elohechem asher hotzeti etchem meeretz mitzrayim lihyot lachem lelohim ani Adonai elohechem
Ana Adonai elahachon di appekit yatchon meara demitzrayim lemehave lechon leelaha ana Adonai elahachon:
Vayyikkach korach ben-yitzhar ben-kehat ben-levi vedatan vaaviram bene eliav veon ben-pelet bene reuven
Veitpeleg korach bar yitzhar bar kehat bar levi vedatan vaaviram bene eliav veon bar pelet bene reuven:
Vayyakumu lifne moshe vaanashim mibbene-yisrael chamishshim umatayim nesie eda kerie moed anshe-shem
Vekamu leappe mshe veguvrayya mibbene yisrael matan vechamshin ravreve chenishta meare zeman enashin dishma:
Vayyikkahalu al-moshe veal-aharon vayyomru alehem rav-lachem ki chol-haeda kullam kedoshim uvetocham Adonai umaddua titnasseu al-kehal Adonai
Veitkenashu al mshe veal aharon vaamaru lehon saggi lechon are chol kenishta kullehon kaddishin uvenehon sharya shechinta daAdonai uma den attun mitravrevin al kehala daAdonai:
Vayyishma moshe vayyippol al-panav
Ushema mshe unefal al appohi:
Vaydabber el-korach veel-kol-adato lemor boker veyoda Adonai et-asher-lo veet-hakkadosh vehikriv elav veet asher yivchar-bo yakriv elav
Umallil im korach veim kol kenishteh lememar betzafra vihoda Adonai yat dechashar leh veyat dekaddish vikarev lokodamohi veyat di yitree veh yekarev leshimmusheh:
Zot asu kechu-lachem machtot korach vechol-adato
Da ividu savu lechon machteyan korach vechol kenishteh:
Utenu vahen esh vesimu alehen ketoret lifne Adonai machar vehaya haish asher-yivchar Adonai hu hakkadosh rav-lachem bene levi
Vehavu vehon eshshata veshavviyu alehon ketoret busemin kodam Adonai mechar vihe gavra deyitree Adonai hu kaddish saggi lechon bene levi:
Vayyomer moshe el-korach shimu-na bene levi
Vaamar mshe lekorach shemau chean bene levi:
Hameat mikkem ki-hivdil elohe yisrael etchem meadat yisrael lehakriv etchem elav laavod et-avodat mishkan Adonai velaamod lifne haeda leshartam
Hazzeer lechon are afresh elaha deyisrael yatchon mikkenishta deyisrael lekarava yatchon kodamohi lemiflach yat palchan mashkena daAdonai ulemekam kodam kenishta leshammashutehon:
Vayyakrev otcha veet-kol-achecha vene-levi ittach uvikkashtem gam-kehunna
Vekarev yatach veyat kol achaych bene levi immach uchean attun baan af kehunnata rabbeta:
Lachen atta vechol-adatcha hannoadim al-Adonai veaharon ma-hu ki tallinu alav
Bechen at vechol kenishtach deizdammintun al Adonai veaharon ma hu are itraamtun alohi:
Vayyishlach moshe likro ledatan velaaviram bene eliav vayyomru lo naale
Ushelach mshe lemikre ledatan velaaviram bene eliav vaamaru la nissak:
Hameat ki heelitanu meeretz zavat chalav udevash lahamitenu bammidbar ki-tistarer alenu gam-histarer
Hazzeer are assektana meara avda chalav udevash lekattalutana bemadbera are itravravt alana af itravrava:
Af lo el-eretz zavat chalav udevash haviotanu vattitten-lanu nachalat sade vacharem haene haanashim hahem tenakker lo naale
Beram la leara avda chalav udevash aaltana vihavta lana achasanat chaklin vecharmin haene guvrayya hainnun teshallach leavvara la nissak:
Vayyichar lemoshe meod vayyomer el-Adonai al-tefen el-minchatam lo chamor echad mehem nasati velo hareoti et-achad mehem
Utekef lemshe lachada vaamar kodam Adonai la tekabbel beraava kurbanhon la chamara dechad minnehon shecharit vela aveshit yat chad minnehon:
Vayyomer moshe el-korach atta vechol-adatcha heyu lifne Adonai atta vahem veaharon machar
Vaamar mshe lekorach at vechol kenishtach hevo zeminin lokodam Adonai at veinnun veaharon mechar:
Ukechu ish machtato unetattem alehem ketoret vehikravtem lifne Adonai ish machtato chamishshim umatayim machtot veatta veaharon ish machtato
Usevu gevar machtiteh uteshavvun alehon ketoret busemin utekarvun kodam Adonai gevar machtiteh matan vechamshin machteyan veat veaharon gevar machtiteh:
Vayyikchu ish machtato vayyittenu alehem esh vayyasimu alehem ketoret vayyaamdu petach ohel moed umoshe veaharon
Unesivu gevar machtiteh vihavu alehon eshshata veshavviu alehon ketoret busemin vekamu bitra mashkan zimna umshe veaharon:
Vayyakhel alehem korach et-kol-haeda el-petach ohel moed vayyera chevod-Adonai el-kol-haeda
Veachnash alehon korach yat kol kenishta litra mashkan zimna veitgele yekara daAdonai lechol kenishta:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe veel-aharon lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe veim aharon lememar:
Hibbadlu mittoch haeda hazzot vaachalle otam keraga
Itteperashu miggo kenishta hada veeshetze yathon keshaa:
Vayyippelu al-penehem vayyomru el elohe haruchot lechol-basar haish echad yecheta veal kol-haeda tiktzof
Unefalu al appehon vaamaru el elaha ruchayya lechol bisra gavra chad yechov veal kol kenishta yehe rugeza:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallel Adonai im mshe lememar:
Dabber el-haeda lemor healu missaviv lemishkan-korach datan vaaviram
Mallel im kenishta lememar istallaku missechor sechor lemashkena dekorach datan vaaviram:
Vayyakom moshe vayyelech el-datan vaaviram vayyelchu acharav zikne yisrael
Vekam mshe vaazal levat datan vaaviram vaazalu vatrohi save yisrael:
Vaydabber el-haeda lemor suru na meal ohole haanashim harshaim haelle veal-tiggeu bechol-asher lahem pen-tissafu bechol-chattotam
Umallil im kenishta lememar zuru chean meillave mashkene guvrayya chayyavayya haillen vela tikrevun bechol di lehon dilma tilkun bechol chovehon:
Vayyealu meal mishkan-korach datan vaaviram missaviv vedatan vaaviram yatzu nitztzavim petach oholehem uneshehem uvenehem vetappam
Veistallaku meillave mashkena dekorach datan vaaviram missechor sechor vedatan vaaviram nefaku kayyemin bitra mashkenehon uneshehon uvenehon vetaflehon:
Vayyomer moshe bezot tedun ki-Adonai shelachani laasot et kol-hammaasim haelle ki-lo millibbi
Vaamar mshe beda tiddeun are Adonai shallechanni lemebad yat kol ovadayya haillen are la meruti:
Im-kemot kol-haadam yemutun elle ufekuddat kol-haadam yippaked alehem lo Adonai shelachani
Im kemota dechal enasha yemutun illen useara dechal enasha yistear alehon la Adonai shallechanni:
Veim-beria yivra Adonai ufatzta haadama et-piha uvala otam veet-kol-asher lahem veyardu chayyim sheola vidatem ki niatzu haanashim haelle et-Adonai
Veim beria yivre Adonai ufetachat ara yat puma uvelaat yathon veyat kol di lehon veyechetun kad chayyin lishol vetiddeun are argizu guvrayya haillen kodam Adonai:
Vayhi kechalloto ledabber et kol-haddevarim haelle vattibbaka haadama asher tachtehem
Vahava kad shetze lemallala yat kol pitgamayya haillen veitbezaat ara di techotehon:
Vattiftach haaretz et-piha vattivla otam veet-battehem veet kol-haadam asher lekorach veet kol-harchush
Ufetachat ara yat puma uvelaat yathon veyat enash battehon veyat kol enasha di lekorach veyat kol kinyana:
Vayyerdu hem vechol-asher lahem chayyim sheola vattechas alehem haaretz vayyovdu mittoch hakkahal
Unechatu innun vechol di lehon kad chayyin lishol vachafat alehon ara vaavadu miggo kehala:
Vechol-yisrael asher sevivotehem nasu lekolam ki amru pen-tivlaenu haaretz
Vechol yisrael di besacharanehon araku lekalhon are amaru dilma tivleinnana ara:
Veesh yatza meet Adonai vattochal et hachamishshim umatayim ish makrive hakketoret
Veeshshata nefakat min kodam Adonai vaachalat yat matan vechamshin gavra mekarve ketoret busemayya:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Emor el-elazar ben-aharon hakkohen veyarem et-hammachtot mibben hasserefa veet-haesh zere-hala ki kadeshu
Amar leelazar bar aharon kahana veyafresh yat machteyata mibben yekidayya veyat eshshata yarchek lehala are itkaddashu:
Et machtot hachattaim haelle benafshotam veasu otam rikkue fachim tzippuy lammizbeach ki-hikrivum lifne-Adonai vayyikdashu veyihyu leot livne yisrael
Yat machteyat chayyavayya haillen deitchayyavu benafshatehon veyabedun yathen tassin raddidin chofaa lemadbecha are karevunnun kodam Adonai veitkaddashu vihevyan leat livne yisrael:
Vayyikkach elazar hakkohen et machtot hannechoshet asher hikrivu hasserufim vayrakkeum tzippuy lammizbeach
Unesiv elazar kahana yat machteyata dinchasha dekarivu yokidayya veraddidunnun chofaa lemadbecha:
Zikkaron livne yisrael lemaan asher lo-yikrav ish zar asher lo mizzera aharon hu lehaktir ketoret lifne Adonai velo-yihye chekorach vechaadato kaasher dibber Adonai beyad-moshe lo
Dachrana livne yisrael bedil di la yikrav gevar chillonay di la mizzara deaharon hu leassaka ketoret busemin kodam Adonai vela yehe chekorach vechichnishteh kema di mallil Adonai bida demshe leh:
Vayyillonu kol-adat bene-yisrael mimmochorat al-moshe veal-aharon lemor attem hamittem et-am Adonai
Veitraamu kol kenishta divne yisrael miyyoma devatrohi al mshe veal aharon lememar attun geramtun demit amma daAdonai:
Vayhi behikkahel haeda al-moshe veal-aharon vayyifnu el-ohel moed vehinne chissahu heanan vayyera kevod Adonai
Vahava beitkannashut kenishta al mshe veal aharon veitpeniu lemashkan zimna veha chafahi anana veitgeli yekara daAdonai:
Vayyavo moshe veaharon el-pene ohel moed
Veal mshe veaharon lokodam mashkan zimna:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Herommu mittoch haeda hazzot vaachalle otam keraga vayyippelu al-penehem
Itperashu miggo kenishta hada veeshetze yathon keshaa unefalu al appehon:
Vayyomer moshe el-aharon kach et-hammachta veten-aleha esh meal hammizbeach vesim ketoret veholech mehera el-haeda vechapper alehem ki-yatza hakketzef millifne Adonai hechel hannagef
Vaamar mshe leaharon sav yat machtita vehav ala eshshata meillave madbecha veshav ketoret busemayya veovil bifria lichnishta vechapper alehon are nefak rogza min kodam Adonai share motana:
Vayyikkach aharon kaasher dibber moshe vayyarotz el-toch hakkahal vehinne hechel hannegef baam vayyitten et-hakketoret vaychapper al-haam
Unesiv aharon kema di mallil mshe urehat lego kehala veha share motana beamma vihav yat ketoret busemayya vechappar al amma:
Vayyaamod ben-hammetim uven hachayyim vatteatzar hammaggefa
Vekam ben metayya uven chayyayya veitkeli motana:
Vayyihyu hammetim bammaggefa arbaa asar elef usheva meot millevad hammetim al-devar-korach
Vahavo demitu bemotana arbeat ashar alfin usheva mea bar middemitu al pelugta dekorach:
Vayyashov aharon el-moshe el-petach ohel moed vehammaggefa neetzara
Vetav aharon lemshe litra mashkan zimna umotana itkeli:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael vekach meittam matte matte levet av meet kol-nesiehem levet avotam shenem asar mattot ish et-shemo tichtov al-mattehu
Mallel im bene yisrael vesav minnehon chutra chutra levet abba min kol ravrevanehon levet avahathon tere asar chutrin gevar yat shemeh tichtov al chutreh:
Veet shem aharon tichtov al-matte levi ki matte echad lerosh bet avotam
Veyat shema deaharon tichtov al chutra delevi are chutra chad leresh bet avahathon:
Vehinnachtam beohel moed lifne haedut asher ivvaed lachem shamma
Vetatzneinnun bemashkan zimna kodam sahaduta di azammen memri lechon tamman:
Vehaya haish asher evchar-bo mattehu yifrach vahashikkoti mealay et-telunnot bene yisrael asher hem mallinim alechem
Vihe gavra deitree veh chutreh yine vaaniach min kodamay yat tureamat bene yisrael di innun mitraamin alechon:
Vaydabber moshe el-bene yisrael vayyittenu elav kol-nesiehem matte lenasi echad matte lenasi echad levet avotam shenem asar mattot umatte aharon betoch mattotam
Umallil mshe im bene yisrael vihavu leh kol ravrevanehon chutra lerabba chad chutra lerabba chad levet avahathon tere asar chutrin vechutra deaharon bego chutrehon:
Vayyannach moshe et-hammattot lifne Adonai beohel haedut
Veatzna mshe yat chutrayya kodam Adonai bemashkena desahaduta:
Vayhi mimmochorat vayyavo moshe el-ohel haedut vehinne parach matte-aharon levet levi vayyotze ferach vayyatzetz tzitz vayyigmol shekedim
Vahava veyoma devatrohi veal mshe lemashkena desahaduta veha nea chutra deaharon levet levi veappek lavlevin veanetz netz vechafet shigdin
Vayyotze moshe et-kol-hammattot millifne Adonai el-kol-bene yisrael vayyiru vayyikchu ish mattehu
Veappek mshe yat kol chutrayya min kodam Adonai levat kol bene yisrael veishtemodau unesivu gevar chutreh:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe hashev et-matte aharon lifne haedut lemishmeret leot livne-meri utechal telunnotam mealay velo yamutu
Vaamar Adonai lemshe atev yat chutra deaharon lokodam sahaduta lemattera leat leamma sarbana visufan tureamathon min kodamay vela yemutun:
Vayyaas moshe kaasher tzivva Adonai oto ken asa
Vaavad mshe kema di fakkid Adonai yateh ken avad:
Vayyomru bene yisrael el-moshe lemor hen gavanu avadnu kullanu avadnu
Vaamaru bene yisrael lemshe lememar ha minnana ketalat charba ha minnana belaat ara veha minnana demitu vemotana:
Kol hakkarev hakkarev el-mishkan Adonai yamut haim tamnu ligvoa
Kol dekarev mikrav lemashkena daAdonai mait ha anachna sayfin limmat:
Vayyomer Adonai el-aharon atta uvanecha uvet-avicha ittach tisu et-avon hammikdash veatta uvanecha ittach tisu et-avon kehunnatchem
Vaamar Adonai leaharon at uvenaych uvet avuch immach tesallechun al chove makdesha veat uvenaych immach tesallechun al chove chehunnatchon:
Vegam et-achecha matte levi shevet avicha hakrev ittach veyillavu alecha vishartucha veatta uvanecha ittach lifne ohel haedut
Veaf yat achaych shivta delevi shivta deavuch karev levatach veyittosfun alach vishammeshunnach veat uvenaych immach kodam mashkena desahaduta:
Veshamru mishmartecha umishmeret kol-haohel ach el-kele hakkodesh veel-hammizbeach lo yikravu velo-yamutu gam-hem gam-attem
Veyitterun mattartach umatterat kol mashkena beram lemane kudesha ulemadbecha la yikrevun vela yemutun af innun af attun:
Venilvu alecha veshamru et-mishmeret ohel moed lechol avodat haohel vezar lo-yikrav alechem
Veyittosfun alach veyitterun yat matterat mashkan zimna lechol palchan mashkena vechillonay la yikrav levatchon:
Ushemartem et mishmeret hakkodesh veet mishmeret hammizbeach velo-yihye od ketzef al-bene yisrael
Vetitterun yat matterat kudesha veyat matterat madbecha vela yehe od rogza al bene yisrael:
Vaani hinne lakachti et-achechem haleviyyim mittoch bene yisrael lachem mattana netunim la-Adonai laavod et-avodat ohel moed
Vaana ha karevit yat achechon levae miggo bene yisrael lechon mattena yehivin kodam Adonai lemiflach yat palchan mashkan zimna:
Veatta uvanecha ittecha tishmeru et-kehunnatchem lechol-devar hammizbeach ulemibbet lapparochet vaavadtem avodat mattana etten et-kehunnatchem vehazzar hakkarev yumat
Veat uvenaych immach titterun yat kehunnatchon lechol pitgam madbecha ulemiggav lefarucheta vetiflechun palchan mattena ehav yat kehunnatchon vechillonay deyikrav yitketal:
Vaydabber Adonai el-aharon vaani hinne natatti lecha et-mishmeret terumotay lechol-kodshe vene-yisrael lecha netattim lemoshcha ulevanecha lechok-olam
Umallil Adonai im aharon vaana ha yehavit lach yat matterat afrashutay lechol kudeshayya divne yisrael lach yehavtinnun lirvu velivnaych likyam olam:
Ze-yihye lecha mikkodesh hakkodashim min-haesh kol-korbanam lechol-minchatam ulechol-chattatam ulechol-ashamam asher yashivu li kodesh kodashim lecha hu ulevanecha
Den yehe lach mikkodesh kudeshayya motar min eshshata kol kurebanehon lechol minchathon ulechal chatvathon ulechal ashamhon di yetivun kodamay kodesh kudeshin di lach hu velivnaych:
Bekodesh hakkodashim tochlennu kol-zachar yochal oto kodesh yihye-llach
Bekodesh kudeshin techlunneh kol dechura yechul yateh kudesha yehe lach:
Veze-llecha terumat mattanam lechol-tenufot bene yisrael lecha netattim ulevanecha velivnotecha ittecha lechok-olam kol-tahor bevetcha yochal oto
Veden lach afrashut mattenathon lechol aramut bene yisrael lach yehavtinnun velivnaych velivnataych immach likyam olam kol didche bevetach yechul yateh:
Kol chelev yitzhar vechol-chelev tirosh vedagan reshitam asher-yittenu la-Adonai lecha netattim
Kol tuv meshach vechol tuv chamar veibbur reshithon di yittenun kodam Adonai lach yehavtinnun:
Bikkure kol-asher beartzam asher-yaviu la-Adonai lecha yihye kol-tahor bevetcha yochlennu
Bikkure kol di vearahon di yaytun kodam Adonai di lach yehe kol didche bevetach yechlunneh:
Kol-cherem beyisrael lecha yihye
Kol cherma veyisrael di lach yehe:
Kol-peter rechem lechol-basar asher-yakrivu la-Adonai baadam uvabbehema yihye-llach ach pado tifde et bechor haadam veet bechor-habbehema hattemea tifde
Kol patach valda lechol bisra di yekarvun kodam Adonai beenasha uvivira yehe lach beram mifrak tifruk yat buchera deenasha veyat buchera divira mesaava tifrok:
Ufeduyav mibben-chodesh tifde beerkecha kesef chameshet shekalim beshekel hakkodesh esrim gera hu
Ufurekaneh mibbar yarcha tifrok befursaneh kesaf chamesh silin besile kudesha asrin main hu:
Ach bechor-shor o-vechor kesev o-vechor ez lo tifde kodesh hem et-damam tizrok al-hammizbeach veet-chelbam taktir ishshe lereach nichoach la-Adonai
Beram buchera detora o vuchera deimra o vuchera deizza la tifruk kudesha innun yat dimhon tizruk al madbecha veyat tarbehon tassek kureban leitkabbala veraava kodam Adonai:
Uvesaram yihye-llach kachaze hattenufa ucheshok hayyamin lecha yihye
Uvisrehon yehe lach kechadya daaramuta ucheshoka deyammina lach yehe:
Kol terumot hakkodashim asher yarimu vene-yisrael la-Adonai natatti lecha ulevanecha velivnotecha ittecha lechok-olam berit melach olam hiv lifne Adonai lecha ulezaracha ittach
Kol afrashut kudeshayya di yifreshun bene yisrael kodam Adonai yehavit lach velivnaych velivnataych immach likyam olam keyam melach olam hu kodam Adonai lach velivnaych immach:
Vayyomer Adonai el-aharon beartzam lo tinchal vechelek lo-yihye lecha betocham ani chelkecha venachalatcha betoch bene yisrael
Vaamar Adonai leaharon bearahon la tachasin vocholak la yehe lach benehon mattenan di yehavit lach innun chulekach veachasantach bego bene yisrael:
Velivne levi hinne natatti kol-maaser beyisrael lenachala chelef avodatam asher-hem ovdim et-avodat ohel moed
Velivne levi ha yehavit kol maasra veyisrael leachasana chalaf pulechanhon di innun palchin yat pulechan mashkan zimna:
Velo-yikrevu od bene yisrael el-ohel moed laset chet lamut
Vela yikrevun od bene yisrael lemashkan zimna lekabbala chova limmat:
Veavad hallevi hu et-avodat ohel moed vehem yisu avonam chukkat olam ledorotechem uvetoch bene yisrael lo yinchalu nachala
Veyiflechun levae innun yat pulechan mashkan zimna veinnun yekabbelun chovehon keyam olam ledarechon uvego bene yisrael la yachsenun achasana:
Ki et-masar bene-yisrael asher yarimu la-Adonai teruma natatti lalviyyim lenachala al-ken amarti lahem betoch bene yisrael lo yinchalu nachala
Are yat maasra divne yisrael di yafreshun kodam Adonai afrashuta yehavit lelevae leachasana al ken amarit lehon bego bene yisrael la yachsenun achasana:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Veel-haleviyyim tedabber veamarta alehem ki-tikchu meet bene-yisrael et-hammaaser asher natatti lachem meittam benachalatchem vaharemotem mimmennu terumat Adonai maaser min-hammaaser
Ulelevae temallel vetemar lehon are tissevun min bene yisrael yat maasra di yehavit lechon minnehon beachasantechon vetafreshun minneh afrashuta kodam Adonai maasra min maasra:
Venechshav lachem terumatchem kaddagan min-haggoren vechamlea min-hayyakev
Vetitchashshav lechon afrashutechon keibbura min idra vechammeleata min matzarta:
Ken tarimu gam-attem terumat Adonai mikkol maserotechem asher tikchu meet bene yisrael unetattem mimmennu et-terumat Adonai leaharon hakkohen
Ken tafreshun af attun afrashuta kodam Adonai mikkol maasratechon di tissevun min bene yisrael vetittenun minneh yat afrashuta kodam Adonai leaharon kahana:
Mikkol mattenotechem tarimu et kol-terumat Adonai mikkol-chelbo et-mikdesho mimmennu
Mikkol mattenatchon tafreshun yat kol afrashuta daAdonai mikkol shufereh yat makdesheh minneh:
Veamarta alehem baharimchem et-chelbo mimmennu venechshav lalviyyim kitvuat goren vechitvuat yakev
Vetemar lehon beafrashutechon yat shufereh minneh veyitchashshav lelevae kaalalat idra vechaalalat matzarta:
Vaachaltem oto bechol-makom attem uvetchem ki-sachar hu lachem chelef avodatchem beohel moed
Vetechlun yateh bechol atar attun veenash battechon are agra hu lechon chalaf palchanchon bemashkan zimna:
Velo-tisu alav chet baharimchem et-chelbo mimmennu veet-kodshe vene-yisrael lo techallelu velo tamutu
Vela tekabbelun alohi chova beafrashutechon yat shufereh minneh veyat kudeshayya divne yisrael la tachalun vela temutun:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe veel-aharon lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe veim aharon lememar:
Zot chukkat hattora asher-tzivva Adonai lemor dabber el-bene yisrael veyikchu elecha fara adumma temima asher en-bah mum asher lo-ala aleha ol
Da gezerat orayta di fakkid Adonai lememar mallel im bene yisrael veyissevun lach torta simmuketa shelemta di let bah muma di la selik ala nira:
Unetattem otah el-elazar hakkohen vehotzi otah el-michutz lammachane veshachat otah lefanav
Vetittenun yata leelazar kahana veyappek yata lemibbara lemashrita veyikkos yata kodamohi:
Velakach elazar hakkohen middamah beetzbao vehizza el-nochach pene ohel-moed middamah sheva peamim
Veyissav elazar kahana middema beetzbeeh veyaddi lokovel appe mashkan zimna middema sheva zimnin:
Vesaraf et-happara leenav et-orah veet-besarah veet-damah al-pirshah yisrof
Veyoked yat torta leenohi yat mashka veyat bisra veyat dema al ochla yoked:
Velakach hakkohen etz erez veezov usheni tolaat vehishlich el-toch serefat happara
Veyissav kahana aa dearza veezova utzeva zehori veyirme lego yekidat torta:
Vechibbes begadav hakkohen verachatz besaro bammayim veachar yavo el-hammachane vetame hakkohen ad-haarev
Vitzabba levushohi kahana veyasche visreh bemayya uvatar ken yeul lemashrita vihe mesaav kahana ad ramsha:
Vehassoref otah yechabbes begadav bammayim verachatz besaro bammayim vetame ad-haarev
Udemoked yata yetzabba levoshohi bemayya veyasche visreh bemayya vihe mesaav ad ramsha:
Veasaf ish tahor et efer happara vehinniach michutz lammachane bemakom tahor vehayta laadat bene-yisrael lemishmeret leme nidda chattat hiv
Veyichnosh gevar deche yat kitma detorta veyatzna lemibbara lemashrita baatar deche utehe lichnishta divne yisrael lemattara leme addayuta chattata hi:
Vechibbes haosef et-efer happara et-begadav vetame ad-haarev vehayta livne yisrael velagger haggar betocham lechukkat olam
Vitzabba dechannesh yat kitma detorta yat levushohi vihe mesaav ad ramsha utehe livne yisrael ulegiyyorayya deyitgayyerun benehon likyam olam:
Hannogea bemet lechol-nefesh adam vetame shivat yamim
Deyikrav bemeta lechol nafsha deenasha vihe mesaav shava yomin:
Hu yitchatta-vo bayyom hashshelishi uvayyom hashshevii yithar veim-lo yitchatta bayyom hashshelishi uvayyom hashshevii lo yithar
Hu yadde alohi beyoma telitaa uveyoma sheviaa yidke veim la yadde alohi beyoma telitaa uveyoma sheviaa la yidke:
Kol-hannogea bemet benefesh haadam asher-yamut velo yitchatta et-mishkan Adonai timme venichreta hannefesh hahiv miyyisrael ki me nidda lo-zorak alav tame yihye od tumato vo
Kol deyikrav bemita venafsha deenasha di yemut vela yadde alohi yat mashkena daAdonai saav veyishtetze enasha hahu miyyisrael are me addayuta la izderiku alohi mesaav yehe od seovteh beh:
Zot hattora adam ki-yamut beohel kol-habba el-haohel vechol-asher baohel yitma shivat yamim
Da orayta enash are yemut bemashkena kol dealel lemashkena vechol di bemashkena yehe mesaav shava yomin:
Vechol keli fatuach asher en-tzamid patil alav tame hu
Vechol man dachasaf petiach delet megufat sheyia makkaf alohi mesaav hu:
Vechol asher-yigga al-pene hassade bachalal-cherev o vemet o-veetzem adam o vekaver yitma shivat yamim
Vechol di yikrav al appe chakla biktel charba o vemeta o vegarma deenasha o vekivra yehe mesaav shava yomin:
Velakchu lattame meafar serefat hachattat venatan alav mayim chayyim el-keli
Veyissevun ledimsaav meafar yekedat chattata veyittenun alohi me mabbua leman:
Velakach ezov vetaval bammayim ish tahor vehizza al-haohel veal-kol-hakkelim veal-hannefashot asher hayu-sham veal-hannogea baetzem o vechalal o vammet o vakkaver
Veyissav ezova veyitbol bemayya gevar deche veyadde al mashkena veal kol manayya veal nafshata di havo tamman veal deyikrav begarma o vekatila o vemeta o vekivra:
Vehizza hattahor al-hattame bayyom hashshelishi uvayyom hashshevii vechitteo bayyom hashshevii vechibbes begadav verachatz bammayim vetaher baarev
Veyadde dachya al mesaava beyoma telitaa uveyoma sheviaa vidakkinneh beyoma sheviaa vitzabba levushohi veyasche vemayya veyidke veramsha:
Veish asher-yitma velo yitchatta venichreta hannefesh hahiv mittoch hakkahal ki et-mikdash Adonai timme me nidda lo-zorak alav tame hu
Ugevar di yistaav vela yadde alohi veyishtetze enasha hahu miggo kehala are yat makdesha daAdonai saiv me addayuta la izderiku alohi mesaav hu:
Vehayta lahem lechukkat olam umazze me-hannidda yechabbes begadav vehannogea beme hannidda yitma ad-haarev
Utehe lehon likyam olam udeyadde me addayuta yetzabba levushohi udeyikrav beme addayuta yehe mesaav ad ramsha:
Vechol asher-yigga-bo hattame yitma vehannefesh hannogaat titma ad-haarev
Vechol di yikrav beh mesaava yehe mesaav veenash deyikrav beh yehe mesaav ad ramsha:
Vayyavou vene-yisrael kol-haeda midbar-tzin bachodesh harishon vayyeshev haam bekadesh vattamot sham miryam vattikkaver sham
Vaato vene yisrael kol kenishta lemadbera detzin beyarcha kadmaa vitev amma birkam umitat tamman miryam veitkevarat tamman:
Velo-haya mayim laeda vayyikkahalu al-moshe veal-aharon
Vela hava mayya lichnishta veitkenashu al mshe veal aharon:
Vayyarev haam im-moshe vayyomru lemor velu gavanu bigva achenu lifne Adonai
Unetza amma im mshe vaamaru lememar uleve demitna bemota deachana kodam Adonai:
Velama havetem et-kehal Adonai el-hammidbar hazze lamut sham anachnu uveirenu
Ulema aeltun yat kehala daAdonai lemadbera haden limmat tamman anachna uveirana:
Velama heelitunu mimmitzrayim lehavi otanu el-hammakom hara hazze lo mekom zera uteena vegefen verimmon umayim ayin lishtot
Ulema assektuna mimmitzrayim leaytaa yatana leatra visha haden la atar keshar levet zera veaf la tenin vegufenin verimmonin umayya let lemishte:
Vayyavo moshe veaharon mippene hakkahal el-petach ohel moed vayyippelu al-penehem vayyera chevod-Adonai alehem
Veal mshe veaharon min kodam kehala litra mashkan zimna unefalu al appehon veitgele yekara daAdonai lehon:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Kach et-hammatte vehakhel et-haeda atta veaharon achicha vedibbartem el-hassela leenehem venatan memav vehotzeta lahem mayim min-hassela vehishkita et-haeda veet-beiram
Sav yat chutera veachnesh yat kenishta at veaharon achuch utemallelun im kefa leenehon veyitten mohi vetappek lehon mayya min kefa vetashke yat kenishta veyat beirhon:
Vayyikkach moshe et-hammatte millifne Adonai kaasher tzivvahu
Unesiv mshe yat chutera min kodam Adonai kema di pakkedeh:
Vayyakhilu moshe veaharon et-hakkahal el-pene hassala vayyomer lahem shimu-na hammorim hamin-hassela hazze notzi lachem mayim
Veachnishu mshe veaharon yat kehala lokodam kefa vaamar lehon shemau chean sarvanayya hamin kefa haden nappek lechon mayya:
Vayyarem moshe et-yado vayyach et-hassela bemattehu paamayim vayyetzu mayim rabbim vattesht haeda uveiram
Vaarem mshe yat yedeh umecha yat kefa bechutereh tarten zimnin unefaku mayya saggie ushetiat kenishta uveirhon:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe veel-aharon yaan lo-heemantem bi lehakdisheni leene bene yisrael lachen lo taviu et-hakkahal hazze el-haaretz asher-natatti lahem
Vaamar Adonai lemshe uleaharon chalaf di la hemantun bememri lekaddashuti leene bene yisrael bechen la taalun yat kehala haden leara di yehavit lehon:
Hemma me meriva asher-ravu vene-yisrael et-Adonai vayyikkadesh bam
Innun me matztzuta di netzo bene yisrael kodam Adonai veitkaddash behon:
Vayyishlach moshe malachim mikkadesh el-melech edom ko amar achicha yisrael atta yadata et kol-hattelaa asher metzaatnu
Ushelach mshe izgaddin merkam levat malka deedom kidnan amar achuch yisrael at yedaat yat kol akta di ashkachtana:
Vayyerdu avotenu mitzrayma vanneshev bemitzrayim yamim rabbim vayyareu lanu mitzrayim velaavotenu
Unechatu avahatana lemitzrayim vitevna vemitzrayim yomin saggiin veavishu lana mitzrae velaavahatana:
Vannitzak el-Adonai vayyishma kolenu vayyishlach malach vayyotzienu mimmitzrayim vehinne anachnu vekadesh ir ketze gevulecha
Vetzallena kodam Adonai vekabbil tzelotana ushelach malacha veappekana mimmitzrayim veha anachna virkam karta devistar techumach:
Nabera-nna veartzecha lo naavor besade uvecherem velo nishte me veer derech hammelech nelech lo nitte yamin usemovl ad asher-naavor gevulecha
Neibbar kean bearach la neibbar bachakal uvichram vela nishte me gov beorach malka nezel la niste leyammina velismala ad dinibbar techumach:
Vayyomer elav edom lo taavor bi pen-bacherev etze likratecha
Vaamar leh edomaa la teibbar bitchumi dilma bidkatlin becharba eppok lokodamutach:
Vayyomru elav bene-yisrael bamsilla naale veim-memecha nishte ani umiknay venatatti michram rak en-davar beraglay eevora
Vaamaru leh bene yisrael beorach kevisha nissak veim meyymach nishte ana uveiray veetten demehon lechod let pitgam devish beraglay aibbar:
Vayyomer lo taavor vayyetze edom likrato beam kaved uveyad chazaka
Vaamar la teibbar unefak edomaa lokodamuteh bechel rav uvida takkifa:
Vaymaen edom neton et-yisrael avor bigvulo vayyet yisrael mealav
Vesarev edomaa lemishvak yat yisrael lemeebbar bitchumeh useta yisrael millevateh:
Vayyisu mikkadesh vayyavou vene-yisrael kol-haeda hor hahar
Unetalu merkam vaato vene yisrael kol kenishta lehor tura:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe veel-aharon behor hahar al-gevul eretz-edom lemor
Vaamar Adonai lemshe uleaharon behor tura al techum ara deedom lememar:
Yeasef aharon el-ammav ki lo yavo el-haaretz asher natatti livne yisrael al asher-meritem et-pi leme meriva
Yitkenesh aharon leammeh are la yeol leara di yehavit livne yisrael al di sarivtun al memri leme matztzuta:
Kach et-aharon veet-elazar beno vehaal otam hor hahar
Devar yat aharon veyat elazar bereh veassek yathon lehor tura:
Vehafshet et-aharon et-begadav vehilbashtam et-elazar beno veaharon yeasef umet sham
Veashlach yat aharon yat levushohi vetalbeshinnun yat elazar bereh veaharon yitkenesh vimut tamman:
Vayyaas moshe kaasher tzivva Adonai vayyaalu el-hor hahar leene kol-haeda
Vaavad mshe kema di pakkid Adonai useliku lehor tura leene kol kenishta:
Vayyafshet moshe et-aharon et-begadav vayyalbesh otam et-elazar beno vayyamot aharon sham berosh hahar vayyered moshe veelazar min-hahar
Veashlach mshe yat aharon yat levushohi vealbesh yathon yat elazar bereh umit aharon tamman beresh tura unechat mshe veelazar min tura:
Vayyiru kol-haeda ki gava aharon vayyivku et-aharon sheloshim yom kol bet yisrael
Vachazo kol kenishta are mit aharon uvecho yat aharon telatin yomin kol bet yisrael:
Vayyishma hakkenaani melech-arad yoshev hannegev ki ba yisrael derech haatarim vayyillachem beyisrael vayyishb mimmennu shevi
Ushema kenaanaa malka daarad yatev daroma are ata yisrael orach meallayya veaggach kerava beyisrael usheva minneh shivya:
Vayyiddar yisrael neder la-Adonai vayyomar im-naton titten et-haam hazze beyadi vehacharamti et-arehem
Vekayyem yisrael keyam kodam Adonai vaamar im mimsar timsar yat amma haden bidi vaagammar yat kirvehon:
Vayyishma Adonai bekol yisrael vayyitten et-hakkenaani vayyacharem ethem veet-arehem vayyikra shem-hammakom chorma
Vekabbel Adonai tzeloteh deyisrael umesar yat kenaanaa vegammar yathon veyat kirvehon ukera shema deatra charma:
Vayyisu mehor hahar derech yam-suf lisvov et-eretz edom vattiktzar nefesh-haam baddarech
Unetalu mehor tura orach yamma desuf leakkafa yat ara deedom vaakat nafsha deamma beorcha:
Vaydabber haam belohim uvemoshe lama heelitunu mimmitzrayim lamut bammidbar ki en lechem veen mayim venafshenu katza ballechem hakkelokel
Veitraam amma bememra daAdonai veim mshe netzo lema assektuna mimmitzrayim limmat bemadbera are let lachma velet mayya venafshana akat bemanna haden demechleh kalil:
Vayshallach Adonai baam et hannechashim hasserafim vaynashshechu et-haam vayyamot am-rav miyyisrael
Vegare Adonai beamma yat chivan kalan unechitu yat amma umit am saggi miyyisrael:
Vayyavo haam el-moshe vayyomru chatanu ki-dibbarnu va-Adonai vavach hitpallel el-Adonai veyaser mealenu et-hannachash vayyitpallel moshe bead haam
Vaata amma lemshe vaamaru chavna are itraamna kodam Adonai veimmach netzena tzalli kodam Adonai veyaaddi minnana yat chivya vetzalli mshe al amma:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe ase lecha saraf vesim oto al-nes vehaya kol-hannashuch veraa oto vachay
Vaamar Adonai lemshe aved lach kalya veshavve yateh al at vihe kol deyitnechit veyecheze yateh veyitkayyam:
Vayyaas moshe nechash nechoshet vaysimehu al-hannes vehaya im-nashach hannachash et-ish vehibbit el-nechash hannechoshet vachay
Vaavad mshe chivya dinchasha veshavyeh al at vahava kad nachit chivya yat gavra umistakkel lechivya dinchasha umitkayyam:
Vayyisu bene yisrael vayyachanu beovot
Unetalu bene yisrael ushero beovot:
Vayyisu meovot vayyachanu beiyye haavarim bammidbar asher al-pene moav mimmizrach hashshamesh
Unetalu meovot ushero bimgizat avarae bemadbera di al appe moav mimmadnach shimsha:
Mishsham nasau vayyachanu benachal zared
Mittamman netalu ushero benachala dezared:
Mishsham nasau vayyachanu meever arnon asher bammidbar hayyotze miggevul haemori ki arnon gevul moav ben moav uven haemori
Mittamman netalu ushero meivra dearnon di vemadbera denafek mittechum emoraa are arnon techum moav ben moav uven emoraa:
Al-ken yeamar besefer milchamot Adonai et-vahev besufa veet-hannechalim arnon
Al ken yitammar besifra keravin daavad Adonai al yamma desuf ugevuran deal nachale arnon:
Veeshed hannechalim asher nata leshevet ar venishan ligvul moav
Veshafuch nachalayya demiddabberin lokovel lechayyat umistemich litchum moav:
Umishsham beera hiv habbeer asher amar Adonai lemoshe esof et-haam veettena lahem mayim
Umittamman ityehivat lehon bera hi vera di amar Adonai lemshe kenosh yat amma veetten lehon mayya:
Az yashir yisrael et-hashshira hazzot ali veer enu-lah
Bechen shabbach yisrael yat tushebachta hada sakki vera shabbachu lah:
Beer chafaruha sarim karuha nedive haam bimchokek bemishanotam umimmidbar mattana
Bera dechafruha ravrevayya keruha reshe amma safrayya bechuterehon umimmadbera ityehivat lehon:
Umimmattana nachaliel uminnachaliel bamot
Umiddeityehivat lehon nachata immehon lenachalayya uminachalayya salka immehon leramata:
Umibbamot haggay asher bisde moav rosh happisga venishkafa al-pene hayeshimon
Umeramata lechelayya di bechakle moav resh ramata umistachya al appe vet yeshimon:
Vayyishlach yisrael malachim el-sichon melech-haemori lemor
Ushelach yisrael izgaddin levat sichon malka deemoraa lememar:
Ebera veartzecha lo nitte besade uvecherem lo nishte me veer bederech hammelech nelech ad asher-naavor gevulecha
Aivar bearach la niste bachakal uvichram la nishte me gov beorach malka nezel ad di neivar techumach:
Velo-natan sichon et-yisrael avor bigvulo vayyeesof sichon et-kol-ammo vayyetze likrat yisrael hammidbara vayyavo yahtza vayyillachem beyisrael
Vela shevak sichon yat yisrael lemebar bitchumeh uchenash sichon yat kol ammeh unefak lokodamut yisrael lemadbera vaata leyahatz viaggiach kerava beyisrael:
Vayyakkehu yisrael lefi-charev vayyirash et-artzo mearnon ad-yabbok ad-bene ammon ki az gevul bene ammon
Umechahi yisrael lefitgam decharev viret yat areh mearnona ad yuveka ad bene ammon are takkif techuma divne ammon:
Vayyikkach yisrael et kol-hearim haelle vayyeshev yisrael bechol-are haemori becheshbon uvechol-benoteha
Uchevash yisrael yat kol kirvayya haillen vitev yisrael bechol kirve emoraa becheshbon uvechol kafranaha:
Ki cheshbon ir sichon melech haemori hiv vehu nilcham bemelech moav harishon vayyikkach et-kol-artzo miyyado ad-arnon
Are cheshbon karta desichon malka deemoraa hi vehu aggach kerava bemalka demoav kadmaa unesiv yat kol areh mideh ad arnon:
Al-ken yomru hammoshlim bou cheshbon tibbane vetikkonen ir sichon
Al ken yemrun metalayya ulu lecheshbon titbene vetishtachlal karta desichon:
Ki-esh yatza mecheshbon lehava mikkiryat sichon achla ar moav baale bamot arnon
Are kidum takkif keeshsha nefak mecheshbon avde kerava keshalhovita mikkarta desichon ketilu amma dishro vilchayat moav kumerayya defalchin bet dachala ramata dearnon:
Oy-lecha moav avadta am-kemosh natan banav peletim uvenotav bashshevit lemelech emori sichon
Vay lechon moavae avadtun amma defalchin lichmosh mesar benohi tzirin uvenateh beshivya lemalka deemoraa sichon:
Vanniram avad cheshbon ad-divon vannashshim ad-nofach asher ad-medva
Umalchu fesakat mecheshbon ada shuletan middivon vetzadiu ad nofach dismich ad medva:
Vayyeshev yisrael beeretz haemori
Vitev yisrael baara emoraa:
Vayyishlach moshe leraggel et-yazer vayyilkedu benoteha vayyoresh et-haemori asher-sham
Ushelach mshe leallala yat yazer uchevashu kafranaha vetarich yat emoraa di tamman:
Vayyifnu vayyaalu derech habbashan vayyetze og melech-habbashan likratam hu vechol-ammo lammilchama edrei
Veitpeniu useliku leorach matnan unefak og malka dematnan lokodamutehon hu vechol ammeh leaggacha kerava leedrei:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe al-tira oto ki veyadcha natatti oto veet-kol-ammo veet-artzo veasita lo kaasher asita lesichon melech haemori asher yoshev becheshbon
Vaamar Adonai lemshe la tidchal minneh are vidach mesarit yateh veyat kol ammeh veyat areh vetabed leh kema di avadt lesichon malka deemoraa di yatev becheshbon:
Vayyakku oto veet-banav veet-kol-ammo ad-bilti hishir-lo sarid vayyirshu et-artzo
Umecho yateh veyat benohi veyat kol ammeh ad dela ishtear leh mesheziv viritu yat areh:
Vayyisu bene yisrael vayyachanu bearvot moav meever leyarden yerecho
Unetalu bene yisrael ushero bemeshrayya demoav meivra leyardena direcho:
Vayyar balak ben-tzippor et kol-asher-asa yisrael laemori
Vachaza balak bar tzippor yat kol di avad yisrael leemorae:
Vayyagor moav mippene haam meod ki rav-hu vayyakotz moav mippene bene yisrael
Udechel moavaa min kodam amma lachada are saggi hu vaakat lemoavaa min kodam bene yisrael:
Vayyomer moav el-zikne midyan atta yelachachu hakkahal et-kol-sevivotenu kilchoch hashshor et yerek hassade uvalak ben-tzippor melech lemoav baet hahiv
Vaamar moav lesave midyan kean yeshetzun kehala yat kol sacharanana kema dimlachich tora yat yeroka dechakla uvalak bar tzippor malka lemoav beiddana hahi:
Vayyishlach malachim el-bilam ben-beor petora asher al-hannahar eretz bene-ammo likro-lo lemor hinne am yatza mimmitzrayim hinne chissa et-en haaretz vehu yoshev mimmuli
Ushelach izgaddin levat bilam bar beor liftor aram deal perat ara bene ammeh lemikre leh lememar ha amma nefak mimmitzrayim ha chafa yat en shimsha deara vehu share millekivli:
Veatta lecha-nna ara-lli et-haam hazze ki-atzum hu mimmenni ulay uchal nakke-bbo vaagarshennu min-haaretz ki yadati et asher-tevarech mevorach vaasher taor yuar
Uchean ita chean lot li yat amma haden are takkif hu minni maim ekkul leaggacha veh kerav vaatarechinneh min ara are yedana yat di tevarach mevarach vedi telot lit:
Vayyelchu zikne moav vezikne midyan ukesamim beyadam vayyavou el-bilam vaydabberu elav divre valak
Vaazalu save moav vesave midyan vekismayya bidehon vaato levat bilam umallilu immeh pitgame valak:
Vayyomer alehem linu fo hallayla vahashivoti etchem davar kaasher yedabber Adonai elay vayyeshvu sare-moav im-bilam
Vaamar lehon bitu hacha belelya veatev yatchon pitgama kema di mallel Adonai immi veorichu ravreve moav im bilam:
Vayyavo elohim el-bilam vayyomer mi haanashim haelle immach
Vaata memar min kodam Adonai levat bilam vaamar man guvrayya haillen deimmach:
Vayyomer bilam el-haelohim balak ben-tzippor melech moav shalach elay
Vaamar bilam kodam Adonai balak bar tzippor malka demoav shelach levati:
Hinne haam hayyotze mimmitzrayim vaychas et-en haaretz atta lecha kava-lli oto ulay uchal lehillachem bo vegerashtiv
Ha amma di nefak mimmitzrayim vachafa yat en shimsha deara kean ita lot li yateh maim echul leaggacha veh kerav vaatarechinneh:
Vayyomer elohim el-bilam lo telech immahem lo taor et-haam ki varuch hu
Vaamar Adonai levilam la tezil immehon la telut yat amma are verich hu:
Vayyakom bilam babboker vayyomer el-sare valak lechu el-artzechem ki meen Adonai letitti lahaloch immachem
Vekam bilam betzafra vaamar leravreve valak izilu learachon are let raava kodam Adonai lemishbeki lemizal immechon:
Vayyakumu sare moav vayyavou el-balak vayyomru meen bilam haloch immanu
Vekamu ravreve moav vaato levat balak vaamaru sarev bilam lemete immana:
Vayyosef od balak sheloach sarim rabbim venichbadim meelle
Veosif od balak lemishlach ravrevin saggiin veyakkirin meillen:
Vayyavou el-bilam vayyomru lo ko amar balak ben-tzippor al-na timmana mehaloch elay
Vaato levat bilam vaamaru leh kidnan amar balak bar tzippor la chean titmena millemete levati:
Ki-chabbed achabbedcha meod vechol asher-tomar elay eese ulecha-nna kava-lli et haam hazze
Are yekara ayakkerinnach lachada vechol di temar li abed veita chean lot li yat amma haden:
Vayyaan bilam vayyomer el-avde valak im-yitten-li valak melo veto kesef vezahav lo uchal laavor et-pi Adonai elohay laasot ketanna o gedola
Veatev bilam vaamar leavde valak im yitten li valak mele veteh kesaf udehav let li reshu lemebar al gezerat memra daAdonai elahi lemebad zeerta o rabbeta:
Veatta shevu na vaze gam-attem hallayla veeda ma-yyosef Adonai dabber immi
Uchean orichu chean hacha af attun belelya veidda ma yosef Adonai lemallala immi:
Vayyavo elohim el-bilam layla vayyomer lo im-likro lecha bau haanashim kum lech ittam veach et-haddavar asher-adabber elecha oto taase
Vaata memar min kodam Adonai levilam belelya vaamar leh im lemikre lach ato guvrayya kum izzel immehon uveram yat pitgama di amallel immach yateh tabed:
Vayyakom bilam babboker vayyachavosh et-atono vayyelech im-sare moav
Vekam bilam betzafra vezariz yat attaneh vaazal im ravreve moav:
Vayyichar-af elohim ki-holech hu vayyityatztzev malach Adonai badderech lesatan lo vehu rochev al-atono ushene nearav immo
Utekef rogza daAdonai are azel hu veitattad malacha daAdonai beorcha lesatan leh vehu rachiv al attaneh uteren ulemohi immeh:
Vattere haaton et-malach Adonai nitztzav badderech vecharbo shelufa beyado vattet haaton min-hadderech vattelech bassade vayyach bilam et-haaton lehattotah haddarech
Vachazat attana yat malacha daAdonai meattad beorcha vecharbeh shelifa bideh usetat attana min orcha vaazalat bechakla umecha vilam yat attana leastayuta leorcha:
Vayyaamod malach Adonai bemishol hakkeramim gader mizze vegader mizze
Vekam malacha daAdonai bishvil karmayya atra degadera mikka vegadera mikka:
Vattere haaton et-malach Adonai vattillachetz el-hakkir vattilchatz et-regel bilam el-hakkir vayyosef lehakkotah
Vachazat attana yat malacha daAdonai veidchekat lechatla udechekat yat rigla devilam lechatla veosif lemimcha:
Vayyosef malach-Adonai avor vayyaamod bemakom tzar asher en-derech lintot yamin usemovl
Veosef malacha daAdonai lemebar vekam baatar ak di let orach lemiste leyammina velismala:
Vattere haaton et-malach Adonai vattirbatz tachat bilam vayyichar-af bilam vayyach et-haaton bammakkel
Vachazat attana yat malacha daAdonai urevaat techot bilam utekef rugeza devilam umecha yat attana bechutra:
Vayyiftach Adonai et-pi haaton vattomer levilam me-asiti lecha ki hikkitani ze shalosh regalim
Ufetach Adonai yat puma deaattana vaamarat levilam me avadit lach are mechitanni denan telat zimnin:
Vayyomer bilam laaton ki hitallalt bi lu yesh-cherev beyadi ki atta haragtich
Vaamar bilam leattana are chayyicht bi illufon it charba bidi are chean ketaltich:
Vattomer haaton el-bilam halo anochi atoncha asher-rachavta alay meodcha ad-hayyom hazze hahasken hiskanti laasot lecha ko vayyomer lo
Vaamarat attana levilam hala ana attanach di rechavt alay middeitach ad yoma haden hamelaf allifna lemebad lach keden vaamar la:
Vaygal Adonai et-ene vilam vayyar et-malach Adonai nitztzav badderech vecharbo shelufa beyado vayyikkod vayyishtachu leappav
Ugela Adonai yat ene vilam vachaza yat malacha daAdonai meattad beorcha vecharbeh shelifa bideh uchera usegid leappohi:
Vayyomer elav malach Adonai al-ma hikkita et-atoncha ze shalosh regalim hinne anochi yatzati lesatan ki-yarat hadderech lenegdi
Vaamar leh malacha daAdonai al ma mechita yat attanach denan telat zimnin ha ana nefakit lemistan are gele kodamay deat rae lemezal beurecha lekivli:
Vattirani haaton vattet lefanay ze shalosh regalim ulay natta mippanay ki atta gam-otcha haragti veotah hecheyeti
Vachazatni attana usetat min kodamay denan telat zimnin illufon la setat min kodamay are chean af yatach ketalit veyata kayyemit:
Vayyomer bilam el-malach Adonai chatati ki lo yadati ki atta nitztzav likrati baddarech veatta im-ra beenecha ashuva li
Vaamar bilam lemalacha daAdonai chavit are la yedait di at meattad lokodamuti beorcha uchean im bish beenaych etov li:
Vayyomer malach Adonai el-bilam lech im-haanashim veefes et-haddavar asher-adabber elecha oto tedabber vayyelech bilam im-sare valak
Vaamar malacha daAdonai levilam izzel im guvrayya ulechod yat pitgama di amallel immach yateh temallel vaazal bilam im ravreve valak:
Vayyishma balak ki va vilam vayyetze likrato el-ir moav asher al-gevul arnon asher biktze haggevul
Ushema balak are ata vilam unefak lokodamuteh lekarta demoav di al techum arnon di bistar techuma:
Vayyomer balak el-bilam halo shaloach shalachti elecha likro-lach lamma lo-halachta elay haumnam lo uchal kabbedecha
Vaamar balak levilam hala mishlach shelachit levatach lemikre lach lema la ateta levati habbekusheta haveta amar let ana yachil leyakkerutach:
Vayyomer bilam el-balak hinne-vati elecha atta hayachol uchal dabber meuma haddavar asher yasim elohim befi oto adabber
Vaamar bilam levalak ha ateti levatach kean hamechal yachilna lemallala middaam pitgama dishavvi Adonai befumi yateh amallel:
Vayyelech bilam im-balak vayyavou kiryat chutzot
Vaazal bilam im balak vaato lekiryat machozohi:
Vayyizbach balak bakar vatzon vayshallach levilam velassarim asher itto
Uneches balak torin vean ushelach levilam uleravrevayya di immeh:
Vayhi vabboker vayyikkach balak et-bilam vayyaalehu bamot baal vayyar mishsham ketze haam
Vahava vetzafra udevar balak yat bilam veassekeh leramat dachalteh vechaza mittamman ketzat min amma:
Vayyomer bilam el-balak bene-li vaze shiva mizbechot vehachen li baze shiva farim veshiva elim
Vaamar bilam levalak bene li hacha shava madbechin veatken li hacha shava torin veshava dichrin:
Vayyaas balak kaasher dibber bilam vayyaal balak uvilam par vaayil bammizbeach
Vaavad balak kema di mallel bilam veassek balak uvilam tor udechar al kol madbecha:
Vayyomer bilam levalak hityatztzev al-olatecha veelcha ulay yikkare Adonai likrati udevar ma-yyareni vehiggadti lach vayyelech shefi
Vaamar bilam levalak itattad al alatach veehach maim yeara memar min kodam Adonai lokodamuti ufitgama deyachazinnani veechavve lach vaazal yechidi:
Vayyikkar elohim el-bilam vayyomer elav et-shivat hammizbechot arachti vaaal par vaayil bammizbeach
Vaara memar min kodam Adonai levat bilam vaamar leh yat shava madbechin saddarit veassekit tor udechar al kol madbecha:
Vayyasem Adonai davar befi vilam vayyomer shuv el-balak vecho tedabber
Veshavvi Adonai pitgama befuma devilam vaamar tuv levat balak ucheden temallel:
Vayyashov elav vehinne nitztzav al-olato hu vechol-sare moav
Vetav levateh veha meattad al alateh hu vechol ravreve moav:
Vayyissa meshalo vayyomar min-aram yancheni valak melech-moav meharre-kedem lecha ara-lli yaakov ulecha zoama yisrael
Unetal matleh vaamar min aram dabberani valak malka demoav mitture maddincha ita lut li yaakov veita tarech li yisrael:
Ma ekkov lo kabbo el uma ezom lo zaam Adonai
Ma aloteh dela latye el uma atarcheh dela tarcheh Adonai:
Ki-merosh tzurim erennu umiggevaot ashurennu hen-am levadad yishkon uvaggoyim lo yitchashshav
Are meresh turayya chaziteh umeramata sechiteh ha amma bilchodehon atidin deyachsenun alma uvaamamayya la yitdanun gemira:
Mi mana afar yaakov umispar et-rova yisrael tamot nafshi mot yesharim utehi achariti kamohu
Man yechol lemimne dadekayya devet yaakov deamir alehon yisgun keafra deara o chada mearba mashshiryata deyisrael temut nafshi mota dekashshitohi vihe sofi kevathon:
Vayyomer balak el-bilam me asita li lakov oyvay lekachticha vehinne berachta varech
Vaamar balak levilam me avadt li lemelat sanay devartich veha varacha mevarchat lehon:
Vayyaan vayyomar halo et asher yasim Adonai befi oto eshmor ledabber
Vaatev vaamar hala yat dishavvi Adonai befumi yateh ettar lemallala:
Vayyomer elav balak lecha-nna itti el-makom acher asher tirennu mishsham efes katzehu tire vechullo lo tire vekovno-li mishsham
Vaamar leh balak ita chean immi laatar ochoran detechazinneh mittamman lechod ketzateh techeze vechulleh la techeze uteluteh li mittamman:
Vayyikkachehu sede tzofim el-rosh happisga vayyiven shiva mizbechot vayyaal par vaayil bammizbeach
Vedabbereh lachakal sechuta leresh ramata uvena shava madbechin veassek tor udechar al kol madbecha:
Vayyomer el-balak hityatztzev ko al-olatecha veanochi ikkare ko
Vaamar levalak itattad hacha al alatach vaana itmete ad ka:
Vayyikkar Adonai el-bilam vayyasem davar befiv vayyomer shuv el-balak vecho tedabber
Vaara memar min kodam Adonai levilam veshavvi fitgama befumeh vaamar tuv levat balak ucheden temallel:
Vayyavo elav vehinno nitztzav al-olato vesare moav itto vayyomer lo balak ma-ddibber Adonai
Vaata levateh vehu meattad al alateh veravreve moav immeh vaamar leh balak ma mallil Adonai:
Vayyissa meshalo vayyomar kum balak ushema haazina aday beno tzippor
Unetal matleh vaamar kum balak ushema atzet lememri bar tzippor:
Lo ish el vichazzev uven-adam veyitnecham hahu amar velo yaase vedibber velo yekimenna
La chemille vene enasha memar elaha bene enasha amrin umechaddevin veaf la keovade vene visra di innun gazrin lemebad vetayyevin umitmallechin dehu amar veaved vechol memreh mitkayyam:
Hinne varech lakachti uverech velo ashivenna
Ha virchan kabbelit vaavarechinneh leyisrael vela atev birketi minneh:
Lo-hibbit aven beyaakov velo-raa amal beyisrael Adonai elohav immo uteruat melech bo
Istakkalit let palche gillulin bidvet yaakov veaf la avde leut shekar beyisrael memra daAdonai elahahon besadehon ushechinat malkehon benehon:
El motziam mimmitzrayim ketoafot reem lo
Elaha deappekinnun mimmtzerayim tukepa veruma dileh:
Ki lo-nachash beyaakov velo-kesem beyisrael kaet yeamer leyaakov uleyisrael ma-ppaal el
Are la nachashayya tzavan deyitav lidvet yaakov veaf la kesamayya rean birvut bet yisrael keiddan yitammar leyaakov uleyisrael me avad elaha:
Hen-am kelavi yakum vechaari yitnassa lo yishkav ad-yochal teref vedam-chalalim yishte
Ha amma keleta share uchearya yitnattal la yishre veareh ad deyiktol ketol venichse ammayya yerat:
Vayyomer balak el-bilam gam-kov lo tikkovennu gam-barech lo tevarchennu
Vaamar balak levilam af melat la telutinnun af beracha la tevarechinnun:
Vayyaan bilam vayyomer el-balak halo dibbarti elecha lemor kol asher-yedabber Adonai oto eese
Vaatev bilam vaamar levalak hala mallelit immach lememar kol di yemallel Adonai yateh ebed:
Vayyomer balak el-bilam lecha-nna ekkachacha el-makom acher ulay yishar beene haelohim vekabboto li mishsham
Vaamar balak levilam ita chean adabberinnach laatar ochoran maim yehe raava min kodam Adonai uteluteh li mittamman:
Vayyikkach balak et-bilam rosh happeor hannishkaf al-pene hayeshimon
Udevar balak yat bilam resh ramata demistakkeya al appe vet yeshimon:
Vayyomer bilam el-balak bene-li vaze shiva mizbechot vehachen li baze shiva farim veshiva elim
Vaamar bilam levalak bene li hacha shava madbechin veatken li hacha shava torin veshava dichrin:
Vayyaas balak kaasher amar bilam vayyaal par vaayil bammizbeach
Vaavad balak kema di amar bilam veassek tor udechar al kol madbecha:
Vayyar bilam ki tov beene Adonai levarech et-yisrael velo-halach kefaam-befaam likrat nechashim vayyashet el-hammidbar panav
Vachaza vilam are takkin kodam Adonai levaracha yat yisrael vela halach kizman bizman ellahen lokodamut nechashayya veshavvi lemadbera appohi:
Vayyissa vilam et-enav vayyar et-yisrael shochen lishvatav vattehi alav ruach elohim
Uzekef bilam yat enohi vachaza yat yisrael sharan leshivtohi usherat alohi ruach nevua min kodam Adonai:
Vayyissa meshalo vayyomar neum bilam beno veor uneum haggever shetum haayin
Unetal matleh vaamar emar bilam bereh beor veemar gavra deshappir chaze:
Neum shomea imre-el asher machaze shadday yecheze nofel ugeluy enayim
Emar dishma memar min kodam el vechezu min kodam shadday chaze shechiv umitgele leh:
Ma-ttovu ohalecha yaakov mishkenotecha yisrael
Ma tava arach yaakov bet meshraych yisrael:
Kinchalim nittayu kegannot ale nahar kaahalim nata Adonai kaarazim ale-mayim
Kenachalin demiddabberin keginnat shakya deal perat kevusemayya dintziv Adonai kearzin dintzivin al mayya:
Yizzal-mayim middalyav vezaro bemayim rabbim veyarom meagag malko vetinnasse malchuto
Yisge malka deyitrabba mibbenohi veyishlot beammin saggiin veyitkof meagag malkeh vetitnetel malchuteh:
El motzio mimmitzrayim ketoafot reem lo yochal goyim tzarav veatzmotehem yegarem vechitztzav yimchatz
Elaha deappekinnun mimmitzrayim takpa veruma dileh yechlun bene yisrael nichse ammayya sanehon uvevizzat malkehon yitpannekun vearathon yachsenun:
Kara shachav kaari uchelavi mi yekimennu mevarchecha varuch veorerecha arur
Yenuach yishre vitkof kearya ucheleta let malchu ditzazeineh berichach yehon berichin velitaych yehon litin:
Vayyichar-af balak el-bilam vayyispok et-kappav vayyomer balak el-bilam lakov oyvay keraticha vehinne berachta varech ze shalosh peamim
Utekef rugeza devalak bevilam ushekafinnun lidohi vaamar balak levilam lemelat sanay keritach veha baracha mevarchat lehon denan telat zimnin:
Veatta berach-lecha el-mekomecha amarti kabbed achabbedcha vehinne menaacha Adonai mikkavod
Uchean ezil lach leatrach amarit yekara ayakkerinnach veha menaach Adonai min yekar:
Vayyomer bilam el-balak halo gam el-malachecha asher-shalachta elay dibbarti lemor
Vaamar bilam levalak hala af leizgaddaych di shallechat levati mallelit lememar:
Im-yitten-li valak melo veto kesef vezahav lo uchal laavor et-pi Adonai laasot tova o raa millibbi asher-yedabber Adonai oto adabber
Im yitten li valak mele veteh kesaf udehav let li reshu lemebar al gezerat memra daAdonai lemebad tavta o vishta meruti dimallel Adonai yateh amallel:
Veatta hinni holech leammi lecha iatzcha asher yaase haam hazze leammecha beacharit hayyamim
Uchean ha ana azel leammi ita amalchinach ma detabed vaachavve lach ma deyabed amma haden leammach besof yomayya:
Vayyissa meshalo vayyomar neum bilam beno veor uneum haggever shetum haayin
Unetal matleh vaamar emar bilam bereh beor veemar gavra deshappir chaze:
Neum shomea imre-el veyodea daat elyon machaze shadday yecheze nofel ugeluy enayim
Emar dishma memar min kodam el vida madda min kodam illaa chezu min kodam shadday chaze shechiv umitgele leh:
Erennu velo atta ashurennu velo karov darach kochav miyyaakov vekam shevet miyyisrael umachatz paate moav vekarkar kol-bene-shet
Chaziteh vela chean sechiteh vela itohi kariv kad yekum malka miyyaakov veyitrabba meshicha miyyishrael veyiktol ravreve moav veyishlot bechol bene enasha:
Vehaya edom yeresha vehaya yeresha seir oyvav veyisrael ose chayil
Vihe edom yerutta vihe yerutta seir levaale devavohi veyisrael yatzlach benichsin:
Veyerd miyyaakov veheevid sarid meir
Veyechut chad middevet yaakov veyoved meshezev mikkiryat ammayya:
Vayyar et-amalek vayyissa meshalo vayyomar reshit goyim amalek veacharito ade oved
Vachaza yat amalkaa unetal matleh vaamar resh keravayya deyisrael hava amalkaa vesofeh lealma yevad:
Vayyar et-hakkeni vayyissa meshalo vayyomar etan moshavecha vesim bassela kinnecha
Vachaza yat shalmaa unetal matleh vaamar takkif bet motvach veshavvi vichrach takkif medorach:
Ki im-yihye levaer kayin ad-ma ashshur tishbekka
Are im yehe leshetzaa shalmaa ad ma aturaa yishbinnach:
Vayyissa meshalo vayyomar oy mi yichye missumo el
Unetal matleh vaamar vay lechayyavayya deyechon kad yaabbed elaha yat illen:
Vetzim miyyad kittim veinnu ashshur veinnu-ever vegam-hu ade oved
Vesian yitztarchan meromae viannun leatur veyishtabedun leevar perat veaf innun lealma yevdun:
Vayyakom bilam vayyelech vayyashov limkomo vegam-balak halach ledarko
Vekam bilam vaazal vetav leatreh veaf balak azal leorcheh:
Vayyeshev yisrael bashshittim vayyachel haam liznot el-benot moav
Vitev yisrael beshittin veshare amma lemite batar benat moav:
Vattikrena laam lezivche elohehen vayyochal haam vayyishtachavu lelohehen
Ukera leamma ledivche taavathon vaachal amma usegidu letaavathon:
Vayyitztzamed yisrael levaal peor vayyichar-af Adonai beyisrael
Veitchabbar yisrael levaala feor utekef rogza daAdonai beyisrael:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe kach et-kol-rashe haam vehoka otam la-Adonai neged hashshamesh veyashov charon af-Adonai miyyisrael
Vaamar Adonai lemshe devar yat kol reshe amma vedun uketol dechayyav ketol kodam Adonai lokovel shimsha vituv tekof rugeza daAdonai miyyisrael:
Vayyomer moshe el-shofte yisrael hirgu ish anashav hannitzmadim levaal peor
Vaamar mshe ledayyane yisrael ketulu gevar gavrohi deitchabbaru levaala feor:
Vehinne ish mibbene yisrael ba vayyakrev el-echav et-hammidyanit leene moshe uleene kol-adat bene-yisrael vehemma vochim petach ohel moed
Veha gavra mibbene yisrael ata vekarev levat achohi yat midyaneta leene mshe uleene kol kenishta divne yisrael veinnun bachan bitra mashkan zimna:
Vayyar pinchas ben-elazar ben-aharon hakkohen vayyakom mittoch haeda vayyikkach romach beyado
Vachaza pinchas bar elazar bar aharon kahana vekam miggo chenishta unesev ramcha bideh:
Vayyavo achar ish-yisrael el-hakkubba vayyidkor et-shenehem et ish yisrael veet-haishsha el-kovatah vatteatzar hammaggefa meal bene yisrael
Veal batar gavra var yisrael lekuvata uveza yat tarvehon yat gavra var yisrael veyat itteta limaha veitkeli motana meal bene yisrael:
Vayyihyu hammetim bammaggefa arbaa veesrim alef
Vahavo demitu vemotana asrin vearbea alfin:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Pinchas ben-elazar ben-aharon hakkohen heshiv et-chamati meal bene-yisrael bekano et-kinati betocham velo-chilliti et-bene-yisrael bekinati
Pinchas bar elazar bar aharon kahana atev yat chemti meal bene yisrael bidkanne yat kinati benehon vela shetzeti yat bene yisrael bekinati:
Lachen emor hinni noten lo et-beriti shalom
Bechen emar ha ana gezar leh yat keyami shelam:

Umit nadav vaavihu bekarovehon eshshata nuchereta kodam Adonai:

Illen minyane mshe veelazar kahana di meno yat bene yisrael bemeshrayya demoav al yardena direcho:

Bar mealat tzafra dehi alat tedira tabedun yat illen:
Kaelle taasu layyom shivat yamim lechem ishshe reach-nichoach la-Adonai al-olat hattamid yease venisko
Kaillen tabedun leyoma shava yomin lechem kureban demitkabbel beraava kodam Adonai al alata tedira yitaved veniskeh:
Uvayyom hashshevii mikra-kodesh yihye lachem kol-melechet avoda lo taasu
Uveyoma sheviaa meara kaddish yehe lechon kol ividat pulechan la tabedun:

Uveyoma devikkurayya bekarovechon minchata chadatta kodam Adonai beatzratechon meara kaddish yehe lechon kol ividat pulechan la tabedun:
Vehikravtem ola lereach nichoach la-Adonai parim bene-vakar shenayim ayil echad shiva chevasim bene shana
Utekarvun alata leitkabbala veraava kodam Adonai torin bene tore teren udechar chad shava immerin bene shena:
Uminchatam solet belula vashshamen shelosha esronim lappar haechad shene esronim laayil haechad
Uminchathon sulta defila vimshach telata isronin letora chad teren isronin ledichra chad:
Issaron issaron lakkeves haechad leshivat hakkevasim
Isrona ishrona leimmera chad leshava immerin:
Seir izzim echad lechapper alechem
Tzefir bar izzin chad lechappara alechon:

Bar mealat tedira uminchateh tabedun shalmin yehon lechon veniskehon:

Minchathon veniskehon letora ledichra uleimmerin beminyanehon kidchaze:
Useir chattat echad millevad olat hattamid uminchatah veniskah
Utzefira dechattata chad bar mealat tedira uminchata veniska:
Elle taasu la-Adonai bemoadechem levad minnidrechem venidvotechem leolotechem uleminchotechem uleniskechem uleshalmechem
Illen taabbedun kodam Adonai bemoadechon bar minnidrechon venidvatchon laalavatchon uleminchatchon uleniskechon ulenichsat kudeshechon:
Vayyomer moshe el-bene yisrael kechol asher-tzivva Adonai et-moshe
Vaamar mshe livne yisrael kechol di fakkid Adonai yat mshe:
Vaydabber moshe el-rashe hammattot livne yisrael lemor ze haddavar asher tzivva Adonai
Umallil mshe im reshe shivtayya livne yisrael lememar den pitgama di pakkid Adonai:
Ish ki-yiddor neder la-Adonai o-hishshava shevua lesor issar al-nafsho lo yachel devaro kechol-hayyotze mippiv yaase
Gevar are yiddar nedar kodam Adonai o yekayyem keyam lemesar esar al nafsheh la yevattal pitgameh kechal deyippok mippumeh yaabbed:
Veishsha ki-tiddor neder la-Adonai veasra issar bevet aviha binureha
Veitteta are tiddar nedar kodam Adonai vetesar esar bevet avuha beravyutaha:
Veshama aviha et-nidrah veesarah asher asra al-nafshah vehecherish lah aviha vekamu kol-nedareha vechol-issar asher-asra al-nafshah yakum
Veyishma avuha yat nidrah veesarah di asarat al nafsha veyishtok lah avuha vikumun kol nidraha vechol esare di asarat al nafsha yekumun:
Veim-heni aviha otah beyom shomo kol-nedareha veesareha asher-asra al-nafshah lo yakum va-Adonai yislach-lah ki-heni aviha otah
Veim adi avuha yata beyoma dishma kol nidraha veesaraha di asarat al nafsha la yekumun umin kodam Adonai yishtevek lah are adi avuha yata:
Veim-hayo tihye leish unedareha aleha o mivta sefateha asher asra al-nafshah
Veim meheva teheve ligvar venidraha ala o perush sifvataha di asarat al nafshah:
Veshama ishah beyom shomo vehecherish lah vekamu nedareha veesareha asher-asra al-nafshah yakumu
Veyishma baala beyoma dishma veyishtok la vikumun nidraha veesaraha di asarat al nafsha yekumun:
Veim beyom shemoa ishah yani otah vehefer et-nidrah asher aleha veet mivta sefateha asher asra al-nafshah va-Adonai yislach-lah
Veim beyoma dishma baala adi yata uvattal yat nidraha di ala veyat perush sifvataha di asarat al nafsha umin kodam Adonai yishtevek la:
Veneder almana ugerusha kol asher-asra al-nafshah yakum aleha
Unedar armela umetarcha kol di asarat al nafsha yekum ala:
Veim-bet ishah nadara o-asra issar al-nafshah bishvua
Veim bet baala nedarat o asarat esar al nafsha bekiyyum:
Veshama ishah vehecherish lah lo heni otah vekamu kol-nedareha vechol-issar asher-asra al-nafshah yakum
Veyishma baala veyishtok la la adi yathon vikumun kol nidraha vechol esare di asarat al nafsha yekumun:
Veim-hafer yafer otam ishah beyom shomo kol-motza sefateha lindareha uleissar nafshah lo yakum ishah haferam va-Adonai yislach-lah
Veim battala yevattel yathon bala beyoma di shema kol appakut sifvataha lenidraha uleesar nafsha la yekumun baala battelinnun umin kodam Adonai yishtevek la:
Kol-neder vechol-shevuat issar leannot nafesh ishah yekimennu veishah yeferennu
Kol nedar vechol kiyyumat esar lesaggafa nefash baala yekayyeminnun uvaala yevattelinnun:
Veim-hacharesh yacharish lah ishah miyyom el-yom vehekim et-kol-nedareha o et-kol-esareha asher aleha hekim otam ki-hecherish lah beyom shomo
Veim mishtak yishtok la baala miyyom leyom vikayyem yat kol nidraha o yat kol esaraha di ala kayyam yathon are shatek la beyoma dishma:
Veim-hafer yafer otam achare shomo venasa et-avonah
Veim battala yevattel yathon batar dishma vikabbal yat chova:
Elle hachukkim asher tzivva Adonai et-moshe ben ish leishto ben-av levitto binureha bet aviha
Illen keyamayya di fakkid Adonai yat mshe ben gevar leitteteh ben abba livratteh beravyutaha bet avuha:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Nekom nikmat bene yisrael meet hammidyanim achar teasef el-ammecha
Itpera puranut bene yisrael min midyanae batar ken titkenesh leammaych:
Vaydabber moshe el-haam lemor hechaltzu meittechem anashim latztzava veyihyu al-midyan latet nikmat-Adonai bemidyan
Umallil mshe im amma lememar zerizu minnechon guvrin lechela vihon al midyan lemehav puranut din amma daAdonai bemidyan:
Elef lammatte elef lammatte lechol mattot yisrael tishlechu latztzava
Alfa leshivta alfa leshivta lechol shivtayya deyisrael teshallechun lechela:
Vayyimmasru mealfe yisrael elef lammatte shenem-asar elef chalutze tzava
Veitbecharu mealfayya deyisrael alfa leshivta tere asar alfin mezarze chela:
Vayyishlach otam moshe elef lammatte latztzava otam veet-pinchas ben-elazar hakkohen latztzava uchele hakkodesh vachatzotzrot hatterua beyado
Ushelach yathon mshe alfa leshivta lechela yathon veyat pinchas bar elazar kahana lechela umane dekudesha vachatzatzrat yabbevta bideh:
Vayyitzbeu al-midyan kaasher tzivva Adonai et-moshe vayyahargu kol-zachar
Veitchayyalu al midyan kema di pakkid Adonai yat mshe uketalu kol dechura:
Veet-malche midyan hargu al-challehem et-evi veet-rekem veet-tzur veet-chur veet-reva chameshet malche midyan veet bilam ben-beor hargu becharev
Veyat malche midyan ketalu al ketilehon yat evi veyat rekem veyat tzur veyat chur veyat reva chamsha malche midyan veyat bilam bar beor ketalu vecharba:
Vayyishbu vene-yisrael et-neshe midyan veet-tappam veet kol-behemtam veet-kol-miknehem veet-kol-chelam bazazu
Ushevo vene yisrael yat neshe midyan veyat taflehon veyat kol beirhon veyat kol getehon veyat kol nichsehon bezo:
Veet kol-arehem bemoshvotam veet kol-tirotam sarfu baesh
Veyat kol kirvehon bemotvanehon veyat kol bet sigdathon okidu benura:
Vayyikchu et-kol-hashshalal veet kol-hammalkoach baadam uvabbehema
Ushevo yat kol adaa veyat kol devarta beenasha uvivira:
Vayyaviu el-moshe veel-elazar hakkohen veel-adat bene-yisrael et-hashshevi veet-hammalkoach veet-hashshalal el-hammachane el-arvot moav asher al-yarden yerecho
Veaytiyyu levat mshe ulevat elazar kahana ulevat kenishta divne yisrael yat shivya veyat devarta veyat adaa lemashrita lemeshrayya demoav di al yardena direcho:
Vayyetzu moshe veelazar hakkohen vechol-nesie haeda likratam el-michutz lammachane
Unefaku mshe veelazar kahana vechol ravreve chenishta lokodamutehon lemibbara lemashrita:
Vayyiktzof moshe al pekude hechayil sare haalafim vesare hammeot habbaim mitztzeva hammilchama
Uregez mshe al dimmannan al chela rabbane alfin verabbane maavata daato mechel kerava:
Vayyomer alehem moshe hachiyyitem kol-nekeva
Vaamar lehon mshe hakayyemtun kol nukeba:
Hen henna hayu livne yisrael bidvar bilam limsor-maal ba-Adonai al-devar-peor vattehi hammaggefa baadat Adonai
Ha innun havaa livne yisrael baatzat bilam leshakkara shekar kodam Adonai al esak peor vahavat motana bichnishta daAdonai:
Veatta hirgu chol-zachar battaf vechol-ishsha yodaat ish lemishkav zachar harogu
Uchean ketulu chol dechura betafla vechol itteta didaat gevar lemishkeve dechura ketulu:
Vechol hattaf bannashim asher lo-yadu mishkav zachar hachayu lachem
Vechol tafla vinshayya di la yedaa mishkeve dechura kayyeymu lechon:

Veattun shero mibbara lemashrita shava yomin kol di ketal nafsha vechol di kerav bekatila taddun alohi beyoma telitaa uveyoma sheviaa attun ushevichon:
Vechol-beged vechol-keli-or vechol-maase izzim vechol-keli-etz titchattau
Vechol levush vechol man dimshach vechol ovad meazze vechol man dea taddun alohi:
Vayyomer elazar hakkohen el-anshe hatztzava habbaim lammilchama zot chukkat hattora asher-tzivva Adonai et-moshe
Vaamar elazar kahana legavre chela daato likrava da gezerat orayta di fakkid Adonai yat mshe:
Ach et-hazzahav veet-hakkasef et-hannechoshet et-habbarzel et-habbedil veet-haofaret
Beram yat dahava veyat kaspa yat nechasha yat parzela yat avatza veyat avara:
Kol-davar asher-yavo vaesh taaviru vaesh vetaher ach beme nidda yitchatta vechol asher lo-yavo baesh taaviru vammayim
Kol middaam demittaal benura taavrunneh benura veyidke beram beme addayuta yittadde vechol di la mittaal benura taavrunneh bemayya:
Vechibbastem bigdechem bayyom hashshevii utehartem veachar tavou el-hammachane
Utechavverun levushechon beyoma sheviaa vetidkun uvatar ken tealun lemashrita:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe lemor
Vaamar Adonai lemshe lememar:
Sa et rosh malkoach hashshevi baadam uvabbehema atta veelazar hakkohen verashe avot haeda
Kabbel yat chusheban davrat shavya beenasha uvivira at veelazar kahana vereshe avahat kenishta:
Vechatzita et-hammalkoach ben tofse hammilchama hayyotzim latztzava uven kol-haeda
Utefalleg yat devarta ben gavre megiche kerava dinfaku lechela uven kol kenishta:

Vetafresh nesiva kodam Adonai min gavre megiche kerava dinfaku lechela chad nafsha mechamesh mea min enasha umin tore umin chamare umin ana:
Mimmachatzitam tikkachu venatatta leelazar hakkohen terumat Adonai
Mippalgutehon tissevun vetitten leelazar kahana afrashuta kodam Adonai:

Vaavad mshe veelazar kahana kema di pakkid Adonai yat mshe:

Vahava devarta shear bizza di vezo amma di nefaku lechela ana shit mea veshavin vechamsha alfin:

Vetore shavin uteren alfin:
Vachamorim echad veshishshim alef
Vachamare shittin vechad alfin:
Venefesh adam min-hannashim asher lo-yadu mishkav zachar kol-nefesh shenayim usheloshim alef
Venafsha deenasha min neshayya di la yedaa mishkeve dechura kol nafshata telatin uteren alfin:
Vattehi hammechetza chelek hayyotzim batztzava mispar hatztzon shelosh-meot elef usheloshim elef veshivat alafim vachamesh meot
Vahavat palguta chulak guvrayya di nefaku lechela minyan ana telat mea utelatin usheva alfin vachamesh mea:
Vayhi hammeches la-Adonai min-hatztzon shesh meot chamesh veshivim
Vahava nesiva kodam Adonai min ana shit mea shavin vechamesh:
