Vehabbakar shishsha usheloshim alef umichsam la-Adonai shenayim veshivim
Vetore telatin veshitta alfin unesivhon kodam Adonai shavin uteren:
Vachamorim sheloshim elef vachamesh meot umichsam la-Adonai echad veshishshim
Vachamare telatin alfin vachamesh mea unesivhon kodam Adonai shittin vechad:
Venefesh adam shishsha asar alef umichsam la-Adonai shenayim usheloshim nafesh
Venafsha deenasha shitta asar alfin unesivhon kodam Adonai telatin uteren nafshin:
Vayyitten moshe et-meches terumat Adonai leelazar hakkohen kaasher tzivva Adonai et-moshe
Vihav mshe yat nesiv afrashuta kodam Adonai leelazar kahana kema di pakkid Adonai yat mshe:
Umimmachatzit bene yisrael asher chatza moshe min-haanashim hatztzovim
Umippalgut bene yisrael di pelag mshe min gavrayya di nefaku lechela:
Vattehi mechetzat haeda min-hatztzon shelosh-meot elef usheloshim elef shivat alafim vachamesh meot
Vahavat palgut kenishta min ana telat mea utelatin veshava alfin vachamesh mea:
Uvakar shishsha usheloshim alef
Vetore telatin veshitta alfin:
Vachamorim sheloshim elef vachamesh meot
Vachamare telatin alfin vachamesh mea:
Venefesh adam shishsha asar alef
Venafsha deenasha shitta asar alfin:
Vayyikkach moshe mimmachatzit bene-yisrael et-haachuz echad min-hachamishshim min-haadam umin-habbehema vayyitten otam lalviyyim shomre mishmeret mishkan Adonai kaasher tzivva Adonai et-moshe
Unesiv mshe mippalgut bene yisrael yat deittachad chad min chamshin min enasha umin beira vihav yathon lelevae natre matterat mashkena daAdonai kema di pakkid Adonai yat mshe:
Vayyikrevu el-moshe happekudim asher lealfe hatztzava sare haalafim vesare hammeot
Vekarivu levat mshe di memannan al alfe chela rabbane alfin verabbane maavata:
Vayyomru el-moshe avadecha nasu et-rosh anshe hammilchama asher beyadenu velo-nifkad mimmennu ish
Vaamaru lemshe avdaych kabbilu yat chushban gavre megiche kerava di immana vela shega minnana enash:
Vannakrev et-korban Adonai ish asher matza cheli-zahav etzada vetzamid tabbaat agil vechumaz lechapper al-nafshotenu lifne Adonai
Vekarevna yat kurebana daAdonai gevar deashkach man didhav shirin veshibbechin izkan kaddashin umachoch lechappara al nafshatana kodam Adonai:
Vayyikkach moshe veelazar hakkohen et-hazzahav meittam kol keli maase
Unesiv mshe veelazar kahana yat dahava minnehon kol man deovada:
Vayhi kol-zehav hatteruma asher herimu la-Adonai shishsha asar elef sheva-meot vachamishshim shakel meet sare haalafim umeet sare hammeot
Vahava kol dehav afrashuta di afrishu kodam Adonai shitta asar alfin sheva mea vechamshin silin min rabbane alfin umin rabbane maavata:
Anshe hatztzava bazezu ish lo
Gavre dechela bazu gevar lenafsheh:
Vayyikkach moshe veelazar hakkohen et-hazzahav meet sare haalafim vehammeot vayyaviu oto el-ohel moed zikkaron livne-yisrael lifne Adonai
Unesiv mshe veelazar kahana yat dahava min rabbane alfin umaavata veaytiu yateh lemashkan zimna dachrana livne yisrael kodam Adonai:
Umikne rav haya livne reuven velivne-gad atzum meod vayyiru et-eretz yazer veet-eretz gilad vehinne hammakom mekom mikne
Uveir saggi hava livne reuven velivne gad takkif lachada vachazo yat ara yazer veyat ara gilad veha atra atar keshar levet beir:
Vayyavou vene-gad uvene reuven vayyomru el-moshe veel-elazar hakkohen veel-nesie haeda lemor
Vaato vene gad uvene reuven vaamaru lemshe uleelazar kahana uleravreve kenishta lememar:
Atarot vedivon veyazer venimra vecheshbon veelale usevam unevo uveon
Machlelta umalbeshta vechumerin uvet nimrin uvet chushebana uvaale devava vechima vesiat bet kevurta demshe uveon:
Haaretz asher hikka Adonai lifne adat yisrael eretz mikne hiv velaavadecha mikne
Ara di mecha Adonai yat yatvaha kodam kenishta deyisrael ara kashra levet beir hi uleavdaych it beir:
Vayyomru im-matzanu chen beenecha yuttan et-haaretz hazzot laavadecha laachuzza al-taavirenu et-hayyarden
Vaamaru im ashchachna rachamin beenaych tityehiv yat ara hada leavdaych leachasana la teavrinnana yat yardena:
Vayyomer moshe livne-gad velivne reuven haachechem yavou lammilchama veattem teshvu fo
Vaamar mshe livne gad velivne reuven haachechon yealun likrava veattun tetvun hacha:
Velamma teniun et-lev bene yisrael meavor el-haaretz asher-natan lahem Adonai
Ulema tonun yat libba divne yisrael millemebar leara dihav lehon Adonai:
Ko asu avotechem besholchi otam mikkadesh barnea lirot et-haaretz
Keden avadu avahatchon kad shelachit yathon merkam gea lemecheze yat ara:
Vayyaalu ad-nachal eshkol vayyiru et-haaretz vayyaniu et-lev bene yisrael levilti-vo el-haaretz asher-natan lahem Adonai
Useliku ad nachla deitkala vachazo yat ara veoniu yat libba divne yisrael bedil dela lemeal leara dihav lehon Adonai:
Vayyichar-af Adonai bayyom hahu vayyishshava lemor
Utekef rugeza daAdonai beyoma hahu vekayyem lememar:
Im-yiru haanashim haolim mimmitzrayim mibben esrim shana vamala et haadama asher nishbati leavraham leyitzchak uleyaakov ki lo-milu acharay
Im yechezun guvrayya disliku mimmitzrayim mibbar asrin shenin uleella yat ara di kayyemit leavraham leyitzchak uleyaakov are la ashlimu batar dachalti:
Bilti kalev ben-yefunne hakkenizzi vihoshua bin-nun ki milu achare Adonai
Elahen kalev bar yefunne kenizzaa vihoshua bar nun are ashlimu batar dachalta daAdonai:
Vayyichar-af Adonai beyisrael vayniem bammidbar arbaim shana ad-tom kol-haddor haose hara beene Adonai
Utekef rugeza daAdonai beyisrael vetardinnun bemadbera arbein shenin ad desaf kol dara daavid devish kodam Adonai:
Vehinne kamtem tachat avotechem tarbut anashim chattaim lispot od al charon af-Adonai el-yisrael
Veha kamtun chalaf avahatchon talmide guvrayya chayyavaya leosafa od al tekof rugeza daAdonai leyisrael:
Ki teshuvun meacharav veyasaf od lehannicho bammidbar veshichattem lechol-haam hazze
Are tetuvun mibbatar dachalteh veyosef od leacharutehon bemadbera utechabbelun lechol amma haden:
Vayyiggeshu elav vayyomru gidrot tzon nivne lemiknenu po vearim letappenu
Vekarivu levateh vaamaru chatrin dean nivne livirana hacha vekirvin letaflana:
Vaanachnu nechaletz chushim lifne bene yisrael ad asher im-havionum el-mekomam veyashav tappenu beare hammivtzar mippene yoshve haaretz
Vaanachna nizdarez mavin kodam bene yisrael ad di neelinnun leatrehon veyetvun taflana bekirvin kerichin min kodam yatve ara:
Lo nashuv el-battenu ad hitnachel bene yisrael ish nachalato
La netuv levetana ad deyachsenun bene yisrael gevar achasanteh:
Ki lo ninchal ittam meever layyarden vahala ki vaa nachalatenu elenu meever hayyarden mizracha
Are la nachsin immehon meivra leyardena ulehala are kabbelna achasantana lana meivra leyardena maddincha:
Vayyomer alehem moshe im-taasun et-haddavar hazze im-techaltzu lifne Adonai lammilchama
Vaamar lehon mshe im tabedun yat pitgama haden im tizdarzun kodam amma daAdonai likrava:
Veavar lachem kol-chalutz et-hayyarden lifne Adonai ad horisho et-oyvav mippanav
Veyaabber lechon kol dimzarez yat yardena kodam amma daAdonai ad ditarech yat baale devavohi min kodamohi:
Venichbesha haaretz lifne Adonai veachar tashuvu vihyitem nekiyyim mey-Adonai umiyyisrael vehayta haaretz hazzot lachem laachuzza lifne Adonai
Vetitkevesh ara kodam amma daAdonai uvatar ken tetuvun utehon zakkain min kodam Adonai umiyyisrael utehe ara hada lechon leachasana kodam Adonai:
Veim-lo taasun ken hinne chatatem la-Adonai udeu chattatchem asher timtza etchem
Veim la taabbedun ken ha chavtun kodam Adonai vetidun chovatchon di tashkach yatchon:
Benu-lachem arim letappechem ugederot letzonaachem vehayyotze mippichem taasu
Benu lechon kirvin letaflechon vechatrin leanchon udeyippok mippumechon taabbedun:
Vayyomer bene-gad uvene reuven el-moshe lemor avadecha yaasu kaasher adoni metzavve
Vaamaru vene gad uvene reuven lemshe lememar avdaych yabedun kema di ribboni mefakked:
Tappenu nashenu miknenu vechol-behemtenu yihyu-sham beare haggilad
Taflana neshana getana vechol beirana yehon tamman bekirve gilad:
Vaavadecha yaavru kol-chalutz tzava lifne Adonai lammilchama kaasher adoni dover
Veavdaych yaberun kol dimzarez chela kodam amma daAdonai likrava kema di ribboni memallel:
Vaytzav lahem moshe et elazar hakkohen veet yehoshua bin-nun veet-rashe avot hammattot livne yisrael
Ufakkid lehon mshe yat elazar kahana veyat yehoshua bar nun veyat reshe avahat shivtayya livne yisrael:
Vayyomer moshe alehem im-yaavru vene-gad uvene-reuven ittechem et-hayyarden kol-chalutz lammilchama lifne Adonai venichbesha haaretz lifnechem unetattem lahem et-eretz haggilad laachuzza
Vaamar mshe lehon im yaberun bene gad uvene reuven immechon yat yardena kol dimzaraz likrava kodam amma daAdonai vetitkevesh ara kodamechon vetittenun lehon yat ara degilad leachasana:
Veim-lo yaavru chalutzim ittechem venochazu vetochechem beeretz kenaan
Veim la yaberun mezarzin immechon veyachsenun benechon beara dichnaan:
Vayyaanu vene-gad uvene reuven lemor et asher dibber Adonai el-avadecha ken naase
Vaativu vene gad uvene reuven lememar yat di mallil Adonai leavdaych ken nabed:
Nachnu naavor chalutzim lifne Adonai eretz kenaan veittanu achuzzat nachalatenu meever layyarden
Nachna neivar mezarzin kodam amma daAdonai leara dichnaan veimmana achudat achasantana meivra leyardena:
Vayyitten lahem moshe livne-gad velivne reuven velachatzi shevet menashshe ven-yosef et-mamlechet sichon melech haemori veet-mamlechet og melech habbashan haaretz leareha bigvulot are haaretz saviv
Vihav lehon mshe livne gad velivne reuven ulefalgut shivta dimnashshe var yosef yat malkevat sichon malka deemoraa veyat malkevat og malka dematnan ara lekirvaha bitchumin kirve ara sechor sechor:
Vayyivnu vene-gad et-divon veet-atarot veet aroer
Uveno vene gad yat divon veyat atarot veyat aroer:
Veet-atrot shofan veet-yazer veyogbeha
Veyat atrot shofan veyat yazer veramata:
Veet-bet nimra veet-bet haran are mivtzar vegidrot tzon
Veyat bet nimra veyat bet haran kirvin kerichan vechatrin dean:
Uvene reuven banu et-cheshbon veet-elale veet kiryatayim
Uvene reuven beno yat cheshbbon veyat elale veyat kiryatayim:
Veet-nevo veet-baal meon musabbot shem veet-sivma vayyikreu veshemot et-shemot hearim asher banu
Veyat nevo veyat baal meon makkefan shemahan veyat sivma ukero vishmahan yat shemahat kirvayya di veno:
Vayyelchu bene machir ben-menashshe gilada vayyilkeduha vayyoresh et-haemori asher-bah
Vaazalu bene machir bar menashshe legilad vechivshuha vetarich yat emoraa di va:
Vayyitten moshe et-haggilad lemachir ben-menashshe vayyeshev bah
Vihav mshe yat gilad lemachir bar menashshe vitev ba:
Veyair ben-menashshe halach vayyilkod et-chavvotehem vayyikra ethen chavvot yair
Veyair bar menashshe azal uchevash yat kafranehon ukera yathen kafrane yair:
Venovach halach vayyilkod et-kenat veet-benoteha vayyikra la novach bishmo
Venovach azal uchevash yat kenat veyat kafranaha ukera la novach bishmeh:
Elle mase vene-yisrael asher yatzu meeretz mitzrayim letzivotam beyad-moshe veaharon
Illen mattelane vene yisrael di nefaku meara demitzrayim lechelehon bida demshe veaharon:
Vayyichtov moshe et-motzaehem lemasehem al-pi Adonai veelle masehem lemotzaehem
Uchetav mshe yat mappekanehon lemattelanehon al memra daAdonai veillen mattelanehon lemappekanehon:
Vayyisu merameses bachodesh harishon bachamishsha asar yom lachodesh harishon mimmochorat happesach yatzu vene-yisrael beyad rama leene kol-mitzrayim
Unetalu merameses beyarcha kadmaa bechamsha asra yoma leyarcha kadmaa mibbatar yoma depischa nefaku vene yisrael beresh gele leene kol mitzrae:
Umitzrayim mekabberim et asher hikka Adonai bahem kol-bechor uvelohehem asa Adonai shefatim
Umitzrae mekabberin yat di ketal Adonai behon kol buchera uvetaavathon avad Adonai dinin:
Vayyisu vene-yisrael merameses vayyachanu besukkot
Unetalu vene yisrael merameses ushero besukkot:
Vayyisu missukkot vayyachanu veetam asher biktze hammidbar
Unetalu missukkot ushero veetam di bistar madbera:
Vayyisu meetam vayyashov al-pi hachirot asher al-pene baal tzefon vayyachanu lifne migdol
Unetalu meetam vetav al pum chirata di kodam beel tzefon ushero kodam migdol:
Vayyisu mippene hachirot vayyaavru vetoch-hayyam hammidbara vayyelchu derech sheloshet yamim bemidbar etam vayyachanu bemara
Unetalu min pum chirata vaavaru bego yamma lemadbera vaazalu mahalach telata yomin bemadbera deetam ushero bemara:
Vayyisu mimmara vayyavou elima uveelim shetem esre enot mayim veshivim temarim vayyachanu-sham
Unetalu mimmara vaato leelim uveelim tere asar mabbuin demayyin veshavin diklin ushero tamman:
Vayyisu meelim vayyachanu al-yam-suf
Unetalu meelim ushero al yamma desuf:
Vayyisu miyyam-suf vayyachanu bemidbar-sin
Unetalu miyyamma desuf ushero bemadbera desin:
Vayyisu mimmidbar-sin vayyachanu bedofka
Unetalu mimmadbera desin ushero bedafka:
Vayyisu middofka vayyachanu bealush
Unetalu middafka ushero bealush:
Vayyisu mealush vayyachanu birfidim velo-haya sham mayim laam lishtot
Unetalu mealush ushero birfidim vela hava tamman mayya leamma lemishte:
Vayyisu merfidim vayyachanu bemidbar sinay
Unetalu merfidim ushero bemadbera desinay:
Vayyisu mimmidbar sinay vayyachanu bekivrot hattaava
Unetalu mimmadbera desinay ushero bekivre dimshaale:
Vayyisu mikkivrot hattaava vayyachanu bachatzerot
Unetalu mikkivre dimshaale ushero bachatzerot:
Vayyisu mechatzerot vayyachanu beritma
Unetalu mechatzerot ushero beritma:
Vayyisu meritma vayyachanu berimmon paretz
Unetalu meritma ushero berimmon paretz:
Vayyisu merimmon paretz vayyachanu belivna
Unetalu merimmon paretz ushero belivna:
Vayyisu millivna vayyachanu berissa
Unetalu millivna ushero berissa:
Vayyisu merissa vayyachanu bikhelata
Unetalu merissa ushero bikhelata:
Vayyisu mikkehelata vayyachanu behar-shafer
Unetalu mikhelata ushero betura deshafer:
Vayyisu mehar-shafer vayyachanu bacharada
Unetalu mittura deshafer ushero bacharada:
Vayyisu mecharada vayyachanu bemakhelot
Unetalu mecharada ushero bemakhelot:
Vayyisu mimmakhelot vayyachanu betachat
Unetalu mimmakhelot ushero betachat:
Vayyisu mittachat vayyachanu betarach
Unetalu mittachat ushero betarach:
Vayyisu mittarach vayyachanu bemitka
Unetalu mittarach ushero bemitka:
Vayyisu mimmitka vayyachanu bechashmona
Unetalu mimmitka ushero bechashmona:
Vayyisu mechashmona vayyachanu bemoserot
Unetalu mechashmona ushero bemoserot:
Vayyisu mimmoserot vayyachanu bivne yaakan
Unetalu mimmoserot ushero bivne yaakan:
Vayyisu mibbene yaakan vayyachanu bechor haggidgad
Unetalu mibbene yaakan ushero bechor haggidgad:
Vayyisu mechor haggidgad vayyachanu beyotvata
Unetalu mechor haggidgad ushero beyatvata:
Vayyisu miyyotvata vayyachanu beavrona
Unetalu miyyatvata ushero beavrona:
Vayyisu meavrona vayyachanu beetzyon gaver
Unetalu meavrona ushero beetzyon gaver:
Vayyisu meetzyon gaver vayyachanu vemidbar-tzin hiv kadesh
Unetalu meetzyon gaver ushero bemadbera detzin hi rekam:
Vayyisu mikkadesh vayyachanu behor hahar biktze eretz edom
Unetalu merkam ushero behor tura bisyafe ara deedom:
Vayyaal aharon hakkohen el-hor hahar al-pi Adonai vayyamot sham bishnat haarbaim letzet bene-yisrael meeretz mitzrayim bachodesh hachamishi beechad lachodesh
Uselek aharon kahana lehor tura al memra daAdonai umit tamman bishnat arbein lemeppak bene yisrael meara demitzrayim beyarcha chamishshaa bechad leyarcha:
Veaharon ben-shalosh veesrim umeat shana bemoto behor hahar
Veaharon bar mea veasrin utelat shenin kad mit behor tura:
Vayyishma hakkenaani melech arad vehu-yoshev bannegev beeretz kenaan bevo bene yisrael
Ushema kenaanaa malka daarad vehu yatev bidroma beara dichnaan bemete bene yisrael:
Vayyisu mehor hahar vayyachanu betzalmona
Unetalu mehor tura ushero betzalmona:
Vayyisu mitztzalmona vayyachanu befunon
Unetalu mitztzalmona ushero befunon:
Vayyisu mippunon vayyachanu beovot
Unetalu mippunon ushero beovot:
Vayyisu meovot vayyachanu beiyye haavarim bigvul moav
Unetalu meovot ushero bimgizzat avarae bitchum moav:
Vayyisu meiyyim vayyachanu bedivon gad
Unetalu mimmegizzata ushero bedivon gad:
Vayyisu middivon gad vayyachanu bealmon divlatayma
Unetalu middivon gad ushero bealmon divlatayma:
Vayyisu mealmon divlatayma vayyachanu behare haavarim lifne nevo
Unetalu mealmon divlatayma ushero beture daavarae dikodam nevo:
Vayyisu mehare haavarim vayyachanu bearvot moav al yarden yerecho
Unetalu mitture daavarae ushero bemeshrayya demoav al yardena direcho:
Vayyachanu al-hayyarden mibbet hayeshimot ad avel hashshittim bearvot moav
Ushero al yardena mibbet yeshimot ad meshar shittin bemeshrayya demoav:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe bearvot moav al-yarden yerecho lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe bemeshrayya demoav al yardena direcho lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael veamarta alehem ki attem ovrim et-hayyarden el-eretz kenaan
Mallel im bene yisrael vetemar lehon are attun avrin yat yardena leara dichnaan:
Vehorashtem et-kol-yoshve haaretz mippenechem veibbadtem et kol-maskiyyotam veet kol-tzalme massechotam teabbedu veet kol-bamotam tashmidu
Utetarchun yat kol yatve ara min kodamechon vetevdun yat kol bet sigdathon veyat kol tzalme mattechathon tevdun veyat kol bamathon teshetzun:
Vehorashtem et-haaretz vishavtem-bah ki lachem natatti et-haaretz lareshet otah
Utetarchun yat yatve ara vetetvun ba are lechon yehavit yat ara lemerat yatah:
Vehitnachaltem et-haaretz begoral lemishpechotechem larav tarbu et-nachalato velamat tamit et-nachalato el asher-yetze lo shamma haggoral lo yihye lemattot avotechem titnechalu
Vetachsenun yat ara veadva lezarayatchon lesaggie tasgun yat achasantehon velizire tazirun yat achasantehon lidyippok leh tamman adva di leh yehe leshivte avahatchon tachsenun:
Veim-lo torishu et-yoshve haaretz mippenechem vehaya asher totiru mehem lesikkim beenechem velitzninim betziddechem vetzareru etchem al-haaretz asher attem yoshvim bah
Veim la tetarchun yat yatve ara min kodamechon vihe di tasharun minnehon lesian natlan zeyan lakivlechon ulemashshiryan makpanchon viikun lechon al ara di attun yatvin ba:
Vehaya kaasher dimmiti laasot lahem eese lachem
Vihe kema di chashavit lemebad lehon aabbed lechon:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Tzav et-bene yisrael veamarta alehem ki-attem baim el-haaretz kenaan zot haaretz asher tippol lachem benachala eretz kenaan ligvuloteha
Pakked yat bene yisrael vetemar lehon are attun alin leara dichnaan da ara di titpeleg lechon beachasana ara dichnaan litchumaha:
Vehaya lachem peat-negev mimmidbar-tzin al-yede edom vehaya lachem gevul negev miktze yam-hammelach kedma
Vihe lechon ruach daroma mimmadbera detzin al techume edom vihe lechon techum daroma misseyafe yamma demilcha kidduma:
Venasav lachem haggevul minnegev lemaale akrabbim veavar tzina vehayu totzotav minnegev lekadesh barnea veyatza chatzar-addar veavar atzmona
Veyaschar lechon techuma midderoma lemaskana deakrabbim viivar letzin vihon mappekanohi midderoma lirkam gea veyippok lachatzar addar viivar leatzmon:
Venasav haggevul meatzmon nachla mitzrayim vehayu totzotav hayyamma
Veyaschar techuma meatzmon lenachala demitzrayim vihon mappekanohi leyamma:
Ugevul yam vehaya lachem hayyam haggadol ugevul ze-yihye lachem gevul yam
Utechum maarva vihe lechon yamma rabba utechumeh den yehe lechon techum maarva:
Veze-yihye lachem gevul tzafon min-hayyam haggadol tetau lachem hor hahar
Veden yehe lechon techum tzippuna min yamma rabba techavvenun lechon lehor tura:
Mehor hahar tetau levo chamat vehayu totzot haggevul tzedada
Mehor tura techavvenun limte chamat vihon mappekanohi ditchuma litzdad:
Veyatza haggevul zifrona vehayu totzotav chatzar enan ze-yihye lachem gevul tzafon
Veyippok techuma lezifron vihon mappekanohi lachatzar enan den yehe lechon techum tzippuna:
Vehitavvitem lachem ligvul kedma mechatzar enan shefama
Utechavvenun lechon litchum kidduma mechatzar enan lishfam:
Veyarad haggevul mishshefam harivla mikkedem laayin veyarad haggevul umacha al-ketef yam-kinneret kedma
Veyechot techuma mishshefam lerivla mimmadnach laayin veyechot techuma veyimte al kef yam ginesar kidduma:
Veyarad haggevul hayyardena vehayu totzotav yam hammelach zot tihye lachem haaretz ligvuloteha saviv
Veyechot techuma leyardena vihon mappekanohi leyamma demilcha da tehe lechon ara litchumaha sechor sechor:
Vaytzav moshe et-bene yisrael lemor zot haaretz asher titnachalu otah begoral asher tzivva Adonai latet letishat hammattot vachatzi hammatte
Ufakkid mshe yat bene yisrael lememar da ara di titchasnun yata beadva di pakkid Adonai lemittan letishat shivtin ufalgut shivta:
Ki lakchu matte vene haruveni levet avotam umatte vene-haggadi levet avotam vachatzi matte menashshe lakchu nachalatam
Are kabbilu shivta divne reuven levet avahathon veshivta divne gad levet avahathon ufalgut shivta dimnashshe kabbilu achasantehon:
Shene hammattot vachatzi hammatte lakchu nachalatam meever leyarden yerecho kedma mizracha
Teren shivtin ufalgut shivta kabbilu achasantehon meivra leyardena direcho kidduma maddincha:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Elle shemot haanashim asher-yinchalu lachem et-haaretz elazar hakkohen vihoshua bin-nun
Illen shemahat guvrayya di yachsenun lechon yat ara elazar kahana vihoshua bar nun:
Venasi echad nasi echad mimmatte tikchu linchol et-haaretz
Verabba chad rabba chad mishshivta tissevun leachasana yat ara:
Veelle shemot haanashim lematte yehuda kalev ben-yefunne
Veillen shemahat guvrayya leshivta dihuda kalev bar yefunne:
Ulematte bene shimon shemuel ben-ammihud
Uleshivta divne shimon shemuel bar amihud:
Lematte vinyamin elidad ben-kislon
Leshivta devinyamin elidad bar kislon:
Ulematte vene-dan nasi bukki ben-yogli
Uleshivta divne dan rabba bukki bar yagli:
Livne yosef lematte vene-menashshe nasi channiel ben-efod
Livne yosef leshivta divne menashshe rabba channiel bar efod:
Ulematte vene-efrayim nasi kemuel ben-shiftan
Uleshivta divne efrayim rabba kemuel bar shiftan:
Ulematte vene-zevulun nasi elitzafan ben-parnach
Uleshivta divne zevulun rabba elitzafan bar parnach:
Ulematte vene-yissashchar nasi paltiel ben-azzan
Uleshivta divne yissashchar rabba paltiel bar azzan:
Ulematte vene-asher nasi achihud ben-shelomi
Uleshivta divne asher rabba achihud bar shelomi:
Ulematte vene-naftali nasi pedael ben-ammihud
Uleshivta divne naftali rabba pedael bar ammihud:
Elle asher tzivva Adonai lenachel et-bene-yisrael beeretz kenaan
Illen di pakkid Adonai leachasana yat bene yisrael beara dichnaan:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe bearvot moav al-yarden yerecho lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe bemeshrayya demoav al yardena direcho lememar:
Tzav et-bene yisrael venatnu lalviyyim minnachalat achuzzatam arim lashavet umigrash learim sevivotehem tittenu lalviyyim
Pakked yat bene yisrael veyittenun lelevae meachasanat achudathon kirvin lemittav verevach lekirvayya sacharanehon tittenun lelevae:
Vehayu hearim lahem lashavet umigreshehem yihyu livhemtam velirchusham ulechol chayyatam
Vihon kirvayya lehon lemittav veravchehon yehon livirhon ulekinyanehon ulechal chevathon:
Umigreshe hearim asher tittenu lalviyyim mikkir hair vachutza elef amma saviv
Urevache kirvayya di tittenun lelevae mikkotel karta ulevara alaf ammin sechor sechor:
Umaddotem michutz lair et-peat-kedma alpayim baamma veet-peat-negev alpayim baamma veet-peat-yam alpayim baamma veet peat tzafon alpayim baamma vehair battavech ze yihye lahem migreshe hearim

Vetimshechun mibbara lekarta yat ruach kidduma teren alfin beammin veyat ruach deroma teren alfin beammin veyat ruach maarva teren alfin beammin veyat ruach tzippuna teren alfin beammin vekarta vimtzia den yehe lehon revache kirvayya:
Veet hearim asher tittenu lalviyyim et shesh-are hammiklat asher tittenu lanus shamma harotzeach vaalehem tittenu arbaim ushetayim ir
Veyat kirvayya di tittenun lelevae yat shit kirve shezavuta di tittenun lemearak tamman katola vaalehon tittenun arbein vetarten kirvin:
Kol-hearim asher tittenu lalviyyim arbaim ushemone ir ethen veet-migreshehen
Kol kirvayya di tittenun lelevae arbein vetamne kirvin yathen veyat revachehen:
Vehearim asher tittenu meachuzzat bene-yisrael meet harav tarbu umeet hameat tamitu ish kefi nachalato asher yinchalu yitten mearav lalviyyim
Vekirvayya di tittenun meachudat bene yisrael min saggie tasgun umin zeire tazirun gevar kefum achasanteh di yachsenun yitten mikkirvohi lelevae:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe lememar:
Dabber el-bene yisrael veamarta alehem ki attem ovrim et-hayyarden artza kenaan
Mallel im bene yisrael vetemar lehon are attun avrin yat yardena leara dichnaan:
Vehikritem lachem arim are miklat tihyena lachem venas shamma rotzeach makke-nefesh bishgaga
Utezammenun lechon kirvin kirve shezavuta yehevyan lechon veyearok letamman katola deyiktol nafsha beshalu:
Vehayu lachem hearim lemiklat miggoel velo yamut harotzeach ad-omdo lifne haeda lammishpat
Vihon lechon kirvayya leshezava miggael dema vela yemut katola ad deyekum kodam kenishta ledina:
Vehearim asher tittenu shesh-are miklat tihyena lachem
Vekirvayya di tittenun shit kirve shezavuta yehevyan lechon:
Et shelosh hearim tittenu meever layyarden veet shelosh hearim tittenu beeretz kenaan are miklat tihyena
Yat telat kirvayya tittenun meivra leyardena veyat telat kirvayya tittenun beara dichnaan kirve shezavuta yehevyan:
Livne yisrael velagger velattoshav betocham tihyena shesh-hearim haelle lemiklat lanus shamma kol-makke-nefesh bishgaga
Livne yisrael ulegiyyora uletotavaya devenechon yehevyan shit kirvayya haillen leshezava lemearok letamman kol deyiktol nafsha beshalu:
Veim-bichli varzel hikkahu vayyamot rotzeach hu mot yumat harotzeach
Veim beman defarzela mechahi vekatleh katola hu itketala yitketel katola:
Veim beeven yad asher-yamut bah hikkahu vayyamot rotzeach hu mot yumat harotzeach
Veim beavna demitnasva vida dehi chemissat di yemut ba mechahi vekatleh katola hu itketala yitketel katola:
O bichli etz-yad asher-yamut bo hikkahu vayyamot rotzeach hu mot yumat harotzeach
O beman dea demitnasev bida dehi chemissat di yemut beh mechahi vekatleh katola hu itketala yitketal katola:
Goel haddam hu yamit et-harotzeach befigo-vo hu yemitennu
Gael dema hu yiktol yat katola kad itchayyav leh min dina hu yiktelinneh:
Veim-besina yedofennu o-hishlich alav bitzdiyya vayyamot
Veim besana dechahi o rema alohi vechamna vekatleh:
O veeva hikkahu veyado vayyamot mot-yumat hammakke rotzeach hu goel haddam yamit et-harotzeach befigo-vo
O vidvavu mechahi videh vekatleh itketala yitketel machaya katola hu gael dema yiktol yat katola kad itchayyav leh min dina:
Veim-befeta belo-eva hadafo o-hishlich alav kol-keli belo tzediyya
Veim bitchef bela devavu dechahi o rema alohi kol man bela cheman leh:
O vechol-even asher-yamut bah belo reot vayyappel alav vayyamot vehu lo-oyev lo velo mevakkesh raato
O vechal avna dehi chemissat di yemut ba bela chaze urema alohi vekatleh vehu la sane leh vela tava bishteh:
Veshaftu haeda ben hammakke uven goel haddam al hammishpatim haelle
Vidunun kenishta ben machaya uven gael dema al dinayya haillen:
Vehitztzilu haeda et-harotzeach miyyad goel haddam veheshivu oto haeda el-ir miklato asher-nas shamma veyashav bah ad-mot hakkohen haggadol asher-mashach oto beshemen hakkodesh
Vishezvun kenishta yat katola miyyad gael dema vitivun yateh kenishta lekiryat shezavuteh di arak letamman vitev ba ad dimut kahana rabba di rabbi yateh bimshach kudesha:
Veim-yatzo yetze harotzeach et-gevul ir miklato asher yanus shamma
Veim mippak yippok katola yat techum kiryat shezavuteh di arak letamman:
Umatza oto goel haddam michutz ligvul ir miklato veratzach goel haddam et-harotzeach en lo dam
Veyashkach yateh gael dema mibbara litchum kiryat shezavuteh veyiktol gael dema yat katola let leh dema:
Ki veir miklato yeshev ad-mot hakkohen haggadol veachare mot hakkohen haggadol yashuv harotzeach el-eretz achuzzato
Are vekiryat shezavuteh yittev ad dimut kahana rabba uvatar dimut kahana rabba yetuv katola laara achasanteh:
Vehayu elle lachem lechukkat mishpat ledorotechem bechol moshvotechem
Vihon illen lechon ligzerat din ledarechon bechol motvanechon:
Kol-makke-nefesh lefi edim yirtzach et-harotzeach veed echad lo-yaane venefesh lamut
Kol deyiktol nafsha lefum sahadin yiktol yat katola vesahid chad la yashed beenash lemiktal:
Velo-tikchu chofer lenefesh rotzeach asher-hu rasha lamut ki-mot yumat
Vela tekabbelun mamon al enash katol di hu chayyav lemiktal are itketala yitketel:
Velo-tikchu chofer lanus el-ir miklato lashuv lashevet baaretz ad-mot hakkohen
Vela tekabbelun mamon lemearok lekiryat shezavuteh lemittuv lemittav beara ad dimut kahana:
Velo-tachanifu et-haaretz asher attem bah ki haddam hu yachanif et-haaretz velaaretz lo-yechuppar laddam asher shuppach-bah ki-im bedam shofcho
Vela techayyevun yat ara di attun ba are dema hu mechayyav yat ara uleara la mitkapper al dam zakkay deittashad ba ellahen bedam ashdeh:
Velo tetamme et-haaretz asher attem yoshvim bah asher ani shochen betochah ki ani Adonai shochen betoch bene yisrael
Vela tesaavun yat ara di attun yatvin ba di shechinti sharya begavvah are ana Adonai dishchinti sharya bego bene yisrael:
Vayyikrevu rashe haavot lemishpachat bene-gilad ben-machir ben-menashshe mimmishpechot bene yosef vaydabberu lifne moshe velifne hannesiim rashe avot livne yisrael
Vekarivu reshe avahata lezarit bene gilad bar machir bar menashshe mizzarayat bene yosef umallilu kodam mshe vekodam ravrevayya reshe avahata livne yisrael:
Vayyomru et-adoni tzivva Adonai latet et-haaretz benachala begoral livne yisrael vadoni tzuvva va-Adonai latet et-nachalat tzelofchad achinu livnotav
Vaamaru yat ribboni pakkid Adonai lemittan yat ara beachasana beadva livne yisrael veribboni itpakkad bememra daAdonai lemittan yat achasanat tzelafchad achuna livnateh:
Vehayu leechad mibbene shivte vene-yisrael lenashim venigrea nachalatan minnachalat avotenu venosaf al nachalat hammatte asher tihyena lahem umiggoral nachalatenu yiggarea
Vihevyan lechad mibbene shivtayya divne yisrael linshin vetitmena achasantehon meachasanat avhatana vetittosaf al achasanat shivtayya di yehevyan lehon umeadav achasanta yittimna:
Veim-yihye hayyovel livne yisrael venosfa nachalatan al nachalat hammatte asher tihyena lahem uminnachalat matte avotenu yiggara nachalatan
Veim yehe yovla livne yisrael vetittosaf achasantehon al achasanat shivta di tehevyan lehon umeachasanat shivta daavhatana yittimna achasantehen:
Vaytzav moshe et-bene yisrael al-pi Adonai lemor ken matte vene-yosef dovrim
Ufakkid mshe yat bene yisrael al memra daAdonai lememar yaut shivta divne yosef memallelin:
Ze haddavar asher-tzivva Adonai livnot tzelofchad lemor lattov beenehem tihyena lenashim ach lemishpachat matte avihem tihyena lenashim
Den pitgama di fakkid Adonai livnat tzelafchad lememar lidtakkin beenehon tehevyan linshin beram lezarit shivta daavuhen tehevyan linshin:
Velo-tissov nachala livne yisrael mimmatte el-matte ki ish benachalat matte avotav yidbeku bene yisrael
Vela taschar achasana livne yisrael mishshivta leshivta are gevar beachasanat shivta daavahatohi yiddabbekun bene yisrael:
Vechol-bat yoreshet nachala mimmattot bene yisrael leechad mimmishpachat matte aviha tihye leishsha lemaan yirshu bene yisrael ish nachalat avotav
Vechol beratta yartat achasana mishshivtayya divne yisrael lechad mizzarit shivta daavuha tehe leintu bedil di yertun bene yisrael gevar achasanat avahatohi:
Velo-tissov nachala mimmatte lematte acher ki-ish benachalato yidbeku mattot bene yisrael
Vela taschar achasana mishshivta leshivta ocharana are gevar beachasanteh yiddebekun shivtayya divne yisrael:
Kaasher tzivva Adonai et-moshe ken asu benot tzelofchad
Kema di pakkid Adonai yat mshe ken avadu benat tzelafchad:
Vattihyena machla tirtza vechogla umilka venoa benot tzelofchad livne dodehen lenashim
Vahavaa machla tirtza vechagla umilka venoa benat tzelafchad livne ache avuhen linshin:
Mimmishpechot bene-menashshe ven-yosef hayu lenashim vattehi nachalatan al-matte mishpachat avihen
Mizarayat bene menashshe var yosef havaa linshin vahavat achasantehen al shivta zarit avuhen:
Elle hammitzvot vehammishpatim asher tzivva Adonai beyad-moshe el-bene yisrael bearvot moav al yarden yerecho
Illen pikkodayya vedinayya di fakkid Adonai bida demshe levat bene yisrael bemeshrayya demoav al yardena direcho:
Deuteronomy: Elle haddevarim asher dibber moshe el-kol-yisrael beever hayyarden bammidbar baarava mol suf ben-paran uven-tofel velavan vachatzerot vedi zahav

Illen pitgamayya di mallil mshe im kol yisrael beivra deyardena ochach yathon al dechavu vemadbera veal deargizu vemeshra lokovel yam suf befaran deittappalu al manna uvachatzerot deargizu al bisra veal daavadu egal didhav:
Achad asar yom mechorev derech har-seir ad kadesh barnea
Mahalach chad asar yomin mechorev orach tura deseir ad rekam gea:
Vayhi bearbaim shana beashte-asar chodesh beechad lachodesh dibber moshe el-bene yisrael kechol asher tzivva Adonai oto alehem
Vahava bearbein shenin bechad asar yarcha bechad leyarcha mallil mshe im bene yisrael kechol di fakkid Adonai yateh levathon:
Achare hakkoto et sichon melech haemori asher yoshev becheshbon veet og melech habbashan asher-yoshev beashtarot beedrei
Batar dimcha yat sichon malka deemoraa deyatev becheshbon veyat og malka dematnan deyatev beashtarot beedrei:
Beever hayyarden beeretz moav hoil moshe beer et-hattora hazzot lemor
Beivra deyardena beara demoav shari mshe paresh yat ulefan orayta hada lememar:
Adonai elohenu dibber elenu bechorev lemor rav-lachem shevet bahar hazze
Adonai elahana mallil immana bechorev lememar saggi lechon ditevtun betura haden:
Penu useu lachem uvou har haemori veel-kol-shechenav baarava vahar uvashshefela uvannegev uvechof hayyam eretz hakkenaani vehallevanon ad-hannahar haggadol nehar-perat
Itpenu vetulu lechon veulu letura deemoraa ulechal magirohi bemeshrayya vetura uvishfelta uvidroma uvisfar yamma ara dichnaanaa velivnan ad nahara rabba nahara ferat:
Ree natatti lifnechem et-haaretz bou ureshu et-haaretz asher nishba Adonai laavotechem leavraham leyitzchak uleyaakov latet lahem ulezaram acharehem
Chaze dihavit kodamechon yat ara ulu veachasinu yat ara di kayyam Adonai laavahatchon leavraham leyitzchak uleyaakov lemittan lehon velivnehon batrehon:
Vaomar alechem baet hahiv lemor lo-uchal levaddi seet etchem
Vaamarit lechon beiddana hahi lememar let ana yachil bilchodi lesovara yatchon:
Adonai elohechem hirba etchem vehinnechem hayyom kechochve hashshamayim larov
Adonai elahachon asge yatchon veha itechon yoma den kechochve shemayya lemisge:
Adonai elohe avotechem yosef alechem kachem elef peamim vivarech etchem kaasher dibber lachem
Adonai elaha daavahatchon yosef alechon kevatchon alaf zimnin vivarech yatchon kema di mallil lechon:
Echa essa levaddi torchachem umassaachem verivchem
Echden esovar bilchodi tarchachon veiskechon vedinchon:
Havu lachem anashim chachamim unevonim viduim leshivtechem vaasimem berashechem
Havu lechon guvrin chakkimin vesucheletanun umaddean leshivtechon veemanninnun reshin alechon:
Vattaanu oti vattomru tov-haddavar asher-dibbarta laasot
Vaatevtun yati vaamartun takkin pitgama di mallelta lemebad:
Vaekkach et-rashe shivtechem anashim chachamim viduim vaetten otam rashim alechem sare alafim vesare meot vesare chamishshim vesare asarot veshotrim leshivtechem
Udevarit yat reshe shivtechon guvrin chakkimin umaddean umanneti yathon reshin alechon rabbane alfin verabbane maavata verabbane chamshin verabbane issoryata vesarchin leshivtechon:
Vaatzavve et-shoftechem baet hahiv lemor shamoa ben-achechem ushefattem tzedek ben-ish uven-achiv uven gero
Ufakkedit yat dayanechon beiddana hahi lememar shemau ben achechon utedunun kusheta ben gavra uven achuhi uven giyyoreh:
Lo-takkiru fanim bammishpat kakkaton kaggadol tishmaun lo taguru mippene-ish ki hammishpat lelohim hu vehaddavar asher yikshe mikkem takrivun elay ushemativ
La tishtemodun appin bedina mille zeera cherabba tishmeun la tidchalun min kodam gavra are dina daAdonai hu ufitgama di yikshe minnechon tekarvun levati veeshmeinneh:
Vaatzavve etchem baet hahiv et kol-haddevarim asher taasun
Ufakkedit yatchon beiddana hahi yat kol pitgamayya di tabedun:
Vannissa mechorev vannelech et kol-hammidbar haggadol vehannora hahu asher reitem derech har haemori kaasher tzivva Adonai elohenu otanu vannavo ad kadesh barnea
Unetalna mechorev vehallichna yat kol madbera rabba udechila hahu di chazetun orach tura deemoraa kema di fakkid Adonai elahana yatana vaatena ad rekam gea:
Vaomar alechem batem ad-har haemori asher-Adonai elohenu noten lanu
Vaamarit lechon atetun ad tura deemoraa daAdonai elahana yahev lana:
Ree natan Adonai elohecha lefanecha et-haaretz ale resh kaasher dibber Adonai elohe avotecha lach al-tira veal-techat
Chaze yehav Adonai elahach kodamach yat ara sak achasan kema di mallil Adonai elaha daavahatach lach la tidchal vela tittevar:
Vattikrevun elay kullechem vattomru nishlecha anashim lefanenu veyachperu-lanu et-haaretz veyashivu otanu davar et-hadderech asher naale-bbah veet hearim asher navo alehen
Ukerevtun levati kullechon vaamartun nishlach guvrin kodamana vialalun lana yat ara vitivun yatana pitgama yat orcha di nissek ba veyat kirvayya di neol lehen:
Vayyitav beenay haddavar vaekkach mikkem shenem asar anashim ish echad lashshavet
Ushefar beenay pitgama udevarit minnechon teren asar guvrin gavra chad leshivta:
Vayyifnu vayyaalu hahara vayyavou ad-nachal eshkol vayraggelu otah
Veitpeniyyu useliku letura vaato ad nachala deetkala veallilu yata:
Vayyikchu veyadam mipperi haaretz vayyoridu elenu vayyashivu otanu davar vayyomru tova haaretz asher-Adonai elohenu noten lanu
Unesivu videhon meibba deara vaachitu lana vaativu yatana pitgama vaamaru tava ara daAdonai elahana yahev lana:
Velo avitem laalot vattamru et-pi Adonai elohechem
Vela avitun lemissak vesarevtun al memra daAdonai elahachon:
Vatteragnu veoholechem vattomru besinat Adonai otanu hotzianu meeretz mitzrayim latet otanu beyad haemori lehashmidenu
Veitraamtun bemashkenechon vaamartun bidsane Adonai yatana appekana meara demitzrayim lemimsar yatana bida deemoraa leshetzayutana:
Ana anachnu olim achenu hemassu et-levavenu lemor am gadol varam mimmennu arim gedolot uvetzurot bashshamayim vegam-bene anakim rainu sham
Lean anachna salkin achana tevaru yat libbana lememar am saggi vetakkif minnana kirvin ravrevan ucherichan ad tzet shemayya veaf bene gibbarae chazena tamman:
Vaomar alechem lo-taartzun velo-tirun mehem
Vaamarit lechon la tittavrun vela tidchalun minnehon:
Adonai elohechem haholech lifnechem hu yillachem lachem kechol asher asa ittechem bemitzrayim leenechem
Adonai elahachon dimdabbar kodamechon hu yegiach lechon kechol di avad immechon bemitzrayim leenechon:
Uvammidbar asher raita asher nesaacha Adonai elohecha kaasher yissa-ish et-beno bechol-hadderech asher halachtem ad-boachem ad-hammakom hazze
Uvemadbera di chazeta di sovrach Adonai elahach kema di mesovar gevar yat bereh bechol orcha di hallechtun ad metechon ad atra haden:
Uvaddavar hazze enchem maaminim ba-Adonai elohechem
Uvefitgama haden letechon mehemnin bememra daAdonai elahachon:
Haholech lifnechem badderech latur lachem makom lachanotchem baesh layla larotchem badderech asher telchu-vah uveanan yomam
Di medabber kodamechon beorcha leatkenaa lechon atar bet meshri leashrayutechon beammuda deeshshata belelya leachazayutechon beorcha di tehachun ba uveammuda daanana bimama:
Vayyishma Adonai et-kol divrechem vayyiktzof vayyishshava lemor
Ushemia kodam Adonai yat kal pitgamechon uregez vekayyam lememar:
Im-yire ish baanashim haelle haddor hara hazze et haaretz hattova asher nishbati latet laavotechem
Im yecheze gevar beguvrayya haillen dara visha haden yat ara tavta di kayyemit lemittan laavahatchon:
Zulati kalev ben-yefunne hu yirenna velo-etten et-haaretz asher darach-bah ulevanav yaan asher mille achare Adonai
Ellahen kalev bar yefunne hu yechezinna veleh etten yat ara di derach ba velivnohi chalaf di ashlim batar dachalta daAdonai:
Gam-bi hitannaf Adonai biglalchem lemor gam-atta lo-tavo sham
Af alay hava regaz min kodam Adonai bedilchon lememar af at la teol tamman:
Yehoshua bin-nun haomed lefanecha hu yavo shamma oto chazzek ki-hu yanchilenna et-yisrael
Yehoshua bar nun dekaem kodamach hu yeol tamman yateh takkef are hu yachseninna leyisrael:
Vetappechem asher amartem lavaz yihye uvenechem asher lo-yadu hayyom tov vara hemma yavou shamma velahem ettenenna vehem yirashuha
Vetaflechon di amartun levizza yehon uvenechon di la yedau yoma den tav uvish innun yaalun letamman ulehon etteninna veinnun yertunna:
Veattem penu lachem useu hammidbara derech yam-suf
Veattun itpeniyyu lechon vetulu lemadbera orach yamma desuf:
Vattaanu vattomru elay chatanu la-Adonai anachnu naale venilchamnu kechol asher-tzivvanu Adonai elohenu vattachgeru ish et-kele milchamto vattahinu laalot hahara
Vaatevtun vaamartun li chavna kodam Adonai anachna nissak unegiach beh kerav kechol di fakkedana Adonai elahana vezareztun gevar yat mane keraveh vesharetun lemissak letura:
Vayyomer Adonai elay emor lahem lo taalu velo-tillachamu ki enenni bekirbechem velo tinnagfu lifne oyvechem
Vaamar Adonai li emar lehon la tissekun vela tegichun kerav are let shechinti sharya venechon vela tittavrun kodam baale devavechon:
Vaadabber alechem velo shematem vattamru et-pi Adonai vattazidu vattaalu hahara
Umallelit immechon vela kabbeltun vesarevtun al gezerat memra daAdonai vearshatun uselektun letura:
Vayyetze haemori hayyoshev bahar hahu likratchem vayyirdefu etchem kaasher taasena haddevorim vayyakketu etchem beseir ad-chorma
Unefak emoraa deyatev betura hahu lekaddamutechon uredafu yatchon kema di nattezan dabbaryata uteradu yatchon beseir ad charma:
Vattashuvu vattivku lifne Adonai velo-shama Adonai bekolchem velo heezin alechem
Vetavtun uvechitun kodam Adonai vela kabbil Adonai tzelotchon vela atztzet lemillechon:
Vatteshvu vekadesh yamim rabbim kayyamim asher yeshavtem
Vitevtun birkam yomin saggiin keyomayya di yetevtun:
Vannefen vannissa hammidbara derech yam-suf kaasher dibber Adonai elay vannasov et-har-seir yamim rabbim
Veitpenena unetalna lemadbera orach yamma desuf kema di mallil Adonai immi veakkefna yat tura deseir yomin saggiin:
Vayyomer Adonai elay lemor
Vaamar Adonai li lememar:
Rav-lachem sov et-hahar hazze penu lachem tzafona
Saggi lechon deakkeftun yat tura haden itpeniyyu lechon tzippuna:
Veet-haam tzav lemor attem ovrim bigvul achechem bene-esav hayyoshvim beseir veyiru mikkem venishmartem meod
Veyat amma pakked lememar attun avrin bitchum achuchon bene esav deyatvin beseir veyidchalun minnechon vetistammerun lachada:
Al-titgaru vam ki lo-etten lachem meartzam ad midrach kaf-ragel ki-yerushsha leesav natatti et-har seir
La titgarun behon are la etten lechon mearahon ad midrach parsat rigla are yerutta leesav yehavit yat tura deseir:
Ochel tishberu meittam bakkesef vaachaltem vegam-mayim tichru meittam bakkesef ushetitem
Ivura tizbenun minnehon bechaspa vetechlun veaf mayya tichrun minnehon bechaspa vetishtun:
Ki Adonai elohecha berachcha bechol maase yadecha yada lechtecha et-hammidbar haggadol hazze ze arbaim shana Adonai elohecha immach lo chasarta davar
Are Adonai elahach berchach bechol ovad yedach sappek lach tzorkach bemehechach lemadbera rabba haden denan arbein shenin memra daAdonai elahach besaaddach la menata middaam:
Vannaavor meet achenu vene-esav hayyoshvim beseir midderech haarava meelat umeetzyon gaver vannefen vannaavor derech midbar moav
Vaavarna mikkodam achuna vene esav deyatvin beseir meorach meshra meelat umeetzyon gaver veitpenena vaavarna orach madbera demoav:
Vayyomer Adonai elay al-tatzar et-moav veal-titgar bam milchama ki lo-etten lecha meartzo yerushsha ki livne-lot natatti et-ar yerushsha
Vaamar Adonai li la tetzur al moavae vela titgare lemebad immehon kerav are la etten lach meareh yerutta are livne lot yehavit yat lechayat yerutta:
Haemim lefanim yashvu vah am gadol verav varam kaanakim
Emtane millekadmin yetivu va am rav vesaggi vetakkif kegibbarayya:
Refaim yechashvu af-hem kaanakim vehammoavim yikreu lahem emim
Gibbarae mitchashshevin af innun kegibbarae umoavae yikran lehon emtane:
Uveseir yashvu hachorim lefanim uvene esav yirashum vayyashmidum mippenehem vayyeshvu tachtam kaasher asa yisrael leeretz yerushshato asher-natan Adonai lahem
Uveseir yetivu chorae millekadmin uvene esav tarechunnun veshetzayunnun mikkadamehon vitivu beatrehon kema di avad yisrael leara yeruttateh dihav Adonai lehon:
Atta kumu veivru lachem et-nachal zared vannaavor et-nachal zared
Kean kumu veivaru lechon yat nachala dezared vaavarna yat nachala dezared:
Vehayyamim asher-halachnu mikkadesh barnea ad asher-avarnu et-nachal zered sheloshim ushemone shana ad-tom kol-haddor anshe hammilchama mikkerev hammachane kaasher nishba Adonai lahem
Veyomayya di hallechna merkam gea ad di avarna yat nachala dezered telatin vetamne shenin ad desaf kol dara guvre megiche kerava miggo mashrita kema di kayyim Adonai lehon:
Vegam yad-Adonai hayta bam lehummam mikkerev hammachane ad tummam
Veaf macha min kodam Adonai havat behon leshetzayutehon miggo mashrita ad dishlimu:
Vayhi chaasher-tammu kol-anshe hammilchama lamut mikkerev haam
Vahava kad shelimu kol guvre megiche kerava limmat miggo amma:
Vaydabber Adonai elay lemor
Umallil Adonai immi lememar:
Atta over hayyom et-gevul moav et-ar
At aver yoma den yat techum moav yat lechayat:
Vekaravta mul bene ammon al-tetzurem veal-titgar bam ki lo-etten meeretz bene-ammon lecha yerushsha ki livne-lot netattiha yerushsha
Vetikrav lokovel bene ammon la tetzur alehon vela titgare lemebad immehon kerav are la etten meara vene ammon lach yerutta are livne lot yehavitta yerutta:
Eretz-refaim techashev af-hiv refaim yashvu-vah lefanim vehaammonim yikreu lahem zamzummim
Ara gibbarayya mitchashsheva af hi gibbarae yativu va millekadmin veammonae keran lehon chushbane:
Am gadol verav varam kaanakim vayyashmidem Adonai mippenehem vayyirashum vayyeshvu tachtam
Am rav vesaggi vetakkif kegibbarayya veshetzinnun Adonai mikkodamehon vetarechunnun vitivu veatrehon:
Kaasher asa livne esav hayyoshvim beseir asher hishmid et-hachori mippenehem vayyirashum vayyeshvu tachtam ad hayyom hazze
Kema di avad livne esav deyatvin beseir di shetze yat chorae mikkodamehon vetarechunnun vitivu veatrehon ad yoma haden:
Vehaavvim hayyoshvim bachatzerim ad-azza kaftorim hayyotzim mikkaftor hishmidum vayyeshvu tachtam
Veavvae deyatvin bidfiach ad azza kapputekae dinfaku mikkapputekayya shetzunnun vitivu veatrehon:
Kumu seu veivru et-nachal arnon ree natatti veyadcha et-sichon melech-cheshbon haemori veet-artzo hachel rash vehitgar bo milchama
Kumu tulu veivaru yat nachala dearnon chaze dimsarit bidach yat sichon malka decheshbon emoraa veyat areh share letarachuteh veitgare lemebad immeh kerava:
Hayyom hazze achel tet pachdecha veyiratcha al-pene haammim tachat kol-hashshamayim asher yishmeun shimacha verogzu vechalu mippanecha
Yoma haden eshare lemittan zutach vedachaltach al appe ammayya di techot kol shemayya di yishmeun shimach vizuun veyidchalun min kodamach:
Vaeshlach malachim mimmidbar kedemot el-sichon melech cheshbon divre shalom lemor
Ushelachit izgaddin mimmadbera dikdemot levat sichon malka decheshbon pitgame shelama lememar:
Ebera veartzecha badderech badderech elech lo asur yamin usemovl
Eibbar bearach beorcha beorcha ezel la este yammina usemala:
Ochel bakkesef tashbireni veachalti umayim bakkesef titten-li veshatiti rak ebera veraglay
Ivura vechaspa tezabben li veechul umayya bechaspa titten li veeshte lechod eivar beraglay:
Kaasher asu-li bene esav hayyoshvim beseir vehammoavim hayyoshvim bear ad asher-eevor et-hayyarden el-haaretz asher-Adonai elohenu noten lanu
Kema di avadu li bene esav deyatvin beseir umoavae deyatvin bilchayat ad deeivar yat yardena leara daAdonai elahana yahev lana:
Velo ava sichon melech cheshbon haavirenu bo ki-hiksha Adonai elohecha et-rucho veimmetz et-levavo lemaan titto veyadcha kayyom hazze
Vela ave sichon malka decheshbon lemishbekana lemebar bitchumeh are akshe Adonai elahach yat rucheh vetakkif yat libbeh bedil lemimsereh bidach keyoma haden:
Vayyomer Adonai elay ree hachilloti tet lefanecha et-sichon veet-artzo hachel rash lareshet et-artzo
Vaamar Adonai li chaze shareti lemimsar kodamach yat sichon veyat areh shere letarachuteh lemerat yat areh:
Vayyetze sichon likratenu hu vechol-ammo lammilchama yahtza
Unefak sichon lekaddamutana hu vechol ammeh laagacha kerava leyahatz:
Vayyittenehu Adonai elohenu lefanenu vannach oto veet-banav veet-kol-ammo
Umasreh Adonai elahana kodamana umechena yateh veyat benohi veyat kol ammeh:
Vannilkod et-kol-arav baet hahiv vannacharem et-kol-ir metim vehannashim vehattaf lo hisharnu sarid
Uchevashna yat kol kirvohi beiddana hahi vegammarna yat kol kirve guvrayya uneshayya vetafla la asharna meshezev:
Rak habbehema bazaznu lanu ushelal hearim asher lachadnu
Lechod beira bazzana lana vaadi kirvayya di chevashna:
Mearoer asher al-sefat-nachal arnon vehair asher bannachal vead-haggilad lo hayta kirya asher sagva mimmennu et-hakkol natan Adonai elohenu lefanenu
Mearoer di al kef nachala dearnon vekarta di venachala vead gilad la havat karta di tekefat minnana yat kolla mesar Adonai elahana kodamana:
Rak el-eretz bene-ammon lo karavta kol-yad nachal yabbok veare hahar vechol asher-tzivva Adonai elohenu
Lechod leara vene ammon la karevta kol kef nachala yuveka vekirve tura vechol di fakkid Adonai elahana:
Vannefen vannaal derech habbashan vayyetze og melech-habbashan likratenu hu vechol-ammo lammilchama edrei
Veitpenena uselekna orach dematnan unefak og malka dematnan lekaddamutana hu vechol ammeh laagacha kerava edrei:
Vayyomer Adonai elay al-tira oto ki veyadcha natatti oto veet-kol-ammo veet-artzo veasita lo kaasher asita lesichon melech haemori asher yoshev becheshbon
Vaamar Adonai li la tidchal yateh are vidach mesarit yateh veyat kol ammeh veyat areh vetabed leh kema di avadta lesichon malka deemoraa di yatev becheshbon:
Vayyitten Adonai elohenu beyadenu gam et-og melech-habbashan veet-kol-ammo vannakkehu ad-bilti hishir-lo sarid
Umesar Adonai elahana bidana af yat og malka dematnan veyat kol ammeh umechinnohi ad dela ishtaar leh meshezev:
Vannilkod et-kol-arav baet hahiv lo hayta kirya asher lo-lakachnu meittam shishshim ir kol-chevel argov mamlechet og babbashan
Uchevashna yat kol kirvohi beiddana hahi la havat karta di la nesivna minnehon shittin kirvin kol bet palach terachona malkevata deog bematnan:
Kol-elle arim betzurot choma gevoha delatayim uveriach levad meare happerazi harbe meod
Kol illen kirvin kerichan makkefan shur ram dilhen dashin veabberin bar mikkirve patzchayya saggi lachada:
Vannacharem otam kaasher asinu lesichon melech cheshbon hacharem kol-ir metim hannashim vehattaf
Vegammarna yathon kema di avadna lesichon malka decheshbon gammar kol kirve guvrayya neshayya vetafla:
Vechol-habbehema ushelal hearim bazzonu lanu
Vechol beira vaadi kirvayya bazzana lana:
Vannikkach baet hahiv et-haaretz miyyad shene malche haemori asher beever hayyarden minnachal arnon ad-har chermon
Unesivna beiddana hahi yat ara miyyada teren malche emoraa di beivra deyardena minnachala dearnon ad tura dechermon:
Tzidonim yikreu lechermon siryon vehaemori yikreu-lo senir
Tzidonae keran lechermon siryon veemorae keran leh tur talga:
Kol are hammishor vechol-haggilad vechol-habbashan ad-salcha veedrei are mamlechet og babbashan
Kol kirve meshra vechol gilad vechol dematnan ad salcha veedrei kirve malkevata deog bematnan:
Ki rak-og melech habbashan nishar miyyeter harfaim hinne arso eres barzel halo hiv berabbat bene ammon tesha ammot orkah vearba ammot rochbah beammat-ish
Are lechod og malka dematnan ishtaar mishshear gibbarayya ha arseh arsa defarzela hala hi berabbat bene ammon tesha ammin orka vearba ammin petaya beamat melach:
Veet-haaretz hazzot yarashnu baet hahiv mearoer asher-al-nachal arnon vachatzi har-haggilad vearav natatti laruveni velaggadi
Veyat ara hada yeritna beiddana hahi mearoer di al nachala dearnon ufalgut tura degilad vekirvohi yehavit leshivta diruven uleshivta degad:
Veyeter haggilad vechol-habbashan mamlechet og natatti lachatzi shevet hamenashshe kol chevel haargov lechol-habbashan hahu yikkare eretz refaim
Ushear gilad vechol dematnan malkevata deog yehavit lefalgut shivta dimnashshe kol bet palach terachona lechol matnan hahu mitkere ara gibbarayya:
Yair ben-menashshe lakach et-kol-chevel argov ad-gevul haggeshuri vehammaachati vayyikra otam al-shemo et-habbashan chavvot yair ad hayyom hazze
Yair bar menashshe nesiv yat kol bet palach terachona ad techum geshuraa veafkeros ukera yathon al shemeh yat matnan kafrane yair ad yoma haden:
Ulemachir natatti et-haggilad
Ulemachir yehavit yat gilad:
Velaruveni velaggadi natatti min-haggilad vead-nachal arnon toch hannachal ugevul vead yabbok hannachal gevul bene ammon
Uleshivta diruven uleshivta degad yehavit min gilad vead nachala dearnon go nachala utechum vead yuveka denachala techum bene ammon:
Vehaarava vehayyarden ugevul mikkinneret vead yam haarava yam hammelach tachat ashdot happisga mizracha
Umeshra veyardena utechumeh miggenosar vead yamma demeshra yamma demilcha techot mashpach meramata madincha:
Vaatzav etchem baet hahiv lemor Adonai elohechem natan lachem et-haaretz hazzot lerishtah chalutzim taavru lifne achechem bene-yisrael kol-bene-chayil
Ufakkedit yatchon beiddana hahi lememar Adonai elahachon yehav lechon yat ara hada lemerta mezarzin taberun kodam achechon bene yisrael kol mezarze chela:
Rak neshechem vetappechem umiknechem yadati ki-mikne rav lachem yeshvu bearechem asher natatti lachem
Lechod neshechon vetaflechon uveirchon yedana are veir saggi lechon yetvun bekirvechon di yehavit lechon:
Ad asher-yaniach Adonai laachechem kachem veyarshu gam-hem et-haaretz asher Adonai elohechem noten lahem beever hayyarden veshavtem ish lirushshato asher natatti lachem
Ad di yeniach Adonai laachechon kevatchon veyertun af innun yat ara daAdonai elahachon yahev lehon beivra deyardena utetuvun gevar lirutteteh di yehavit lechon:
Veet-yehoshua tzivveti baet hahiv lemor enecha haroot et kol-asher asa Adonai elohechem lishne hammelachim haelle ken-yaase Adonai lechol-hammamlachot asher atta over shamma
Veyat yehoshua pakkedit beiddana hahi lememar enaych chazaa yat kol di avad Adonai elahachon litren malchayya haillen ken yabed Adonai lechol malkevata di at aver letamman:
Lo tiraum ki Adonai elohechem hu hannilcham lachem
La tidchalun minnehon are Adonai elahachon memreh yegiach lechon:
Vaetchannan el-Adonai baet hahiv lemor
Vetzalleti kodam Adonai beiddana hahi lememar:
Adonay Elohim atta hachillota leharot et-avdecha et-godlecha veet-yadcha hachazaka asher mi-el bashshamayim uvaaretz asher-yaase chemaasecha vechigvurotecha
Adonai ellohim at shareta leachazaa yat avdach yat revutach veyat yedach takkefta di at hu elaha dishchintach bishmayya milella veshallit beara velet deyabed keovadaych uchegibbartach:
Ebera-nna veere et-haaretz hattova asher beever hayyarden hahar hattov hazze vehallevanon
Eivar kean veecheze yat ara tavta di beivra deyardena tura tava haden uvet makdasha:
Vayyitabber Adonai bi lemaanchem velo shama elay vayyomer Adonai elay rav-lach al-tosef dabber elay od baddavar hazze
Vahava regaz min kodam Adonai alay bedilchon vela kabbil minni vaamar Adonai li saggi lach la tosef lemallala kodamay od befitgama haden:
Ale rosh happisga vesa enecha yamma vetzafona vetemana umizracha uree veenecha ki-lo taavor et-hayyarden hazze
Sak leresh ramata uzekof enaych lemaarava uletzippuna velidroma ulemadincha vachaze veenayich are la teivar yat yardena haden:
Vetzav et-yehoshua vechazzekehu veammetzehu ki-hu yaavor lifne haam hazze vehu yanchil otam et-haaretz asher tire
Ufakked yat yehoshua vetakkefhi veallemhi are hu yeivar kodam amma haden vehu yachsen yathon yat ara di techeze:
Vanneshev baggay mul bet peor
Vitevna vechelata lokovel bet peor:
Veatta yisrael shema el-hachukkim veel-hammishpatim asher anochi melammed etchem laasot lemaan tichyu uvatem virishtem et-haaretz asher Adonai elohe avotechem noten lachem
Uchean yisrael shema likyamayya uledinayya di ana meallef yatchon lemebad bedil detechun vetetun vetertun yat ara di Adonai elaha daavahatchon yahev lechon:
Lo tosifu al-haddavar asher anochi metzavve etchem velo tigreu mimmennu lishmor et-mitzvot Adonai elohechem asher anochi metzavve etchem
La tosfun al pitgama di ana mefakked yatchon vela timneun minneh lemittar yat pikkudayya daAdonai elahachon di ana mefakked yatchon:
Enechem haroot et asher-asa Adonai bevaal peor ki chol-haish asher halach achare vaal-peor hishmido Adonai elohecha mikkirbecha
Enechon chazan yat di avad Adonai bevaal peor are kol gavra di azal batar baal peor shetzyeh Adonai elahach mibbenach:
Veattem haddevekim ba-Adonai elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom
Veattun deadbektun bedachalta daAdonai elahachon kayyamin kullechon yoma den:
Ree limmadti etchem chukkim umishpatim kaasher tzivvani Adonai elohay laasot ken bekerev haaretz asher attem baim shamma lerishtah
Chazo deallefit yatchon keyamayya vedinayya kema di fakkedani Adonai elahay lemebad ken bego ara di attun allin tamman lemerta:
Ushemartem vaasitem ki hiv chochmatchem uvinatchem leene haammim asher yishmeun et kol-hachukkim haelle veamru rak am-chacham venavon haggoy haggadol hazze
Vetitterun vetabedun are hi chochmatchon vesucheletanutechon leene ammayya di yishmeun yat kol keyamayya haillen veyemrun lechod am chakkim vesucheletan amma rabba haden:
Ki mi-goy gadol asher-lo elohim kerovim elav ka-Adonai elohenu bechol-korenu elav
Are man am rav di leh elaha kariv leh lekabbala tzeloteh beiddan akteh kaAdonai elahana bechol iddan daanachna metzallin kodamohi:
Umi goy gadol asher-lo chukkim umishpatim tzaddikim kechol hattora hazzot asher anochi noten lifnechem hayyom
Uman am rav di leh keyamin vedinin kashshitin kechol orayta hada di ana yahev kodamechon yoma den:
Rak hishshamer lecha ushemor nafshecha meod pen-tishkach et-haddevarim asher-rau enecha ufen-yasuru millevavcha kol yeme chayyecha vehodatam levanecha velivne vanecha
Lechod istammar lach vetar nafshach lachada dilma tinshe yat pitgamayya di chazo enayich vedilma yeiddun millibbach kol yome chayyaych utehodinnun livnaych velivne venaych:
Yom asher amadta lifne Adonai elohecha bechorev beemor Adonai elay hakhel-li et-haam veashmiem et-devaray asher yilmedun leyira oti kol-hayyamim asher hem chayyim al-haadama veet-benehem yelammedun

Yoma di kamta kodam Adonai elahach bechorev kad amar Adonai li kenosh kodamay yat amma veashmeinnun yat pitgamay di yelfun lemidchal kodamay kol yomayya di innun kayyamin al ara veyat benehon yallefun:
Vattikrevun vattaamdun tachat hahar vehahar boer baesh ad-lev hashshamayim choshech anan vaarafel
Ukerevtun vekamtun beshippole tura vetura baer beeshshata ad tzet shemayya chashocha anana vaamitta:
Vaydabber Adonai alechem mittoch haesh kol devarim attem shomim utemuna enchem roim zulati kol
Umallil Adonai immechon miggo eshshata kal pitgamin attun shamin udemut letechon chazan ellahen kala:
Vayyagged lachem et-berito asher tzivva etchem laasot aseret haddevarim vayyichtevem al-shene luchot avanim
Vechavvi lechon yat keyameh di fakkid yatchon lemebad aseret pitgamin uchetavinun al teren luche avnayya:
Veoti tzivva Adonai baet hahiv lelammed etchem chukkim umishpatim laasotchem otam baaretz asher attem ovrim shamma lerishtah
Veyati pakkid Adonai beiddana hahi leallafa yatchon keyamin vedinin lemebadchon yathon beara di attun avrin tamman lemerta:
Venishmartem meod lenafshotechem ki lo reitem kol-temuna beyom dibber Adonai alechem bechorev mittoch haesh
Vetistammerun lachada lenafshatechon are la chazetun kol demut beyoma di mallil Adonai immechon bechorev miggo eshshata:
Pen-tashchitun vaasitem lachem pesel temunat kol-samel tavnit zachar o nekeva
Dilma techabbelun vetabedun lechon tzelem demut kol tzura demut dechar o nukba:
Tavnit kol-behema asher baaretz tavnit kol-tzippor kanaf asher tauf bashshamayim
Demut kol beira di veara demut kol tzippar gadfa di farach baaver rekia shemayya:
Tavnit kol-romes baadama tavnit kol-daga asher-bammayim mittachat laaretz
Demut kol richasha di veara demut kol nune di vemayya millera leara:

Ufen-tissa enecha hashshamayma veraita et-hashshemesh veet-hayyareach veet-hakkochavim kol tzeva hashshamayim veniddachta vehishtachavita lahem vaavadtam asher chalak Adonai elohecha otam lechol haammim tachat kol-hashshamayim

Vedilma tizkof enaych lishmayya vetecheze yat shimsha veyat sihara veyat kochvayya kol chele shemayya vetite vetisgud lehon vetiflechinnun di zammin Adonai elahach yathon lechol ammayya techot kol shemayya:
Veetchem lakach Adonai vayyotzi etchem mikkur habbarzel mimmitzrayim lihyot lo leam nachala kayyom hazze
Veyatchon kariv Adonai ledachalteh veappek yatchon mikkura defarzela mimmitzrayim lemeheve leh leamma achasana keyoma haden:
Va-Adonai hitannaf-bi al-divrechem vayyishshava levilti ovri et-hayyarden ulevilti-vo el-haaretz hattova asher Adonai elohecha noten lecha nachala
Umin kodam Adonai hava regaz alay al pitgamechon vekayyim bedil dela lemeavar yat yardena uvedil dela lemeal leara tava di Adonai elahach yahev lach achasana:
Ki anochi met baaretz hazzot enenni over et-hayyarden veattem ovrim virishtem et-haaretz hattova hazzot
Are ana mait beara hada let ana aver yat yardena veattun avrin vetertun yat ara tava hada:
Hishshamru lachem pen-tishkechu et-berit Adonai elohechem asher karat immachem vaasitem lachem pesel temunat kol asher tzivvecha Adonai elohecha
Istammaru lechon dilma tittinshun yat keyama daAdonai elahachon di gezar immechon vetabedun lechon tzelem demut kolla di fakkedach Adonai elahach:
Ki Adonai elohecha esh ochla hu el kanna
Are Adonai elahach memreh eshsha ochla hu el kanna:
Ki-tolid banim uvene vanim venoshantem baaretz vehishchattem vaasitem pesel temunat kol vaasitem hara beene Adonaielohecha lehachiso
Are toldun benin uvene venin vetitattekun beara utechabbelun vetabedun tzelem demut kolla vetabedun devish kodam Adonai elahach leargaza kodamohi:
Haidoti vachem hayyom et-hashshamayim veet-haaretz ki-avod tovedun maher meal haaretz asher attem ovrim et-hayyarden shamma lerishtah lo-taarichun yamim aleha ki hishshamed tishshamedun
Ashedit bechon yoma den yat shemayya veyat ara are mevad tevdun bifria meal ara di attun avrin yat yardena letamman lemerta la torchun yomin ala are ishtetzaa tishtetzun:
Vehefitz Adonai etchem baammim venishartem mete mispar baggoyim asher yenaheg Adonai etchem shamma
Vivaddar Adonai yatchon beammayya vetishtaarun am deminyan beammayya di yedabbar Adonai yatchon letamman:
Vaavadtem-sham elohim maase yede adam etz vaeven asher lo-yirun velo yishmeun velo yochlun velo yerichun
Vetiflechun tamman leammayya falche taavata ovad yede enasha aa veavna di la yechezun vela shamin vela ochlin vela merichin:
Uvikkashtem mishsham et-Adonai elohecha umatzata ki tidreshennu bechol-levavcha uvechol-nafshecha
Vetitbeun mittamman dachalta daAdonai elahach vetishkach are tive min kodamohi bechol libbach uvechol nafshach:
Batztzar lecha umetzaucha kol haddevarim haelle beacharit hayyamim veshavta ad-Adonai elohecha veshamata bekolo
Kad yeok lach veyashkechunnach kol pitgamayya haillen besof yomayya utetuv ledachalta daAdonai elahach utekabbel lememreh:
Ki el rachum Adonai elohecha lo yarpecha velo yashchitecha velo yishkach et-berit avotecha asher nishba lahem
Are elaha rachamana Adonai elahach la yishbekinnach vela yechabbelinnach vela yittinshe yat keyama daavahatach di kayyim lehon:
Ki sheal-na leyamim rishonim asher-hayu lefanecha lemin-hayyom asher bara elohim adam al-haaretz ulemiktze hashshamayim vead-ketze hashshamayim hanihya kaddavar haggadol hazze o hanishma kamohu
Are sheel kean leyomayya kadmae dahavo kodamach lemin yoma di vera Adonai adam al ara ulemisseyafe shemayya vead seyafe shemayya hahava kefitgama rabba haden o haishtema kevateh:
Hashama am kol elohim medabber mittoch-haesh kaasher-shamata atta vayyechi
Hashma amma kal memra daAdonai memallel miggo eshshata kema di shemaat at veyitkayyam:
O hanissa elohim lavo lakachat lo goy mikkerev goy bemassot beotot uvemoftim uvemilchama uveyad chazaka uvizroa netuya uvemoraim gedolim kechol asher-asa lachem Adonai elohechem bemitzrayim leenecha

O nissin di avad Adonai leitgallaa lemifrak leh am miggo am benissin beatin uvemoftin uvikrava uvida takkifa uvidraa merama uvechezvanin ravrevin kechol di avad lechon Adonai elahachon bemitzrayim leenaych:
Atta horeta ladaat ki Adonai hu haelohim en od millevaddo
At itchazeta lemidda are Adonai hu ellohim let od bar minneh:
Min-hashshamayim hishmiacha et-kolo leyasserekka veal-haaretz heracha et-ishsho haggedola udevarav shamata mittoch haesh
Min shemayya ashmeach yat kal memreh leallafutach veal ara achzeyach yat eshshateh rabbeta ufitgamohi shemaat miggo eshshata:
Vetachat ki ahav et-avotecha vayyivchar bezaro acharav vayyotziacha befanav bechocho haggadol mimmitzrayim
Vocholaf are rechim yat avahatach veittire vivnohi batrohi veappekach bememreh becheleh rabba mimmitzrayim:
Lehorish goyim gedolim vaatzumim mimmecha mippanecha lahaviacha latet-lecha et-artzam nachala kayyom hazze
Letaracha ammin ravrevin vetakkifin minnach min kodamach leaalutach lemittan lach yat arahon achasana keyoma haden:
Veyadata hayyom vahashevota el-levavecha ki Adonai hu haelohim bashshamayim mimmaal veal-haaretz mittachat en od
Vetidda yoma den utetuv lelibbach are Adonai hu elaha dishchinteh bishmayya milleella veshallit al ara millera let od:
Veshamarta et-chukkav veet-mitzvotav asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom asher yitav lecha ulevanecha acharecha ulemaan taarich yamim al-haadama asher Adonai elohecha noten lecha kol-hayyamim
Vetittar yat keyamohi veyat pikudohi di ana mefakkedach yoma den di yetav lach velivnaych batrach uvedil detorich yomin al ara di Adonai elahach yahev lach kol yomayya:
Az yavdil moshe shalosh arim beever hayyarden mizrecha shamesh
Bechen yafresh mshe telat kirvin beivra deyardena midnach shimsha:
Lanus shamma rotzeach asher yirtzach et-reehu bivli-daat vehu lo-sone lo mittemol shilshom venas el-achat min-hearim hael vachay
Lemeirok tamman katola di yiktol yat chavreh bela mandee vehu la sane leh meitmalle umiddekammohi veyeirok lechad min kirvayya haillen veyitkayyam:
Et-betzer bammidbar beeretz hammishor laruveni veet-ramot baggilad laggadi veet-golan babbashan lamnashshi
Yat betzer bemadbera beara meshra leshivta diruven veyat ramot baggilad leshivta degad veyat golan bematnan leshivta dimnashshe:
Vezot hattora asher-sam moshe lifne bene yisrael
Veda orayta di saddar mshe kodam bene yisrael:
Elle haedot vehachukkim vehammishpatim asher dibber moshe el-bene yisrael betzetam mimmitzrayim
Illen sahedvata ukeyamayya vedinayya di mallil mshe im bene yisrael bemippakhon mimmitzrayim:
Beever hayyarden baggay mul bet peor beeretz sichon melech haemori asher yoshev becheshbon asher hikka moshe uvene yisrael betzetam mimmitzrayim
Beivra deyardena bechelata lokovel bet peor beara desichon malka deemoraa di yatev becheshbon di mecha mshe uvene yisrael bemippakhon mimmitzrayim:
Vayyirshu et-artzo veet-eretz og melech-habbashan shene malche haemori asher beever hayyarden mizrach shamesh
Viritu yat areh veyat ara deog malka dematnan teren malche emoraa di beivra deyardena midnach shimsha:
Mearoer asher al-sefat-nachal arnon vead-har sion hu chermon
Mearoer di al kef nachala dearnon vead tura desion hu chermon:
Vechol-haarava ever hayyarden mizracha vead yam haarava tachat ashdot happisga
Vechol meshra ivra deyardena lemadincha vead yamma demeshra techot mashpach meramata:
Vayyikra moshe el-kol-yisrael vayyomer alehem shema yisrael et-hachukkim veet-hammishpatim asher anochi dover beoznechem hayyom ulemadtem otam ushemartem laasotam
Ukera mshe lechol yisrael vaamar lehon shema yisrael yat keyamayya veyat dinayya di ana memallel kodamechon yoma den vetallefun yathon vetitterun lemebadhon:
Adonai elohenu karat immanu berit bechorev
Adonai elahana gezar immana keyam bechorev:
Lo et-avotenu karat Adonai et-habberit hazzot ki ittanu anachnu elle fo hayyom kullanu chayyim
La im avahatana gezar Adonai yat keyama hada ellahen immana anachna illen hacha yoma den kullana kayyamin:
Panim befanim dibber Adonai immachem bahar mittoch haesh
Mamlal im mamlal mallil Adonai immechon betura miggo eshshata:
Anochi omed ben-Adonai uvenechem baet hahiv lehaggid lachem et-devar Adonai ki yeretem mippene haesh velo-alitem bahar lemor
Ana haveti kaem ben memra daAdonai uvenechon beiddana hahi lechavvaa lechon yat pitgama daAdonai are decheltun mikkodam eshshata vela selektun betura lememar:
Anochi Adonai elohecha asher hotzeticha meeretz mitzrayim mibbet avadim
Ana Adonai elahach di appektach meara demitzrayim mibbet avduta:
Lo-yihye-lecha elohim acherim al-panaay
La yehe lach elaha ochoran bar minni:
Lo-taase-lecha fesel kol-temuna asher bashshamayim mimmaal vaasher baaretz mittaachat vaasher bammayim mittachat laaretz
La tabed lach tzelem kol demut di vishmayya milleella vedi veara millera vedi vemayya millera leara:
Lo-tishtachave lahem velo toovdem ki anochi Adonai elohecha el kanna poked avon avot al-banim veal-shilleshim veal-ribbeim lesonay
La tisgud lehon vela tiflechinnun are ana Adonai elahach el kanna masar chove avahan al benin meradin al dar telitay veal dar reviay lesanay kad meshallemin benayya lemechete batar avahathon:
Veose chesed laalafim leohavay uleshomre mitzvotay
Veaved tevu lealfe darin lerachamay ulenatre fikkoday:
Lo tissa et-shem-Adonai elohecha lashshav ki lo yenakke Adonai et asher-yissa et-shemo lashshav
La teme yat shema daAdonai elahach lemaggana are la yezakke Adonai yat di yeme vishmeh leshikra:
Shamor et-yom hashshabbat lekaddesho kaasher tzivvecha Adonai elohecha
Tar yat yoma deshabbeta lekaddashuteh kema di fakdach Adonai elahach:
Sheshet yamim taavod veasita kol-melachtecha
Shitta yomin tiflach vetabed kol ividtach:

Veyom hashshevii shabbat la-Adonai elohecha lo taase chol-melacha atta uvincha-uvittecha veavdecha-vaamatecha veshorcha vachamorcha vechol-behemtecha vegercha asher bisharecha lemaan yanuach avdecha vaamatcha kamocha

Veyoma sheviaa shabbeta kodam Adonai elahach la tabed kol ivida at uverach uverattach veavdach veamtach vetorach vachamarach vechol beirach vegiyyorach di vekirvach bedil di yenuach avdach veamtach kevatach:
Vezacharta ki-eved hayita beeretz mitzrayim vayyotziacha Adonai elohecha mishsham beyad chazaka uvizroa netuya al-ken tzivvecha Adonai elohecha laasot et-yom hashshabbat
Vetidkar are avda haveta beara demitzrayim veappekach Adonai elahach mittamman bida takkifa uvidraa merama al ken pakkedach Adonai elahach lemebad yat yoma deshabbeta:
Kabbed et-avicha veet-immecha kaasher tzivvecha Adonai elohecha lemaan yaarichun yamecha ulemaan yitav lach al haadama asher-Adonai elohecha noten lach
Yakkar yat avuch veyat immach kema di fakkedach Adonai elahach bedil deyorchun yomaych uvedil deyotev lach al ara daAdonai elahach yahev lach:
Lo tirtzach velo tinaf velo tignov velo-taane vereacha ed shav
La tiktol nefash. vela teguf. vela tignov. vela tashed bechavrach sahaduta deshikra:
Velo tachmod eshet reecha velo titavve bet reecha sadehu veavdo vaamato shoro vachamoro vechol asher lereecha
Vela tachmed ittat chavrach vela terog bet chavrach chakleh veavdeh veamteh toreh vachamareh vechol di lechavrach:
Et-haddevarim haelle dibber Adonai el-kol-kehalechem bahar mittoch haesh heanan vehaarafel kol gadol velo yasaf vayyichtevem al-shene luchot avanim vayyittenem elay
Yat pitgamayya haillen mallil Adonai im kol kehalchon betura miggo eshshata anana vaamitta kal rav vela fesak uchetavinnun al teren luche avnayya vihavinnun li:
Vayhi keshomachem et-hakkol mittoch hachoshech vehahar boer baesh vattikrevun elay kol-rashe shivtechem veziknechem
Vahava kad shemaachon yat kala miggo chashocha vetura baer beeshshata vekarevtun levati kol reshe shivtechon vesavechon:
Vattomru hen heranu Adonai elohenu et-kevodo veet-godlo veet-kolo shamanu mittoch haesh hayyom hazze rainu ki-yedabber elohim et-haadam vachay
Vaamartun ha achzeyana Adonai elahana yat yekareh veyat revuteh veyat kal memreh shemana miggo eshshata yoma haden chazena are yemallel Adonai im anasha veyitkayyam:
Veatta lamma namut ki tochlenu haesh haggedola hazzot im-yosfim anachnu lishmoa et-kol Adonai elohenu od vamatnu
Uchean lema nemut are techlinnana eshshata rabbeta hada im mosfin anachna lemishma yat kal memra daAdonai elahana od umaytin anachna:
Ki mi chol-basar asher shama kol elohim chayyim medabber mittoch-haesh kamonu vayyechi
Are man kol bisra di shema kal memra daAdonai kayyama memallel miggo eshshata kevatana veitkayyam:
Kerav atta ushema et kol-asher yomar Adonai elohenu veat tedabber elenu et kol-asher yedabber Adonai elohenu elecha veshamanu veasinu
Kerav at ushema yat kol di yemar Adonai elahana veat temallel immana yat kol di mallel Adonai elahana immach unekabbel venabed:
Vayyishma Adonai et-kol divrechem bedabberchem elay vayyomer Adonai elay shamati et-kol divre haam hazze asher dibberu elecha hetivu kol-asher dibberu
Ushemia kodam Adonai yat kal pitgamechon bemallalutechon immi vaamar Adonai li shemia kodamay yat kal pitgame amma haden di mallilu immach atkinu kol di mallilu:
Mi-yitten vehaya levavam ze lahem leyira oti velishmor et-kol-mitzvotay kol-hayyamim lemaan yitav lahem velivnehem leolam
Levay di yehe libba haden lehon lemidchal kodamay ulemittar yat kol pikkuday kol yomayya bedil deyetav lehon velivnehon lealam:
Lech emor lahem shuvu lachem leoholechem
Izzel emar lehon tuvu lechon lemashkenechon:
Veatta po amod immadi vaadabbera elecha et kol-hammitzva vehachukkim vehammishpatim asher telammedem veasu vaaretz asher anochi noten lahem lerishtah
Veat hacha kim kodamay veemallel immach yat kol tafkedta ukeyamayya vedinayya di tallefun veyabedun beara di ana yahev lehon lemerta:
Ushemartem laasot kaasher tzivva Adonai elohechem etchem lo tasuru yamin usemol
Vetitterun lemebad kema di fakkid Adonai elahachon yatchon la tistun yammina usemala:
Bechol-hadderech asher tzivva Adonai elohechem etchem telechu lemaan tichyun vetov lachem vehaarachtem yamim baaretz asher tirashun
Bechol orcha di fakkid Adonai elahachon yatchon tehachun bedil detechun veyetav lechon vetorchun yomin beara di tertun:
Vezot hammitzva hachukkim vehammishpatim asher tzivva Adonai elohechem lelammed etchem laasot baaretz asher attem ovrim shamma lerishtah
Veda tafkedta keyamayya vedinayya di fakkid Adonai elahachon leallafa yatchon lemebad beara di attun avrin tamman lemerta:
Lemaan tira et-Adonai elohecha lishmor et-kol-chukkotav umitzvotav asher anochi metzavvecha atta uvincha uven-bincha kol yeme chayyecha ulemaan yaarichun yamecha
Bedil detidchal kodam Adonai elahach lemittar yat kol keyamohi ufikkudohi di ana mefakkedach at uverach uvar berach kol yome chayyaych uvedil deyorchun yomaych:
Veshamata yisrael veshamarta laasot asher yitav lecha vaasher tirbun meod kaasher dibber Adonai elohe avotecha lach eretz zavat chalav udevash
Utekabbel yisrael vetittar lemebad di yetav lach vedi tisgun lachada kema di mallil Adonai elaha daavahatach lach ara avda chalav udevash:
Shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad
Shema yisrael Adonai elahana Adonai chad:
Veahavta et Adonai elohecha bechol-levavcha uvechol-nafshecha uvechol-meodecha
Vetircham yat Adonai elahach bechol libbach uvechol nafshach uvechol nichsach:
Vehayu haddevarim haelle asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom al-levavecha
Vihon pitgamayya haillen di ana mefakkedach yoma den al libbach:
Veshinnantam levanecha vedibbarta bam beshivtecha bevetecha uvelechtecha vadderech uveshochbecha uvekumecha
Utetaninnun livnaych utemallel behon bemittevach bevetach uvimhachach beorcha uvemishkevach uvimkimach:
Ukeshartam leot al-yadecha vehayu letotafot ben enecha
Vetikterinnun leat al yedach vihon litfillin ben enaych:
Uchetavtam al-mezuzot betecha uvisharecha
Vetichtevinnun al mezuzeyan vetikbeinnun besippe vetach uvetaraych:
Vehaya ki yeviacha Adonai elohecha el-haaretz asher nishba laavotecha leavraham leyitzchak uleyaakov latet lach arim gedolot vetovot asher lo-vanita
Vihe are yaelinnach Adonai elahach leara di kayyim laavahatach leavraham leyitzchak uleyaakov lemittan lach kirvin ravrevan vetavan di la veneta:
Uvattim meleim kol-tuv asher lo-milleta uvorot chatzuvim asher lo-chatzavta keramim vezetim asher lo-natata veachalta vesavata
Uvattin melan kol tuv di la malleta vegubbin pesilan di la fesalta karmin vezetin di la netzevta vetechul vetisba:
Hishshamer lecha pen-tishkach et-Adonai asher hotziacha meeretz mitzrayim mibbet avadim
Istammar lach dilma tinshe yat dachalta daAdonai di appekach meara demitzrayim mibbet avduta:
Et-Adonai elohecha tira veoto taavod uvishmo tishshavea
Yat Adonai elahach tidchal vekadamohi tiflach uvishmeh tekayyam:
Lo telchun achare elohim acherim meelohe haammim asher sevivotechem
La tehachun batar taavat ammayya mittaavat ammayya di vesacharanechon:
Ki el kanna Adonai elohecha bekirbecha pen-yechere af-Adonai elohecha bach vehishmidcha meal pene haadama
Are el kanna Adonai elahach shechinteh benach dilma yitkef rogza daAdonai elahach bach vishetzach meal appe ara:
Lo tenassu et-Adonai elohechem kaasher nissitem bammassa
La tenassun kodam Adonai elahachon kema di nassetun benisseta:
Shamor tishmerun et-mitzvot Adonai elohechem veedotav vechukkav asher tzivvach
Mittar titterun yat pikkudayya daAdonai elahachon usehedvateh ukeyamohi di fakdach:
Veasita hayyashar vehattov beene Adonai lemaan yitav lach uvata veyarashta et-haaretz hattova asher-nishba Adonai laavotecha
Vetabed dechashar udetaken kodam Adonai bedil deyetav lach veteul veterat yat ara tavta di kayyim Adonai laavahatach:
Lahadof et-kol-oyvecha mippanecha kaasher dibber Adonai
Lemittevar yat kol baale devavach mikkodamach kema di mallil Adonai:
Ki-yishalcha vincha machar lemor ma haedot vehachukkim vehammishpatim asher tzivva Adonai elohenu etchem
Are yishalinnach berach mechar lememar ma sahedvata ukeyamayya vedinayya di fakkid Adonai elahana yatchon:
Veamarta levincha avadim hayinu lefaro bemitzrayim vayyotzienu Adonai mimmitzrayim beyad chazaka
Vetemar livnach avdin havena lefaro bemitzrayim veappekana Adonai mimmitzrayim bida takkifa:
Vayyitten Adonai otot umoftim gedolim veraim bemitzrayim befaro uvechol-beto leenenu
Vihav Adonai atin umoftin ravrevin uvishin bemitzrayim befaro uvechol enash beteh leenana:
Veotanu hotzi mishsham lemaan havi otanu latet lanu et-haaretz asher nishba laavotenu
Veyatana appek mittamman bedil leaala yatana lemittan lana yat ara di kayyim laavahatana:
Vaytzavvenu Adonai laasot et-kol-hachukkim haelle leyira et-Adonai elohenu letov lanu kol-hayyamim lechayyotenu kehayyom hazze
Ufakkedana Adonai lemebad yat kol keyamayya haillen lemidchal yat Adonai elahana letav lana kol yomayya lekayyamutana keyoma haden:
Utzedaka tihye-llanu ki-nishmor laasot et-kol-hammitzva hazzot lifne Adonai elohenu kaasher tzivvanu
Vezachuta tehe lana are nittar lemebad yat kol tafkedta hada kodam Adonai elahana kema di fakkedana:

Ki yeviacha Adonai elohecha el-haaretz asher-atta va-shamma lerishtah venashal goyim-rabbim mippanecha hachitti vehaggirgashi vehaemori vehakkenaani vehapperizzi vehachivvi vehayevusi shiva goyim rabbim vaatzumim mimmekka

Are yeelinnach Adonai elahach leara di at alel letamman lemerta vitarech ammin saggiin min kodamach chittae vegirgashae veemorae uchenaanae uferizzae vechivvae vivusae shiva ammin saggiin vetakkifin minnach:
Unetanam Adonai elohecha lefanecha vehikkitam hacharem tacharim otam lo-tichrot lahem berit velo techonnem
Veyimserinnun Adonai elahach kodamach vetimchinnun gammara tegammar yathon la tigzar lehon keyam vela teracham alehon:
Velo titchatten bam bittecha lo-titten livno uvitto lo-tikkach livnecha
Vela titchattan behon berattach la titten livreh uveratteh la tissav livrach:
Ki-yasir et-bincha meacharay veavdu elohim acherim vechara af-Adonai bachem vehishmidcha maher
Are yatayan yat berach mibbatar palchani veyiflechun letaavat ammayya veyitkef rogza daAdonai bechon vishetzach bifria:
Ki-im-ko taasu lahem mizbechotehem tittotzu umatztzevotam teshabberu vaasherehem tegaddeun ufesilehem tisrefun baesh
Are im keden tabedun lehon egorehon tetarun vekamathon tetabberun vaasherehon tekotzetzun vetzalme taavathon tokdun benura:
Ki am kadosh atta la-Adonai elohecha becha bachar Adonai elohecha lihyot lo leam segulla mikkol haammim asher al-pene haadama
Are am kaddish at kodam Adonai elahach bach ittire Adonai elahach lemeheve leh leam chabbiv mikkol ammayya di al appe ara:
