Lo merubbechem mikkol-haammim chashak Adonai bachem vayyivchar bachem ki-attem hameat mikkol-haammim
La middesaggiin attun mikkol ammayya tzave Adonai bechon veittire vechon are attun zeerin mikkol ammayya:
Ki meahavat Adonai etchem umishshomro et-hashshevua asher nishba laavotechem hotzi Adonai etchem beyad chazaka vayyifdecha mibbet avadim miyyad paro melech-mitzrayim
Are midderacham Adonai yatchon umiddintar yat keyama di kayyim laavahatchon appek Adonai yatchon bida takkifa ufarkach mibbet avduta mida defaro malka demitzrayim:
Veyadata ki-Adonai elohecha hu haelohim hael hanneeman shomer habberit vehachesed leohavav uleshomre mitzvotav leelef dor
Vetidda are Adonai elahach hu ellohim elaha mehemna nater keyama vechisda lerachamohi ulenatre fikkodohi lealfe darin:
Umeshallem lesonav el-panav lehaavido lo yeacher lesono el-panav yeshallem-lo
Umeshallem lesanohi tavan di innun avdin kodamohi bechayyehon leovadehon la meachar ovad tav lesanohi tavvan di innun avdin kodamohi bechayyehon meshallem lehon:
Veshamarta et-hammitzva veet-hachukkim veet-hammishpatim asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom laasotam
Vetittar yat tafkedta veyat keyamayya veyat dinayya di ana mefakkedach yoma den lemebadhon:
Vehaya ekev tishmeun et hammishpatim haelle ushemartem vaasitem otam veshamar Adonai elohecha lecha et-habberit veet-hachesed asher nishba laavotecha
Vihe cholaf di tekabbelun yat dinayya haillen vetitterun vetabedun yathon veyittar Adonai elahach lach yat keyama veyat chisda di kayyim laavahatach:
Vaahevcha uverachcha vehirbecha uverach peri-vitnecha uferi-admatecha degancha vetiroshcha veyitzharecha shegar-alafecha veashterot tzonecha al haadama asher-nishba laavotecha latet lach
Veyirchaminnach vivarechinnach veyasginnach vivarech valda dimach veibba dearach ivurach vechamrach umishchach bakre toraych veedre anach al ara di kayyim laavahatach lemittan lach:
Baruch tihye mikkol-haammim lo-yihye vecha akar vaakara uvivhemtecha
Berich tehe mikkol ammayya la yehe vach akar veakra uvivirach:
Vehesir Adonai mimmecha kol-choli vechol-madve mitzrayim haraim asher yadata lo yesimam bach unetanam bechol-sonecha
Veyede Adonai minnach kol marin vechol machteshe mitzrayim bishayya di yedaat la yeshavvinnun bach veyitteninnun bechol sanach:
Veachalta et-kol-haammim asher Adonai elohecha noten lach lo-tachos encha alehem velo taavod et-elohehem ki-mokesh hu lach
Utegammar yat kol ammayya di Adonai elahach yahev lach la techus enach alehon vela tiflach yat taavathon are letakla hu lach:
Ki tomar bilvavcha rabbim haggoyim haelle mimmenni echa uchal lehorisham
Dilma temar belibbach saggiin ammayya haillen minni echden ikkul letarachutehon:
Lo tira mehem zachor tizkor et asher-asa Adonai elohecha lefaro ulechol-mitzrayim
La tidchal minnehon midkar tidkar yat di avad Adonai elahach lefaro ulechal mitzrayim:
Hammassot haggedolot asher-rau enecha vehaotot vehammoftim vehayyad hachazaka vehazzeroa hannetuya asher hotziacha Adonai elohecha ken-yaase Adonai elohecha lechol-haammim asher-atta yare mippenehem
Nissin ravrevin di chazaa enach veatayya umoftayya vida takkefta uderaa meramema di appekach Adonai elahach ken yabed Adonai elahach lechol ammayya di at dachel mikkodamehon:
Vegam et-hatztzira yeshallach Adonai elohecha bam ad-avod hannisharim vehannistarim mippanecha
Veaf yat araita yegare Adonai elahach behon ad diyevaddun deishtaaru udeittammaru mikkodamach:
Lo taarotz mippenehem ki-Adonai elohecha bekirbecha el gadol venora
La tittevar mikkodamehon are Adonai elahach shechinteh benach elaha rabba udechila:
Venashal Adonai elohecha et-haggoyim hael mippanecha meat meat lo tuchal kallotam maher pen-tirbe alecha chayyat hassade
Vitarech Adonai elahach yat ammayya haillen mikkodamach zeer zeer la tikkul leshetzayutehon bifria dilma tisge alach chevat bara:
Unetanam Adonai elohecha lefanecha vehamam mehuma gedola ad hishshamdam
Veyimserinnun Adonai elahach kodamach vishaggeshinnun shiggush rav ad dishetzinnun:
Venatan malchehem beyadecha vehaavadta et-shemam mittachat hashshamayim lo-yityatztzev ish befanecha ad hishmidcha otam
Veyimsar malchehon bidach vetovad yat shimhon mittechot shemayya la yitattad enash mikkodamach ad detishetze yathon:
Pesile elohehem tisrefun baesh lo-tachmod kesef vezahav alehem velakachta lach pen tivvakesh bo ki toavat Adonai elohecha hu
Tzalme taavathon tokdun benura la tachmed kaspa vedahava di alehon vetissav lach dilma tittakal beh are merachaka daAdonai elahach hu:
Velo-tavi toeva el-betecha vehayita cherem kamohu shakketz teshakketzennu vetaev tetaavennu ki-cherem hu
Vela tael dimrachak levetach utehe cherma kevateh shakkatza teshakketzinneh verachaka terachakinneh are cherma hu:
Kol-hammitzva asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom tishmerun laasot lemaan tichyun urevitem uvatem virishtem et-haaretz asher-nishba Adonai laavotechem
Kol tafkedta di ana mefakkedach yoma den titterun lemebad bedil detechun vetisgun vetetun vetertun yat ara di kayyim Adonai laavahatchon:
Vezacharta et-kol-hadderech asher holichcha Adonai elohecha ze arbaim shana bammidbar lemaan annotcha lenassotcha ladaat et-asher bilvavcha hatishmor mitzvotav im-lo
Vetidkar yat kol orcha di dabberach Adonai elahach denan arbein shenin bemadbera bedil leannayutach lenassayutach lemidda yat di velibbach hatittar pikkudohi im la:
Vayannecha vayyarivecha vayyaachilcha et-hamman asher lo-yadata velo yadun avotecha lemaan hodiacha ki lo al-hallechem levaddo yichye haadam ki al-kol-motza fi-Adonai yichye haadam
Veanneyach veachpanach veochalach yat manna di la yedata vela yadun avahataych bedil leodautach are la al lachma vilchodohi mitkayyam enasha are al kol appakut memra daAdonai yitkayyam enasha:
Simlatcha lo valta mealecha veraglecha lo vatzeka ze arbaim shana
Kesutach la ivliat minnach umesanach la yechefu denan arbein shenin:
Veyadata im-levavecha ki kaasher yeyasser ish et-beno Adonai elohecha meyasserekka
Vetidda im libbach are kema di meallef gavra yat bereh Adonai elahach meallef lach:
Veshamarta et-mitzvot Adonai elohecha lalechet bidrachav uleyira oto
Vetittar yat pikkudayya daAdonai elahach limhach beorchan detaknan kodamohi ulemidchal yateh:
Ki Adonai elohecha meviacha el-eretz tova eretz nachale mayim ayanot utehomot yotzim babbika uvahar
Are Adonai elahach maalach leara tavta ara nagda nachalin demayyin mabbue enayan utehomin nafkin bevikan uveturin:
Eretz chitta useora vegefen uteena verimmon eretz-zet shemen udevash
Ara chittin vesaarin vegufenin uteenin verimmonin ara dezetaha avdin mishcha vehi avda devash:
Eretz asher lo vemiskenut tochal-bah lechem lo-techsar kol bah eretz asher avaneha varzel umeharareha tachtzov nechoshet
Ara di la veitztzurin techul ba lachma la techsar kol middaam ba ara di avnaha farzela umitturaha tifsul nechasha:
Veachalta vesavata uverachta et-Adonai elohecha al-haaretz hattova asher natan-lach
Vetechul vetisba utevarach yat Adonai elahach al ara tavta dihav lach:
Hishshamer lecha pen-tishkach et-Adonai elohecha levilti shemor mitzvotav umishpatav vechukkotav asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom
Istammar lach dilma titneshe yat dachalta daAdonai elahach bedil dela lemittar pikkodohi vedinohi ukeyamohi di ana mefakkedach yoma den:
Pen-tochal vesavata uvattim tovim tivne veyashavta
Dilma techul vetisba uvattin shappirin tivne vetetev:
Uvekarcha vetzoncha yirbeyun vechesef vezahav yirbe-llach vechol asher-lecha yirbe
Vetorach veanach yisgun vechaspa vedahava yisge lach vechol di lach yisge:
Veram levavecha veshachachta et-Adonai elohecha hammotziacha meeretz mitzrayim mibbet avadim
Virim libbach vetinshe yat dachalta daAdonai elahach di appekach meara demitzrayim mibbet avduta:
Hammolichcha bammidbar haggadol vehannora nachash saraf veakrav vetzimmaon asher en-mayim hammotzi lecha mayim mitztzur hachallamish
Dedabberach bemadbera rabba udechila atar chevan kalan veakrabbin uvet tzachavana atar di let mayya deappek lach mayya mittinnara takkifa:
Hammaachilcha man bammidbar asher lo-yadun avotecha lemaan annotcha ulemaan nassotecha lehetivcha beacharitecha
Deochalach manna bemadbera di la yadun avahatach bedil leannayutach uvedil lenassayutach leotava lach besofach:
Veamarta bilvavecha kochi veotzem yadi asa li et-hachayil hazze
Vetemar belibbach cheli utekef yedi keno li yat nichsayya haillen:
Vezacharta et-Adonai elohecha ki hu hannoten lecha koach laasot chayil lemaan hakim et-berito asher-nishba laavotecha kayyom hazze
Vetidkar yat Adonai elahach are hu yahev lach etza lemikne nichsin bedil lekayyama yat keyameh di kayyim laavahatach keyoma haden:
Vehaya im-shachoach tishkach et-Adonai elohecha vehalachta achare elohim acherim vaavadtam vehishtachavita lahem haidoti vachem hayyom ki avod tovedun
Vihe im minshaa tinshe yat dachalta daAdonai elahach utehach batar taavat ammayya vetiflechinnun vetisgud lehon ashedit bechon yoma den are mevad tevdun:
Kaggoyim asher Adonai maavid mippenechem ken tovedun ekev lo tishmeun bekol Adonai elohechem
Keammayya di Adonai movid mikkadamechon ken tevdun cholaf dila kabbeltun bememra daAdonai elahachon:
Shema yisrael atta over hayyom et-hayyarden lavo lareshet goyim gedolim vaatzumim mimmekka arim gedolot uvetzurot bashshamayim
Shema yisrael at aver yoma den yat yardena lemeal lemerat ammin ravrevin vetakkifin minnach kirvin ravrevan ucherichan ad tzet shemayya:
Am-gadol varam bene anakim asher atta yadata veatta shamata mi yityatztzev lifne bene anak
Am rav vetakkif bene gibbarayya di at yedaat veat shemaat man yikkul lemekam kodam bene gibbarayya:
Veyadata hayyom ki Adonai elohecha hu-haover lefanecha esh ochla hu yashmidem vehu yachniem lefanecha vehorashtam vehaavadtam maher kaasher dibber Adonai lach
Vetidda yoma den are Adonai elahach hu deivar kodamach memreh eshsha ochla hu yeshetzinnun vehu yetarechinnun kodamach utetarechinnun vetovdinnun bifria kema di mallil Adonai lach:
Al-tomar bilvavcha bahadof Adonai elohecha otam millefanecha lemor betzidkati heviani Adonai lareshet et-haaretz hazzot uverishat haggoyim haelle Adonai morisham mippanecha
La temar belibbach bidyittevar Adonai elahach yathon mikkodamach lememar bezachuti aalani Adonai lemerat yat ara hada uvechove ammayya haillen Adonai metarech lehon mikkodamach:

Lo vetzidkatcha uveyosher levavcha atta va lareshet et-artzam ki berishat haggoyim haelle Adonai elohecha morisham mippanecha ulemaan hakim et-haddavar asher nishba Adonai laavotecha leavraham leyitzchak uleyaakov

La vezachutach uvekashshitut libbach at alel lemerat yat arahon are bechove ammayya haillen Adonai elahach metarechhon mikkodamach uvedil laakama yat pitgama di kayyim Adonai laavahatach leavraham leyitzchak uleyaakov:
Veyadata ki lo vetzidkatcha Adonai elohecha noten lecha et-haaretz hattova hazzot lerishtah ki am-keshe-oref atta
Vetidda are la vezachutach Adonai elahach yahev lach yat ara tavta hada lemerta are am keshe kedal at:
Zechor al-tishkach et asher-hiktzafta et-Adonai elohecha bammidbar lemin-hayyom asher-yatzata meeretz mitzrayim ad-boachem ad-hammakom hazze mamrim heyitem im-Adonai
Heve dechir la tinshe yat di argezta kodam Adonai elahach bemadbera lemin yoma di nefakta meara demitzrayim ad metechon ad atra haden mesarvin havetun kodam Adonai:
Uvechorev hiktzaftem et-Adonai vayyitannaf Adonai bachem lehashmid etchem
Uvechorev argeztun kodam Adonai vahava regaz min kodam Adonai bechon leshetzaa yatchon:
Baaloti hahara lakachat luchot haavanim luchot habberit asher-karat Adonai immachem vaeshev bahar arbaim yom vearbaim layla lechem lo achalti umayim lo shatiti
Bemisseki letura lemissav luche avnayya luche keyama di gezar Adonai immechon vitevit betura arbein yemamin vearbein lelavan lachma la achalit umayya la ishteti:
Vayyitten Adonai elay et-shene luchot haavanim ketuvim beetzba elohim vaalehem kechol-haddevarim asher dibber Adonai immachem bahar mittoch haesh beyom hakkahal
Vihav Adonai li yat teren luche avnayya ketivin beetzbea daAdonai vaalehon kechal pitgamayya di mallil Adonai immechon betura miggo eshshata beyoma dikhala:
Vayhi mikketz arbaim yom vearbaim layla natan Adonai elay et-shene luchot haavanim luchot habberit
Vahava missof arbein yemamin vearbein lelavan yehav Adonai li yat teren luche avnayya luche keyama:
Vayyomer Adonai elay kum red maher mizze ki shichet ammecha asher hotzeta mimmitzrayim saru maher min-hadderech asher tzivvitim asu lahem massecha
Vaamar Adonai li kum chut bifria mikka are chabbil ammach di appekta mimmitzrayim satu bifria min orcha di fakkedtinnun avadu lehon mattecha:
Vayyomer Adonai elay lemor raiti et-haam hazze vehinne am-keshe-oref hu
Vaamar Adonai li lememar geli kodamay yat amma haden veha am keshe kedal hu:
Heref mimmenni veashmidem veemche et-shemam mittachat hashshamayim veeese otcha legoy-atzum varav mimmennu
Annach bautach mikkodamay veeshetzinnun veemche yat shimhon mittechot shemayya veebed yatach leam takkif vesaggi minnehon:
Vaefen vaered min-hahar vehahar boer baesh ushene luchot habberit al shete yaday
Veitpeneti unechatit min tura vetura baer beeshshata uteren luche keyama al tarten yeday:
Vaere vehinne chatatem la-Adonai elohechem asitem lachem egel massecha sartem maher min-hadderech asher-tzivva Adonai etchem
Vachazeti veha chavtun kodam Adonai elahachon avadtun lechon egel mattecha setetun bifria min orcha di fakkid Adonai yatchon:
Vaetpos bishne halluchot vaashlichem meal shete yaday vaashabberem leenechem
Vaachadit bitren luchayya uremitinnun meal tarten yeday utevartinnun leenechon:
Vaetnappal lifne Adonai karishona arbaim yom vearbaim layla lechem lo achalti umayim lo shatiti al kol-chattatchem asher chatatem laasot hara beene Adonai lehachiso
Veishtattachit kodam Adonai kekadmeta arbein yemamin vearbein lelavan lachma la achalit umayya la ishteti al kol chovechon di chavtun lemebad devish kodam Adonai leargaza kodamohi:
Ki yagorti mippene haaf vehachema asher katzaf Adonai alechem lehashmid etchem vayyishma Adonai elay gam bappaam hahiv
Are dechelit mikkodam rogza vechemta di regaz Adonai alechon leshetzaa yatchon vekabbil Adonai tzeloti af bezimna hahi:
Uveaharon hitannaf Adonai meod lehashmido vaetpallel gam-bead aharon baet hahiv
Veal aharon hava regaz min kodam Adonai lachada leshetzayuteh vetzalleti af al aharon beiddana hahi:
Veet-chattatchem asher-asitem et-haegel lakachti vaesrof oto baesh vaekkot oto tachon hetev ad asher-dak leafar vaashlich et-afaro el-hannachal hayyored min-hahar
Veyat chovatchon di avadtun yat egla nesevit veokedit yateh benura veshafit yateh beshufina yaut ad di hava dakkik leafra uremet yat afreh lenachala denachet min tura:
Uvetavera uvemassa uvekivrot hattaava maktzifim heyitem et-Adonai
Uvidlekta uvenisseta uvekivre dimshaale margezin havetun kodam Adonai:
Uvishloach Adonai etchem mikkadesh barnea lemor alu ureshu et-haaretz asher natatti lachem vattamru et-pi Adonai elohechem velo heemantem lo velo shematem bekolo
Vechad shelach Adonai yatchon merkam gea lememar seko veachasinu yat ara di yehavit lechon vesarevtun al gezerat memra daAdonai elahachon vela hemantun leh vela kabbeltun lememreh:
Mamrim heyitem im-Adonai miyyom dati etchem
Mesarvin havetun kodam Adonai miyyoma didait yatchon:
Vaetnappal lifne Adonai et arbaim hayyom veet-arbaim hallayla asher hitnappalti ki-amar Adonai lehashmid etchem
Veishtattachit kodam Adonai yat arbein yemamin veyat arbein lelavan di ishtattachit are amar Adonai leshetzaa yatchon:
Vaetpallel el-Adonai vaomar adonay Elohim al-tashchet ammecha venachalatcha asher padita begodlecha asher-hotzeta mimmitzrayim beyad chazaka
Vetzalleti kodam Adonai vaamarit Adonai elahim la techabbal ammach veachasantach di ferakta betakpach di appekta mimmitzrayim bida takkifa:
Zechor laavadecha leavraham leyitzchak uleyaakov al-tefen el-keshi haam hazze veel-risho veel-chattato
Iddechar leavdaych leavraham leyitzchak uleyaakov la titpene lekashyut amma haden ulechovehon velachataehon:
Pen-yomru haaretz asher hotzetanu mishsham mibbeli yecholet Adonai lahaviam el-haaretz asher-dibber lahem umissinato otam hotziam lahamitam bammidbar
Dilma yemrun dayre ara di appektana mittamman middelet yuchela daAdonai leaaluthon leara di mallil lehon umiddesane yathon appekinnun lekattalutehon bemadbera:
Vehem ammecha venachalatecha asher hotzeta bechochacha haggadol uvizroacha hannetuya
Veinnun ammach veachasantach di appekta bechelach rabba uvidraach meramema:
Baet hahiv amar Adonai elay pesol-lecha shene-luchot avanim karishonim vaale elay hahara veasita lecha aron etz
Beiddana hahi amar Adonai li pesal lach teren luche avnayya kekadmae vesak lokodamay letura vetabed lach arona deaa:
Veechtov al-halluchot et-haddevarim asher hayu al-halluchot harishonim asher shibbarta vesamtam baaron
Veechtov al luchayya yat pitgamayya di havo al luchayya kadmae di tevarta uteshavvinnun baarona:
Vaaas aron atze shittim vaefsol shene-luchot avanim karishonim vaaal hahara ushene halluchot beyadi
Vaavadit arona deae shittin ufesalit teren luche avnayya kekadmae uselekit letura uteren luchayya bidi:
Vayyichtov al-halluchot kammichtav harishon et aseret haddevarim asher dibber Adonai alechem bahar mittoch haesh beyom hakkahal vayyittenem Adonai elay
Uchetav al luchayya kichtava kadmaa yat asra fitgamayya di mallil Adonai immechon betura miggo eshata beyoma dikhala vihavinnun Adonai li:
Vaefen vaered min-hahar vaasim et-halluchot baaron asher asiti vayyihyu sham kaasher tzivvani Adonai
Veitpeneti unechatit min tura veshavveti yat luchayya baarona di avadit vahavo tamman kema di fakkedani Adonai:
Uvene yisrael nasu mibbeerot bene-yaakan mosera sham met aharon vayyikkaver sham vaychahen elazar beno tachtav
Uvene yisrael netalu mibbeerot bene yaakan lemosera tamman mit aharon veitkevar tamman veshammesh elazar bereh techotohi:
Mishsham nasu haggudgoda umin-haggudgoda yotvata eretz nachale mayim
Mittamman netalu legudgod umin gudgod leyatvat ara nagdan nachalin demayyin:
Baet hahiv hivdil Adonai et-shevet hallevi laset et-aron berit-Adonai laamod lifne Adonai lesharto ulevarech bishmo ad hayyom hazze
Beiddana hahi afresh Adonai yat shivta delevi lemittal yat aron keyama daAdonai lemekam kodam Adonai leshammashuteh ulevaracha vishmeh ad yoma haden:
Al-ken lo-haya lelevi chelek venachala im-echav Adonai hu nachalato kaasher dibber Adonai elohecha lo
Al ken la hava lelevi cholak veachasana im achohi mattenan dihav leh Adonai innun achasanteh kema di mallil Adonai elahach leh:
Veanochi amadti vahar kayyamim harishonim arbaim yom vearbaim layla vayyishma Adonai elay gam bappaam hahiv lo-ava Adonai hashchitecha
Vaana haveti kaem betura keyomin kadmain arbein yemamin vearbein lelavan vekabbil Adonai tzeloti af bezimna hahu la ave Adonai lechabbalutach:
Vayyomer Adonai elay kum lech lemassa lifne haam veyavou veyirshu et-haaretz asher-nishbati laavotam latet lahem
Vaamar Adonai li kum zil lemittul kodam amma veyealun veyertun yat ara di kayyemit laavahathon lemittan lehon:
Veatta yisrael ma Adonai elohecha shoel meimmach ki im-leyira et-Adonai elohecha lalechet bechol-derachav uleahava oto velaavod et-Adonai elohecha bechol-levavcha uvechol-nafshecha

Uchean yisrael ma Adonai elahach tava minnach ellahen lemidchal kodam Adonai elahach limhach bechol orchan detaknan kodamohi ulemircham yateh ulemiflach kodam Adonai elahach bechol libbach uvechol nafshach:
Lishmor et-mitzvot Adonai veet-chukkotav asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom letov lach
Lemittar yat pikkodayya daAdonai veyat keyamohi daana mefakkedach yoma den lidyetav lach:
Hen la-Adonai elohecha hashshamayim usheme hashshamayim haaretz vechol-asher-bah
Ha daAdonai elahach shemayya usheme shemayya ara vechol di va:
Rak baavotecha chashak Adonai leahava otam vayyivchar bezaram acharehem bachem mikkol-haammim kayyom hazze
Lechod baavahatach tzave Adonai lemircham yathon veittire bivnehon batrehon bechon mikkol ammayya keyoma haden:
Umaltem et orlat levavchem veorpechem lo takshu od
Vetedun yat tafshut libbechon ukedalchon la takshun od:
Ki Adonai elohechem hu elohe haelohim vaadone haadonim hael haggadol haggibbor vehannora asher lo-yissa fanim velo yikkach shochad
Are Adonai elahachon hu elaha dayyanin umare malchin elaha rabba gibbara udechila di let kodamohi missav appin veaf la lekabbala shachda:
Ose mishpat yatom vealmana veohev ger latet lo lechem vesimla
Aved din yittam vearmela verachem giyyora lemittan leh mezona uchesu:
Vaahavtem et-hagger ki-gerim heyitem beeretz mitzrayim
Vetirchamun yat giyyora are dayyarin havetun beara demitzrayim:
Et-Adonai elohecha tira oto taavod uvo tidbak uvishmo tishshavea
Yat Adonai elahach tidchal ukodamohi tiflach uledachalteh tikrav uvishmeh tekayyam:
Hu tehillatcha vehu elohecha asher-asa ittecha et-haggedolot veet-hannoraot haelle asher rau enecha
Hu tushbachtach vehu elahach daavad immach yat ravrevata veyat chasinata haillen di chazo enaych:
Beshivim nefesh yardu avotecha mitzrayma veatta samcha Adonai elohecha kechochve hashshamayim larov
Beshavin nafshan nechatu avahatach lemitzrayim uchean shavveyach Adonai elahach kechochve shemayya lemisge:
Veahavta et Adonai elohecha veshamarta mishmarto vechukkotav umishpatav umitzvotav kol-hayyamim
Vetircham yat Adonai elahach vetittar matterat memreh ukeyamohi vedinohi ufikkodohi kol yomayya:
Vidatem hayyom ki lo et-benechem asher lo-yadu vaasher lo-rau et-musar Adonai elohechem et-godlo et-yado hachazaka uzeroo hannetuya
Vetiddeun yoma den are la yat benechon di la yedau vedi la chazo yat ulfana daAdonai elahachon yat revuteh yat yedeh takkifa uderaeh meramema:
Veet-ototav veet-maasav asher asa betoch mitzrayim lefaro melech-mitzrayim ulechol-artzo
Veyat atvateh veyat ovadohi di avad bego mitzrayim lefaro malka demitzrayim ulechal areh:
Vaasher asa lechel mitzrayim lesusav ulerichbo asher hetzif et-me yam-suf al-penehem berodfam acharechem vayabbedem Adonai ad hayyom hazze
Vedi avad lemashshiryat mitzrayim lesusavateh velirtichohi di attif yat me yamma desuf al appehon bemirdafhon batrechon veovadinnun Adonai ad yoma haden:
Vaasher asa lachem bammidbar ad-boachem ad-hammakom hazze
Vedi avad lechon bemadbera ad metechon ad atra haden:
Vaasher asa ledatan velaaviram bene eliav ben-reuven asher patzta haaretz et-piha vattivlaem veet-battehem veet-oholehem veet kol-hayekum asher beraglehem bekerev kol-yisrael
Vedi avad ledatan velaaviram bene eliav bar reuven di fetachat ara yat puma uvelaatnun veyat enash battehon veyat mashkenehon veyat kol yekuma di immehon bego kol yisrael:
Ki enechem haroot et-kol-maase Adonai haggadol asher asa
Are enechon chazaa yat kol ovada daAdonai rabba di avad:
Ushemartem et-kol-hammitzva asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom lemaan techezku uvatem virishtem et-haaretz asher attem ovrim shamma lerishtah
Vetittar yat kol tafkedta di ana mefakkedach yoma den bedil detitkefun vetealun vetertun yat ara di attun avrin tamman lemerta:
Ulemaan taarichu yamim al-haadama asher nishba Adonai laavotechem latet lahem ulezaram eretz zavat chalav udevash
Uvedil detorchun yomin al ara di kayyim Adonai laavahatchon lemittan lehon velivnehon ara avda chalav udevash:
Ki haaretz asher atta va-shamma lerishtah lo cheeretz mitzrayim hiv asher yetzatem mishsham asher tizra et-zaracha vehishkita veraglecha kegan hayyarak
Are ara di at alel letamman lemerta la cheara demitzrayim hi di nefaktun mittamman di tizra yat zarach umashkat leh beraglach keginta yarka:
Vehaaretz asher attem ovrim shamma lerishtah eretz harim uvekaot limtar hashshamayim tishte-mmayim
Veara di attun avrin tamman lemerta ara turin uvikan limtar shemayya tishte mayya:
Eretz asher-Adonai elohecha doresh otah tamid ene Adonai elohecha bah mereshit hashshana vead acharit shana
Ara daAdonai elahach tava yata tedira ene Adonai elahach ba meresha deshatta vead sofa deshatta:
Vehaya im-shamoa tishmeu el-mitzvotay asher anochi metzavve etchem hayyom leahava et-Adonai elohechem uleovdo bechol-levavchem uvechol-nafshechem
Vihe im kabbala tekabbelun lefikkoday di ana mefakked yatchon yoma den lemircham yat Adonai elahachon ulemiflach kodamohi bechol libbechon uvechol nafshechon:
Venatatti metar-artzechem beitto yore umalkosh veasafta deganecha vetiroshcha veyitzharecha
Veetten metar arachon beiddaneh bakkir velakkish vetichnosh ibburach vechamrach umishchach:
Venatatti esev besadcha livhemtecha veachalta vesavata
Veetten isba vechaklach livirach vetechul vetisba:
Hishshamru lachem pen yifte levavchem vesartem vaavadtem elohim acherim vehishtachavitem lahem
Istammaru lechon dilma yitun libbechon vetistun vetiflechun letaavat ammayya vetisgedun lehon:
Vechara af-Adonai bachem veatzar et-hashshamayim velo-yihye matar vehaadama lo titten et-yevulah vaavadtem mehera meal haaretz hattova asher Adonai noten lachem
Veyitkof rogza daAdonai bechon veyechod yat shemayya vela yehe mitra veara la titten yat alalta vetevdun bifria meal ara tavta daAdonai yahev lechon:
Vesamtem et-devaray elle al-levavchem veal-nafshechem ukeshartem otam leot al-yedchem vehayu letotafot ben enechem
Uteshavvun yat pitgamay illen al libbechon veal nafshechon vetikterun yathon leat al yedchon vihon litfillin ben enechon:
Velimmadtem otam et-benechem ledabber bam beshivtecha bevetecha uvelechtecha vadderech uveshochbecha uvekumecha
Vetallefun yathon yat benechon lemallala vehon bemittevach bevetach uvimhachach beorcha uvemishkevach uvimkimach:
Uchetavtam al-mezuzot betecha uvisharecha
Vetichtevinnun al mezuzeyan vetikbeinnun besippe vetach uvetarach:
Lemaan yirbu yemechem vime venechem al haadama asher nishba Adonai laavotechem latet lahem kime hashshamayim al-haaretz
Bedil deyisgun yomechon veyome venechon al ara di kayyim Adonai laavahatchon lemittan lehon keyome shemayya al ara:
Ki im-shamor tishmerun et-kol-hammitzva hazzot asher anochi metzavve etchem laasotah leahava et-Adonai elohechem lalechet bechol-derachav uledovka-vo
Are im mittar titterun yat kol tafkedta hada di ana mefakked yatchon lemebeda lemircham yat Adonai elahachon limhach bechol orchan detaknan kodamohi uleitkerava ledachalteh:
Vehorish Adonai et-kol-haggoyim haelle millifnechem virishtem goyim gedolim vaatzumim mikkem
Vitarach Adonai yat kol ammayya haillen mikkodamechon vetertun ammin ravrevin vetakkifin minnechon:
Kol-hammakom asher tidroch kaf-raglechem bo lachem yihye min-hammidbar vehallevanon min-hannahar nehar-perat vead hayyam haacharon yihye gevulchem
Kol atra di tidroch parsat raglechon beh dilchon yehe min madbera velivnan min nahara nehar perat vead yamma maarva yehe techumechon:
Lo-yityatztzev ish bifnechem pachdechem umoraachem yitten Adonai elohechem al-pene chol-haaretz asher tidrechu-vah kaasher dibber lachem
La yitattad enash kodamechon dachalatchon veematchon yitten Adonai elahachon al appe chol ara di tidrechun ba kema di mallil lechon:
Ree anochi noten lifnechem hayyom beracha ukelala
Chaze di ana yahev kodamechon yoma den birchan ulevatin:
Et-habberacha asher tishmeu el-mitzvot Adonai elohechem asher anochi metzavve etchem hayyom
Yat birchan di tekabbelun lefikkudayya daAdonai elahachon di ana mefakked yatchon yoma den:
Vehakkelala im-lo tishmeu el-mitzvot Adonai elohechem vesartem min-hadderech asher anochi metzavve etchem hayyom lalechet achare elohim acherim asher lo-yedatem
Ulevatayya im la tekabbelun lefikkudayya daAdonai elahachon vetistun min orcha di ana mefakked yatchon yoma den limhach batar taavat ammayya di la yedatun:
Vehaya ki yeviacha Adonai elohecha el-haaretz asher-atta va-shamma lerishtah venatatta et-habberacha al-har gerizim veet-hakkelala al-har eval
Vihe are yeelinnach Adonai elahach leara di at alel tamman lemerta vetitten yat mevarchayya al tura diggerizzin veyat melattayya al tura deeval:
Halo-hemma beever hayyarden achare derech mevo hashshemesh beeretz hakkenaani hayyoshev baarava mul haggilgal etzel elone more
Hala innun beivra deyardena achore orach maalane shimsha beara kenaanaa deyatev bemeshra lokovel gilgela bistar meshre more:
Ki attem ovrim et-hayyarden lavo lareshet et-haaretz asher-Adonai elohechem noten lachem virishtem otah vishavtem-bah
Are attun avrin yat yardena lemeal lemerat yat ara daAdonai elahachon yahev lechon vetertun yata vetetvun ba:
Ushemartem laasot et kol-hachukkim veet-hammishpatim asher anochi noten lifnechem hayyom
Vetitterun lemebad yat kol keyamayya veyat dinayya di ana yahev kodamechon yoma den:
Elle hachukkim vehammishpatim asher tishmerun laasot baaretz asher natan Adonai elohe avotecha lecha lerishtah kol-hayyamim asher-attem chayyim al-haadama
Illen keyamayya vedinayya di titterun lemebad beara dihav Adonai elaha daavahatach lach lemerta kol yomayya di attun kayyamin al ara:
Abbed teabbedun et-kol-hammekomot asher avdu-sham haggoyim asher attem yorshim otam et-elohehem al-heharim haramim veal-haggevaot vetachat kol-etz raanan
Abbada teabbedun yat kol atrayya di felachu tamman ammayya di attun yartin yathon yat taavathon al turayya ramayya veal ramata utechot kol ilan abbof:
Venittatztem et-mizbechotam veshibbartem et-matztzevotam vaasherehem tisrefun baesh ufesile elohehem tegaddeun veibbadtem et-shemam min-hammakom hahu
Utetarun yat egorehon utetabberun yat kamathon vaasherehon tokdun benura vetzalme taavathon tekotzetzun vetovdun yat shimhon min atra hahu:
Lo-taasun ken la-Adonai elohechem
La tabedun ken kodam Adonai elahachon:
Ki im-el-hammakom asher-yivchar Adonai elohechem mikkol-shivtechem lasum et-shemo sham leshichno tidreshu uvata shamma
Ellahen leatra di yittire Adonai elahachon mikkol shivtechon leashraa shechinteh tamman levet shechinteh titbeun vetetun letamman:
Vahavetem shamma olotechem vezivchechem veet maserotechem veet terumat yedchem venidrechem venidvotechem uvechorot bekarchem vetzonchem
Vetaytun letamman alavatechon venichsat kudeshechon veyat maseratechon veyat afrashut yedchon venidrechon venidvatechon uvechore torchon veanchon:
Vaachaltem-sham lifne Adonai elohechem usemachtem bechol mishlach yedchem attem uvattechem asher berachcha Adonai elohecha
Vetechlun tamman kodam Adonai elahachon vetechedun bechol oshatut yedchon attun veenash battechon di varchach Adonai elahach:
Lo taasun kechol asher anachnu osim po hayyom ish kol-hayyashar beenav
La tabedun kechol di anachna avdin hacha yoma den gevar kol man dechashar kodamohi:
Ki lo-vatem ad-atta el-hammenucha veel-hannachala asher-Adonai elohecha noten lach
Are la atetun ad kean levet neyacha uleachasana daAdonai elahach yahev lach:
Vaavartem et-hayyarden vishavtem baaretz asher-Adonai elohechem manchil etchem veheniach lachem mikkol-oyvechem missaviv vishavtem-betach
Vetaberun yat yardena vetetvun beara daAdonai elahachon machasen yatchon viniach lechon mikkol baale devavechon missechor sechor vetetvun lerachtzan:

Vehaya hammakom asher-yivchar Adonai elohechem bo leshakken shemo sham shamma taviu et kol-asher anochi metzavve etchem olotechem vezivchechem maserotechem uterumat yedchem vechol mivchar nidrechem asher tidderu la-Adonai

Vihe atra di yittire Adonai elahachon beh leashraa shechinteh tamman letamman taytun yat kol di ana mefakked yatchon alavatechon venichsat kudeshechon maseratechon veafrashut yedchon vechol shefar nidrechon di tidderun kodam Adonai:
Usemachtem lifne Adonai elohechem attem uvenechem uvenotechem veavdechem veamhotechem vehallevi asher beshaarechem ki en lo chelek venachala ittechem
Vetechedun kodam Adonai elahachon attun uvenechon uvenatechon veavdechon veamhatechon velevaa di vekirvechon are let leh cholak veachasana immechon:
Hishshamer lecha pen-taale olotecha bechol-makom asher tire
Istammar lach dilma tassek alavatach bechol atra di techeze:
Ki im-bammakom asher-yivchar Adonai beachad shevatecha sham taale olotecha vesham taase kol asher anochi metzavvekka
Ellahen beatra di yittire Adonai bechad min shivtaych tamman tassek alavatach vetamman tabed kol di ana mefakkedach:
Rak bechol-avvat nafshecha tizbach veachalta vasar kevirkat Adonai elohecha asher natan-lecha bechol-shearecha hattame vehattahor yochlennu katztzevi vechaayyal
Lechod bechol reut nafshach tikkos vetechul bisra kevirketa daAdonai elahach di yehav lach bechol kirvaych mesaava vedachya yechluneh kivsar tavya veayla:
Rak haddam lo tochelu al-haaretz tishpechennu kammayim
Lechod dema la techlun al ara tishdinneh kemayya:
Lo-tuchal leechol bisharecha masar degancha vetiroshcha veyitzharecha uvechorot bekarcha vetzonecha vechol-nedarecha asher tiddor venidvotecha uterumat yadecha
Let lach reshu lemechal bekirvaych masar ivurach chamrach umishchach uvechore torach veanach vechol nidrach di tiddar venidvataych veafrashut yedach:

Ki im-lifne Adonai elohecha tochlennu bammakom asher yivchar Adonai elohecha bo atta uvincha uvittecha veavdecha vaamatecha vehallevi asher bisharecha vesamachta lifne Adonai elohecha bechol mishlach yadecha
Ellahen kodam Adonai elahach techlinneh beatra di yittire Adonai elahach beh at uverach uverattach veavdach veamtach velevaa di vekirvaych vetechede kodam Adonai elahach bechol oshatut yedach:
Hishshamer lecha pen-taazov et-hallevi kol-yamecha al-admatecha
Istammar lach dilma tishbok yat levae kol yomaych al arach:
Ki-yarchiv Adonai elohecha et-gevulcha kaasher dibber-lach veamarta ochla vasar ki-teavve nafshecha leechol basar bechol-avvat nafshecha tochal basar
Are yafte Adonai elahach yat techumach kema di mallil lach vetemar echul bisra are tittire nafshach lemechal bisra bechol reut nafshach techul bisra:

Ki-yirchak mimmecha hammakom asher yivchar Adonai elohecha lasum shemo sham vezavachta mibbekarcha umitztzoncha asher natan Adonai lecha kaasher tzivviticha veachalta bisharecha bechol avvat nafshecha
Are yitrachak minnach atra di yittire Adonai elahach leashraa shechinteh tamman vetikkos mittorach umeanach di yehav Adonai lach kema di pakkedittach vetechul bekirvaych bechol reut nafshach:
Ach kaasher yeachel et-hatztzevi veet-haayyal ken tochlennu hattame vehattahor yachdav yochlennu
Beram kema di mitachel besar tavya veayla ken techlinneh mesaava vedachya kachada yechlinneh:
Rak chazak levilti achol haddam ki haddam hu hannafesh velo-tochal hannefesh im-habbasar
Lechod tekef bedil dela lemechal dema are dema hu nafsha vela techul nafsha im bisra:
Lo tochlennu al-haaretz tishpechennu kammayim
La techlinneh al ara tishdinneh kemayya:
Lo tochlennu lemaan yitav lecha ulevanecha acharecha ki-taase hayyashar beene Adonai
La techlinneh bedil deyetav lach velivnaych batrach are tabed dechashar kodam Adonai:
Rak kodashecha asher-yihyu lecha unedarecha tissa uvata el-hammakom asher-yivchar Adonai
Lechod masar kudeshaych dihon lach venidrach tittol vetete leatra di yittire Adonai:
Veasita olotecha habbasar vehaddam al-mizbach Adonai elohecha vedam-zevachecha yishshafech al-mizbach Adonai elohecha vehabbasar tochel
Vetabed alavatach bisra udema al madbecha daAdonai elahach vedam nichsat kudeshaych yishtefech al madbecha daAdonai elahach uvisra techul:
Shemor veshamata et kol-haddevarim haelle asher anochi metzavvekka lemaan yitav lecha ulevanecha acharecha ad-olam ki taase hattov vehayyashar beene Adonai elohecha
Tar utekabbal yat kol pitgamayya haillen di ana mefakkedach bedil deyetav lach velivnaych batrach ad olam are tabed detaken udechashar kodam Adonai elahach:
Ki-yachrit Adonai elohecha et-haggoyim asher atta va-shamma lareshet otam mippanecha veyarashta otam veyashavta beartzam
Are yeshetze Adonai elahach yat ammayya di at alel letamman letaracha yathon mikkodamach veterat yathon vetetav bearahon:
Hishshamer lecha pen-tinnakesh acharehem achare hishshamdam mippanecha ufen-tidrosh lelohehem lemor echa yaavdu haggoyim haelle et-elohehem veeese-kken gam-ani
Istammar lach dilma tittakal batrehon batar deyishtetzun mikkodamach vedilma titba letaavathon lememar echden palchin ammayya haillen yat taavathon veebed ken af ana:
Lo-taase chen la-Adonai elohecha ki chol-toavat Adonai asher sane asu lelohehem ki gam et-benehem veet-benotehem yisrefu vaesh lelohehem
La tabed ken kodam Adonai elahach are kol dimrachak kodam Adonai di sane avadu letaavathon are af yat benehon veyat benatehon yokdin benura letaavathon:
Et kol-haddavar asher anochi metzavve etchem oto tishmeru laasot lo-tosef alav velo tigra mimmennu
Yat kol pitgama di ana mefakked yatchon yateh titterun lemebad la tosfun alohi vela timneun minneh:
Ki-yakum bekirbecha navi o cholem chalom venatan elecha ot o mofet
Are yekum benach neviyya o chalem chelma veyitten lach at o mofta:
Uva haot vehammofet asher-dibber elecha lemor nelcha achare elohim acherim asher lo-yedatam venoovdem
Veyete ata umofta di mallil immach lememar nehach batar taavat ammayya di la yedatanun veniflechinnun:
Lo tishma el-divre hannavi hahu o el-cholem hachalom hahu ki menasse Adonai elohechem etchem ladaat hayishchem ohavim et-Adonai elohechem bechol-levavchem uvechol-nafshechem
La tekabbel lefitgame neviyya hahu o lechalem chelma hahu are menasse Adonai elahachon yatchon lemidda haitechon rachamin yat Adonai elahachon bechol libbechon uvechol nafshechon:
Achare Adonai elohechem telechu veoto tirau veet-mitzvotav tishmoru uvekolo tishmau veoto taavodu uvo tidbakun
Batar dachalta daAdonai elahachon tehachun veyateh tidchalun veyat pikkodohi titterun ulememreh tekabbelun vekadamohi tiflechun uvedachalteh titkarvun:

Vehannavi hahu o cholem hachalom hahu yumat ki dibber-sara al-Adonai elohechem hammotzi etchem meeretz mitzrayim vehappodcha mibbet avadim lehaddichacha min-hadderech asher tzivvecha Adonai elohecha lalechet bah uviarta hara mikkirbecha

Uneviyya hahu o chalem chelma hahu yitketel are mallil satya al Adonai elahachon di appek yatchon meara demitzrayim udefarkach mibbet avduta leatayutach min orcha di fakkedach Adonai elahach limhach ba utefalle aved devish mibbenach:
Ki yesitcha achicha ven-immecha o-vincha o-vittecha o eshet chekecha o reacha asher kenafshecha basseter lemor nelcha venaavda elohim acherim asher lo yadata atta vaavotecha
Are yemallechinnach achuch bar immach o verach o verattach o ittat keyamach o chavrach di chenafshach besitra lememar nehach veniflach letaavat ammayya di la yedaat at vaavahatach:
Meelohe haammim asher sevivotechem hakkerovim elecha o harchokim mimmekka miktze haaretz vead-ketze haaretz
Mittaavat ammayya di vesacharanechon dikrivin lach o dirchikin minnach misseyafe ara vead seyafe ara:
Lo-tove lo velo tishma elav velo-tachos encha alav velo-tachmol velo-techasse alav
La teve leh vela tekabbel minneh vela techus enach alohi vela teracham vela techasse alohi:
Ki harog tahargennu yadcha tihye-bbo varishona lahamito veyad kol-haam baacharona
Are miktal tiktelinneh yedach tehe veh bekadmeta lemikteleh vida dechal amma bevatreta:
Usekalto vaavanim vamet ki vikkesh lehaddichacha meal Adonai elohecha hammotziacha meeretz mitzrayim mibbet avadim
Vetirgeminneh beavnayya vimut are vaa leatayutach middachalta daAdonai elahach di appekach meara demitzrayim mibbet avduta:
Vechol-yisrael yishmeu veyiraun velo-yosifu laasot kaddavar hara hazze bekirbecha
Vechol yisrael yishmeun veyidchalun vela yosfun lemebad kefitgama visha haden benach:
Ki-tishma beachat arecha asher Adonai elohecha noten lecha lashevet sham lemor
Are tishma bechad mikkirvaych di Adonai elahach yahev lach lemittav tamman lememar:
Yatzu anashim bene-veliyyaal mikkirbecha vayyaddichu et-yoshve iram lemor nelcha venaavda elohim acherim asher lo-yedatem
Nefaku guvrin bene risha mibbenach veatayu yat yatve kartehon lememar nehach veniflach letaavat ammayya di la yedatun:
Vedarashta vechakarta veshaalta hetev vehinne emet nachon haddavar neesta hattoeva hazzot bekirbecha
Vetitba vetivdok vetishal yaut veha kushta kevan pitgama itavida toevta hada benach:
Hakke takke et-yoshve hair hahiv lefi-charev hacharem otah veet-kol-asher-bah veet-behemtah lefi-charev
Mimcha timche yat yatve karta hahi lefitgam decharev gammar yata veyat kol di va veyat beira lefitgam decharev:
Veet-kol-shelalah tikbotz el-toch rechovah vesarafta vaesh et-hair veet-kol-shelalah kalil la-Adonai elohecha vehayta tel olam lo tibbane od
Veyat kol adaa tichnosh lego fetayya vetoked benura yat karta veyat kol adaa gemir kodam Adonai elahach utehe tel chariv lealam la titbene od:
Velo-yidbak beyadcha meuma min-hacherem lemaan yashuv Adonai mecharon appo venatan-lecha rachamim verichamcha vehirbecha kaasher nishba laavotecha
Vela yidbak bidach middaam min cherma bedil dituv Adonai mittekof rugezeh veyehav lach rachamin viracham alach veyasginnach kema di kayyim laavahatach:
Ki tishma bekol Adonai elohecha lishmor et-kol-mitzvotav asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom laasot hayyashar beene Adonai elohecha
Are tekabbel lememra daAdonai elahach lemittar yat kol pikkodohi di ana mefakkedach yoma den lemebad dechashar kodam Adonai elahach:
Banim attem la-Adonai elohechem lo titgodedu velo-tasimu korcha ben enechem lamet
Benin attun kodam Adonai elahachon la titchammun vela teshavvun merat ben enechon al mit:
Ki am kadosh atta la-Adonai elohecha uvecha bachar Adonai lihyot lo leam segulla mikkol haammim asher al-pene haadama
Are am kaddish at kodam Adonai elahach uvach ittire Adonai lemeheve leh leam chabbiv mikkol ammayya di al appe ara:
Lo tochal kol-toeva
La techul kol dimrachak:
Zot habbehema asher tochelu shor se chesavim vese izzim
Den beira detechlun torin immerin dirchelin vegadyan deizzin:
Ayyal utzevi veyachmur veakko vedishon uteo vazamer
Ayyala vetavya veyachmura veyala verema vetorbala veditza:
Vechol-behema mafreset parsa veshosaat shesa shete ferasot maalat gera babbehema otah tochelu
Vechol beira disdika farsata umattilfa tilfin tarten parsata masseka fishra bivira yata techlun:
Ach et-ze lo tochlu mimmaale haggera umimmafrise happarsa hashshesua et-haggamal veet-haarnevet veet-hashshafan ki-maale gera hemma ufarsa lo hifrisu temeim hem lachem
Beram yat den la techlun mimmasseke fishra umimmasdike farsata mattilfe tilfayya yat gamla veyat arneva veyat tafza are masseke fishra innun ufarsathon la sedika mesaavin innun lechon:
Veet-hachazir ki-mafris parsa hu velo gera tame hu lachem mibbesaram lo tochelu uvenivlatam lo tiggau
Veyat chazira are masdik parsata hu vela fashar mesaav hu lechon mibbisrehon la techlun uvinviltehon la tikrevun:
Et-ze tochlu mikkol asher bammayim kol asher-lo senappir vekaskeset tochelu
Yat den techlun mikkol di vemayya kol di leh tzitzin vekalfin techlun:
Vechol asher en-lo senappir vekaskeset lo tochelu tame hu lachem
Vechol di let leh tzitzin vekalfin la techlun mesaav hu lechon:
Kol-tzippor tehora tochelu
Kol tzippar dachya techlun:
Veze asher lo-tochlu mehem hannesher vehapperes vehaozniyya
Veden di la techlun minnehon nishra vear veazya:
Veharaa veet-haayya vehaddayya leminah
Uvat kanfa vetarafita vedayyeta lizna:
Veet kol-orev lemino
Veyat kol orva lizneh:
Veet bat hayyaana veet-hattachmas veet-hashshachaf veet-hannetz leminehu
Veyat bat naamita vetzitza vetzippar shachpa venatza liznohi:
Et-hakkos veet-hayyanshuf vehattinshamet
Vekadya vekippofa uvavta:
Vehakkaat veet-harachama veet-hashshalach
Vekata virakreka veshale nuna:
Vehachasida vehaanafa leminah vehadduchifat vehaatallef
Vechavvarita veibbu lizna venaggar tura vaatallefa:
Vechol sheretz haof tame hu lachem lo yeachelu
Vechol richasha deofa mesaav hu lechon la yitochlun:
Kol-of tahor tochelu
Kol ofa deche techlun:
Lo tochlu chol-nevela lagger asher-bisharecha tittenenna vaachalah o machor lenochri ki am kadosh atta la-Adonai elohecha lo-tevashshel gedi bachalev immo
La techlun kol nevila letotav arel di vekirvaych titteninna veyechlinna o tezabbeninna levar ammin are am kaddish at kodam Adonai elahach la techul besar bachalav:
Asser teasser et kol-tevuat zarecha hayyotze hassade shana shana
Assera teasser yat kol alalat zarach deyippok chakla shatta veshatta:
Veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha bammakom asher-yivchar leshakken shemo sham masar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha uvechorot bekarcha vetzonecha lemaan tilmad leyira et-Adonai elohecha kol-hayyamim
Vetechul kodam Adonai elahach beatra di yittire leashraa shechinteh tamman masar ivurach chamrach umishchach uvechore torach veanach bedil detelaf lemidchal kodam Adonai elahach kol yomayya:
Vechi-yirbe mimmecha hadderech ki lo tuchal seeto ki-yirchak mimmecha hammakom asher yivchar Adonai elohecha lasum shemo sham ki yevarechcha Adonai elohecha
Vaare yisge minnach orcha are la tikkul lemitteleh are yitrachak minnach atra di yittire Adonai elahach leashraa shechinteh tamman are yevarechinnach Adonai elahach:
Venatatta bakkasef vetzarta hakkesef beyadcha vehalachta el-hammakom asher yivchar Adonai elohecha bo
Vetitten bechaspa utetzur kaspa bidach utehach leatra di yittire Adonai elahach beh:
Venatatta hakkesef bechol asher-teavve nafshecha babbakar uvatztzon uvayyayin uvashshechar uvechol asher tishalcha nafshecha veachalta sham lifne Adonai elohecha vesamachta atta uvetecha
Vetitten kaspa bechol di yittire nafshach betore uveana uvachamar chadat veattik uvechol di tishalinnach nafshach vetechul tamman kodam Adonai elahach vetechede at veenash betach:
Vehallevi asher-bisharecha lo taazvennu ki en lo chelek venachala immach
Velevaa di vekirvaych la tishbekinneh are let leh cholak veachasana immach:
Miktze shalosh shanim totzi et-kol-masar tevuatcha bashshana hahiv vehinnachta bisharecha
Missof telat shenin tappek yat kol masar alaltach beshatta hahi vetatzna bekirvaych:
Uva hallevi ki en-lo chelek venachala immach vehagger vehayyatom vehaalmana asher bisharecha veochlu vesaveu lemaan yevarechcha Adonai elohecha bechol-maase yadcha asher taase
Veyete levaa are let leh cholak veachasana immach vegiyyora veyittamma vearmela di vekirvaych veyechlun veyisbeun bedil di yevarechinnach Adonai elahach bechol ovade yedach di tabed:
Mikketz sheva-shanim taase shemitta
Missof sheva shenin tabed shemitteta:
Veze devar hashshemitta shamot kol-baal mashshe yado asher yashshe bereehu lo-yiggos et-reehu veet-achiv ki-kara shemitta la-Adonai
Veden pitgam shemitteta detashmet kol gevar mare reshu di yarshe bechavreh la yitba min chavreh umin achuhi are kera shemitteta kodam Adonai:
Et-hannochri tiggos vaasher yihye lecha et-achicha tashmet yadecha
Min bar ammin titba vedi yehe lach im achuch tashmet yedach:
Efes ki lo yihye-bbecha evyon ki-varech yevarechcha Adonai baaretz asher Adonai elohecha noten-lecha nachala lerishtah
Lechod are la yehe vach miskena are varacha yevarechinnach Adonai beara di Adonai elahach yahev lach achasana lemerta:
Rak im-shamoa tishma bekol Adonai elohecha lishmor laasot et-kol-hammitzva hazzot asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom
Lechod im kabbala tekabbel lememra daAdonai elahach lemittar lemebad yat kol tafkedta hada di ana mefakkedach yoma den:
Ki-Adonai elohecha berachcha kaasher dibber-lach vehaavatta goyim rabbim veatta lo taavot umashalta begoyim rabbim uvecha lo yimsholu
Are Adonai elahach barchach kema di mallil lach vetozef leammin saggiin veat la tezuf vetishlot beammin saggiin uvach la yishletun:
Ki-yihye vecha evyon meachad achecha beachad shearecha beartzecha asher-Adonai elohecha noten lach lo teammetz et-levavcha velo tikpotz et-yadcha meachicha haevyon
Are yehe vach miskena chad meachaych bachada mikkirvaych bearach daAdonai elahach yahev lach la tatkef yat libbach vela tikpotz yat yedach meachuch miskena:
Ki-fatoach tiftach et-yadcha lo vehaavet taavitennu de machsoro asher yechsar lo
Ella miftach tiftach yat yedach leh veozafa tozfinneh kemissat chesroneh deyachasir leh:
Hishshamer lecha pen-yihye davar im-levavcha veliyyaal lemor karva shenat-hashsheva shenat hashshemitta veraa encha beachicha haevyon velo titten lo vekara alecha el-Adonai vehaya vecha chet
Istammar lach dilma yehe fitgam im libbach birsha lememar keriva shatta sheviata shatta dishmitteta vetavesh enach beachuch miskena vela titten leh veyikre alach kodam Adonai vihe vach chova:
Naton titten lo velo-yera levavcha betittecha lo ki biglal haddavar hazze yevarechcha Adonai elohecha bechol-maasecha uvechol mishlach yadecha
Mittan titten leh vela yavesh libbach bemittenach leh are bedil pitgama haden yevarechinnach Adonai elahach bechol ovadach uvechol oshatut yedach:
Ki lo-yechdal evyon mikkerev haaretz al-ken anochi metzavvecha lemor patoach tiftach et-yadcha leachicha laaniyyecha uleevyoncha beartzecha
Are la yifsok miskena miggo ara al ken ana mefakkedach lememar miftach tiftach yat yedach laachuch leanyach ulemiskenach bearach:
Ki-yimmacher lecha achicha haivri o haivriyya vaavadcha shesh shanim uvashshana hashsheviit teshallechennu chofshi meimmach
Are yizdabban lach achuch bar yisrael o bat yisrael veyiflechinnach shit shenin uveshatta sheviata tifterinneh bar chorin meimmach:
Vechi-teshallechennu chofshi meimmach lo teshallechennu rekam
Vaare tifterinneh bar chorin meimmach la tifterinneh rekan:
Haanek taanik lo mitztzoncha umiggornecha umiyyikvecha asher berachcha Adonai elohecha titten-lo
Afrasha tafresh leh meanach umeidderach umimmaatzartach di varchach Adonai elahach titten leh:
Vezacharta ki eved hayita beeretz mitzrayim vayyifdecha Adonai elohecha al-ken anochi metzavvecha et-haddavar hazze hayyom
Vetidkar are avda haveta beara demitzrayim ufarkach Adonai elahach al ken ana mefakkedach yat pitgama haden yoma den:
Vehaya ki-yomar elecha lo etze meimmach ki ahevcha veet-betecha ki-tov lo immach
Vihe are yemar lach la eppok meimmach are rachamach veyat enash betach are tav leh immach:
Velakachta et-hammartzea venatatta veozno uvaddelet vehaya lecha eved olam veaf laamatcha taase-kken
Vetissav yat martzea vetitten beudneh uvedasha vihe lach ived palach lealam veaf leamtach tabed ken:
Lo-yikshe veenecha beshallechacha oto chofshi meimmach ki mishne sechar sachir avadcha shesh shanim uverachcha Adonai elohecha bechol asher taase
La yikshe veenach bemifterach yateh bar chorin meimmach are al chad teren kaagar agira palchach shit shenin vivarechinnach Adonai olahach bechol di tabed:
Kol-habbechor asher yivvaled bivkarcha uvetzoncha hazzachar takdish la-Adonai elohecha lo taavod bivchor shorecha velo tagoz bechor tzonecha
Kol buchera di yityelid betorach uveanach dichrin takdesh kodam Adonai elahach la tiflach bevuchera detorach vela tegoz buchera deanach
Lifne Adonai elohecha tochlennu shana veshana bammakom asher-yivchar Adonai atta uvetecha
Kodam Adonai elahach techlinneh shatta veshatta beatra di yittire Adonai at veenash betach:
Vechi-yihye vo mum pisseach o ivver kol mum ra lo tizbachennu la-Adonai elohecha
Vaare yehe veh muma chagir o avir kol mum bish la tikkesinneh kodam Adonai elahach:
Bisharecha tochlennu hattame vehattahor yachdav katztzevi vechaayyal
Bekirvaych techlinneh mesaava vedachya kachada kivsar tavya veayla:
Rak et-damo lo tochel al-haaretz tishpechennu kammayim
Lechod yat demeh la techul al ara tishdinneh kemayya:
Shamor et-chodesh haaviv veasita pesach la-Adonai elohecha ki bechodesh haaviv hotziacha Adonai elohecha mimmitzrayim layla
Tar yat yarcha daaviva vetabed pischa kodam Adonai elahach are beyarcha daaviva appekach Adonai elahach mimmitzrayim vaavad lach nissin belelya:
Vezavachta pesach la-Adonai elohecha tzon uvakar bammakom asher-yivchar Adonai leshakken shemo sham
Vetikkos pischa kodam Adonai elahach min bene ana venichsat kudeshayya min tore beatra di yittire Adonai leashraa shechinteh tamman:
Lo-tochal alav chametz shivat yamim tochal-alav matztzot lechem oni ki vechippazon yatzata meeretz mitzrayim lemaan tizkor et-yom tzetcha meeretz mitzrayim kol yeme chayyecha
La techul alohi chamia shiva yomin techul alohi fattir lechem oni are bivhilu nefakta meara demitzrayim bedil detidkar yat yoma mippekach meara demitzrayim kol yome chayyaych:
Velo-yerae lecha seor bechol-gevulcha shivat yamim velo-yalin min-habbasar asher tizbach baerev bayyom harishon labboker
Vela yitchaze lach chamir bechol techumach shiva yomin vela yevit min bisra di tikkos beramsha beyoma kadmaa letzafra:
Lo tuchal lizboach et-happasach beachad shearecha asher-Adonai elohecha noten lach
Let lach reshu lemikkos yat pischa bachada mikkirvaych daAdonai elahach yahev lach:
Ki im-el-hammakom asher-yivchar Adonai elohecha leshakken shemo sham tizbach et-happesach baarev kevo hashshemesh moed tzetcha mimmitzrayim
Ellahen leatra di yittire Adonai elahach leashraa shechinteh tamman tikkos yat pischa beramsha kemeal shimsha zeman mippekach mimmitzrayim:
Uvishshalta veachalta bammakom asher yivchar Adonai elohecha bo ufanita vabboker vehalachta leohalecha
Utevashshal vetechul beatra di yittire Adonai elahach beh vetitpene vetzafra utehach lekirvach:
Sheshet yamim tochal matztzot uvayyom hashshevii atzeret la-Adonai elohecha lo taase melacha
Shitta yomin techul pattira uveyoma sheviaa kenesh kodam Adonai elahach la tabed ivida:
Shiva shavuot tispor-lach mehachel chermesh bakkama tachel lispor shiva shavuot
Shiva shavuin timne lach middesharyut maggela bachatzad umera daaramuta tishre lemimne shiva shavuin:
Veasita chag shavuot la-Adonai elohecha missat nidvat yadcha asher titten kaasher yevarechcha Adonai elohecha
Vetabed chagga deshavuayya kodam Adonai elahach missat nidvat yedach di titten kema di yevarechinnach Adonai elahach:

Vesamachta lifne Adonai elohecha atta uvincha uvittecha veavdecha vaamatecha vehallevi asher bisharecha vehagger vehayyatom vehaalmana asher bekirbecha bammakom asher yivchar Adonai elohecha leshakken shemo sham
Vetechede kodam Adonai elahach at uverach uverattach veavdach veamtach velevaa di vekirvaych vegiyyora veyittamma vearmela di venach beatra di yittire Adonai elahach leashraa shechinteh tamman:
Vezacharta ki-eved hayita bemitzrayim veshamarta veasita et-hachukkim haelle
Vetidkar are avda haveta bemitzrayim vetittar vetabed yat keyamayya haillen:
Chag hassukkot taase lecha shivat yamim beospecha miggornecha umiyyikvecha
Chagga dimtallayya tabed lach shiva yomin bemichneshach meidderach umimmaatzartach:
Vesamachta bechaggecha atta uvincha uvittecha veavdecha vaamatecha vehallevi vehagger vehayyatom vehaalmana asher bisharecha
Vetechede bechaggach at uverach uverattach veavdach veamtach velevaa vegiyyora veyittamma vearmela di vekirvaych:
Shivat yamim tachog la-Adonai elohecha bammakom asher-yivchar Adonai ki yevarechcha Adonai elohecha bechol tevuatcha uvechol maase yadecha vehayita ach sameach
Shiva yomin techog kodam Adonai elahach beatra di yittire Adonai are yevarechinnach Adonai elahach bechol alaltach uvechol ovade yedaych utehe beram chade:
Shalosh peamim bashshana yerae chol-zechurecha et-pene Adonai elohecha bammakom asher yivchar bechag hammatztzot uvechag hashshavuot uvechag hassukkot velo yerae et-pene Adonai rekam
Telat zimnin beshatta yitchaze chol dechurach kodam Adonai elahach beatra di yittire bechagga defattirayya uvechagga deshavuayya uvechagga dimtallayya vela yitchaze kodam Adonai rekanun:
Ish kemattenat yado kevirkat Adonai elohecha asher natan-lach
Gevar kemattenat yedeh kevirketa daAdonai elahach di yehav lach:
Shoftim veshotrim titten-lecha bechol-shearecha asher Adonai elohecha noten lecha lishvatecha veshaftu et-haam mishpat-tzedek
Dayyanin ufuranin temanne lach bechol kirvaych di Adonai elahach yahev lach leshivtaych vidunun yat amma din dikshot:
Lo-tatte mishpat lo takkir panim velo-tikkach shochad ki hashshochad yeavver ene chachamim visallef divre tzaddikim
La tatzle din la tishtemoda appin vela tekabbel shochada are shochada meavver ene chakkimin umekalkel pitgamin teritzin:
Tzedek tzedek tirdof lemaan tichye veyarashta et-haaretz asher-Adonai elohecha noten lach
Kushta kushta tehe radif bedil deteche veterat yat ara daAdonai elahach yahev lach:
Lo-titta lecha ashera kol-etz etzel mizbach Adonai elohecha asher taase-llach
La titztzov lach asherat kol ilan bistar madbecha daAdonai elahach di tabed lach:
Velo-takim lecha matztzeva asher sane Adonai elohecha
Vela tekim lach kama di sane Adonai elahach:
Lo-tizbach la-Adonai elohecha shor vase asher yihye vo mum kol davar ra ki toavat Adonai elohecha hu
La tikkos kodam Adonai elahach tor veimmar di yehe veh muma kol middaam bish are merachak kodam Adonai elahach hu:
Ki-yimmatze vekirbecha beachad shearecha asher-Adonai elohecha noten lach ish o-ishsha asher yaase et-hara beene Adonaielohecha laavor berito
Are yishtechach benach bachada mikkirvaych daAdonai elahach yahev lach gevar o itteta di yabed yat devish kodam Adonai elahach lemebar al keyameh:
Vayyelech vayyaavod elohim acherim vayyishtachu lahem velashshemesh o layyareach o lechol-tzeva hashshamayim asher lo-tzivviti
Vaazal ufelach letaavat ammayya usegid lehon uleshimsha o lesihara o lechol chele shemayya di la fakkedit:
Vehuggad-lecha veshamata vedarashta hetev vehinne emet nachon haddavar neesta hattoeva hazzot beyisrael
Vichavvun lach vetishma vetitba yaut veha kushta kevan pitgama itavidat toevta hada beyisrael:
Vehotzeta et-haish hahu o et-haishsha hahiv asher asu et-haddavar hara hazze el-shearecha et-haish o et-haishsha usekaltam baavanim vametu
Vetappek yat gavra hahu o yat itteta hahi di avadu yat pitgama visha haden litra bet dinach yat gavra o yat itteta vetirgeminnun beavnayya vimutun:
Al-pi shenayim edim o shelosha edim yumat hammet lo yumat al-pi ed echad
Al memar teren sahadin o telata sahadin yitketel dechayyav ketol la yitketel al memar sahid chad:
Yad haedim tihye-bbo varishona lahamito veyad kol-haam baacharona uviarta hara mikkirbecha
Yeda desahadayya tehe veh bekadmeta lemikteleh vida dechal amma bevatreta utefalle aved devish mibbenach:
Ki yippale mimmecha davar lammishpat ben-dam ledam ben-din ledin uven nega lanega divre rivot bisharecha vekamta vealita el-hammakom asher yivchar Adonai elohecha bo
Are yittichse minnach pitgama ledina ben dema lidma ben dina ledina uven machtash segiru lemachtash segiru pitgame felugta dina bekirvaych utekum vetissak leatra di yittire Adonai elahach beh:
Uvata el-hakkohanim haleviyyim veel-hashshofet asher yihye bayyamim hahem vedarashta vehiggidu lecha et devar hammishpat
Vetete levat kahanaya levae ulevat dayyana di yehe beyomayya hainnun vetitba vichavvun lach yat pitgama dedina:
Veasita al-pi haddavar asher yaggidu lecha min-hammakom hahu asher yivchar Adonai veshamarta laasot kechol asher yorucha
Vetabed al memar pitgama di yechavvun lach min atra hahu di yittire Adonai vetittar lemebad kechol di yallefunnach:
Al-pi hattora asher yorucha veal-hammishpat asher-yomru lecha taase lo tasur min-haddavar asher-yaggidu lecha yamin usemol
Al memar orayta di yallefunnach veal dina di yemrun lach tabed la tiste min pitgama di yechavvun lach yammina usemala:
Vehaish asher-yaase vezadon levilti shemoa el-hakkohen haomed lesharet sham et-Adonai elohecha o el-hashshofet umet haish hahu uviarta hara miyyisrael
Ugevar di yabed birsha bedil dela lekabbala min kahana dekaem leshammasha tamman kodam Adonai elahach o min dayyana veyitketel gavra hahu utefalle aved devish miyyisrael:
Vechol-haam yishmeu veyirau velo yezidun od
Vechol amma yishmeun veyidchalun vela yarshiun od:
Ki-tavo el-haaretz asher Adonai elohecha noten lach virishtah veyashavta bah veamarta asima alay melech kechol-haggoyim asher sevivotay
Are teol leara daAdonai elahach yahev lach veterta vetetev ba vetemar emanni alay malka kechal ammayya di vesacharanay:
Som tasim alecha melech asher yivchar Adonai elohecha bo mikkerev achecha tasim alecha melech lo tuchal latet alecha ish nochri asher lo-achicha hu
Mannaa temanne alach malka di yittire Adonai elahach beh miggo achaych temanne alach malka let lach reshu lemannaa alach gevar nucheray di la achuch hu:
Rak lo-yarbe-llo susim velo-yashiv et-haam mitzrayma lemaan harbot sus va-Adonai amar lachem lo tosifun lashuv badderech hazze od
Lechod la yasge leh susavan vela yatev yat amma lemitzrayim bedil leasgaa leh susavan vaAdonai amar lechon la tosfun lemittuv beorach hada od:
Velo yarbe-llo nashim velo yasur levavo vechesef vezahav lo yarbe-llo meod
Vela yasge leh neshin vela yite libbeh vechaspa vedahava la yasge leh lachada:
Vehaya cheshivto al kisse mamlachto vechatav lo et-mishne hattora hazzot al-sefer millifne hakkohanim haleviyyim
Vihe chemitteveh al karsa malchuteh veyichtov leh yat patshegen orayta hada al sifra min kodam kahanayya levae:
Vehayta immo vekara vo kol-yeme chayyav lemaan yilmad leyira et-Adonai elohav lishmor et-kol-divre hattora hazzot veet-hachukkim haelle laasotam
Utehe immeh vihe kare veh kol yome chayyohi bedil deyelaf lemidchal kodam Adonai elaheh lemittar yat kol pitgame orayta hada veyat keyamayya haillen lemebadhon:
Levilti rum-levavo meechav ulevilti sur min-hammitzva yamin usemovl lemaan yaarich yamim al-mamlachto hu uvanav bekerev yisrael
Bedil dela yerim libbeh meachohi uvedil dela yiste min tafkedta yammina usemala bedil deyorech yomin al malchuteh hu uvenohi bego yisrael:
Lo-yihye lakkohanim haleviyyim kol-shevet levi chelek venachala im-yisrael ishshe Adonai venachalato yochelun
La yehe lechahanayya levae kol shivta delevi cholak veachasana im yisrael kurbanayya daAdonai veachasanteh yechlun:
Venachala lo-yihye-llo bekerev echav Adonai hu nachalato kaasher dibber-lo
Veachasana la yehe leh bego achohi mattenan dihav leh Adonai innun achasanteh kema di mallil leh:
Veze yihye mishpat hakkohanim meet haam meet zovche hazzevach im-shor im-se venatan lakkohen hazzeroa vehallechayayim vehakkeva
Veden yehe dechaze lechahanayya min amma min nachse nichsata im tor im immar veyitten lechahana deroa veloa vekuvta:
Reshit degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha vereshit gez tzoncha titten-lo
Resh ivurach chamrach umishchach veresh gizza deanach titten leh:
Ki vo bachar Adonai elohecha mikkol-shevatecha laamod lesharet beshem-Adonai hu uvanav kol-hayyamim
Are veh yittire Adonai elahach mikkol shivtaych lemekam leshammasha vishma daAdonai hu uvenohi kol yomayya:
Vechi-yavo hallevi meachad shearecha mikkol-yisrael asher-hu gar sham uva bechol-avvat nafsho el-hammakom asher-yivchar Adonai
Vaare yete levaa mechada mikkirvaych mikkol yisrael di hu dar tamman veyete bechol reut nafsheh leatra di yittire Adonai:
Vesheret beshem Adonai elohav kechol-echav haleviyyim haomdim sham lifne Adonai
Vishammash bishma daAdonai elaheh kechal achohi levae dimshammeshin tamman bitzlo kodam Adonai:
Chelek kechelek yochelu levad mimkarav al-haavot
Cholak kocholak yechlun bar mimmattarta deyete veshabbatta dechen atkinu avahata:
Ki atta ba el-haaretz asher-Adonai elohecha noten lach lo-tilmad laasot ketoavot haggoyim hahem
Are at alel leara daAdonai elahach yahev lach la telaf lemebad ketaavat ammayya hainnun:
Lo-yimmatze vecha maavir beno-uvitto baesh kosem kesamim meonen umenachesh umechashshef
La yishtechach bach maavar bereh uveratteh benura kasem kusmin meanen umenachesh vecharash:
Vechover chaver veshoel ov veyiddeoni vedoresh el-hammetim
Veratin retan veshael biddin uzechuru vetava min metayya:
Ki-toavat Adonai kol-ose elle uviglal hattoevot haelle Adonai elohecha morish otam mippanecha
Are merachak Adonai kol deyabed illen uvedil toavata haillen Adonai elahach metarach yathon mikkodamach:
Tamim tihye im Adonai elohecha
Shelim tehe bedachalta daAdonai elahach:
Ki haggoyim haelle asher atta yoresh otam el-meonenim veel-kosmim yishmau veatta lo chen natan lecha Adonai elohecha
Are ammayya haillen di at yaret yathon min meanenayya umin kassamayya shamin veat la chen yehav lach Adonai elahach:
Navi mikkirbecha meachecha kamoni yakim lecha Adonai elohecha elav tishmaun
Neviyya mibbenach meachaych kevati yekim lach Adonai elahach minneh tekabbelun:
Kechol asher-shaalta meim Adonai elohecha bechorev beyom hakkahal lemor lo osef lishmoa et-kol Adonai elohay veet-haesh haggedola hazzot lo-ere od velo amut
Kechol di sheelta mikkodam Adonai elahach bechorev beyoma dikhala lememar la osef lemishma yat kal memra daAdonai elahay veyat eshshata rabbeta hada la echeze od vela emut:
Vayyomer Adonai elay hetivu asher dibberu
Vaamar Adonai li otivu di mallilu:
Navi akim lahem mikkerev achehem kamocha venatatti devaray befiv vedibber alehem et kol-asher atzavvennu
Neviyya akim lehon miggo achehon kevatach veetten pitgame nevuati befumeh vimallel immehon yat kol di afakkedinneh:
Vehaya haish asher lo-yishma el-devaray asher yedabber bishmi anochi edrosh meimmo
Vihe gavra di la yekabbel lefitgamay di yemallel bishmi memri yitba minneh:
Ach hannavi asher yazid ledabber davar bishmi et asher lo-tzivvitiv ledabber vaasher yedabber beshem elohim acherim umet hannavi hahu
Beram neviyya di yarsha lemallala fitgama bishmi yat di la fakkeditteh lemallala vedi yemallel beshum taavat ammayya veyitketel neviyya hahu:
Vechi tomar bilvavecha echa neda et-haddavar asher lo-dibbero Adonai
Vaare temar belibbach echden nidda yat pitgama di la malleleh Adonai:
Asher yedabber hannavi beshem Adonai velo-yihye haddavar velo yavo hu haddavar asher lo-dibbero Adonai bezadon dibbero hannavi lo tagur mimmennu
Di yemallel neviyya bishma daAdonai vela yehe fitgama vela yitkayyam hu fitgama di la malleleh Adonai birsha malleleh neviyya la tidchal minneh:
Ki-yachrit Adonai elohecha et-haggoyim asher Adonai elohecha noten lecha et-artzam virishtam veyashavta vearehem uvevattehem
Are yeshetze Adonai elahach yat ammayya di Adonai elahach yahev lach yat arahon vetertinnun vetetev bekirvehon uvevattehon:
Shalosh arim tavdil lach betoch artzecha asher Adonai elohecha noten lecha lerishtah
Telat kirvin tafrash lach bego arach di Adonai elahach yahev lach lemerta:
Tachin lecha hadderech veshillashta et-gevul artzecha asher yanchilcha Adonai elohecha vehaya lanus shamma kol-rotzeach
Tetakken lach orcha utetallat yat techum arach di yachseninnach Adonai elahach vihe lemeirok tamman kol katola:
Veze devar harotzeach asher-yanus shamma vachay asher yakke et-reehu bivli-daat vehu lo-sone lo mittemol shilshom
Veden pitgam katola deyeirok tamman veyitkayyam di yiktol yat chavreh bela mandeeh vehu la sane leh meitmalle umiddekamohi:
Vaasher yavo et-reehu vayyaar lachtov etzim veniddecha yado vaggarzen lichrot haetz venashal habbarzel min-haetz umatza et-reehu vamet hu yanus el-achat hearim-haelle vachay
Vedi yeul im chavreh bechursha lemikkatz ain vetitmereg yedeh befarzela lemikkatz ain veyishtelef parzela min aa veyashkach yat chavreh vimut hu yeirok lachada min kirvayya haillen veyitkayyam:
Pen-yirdof goel haddam achare harotzeach ki-yecham levavo vehissigo ki-yirbe hadderech vehikkahu nafesh velo en mishpat-mavet ki lo sone hu lo mittemol shilshom
Dilma yirdof gael dema batar katola are yecham libbeh veyadbekinneh are tisge orcha veyiktelinneh nefash veleh let chovat din diktol are la sane hu leh mittemalli umiddekamohi:
Al-ken anochi metzavvecha lemor shalosh arim tavdil lach
Al ken ana mefakkedach lememar telat kirvin tafresh lach:
Veim-yarchiv Adonai elohecha et-gevulcha kaasher nishba laavotecha venatan lecha et-kol-haaretz asher dibber latet laavotecha
Veim yafte Adonai elahach yat techumach kema di kayyim laavahatach veyitten lach yat kol ara di mallil lemittan laavahatach:
Ki-tishmor et-kol-hammitzva hazzot laasotah asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom leahava et-Adonai elohecha velalechet bidrachav kol-hayyamim veyasafta lecha od shalosh arim al hashshalosh haelle
Are tittar yat kol tafkedta hada lemebeda di ana mefakkedach yoma den lemircham yat Adonai elahach velimhach beorchan detakkenan kodamohi kol yomayya vetosef lach od telat kirvin al telat illen:
Velo yishshafech dam naki bekerev artzecha asher Adonai elohecha noten lecha nachala vehaya alecha damim
Vela yishtefech dam zakkay bego arach di Adonai elahach yahev lach achasana vihe alach chovat din diktol:
Vechi-yihye ish sone lereehu vearav lo vekam alav vehikkahu nefesh vamet venas el-achat hearim hael
Vaare yehe gevar sane lechavreh veyichman leh vikum alohi veyimchinneh nefash vimut veyeirok lachada min kirvayya haillen:
Veshalchu zikne iro velakchu oto mishsham venatnu oto beyad goel haddam vamet
Vishallechun save karteh veyidberun yateh mittamman veyittenun yateh beyad gael dema vimut:
Lo-tachos encha alav uviarta dam-hannaki miyyisrael vetov lach
La techus enach alohi utefalle ashdi dam zakkay miyyisrael veyetav lach:
Lo tassig gevul reacha asher gavlu rishonim benachalatcha asher tinchal baaretz asher Adonai elohecha noten lecha lerishtah
La tashne techuma dechavrach di techimu kadmae beachasantach di tachsen beara di Adonai elahach yahev lach lemerta:
Lo-yakum ed echad beish lechol-avon ulechol-chattat bechol-chet asher yecheta al-pi shene edim o al-pi shelosha-edim yakum davar
La yekum sahid chad bigvar lechol avvayan ulechal chovin bechol chet di yechta al memar teren sahadin o al memar telata sahadin yitkayyam pitgama:
Ki-yakum ed-chamas beish laanot bo sara
Are yekum sahid shekar bigvar leashada veh satya:
Veamdu shene-haanashim asher-lahem hariv lifne Adonai lifne hakkohanim vehashshoftim asher yihyu bayyamim hahem
Vikumun teren guvrin di lehon dina kodam Adonai kodam kahanayya vedayyanayya di yehon beyomayya hainnun:
Vedarshu hashshoftim hetev vehinne ed-sheker haed sheker ana veachiv
Veyitbeun dayyanayya yaut veha sahid shekar sahada shikra ashad baachohi:
Vaasitem lo kaasher zamam laasot leachiv uviarta hara mikkirbecha
Vetabedun leh kema di chashshiv lemebad laachohi utefalle aved devish mibbenach:
Vehannisharim yishmeu veyirau velo-yosifu laasot od kaddavar hara hazze bekirbecha
Udeyishtaarun yishmeun veyidchalun vela yosfun lemebad od kefitgama visha haden benach:
Velo tachos enecha nefesh benefesh ayin beayin shen beshen yad beyad regel beragel
Vela techus enach nafsha cholaf nafsha ena cholaf ena shinna cholaf shinna yeda cholaf yeda ragla cholaf ragla:
Ki-tetze lammilchama al-oyvecha veraita sus varechev am rav mimmecha lo tira mehem ki-Adonai elohecha immach hammaalcha meeretz mitzrayim
Are tippok laagacha kerava al baale devavach vetecheze susavan uretikkin am saggi minnach la tidchal minnehon are Adonai elahach memreh besadach deassekach meara demitzrayim:
Vehaya kekarovchem el-hammilchama veniggash hakkohen vedibber el-haam
Vihe kemikravchon laagacha kerava veyitkeriv kahana vimallel im amma:
Veamar alehem shema yisrael attem kerevim hayyom lammilchama al-oyvechem al-yerach levavchem al-tiru veal-tachpezu veal-taartzu mippenehem
Veyemar lehon shema yisrael attun kerivin yoma den laagacha kerava al baale devavechon la yezua libbechon la tidchalun vela tetebahatun vela tittavrun mikkodamehon:
Ki Adonai elohechem haholech immachem lehillachem lachem im-oyvechem lehoshia etchem
Are Adonai elahachon dimdabbar kodamechon laagacha lechon kerav im baale devavechon lemifrak yatchon:
Vedibberu hashshotrim el-haam lemor mi-haish asher bana vayit-chadash velo chanacho yelech veyashov leveto pen-yamut bammilchama veish acher yachnechennu
Vimallelun sarchayya kodam amma lememar man gavra di vena veta chadta vela chancheh yehach vituv leveteh dilma yemut baagacha kerava ugevar ochoran yachnechinneh:
Umi-haish asher-nata kerem velo chillelo yelech veyashov leveto pen-yamut bammilchama veish acher yechallelennu
Uman gavra di netziv karma vela achaleh yehach vituv leveteh dilma yemut baagacha kerava ugevar ochoran yechallinneh:
Umi-haish asher-eras ishsha velo lekachah yelech veyashov leveto pen-yamut bammilchama veish acher yikkachenna
Uman gavra di eras itteta vela nasva yehach vituv leveteh dilma yemut baagacha kerava ugevar ochoran yissevinna:
Veyasfu hashshotrim ledabber el-haam veamru mi-haish hayyare verach hallevav yelech veyashov leveto velo yimmas et-levav echav kilvavo
Veyosfun sarchayya lemallala im amma veyemrun man gavra dedachel utevir libba yehach vituv leveteh vela yittevar yat libba daachohi kelibbeh:
Vehaya kechallot hashshotrim ledabber el-haam ufakdu sare tzevaot berosh haam
Vihe kad yeshetzun sarchayya lemallala im amma vimannun rabbane chela beresh amma:
Ki-tikrav el-ir lehillachem aleha vekarata eleha leshalom
Are tikrav lekarta laagacha kerava ala vetikre la millin dishlam:
Vehaya im-shalom taancha ufatcha lach vehaya kol-haam hannimtza-vah yihyu lecha lamas vaavaducha
Vihe im shelam taaninnach vetiftach lach vihe kol amma deyishtechach ba yehon lach masseke missin veyiflechunnach:
Veim-lo tashlim immach veasta immecha milchama vetzarta aleha
Veim la tashlem immach vetabed immach kerav utetzur ala:
Unetanah Adonai elohecha beyadecha vehikkita et-kol-zechurah lefi-charev
Veyimserinna Adonai elahach bidach vetimche yat kol dechura lefitgam decharev:
Rak hannashim vehattaf vehabbehema vechol asher yihye vair kol-shelalah tavoz lach veachalta et-shelal oyvecha asher natan Adonai elohecha lach
Lechod neshayya vetafla uveira vechol di yehe vekarta kol adaa tevoz lach vetechul yat adaa desanach di yehav Adonai elahach lach:
Ken taase lechol-hearim harchokot mimmecha meod asher lo-meare haggoyim-haelle henna
Ken tabed lechol kirvayya di rechikin minnach lachada di la mikkirve ammayya haillen innun:
Rak meare haammim haelle asher Adonai elohecha noten lecha nachala lo techayye kol-neshama
Lechod mikkirve ammayya haillen di Adonai elahach yahev lach achasana la tekayyam kol nishmata:
Ki-hacharem tacharimem hachitti vehaemori hakkenaani vehapperizzi hachivvi vehayevusi kaasher tzivvecha Adonai elohecha
Are gammara tegammerinnun chittae veemorae kenaanae uferizzae chivvae vivusae kema di fakkedach Adonai elahach:
Lemaan asher lo-yelammedu etchem laasot kechol toavotam asher asu lelohehem vachatatem la-Adonai elohechem
Bedil di la yallefun yatchon lemebad kechal toavathon di avadu letaavathon utechovun kodam Adonai elahachon:
Ki-tatzur el-ir yamim rabbim lehillachem aleha letofsah lo-tashchit et-etzah lindoach alav garzen ki mimmennu tochel veoto lo tichrot ki haadam etz hassade lavo mippanecha bammatzor
Are tetzur lekarta yomin saggiin laagacha ala lemichbesha la techabbal yat ilana laarama alohi garzena are minneh techul veyateh la tekutz are la chaanasha ilan chakla lemeal mikkodamach bitzyara:
Rak etz asher-teda ki-lo-etz maachal hu oto tashchit vecharatta uvanita matzor al-hair asher-hiv osa immecha milchama ad ridtah
Lechod ilan detidda are la ilan demaachal hu yateh techabbal utekutz vetivne charkomin al karta di hi avda immach kerava ad detichbesha:
Ki-yimmatze chalal baadama asher Adonai elohecha noten lecha lerishtah nofel bassade lo noda mi hikkahu
Are yishtechach ketila beara di Adonai elahach yahev lach lemerta rame bechakla la ityeda man katleh:
Veyatzu zekenecha veshoftecha umadedu el-hearim asher sevivot hechalal
Veyippekun savaych vedayyanaych veyimshechun lekirvayya di sacharanut ketila:
Vehaya hair hakkerova el-hechalal velakchu zikne hair hahiv eglat bakar asher lo-ubbad bah asher lo-mashcha beol
Utehe karta dikariva liktila veyidberun save karta hahi eglat tore di la itpelach ba di la negidat benir:
Vehoridu zikne hair hahiv et-haegla el-nachal etan asher lo-yeaved bo velo yizzarea vearfu-sham et-haegla bannachal
Veyechetun save karta hahi yat agalta lenachala vayyar di la itpelach beh vela yizdera veyinkefun tamman yat agalta benachala:
Veniggeshu hakkohanim bene levi ki vam bachar Adonai elohecha lesharto ulevarech beshem Adonai veal-pihem yihye kol-riv vechol-naga
Veyitkarvun kahanayya bene levi are vehon yittire Adonai elahach leshammashuteh ulevaracha bishma daAdonai veal memrehon yehe kol din vechol machtash segiru:
Vechol zikne hair hahiv hakkerovim el-hechalal yirchatzu et-yedehem al-haegla haarufa vannachal
Vechol save karta hahi dikrivin liktila yaschun yat yedehon al agalta dinkefta venachala:
Veanu veamru yadenu lo shafchu et-haddam hazze veenenu lo rau
Vitivun veyemrun yedana la ashdo yat dema haden veenana la chazaa:
Kapper leammecha yisrael asher-padita Adonai veal-titten dam naki bekerev ammecha yisrael venikkapper lahem haddam
Kahanayya yemrun kappar leammach yisrael di ferakta Adonai vela titten chovat dam zakkay bego ammach yisrael veyitkappar lehon al dema:
Veatta tevaer haddam hannaki mikkirbecha ki-taase hayyashar beene Adonai
Veat tefalle ashdi dam zakkay mibbenach are tabed dechashar kodam Adonai:
Ki-tetze lammilchama al-oyvecha unetano Adonai elohecha beyadecha veshavita shivyo
Are tippok laagacha kerava al baale devavach veyimserinnun Adonai elahach bidach vetishbe shivyehon:
Veraita bashshivya eshet yefat-toar vechashakta vah velakachta lecha leishsha
Vetecheze beshivya itteta shappirat chezu vetitree va vetisseva lach leintu:
Vahavetah el-toch betecha vegillecha et-roshah veasta et-tzipporneha
Vetaelinna lego vetach utegallach yat resha uterabbi yat tuferanaha:
Vehesira et-simlat shivyah mealeha veyashva bevetecha uvachta et-aviha veet-immah yerach yamim veachar ken tavo eleha uvealtah vehayta lecha leishsha
Vetede yat kesut shivya minna vetetav bevetach vetivke yat avuha veyat imma yerach yomin uvatar ken teul levata vetivalinna utehe lach leintu:
Vehaya im-lo chafatzta bah veshillachtah lenafshah umachor lo-timkerenna bakkasef lo-titammer bah tachat asher innitah
Vihe im la titree va vetifterinna lenafsha vezabbana la tezabbeninna bechaspa la tittagar ba chalaf di innita:
Ki-tihyena leish shete nashim haachat ahuva vehaachat senua veyaldu-lo vanim haahuva vehassenua vehaya habben habbechor lassenia
Are tehevyan ligvar tarten neshin chada rechemta vachada seniata vilidan leh benin rechemta useniata vihe bera vuchera lisniata:
Vehaya beyom hanchilo et-banav et asher-yihye lo lo yuchal levakker et-ben-haahuva al-pene ven-hassenua habbechor
Vihe beyoma deyachasen livnohi yat di yehe leh let leh reshu levakkara yat bar rechemta al appe var seniata buchera:
Ki et-habbechor ben-hassenua yakkir latet lo pi shenayim bechol asher-yimmatze lo ki-hu reshit ono lo mishpat habbechora
Are yat buchera var seniata yafrash lemittan leh tarten cholakin bechol di yishtechach leh are hu resh takpeh leh chazya vecheruta:
Ki-yihye leish ben sorer umore enennu shomea bekol aviv uvekol immo veyisseru oto velo yishma alehem
Are yehe ligvar bar sate umare letohi mekabbal lememar avuhi ulememar immeh umallefan yateh vela yekabbel minnehon:
Vetafsu vo aviv veimmo vehotziu oto el-zikne iro veel-shaar mekomo
Veyechedun beh avuhi veimmeh veyappekun yateh lokodam save karteh velitra bet din atreh:
Veamru el-zikne iro benenu ze sorer umore enennu shomea bekolenu zolel vesove
Veyemrun lesave karteh benana den sate umare letohi mekabbel lememrana zalel besar vesave chamar:
Uregamuhu kol-anshe iro vaavanim vamet uviarta hara mikkirbecha vechol-yisrael yishmeu veyirau
Veyirgemunneh kol gavre karteh beavnayya vimut utefalle aved devish mibbenach vechol yisrael yishmeun veyidchalun:
Vechi-yihye veish chet mishpat-mavet vehumat vetalita oto al-etz
Vaare yehe vigvar chovat din diktol veyitketel vetitzlov yateh al tzeliva:
Lo-talin nivlato al-haetz ki-kavor tikberennu bayyom hahu ki-killat elohim taluy velo tetamme et-admatcha asher Adonai elohecha noten lecha nachala
La tevit nevilteh al tzeliva are mikbar tikberinneh beyoma hahu are al dechav kodam Adonai itztelav vela tesaev yat arach di Adonai elahach yahev lach achasana:
Lo-tire et-shor achicha o et-seyo niddachim vehitallamta mehem hashev teshivem leachicha
La techeze yat tora deachuch o yat immereh detaan vetitkevesh minnehon atava tatevinnun leachuch:
Veim-lo karov achicha elecha velo yedato vaasafto el-toch betecha vehaya immecha ad derosh achicha oto vahashevoto lo
Veim la karev achuch levatach vela yedaat leh vetachneshinneh lego vetach vihe immach ad deyitba achuch yateh vetatevinneh leh:
Vechen taase lachamoro vechen taase lesimlato vechen taase lechol-avedat achicha asher-tovad mimmennu umetzatah lo tuchal lehitallem
Vechen tabed lachamareh vechen tabed lichsuteh vechen tabed lechol avedat achuch di tevad minneh vetashkechinna let lach reshu leitkassaa:
Lo-tire et-chamor achicha o shoro noflim badderech vehitallamta mehem hakem takim immo
La techeze yat chamara deachuch o toreh raman beorcha vetitkevesh minnehon akama tekim immeh:
Lo-yihye cheli-gever al-ishsha velo-yilbash gever simlat ishsha ki toavat Adonai elohecha kol-ose elle
La yehe tikkun zen digvar al itteta vela yetakken gevar betikkune itteta are merachak kodam Adonai elahach kol aved illen:
Ki yikkare kan-tzippor lefanecha badderech bechol-etz o al-haaretz efrochim o vetzim vehaem rovetzet al-haefrochim o al-habbetzim lo-tikkach haem al-habbanim
Are yeara kinna detzippera kodamach beorcha bechol ilan o al ara efrochin o vein veima revea al efrochin o al bein la tissav imma al benayya:
Shalleach teshallach et-haem veet-habbanim tikkach-lach lemaan yitav lach vehaarachta yamim
Shallacha teshallach yat imma veyat benayya tissav lach bedil deyetav lach vetorich yomin:
Ki tivne bayit chadash veasita maake legaggecha velo-tasim damim bevetecha ki-yippol hannofel mimmennu
Are tivne beta chadta vetabed teyaka leiggerach vela teshavvi chovat din diktol bevetach are yippel denafel minneh:
