Lo-tizra karmecha kilayim pen-tikdash hamelea hazzera asher tizra utevuat hakkarem
La tizra karmach eruvin dilma tistaav dimat zara di tizra vaalalat karma:
Lo-tacharosh beshor-uvachamor yachdav
La tirde vetora uvachamara kachada:
Lo tilbash shaatnez tzemer ufishtim yachdav
La tilbash shaatneza amar vechittan mechubbar kachada:
Gedilim taase-llach al-arba kanfot kesutecha asher techasse-bbah
Keruspedin tabed lach al arba kanfe chesutach di techasse va:
Ki-yikkach ish ishsha uva eleha useneah
Are yissav gevar itteta veyeul levata veyisninna:
Vesam lah alilot devarim vehotzi aleha shem ra veamar et-haishsha hazzot lakachti vaekrav eleha velo-matzati lah betulim
Vishavvi la taskofe millin veyappek ala shum bish veyemar yat itteta hada nesevit veallit levata vela ashkachit la betulin:
Velakach avi hannaara veimmah vehotziu et-betule hannaara el-zikne hair hashshara
Veyissav avuha deulemta veimma veyappekun yat betule ulemta lokodam save karta litra bet din atra:
Veamar avi hannaara el-hazzekenim et-bitti natatti laish hazze leishsha vayyisnaeha
Veyemar avuha deulemta lesavayya yat beratti yehavit legavra haden leintu useninna:
Vehinne-hu sam alilot devarim lemor lo-matzati levittecha betulim veelle betule vitti ufarsu hassimla lifne zikne hair
Veha hu shavvi taskofe millin lememar la ashkachit livrattach betulin veillen betule veratti veyifresun shoshifa kodam save karta:
Velakchu zikne hair-hahiv et-haish veyisseru oto
Veyidberun save karta hahi yat gavra veyalkun yateh:
Veanshu oto mea chesef venatnu laavi hannaara ki hotzi shem ra al betulat yisrael velo-tihye leishsha lo-yuchal leshallechah kol-yamav
Veyigbun minneh mea silin dichsaf veyittenun laavuha deulemta are appek shum bish al betuleta deyisrael veleh tehe leintu let leh reshu lemiftera kol yomohi:
Veim-emet haya haddavar hazze lo-nimtzeu vetulim lannaara
Veim kushta hava pitgama haden la ishtechachu vetulin leulemta:
Vehotziu et-hannaara el-petach bet-aviha usekaluha anshe irah baavanim vameta ki-asta nevala beyisrael liznot bet aviha uviarta hara mikkirbecha
Veyappekun yat ulemta litra bet avuha veyirgemunna enashe karta beavnayya utemut are avdat kelana beyisrael lezannaa bet avuha utefalle aved devish mibbenach:
Ki-yimmatze ish shochev im-ishsha veulat-baal umetu gam-shenehem haish hashshochev im-haishsha vehaishsha uviarta hara miyyisrael
Are yishtechach gevar deshachev im itteta ittat gevar veyitkattelun af tarvehon gavra deshachev im itteta veitteta utefalle aved devish miyyisrael:
Ki yihye naara vetula meorasa leish umetzaah ish bair veshachav immah
Are tehe ulemta vetulta dimarsa ligvar veyashkechinna gevar bekarta veyishkuv imma:
Vehotzetem et-shenehem el-shaar hair hahiv usekaltem otam baavanim vametu et-hannaara al-devar asher lo-tzaaka vair veet-haish al-devar asher-inna et-eshet reehu uviarta hara mikkirbecha
Vetappekun yat tarvehon litra karta hahi vetirgemun yathon beavnayya vimutun yat ulemta al esak di la tzevachat bekarta veyat gavra al esak deanni yat ittat chavreh utefalle aved devish mibbenach:
Veim-bassade yimtza haish et-hannaara hameorasa vehechezik-bah haish veshachav immah umet haish asher-shachav immah levaddo
Veim bechakla yashkach gevar yat ulemta dimarsa veyitkef ba gavra veyishkuv imma veyitketel gavra deshachev imma bilchodohi:
Velannaara lo-taase davar en lannaara chet mavet ki kaasher yakum ish al-reehu uretzacho nefesh ken haddavar hazze
Uleulemta la tabed middaam let leulemta chovat din diktol are kema dikum gavra al chavreh veyiktelinneh nefash ken pitgama haden:
Ki vassade metzaah tzaaka hannaara hameorasa veen moshia lah
Are vechakla ashkecha tzevachat ulemta dimarsa velet defarik la:
Ki-yimtza ish naara vetula asher lo-orasa utefasah veshachav immah venimtzau
Are yashkach gevar ulemta vetulta di la mearsa veyechedinna veyishkuv imma veyishtakkechun:
Venatan haish hashshochev immah laavi hannaara chamishshim kasef velo-tihye leishsha tachat asher innah lo-yuchal shallechah kol-yamav
Veyitten gavra deyishkuv imma laavuha deulemta chamshin silin dichsaf veleh tehe leintu cholaf di anya let leh reshu lemiftera kol yomohi:
Lo-yikkach ish et-eshet aviv velo yegalle kenaf aviv
La yissav gevar yat ittat avuhi vela yegalle kanfa daavuhi:
Lo-yavo fetzua-ddakka ucherut shofcha bikhal Adonai
La yidke defasik vedimchabbal lemeal bikhala daAdonai:
Lo-yavo mamzer bikhal Adonai gam dor asiri lo-yavo lo bikhal Adonai
La yidke mamzera lemeal bikhala daAdonai af dara asiraa la yidke leh lemeal bikhala daAdonai:
Lo-yavo ammoni umoavi bikhal Adonai gam dor asiri lo-yavo lahem bikhal Adonai ad-olam
La yidkun ammonae umoavae lemeal bikhala daAdonai af dara asiraa la yidke lehon lemeal bikhala daAdonai ad olam:
Al-devar asher lo-kiddemu etchem ballechem uvammayim badderech betzetchem mimmitzrayim vaasher sachar alecha et-bilam ben-beor mippetor aram naharayim lekallekka
Al esak di la arau yatchon belachma uvemayya beorcha bemippakchon mimmitzrayim vedi agar alach yat bilam bar beor mippetor aram di al perat lelattayutach:
Velo-ava Adonai elohecha lishmoa el-bilam vayyahafoch Adonai elohecha lecha et-hakkelala livracha ki ahevcha Adonai elohecha
Vela ave Adonai elahach lekabbala min bilam vahafach Adonai elahach lach yat levatin levirchan are rachamach Adonai elahach:
Lo-tidrosh shelomam vetovatam kol-yamecha leolam
La titba shelamhon vetavathon kol yomaych lealam:
Lo-tetaev adomi ki achicha hu lo-tetaev mitzri ki-ger hayita veartzo
La terachak edomaa are achuch hu la terachak mitzraa are dayyar haveta veareh:
Banim asher-yivvaldu lahem dor shelishi yavo lahem bikhal Adonai
Benin di yityelidu lehon dara telitaa yidke lehon lemeal bikhala daAdonai:
Ki-tetze machane al-oyvecha venishmarta mikkol davar ra
Are tippok mashrita al baale devavach vetistammar mikkol middaam bish:
Ki-yihye vecha ish asher lo-yihye tahor mikkere-layla veyatza el-michutz lammachane lo yavo el-toch hammachane
Are yehe vach gevar di la yehe deche mikkere lelya veyippok lemibbara lemashrita la yeul lego mashrita:
Vehaya lifnot-erev yirchatz bammayim uchevo hashshemesh yavo el-toch hammachane
Vihe lemifne ramsha yasche vemayya uchemeal shimsha yeul lego mashrita:
Veyad tihye lecha michutz lammachane veyatzata shamma chutz
Vaatar metakkan yehe lach mibbara lemashrita vetippok tamman levara:
Veyated tihye lecha al-azenecha vehaya beshivtecha chutz vechafarta vah veshavta vechissita et-tzeatecha
Vesikketa tehe lach al zenach vihe bemitvach levara vetachpar ba utetuv utechasse yat mippekatach:
Ki Adonai elohecha mithallech bekerev machanecha lehatztzilcha velatet oyvecha lefanecha vehaya machanecha kadosh velo-yire vecha ervat davar veshav meacharecha
Are Adonai elahach shechinteh mehallecha bego mashritach leshezavutach ulemimsar baale devavach kodamach utehe mashritach kaddisha vela yitchaze vach averat pitgam vituv memreh milleotava lach:
Lo-tasgir eved el-adonav asher-yinnatzel elecha meim adonav
La timsar eved ammin leyad ribboneh deyishtezev levatach millevat ribboneh:
Immecha yeshev bekirbecha bammakom asher-yivchar beachad shearecha battov lo lo tonennu
Immach yittev benach beatra di yittire bachada min kirvaych bidyetav leh la toninneh:
Lo-tihye kedesha mibbenot yisrael velo-yihye kadesh mibbene yisrael
La tehe itteta mibbenat yisrael ligvar aved vela yissav gavra mibbene yisrael itteta ama:
Lo-tavi etnan zona umechir kelev bet Adonai elohecha lechol-neder ki toavat Adonai elohecha gam-shenehem
La tael agar zannita vechulefan kalba levet makdesha daAdonai elahach lechol nidra are merachak kodam Adonai elahach af tarvehon:
Lo-tashshich leachicha neshech kesef neshech ochel neshech kol-davar asher yishshach
La terabbe laachuch ribbit kesaf ribbit ivur ribbit kol middaam demitrabbe:
Lannochri tashshich uleachicha lo tashshich lemaan yevarechcha Adonai elohecha bechol mishlach yadecha al-haaretz asher-atta va-shamma lerishtah
Levar ammin terabbe velaachuch la terabbe bedil divarechinnach Adonai elahach bechol oshatut yedach al ara di at alel letamman lemerta:
Ki-tiddor neder la-Adonai elohecha lo teacher leshallemo ki-darosh yidreshennu Adonai elohecha meimmach vehaya vecha chet
Are tiddar nedar kodam Adonai elahach la teachar leshallamuteh are mitba yitbeinneh Adonai elahach minnach vihe vach chova:
Vechi techdal lindor lo-yihye vecha chet
Vaare tittimna lemindar la yehe vach chova:
Motza sefatecha tishmor veasita kaasher nadarta la-Adonai elohecha nedava asher dibbarta beficha
Appakut sifvatach tittar vetabed kema di nedarta kodam Adonai elahach nedavta di mallelta befumach:
Ki tavo becherem reecha veachalta anavim kenafshecha sovecha veel-kelyecha lo titten
Are tittagar becharma dechavrach vetechul innevin kenafshach sivach ulemanach la titten:
Ki tavo bekamat reecha vekatafta melilot beyadecha vechermesh lo tanif al kamat reecha
Are tittagar bekamta dechavrach vetiktof melilan bidach umagla la terim al kamta dechavrach:
Ki-yikkach ish ishsha uvealah vehaya im-lo timtza-chen beenav ki-matza vah ervat davar vechatav lah sefer keritut venatan beyadah veshillechah mibbeto
Are yissav gevar itteta veyivalinna vihe im la tashkach rachamin beenohi are ashkach ba averat pitgam veyichtov la get pitturin vihav bida veyifterinna mibbeteh:
Veyatza mibbeto vehalcha vehayta leish-acher
Vetippok mibbeteh utehach utehe ligvar ochoran:
Useneah haish haacharon vechatav lah sefer keritut venatan beyadah veshillechah mibbeto o chi yamut haish haacharon asher-lekachah lo leishsha
Veyisninna gavra vatraa veyichtov la get pitturin veyitten bida veyifterinna mibbeteh o are yemut gavra vatraa denasva leh leintu:
Lo-yuchal balah harishon asher-shillechah lashuv lekachtah lihyot lo leishsha achare asher huttammaa ki-toeva hiv lifne Adonai velo tachati et-haaretz asher Adonai elohecha noten lecha nachala
Let leh reshu levaala kadmaa di fatra lemittuv lemisseva lemeheve leh leintu batar di istaavat are merachaka hi kodam Adonai vela techayyav yat ara di Adonai elahach yahev lach achasana:
Ki-yikkach ish ishsha chadasha lo yetze batztzava velo-yaavor alav lechol-davar naki yihye leveto shana echat vesimmach et-ishto asher-lakach
Are yissav gevar itteta chadta la yippok bechela vela yeivar alohi lechol middaam pane yehe leveteh shatta chada veyachde yat itteteh di nesav:
Lo-yachavol rechayim varachev ki-nefesh hu chovel
La yissav mashkona richya verichba are vehon mitaved mazon lechol nefash:
Ki-yimmatze ish gonev nefesh meechav mibbene yisrael vehitammer-bo umecharo umet haggannav hahu uviarta hara mikkirbecha
Are yishtechach gevar ganev nafsha meachohi mibbene yisrael veyittagar beh vizabbeninneh veyitketel gannava hahu utefalle aved devish mibbenach:
Hishshamer benega-hatztzaraat lishmor meod velaasot kechol asher-yoru etchem hakkohanim haleviyyim kaasher tzivvitim tishmeru laasot
Istammar bemachtash segiru lemittar lachada ulemebad kechol di yallefun yatchon kahanayya levae kema di fakkedtinnun titterun lemebad:
Zachor et asher-asa Adonai elohecha lemiryam badderech betzetchem mimmitzrayim
Have dechir yat di avad Adonai elahach lemiryam beorcha bemippakchon mimmitzrayim:
Ki-tashshe vereacha mashshat meuma lo-tavo el-beto laavot avoto
Are tarshe vechavrach reshu middaam la teul leveteh lemissav mashkoneh:
Bachutz taamod vehaish asher atta noshe vo yotzi elecha et-haavot hachutza
Bevara tekum vegavra di at rashe veh yappek levatach yat mashkona levara:
Veim-ish ani hu lo tishkav baavoto
Veim gevar misken hu la tishkuv bemashkoneh:
Hashev tashiv lo et-haavot kevo hashshemesh veshachav besalmato uverchekka ulecha tihye tzedaka lifne Adonai elohecha
Atava tatev leh yat mashkona kemeal shimsha veyishkuv bichsuteh vivarechinnach velach tehe zechuta kodam Adonai elahach:
Lo-taashok sachir ani veevyon meachecha o miggercha asher beartzecha bisharecha
La teishshuk agira anya umiskena meachaych o miggiyyorach di vearach bekirvaych:
Beyomo titten secharo velo-tavo alav hashshemesh ki ani hu veelav hu nose et-nafsho velo-yikra alecha el-Adonai vehaya vecha chet
Beyomeh titten agreh vela teul alohi shimsha are anya hu veleh hu mesar yat nafsheh vela yikre alach kodam Adonai vihe vach chova:
Lo-yumetu avot al-banim uvanim lo-yumetu al-avot ish becheto yumatu
La yemutun avahan al pum benin uvenin la yemutun al pum avahan enash bechoveh yemutun:
Lo tatte mishpat ger yatom velo tachavol beged almana
La tatzle din giyyora veyittamma vela tissav mashkona levush armela:
Vezacharta ki eved hayita bemitzrayim vayyifdecha Adonai elohecha mishsham al-ken anochi metzavvecha laasot et-haddavar hazze
Vetidkar are avda haveta bemitzrayim ufarkach Adonai elahach mittamman al ken ana mefakkedach lemebad yat pitgama haden:
Ki tiktzor ketzircha vesadecha veshachachta omer bassade lo tashuv lekachto lagger layyatom velaalmana yihye lemaan yevarechcha Adonai elohecha bechol maase yadecha
Are tachtzod chatzadach bechaklach vetinshe umra vechakla la tetuv lemisseveh legiyyora leyittamma ulearmela yehe bedil divarechinnach Adonai elahach bechol ovade yedach:
Ki tachbot zetcha lo tefaer acharecha lagger layyatom velaalmana yihye
Are tachbot zetach la tefalle batrach legiyyora leyittamma ulearmela yehe:
Ki tivtzor karmecha lo teolel acharecha lagger layyatom velaalmana yihye
Are tiktof karmach la tealel batrach legiyyora leyittamma ulearmela yehe:
Vezacharta ki-eved hayita beeretz mitzrayim al-ken anochi metzavvecha laasot et-haddavar hazze
Vetidkar are avda haveta beara demitzrayim al ken ana mefakkedach lemebad yat pitgama haden:
Ki-yihye riv ben anashim veniggeshu el-hammishpat ushefatum vehitzdiku et-hatztzaddik vehirshiu et-harasha
Are yehe din ben guvrayya veyitkarvun ledina vidununnun vizakkun yat zakkaa vichayyevun yat chayyava:
Vehaya im-bin hakkot harasha vehippilo hashshofet vehikkahu lefanav kede rishato bemispar
Vihe im bar chayyava lealkaa chayyava veyirminneh dayyana veyalkinneh kodamohi kemissat chovteh beminyan:
Arbaim yakkennu lo yosif pen-yosif lehakkoto al-elle makka rabba venikla achicha leenecha
Arbein yalkinneh la yosef dilma yosef lealkayuteh al illen macha rabba veyekal achuch leenaych:
Lo-tachsom shor bedisho
La techod pum tora bidyasheh:
Ki-yeshvu achim yachdav umet achad mehem uven en-lo lo-tihye eshet-hammet hachutza leish zar yevamah yavo aleha ulekachah lo leishsha veyibbemah
Are yetvun achin kachada vimut chad minnehon uvar let leh la tehe ittat metana levara ligvar ocharan yevama yeul ala veyisseva leh leintu veyibbema:
Vehaya habbechor asher teled yakum al-shem achiv hammet velo-yimmache shemo miyyisrael
Vihe vuchera di telid yekum al shema daachuhi metana vela yittimche shemeh miyyisrael:
Veim-lo yachpotz haish lakachat et-yevimto vealta yevimto hashshara el-hazzekenim veamra meen yevami lehakim leachiv shem beyisrael lo ava yabbemi
Veim la yitzve gavra lemissav yat yevimteh vetissak yevimteh litra bet dina lokodam savayya vetemar la tzave yevami laakama laachuhi shema beyisrael la ave leyabbamuti:
Vekaru-lo zikne-iro vedibberu elav veamad veamar lo chafatzti lekachtah
Veyikrun leh save karteh vimallelun immeh vikum veyemar la reena lemisba:
Veniggesha yevimto elav leene hazzekenim vechaltza naalo meal raglo veyarka befanav veanta veamra kacha yease laish asher lo-yivne et-bet achiv
Vetitkerav yevimteh levateh lokodam savayya vetashre seneh meal ragleh veterok beanpohi vetatev vetemar keden yitaved ligvar di la yivne yat beta daachuhi:
Venikra shemo beyisrael bet chalutz hannaal
Veyitkere shemeh beyisrael bet sheri sena:
Ki-yinnatzu anashim yachdav ish veachiv vekarva eshet haechad lehatztzil et-ishah miyyad makkehu veshalcha yadah vehechezika bimvushav
Are yintzun guvrin kachada gevar vaachuhi vetitkerev ittat chad leshezava yat baala miyyad machuhi vetoshet yeda vetitkef bevet bahatteteh:
Vekatztzota et-kappah lo tachos enecha
Utekutz yat yeda la techus enach:
Lo-yihye lecha bechischa even vaaven gedola uketanna
La yehe lach bechisach matkal umatkal rabbeta uzeerta:
Lo-yihye lecha bevetcha efa veefa gedola uketanna
La yehe lach bevetach mechila umechila rabbeta uzeerta:
Even shelema vatzedek yihye-llach efa shelema vatzedek yihye-llach lemaan yaarichu yamecha al haadama asher-Adonai elohecha noten lach
Matkelin shalmin dikshot yehon lach mechilan shalmin dikshot yehon lach bedil deyorchun yomaych al ara daAdonai elahach yahev lach:
Ki toavat Adonai elohecha kol-ose elle kol ose avel
Are merachak kodam Adonai elahach kol aved illen kol aved shekar:
Zachor et asher-asa lecha amalek badderech betzetchem mimmitzrayim
Have dechir yat di avad lach amalek beorcha bemippakchon mimmitzrayim:
Asher karcha badderech vayzannev becha kol-hannecheshalim acharecha veatta ayef veyagea velo yare elohim
Di arach beorcha vekatel bach kol dahavo mitacharin batrach veat meshalhe velae vela dachel min kodam Adonai:
Vehaya behaniach Adonai elohecha lecha mikkol-oyvecha missaviv baaretz asher Adonaielohecha noten lecha nachala lerishtah timche et-zecher amalek mittachat hashshamayim lo tishkach
Vihe kad yeniach Adonai elahach lach mikkol baale devavach missechor sechor beara di Adonai elahach yahev lach achasana lemerta timche yat ducherana daamalek mittechot shemayya la tittinshe:
Vehaya ki-tavo el-haaretz asher Adonai elohecha noten lecha nachala virishtah veyashavta bah
Vihe are teul leara di Adonai elahach yahev lach achasana veterta vetetev ba:
Velakachta mereshit kol-peri haadama asher tavi meartzecha asher Adonai elohecha noten lach vesamta vattene vehalachta el-hammakom asher yivchar Adonai elohecha leshakken shemo sham
Vetissav meresh kol ibba deara di tael mearach di Adonai elahach yahev lach uteshavve vesalla utehach leatra di yittire Adonai elahach leashraa shechinteh tamman:
Uvata el-hakkohen asher yihye bayyamim hahem veamarta elav higgadti hayyom la-Adonai elohecha ki-vati el-haaretz asher nishba Adonai laavotenu latet lanu
Vetete levat kahana di yehe beyomayya hainnun vetemar leh chavveti yoma den kodam Adonai elahach are allit leara di kayyim Adonai laavahatana lemittan lana:
Velakach hakkohen hattene miyyadecha vehinnicho lifne mizbach Adonai elohecha
Veyissav kahana salla midach veyachtinneh kodam madbecha daAdonai elahach:
Veanita veamarta lifne Adonai elohecha arammi oved avi vayyered mitzrayma vayyagor sham bimte meat vayhi-sham legoy gadol atzum varav
Vetatev vetemar kodam Adonai elahach lavan arammaa baa leovada yat abba unechat lemitzrayim vedar tamman beam zeer vahava tamman leam rav takkif vesaggi:
Vayyareu otanu hammitzrim vayannunu vayyittenu alenu avoda kasha
Veavishu lana mitzrayim veanneyana vihavu alana palchana kashya:
Vannitzak el-Adonai elohe avotenu vayyishma Adonai et-kolenu vayyar et-onyenu veet-amalenu veet-lachatzenu
Vetzallena kodam Adonai elaha daavahatana vekabbil Adonai tzelotana ugele kodamohi amlana veleutana veduchakana:
Vayyotzienu Adonai mimmitzrayim beyad chazaka uvizroa netuya uvemora gadol uveotot uvemoftim
Veappekana Adonai mimmitzrayim bida takkifa uvidraa meramema uvechezvana rabba uveatin uvemoftin:
Vayvienu el-hammakom hazze vayyitten-lanu et-haaretz hazzot eretz zavat chalav udevash
Veaytana leatra haden vihav lana yat ara hada ara avda chalav udevash:
Veatta hinne heveti et-reshit peri haadama asher-natatta li Adonai vehinnachto lifne Adonai elohecha vehishtachavita lifne Adonai elohecha
Uchean ha ayteti yat resh ibba deara dihavt li Adonai vetachtineh kodam Adonai elahach vetisgud kodam Adonai elahach:
Vesamachta vechol-hattov asher natan-lecha Adonai elohecha ulevetecha atta vehallevi vehagger asher bekirbecha
Vetechede vechal tavta di yehav lach Adonai elahach veleenash betach at velevae vegiyyora di venach:
Ki techalle laser et-kol-masar tevuatcha bashshana hashshelishit shenat hammaaser venatatta lallevi lagger layyatom velaalmana veochlu visharecha vesaveu
Are teshetze leassara yat kol maasar alaltach beshatta telitaa shenat masera vetitten lelevae legiyyora leyittamma ulearmela veyechlun bekirvaych veyisbeun:
Veamarta lifne Adonai elohecha biarti hakkodesh min-habbayit vegam netattiv lallevi velagger layyatom velaalmana kechol-mitzvatcha asher tzivvitani lo-avarti mimmitzvotecha velo shachachti
Vetemar kodam Adonai elahach palleti kodesh masera min beta veaf yehavitteh lelevae ulegiyyora leyittamma ulearmela kechal pikkudach di fakkidtani la avarit mippikkudaych vela ittinsheti:
Lo-achalti veoni mimmennu velo-viarti mimmennu betame velo-natatti mimmennu lemet shamati bekol Adonai elohay asiti kechol asher tzivvitani
La achalit beevli minneh vela falleti minneh bedimsaav vela yehavit minneh lemit kabbelit lememra daAdonai elahay avadit kechol di fakkidtani:
Hashkifa mimmeon kodshecha min-hashshamayim uvarech et-ammecha et-yisrael veet haadama asher natatta lanu kaasher nishbata laavotenu eretz zavat chalav udevash
Istechi mimmedor kodshach min shemayya uvarech yat ammach yat yisrael veyat ara di yehavt lana kema di kayyemta laavahatana ara avda chalav udevash:
Hayyom hazze Adonai elohecha metzavvecha laasot et-hachukkim haelle veet-hammishpatim veshamarta veasita otam bechol-levavcha uvechol-nafshecha
Yoma haden Adonai elahach mefakkedach lemebad yat keyamayya haillen veyat dinayya vetittar vetabed yathon bechol libbach uvechol nafshach:
Et-Adonai heemarta hayyom lihyot lecha lelohim velalechet bidrachav velishmor chukkav umitzvotav umishpatav velishmoa bekolo
Yat Adonai chatavta yoma den lemeheve lach leelah velimhach beorchan detaknan kodamohi ulemittar keyamohi ufikkudohi vedinohi ulekabbala vememreh:
Va-Adonai heemircha hayyom lihyot lo leam segulla kaasher dibber-lach velishmor kol-mitzvotav
Vayya chatvach yoma den lemeheve leh leam chabbiv kema di mallil lach ulemittar kol pikkudohi:
Uletittecha elyon al kol-haggoyim asher asa lithilla uleshem uletifaret velihyotcha am-kadosh la-Adonai elohecha kaasher dibber
Ulemittenach illaa al kol ammayya di avad letushbacha uleshum velirvu ulemehevach am kaddish kodam Adonai elahach kema di mallil:
Vaytzav moshe vezikne yisrael et-haam lemor shamor et-kol-hammitzva asher anochi metzavve etchem hayyom
Ufakkid mshe vesave yisrael yat amma lememar tar yat kol tafkedta di ana mefakked yatchon yoma den:
Vehaya bayyom asher taavru et-hayyarden el-haaretz asher-Adonai elohecha noten lach vahakemota lecha avanim gedolot vesadta otam bassid
Vihe beyoma di taberun yat yardena leara daAdonai elahach yahev lach utekim lach avnin ravrevin utesud yathon besida:
Vechatavta alehen et-kol-divre hattora hazzot beovrecha lemaan asher tavo el-haaretz asher-Adonai elohecha noten lecha eretz zavat chalav udevash kaasher dibber Adonai elohe-avotecha lach
Vetichtov alehon yat kol pitgame orayta hada bemeberach bedil di teul leara daAdonai elahach yahev lach ara avda chalav udevash kema di mallil Adonai elaha daavahatach lach:
Vehaya beovrechem et-hayyarden takimu et-haavanim haelle asher anochi metzavve etchem hayyom behar eval vesadta otam bassid
Vihe bemeavarchon yat yardena tekimun yat avnayya haillen di ana mefakked yatchon yoma den betura deeval utesud yathon besida:
Uvanita sham mizbeach la-Adonai elohecha mizbach avanim lo-tanif alehem barzel
Vetivne tamman madbecha kodam Adonai elahach madbach avnin la terim alehon parzela:
Avanim shelemot tivne et-mizbach Adonai elohecha vehaalita alav olot la-Adonai elohecha
Avnin shalmin tivne yat madbecha daAdonai elahach vetassek alohi alavan kodam Adonai elahach:
Vezavachta shelamim veachalta sham vesamachta lifne Adonai elohecha
Vetikkos nichsat kudeshin vetechul tamman vetechede kodam Adonai elahach:
Vechatavta al-haavanim et-kol-divre hattora hazzot baer hetev
Vetichtov al avnayya yat kol pitgame orayta hada parash yaut:
Vaydabber moshe vehakkohanim haleviyyim el kol-yisrael lemor hasket ushema yisrael hayyom hazze nihyeta leam la-Adonai elohecha
Umallil mshe vechahanayya levae lechol yisrael lememar atzet ushema yisrael yoma haden haveta leamma kodam Adonai elahach:
Veshamata bekol Adonai elohecha veasita et-mitzvotav veet-chukkav asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom
Utekabbel lememra daAdonai elahach vetabed yat pikkudohi veyat keyamohi di ana mefakkedach yoma den:
Vaytzav moshe et-haam bayyom hahu lemor
Ufakkid mshe yat amma beyoma hahu lememar:
Elle yaamdu levarech et-haam al-har gerizim beovrechem et-hayyarden shimon velevi vihuda veyissashchar veyosef uvinyamin
Illen yekumun levaracha yat amma al tura digrizzim bemeavarchon yat yardena shimon velevi vihuda veyissaschar veyosef uvinyamin:
Veelle yaamdu al-hakkelala behar eval reuven gad veasher uzevulun dan venaftali
Veillen yekumun al levatayya betura deeval reuven gad veasher uzevulun dan venaftali:
Veanu haleviyyim veamru el-kol-ish yisrael kol ram
Vitivun levae veyemrun lechol enash yisrael kala rama:
Arur haish asher yaase fesel umassecha toavat Adonai maase yede charash vesam bassater veanu chol-haam veamru amen
Lit gavra di yabed tzelem umattecha merachaka kodam Adonai ovad yede aman umeshavvi vesitra vitivun kol amma veyemrun amen:
Arur makle aviv veimmo veamar kol-haam amen
Lit deyikle avuhi veimmeh veyemar kol amma amen:
Arur massig gevul reehu veamar kol-haam amen
Lit deyishne techuma dechavreh veyemar kol amma amen:
Arur mashge ivver baddarech veamar kol-haam amen
Lit deyate avvira beorcha veyemar kol amma amen:
Arur matte mishpat ger-yatom vealmana veamar kol-haam amen
Lit deyatzle din dayyar yittamma vearmela veyemar kol amma amen:
Arur shochev im-eshet aviv ki gilla kenaf aviv veamar kol-haam amen
Lit deyishkuv im ittat avuhi are galli kanfa daavuhi veyemar kol amma amen:
Arur shochev im-kol-behema veamar kol-haam amen
Lit deyishkuv im kol beira veyemar kol amma amen:
Arur shochev im-achoto bat-aviv o vat-immo veamar kol-haam amen
Lit deyishkuv im achateh bat avuhi o vat immeh veyemar kol amma amen:
Arur shochev im-chotanto veamar kol-haam amen
Lit deyishkuv im chamoteh veyemar kol amma amen:
Arur makke reehu bassater veamar kol-haam amen
Lit deyimche lechavreh besitra veyemar kol amma amen:
Arur lokeach shochad lehakkot nefesh dam naki veamar kol-haam amen
Lit di mekabbel shochada lemiktal nefash dam zakkay veyemar kol amma amen:
Arur asher lo-yakim et-divre hattora-hazzot laasot otam veamar kol-haam amen
Lit di la yekayyam yat pitgame orayta hada lemebad yathon veyemar kol amma amen:
Vehaya im-shamoa tishma bekol Adonai elohecha lishmor laasot et-kol-mitzvotav asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom unetancha Adonai elohecha elyon al kol-goye haaretz
Vihe im kabbala tekabbel lememra daAdonai elahach lemittar lemebad yat kol pikkudohi di ana mefakkedach yoma den veyitteninnach Adonai elahach illay al kol amme ara:
Uvau alecha kol-habberachot haelle vehissigucha ki tishma bekol Adonai elohecha
Veyetun alach kol birketa haillen veyidbekunnach are tekabbal lememra daAdonai elahach:
Baruch atta bair uvaruch atta bassade
Berich at bekarta uverich at bechakla:
Baruch peri-vitnecha uferi admatcha uferi vehemtecha shegar alafecha veashterot tzonecha
Berich valda dimach veibba dearach uvalda divirach bakre toraych veedre anach:
Baruch tanacha umishartecha
Berich sallach veatzvatach:
Baruch atta bevoecha uvaruch atta betzetecha
Berich at bemealach uverich at bemippekach:
Yitten Adonai et-oyvecha hakkamim alecha niggafim lefanecha bederech echad yetzu elecha uveshiva derachim yanusu lefanecha
Yitten Adonai yat baale devavach dekaymin alach tevirin kodamach beorcha chad yippekun levatach uveshiva orchan yeirkun mikkodamach:
Yetzav Adonai ittecha et-habberacha baasamecha uvechol mishlach yadecha uverachcha baaretz asher-Adonai elohecha noten lach
Yefakked Adonai immach yat birketa beotzarach uvechol oshatut yedach vivarechinnach beara daAdonai elahach yahev lach:
Yekimcha Adonai lo leam kadosh kaasher nishba-lach ki tishmor et-mitzvot Adonai elohecha vehalachta bidrachav
Yekiminnach Adonai leh leam kaddish kema di kayyim lach are tittar yat pikkudayya daAdonai elahach utehach beorchan detaknan kodamohi:
Verau kol-amme haaretz ki shem Adonai nikra alecha veyaru mimmekka
Veyechezun kol amme ara are shema daAdonai itkere alach veyidchalun minnach:
Vehotircha Adonai letova bifri vitnecha uvifri vehemtecha uvifri admatecha al haadama asher nishba Adonai laavotecha latet lach
Veyotrinnach Adonai letava bevalda dimach uvevalda divirach uveibba dearach al ara di kayyim Adonai laavahatach lemittan lach:
Yiftach Adonai lecha et-otzaro hattov et-hashshamayim latet metar-artzecha beitto ulevarech et kol-maase yadecha vehilvita goyim rabbim veatta lo tilve
Yiftach Adonai lach yat otzareh tava yat shemayya lemittan metar arach beiddaneh ulevaracha yat kol ovade yedach vetozef leammin saggiin veat la tezuf:
Unetancha Adonai lerosh velo lezanav vehayita rak lemala velo tihye lematta ki-tishma el-mitzvot Adonai elohecha asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom lishmor velaasot
Veyitteninnach Adonai letakkif vela lechallash utehe beram leella vela tehe letachta are tekabbal lefikkudayya daAdonai elahach di ana mefakkedach yoma den lemittar ulemebad:
Velo tasur mikkol-haddevarim asher anochi metzavve etchem hayyom yamin usemovl lalechet achare elohim acherim leovdam
Vela tistun mikkol pitgamayya di ana mefakked yatchon yoma den yammina usemala limhach batar taavat ammayya lemiflechinnun:
Vehaya im-lo tishma bekol Adonai elohecha lishmor laasot et-kol-mitzvotav vechukkotav asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom uvau alecha kol-hakkelalot haelle vehissigucha
Vihe im la tekabbal bememra daAdonai elahach lemittar lemebad yat kol pikkudohi ukeyamohi di ana mefakkedach yoma den veyetun alach kol levatayya haillen veyidbekunnach:
Arur atta bair vearur atta bassade
Lit at bekarta velit at bechakla:
Arur tanacha umishartecha
Lit sallach veatzvatach:
Arur peri-vitnecha uferi admatecha shegar alafecha veashterot tzonecha
Lit valda dimach veibba dearach bakre toraych veedre anach:
Arur atta bevoecha vearur atta betzetecha
Lit at bemealach velit at bemippekach:
Yeshallach Adonai becha et-hammeera et-hammehuma veet-hammigeret bechol-mishlach yadcha asher taase ad hishshamedcha vead-avodcha maher mippene roa maalalecha asher azavtani
Yegare Adonai bach yat meerta veyat shiggushayya veyat mezofita bechol oshatut yedach di tabed ad detishtetze vead detevad bifria min kodam bishut ovadaych dishvakta dachalti:
Yadbek Adonai becha et-haddaver ad kalloto otcha meal haadama asher-atta va-shamma lerishtah
Yadbek Adonai bach yat mota ad dishetze yatach meal ara di at alel letamman lemerta:
Yakkecha Adonai bashshachefet uvakkaddachat uvaddalleket uvacharchur uvacherev uvashshiddafon uvayyerakon uredafucha ad ovdecha
Yimchinnach Adonai beshachefta uvekaddachta uvidlekta uvecharchura uvecharba uveshiddefona uveyarkona veyirdefunnach ad detevad:
Vehayu shamecha asher al-roshcha nechoshet vehaaretz asher-tachtecha barzel
Vihon shemayyach di illave reshach chasinin kinchasha milleachata mitra veara di techotach takkifa chefarzela millemebad perin:
Yitten Adonai et-metar artzecha avak veafar min-hashshamayim yered alecha ad hishshamdach
Yitten Adonai yat metar arach avka veafra min shemayya yechut alach ad detishtetze:
Yittencha Adonai niggaf lifne oyvecha bederech echad tetze elav uveshiva derachim tanus lefanav vehayita lezaava lechol mamlechot haaretz
Yitteninnach Adonai tevir kodam sanach beorcha chada tippok levateh uveshiva orchan teirok mikkodamohi utehe lezia lechol malkevat ara:
Vehayta nivlatcha lemaachal lechol-of hashshamayim ulevehemat haaretz veen macharid
Utehe neviltach meshaggera lemechal lechol ofa dishmayya velivirat ara velet demanid:
Yakkecha Adonai bishchin mitzrayim uvattechorim uvaggarav uvechares asher lo-tuchal leherafe
Yimchinnach Adonai beshichana demitzrayim uvitchorin uvegarba uvacharis yabbish di la tikkul leittassaa:
Yakkecha Adonai beshiggaon uveivvaron uvetimhon levav
Yimchinnach Adonai betafshuta uvesamyuta uveshaamamut libba:
Vehayita memashshesh batztzohorayim kaasher yemashshesh haivver baafela velo tatzliach et-derachecha vehayita ach ashuk vegazul kol-hayyamim veen moshia
Utehe memashshesh betihara kema di mashshesh avvira bekavla vela tatzlach yat orchataych utehe beram ashik veanis kol yomayya velet defarik:
Ishsha teares veish acher yishkavenna bayit tivne velo-teshev bo kerem titta velo techallelennu
Itteta teros ugevar ochoran yishkevinna beta tivne vela tetev beh karma titztzov vela techallinneh:
Shorcha tavuach leenecha velo tochal mimmennu chamorcha gazul millefanecha velo yashuv lach tzoncha netunot leoyvecha veen lecha moshia
Torach yehe naches leenaych vela techul minneh chamarach yehe anes mikkodamach vela yetuv lach anach mesirin levaale devavach velet lach parik:
Banecha uvenotecha netunim leam acher veenecha root vechalot alehem kol-hayyom veen leel yadecha
Benaych uvenataych mesirin leamma ochoran veenaych chazan visufan biglalhen kol yoma velet chela bidach:
Peri admatcha vechol-yegiacha yochal am asher lo-yadata vehayita rak ashuk veratzutz kol-hayyamim
Ibba dearach vechol leutach yechul amma di la yedaat utehe veram ashik ureia kol yomayya:
Vehayita meshugga mimmare enecha asher tire
Utehe mishtatteh mechezu enaych di techeze:
Yakkecha Adonai bishchin ra al-habbirkayim veal-hashshokayim asher lo-tuchal leherafe mikkaf raglecha vead kodkodecha
Yimchinnach Adonai beshichana visha al rechuvayya veal shakayya di la tikkul leittassaa mipparsat raglach vead mochach:
Yolech Adonai otcha veet-malkecha asher takim alecha el-goy asher lo-yadata atta vaavotecha veavadta sham elohim acherim etz vaaven
Yagle Adonai yatach veyat malkach di tekim alach leam di la yedaat at vaavahataych vetiflach tamman leammayya palche taavata aa veavna:
Vehayita leshamma lemashal velishnina bechol haammim asher-yenahegcha Adonai shamma
Utehe letzadu limtal uleshoe bechol ammayya di yidberinnach Adonai letamman:
Zera rav totzi hassade umeat teesof ki yachselennu haarbe
Bar zera saggi tappek lechakla uzeer tichnosh are yachselinneh gova:
Keramim titta veavadta veyayin lo-tishte velo teegor ki tochlennu hattolaat
Karmin titztzov vetiflach vechamra la tishte vela tichnosh are techlinneh tolata:
Zetim yihyu lecha bechol-gevulecha veshemen lo tasuch ki yishshal zetecha
Zetin yehon lach bechol techumach umishcha la tesuch are yitterun zetaych:
Banim uvanot tolid velo-yihyu lach ki yelchu bashshevi
Benin uvenan tolid vela yehon lach are yehachun beshivya:
Kol-etzcha uferi admatecha Adonairesh hatztzelatzal
Kol ilanach veibba dearach yachseninneh sakkaa:
Hagger asher bekirbecha yaale alecha mala mala veatta tered matta matta
Totav arel di venach yehe salik el minnach leella leella veat tehe nachet letachta letachta:
Hu yalvecha veatta lo talvennu hu yihye lerosh veatta tihye lezanav
Hu yozfinnach veat la tozfinneh hu yehe letakkif veat tehe lechallash:
Uvau alecha kol-hakkelalot haelle uredafucha vehissigucha ad hishshamdach ki-lo shamata bekol Adonai elohecha lishmor mitzvotav vechukkotav asher tzivvach
Veyetun alach kol levatayya haillen veyirdefunnach veyidbekunnach ad detishtetze are la kabbelta lememra daAdonai elahach lemittar pikkudohi ukeyamohi di fakkedach:
Vehayu vecha leot ulemofet uvezaracha ad-olam
Vihon bach leat ulemofet uvivnaych ad olam:
Tachat asher lo-avadta et-Adonai elohecha besimcha uvetuv levav merov kol
Cholaf di la felachta kodam Adonai elahach bechedva uveshappirut libba missege kolla:
Veavadta et-oyvecha asher yeshallechennu Adonai bach beraav uvetzama uveerom uvechoser kol venatan ol barzel al-tzavvarecha ad hishmido otach
Vetiflach yat baale devavach di yegarinneh Adonai bach bechafna uvetzachuta uveartilyata uvachasirut kolla veyitten nir parzela al tzavverach ad dishetze yatach:
Yissa Adonai alecha goy merachok miktze haaretz kaasher yide hannasher goy asher lo-tishma leshono
Yayti Adonai alach am merachik misseyafe ara kema di mishtedi nishra amma di la tishma lishaneh:
Goy az panim asher lo-yissa fanim lezaken venaar lo yachon
Am takkif appin di la yissav appin lesava veal yanka la merachem:
Veachal peri vehemtecha uferi-admatcha ad hishshamdach asher lo-yashir lecha dagan tirosh veyitzhar shegar alafecha veashterot tzonecha ad haavido otach
Veyechul valda divirach veibba dearach ad detishtetze di la yashar lach ivura chamra umishcha bakre toraych veedre anach ad deyoved yatach:
Vehetzar lecha bechol-shearecha ad redet chomotecha haggevohot vehabbetzurot asher atta boteach bahen bechol-artzecha vehetzar lecha bechol-shearecha bechol-artzecha asher natan Adonai elohecha lach
Veyaek lach bechol kirvaych ad deyichbash shuraych ramayya ucherichayya di at rachetz leishtezava behen bechol arach veyaek lach bechol kirvaych bechol arach di yehav Adonai elahach lach:
Veachalta feri-vitnecha besar banecha uvenotecha asher natan-lecha Adonai elohecha bematzor uvematzok asher-yatzik lecha oyvecha
Vetechul valda dimach besar benaych uvenataych di yehav lach Adonai elahach bitzyara uveakta deyaek lach sanach:
Haish harach becha veheanog meod tera eno veachiv uveeshet cheko uveyeter banav asher yotir
Gavra derakkich bach vedimfannak lachada tivesh eneh beachuhi uveittat keyameh uvishar benohi di yashar:
Mittet leachad mehem mibbesar banav asher yochel mibbeli hishir-lo kol bematzor uvematzok asher yatzik lecha oyivcha bechol-shearecha
Millemittan lechad minnehon mibbesar benohi di yechul middela ishtaar leh kolla bitzyara uveakta di yaek lach sanach bechol kirvaych:
Harakka vecha vehaanugga asher lo-nisseta chaf-raglah hatztzeg al-haaretz mehitanneg umeroch tera enah beish chekah uvivnah uvevittah
Derakkicha vach vedimfanneka di la nassiat parsat ragla laachata al ara mimmefanneku umerakkichu tavesh ena bigvar keyama uvivra uvivratta:
Uveshilyatah hayyotzet mibben ragleha uvevaneha asher teled ki-tochlem bechoser-kol bassater bematzor uvematzok asher yatzik lecha oyivcha bisharecha
Uvizer benaha deyippekun minna uvivnaha di telid are techlinnun bachasirut kolla besitra bitzyara uveakta di yaek lach sanach bekirvaych:
Im-lo tishmor laasot et-kol-divre hattora hazzot hakketuvim bassefer hazze leyira et-hashshem hannichbad vehannora hazze et Adonai elohecha
Im la tittar lemebad yat kol pitgame orayta hada dichtivin besifra haden lemidchal yat shema yakkira udechila haden yat Adonai elahach:
Vehifla Adonai et-makkotcha veet makkot zarecha makkot gedolot veneemanot vocholayim raim veneemanim
Veyafrash Adonai yat machatach veyat machat benaych machan ravrevan umehemnan umachteshin bishin umehemnin:
Veheshiv becha et kol-madve mitzrayim asher yagorta mippenehem vedavku bach
Veyatev bach yat kol machteshe mitzrayim di dechelta mikkodamehon veyidbekun bach:
Gam kol-choli vechol-makka asher lo chatuv besefer hattora hazzot yalem Adonai alecha ad hishshamdach
Af kol mera vechol macha di la chetivin besifra deorayta hada yaytinnun Adonai alach ad deyishtetzach:
Venishartem bimte meat tachat asher heyitem kechochve hashshamayim larov ki-lo shamata bekol Adonai elohecha
Vetishtaarun beam zeer cholaf di havetun kechochve shemayya lemisge are la kabbelta lememra daAdonai elahach:
Vehaya kaasher-sas Adonai alechem lehetiv etchem uleharbot etchem ken yasis Adonai alechem lehaavid etchem ulehashmid etchem venissachtem meal haadama asher-atta va-shamma lerishtah
Vihe kema dichadde Adonai alechon leotava yatchon uleasgaa yatchon ken yechede Adonai alechon leovada yatchon uleshetzaa yatchon vetittaltelun meal ara diat alel letamman lemerta:
Vehefitzcha Adonai bechol-haammim miktze haaretz vead-ketze haaretz veavadta sham elohim acherim asher lo-yadata atta vaavotecha etz vaaven
Vivadderinnach Adonai bechol ammayya misseyafe ara vead seyafe ara vetiflach tamman leammayya palche taavata di la yedata at vaavahatach aa veavna:
Uvaggoyim hahem lo targia velo-yihye manoach lechaf-raglecha venatan Adonai lecha sham lev raggaz vechilyon enayim vedaavon nafesh
Uveammayya hainnun la tenuach vela yehe menach lefarsat raglach veyitten Adonai lach tamman lev dachel vechashchat aynin umappechan nefash:
Vehayu chayyecha teluim lecha minneged ufachadta layla veyomam velo taamin bechayyecha
Vihon chayyaych telan lach mikkovel utehe tave lelya vimama vela tehemin bechayyaych:
Babboker tomar mi-yitten erev uvaerev tomar mi-yitten boker mippachad levavcha asher tifchad umimmare enecha asher tire
Betzafra temar man yitten ramsha uveramsha temar man yitten tzafra mittavhut libbach di tehe tave umechezu enaych di tehe chaze:
Veheshivcha Adonai mitzrayim booniyyot badderech asher amarti lecha lo-tosif od lirotah vehitmakkartem sham leoyvecha laavadim velishfachot veen kone
Veyatevinnach Adonai mitzrayim bisfinan beorcha di amarit lach la tosef od lemechzeya vetizdabbenun tamman levaale devavach leavdin uleamhan velet dekane:
Elle divre habberit asher-tzivva Adonai et-moshe lichrot et-bene yisrael beeretz moav millevad habberit asher-karat ittam bechorev
Illen pitgame keyama di fakkid Adonai yat mshe lemigzar im bene yisrael beara demoav bar mikkeyama di gezar immehon bechorev:
Vayyikra moshe el-kol-yisrael vayyomer alehem attem reitem et kol-asher asa Adonai leenechem beeretz mitzrayim lefaro ulechol-avadav ulechol-artzo
Ukera mshe lechol yisrael vaamar lehon attun chazetun yat kol di avad Adonai leenechon beara demitzrayim lefaro ulechal avdohi ulechal areh:
Hammassot haggedolot asher rau enecha haotot vehammoftim haggedolim hahem
Nisse ravrevayya di chazaa enaych atayya umoftayya ravrevayya hainnun:
Velo-natan Adonai lachem lev ladaat veenayim lirot veoznayim lishmoa ad hayyom hazze
Vela yehav Adonai lechon libba lemidda veaynin lemecheze veudnin lemishma ad yoma haden:
Vaolech etchem arbaim shana bammidbar lo-valu salmotechem mealechem venaalcha lo-valta meal raglecha
Vedabbarit yatchon arbein shenin bemadbera la veliat kesutechon minnechon umesanach la ado meal raglach:
Lechem lo achaltem veyayin veshechar lo shetitem lemaan tedu ki ani Adonai elohechem
Lachma la achaltun vachamar chadat veattik la shetetun bedil detiddeun are ana Adonai elahachon:
Vattavou el-hammakom hazze vayyetze sichon melech-cheshbon veog melech-habbashan likratenu lammilchama vannakkem
Vaatetun leatra haden unefak sichon malka decheshbon veog malka dematnan lokodamutana laagacha kerava umechonun:
Vannikkach et-artzam vannittenah lenachala laruveni velaggadi velachatzi shevet hamenashshi
Unesivna yat arahon vihavinna leachasana leshivta diruven uleshivta degad ulefalgut shivta dimnashshe:
Ushemartem et-divre habberit hazzot vaasitem otam lemaan taskilu et kol-asher taasun
Vetitterun yat pitgame keyama hada vetabedun yathon bedil detitzlechun yat kol di tabedun:
Attem nitztzavim hayyom kullechem lifne Adonai elohechem rashechem shivtechem ziknechem veshotrechem kol ish yisrael
Attun kaymin yoma den kalchon kodam Adonai elahachon reshechon shivtechon savechon vesarchechon kol enash yisrael:
Tappechem neshechem vegercha asher bekerev machanecha mechotev etzecha ad shoev memecha
Taflechon neshechon vegiyyorach di bego mashritaych millaket aaych ad mele mayyaych:
Leovrecha bivrit Adonai elohecha uvealato asher Adonai elohecha koret immecha hayyom
Leaalutach bikyama dayya elahach uvemomateh di Adonai elahach gezar immach yoma den:
Lemaan hakim-otcha hayyom lo leam vehu yihye-llecha lelohim kaasher dibber-lach vechaasher nishba laavotecha leavraham leyitzchak uleyaakov
Bedil laakama yatach yoma den kodamohi leamma vehu yehe lach leelah kema di mallil lach uchema di kayyim laavahatach leavraham leyitzchak uleyaakov:
Velo ittechem levaddechem anochi koret et-habberit hazzot veet-haala hazzot
Vela immechon bilchodechon ana gezar yat keyama hada veyat momata hada:
Ki et-asher yeshno po immanu omed hayyom lifne Adonai elohenu veet asher enennu po immanu hayyom
Are yat man deitohi hacha immana kaem yoma den kodam Adonai elahana veyat di letohi hacha immana yoma den:
Ki-attem yedatem et asher-yashavnu beeretz mitzrayim veet asher-avarnu bekerev haggoyim asher avartem
Are attun yedatun yat ditevna beara demitzrayim veyat di avarna bego ammayya di avartun:
Vattiru et-shikkutzehem veet gillulehem etz vaeven kesef vezahav asher immahem
Vachazetun yat shikkutzehon veyat taavathon aa veavna kaspa vedahava di immehon:
Pen-yesh bachem ish o-ishsha o mishpacha o-shevet asher levavo fone hayyom meim Adonai elohenu lalechet laavod et-elohe haggoyim hahem pen-yesh bachem shoresh pore rosh velaana
Dilma it bechon gevar o itteta o zarit o shivta di libbeh pane yoma den middachalta daAdonai elahana lemehach lemiflach yat taavat ammayya hainnun dilma it bechon gevar meharhar chetin o zadon:
Vehaya beshomo et-divre haala hazzot vehitbarech bilvavo lemor shalom yihye-lli ki bishrirut libbi elech lemaan sefot harava et-hatztzemea
Vihe bemishmeeh yat pitgame momata hada vichashshav belibbeh lememar shelama yehe li are beharhor libbi ana azel bedil leosafa leh chete shaluta al zedanuta:
Lo-yove Adonai seloach lo ki az yeshan af-Adonai vekinato baish hahu veravtza bo kol-haala hakketuva bassefer hazze umacha Adonai et-shemo mittachat hashshamayim
La yeve Adonai lemishbak leh are bechen yitkef rogza daAdonai vechemteh begavra hahu veyidbekun beh kol levatayya dichtivin besifra haden veyimche Adonai yat shemeh mittechot shemayya:
Vehivdilo Adonai leraa mikkol shivte yisrael kechol alot habberit hakketuva besefer hattora hazze
Veyafreshinneh Adonai levisha mikkol shivtayya deyisrael kechol levate keyama dichtivin besifra deorayta haden:
Veamar haddor haacharon benechem asher yakumu meacharechem vehannochri asher yavo meeretz rechoka verau et-makkot haaretz hahiv veet-tachalueha asher-chilla Adonai bah
Veyemar dara vatraa benechon di yekumun mibbatrechon uvar ammin deyete meara rechika veyechezun yat mechata deara hahi veyat maraha di amra Adonai ba:
Gofrit vamelach serefa chol-artzah lo tizzara velo tatzmiach velo-yaale vah kol-esev kemapechat sedom vaamora adma utzevoyim asher hafach Adonai beappo uvachamato
Gafreta umilcha yekidat kol ara la tizra vela tatzmach vela yissak ba kol esba kemapechta disdom vaamora adma utzevoyim di hafach Adonai berogzeh uvechemteh:
Veamru kol-haggoyim al-me asa Adonai kacha laaretz hazzot me chori haaf haggadol hazze
Veyemrun kol ammayya al me avad Adonai keden leara hada ma tekof rogza rabba haden:
Veamru al asher azvu et-berit Adonai elohe avotam asher karat immam behotzio otam meeretz mitzrayim
Veyemrun al dishvaku yat keyama daAdonai elaha daavahathon di gezar immehon beappakuteh yathon meara demitzrayim:
Vayyelchu vayyaavdu elohim acherim vayyishtachavu lahem elohim asher lo-yedaum velo chalak lahem
Vaazalu ufelachu letaavat ammayya usegidu lehon dachalan di la yedaunnun vela otiva lehon:
Vayyichar-af Adonai baaretz hahiv lehavi aleha et-kol-hakkelala hakketuva bassefer hazze
Utekef rogza daAdonai beara hahi leaytaa ala yat kol levatayya dichtivin vesifra haden:
Vayyitteshem Adonai meal admatam beaf uvechema uveketzef gadol vayyashlichem el-eretz acheret kayyom hazze
Vetaltelinnun Adonai meal arahon birgaz uvechema uvechemta uvitkof regaz veaglinnun leara ochori keyoma haden:
Hannistarot la-Adonai elohenu vehanniglot lanu ulevanenu ad-olam laasot et-kol-divre hattora hazzot
Demittammeran kodam Adonai elahana udemiggolyan lana velivnana ad olam lemebad yat kol pitgame orayta hada:
Vehaya chi-yavou alecha kol-haddevarim haelle habberacha vehakkelala asher natatti lefanecha vahashevota el-levavecha bechol-haggoyim asher hiddichacha Adonai elohecha shamma
Vihe are yetun alach kol pitgamayya haillen birchan ulevatin di yehavit kodamach utetuv lelibbach bechol ammayya di aglach Adonai elahach letamman:
Veshavta ad-Adonai elohecha veshamata vekolo kechol asher-anochi metzavvecha hayyom atta uvanecha bechol-levavcha uvechol-nafshecha
Utetuv ledachalta daAdonai elahach utekabbal lememreh kechol di ana mefakkedach yoma den at uvenaych bechol libbach uvechol nafshach:
Veshav Adonai elohecha et-shevutecha verichamecha veshav vekibbetzcha mikkol-haammim asher hefitzcha Adonai elohecha shamma
Vituv Adonai elahach yat shave galvatach viracham alach vituv veyichneshinnach mikkol ammayya di yevadderinnach Adonai elahach letamman:
Im-yihye niddachacha biktze hashshamayim mishsham yekabbetzcha Adonai elohecha umishsham yikkachecha
Im yehe galvatach bisyafe shemayya mittamman yichneshinnach Adonai elahach umittamman yekarvinnach:
Veheviacha Adonai elohecha el-haaretz asher-yarshu avotecha virishtah vehetivcha vehirbecha meavotecha
Veyaelinnach Adonai elahach leara diritu avahatach veterta veyotev lach veyasginnach meavahatach:
Umal Adonai elohecha et-levavcha veet-levav zarecha leahava et-Adonai elohecha bechol-levavcha uvechol-nafshecha lemaan chayyecha
Veyede Adonai elahach yat tafshut libbach veyat tafshut libba divnaych lemircham yat Adonai elahach bechol libbach uvechol nafshach bedil chayyaych:
Venatan Adonai elohecha et kol-haalot haelle al-oyvecha veal-sonecha asher redafucha
Veyitten Adonai elahach yat kol levatayya haillen al baale devavach veal sanach di redafuch:
Veatta tashuv veshamata bekol Adonai veasita et-kol-mitzvotav asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom
Veat tetuv utekabbal bememra daAdonai vetabed yat kol pikkudohi di ana mefakkedach yoma den:
Vehotircha Adonai elohecha bechol maase yadecha bifri vitnecha uvifri vehemtecha uvifri admatcha letova ki yashuv Adonai lasus alecha letov kaasher-sas al-avotecha
Veyotrinnach Adonai elahach bechol ovade yedach bevalda dimach uvevalda divirach uveibba dearach letava are yetuv Adonai lemechede alach letav kema di chadi al avahatach:
Ki tishma bekol Adonai elohecha lishmor mitzvotav vechukkotav hakketuva besefer hattora hazze ki tashuv el-Adonai elohecha bechol-levavcha uvechol-nafshecha
Are tekabbal bememra dayya elahach lemittar pikkudohi ukeyamohi dichtivin besifra deorayta haden are tetuv kodam Adonai elahach bechol libbach uvechol nafshach:
Ki hammitzva hazzot asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom lo-niflet hiv mimmecha velo rechoka hiv
Are tafkedta hada di ana mefakkedach yoma den la mafresha hi minnach vela rechika hi:
Lo vashshamayim hiv lemor mi yaale-llanu hashshamayma veyikkacheha lanu veyashmienu otah venaasenna
La vishmayya hi lememar man yissak lana lishmayya veyisseva lana veyashmeinnana yata venabedinna:
Velo-meever layyam hiv lemor mi yaavor-lanu el-ever hayyam veyikkacheha lanu veyashmienu otah venaasenna
Vela meivra leyamma hi lememar man yeivar lana leivra deyamma veyisseva lana veyashmeinnana yata venabedinna:
Ki-karov elecha haddavar meod beficha uvilvavcha laasoto
Are kariv lach pitgama lachada befumach uvelibbach lemebedeh:
Ree natatti lefanecha hayyom et-hachayyim veet-hattov veet-hammavet veet-hara
Chaze dihavit kodamach yoma den yat chayye veyat tavta veyat mota veyat bisha:

Asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom leahava et-Adonai elohecha lalechet bidrachav velishmor mitzvotav vechukkotav umishpatav vechayita veravita uverachcha Adonai elohecha baaretz asher-atta va-shamma lerishtah

Di ana mefakkedach yoma den lemircham yat Adonai elahach limhach beorchan detaknan kodamohi ulemittar pikkudohi ukeyamohi vedinohi veteche vetisge vivarechinnach Adonai elahach beara di at alel letamman lemerta:
Veim-yifne levavcha velo tishma veniddachta vehishtachavita lelohim acherim vaavadtam
Veim yifne libbach vela tekabbel vetite vetisgud letaavat ammayya vetiflechinnun:
Higgadti lachem hayyom ki avod tovedun lo-taarichun yamim al-haadama asher atta over et-hayyarden lavo shamma lerishtah
Chavveti lechon yoma den are mevad tevdun la torchon yomin al ara di at aver yat yardena lemeal letamman lemerta:
Haidoti vachem hayyom et-hashshamayim veet-haaretz hachayyim vehammavet natatti lefanecha habberacha vehakkelala uvacharta bachayyim lemaan tichye atta vezarecha
Ashedit bechon yoma den yat shemayya veyat ara chayye umota yehavit kodamach birchan ulevatin vetittire bechayye bedil deteche at uvenaych:
Leahava et-Adonai elohecha lishmoa bekolo uledovka-vo ki hu chayyecha veorech yamecha lashevet al-haadama asher nishba Adonai laavotecha leavraham leyitzchak uleyaakov latet lahem
Lemircham yat Adonai elahach lekabbala lememreh uleitkarava ledachalteh are hu chayyaych veorachut yomaych lemittav al ara di kayyim Adonai laavahatach leavraham leyitzchak uleyaakov lemittan lehon:
Vayyelech moshe vaydabber et-haddevarim haelle el-kol-yisrael
Vaazal mshe umallil yat pitgamayya haillen im kol yisrael:
Vayyomer alehem ben-mea veesrim shana anochi hayyom lo-uchal od latzet velavo va-Adonai amar elay lo taavor et-hayyarden hazze
Vaamar lehon bar mea veesrin shenin ana yoma den let ana yachil od lemippak ulemeal vaAdonai amar li la teibbar yat yardena haden:
Adonai elohecha hu over lefanecha hu-yashmid et-haggoyim haelle millefanecha virishtam yehoshua hu over lefanecha kaasher dibber Adonai
Adonai elahach memreh yeivar kodamach hu yeshetze yat ammayya haillen mikkodamach vetertinnun yehoshua hu aver kodamach kema di mallil Adonai:
Veasa Adonai lahem kaasher asa lesichon uleog malche haemori uleartzam asher hishmid otam
Veyabed Adonai lehon kema di avad lesichon uleog malche emoraa ulearahon di shetzi yathon:
Unetanam Adonai lifnechem vaasitem lahem kechol-hammitzva asher tzivviti etchem
Veyimserinnun Adonai kodamechon vetabedun lehon kechal tafkedta di fakkedit yatchon:
Chizku veimtzu al-tiru veal-taartzu mippenehem ki Adonai elohecha hu haholech immach lo yarpecha velo yaazvekka
Tekifu veallimu la tidchalun vela tittavrun mikkodamehon are Adonai elahach hu dimdabbar kodamach la yishbekinnach vela yarteshinnach:
Vayyikra moshe lihoshua vayyomer elav leene chol-yisrael chazak veematz ki atta tavo et-haam hazze el-haaretz asher nishba Adonai laavotam latet lahem veatta tanchilenna otam
Ukera mshe lihoshua vaamar leh leene chol yisrael tekaf veallim are at teul im amma haden leara di kayyim Adonai laavahathon lemittan lehon veat tachseninna yathon:
Va-Adonai hu haholech lefanecha hu yihye immach lo yarpecha velo yaazvekka lo tira velo techat
VaAdonai hu dimdabbar kodamach memreh yehe vesadach la yishbekinnach vela yarchekinnach la tidchal vela tittevar:
Vayyichtov moshe et-hattora hazzot vayyittenah el-hakkohanim bene levi hannosim et-aron berit Adonai veel-kol-zikne yisrael
Uchetav mshe yat orayta hada vihava lechahanayya bene levi denatlin yat aron keyama daAdonai ulechal save yisrael:
Vaytzav moshe otam lemor mikketz sheva shanim bemoed shenat hashshemitta bechag hassukkot
Ufakkid mshe yathon lememar missof sheva shenin bizman shatta dishmitteta bechagga dimtallayya:
Bevo chol-yisrael leraot et-pene Adonai elohecha bammakom asher yivchar tikra et-hattora hazzot neged kol-yisrael beoznehem
Bemete chol yisrael leitchazaa kodam Adonai elahach beatra di yittire tikre yat orayta hada kodam kol yisrael vetashmeinnun:
Hakhel et-haam haanashim vehannashim vehattaf vegercha asher bisharecha lemaan yishmeu ulemaan yilmedu veyaru et-Adonai elohechem veshamru laasot et-kol-divre hattora hazzot
Kenosh yat amma guvrayya uneshayya vetafla vegiyyorach di vekirvaych bedil deyishmeun uvedil deyillefun veyidchalun mikkodam Adonai elahachon veyitterun lemebad yat kol pitgame orayta hada:
Uvenehem asher lo-yadu yishmeu velamdu leyira et-Adonai elohechem kol-hayyamim asher attem chayyim al-haadama asher attem ovrim et-hayyarden shamma lerishtah
Uvenehon di la yadun yishmeun veyallefun lemidchal yat Adonai elahachon kol yomayya di attun kayyamin al ara di attun avrin yat yardena tamman lemerta:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe hen karvu yamecha lamut kera et-yehoshua vehityatztzevu beohel moed vaatzavvennu vayyelech moshe vihoshua vayyityatztzevu beohel moed
Vaamar Adonai lemshe ha kerivu yomaych limmat kera yat yehoshua veitattadu bemashkan zimna veefakkedinneh vaazal mshe vihoshu veitattadu bemashkan zimna:
Vayyera Adonai baohel beammud anan vayyaamod ammud heanan al-petach haohel
Veitgeli Adonai bemashkena beammuda daanana vekam ammuda daanana al tera mashkena:
Vayyomer Adonai el-moshe hinnecha shochev im-avotecha vekam haam hazze vezana achare elohe nechar-haaretz asher hu va-shamma bekirbo vaazavani vehefer et-beriti asher karatti itto
Vaamar Adonai lemshe ha at shachev im avahatach vikum amma haden veyite batar taavat amme ara di hu al tamman benehon veyishbekun dachalti veyashnun yat keyami di gezarit immehon:
Vechara appi vo vayyom-hahu vaazavtim vehistarti fanay mehem vehaya leechol umetzauhu raot rabbot vetzarot veamar bayyom hahu halo al ki-en elohay bekirbi metzauni haraot haelle

Veyitkof rogzi vehon beyoma hahu vearchekinnun veesallek shechinti minnehon vihon lemibbaz veyiaran yathon bishan saggian veakan veyemar beyoma hahu hala middelet shechinat elahay beni aruni bishayya haillen:
Veanochi haster astir panay bayyom hahu al kol-haraa asher asa ki fana el-elohim acherim
Vaana sallaka esallek shechinti minnehon beyoma hahu al kol bisha di avadu are itpeniyyu letaavat ammayya:
Veatta kitvu lachem et-hashshira hazzot velammedah et-bene-yisrael simah befihem lemaan tihye-lli hashshira hazzot leed bivne yisrael
Uchean ketivu lechon yat tushbachta hada veallefa yat bene yisrael shavveya befumhon bedil dithe kodamay tushbachta hada lesahid bivne yisrael:
Ki-aviennu el-haadama asher-nishbati laavotav zavat chalav udevash veachal vesava vedashen ufana el-elohim acherim vaavadum veniatzuni vehefer et-beriti
Are aelinnun leara di kayyemit laavahathon avda chalav udevash veyechlun veyisbeun veyitpannekun veyitpenun batar taavat ammayya veyiflechunnun veyirgezun kodamay veyashnun yat keyami:
Vehaya ki-timtzena oto raot rabbot vetzarot veanta hashshira hazzot lefanav leed ki lo tishshachach mippi zaro ki yadati et-yitzro asher hu ose hayyom beterem aviennu el-haaretz asher nishbati

Vihe are yearan yateh bishan saggian veakan vetatev tushbachta hada kodamohi lesahid are la titneshe mippum benehon are gele kodamay yat yitzrehon di innun avdin yoma den ad la aelinnun leara di kayyemit:
Vayyichtov moshe et-hashshira hazzot bayyom hahu vaylammedah et-bene yisrael
Uchetav mshe yat tushebachta hada beyoma hahu veallefinna livne yisrael:
Vaytzav et-yehoshua bin-nun vayyomer chazak veematz ki atta tavi et-bene yisrael el-haaretz asher-nishbati lahem veanochi eye immach
Ufakkid yat yehoshua bar nun vaamar tekef veallim are at tael yat bene yisrael leara di kayyemit lehon umemri yehe vesaaddach:
Vayhi kechallot moshe lichtov et-divre hattora-hazzot al-sefer ad tummam
Vahava kad shetze mshe lemichtav yat pitgame orayta hada al sifra ad dishlimu:
Vaytzav moshe et-haleviyyim nose aron berit-Adonai lemor
Ufakkid mshe yat levae natle aron keyama daAdonai lememar:
Lakoach et sefer hattora hazze vesamtem oto mitztzad aron berit-Adonai elohechem vehaya-sham becha leed
Sivu yat sifra deorayta haden uteshavvun yateh missetar arona keyama daAdonai elahachon vihe tamman bach lesahid:
Ki anochi yadati et-meryecha veet-orpecha hakkashe hen beodenni chay immachem hayyom mamrim heyitem im-Adonai veaf ki-achare moti
Are ana yedana yat sarvanutach veyat kedalach dekashya ha vead ana kayyam immechon yoma den mesarvin havetun kodam Adonai veaf are batar deemut:
Hakhilu elay et-kol-zikne shivtechem veshotrechem vaadabbera veoznehem et haddevarim haelle veaida bam et-hashshamayim veet-haaretz
Kenishu levati yat kol save shivtechon vesarchechon veemallel kodamehon yat pitgamayya haillen veashed behon yat shemayya veyat ara:
Ki yadati achare moti ki-hashchet tashchitun vesartem min-hadderech asher tzivviti etchem vekarat etchem haraa beacharit hayyamim ki-taasu et-hara beene Adonai lehachiso bemaase yedechem
Are yedana batar deemut are chabbala techabbelun vetistun min orcha di fakkedit yatchon uteara yatchon bishta besof yomayya are tabedun yat devish kodam Adonai leargaza kodamohi beovade yedechon:
Vaydabber moshe beozne kol-kehal yisrael et-divre hashshira hazzot ad tummam
Umallil mshe kodam kol kehala deyisrael yat pitgame tushebachta hada ad dishlimu:
Haazinu hashshamayim vaadabbera vetishma haaretz imre-fi
Atzitu shemayya veemallel vetishshema ara imre fummi:
Yaarof kammatar likchi tizzal kattal imrati kisirim ale-deshe vechirvivim ale-esev
Yevassam kemitra ulpani yitkabbal ketalla memri keruche mitra denashvin al dita vechirsise malkosha di al isba:
Ki shem Adonai ekra havu godel lelohenu
Are bishma daAdonai ana metzalle havu revuta kodam elahana:
Hatztzur tamim poolo ki chol-derachav mishpat el emuna veen avel tzaddik veyashar hu
Takkifa deshalmin ovadohi are kol rechateh dina elaha mehemna demin kodamohi avla la nafek demin kodam zakkay vekashshit hu:
Shichet lo lo banav mumam dor ikkesh ufetaltol
Chabbilu lehon la leh benayya di felachu letaavata dara deashniyyu ovadohi veishtanniyyu:
Ha le-Adonai tigmelu-zot am naval velo chacham halo-hu avicha kanecha hu ascha vaychonenecha
Ha kodam Adonai attun gamlin da amma dekabbilu orayta vela chakkimu hala hu avuch veat di leh hu avdach veatkenach:
Zechor yemot olam binu shenot dor-vador sheal avicha veyaggedcha zekenecha veyomru lach
Idkar yomin demin alma istakkal bishne dar vedar sheal avuch vichavvi lach savich veyemrun lach:
Behanchel elyon goyim behafrido bene adam yatztzev gevulot ammim lemispar bene yisrael
Beachasana illaa ammayya befarashuteh bene anasha kayyim techume ammayya leminyan bene yisrael:
Ki chelek Adonai ammo yaakov chevel nachalato
Are cholaka daAdonai ammeh yaakv adav achasanteh:
Yimtzaehu beeretz midbar uvetohu yelel yeshimon yesovevenhu yevonenehu yitztzerenhu keishon eno
Sappik tzorkehon beara madbera uvet tzachavana ater di let mayya ashrinnun sechor sechor leshechinteh allefinnun pitgame orayta netarinnun kevavat enehon:
Kenesher yair kinno al-gozalav yerachef yifros kenafav yikkachehu yissaehu al-evrato
Kenishra dimchish lekinneh al benohi mitchofef paris gadpohi mekabbelhon menattelhon al tekof evarohi:
Adonai badad yanchennu veen immo el nechar
Adonai bilchodohi atid leashrayutehon bealma dehu atid leitchaddata vela yitkayyam kodamohi palchan taavan:
Yarkivehu al-bomote aretz vayyochal tenuvot saday vayyenikehu devash missela veshemen mechalmish tzur
Ashrinnun al takfe ara veochalinnun bizzat sanehon vihav lehon bizzat shallite kirvin venichse yatve kerakkin takkifin:
Chemat bakar vachalev tzon im-chelev karim veelim bene-vashan veattudim im-chelev kilyot chitta vedam-enav tishte-chamer
Yehav lehon bizzat malchehon veshallitehon im tar ravrevehon vetakkifehon ama dearahon veachasantehon im bizzat chelehon umashshiryathon vedam gibbarehon yittashad kemayya:
Vayyishman yeshurun vayyivat shamanta avita kasita vayyittosh eloah asahu vaynabbel tzur yeshuato
Veattar yisrael uveat atzlach tekof kena nichsin ushevak palchan elaha deavdeh veargez kodam takkifa defarkeh:
Yakniuhu bezarim betoevot yachisuhu
Akniu kodamohi befalchan taavan betoevta argizu kodamohi:
Yizbechu lashshedim lo eloah elohim lo yedaum chadashim mikkarov bau lo searum avotechem
Dabbachu leshedin dilet behon tzeroch dachalan dela yedaunnun chadta di mikkariv itavida la itassaku vehon avahatchon:
Tzur yeladcha teshi vattishkach el mecholelecha
Dachala takkifa divraach itnesheta shevakta palchan elaha deavdach:
Vayyar Adonai vayyinatz mikkaas banav uvenotav
Ugeli kodam Adonai utekef rogzeh midargizu kadamohi benin uvenan:
Vayyomer astira fanay mehem ere ma acharitam ki dor tapuchot hemma banim lo-emun bam
Vaamar esalek shechinti minnehon geli kodamay ma yehe vesofehon are dara deashniyyu innun benayya dilet behon hemanu:
Hem kinuni velo-el kiasuni behavlehem vaani akniem belo-am begoy naval achisem
Innun akniu kodamay bela dachala argizu kodamay befalchan taavan vaana akninnun bela am beamma tafsha argezinnun:
Ki-esh kadcha veappi vattikad ad-sheol tachtit vattochal eretz vivulah vattelahet mosde harim
Are kiddum takkif keeshsha nefak mikkodamay birgaz veshetze ad sheol arait veasef ara vaalalta veshetziyyat ad seyafe turayya:
Aspe alemo raot chitztzay achalle-bbam
Asef alehon bishin machtashay eshetze vehon:
Meze raav ulechume reshef veketev meriri veshen-behemot ashallach-bam im-chamat zochale afar
Nifiche chafan vaachule uf uchetishe ruchin bishan veshen chevat bara egare behon im chamat tanninayya dezachalin beafra:
Michutz teshakkel-cherev umechadarim ema gam-bachur gam-betula yonek im-ish seva
Mibbara tetakkel charba umittevanayya chargat mota af ulemehon af ulemathon yankehon im enash savehon:
Amarti afehem ashbita meenosh zichram
Amarit echul rogzi alehon veeshetzinnun evattal mibbene anasha ducheranehon:
Lule kaas oyev agur pen-yenakkeru tzaremo pen-yomru yadenu rama velo Adonai paal kol-zot
Illulafon rogza desana kenish dilma yitravrav beel devava dilma yemrun yedana tekifat lana vela min kodam Adonai havat kol da:
Ki-goy ovad etzot hemma veen bahem tevuna
Are am meabbede etza innun velet behon sucheletanu:
Lu chochmu yaskilu zot yavinu leacharitam
Illu chakkimu istakkalu veda sevaru ma yehe vesofehon:
Echa yirdof echad elef ushenayim yanisu revava im-lo ki-tzuram mecharam va-Adonai hisgiram
Echden yirdof chad alfa uteren yeerkun leribbota ellahen are takkifhon mesarinnun vaAdonai ashleminnun:
Ki lo chetzurenu tzuram veoyvenu pelilim
Are la chetakpana takpehon uvaale devavana havo dayyanana:
Ki-miggefen sedom gafnam umishshadmot amora anavemo inneve-rosh ashkelot merorot lamo
Are chefuranut amma disdom puranutehon velakutehon keam amra machathon bishin kereshe chevyan vetushlamat ovadehon kimrarutehon:
Chamat tanninim yenam verosh petanim achzar
Ha chemarat tanninayya ks puranutehon ucheresh petane chevyan achzerain:
Halo-hu kamus immadi chatum beotzrotay
Hala chol ovadehon gelan kodamay genizin leyom dina beotzray:
Li nakam veshillem leet tamut raglam ki karov yom edam vechash atidot lamo
Kodamay puranuta vaana ashallem leiddan deyiglun mearahon are kariv yom tevarhon umabba deatid lehon:
Ki-yadin Adonai ammo veal-avadav yitnecham ki yire ki-azlat yad veefes atzur veazuv
Are yedin Adonai dina deammeh ufuranut avdohi tzaddikayya yitpera are geli kodamohi dividdan dititkef alehon machat sana yehon mittaltelin ushevikin:
Veamar e elohemo tzur chasayu vo
Veyemar an dachalathon takkifa dahavo rechitzin beh:
Asher chelev zevachemo yochelu yishtu yen nesicham yakumu veyazeruchem yehi alechem sitra
Di terav nichsathon havo ochlin shatan chamar niskehon yekumun kean visaadunechon yehon alechon magen:
Reu atta ki ani ani hu veen elohim immadi ani amit vaachayye machatzti vaani erpa veen miyyadi matztzil
Chazo kean are ana ana hu velet elah bar minni ana memit umechayye machena veaf massena velet min yedi meshezev:
Ki-essa el-shamayim yadi veamarti chay anochi leolam
Are atkenit bishmayya bet shechinti vaamarit kayyam ana lealmin:
Im-shannoti berak charbi vetochez bemishpat yadi ashiv nakam letzaray velimsanay ashallem
Im al chad teren kechezu varka missof shemayya vead sof shemayya titgeli charbi vetitkef bedina yedi atev puranuta lesanay ulevaale devavay eshallem:
Ashkir chitztzay middam vecharbi tochal basar middam chalal veshivya merosh parot oyev
Eravve giray middema vecharbi tiktol beammayya middam ketilan veshivyan leadaa chitrin meresh sana uveel devava:
Harninu goyim ammo ki dam-avadav yikkom venakam yashiv letzarav vechipper admato ammo
Shabbachu ammayya ammeh are puranut avdohi tzaddikayya yitpera ufuranut yatev lesanohi vichappar al areh veal ammeh:
Vayyavo moshe vaydabber et-kol-divre hashshira-hazzot beozne haam hu vehoshea bin-nun
Vaata mshe umallil yat kol pitgame tushbachta hada kodam amma hu vehoshea bar nun:
Vaychal moshe ledabber et-kol-haddevarim haelle el-kol-yisrael
Veshetzi mshe lemallala yat kol pitgamayya haillen im kol yisrael:
Vayyomer alehem simu levavchem lechol-haddevarim asher anochi meid bachem hayyom asher tetzavvum et-benechem lishmor laasot et-kol-divre hattora hazzot
Vaamar lehon shavvu libbechon lechol pitgamayya di ana mashed bechon yoma den di tefakkedunnun yat benechon lemittar lemebad yat kol pitgame orayta hada:
Ki lo-davar rek hu mikkem ki-hu chayyechem uvaddavar hazze taarichu yamim al-haadama asher attem ovrim et-hayyarden shamma lerishtah
Are la fitgam reka hu minnechon are hu chayyechon uvefitgama haden torchun yomin al ara di attun avrin yat yardena tamman lemerta:
Vaydabber Adonai el-moshe beetzem hayyom hazze lemor
Umallil Adonai im mshe bichran yoma haden lememar:
Ale el-har haavarim hazze har-nevo asher beeretz moav asher al-pene yerecho uree et-eretz kenaan asher ani noten livne yisrael laachuzza
Sak letura daavarae haden tura dinvo di veara demoav di al appe yerecho vachaze yat ara dichnaan di ana yahev livne yisrael leachasana:
Umut bahar asher atta ole shamma veheasef el-ammecha kaasher-met aharon achicha behor hahar vayyeasef el-ammav
Umut betura di at salek letamman vetitkenesh leammach kema demit aharn achuch behor tura veitkenish leammeh:
Al asher mealtem bi betoch bene yisrael beme-merivat kadesh midbar-tzin al asher lo-kiddashtem oti betoch bene yisrael
Al di shakkartun bememri bego bene yisrael beme matztzut rekam madbera detzin al di la kaddishtun yati bego bene yisrael:
Ki minneged tire et-haaretz veshamma lo tavo el-haaretz asher-ani noten livne yisrael
Are mikkovel techeze yat ara uletamman la teul leara di ana yahev livne yisrael:
Vezot habberacha asher berach moshe ish haelohim et-bene yisrael lifne moto
Veda virketa di varich mshe neviyya daAdonai yat bene yisrael kodam moteh:
Vayyomar Adonai missinay ba vezarach misseir lamo hofia mehar paran veata merivvot kodesh mimino esh dat lamo
Vaamar Adonai missinay itgeli vezehor yekareh misseir itchazi lana itgeli vigvurteh mittura defaran veimmeh rivvat kaddishin ketav yammineh miggo eshshata orayta yehav lana:
Af chovev ammim kol-kedoshav beyadecha vehem tukku leraglecha yissa middabberotecha
Af chabbivinnun leshivtayya kol kaddishohi vet yisrael bigvura appekinnun mimmitzrayim veinnun middabberin techot ananach natlin al memrach:
Tora tzivva-lanu moshe morasha kehillat yaakov
Orayta yehav lana mshe mesara yerutta lechinshat yaakov:
Vayhi vishurun melech behitassef rashe am yachad shivte yisrael
Vahava veyisrael malka beitkannashut reshe amma kachada shivtayya deyisrael:
Yechi reuven veal-yamot vihi metav mispar
Yechi reuven lechayye alma umota tinyana la yemut vikabbelun benohi achasantehon beminyanhon:
Vezot lihuda vayyomar shema Adonai kol yehuda veel-ammo teviennu yadav rav lo veezer mitztzarav tihye
Veda lihuda vaamar kabbel Adonai tzeloteh dihuda bemippekeh leaggacha kerava uleammeh tatevinneh lishlam yedohi yabedan leh puranuta missanohi vesaid mibbaale devavohi have leh:
Ulelevi amar tummecha veurecha leish chasidecha asher nissito bemassa terivehu al-me meriva
Ulelevi amar tummayya veurayya albeshta ligvar deishtechach chasida kodamach di nassitohi benisseta vahava shelim bechantohi al me matztzuta veishtechach meheman:
Haomer leaviv uleimmo lo reitiv veet-echav lo hikkir veet-banav lo yada ki shamru imratecha uveritcha yintzoru
Deal avuhi veal immeh la rachem kad chavu min dina veappe achohi uvenohi la nesiv are netaru matterat memrach ukeyamach la ashniyyu:
Yoru mishpatecha leyaakov vetoratcha leyisrael yasimu ketora beappecha vechalil al-mizbechecha
Kashrin illen deyallefun dinaych leyaakov veorayatach leyisrael yeshavvun ketoret busemin kodamach ugemir leraava al madbechach:
Barech Adonai chelo ufoal yadav tirtze mechatz motnayim kamav umesanav min-yekumun
Barech Adonai nichsohi vekurban yedohi tekabbal beraava tevar chartza desanohi udevaale devavohi dela yekumun:
Levinyamin amar yedid Adonai yishkon lavetach alav chofef alav kol-hayyom uven ketefav shachen
Levinyamin amar rechima daAdonai yishre lerachtzan alohi yehi magen alohi kol yoma uveareh tishre shechinta:
Uleyosef amar mevorechet Adonai artzo mimmeged shamayim mittal umittehom rovetzet tachat
Uleyosef amar mevaracha min kodam Adonai areh avda magdanin mittalla dishmayya milleella umimmabbue enavan utehomin denagdan mimmaamakke ara millera:
Umimmeged tevuot shamesh umimmeged geresh yerachim
Veavda migdanin vaalalan mivul shimsha veavda migdanin meresh yerach birach:
Umerosh harre-kedem umimmeged givot olam
Umeresh turayya bakkirayya umittuv raman dila faskan:
Umimmeged eretz umeloah uretzon shochni sene tavota lerosh yosef ulekodkod nezir echav
Umittuv ara umelaa rae leh dishchinteh bishmayya veal mshe itgeli vaasana yatyan kol illen leresha deyosef uleganya s" ulegavra parisha daachohi:
Bechor shoro hadar lo vekarne reem karnav bahem ammim yenaggach yachdav afse-aretz vehem rivvot efrayim vehem alfe menashshe
Rabba divnohi ziva leh ugevuran deitavida leh mikkodam takpa veruma dileh bigvurteh ammayya yiktel kachada ad seyafe ara veinnun rivvata devet efrayim veinnun alfayya devet menashshe:
Velizvulun amar semach zevulun betzetecha veyissashchar beohalecha
Velizvulun amar chade zevulun bemippekach laagacha kerava al baale devavach veyissaschar bimhachach lemebad zimne moadayya birushelem:
Ammim har-yikrau sham yizbechu zivche-tzedek ki shefa yammim yinaku usefune temune chol
Shivtayya deyisrael letur bet makdesha yitkanneshun tamman yikkesun nichsat kudeshin leraava are nichse ammayya yechlun vesima demittamra vechala mitgalya lehon:
Ulegad amar baruch marchiv gad kelavi shachen vetaraf zeroa af-kodkod
Ulegad amar berich afte legad keleta share veyiktol shiltonin im malchin:
Vayyar reshit lo ki-sham chelkat mechokek safun vayyete rashe am tzidkat Adonai asa umishpatav im-yisrael
Veitkabbel bekadmeta dileh are tamman beachasanteh mshe safra rabba deyisrael kevir vehu nafek veal beresh amma zachvan kodam Adonai avad vedinohi im yisrael:
Uledan amar dan gur arye yezannek min-habbashan
Uledan amar dan takkif kegur aryavan areh shatya min nachalayya denagdan min matnan:
Ulenaftali amar naftali seva ratzon umale birkat Adonai yam vedarom yerasha
Ulenaftali amar naftali seva raava umele birchan min kodam Adonai maarav yam ginnosar vedaroma yerat:
Uleasher amar baruch mibbanim asher yehi retzuy echav vetovel bashshemen raglo
Uleasher amar berich mibbirkat benayya asher yehe raava leachohi veyitrabbe betafnuke malchin:
Barzel unechoshet minalecha ucheyamecha dovecha
Takkif kefarzela unechasha mutavach ucheyome ulematach takpach:
En kael yeshurun rochev shamayim beezrecha uvegaavato shechakim
Let elah keelaha deyisrael dishchinteh bishmayya besadach vetakpeh bishme shemayya:
Meona elohe kedem umittachat zeroot olam vaygaresh mippanecha oyev vayyomer hashmed
Medor elaha di millekadmin bememreh mitaved alma vetarich mikkodamach sana vaamar shetzi:
Vayyishkon yisrael betach badad en yaakov el-eretz dagan vetirosh af-shamav yaarfu tal
Ushera yisrael lerachtzan bilchodohi keen birketa divarechinnun yaakov avuhon leara avda ivur vachamar af shemayya diillavehon yeshammeshunnun betalla:
Ashrecha yisrael mi chamocha am nosha ba-Adonai magen ezrecha vaasher-cherev gaavatecha veyikkachashu oyvecha lach veatta al-bamotemo tidroch
Tuvach yisrael let dichvatach amma defurkaneh min kodam Adonai takkif besadach udemin kodamohi nitzchan gibbarvatach vichaddevun sanach lach veat al perikat tzavvere malchehon tidroch:
Vayyaal moshe mearvot moav el-har nevo rosh happisga asher al-pene yerecho vayyarehu Adonai et-kol-haaretz et-haggilad ad-dan
Uselek mshe mimmeshra demoav letura dinvo resh ramata di al appe yerecho veachzeyeh Adonai yat kol ara yat gilad ad dan:
Veet kol-naftali veet-eretz efrayim umenashshe veet kol-eretz yehuda ad hayyam haacharon
Veyat kol naftali veyat ara deefrayim umenashshe veyat kol ara dihuda ad yamma maarva:
Veet-hannegev veet-hakkikkar bikat yerecho ir hattemarim ad-tzoar
Veyat daroma veyat meshra bikata direcho karta dediklayya ad tzoar:
Vayyomer Adonai elav zot haaretz asher nishbati leavraham leyitzchak uleyaakov lemor lezaracha ettenenna heriticha veenecha veshamma lo taavor
Vaamar Adonai leh da ara di kayyemit leavraham leyitzchak uleyaakov lememar livnaych etteninna achazitach beenaych uletamman la teibbar:
Vayyamot sham moshe eved-Adonai beeretz moav al-pi Adonai
Umit tamman mshe avda daAdonai beara demoav al memra daAdonai:
Vayyikbor oto vaggay beeretz moav mul bet peor velo-yada ish et-kevurato ad hayyom hazze
Ukevar yateh bechelata beara demoav lokovel bet peor vela yeda enash yat kevurteh ad yoma haden:
Umoshe ben-mea veesrim shana bemoto lo-chahata eno velo-nas lecho
Umshe bar mea veasrin shenin kad mit la chehat enohi vela shena ziv yekara deappohi:
Vayyivku vene yisrael et-moshe bearvot moav sheloshim yom vayyittemu yeme vechi evel moshe
Uvecho vene yisrael yat mshe bemeshrayya demoav telatin yomin ushelimu yome vechita evla demshe:
Vihoshua bin-nun male ruach chochma ki-samach moshe et-yadav alav vayyishmeu elav bene-yisrael vayyaasu kaasher tzivva Adonai et-moshe
Vihoshua bar nun mele ruach chochmeta are semach mshe yat yedohi alohi vekabbilu minneh bene yisrael vaavadu kema di pakkid Adonai yat mshe:
Velo-kam navi od beyisrael kemoshe asher yedao Adonai panim el-panim
Vela kam neviyya od beyisrael kemshe di itgeli leh Adonai appin beappin:
Lechol-haotot vehammoftim asher shelacho Adonai laasot beeretz mitzrayim lefaro ulechol-avadav ulechol-artzo
Lechol atayya umoftayya di shalcheh Adonai lemebad beara demitzrayim lefaro ulechal avdohi ulechal areh:
Ulechol hayyad hachazaka ulechol hammora haggadol asher asa moshe leene kol-yisrael
Ulechol yeda takkefta ulechol chezvana rabba di avad mshe leene kol yisrael:
